setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: A quiet night this evening...
yes it is
Have any else come up this eve? I had hoped for a quiet night to examine the stars
Yes, a few came through, but it is a cold night for me, I am used to warmer weather
Well, you are but a common soldier.  No doubt you are used to such a lot.  Thankfully I have my spells to keep me warm.
I am a soldier doing my job
Yes... well... Very well then.  See that you do!  No slacking off while your betters are about.
No sir
When, for example, was this horn last tested?  It looks dented.  How can we be sure it will work?
A year ago, Test it out or cause a need to use it
Mayhap I will speak to the king about such lackness.  Or perhaps I can sell him a spell that will serve just as well.
Good idea, I agree, go do that
Get off of me, you fool!  Who gave you permission to touch me!
To the jail with you

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: You, prisoner. The king wishes to see you.
What for?
The king wishes to make a deal with you. Beyond me why he cares for a prisoner.
Thank heavens, I thought I would never see my family again.
Don't be so hasty. The king might ask more of you than you think.
At least I'll have a chance to explain myself.
You do that. But remember you were put in the dungeon for good cause.
I was placed here by mistake. They have me mixed up with another man!
They all tell me that. But this isn't my decision.
I understand. You are only doing your job.
At least you are cooperating. I'll mention that.
What have I been accused of doing?
You are accused of disobeying a direct order by the queen. As rigid as she is.
I don't remember being ordered by the queen to do anything.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: What are you doing here, archer?
An archer such as myself needs no reason to be at a nice place like this.
Since you are here, I need more wine. Please fill my glass immediately.
Yes sir, although you're under utilizing my ability with a bow and and arrow. What a lovely place you have here.
Thank you. My bed frame alone is more valuable than anything you've ever seen
A frame made from materials more valuable than my bow. Where would one acquire such a material?
That I cannot say. What do you hunt with your bow and arrow?
I hunt the enemy. I deal with those you consider unworthy. It's my most skilled practice. What else can I do for you?
Can you teach me how to use the weapon?
A skill like these is easy to learn but takes a lifetime to master.
I have always wanted to learn but was forbidden as a child.
That's outrageous. A child is more ready to learn than most. I will not neglect you like your parents have.
They were always afraid of any harm coming to their sole heir. I shall cherish our archery lessons.
Can I interrupt you for a moment to admire the gold tapestries on the walls? It resembles the material of your bed frame. Is your bed frame made of solid gold?

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

speech: Ah, another day of work for the king.  He means well but goodness, I don't know how the kingdom gets by sometimes.
Roar. rrrr Rawr.
Ah apologies, friend lion, I forgot my translation crystal.  You're all growls for me.  One moment while I fetch it.
Roar!!
Goodness, you are in a mood!  I know guarding this place isn't the most *interesting* of chores, but there's not need to be rude.  Now, hand it over, there's a good lad.

Apoligies, I was just excited for you to finally get the translation crystal so we could talk like the old friends we are. The redeeming this aout this place is the geodes. It looks pretty in a way, even though it still remains to be gloomy.

Ah well, now that we've both touched it again, the spell should last for a while without us needing to hold it.  Now then, how fares you?  It seems an age since we had but a breath to talk.  The king is nothing if not a taskmaster - not that I mind of course.

Your wisdom is a joy to behold as ever. I guess that is why you are the Wizard you are! I am sorry he has been working you so hard, but it is only because he trusts you will do the jobs he gives you with aplomb.
Ah my friend, it is good to hear you say such words of comfort.  And how fares our young lion friend?  He looks much improved since I chanced upon him in that hunter's trap.

Yes. The getting him out that trap required great effort. Who could hunt a majestic lion and not look him in the eye when he does it? He is still recovering, but doing better. Maybe the healing power of the geodes will help him further still.

I am certain that between the two of us, he will recover soon and we may release him.  I appreciate you looking after him in my stead, and it is good that the crystals are working.  I confess, I was not certain with a lion if they would have the same effect that I am used to.

I will roar at them to vibrate the geodes which might in turn stimulate their healing qualities. Like you say, a lion is not a small mass at it requires a little more time and energy to heal a beast of majesty.

Yes, you are truly magnificant, my friend.  I am sure he will be well in no time.  But I confess, I had another, more troubling reason to see you.  I have heard some troubling rumors from visitors to the castle, and was wondering if your mystic sense had any tremblings of premonition of future dangers>
Well the King certainly has his enemies. But would they seek to hurt him through an underground chamber? Or would they maintain the rules of engagement that we're supposed to uphold?

setting.name: Inside the fairy temple
setting.description: The fairy temple is very small.  No human has ever been in there, but there was a fairy interpreter that described it as covered in green leaves and grass.  He said they told him that there is a giant frog in the middle that eats all of the pesky flies.
setting.background: The fairy room was built by the fairies centuries ago.  It was built inside of a scarab beetle because the Egyptians admired the beetle, so they knew they would never destroy it.

speech: Ah, mighty frog that I am, I hunger!
Ahh I ought to annoy this ugly looking frog!
How dare you attack me in this holy fairy temple, you pesky fly!  I will destroy you and eat you!
Forget and forgive? I was really only looking to make friends.
I... I have never been hugged by a fly before.  I know not what to say.  Surely the very blades of grass tremble at this strange event.
See that beetle over yonder? I am sure it would make a tasty treaty for us...

Alas, friend fly, thought I used to be a prince, a fairy cursed me into a frog, doomed to forever eat flies in this temple.  But, should you help me eat that beetle, she once taunted me by saying I could be free if I but tasted it.  But I have been doomed here for an age...
I shall help my friend frog, you shan't cry! I will hug that beetle and transfer my diseases to it! And then we will feast on it!
Be careful, good fly!  For that bird is Her creature, and the foul beast has attacked me whenever I venture close to it.  But perhaps... it would not suspect such a trick and you could sneak past it.
Or perhaps I can distract it with my annoying screams and you can get it from behind?

A fine plan!  Should I be successful, good fly, I promise to always leave my garbage out for a full month to let it spoil, no matter how my father, the king will complain!  Ah, good fly, you give me hope!  For as much as I enjoy my lily pad, I would long for my castle as well.
I am glad I have left my villainous ways for once. I should live to pester you another day!
And I am glad that I did not eat you right away, delicious looking though you are.
Maybe we should get ourselves a room inside this luxurious temple?

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: I cannot let my city down
Is something happening?
I hope I can convince everyone of how sincere I truly am.
Did you come here to confess a sin?
I am truly sorry for any misunderstandings, I only want one more chance to prove my loyalty
Why has your loyalty been questioned?
Yes, no one believes I am who I say I am
That's so sad. Have you talked to the king?
The king refuses to see me.
Did you do something to make people question you?
Not that I recall
When did you receive your knighthood?
When I turned 18
You must have done something special to earn it at such a young age.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: What brings you to this royal hall, visitor? Speak, and be not afraid, for though I be of noble blood, I do not disdain speaking with the common folk.
Ah Knight! I bring grave news, news thats only for the King's ear!
Halt, there!  Speak this news to me, and I will make sure it reaches the King.  No one known goes before him without passing through me, first.
I.. I must speak to the King, and him alone!
There now, calm down!  Give me that!
Alright, alright! Dont hurt me! I bring news of a great devastation that might befall his King's realm in the coming days.
There now, take a breath!  What news is this?  Some new trouble on the border?  Goodness, I suppose I should put these here until the builders can fix it...
I was there Knight... oh such harrowing screams! The neighboring Kingdom has fallen to the Barbarian army! You must tell the King at once!
Those filth would dare! Ah... there there... you're alright now, you're safe.
Thank you kind Knight. You see, the King must know this information at once! Will you not tell him... ?
But of course, I will inform him.  But tell me more, when did this tragedy occur?  Where there many of them?
Yes... yes. Entire armies of Barbarians laid siege on the Kingdom. So many souls have gone in a brutal fight...
Well, never fear, visitor... what did you say your name was?
Why do need my name?
action: put red brick in kings throne

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: move horse
I may be just a horse but a prefer a little courtesy!
But  You're standing on my gold and silver flooring with your hooves
Yes but my hooves are polished to a shine every morning. They won't do it any harm!
And who do you think makes sure that happens? plus I've seen your poop on my flooring before and i don't want to see that happen again
It's not my faul that your latrines are only for the two legged! It's discrimination, I say!
so what, it's not like you'll know how to use them if provided.
I am a horse of great refinement and I resent that! Also ... oooh, can I have some of those carrots on the table?
i can't resist the most beautiful smile in the kingdom. Have as many carrots as you want!!
Are you sure the King won't be jealous about this?!
we'll just have to not tell him
But but .. he's right there! That said, he does seem to be mostly focused on his dinner
...oh yeah...if he truly loves me he won't get in the way between me and my horse
Well, it worked for Catherine the Great I suppose ...

setting.name: Mud pit
setting.description: The mudpit is dark and brown. The mud inside is sticky and hard to escape. The vegetation surrounding the area is matted down.
setting.background: The mud pit is in the center of the jungle. As animals pass by, they sink into the pit and cannot escape. Soon animals learn to avoid the pit. However, soldier's horses often get stuck, and royal carriages need to be sent to help them.

speech: Well THIS isn't at all what it looked like in the brochure
It is a dark place indeed. But don't let that put you off your holiday. You relax...
Well I think I will put in a strongly worded letter. Nonetheless, I suppose that when one is an enemy of the King and on the run, one cannot be too choosy
Why are you on the run?
I am avenging a blood feud between my family and that of the King. He's probably in the right, but I fancied a change of scenery. Not quite sure this was it though.
I've never met such an even handed outlaw!
One tries one best. And what is this barn cat doing in a, erm, mudpit? More to the point, can you give me a hoist out?

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Greetings, my Lord and King

I am King Fulmer and you have earned you meal for the next one month if you can tell me what happened to the silver ware I demanded to be ordered from Landon. Instead what I am seeing here is a seal of Zinzel kingdom on my kitchen utensils? do these subjects think because my father never enter the kicthen that I won't?
Erm, I, um .. it was on special
can  you kill the person in charge for me for disobeying my orders?
I can certainly speak very severely to them. Can I tempt you to something from this pot here?
you don't speak to you king like that soldier
I do apologise my Lord - I am new to the army and I am merely a humble peasant
You will arrange a meeting with the person in charge at once and let them know I want everything changed
That would cost a great deal of money my Lord

Yes I know we can plan all the arrangements and even set up a factory and start selling to other kingdoms with our seals on it. I want people to know we are better, how can my plate bear the seal of another kingdom. I can't even imagine. Hurry up soldier before I hit you again
S'alright, I'm used to it. What about a pay rise?
You  won't get a raise, instead you will spend a night in prison
Well honestly - this wasn't what they told me it would be like at my school career's guidance in fifth form.
everything in this kingdom seem to be going wrong, is this how my father ruled the kingdom.Or could it be that it's because I spent so much time study in MIT?

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Do you like this beautiful room? Soon it will be mine and I will rule this country.
I designed it. I'm somewhat an expert on things.
You must be looking forward to me being king. I will be the best king ever, believe me.
Sure! Once you're king, you'll need a trusted advisor. I'm the best advisor ever.
Yes! You have great taste. I love all of the gold in this room. Tell me how good I look wearing this robe. I will be the people's king. They will love me.
Oh yes, the robe is divine. A piece of advice, if I may, try this purple gauze wrapped around your head. It brings out your eyes.
I will need this gauze on the battlefield. I am a great military strategist. Many people say I know more than the generals do.
That sounds brilliant. Someday I hope to be as powerful as you.
Together we will make this kingdom great again! First though, you need to tell me where you  got this gilded mirror, I would like one for my summer house.
Oh, that is hand gilded by the castle gilders. You'll be able to have them gild you whatever you want when you're king.
I want it now. The Royal Prince does not wait.
I'm taking back this armor, robe and all this gauze, and I won't give you any more advice.
There! There! Do not be upset.
Here, let me put this armor away for you. You won't need it if we're going to remain friends.
action: steal gauzy purple fabric from advisor
put a king's armor in large chest of drawers

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: I need you to make me the best sword in this kingdom!
Well, there. It will cost you a grandeur pay.
No matter! The pay will be more than enough to buy you acres of land!
Well, let me see your gold first, and then I shall begin my work.
Very well hear it is! Now get to work!
I trust in you to keep your word, my King.
Take the hammer and make me the finest sword!

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Why hello there good sir knight, how are you on this fine day?
Doing well, Lord. Have you given any thought to my request for a pay raise?
Yes! Thank you for the reminder. I have spoken with the king and we both decided that due to your faithful service, an immediate raise will be bestowed.
Thank you. This goes a long way in helping me save enough to get a married, at a wedding which you, Lord, will be invited to!
That sounds splendid! I would be more than happy to host. Service to the king has left me with quite a bit of land to rule over.
Say, do you fancy giving me a promotion as well, seeing all this land that needs ruling...
Would that I could, good sir knight. For something like that, you'd have to speak to the king directly.
Unacceptable. After all my years of hard work and I am still a lowly Knight.
Why, I cannot believe this! After all I've done for you, this is how you repay me?!
Why yes, you don't deserve my service. I shall dance off into the sunset.
Good riddance! I'm sure I can find a knight more faithful among the dozens of tenants I have living here.
But none will be more talented than me!
Oh, that's where you're wrong. Your swordsmanship left much to be desired in all honesty.
Aye, now I feel insulted. Take that back!

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Just a moment, sir knight, let me finish up this here sword.  Ye shan't havfta wait too long, good sire.
I had expected this to be finished an hour ago, my good man
My apologies, my lord.  One of my apprentices caught the flux and it's been a bit hectic.  Now then, which weapon was it that you needed, my lord?
That nice, erm, sharp on there. AndI could do with a new shield.
Ah yes, the mace.  Of course, my lord.  A fine a weapon as you could ask for!  Is my lord heading into battle soon?  I had hoped.. that is the kingdom longs for peace, these days.
I hear were are to march again in three days. I am, of course, greatly looking forward to fighting for my King again

Yes, well, if you'll forgive me for speaking plain, m'lord, tis often the peasants that bare the brunt of the battle these days.  Food'll be scarce if you don't put an end to it soon.  There - 'tis my best work, m'lord.  I hope you'll put those knaves to flight with it.
It is very satisfactory, my good man. Truly, however, a war will take a long, gruelling toll, on both peasant and nobility alike

Well, best I can do is make the weapons of war so that you find lads- beg pardon- lordlings, make it home again.  Now I got a fresh batch of mithril, my lord, so shouldn't be more than a day a'fore your shield be ready.
Ah! our men have been to the Mines of Moria again. Tis a dangerous place

I've but heard whispers, but can say only the brave - or foolish- venture there.  They were lucky to make it out alive, what with the horrors seem to be bandied about there.  Dark times, dark times indeed...
Well, we all play our part. Without this fine sword that you have made for me, I could not myself do much good in the wars

Ah well, tis good of you to say, Sir Knight.  You're a credit to us all, y'are, and tis not many a knight that takes the time to talk to us common folk.  Tis good 'ta hear one take pride in the work we do here.
Will you shake my hand, my good man?

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hm, this room is nice, but I do wish a fireplace was nearby...
It is rather chilly but if you sit on my lap we will keep each other warm
You understand me!  What luck - yes, a good cuddle sounds just the thing.
I only let you in here because I am so fond of you all. Do you know how much this carpet cost?
As much as one of these shiny rock things?
oh boy .. be careful with that!
For you, for the bones from last night.  Those must be worth at least as much as a carpet, they were so tasty!
I cannot thank you enough, oh dogs. I love you almost as much as I love the King
Ah yes, well, I am a magnificent specimen.  All thieves and wrongdoers fear me with my fearsome bark!
Naturally, as Queen, I would only have the best pedigree dogs
Is the king returning soon?  He left his crown lying about - very careless.  I always bury my valueables for safekeeping
He will be back any day now. Please let me have that for safe keeping
Gotta catch me first!  Wheee, what fun!
This is very difficult to do in these garments

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

I am a royal guard of the king
well i am sorry royal guard of the king, I am a thief.

then at least let me take this. Please? I am very poor, and although a scoundrel I still pay taxes like the rest of us!

I am a poor, broken, man. I have eighteen children. And seventeen are redheads!
Should have tried for the ruby then lol
I'm not so bright. I thought a sapphire was like, cool and red and stuff.

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

speech: It is beautiful here in the waterfall.
Yes it is. I am lost, unfortunately.
Oh, I am sorry to hear this. It makes sense. The cave you seek is thousands of feet below where we are here in this beautiful, but somewhat loud, waterfall.
Thousands you say? How do you think I should get down there? I am looking for something.
Well, there is a way down. But it is very dangerous. I've never heard of anyone making it to the cave.
Trust me, this isn't my first rodeo. I do this all the time. Tell me please.
First, you must pass through the Land of Lunacy. At night, of the full, eclipsing moon. If you make it through this land, I have heard you must cross a river that is filled with the stench of death.
Yikes. Would you be interested in  joining me on this fatal quest? There might just be something shiny in it for ya.
Oh, kiddo, I'm an old-timer and not able to withstand such a magnificent journey. However, I will take you into the village to find someone better suited for your arduous journey.
Yes, please. I do not want to attempt this alone, and I can not find my fellow spelunkers. The King is counting on me.
Come this way through the trees. The village is not far this way.
Yes, sir. Thank you. What brings you here, anyway?
I spend much time here observing the birds and the trees, the insects and the way the sun plays upon the water as it falls to the lagoon below. I am an artist and naturalist in this village.
I see. Sounds incredibly peaceful. You seem very in-tune with nature.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: My Lord! What service does the Lord require from me?
I require that my dinner be served immediately
Yes. Yes. My King. WIll you be having the pheasant tonight?
Yes, the pheasant will do fine, I am famished
I'm such a klutz! I can't believe I've spilled your wine all over the rug. I've ruined it.
Why you careless creature! Don't you know how to serve a glass of wine? You must get that rug replaced this instant!
Sir. I can never afford to replace this rug. I live in a simple hut and have no money.
Then you must leave! I cannot have such carelessness around me! I will replace you!
But what about your pheasant? No one likes to eat cold duck. Who will serve you?
Do not think so highly of yourself, I have many servants. I will be served my pheasant and my wine properly!
In that case, would you mind if I take the rug home with me? My floors get cold in the winter.
No! You may not take the rug home! You will have to find another way to deal with your cold floors
Yes My Lord. I am thankful you have not flogged me my King.
As well you should be thankful considering your disgraceful behavior this evening. You are fortunate to even have been working here

setting.name: scenic overlook
setting.description: This lovely clearing overlooks the great mountain range. It is covered in wildflowers of all different colors. There are stone benches where one can sit.
setting.background: The scenic overlook is the most beautiful location on the trail. It was made to give people a place to sit and reflect on the beauty of nature. For many years, people enjoy it. There have been many proposals and was even a wedding!

speech: Greetings, fairest of maidens
Greetings, my Lord.
And how do you do today, betrothed of my beloved son?
I am having the most wonderful day in this beautiful setting.
Tis truly a lovely place is it not? May I pick you this wildflower?
Why thank you ever so much.  When will your son arrive?
He shall be here within the hour fair maiden
It can't come soon enough.  Thank you for being here.  I am humbled by your presence, as well.
Naturally, naturally girl. Look out over the mountains - when I am gone, you and my Son shall rule all of this
Well, that won't be for a very long time.  Shall we sit on the bench and enjoy the beautiful view?
I am enjoying it, fair lady. This bench is perfectly situated
Yes, and the craftsmanship is superb.
Indeed, indeed. What is the name of that mountain over there, do you know?
I am afraid I am not familiar.  Please accept my apology for lack of knowledge.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Hello. What can I get you?
Please bring me my lager, my lady, if you would be so kind.
Yes, sir. Will that be it for you? No meal, or anything else?
Did that peasant just touch you inappropriately? I cannot allow that.
Yes, I think he's had a few too many Ale's. Please, get him out of here!
I will challenge him to a duel, if you so order, my lady!
I can not order such a thing. I am just the King's slave, after all.
Well then, commence with bringing my turkey legs and roast beef if you have such a thing in this dirty little town.
Yes, sir. My pleasure. I will have your lager as well. Are you an outsider?
I am a knight of the king. I come to this town with an urgent message for the people.
An urgent message, you say? Please, tell me.
There has been a dragon spotted nearby. He has burned down other towns.
Impossible, There hasn't been any dragons around here for decades!
Dare you argue with a knight?

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: My good servant, would you come here to speak with me?
Yes of course sir, how can I help?
SIr, I am always looking for information and I was hoping you might be interested in providing me that information from time to time.
Well it depends on what kind of information you want...
I am looking for the kind of information that would be beneficial to my king. I would make it worth your effort.
I am not sure the Royals will be happy with me if they find out I am passing information to you
BUt you will never get caught! You will simply speak with one of my assistants and tell him everything that you see happen here.
Hm I could use the money.. It will cost you a pretty penny sir!
Yes, of course, Now you'll just write down the names of everyone who comes here on this scroll for me. Can you do that?
You take me for a fool? I will report you to my master for trying to manipulate me with your bribes!
My men will kill you where you stand! No one will miss a lowly servant.
Help! Somebody help!
Your cries will fall on deaf ears. This staircase is far from anyone who can help you. HAHAHA.
Maybe this can help me...

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Greetings, sir
Pleased to meet you
And I you sir. I was sent here to see if I could be of service
I sure could use a soldier that knows the area.
I have been garrisoned here before sir, and will help in any way that is appropriate
Come with me, we will go prepare for dusk. There's a rumor a battle is starting this way
I am ever at your service, sir .. and at the service of anyone who pays me
After we are prepared for the next battle, I shall take you to meet the king
I should be honoured, sir
Look that way towards the horizon, do you see how far away those houses seem
They are beautiful houses indeed and yes, far away
Some of the kings immediate aides lives in those houses
And are you fortunate enough to do so, Sir?
Yes, as a matter of fact.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Oh my, I must find my way out of this deserted land.
I have never seen such a terrible place. It truly is appropriately named.
Have you least seen man nor beast nearest us?
Who cares about man or beast? I need champagne and dancing girls.
Oh my a great jester you are, ruler yet you are. Avast, we must find our way back to thy kingdom.
If only my father were here. He'd get depressed and die and I would be king!
You speak so harshly, you must stop!
Stop that! When I am king I will give you this wonderful land to rule over. Your personality is suited to it.
You forget your place and for that I can forgive but speak not of this anymore.
Are you not afraid of when I become king? My father is not feeling well lately.
I fear not for I keep hope for a great future for all of our kingdoms.
Attack me again and you'll be here permanently farming potatoes.
HAHA! Yet you still jest. Calm down soon to be ruler.
You're fuller of hot air than this desert wasteland.

hug future heir to the throne

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Hi, how do you do today? This is quite an impressive farm, wouldn't you agree?
Yes it is beautiful - we grow all kinds of things here
I have a great appreciation for a well kept farm. As the king's official gardener, I always enjoy being around this atmosphere. What are you up to this fine day?
I am looking at the corn especially .. I love to watch it grow
It is fascinating how it can grow so tall. How often are you in this area?
I am a regular visitor, as  Iam an acolyte
How do you like your work?
I love it - it is a true vocation. I love working with the animals very much. What about you?
I also love my line of work. The king takes great care of me and gardening is something that I am truly passionate about.
The land here is beautiful - green and fertile
It is, we are fortunate to live around such land. I have heard of other kingdoms who have dealt with famine in the past.
Yes - here it is very fertile and we have nothing to complain about
Which animal is your favorite here on the farm?
I love the sheep the best - their bleating makes me happy

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: I am scared of noone. Come near me and I will kill you
I respect you as my King, my Lord, but I fear no-one either
Everyone fears me! Your in denial. Look at this shrub
It is a fine shrub indeed Sire. I am yours to command
Take it from me then
Thank you Sire, I am honoured. May we sit before yonder tree and talk?
What is it you desire to talk about?? I'm a very busy man, as I am powerful
We must talk about discipline among the rank and file
i can take care of the issue immediately.
I feel that our armies are generally loyal
The better be loyal, if they know what is best for them
I feel that it is best to rule via loyalty than fear
I like that people fear me
They fear me also but I like to mix it in with love

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: How are you today?
Did I speak to you? Why are you speaking to the King?
Sorry, I was just trying to be polite. I will go on about my work.
Girl, is it you who is in charge of cleaning the Statue of Omamoko?
Yes Sir
My father’s father’s father had that statue made. Did you know that?
No Sir
I didn’t think so, otherwise you wouldn’t be so clumsy with it.
I'm not clumsy. Your father never spoke to me this way. Why are you so mean to me?
Are you questioning the divine right of the King?

You will not lay your hand's on me. How could you claim to be a person of god? You are a animal and can find your self a new Maid if this is how you will treat me. Your father chose me for a reason because I have always gone above and beyond to take care of him and your family. How could you treat someone that practically took care of you most your life with such disrespect?
Perhaps you’d like to spend some time with the king’s hounds? Perhaps your whole family would.
Fine, you will see soon enough how much I really do for you why I am gone.
Stop staining the carpet with your housemaid tears. Have some dignity!

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Shall I burn you today, little knight man?
You can try, mighty dragon! But I think you'll find yourself outmatched!
Why is your castle so run down, little knight?
This is not my castle, but perhaps because trespasser like you keep wandering in.
I have enough treasure hoarded to rebuild this castle 100 times! Your king is just poor.
How dare you insult the king! Take this, dragon!
I wish you didn't do that. What do you think I'm going to do with this stone?
I may have an idea or two, don't even think about it!
Then apologize and give me all of your treasures. Also, tell me I'm pretty.
I shall do no such thing, but perhaps we could strike a deal.
I am willing to listen, although these stupid fairy lights are distracting.
Well, if you agree to never tread on these lands again, then our fighting shall cease.
Well if you give me everything you own, I will not burn you to a crisp. That is the only deal you get!
No way, I'd rather die at your hand!

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: King, I am itching for another battle. It has been far too long.
Is that right? Well you are in for a treat, as we are gathering solders for a battle with another land!
Tell me about this battle. How many men will we be fighting? How many horses do they have?
Our army has become around 500 men and theirs is around 300, so it should be a surefire win!
Only 300? I will fight them all by myself and no one would dare say otherwise!
That's the spirit, we need patriotic, competent soldiers such as yourself!
Will I use the axe or will I use the sword. I want to make it a fair fight.
I shall use the Axe, as it is my honorary weapon.
You are the King, but on the battlefield do not get in my way! I will unleash a fury on those poor souls.
You dare speak to me with such malice and disrespect? I am the mightiest being in the land!
I have killed a thousand men, even monarchs tremble in my presence.
I banish you from this kingdom, go join the enemy so I may slay you!
HAHA! You fight like a drunk toddler. I find you amusing.
You do not deserve the items of this kingdom, leave now or I shall call reenforcements.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I consider myself blessed because I  have 4 people in my house, though beds are usually not enough but we are happy, I love the kitchen because this is where my lovely wife makes our food
It's the least that I can do for this family, honey.
Do you need more wooden counters in this kitchen? the plates seem to have increased dramatically
Hmm I think we might need some, yes. Wouldn't hurt.
how about water,I wish there was something I can do so that you don't have to fetch it from the river everything time
It's quite alright, maybe we could run water into here somehow.
I think I will make another fireplace since our eldest daughter is coming to live with us with her lazy husband
Ohh I'm well aware, we better get on that soon honey.
pray for the king to accept my application to become a knight, then we might get a new apartment with enough beds but it would mean you won't see me at home everyday honey
It is seeming grim but of course I will.
Baby, I am craving some shepard pie, I hope you can make some for us tonight
I'll start it up right now.
Thank you for all you do for the family
Of course, I love you honey.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: I just flew in from Camelot and BOY are my arms tired!
Ohh are you the supposed new jester?
Good day your Majesty. I am the Jester your court has requested. May I say this is the finest dining hall I've ever had the pleasure of performing in
I am not the King but I appreciate the kind words, dear jester.
But of course. Do you have any requests for your humble servant? Shall I take the stage or are we waiting on more members of the court?
Surprise me, jester.
I shall perform a song then.
Sounds splendid, well go on then!
Let
What are you going to sing then?
On top of spaghetti...
Excuse me?
All covered with cheese.... I lost my dear meatball..... I'm sorry, does this tune not please you?
I'm not quite sure what it is... not much of a tune?

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Did you need me for something, your majesty?
Hmmm, doesn't it feel good to be king I have divine rights, yes chambermaid, here is this giant bed that is making a nuisance can you ask someone to remove it?
I can remove it myself, your highness.
What else can you do for me to make me happy today chambermaid, can you pour some roses on the floor and on the bed. One of my wives is coming to town
I'd be more than happy to, king.
I also want the curtains changed those ones there are too silky, my woman likes it more curtain and natural
Maybe you should do that task yourself for a change!
You can only talk to the king like that if he likes you as one of his concubines. If not you will spend the night in prison
You know what, I've had enough of your torment and abuse!
ok chambermaid, because you are pretty I forgive you. come to me, you know I have divine right to rule
As long as you are going to be fair to me.
what if I ask for your hand in marriage? would you still be angry ?
I'd love to, but only if you treat me as your equal and love me.

You seem to have read all the books in my chamber, talking about equal rights and women liberation..because of that I will so you can help me champion my new improvement programs in the kingdom, someone else will be a chambermaid from today onwards

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: I tell jokes for a living but the king hates me, the servants quarters seem to be quiet today,servant, I will stay with you tonight maybe you can prepare a meal for two
Sounds good, I could use the company.
You seem to be very enlightened, I like the titles you have on your shelf
Thank you, I need to pass the time somehow. Let me get a plate so that I can get you a meal.
I am so hungry, thanks for cooking
You're welcome, sir. You don't get enough appreciation around her.
Why are you not married, you seem to have everything
It would appear women don't find men who cannot provide very appealing.

I used to be married myself but the king took her from me, that is why I decided to become a jester so that maybe everyone will know and pass the message about his love for peoples wives. There needs to be changes
That King really knows how to make people feel like nothing.
one day, change will come and I am hoping my hasn't touched my wife yet and i can have her back because so far he has 400 and there are only 365 days in a year
Does your wife still love you then?
she was taken against her wish and you know the king claims he has divine rights to rule, she sends me letters every week
Makes me sick, such power can corrupt nearly any mind.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Hmm what is this? Where am I?
This a cursed cave.And the bone is from the dead people buried here.
Oh no, I didn't mean any harm!
You should leave the bone where you found it or you will be cursed to.
Of course, I wouldn't want to desecrate this burial ground.
how did you found this cave?
I was told by the King to meet him here, I wonder why.
What  will the king will want to come here? Is nothing for him here.
I'm not sure, I just follow his orders.
I've heard rumors that a treasure was buried here.
That might be why, the more riches the kingdom has the better, he likes to say.
But this treasure can be cursed. And also the curse can spread to our land. I can't let this happen to my tribe.
You'll have to let him know, he may understand or you might need to... force him out.
Can the king listen to a simple peasant?

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: The kingdom that I live in his harsh.
tell me about it, but its there is no other place I'd rather be, everyone is so fun and the foyer here is very grandiose
I have to pay taxes that it is so high.
Ok I know what to do to get you to either pay less or get a better job so you won't feel it
I have only one trade.
tell me
I am a blacksmith.
The king likes me alot, I will suggest that we make new weapons and give a good word about you, that way you will have enough money to pay any tax and even marry more wives if you want
That's sound delightful. I only want one wife though.
oh that's good. I like how principled you are, your wife must be lucky and beautiful
She is kind and beautiful. I dislike my life a lot these days.
No my friend be hopeful, if everything goes well, you will hire more people and you can spend more time loving and being happy
I wish that I could be hopeful but the taxes to the king is too high.
Anyways, lets find our way out of this place, the room is so big and the balcony well decorated, I see this is why you are complaining because the king is living grand with our money

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Hello your Majesty
Dear subject.
How are you today?

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: I think I need some of your wise counsel, economist. We need to discuss our kingdom's finances.
What troubles you?  I have heard rumblings of problems in the kingdom, but I need specifics of the situation.
To be honest, we are quickly going broke. Would you think we could get a fair price for these jewels?
I think there is a chance, but who would be in a position to purchase them?  On your travels have you found others that are in better financial shape than us?
Yes, the women of Alilala are very fond of our diamonds and their oil has made the wealthy beyond comprehension. There is one problem however.
Speak it to me.
You would have to join me on the trip. There is no way the king would let carry the jewels without your accompaniment. Would you be willing to come with me?
I normally stay in the kingdom reading my books and attempting to better our financial position, but I guess that hasn't been working out.  I will come!
You are a valued servant of the kingdom! Is there anything special you require to bring along for the journey. It will be many days.
I will require food and water, but who will carry the jewels for us?  There is no way we can carry the load on our own backs.
I will take care of the transport, but I'll leave to you the small task of telling the Queen we are selling her jewelry. Maybe you can ask her for a painting or two as well.
This doesn't sound like a fair trade off.  What if she relieves me of my head for making the suggestion?
I am confident in your abilities economist. Surely you don't think I'd ask you to do something that I, myself, am afraid of.

I am not making any accusations, however, it seems to me, that as a diplomat you are more suited for talking someone into something so unpopular as this.  I am happy to provide any statistical backup you might require.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: What a beautifully exquisite place this is. How may I help you?
It is a nice place. What is is for? It's my first time here.
This is the Altar, a prayer place for my King.
It is beautiful. What is this for?
It is to light up the room for the Holy Spirit. But I suppose there are some other uses as well...
Go on...
Well, I was wondering, that Sapphire must be worth quite a bit...
Hmm... I think I catch your drift. Here.
The King and Queen are too busy, I don't think they would notice if this Sapphire.. suddenly vanished
They probably wouldn't. There's so much fancy stuff in here.
And I happen to know just the person who will give me quite a bit of gold for it
Count me in.
Well then meet me outside tomorrow and I will give you half the... proceedings
I'll be here. Noon okay?

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: It's so beautiful here in the Winter gardens. My father is king, I don't know if you know that. Aren't the flowers perfect?

Ah yes, my princess.  As you maid, of course I am privy to that, but it is such an honor, yes, such an honor indeed that you mention it.  And how could the flowers compare, my lady, when they stand in your presence?
I would be much happier if only my father would fire these annoying jesters. I hate them!

Ah, my princess, it pains me that something distresses you.  Could I not.. that is.. discretely... I know there are certain flowers here that... if ingested... would cause the jesters to trouble my most beautiful and glorious princess no more.
You always have my needs at heart. What do I do, do I eat it? Oh, tell me, I'll eat it now!

Oh no, fair princess, this bloom must never touch your perfect, rosey lips!  I shall but take it and slip it into the jesters food.  They would but pass in their sleep as gentle as lambs.. for as my maid, anything that distresses you, distresses me tenfold!
Ahhhhh....I am royal, but you are wise. I would be lost without you at my side, my loyal maid.
But of course, my princess.  I am ever at your command, and your slightest whim is my deepest desire!  Is there anything else that troubles you, my fair lady?  Anything at all?
I'm a little lonely. Do you know any fair princes looking for a mate?

Ah yes, but of course, my princess!  I did intercept a .. ahem.. a missive from the fairest prince in the land.  It appears he searching for his future queen.  I did take the -ahem- liberty of composing several unflattering letters and portraits of the neighboring princesses, so you need not fear any competition.  Not that any who look upon you could see that you are the fairest of all!
How have been so fortunate to have your loyal graces? I am indeed blessed. I hope that this prince you speak of is ready to meet?

Ah, my princess, my heart leaps at your kind words to one as lowly as I!  Indeed, I can compose a missive for you this very day and send it speedily hence.  I have no doubt he can be yours within the week, should you so favor him with your dulcet tones.
I beg you, do it soon. I am ready for a match, someone to share my royal quarters.
Your wish is my command, oh lady.  I shall but wait until after we leave the Winter Gardens here.  There are spies everywhere, you know, and I would not want to tip our hand too early.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Yoohoo! This candle is so hot it's DRIPPING! What's up with that?
Don't leave your messes for me to clean funny clown.
Oh no! A mess I've made already!
Make me laugh only using this cookpot. Show me your skill.
Hoo hoo! How funny this will look over my head! Perhaps I could put some holes in it and wear it as a diaper!
Fair enough. Now tell me which item here is hardest to juggle. Is it the silverware?
The servants are most difficult to juggle!
You are an amusing jester, I will give you that. Does the king find you as funny as I do?
I sure hope so!
I would employ you myself, if I had any money. I spend my days cleaning chamber pots and dirty dishes yet have nothing to show for my efforts.
Perhaps one day you will sit on the throne! You would surely enjoy my efforts more than the King.
Only in my dreams, jester. Perhaps you will choose to continue to amuse me for free.
I would do so gladly! Few things are better in life than a cheery laugh.
Well, if there is any way you can make a steak appear on this plate, I'd say that's better than a cheery laugh.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: I can make better armor than this place is selling.
How would you improve this armor?
This shield is made of subpar metal. I could make a shield that no one can get past.
This sword looks great to me. It is useful and there is no rust to be found.
That's fair, it's not a bad sword.
Since my group always strives to be the best I would want to have the best sword to protect the King. Can you make a better sword than this one?
I could make a sword so sharp, you could shave your face with it.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: What is your request?
Play me something playful. I'd like to dance with the queen.
As you wish.
No, not that one. You played it last night.
Certainly Sire.
Yes, I think that could do it for one dance with the queen. Have you seen her tonight?
Tonight? Why, no.
Well, I guess I will have this dance alone!
I wasn't aware you had imbibed so much as to dance with yourself.
Are you insulting you king!
I'm sorry I couldn't hear you I was watching this fool dance by himself.
That is your king you fool! I will have your head unless you play me a song I will never forget!
Do you mean I'm your king? You know you really shouldn't have put your brother's head on a pike.
I am your king and I kill those who rebel against me. You bite your tongue.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Have you seen my father, Jacob?
I haven't, but I'd be the first to let you know...I love the king!
Thanks.  God bless the King.  Any news from the village today?

The villagers speak in hushed tones, Jacob's son...People are worried about where their next meal's gonna come from, and the river's unforgiving. Some say the king's foray to bring back food will be successful, others murmur the queen is a witch, and the cause of the drought...

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: This room is so cozy. I hope there aren't any bandits nearby.
Shame how these lands have been overrun as of late. Were this kingdom to have a more diligent nobility we would be rid of such pests.
Yes, something must be done about them. I have been ambushed many times in my travels.

On behalf of my family, I apologize. My cousin, the king, has not visited this county in many years, and my husband's men grow lazy and disloyal. I am in no position to help you, though nobility I be. Here! Sit by the fire an be warmed! Know at least that the night's terrors have not grown so bold as to come to our doorstep.
Oh my, I did not know I was in the presences of a royal family member. I thank you for your hospitality, madam.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: Woman, by god's name! What are you doing here?
Dear priest. I wanted you to pray for me so I might keep my health a little while longer.
My dear child, I will try to keep you in my prayers, but please, you cannot hold me like this. I am a man of god, and god only.
Dear priest thank you for your patience with me. May I ask you what you are doing here?

You may ask, but I am in no obligation to tell you, for as the king's priest, I have to ensure that all religious duties of this kingdom are taken care of. But you, dear child, if you want to keep your health, what are you doing in such a place?
good point well made Father. At my age you will find that one just likes to chat! I heard there was a shortcut to the market and at my age I want to keep the legs fresh!
Oh! Well in that case, I can tell you that you are on the wrong path, if your journey ends in the market. You should have taken the left instead of the right at this last turn.
I have to pray and I have to eat, such as it is. How does the King go?
The king is doing very well. His health has very much improved since that regretfull incident last week. I reckon he will be able to talk to his people in a few day's time, God bless his soul.
Good to hear. How is the Queen? I bet she wouldn't be seen dead down here!
She's as distracted as usual. But I firmly believe that with a bit of good will, she would make great progress towards eternal salvation.
I am pleased to hear that. Are they getting along a bit better now?

Well, Madam, I do not think that it is my place to discuss such matters. But tell me, how are things in your home? Has your oldest resolve the little issue of faith he seemed to have in the last few months?

I am sorry I didn't mean to intrude. It is just that I used to work for her mother so I take what might seem too interested a stance, but when you have seen them grown up and want the best for them then you know how it can be.
