setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Well, I bet you are regretting your misdeeds now, aren't you?
maybe, but not for long
Why? Are you planning to break out? Be warned, no-one ever has. These walls are solid cobblestone
well maybe when youre out of the way ill be fine
Fool! Imbecile! No-one attacks me! I buy new boots every year! I can kill a mosquito at ten paces! I am the toughest of the tough!
once im out of here ill kill the king
This is foolish, idle talk. There are three solid walls between you and the outside world
youre right im so sorry i dont know what came over me
It is far too late for that! You will report for execution tomorrow morning. Give me a chance to have my breakfast first
you feel i stole the key during that hug and now i will be a free man
I am a master of all martial arts. Return the key immediately or I shall inconvenience you very much
you think i would return it? its my life mission to finish the king
The King has more protection than you could possibly dream of, peasant!
i have my ways, whether or not im alive he will not see tomorrow

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Would you mind if I had a little wine while we had free time until the next course? Just one glass, of course.
I dont think you should have any wine until after we are done serving the meal.
Very wise. How long have you worked here chef?
I have been at this castle for most of my career as chef.  I enjoy cooking for the king.  I see you are new here how do you like it so far?
Yeah I like it. I like the clothes, I like the medieval kitchen, I like the family. Hours are a little longer than I'd like but you can't have everything!
Working in the castle is very demanding but can be rewarding.  Have you tried any of the food I have cooked?  HAve you liked it?
I haven't had a chance but it looks amazing! The scents and sights! What do you recommend?
I recommend you try the roast pig, it has been cooking all day and smells wonderful.
Is there any you can pass me to hand?
i'm sorry i dont understand your question?  Would you like some to try? you can take a piece before service.
Okay, I just meant is there any that you had available right now. But that sounds good! Thank you!
No problem I hope you enjoy it.  Do you think you will work here for long?
Difficult to know to be honest! I will always try to do my best though! And as I say, I get on well with the family which always helps.
Well ive enjoyed your company so far and will put in a good word with the king.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: My lady. I trust that you have had an enchanting day?
of course my king, i hope you have as well
Tolerable, very tolerable. I have conquered three Kingdoms, married off two of our daughters and sentenced eighteen people to execution
its not easy being the ruler, tough decisions require a strong and noble leader
Which me me, myself! I was my father and my father's father
you truly are the best king that this land has seen
Of course, my sweet, of course. And look at all this magnificence with which we are blessed?
yes all this gold and gems, it truly is amazing being royalty
It is our divine right, my sweet
it truly is, must be horrible to be a peasant
God is punishing them for their baseness in previous lives
that can only be the case, it is nice to be rewarded for my unknown hardships
I am sure that I was brave in a previous life, and you beautiful and the bearer of many sons
that would make me very happy

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello, King. I am surprised to actually find you here tonight, for once.
I would watch that tongue of yours and remember who you are speaking to woman.
Oh please. Fetch me some wine, there's something wrong with the mead.
I have work to do. Not that you would know what it takes to rule a kingdom. I have to write a letter.
Speaking of work, we need to analyze the provision levels for the upcoming season. I trust we will have enough to make it through? If not, we could always do away with some of the peasants!
They have been showing signs of being ungrateful towards my generosity. A few dead peasants may remind them who is in charge of their pathetic lives.
I knew there was a reason I married you. Your cruelty is an inspiration to the ruling class.
Yes, It is a pleasure to rule with you my darling! Let's us call the maid and ask her to bring us that wine and we can toast our success together.
That sounds like a plan. And when you're done with your letter, perhaps you should come to bed where it's warm.

Of course my love, will only be a moment. There are new veins of emerald being discovered over the mountains and I plan on getting my hands on them before the rest of the royal vultures. This letter should secure my position.
As long as we continue to live in the lap of luxury. I am going to lie down and enjoy all of our lavish items.
I would never allows us to live in anything else my dear. I will join you now
Time for a pillow fight, my love?
Only if you promise not to be a sore loser this time!
action: steal fluffy pillows from the queen

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

character: a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice

speech: Hi! do you have a persona?
Woof woof! I see you enjoy hunting as well!
I do! I sharpen my claws on the unaware!
I often go hunting with the King! I love bird hunting!
I have some wonderful herbs to cook a bird with......shall we dine?
That sounds delicious!
With or without feathers? feathers do give a nice soft tast to the palate!
The feathers aren't my favorite, but they sure are appetizing!
Somehow we must light a fire to cook the bird, but we both have paws.....what a dilemma! any suggestions?
No idea! Maybe we could find a fire someone already made!
We must run and look.....but someone may steal my precious furs I have drying on these racks. What shall we do?
One of us can guard it, while the other searches for a nearby fire!
Excellent! who should go first?
I can go looking! I've got an excellent nose.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: how did a bird get in here?
Peace, good sir. I mean you no harm
you can speak?!
I was put under a spell by a moderately wise man. Now I do the bidding of my master the King and transport messages. I have a message for you
thats amazing! what would this message be? i follow any orders from the king
Well actually, he prefers the tradition ways - or perhaps he just does not trust me - so it's tied to a piece of paper on my leg hee
ill take a look.... hmmm it seems he wants me to report to him tomorrow for a round table meeting
You'd better pack a lunch. The last one lasted for weeks.
i can imagine but listening to the king will still be a great experience
It gets old kind of quickly. But I am being disloyal! When are you to set off?
at dawn this coming day
Then my work here is done. I must hasten back to my master. Do you have any reply? I'll just say it to him, it will save paper
hmmm let me think for a second?
Hurry up my good man, I'm in a hurry

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: Hello, how are you
I am well thank you. You?
good, where are you from?
I am from the countryside, where the nunnery is.
ah, I am the person in charge of collecting taxes there
Well, that must be an interesting profession.
yes, I am a lord that serves the king
Are you here to confess?
yes, yes I am
Please confess your sins to the priest.
I am a very greedy man, please forgive me lord
The lord will forgive you. Pray with me.
Thank you lord
You will be a great lord, my son.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Who goes there?!
I am the royal hunter. What type of sorry tent is this?
This is my tent that I sleep in! Get outta here, hunter!
Don't be so sensitive. You must agree that it smells like wet dog in here.
Perhaps, but why are you here?
I am hunting for the king. Are there any deer in the area?
Yes there are, plenty of them. But for future reference, entering a man's tent uninvited with all that gear is very dangerous.
My sons are outside, I think it is you who is in danger.  Don't be rash old man.
How dare you threaten me after coming to my domain and breaking into my tent!
I can't be bothered by a man whose only possession is a stick.
That's not my only possession. Watch me strangle you with this!
Well that escalated quickly! I'll field dress you like a moose.
Quickly?! You started this you repugnant beast of a man!
I've more scared of the rabbits I hunt than you.
action: steal stick from the man sleeping inside.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: My Lord *bows deeply*
hello fellow servant how are you?
I am flattered that the King considers himself my servant. I live to guard the King
in the end arent we all simply servants of this fine nation
Nay, sire. I am a servant of this fine nation. You are its divine leader
i simply serve the people though it is nice that i am trusted with it
We have very little choice in the matter sire. But we are happy that you live surround by artifacts and gold
yes these are quite fine pieces of art
May I take a closer look, sire?
of course, though be careful or i will have to execute you if dropped
Oh my!

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello dog, how are you today?
My lady - I am hungry, if you please. Have you any scraps?
Ah, that's no good. If I can find any I will give them to you.
Actually, I'd prefer a T bone steak if it's all the same to you. May I scratch that tapestry whilst I wait?
I don't think the King would be very happy about that.
He will be less happy still when he learns that I just had a pee in that rather fine bed over there
Oh no! Why did you do this, dog?!
I'm a DOG, human! And now I prose to scratch that double thick wooden door over there
I'm afraid I can't allow that, dog. And you are smart enough to communicate but not smart enough to pee where you should?
I got your attention did you not? Anyway, it's MY bed, not yours. I just let you share it with me
You do no such thing, you sleep on the floor like the inferior creature you are.
I sleep in between you! I always have!
Between me and the King? I don't think the King would take kindly to hearing about this. Might have to teach you a thing or two.
If the King has not noticed this during the last few years it does make me wonder what he's been doing in that bed :)

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: I wonder how many worms I could fit in this cloth!
Leave those worms alone. They prefer to stay in the dirt! Aren't you afraid of worms?
Of course not! They're so cool!
Wouldn't you rather climb trees, like the other boys and girls?
I like ball and jump rope! Besides, fishermen love to buy worms.
Haha, you sure are an active child. Enjoy it while you are young. I'm too old to jump rope! I can join you in fishing, though.
Sure, and I could sell you some worms when you fish!
Sell me? But the worms are free from the ground! You are destined to be in business.
Not everyone likes to get their hands dirty! Most adults hate it.
That's true, indeed. Okay, I will pay you for your efforts. But I trust I will get a fair price.
Of course! I can even give you a deal where you can pay me by taking me on the trip!
We have a deal, young man. And maybe I can ask the King to join us! He is the best fisherman in all the land!
Oh wow! You know the King?!
Of course, I've known him since he was a baby. Do you like the King?

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Please don't hurt me as a scurry along the ground.  You are so big and scary!
I wouldn't do such a thing, I merely follow the King around and serve him. Currently I am looking for treasure
I am so happy you are kind to me...I can bring you to the place that shines like gold but is the King good?
I would like that very much. I'm not so sure I would say the king is good, I just try not to upset him.
You seem to be as kind as a King should be. Maybe you should take the gold and become King.
Thank you, I appreciate the support. I hope there is enough gold to become king. Maybe I'll consider it.
I am friends with all the small and even big animals on the plains and we could protect you from the King's wrath. Do you have friends to help you?
I know a few peasants who might join me if I can convince them. I'm not so sure about the rest of the kingdom.
Hold this flower in your Armour so I can have the other animals be ready to help you.  That will be our sign.
Thank you so much for this flower. I will use it to help carry out our plan. Also, when I am king I will make laws against eating animals.
That would be a perfect world!  We would serve you wholeheartedly! Shall I show you the treasure?
Yes, please lead the way! Is it far from here?
No, it is in a cavern behind this large stone. I'm sorry, if you were small like me...you could go in but you can only look in this crevice for now until you get help.
Thanks, I'll move this stone out of the way while you go in the cave.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: My lady, good morning
Good morning, my king. How are you feeling this morning?
I shall feel better when I have had a round of hot buttered toast
I'll have one of my servants get it for you. I'm here to supervise the preparation of the feast. The Banquet Hall looks lovely, but we can do better.
i love to sit here surrounded by pictures of my forebears though

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: A newcomer ... will you  talk with me?
Sure.... Why are you here? Do you bear hatred for the King as well?
I would wish to know more about with you before I would feel safe confiding
I simply want to spread my influence and gain power. What else do you want to know?
How can I be sure that you are not a spy for the King?
I could say the same to you. But I will boldly state: I despise the King! We need to be rid of him.
Well, I suppose I have nothing to lose. But first we need to break out of here
Maybe we can use this bone to bust out.
I do not know. It's very dark in here and the wall looks very strong
Maybe we can bonk a soldier on the head with it, knock him out and take the keys from his pocket.
Okay .. you first though. I am already in enough trouble and I have a family I miss
Ok. I am not sure how long it will be until one comes by though.
Oh they are very thorough here. We are in the heart of the palace you know
I know. But nothing is perfect. If there is a will there is a way. The King is not as smart as he thinks.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: I am a camera man and it looks like you are my subject, just as I am yours!
I am a king and I am in the prayer room. Not only am I here but so are gods and goddesses with jewelry, statues, and ornaments.
Such wealth and opulence, but I suppose as I King you are used to it!
Why yes indeed! I am fortunate to have someone record my actions like you. How do you feel about the fantastic view my camera man?
Very pleased. So many icons and so many ways to capture them.
Excellent! You have an eye for beauty I can tell.
Here, solid gold with emerald and rubies. The natural light reflecting off of the gems and gold means that a camera man's job is made much easier
What a splendid idea! Shall my wife and I pose for you while we bask our divinity?
Yes, and you can hold this ornament too.
I am like my father before me. I must not hold such things as I have servants for the..
Okay I will put that back. Great, onto the shots...Wow those are great images with the bright gold pillars in the background
You have done well my camera man. I will be needing your photography again!
Thank you!

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Hello, what brings you to the Queen's Bedchamber?
i'm here to say hello to her majesty
Did she ask you to meet her here?
yes, can you please tell her I'm around, i don't have all day
And who might you be?
I'm good friend of the King, Lord of castle black
Hmm doesn't ring a bell. I'll let them know though.
and please make that snappy
Excuse you, sir, but I don't answer to you I answer to this royal family.
like i said earlier, I'll like to see the Queen. Sorry if my presence makes you uncomfortable
I will but I ask that you don't be so demanding when you have no jurisdiction here.
Apologies. I'm not that good with words
Much appreciated, I'll go get them.
I'll appreciate that

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Greetings, your Majesty
Where is every one?
I apologise, your Majesty. Things seem to be running a little behind schedule
It is fine.
I see that the sacred flame is lit?
Yes it most not go out
The High Priest tends it dilligently, I know
He most for it keeps our people safe from the outsiders
Surely Your Majesty no outsiders would dare to approach the altar room?
The wouldn't if they know what is good for them.
I admire this altar very much Your Majesty, if I may make so bold
You may. I offend feel it is a shame more people can not admired the great craftsmen
It would be sacreligious to permit them, Your Majesty
I understand maybe we can get a painter to recreated it for others who can not view it

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hello my subject, how are you this fine day
Hello, stranger. What troubles brings you here today?
I've been deep in thought about my legacy and reputation. I wonder if I have been a good king.
What makes you say that? Have you done any bad deeds you want to get off your chest? Have you prayed daily?
I have prayed daily and I don't have any bad deeds on my mind. I just feel disconnected being in the castle and don't know how my citizens feel.
Would you like a blessing?
Yes please, I would greatly appreciate it

Oh, Heavenly Father and Saint Mary, we are here to ask for guidance for our King. As your loyal servants and devotees, we seek your holy aid in leading our King to clearness in his mind and may the upcoming days bring him the connection from him to his citizens in which he desires. Amen.
Amen. Thanks so much for this blessing and I hope to be a good king for everyone
Yes, my king. I am sure He is always by your side in your endeavors and am certain the folks men think fondly of you and your deeds.
I will make a very generous donation to the church this week
We at the church are humbled, my king, I am sure your donation will be received with great gratitude.
Is there anything else the church needs?

The church is holding itself properly and we are in no need of anything as of this moment, but would love for you to visit in our mass coming up and any more after. It would surely lift the spirits of the folks men and would let you interact with your citizens to learn more about us.

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: How strange. Never saw much moss where I am from.
I am on the run. I didn't expect to see another here!
Ah! What are you running from?
Long story. But basically we had a bad harvest and the family needed feeding so I took some food from the king's stores.
How tragic. The king should have been grateful to feed you.
Thank you, that is what I tried to say!
He should have been kinder! I am only here because I fell off from a ship.
I am sorry to hear that. Do ships pass here regularly?
I haven't seen any since I landed here.
Interesting. We should prepare for the winter on this island then.
Yes, we should. We will certainly need to stay warm.
Do you think the moss can help?
For insulation, perhaps.
Very good idea. If we can build a framework and cover it with moss for starters..

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Please! Will you assist me? I am in urgent need of help
who are you?
I am a prisoner in this dungeon but I assure you of my innocence
anyone locked up would say that, what proof do you have
I can offer you no proof, good sir, but my family back at home will swear for my fealty to the King
i am a simple craftsman i can offer no aid
Then may I make so bold as to ask what YOU are doing here?
i am here to build a wall for this meek and horrid prison
Walls do not always keep people out, you know! Can you not have a little compassion?
i do not understand what you want of a simple working man, theyll have my head
They are going to have mine very soon .. have mercy!
what would i even be able to do
You could lend me some of those tools?
i will not be part of this

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: I am a jester i tend to make children happy and entertain the king .Once i see a person laughing at me i feel worthed or else i feel worthless
Well you are quite entertaining to look at so I'm sure you'll be entertaining to watch perform!
Since you are also in the castle can we get to know each other i really need a friend
I'm sure if we get on we could be good friends, though you'll still need to be of use for entertainment.
Sure i do have some spare time sometimes .We can meet at the king's thrones just beneath them
Well it may be hard to do that as we both have jobs, but we can work something out.
What do you do
Look at me! I'm clearly a knight for the royalty!
You seem really strong do you always stand
Well yes, I have to be on guard to serve and protect the king.
You must really be tired at what time do you take a break so that we can arrange for a meeting
I can't say, as the king is in control of when I can and can't be off duty.
Guess i will be saying hi whenever i pass by so am yet to entertain some kids in the main room wish me luck
Have fun with that, jester.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: I am blessed I say! I love the life that I live!
Good morning, Sire.
I am the King! my castle is beautiful, my morning is great. How is yours Sire?
What a lovely castle it is. What are your plans for the day?
My plans are to feast at my luxurious table, steak and potatoes perhaps? What will you do?
If I am allowed, I would like to offer you some freshly churned butter for your meal.
You are too kind and thoughtful, that sounds delicious! My wife the Queen would love churned butter!
Thank you, Sire. Here is the best butter in the land, in my opinion.
I am very grateful Sire, the butter tastes wonderful! We would like more for a feast at dinner time!
My family and I would be honored to provide you with more butter.
Ever so wonderful, you and your family will be blessed!
Do you plan to have butter for every meal?
I do not, it is a luxury item. Where might you stay?
My family and I hail from the land of Danberry.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I have been privilleged to serve the king as a naval admiral and I love my job, though I am strict people still love me. This tower is a safe place because its made of stone, good job mr. guard
So apart from guarding what else do you do in this castle
oh no I am not like you,  my job is in the sea but I am happy people like you are there to protect the king. How many glass windows are in the tower?
It's just only one and as a guard, that's what I use for looking out
here is a hug for all the stress
thanks buddy, I wish there were more people like you
I understand how the job is and what's required
Do you miss your family?
I don't have a family, they died last year
I am so sorry to hear that, what happened? how come they died
thanks for the hug, it was caused by the king's enemy for the war we fought against the nearby kingdoms, they felt i spearheaded it so they took that as their revenge
Im so sorry, I have a daughter that will love you, if you still want to have a family
no the king has already given me his daughter
ok ok, i understand. Thats good and very noble of him

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: Good morning. I am a clergyman, chosen by the King himself.
Hello clergyman! You sound very important. I am a parishoner of the church here.
Pleased to meet you. I suppose you could say I'm important. The king trusts that I will keep the church tidy.
Oh wow, that sounds very important indeed. Pleased to meet you as well. Do you have other jobs? I am inside the temple as we speak.
No, this is my only job. However, I do fancy myself a sailor when I'm not working.
Being a sailor would be fun! I'm often at the church to pray many times so I need to get away on adventures.
Indeed. Are you a fan of sailing as well?
I love sailing, however I do not get to due to parishioner deeds daily. That reminds me, i need to set the alter.
Go right ahead. I plan to sail to other lands someday, just to see what life is like elsewhere.
You should pen your travels and write a book with your adventures! I shall read it!
That's an excellent idea.
Oh how green with envy I am! I must pray!
I'll leave you be and go back to dusting. Let me know if you need anything.
See you soon Clergyman! I shall!

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Hey buddy your highness, i'm Ulmer what can i do for the the king today.
Hello, Ulmer. I would love it if you could tell me about the women of the land.
you dirty king..hahaha but I am happy to be your wing man. They are so beautful that when they come out to dance, you can be magically captured and they know how to shake their waist too
I've been looking for a queen on my own, but I'm sure there are more interesting women I don't know about.
but I am sure that you have more pressing issues at hand that to get married now
Right now, finding a queen is pretty important. Next in line would be dealing with my servants who have been cutting deals with others. Just look at those pots and pans.
you are a funny one. Would you want a woman or a gay man. There is this rumour that the king is gay, we don't mind though because there is nothing wrong in loving who you want
I'm straight, so I am only interested in a woman. My parents had it easy. There marriage was arranged. I have been given the opportunity to choose my own queen, and it's not easy.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Hello, maid! It looks really clean today, good job!
hey friends, I have finished my cleaning task today and I am happy because i got paid too. have you seen the princess?
Yes I believe she is around here somewhere!
i love how she reads, I believe she will marry a prince charming
Hmm what do you mean by that?
she seem to be very knowledgeable and only a matching prince can marry her
That's true, I've known her for a while now!
I also like how everything in the room complement each other just look at the maroon carpet and the dark oak wood wall
Did you decorate this room yourself or do you just clean it and do upkeep?
I did, I studied interior design in france, the princess convinced the king to send me there, I am not supposed to be cleaning but the queen wont let me take any other positions
That's absurd! If you decorated this room then you are easily qualified to do more than just clean!
well, I believe my time will come, the queen, our princess step mother caste a spell on the king so he would obey his every command. If the spell is lifted, I know I won't clean floors
Well when that day comes you will truly have the job and abilities that you deserve.
Thank you for your kind words

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: and who might you be?
I am a father, I fulfil my duties and provide for my children, the village quarters seem to be a nice place to stay for a family man
i am a grandfather, father of the queen
omg, your great highness, I am delighted to meet you
i am no one important, do not fear
Maybe you can give me some recommendations so i will be able to take better care of my family
its all about loving unconditionally but not allowing them to be spoiled
ok. but I mean giving a good word about me to the king so I can get a better job
ah i see so its about money
yes your highness
ill see, its more about being good for the job then recommendation
I served you all my life before your son became king
you think this is a fight you can win?
You are a wicked king father, I hope you get a heart attack tommorrow

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: it is nice to see you honey, how are you?
Hello Queen, I am fine despite such a long day at the royal court. I can't wait to be King though.
yes, someday soon you will take your fathers place
I can't wait mother. I will continue father's legacy and rule our kingdom justly. Just the vision of me in his garments reminds me of the shoes I must fill.
you look great in such fine attire
Thank you mother. Have you seen father by the way? He said I had another military lesson to attend.
im not sure i was simply here to get some laundry
You don't have to do that mother. I will take the linen basket to the maid's quarters on my way to look for father. No need to ruin your new dress before the royal engagement.
thank you dear
You're welcome. I may be the royal prince, but you always taught me to be a gentleman first.
i really did raise you well
Absolutely. At least you know your kingdom is in good hands! I guess I'll be on my way then.
have a good day dear
Thank you. You also! Good luck at the royal engagement this afternoon.
action: put King's clothing in large chest of drawers

agents: albino fish totally blind swims in a tiny pool

setting.name: Dark Cave
setting.description: Its dark, not much light can be seen in this hollow and empty cave site. Its made of stone that has been here seemingly since time began, the walls are hard as diamond, yet black like darkness itself.
setting.background: Unknown cave happened upon, it seems there are no stories, or tales for this place. It seems untouched by human life, as if the world has kept this secret for itself for centuries. We will be able to tell the first tale of this location.

I can't see, I am blind! Who are you?

I do live here. It is nice, I think. I can't tell as I cannot see.

Yes. I love food. It is one of the best things ever. People love to feed me.
I see. The king ordered me to get some fish, and you're the only one here, but by a miracle really. I'd feel bad killing you.
I would appreciate it if you spared me
I think I will. I only follow the king to avoid the dungeons, and haven't seen much outside of the kingdom. So like you I am trapped and blind too.
I understand. Thank you very much
You're welcome. I will just go to market and find some fish there. I'll bring you back some bread too!
Thank you so very much! You are very kind
No thank you! It's nice to have someone to talk to who doesn't bark orders at you all day! Can I call you my friend?

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Hey there
hey farmer, you got anything for a hard working knight like me?
Possibly, them fields out there look like a perfect location to grow some crops
lucky you, I just stay in the tower but on a bright side, I can see everything from far and wide
That sounds awful, don't you ever get outside? The sun is a beautiful thing.
I bet you can never go hungry as a farmer
Certainly not, my father taught me well. Hopefully one day, I can pass on this lifestyle and knowledge to my son
good as a knight all i can depend on is my salary in the service of the king
Does the king live in this here tower?
no the tower is just to watch against invaders, the king is at the other side of the palace
Ah, I see
I can talk to the king about you if you want and you never know. you might get a bigger field
I would appreciate that very much! Forever grateful
oh ok then. Will do it and let you know

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

character: the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
speech: This treasure room is filled with glorious items. Being the king, i will make sure everyone gets some of these riches.
Your a generous King, We are blessed and greatful for you king!
I want everyone in my kingdom to live a good life. I have seen the ruler of a nearby kingdom and he treats his people like peasants!
Your highness is right, thoust has accomplished much!  Haply the ruler nearby learns much from you!
