speech: Oh, I do hope we will win this terrible war.
Yes, stay positive my king. We will triumph.
With such brave warriors, I know we can, but at what price? What would my father, in his king days, have done?
We will win because we have God on our side.
That we do. We must remain optomistic. War is long.Thank you for your faith in me.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Hello there Ghost. Is this your swamp?
It is, what are you doing here?
I am here on an adventure. I heard you have a secret treasure hidden here. Is that true?
Maybe... I was once the king, if you think I will give it up without a fight youre wrong
Oh, I am ready for a fight!!
You cant hit a ghost! Muahahaha!
Oh dear I forgot! Thank goodness I have a bag of salt to throw on you! Bahaha!
That doesnt work.
Say, how did you die Ghost?
I was killed in battle
I didn't think Kings took part in battle? I hate academics so I never studied our history.
I go to the battles, and my forces became overran.
No you haunt this silly forest! HA
You better watch it!

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Hello there!
Oh hello there dear dog. How was the meetings today with the King?
It was fun! I found a little flower!
That's great my dear friend! But remember, you are to keep an eye on the King for me!
I will!
You are part of the family! without you attacking the last assassin the King wouldn't be here today!
Thank you! Can I have this thing?
Of course. We have plenty of golden goblets in the cellar.
Really??!!
well don't drop it silly friend! I want you to have it!!
Can we go down to the cellar and see the rest???
Of course! Are you wanting more? Do you have a lady friend who needs one?
No, I just want to roll around with them all
Oh! You are such a silly dog. When dinner is over we shall go!

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: Sad day today
Who are you here for?
My mother passed away. This is her grave. Who are you here for?
Counting how many enemies I've left here.
I hope she wasn't one of them.  Though she was a tough old lady
As long as she wasn't an enemy of the king, I can't claim her.
I don't think she had anything against him.
How long has it been since she passed?
A couple of days.  She was sick and couldn't get to the doctor on time.  I blame my father.
No mother and a poor relationship with your father? Sounds like you would serve the army well.
Is there a war going on?
As long as King Jeoffrey is at the throne, there will always be war. He has many enemies, but they're foolish.
I may be able to help my pain by inflicting some on others. What does it pay?
Honor. Glory. Food during campaign.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hello, What brings you here today?
looking for some jewels
You have come to a confessional, Sire.  There are no jewels here.  Only a place to confess thous sins.
well what good would that do me?
Something must have brought you here.  Do you have something on your mind that you wish to free your soul from?
i'm not sure i haven't been here in awhile
You can meet with a priest in here and speak your heart.  A king must have a lot on his mind and have to do things that may or may not convict your heart.
I guess i haven't treated people with respect in my life
Please don't confess to me.  I'm a lowly altar boy but I shall pray for you.  If you ever need a trustworthy right hand at your throne...I am someone who can be trusted.
thanks for the help this seems like a good place
Once I am older, may I visit your Royal Highness in the castle and become his Royal Priest?
Yes i will have a royal welcome
Thank you, kind Sir!  Wait a moment while I get a Priest for you. I hope you find your jewels.
thanks so much

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: I think I'll need more buckets to wash the blood from this hall.
I will clean them with my hands
Meat has been light this winter. I wonder if I could add some rat to my stew tonight.
please , let me work for you. allow me to live
Gasp, a TALKING rat? Have I gone mad finally? All of the years of hard labor and lack of medical care has finally gone to my head!
I would n`t show this to you. but I didn`t have any choice
I suppose I could keep you alive. You might be useful to spy on the King and Queen. I could finally take the throne back for my family.
if you free me, I will serve you with my life
A servant with a servant? I like the sound of that. Hide just here in my pocket and we'll sneak you out of here.
as you wish
But first, I do need help with the cleaning actually. Could you use your tiny little claws to scrape away the dried blood from those shackles?
done
I must ask though, how are you able to talk?
same as you talk

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hail wisemen, what do the stars tell you tonight?
They are alerting me to a great danger outside these walls.
A danger of the weather or a danger of a battle?
I believe a rival kingdom seeks to come for us.
I must alert the King, but first can you draw any more information for me?  Will we have time to rally our troops and allies?
The stars tell me the time for action is upon us. I think we have time.
If the time is upon us, this is what we have trained to do.  I shall make the troops ready.  We will have to devise a plan to kill this rival king.
But wait one second, soldier. The stars tell me this: We must utilize our archers well. They are the key.
I will make it so.  Do the stars show you many future results?  Does it show our King still standing strong?
It's murky. But our king can be potected, this I sense from the stars. Take care, soldier. I spend all day here and I am sure of our fates.
I know that we can shape our future so I will never give up.  You have saved us just by being diligent to follow the stars.  I will have a soldier protecting you.
That's very thoughtful. But it's not me I'm concerned about. Our very kingdom rests upon one battle.
Protect yourself with these spears. I must sound the alarm horn at once!  Peace be with you.
And with you my friend.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hello there.
hello stranger , who are you
Hello. I am a guard here. What about you?
I am a rat living here. do you have some food ?
I have some food, but it is for me. There is plenty for you to find.
if you share it with me some , I can be a good company in here .
I can spare some bread.
thank you. do you want some information ? I can go everywhere and listen everyone. tell me
Please let me know if anybody is speaking about breaking out. I need to know if they are getting near the king.
if you want , I can kill them if they have intention to escape
No violence, that is my job.
but I know someone will try to kill you to escape. You share your food with me and I will pay back
Fair enough. Go on and let me know what you see.
as you wish

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Ick, what makes that disgusting squeaking sound?  You gross vermin?
I'm not gross!  I'm a rather clean and neat little mouse!
Ah, I see you are but a mouse.  I must stay hushed because I'm seeking out the Duchess' brooch.
Well, I'm am just looking for some grain!  A little spot of grain to eat.. nothing more..
I can help you with that!  If you can help me find the brooch and maybe even a way out without being seen, then I will bring you with me and treat you like a king!
Hmm.. a brooch?  Like the one hidden in the drawer under the false bottom?
Why yes, you genius mouse!  I must secure it quickly before anyone finds out that the guards are missing overboard!
I have no use for brooches!  They have some many shiny things, they probably won't miss one or two...
You have saved me!  I can get good money if I take a few things.  You shall have anything you like?  The best cheese?  The finest grain?  A beautiful bed?
Just food and warmth is all I need!  But first didn't say you have to get out of here unseen?
Yes, but remember...I am a big human...not so easily sneaking through holes like you're able to.  Let us go to our freedom!  My throat will be saved from the knife!
Hmm... I remember a secret door.. how did they open it?  It was so long ago..
I remember a tale of a nail to remove the door, puts it on the floor.  There must be one nail that makes the whole door fall away.  Stand back, for I don't want you to get squished.
I don't know of any tails but I remember a man opening a door in this room from the wall... but it was so long ago...

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Groundskeeper, do I not frighten you? You would be the first.
I have been here many years, ghost. I'm not afraid.
Perhaps. But perhaps you should be. Do you know my story?
I do not. I have a story as well, but I'd like to hear your tale.
I died, in a very unpleasant and unpredictable way. Right here, in this village.
Are you a danger to the king? I serve under his leadership.
As I am no longer a corporeal being, I am no danger to your king. Nor can you hurt me.
I apologize. My job is to protect and serve the king. I am sorry to hear about your story, ghost. Is there anything I can do to help?
I wish for you to relay a message to my beloved. There is a letter in this grave. It has magic properties and you will find it well intact, groundskeeper.
Where must I go to deliver this? I will do it immediately.
All instructions are in the envelope. If you do this, I will finally be able to be at peace, I believe.
Absolutely, sir. Please just watch over the graveyard while I am gone.
I don't normally hug your kind, but I appreciate your efforts. Thanks. And fare thee well.
You are now a friend of mine. Please keep careful watch on the shadows near the corner, they can creep up sometimes.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: hey , do you have some bread ?
Why hello, little mouse. I ate in the hall so I don't have anything but this sweet date I took with me.  Would you like it?
yes please, I am hungry. I couldn`t find food for days
Usually I would be commanded to rid the castle of any rodents but here in the Knights Quarters, it is our domain and I quite like having someone to talk to.
I can be a good company. also I can go everywhere and learn everything. I can be your eyes and ears
I never thought of it like that.  We could be good friends.  I can bring you food and look out for you.  Here, you can even sleep in my trunk which has a hole on the side.

thank you . you are so kind. I will help you. my friend told me, there is an army coming to this way. 40 soldiers and they have cannons. If you warn your friends now, you can stop them when they arrive
You are a noble rodent.  I will quickly assemble my men and we will try to surround them and overtake them.  Do you know if they come from the East or the North?
they are coming from north and they should be 1 day far from here by walk.
We shall ride out and abandon out horses before we reach them and sneak up to surround them.  I will have the king know who saved his kingdom. You must be rewarded!
they won`t believe you if you tell them , you learn this from a mice. I am your friend and this is your reward , don`t mention me

I understand.  It is hard for men and mice to live side by side, but at least I will treat you like a king and will command my officers to leave the abandoned barn by the east gate alone so your fellow mice may live peacefully.  I must go now!  Here is the date for you to enjoy.
thank you
No, thank you. You have done me a great service and I shall never forget it.

setting.name: A Dwarven City
setting.description: The dwarven city is located inside a hollowed out stony mountain. Benign dwarves populate the mountain city. Pillars of the entrance are adorned with gold, and inside the fortress exists a vast city bustling with strange magical technology.
setting.background: What once started as a mine within a mountain has since evolved into a massive city of exciting technology and lots of adventure. The ancestors of the dwarves sold the minerals acquired within the mountain to create a highly advanced civilization that appears foreign even to other dwarven cities. Magical carts can take you anywhere you need to go as long as you make your request in the difficult dwarven language.

speech: Hello blacksmith. I'm just here being good..hehe.
Ha. Well, good morning to ye.
You blacksmith. Give me some tools.
No way, gnome.
Do you not know I am the gnome of the castle lawn!
Do you not know I am the blacksmith of the king? His personal blacksmith? I fit the horses shoes.
I AM GNOME. I'll make you regret laughing at me you blacksmith.
Easy, there. I don't need any craziness. I need to finish my job in this city.
I cause crazy. Did you not hear of the chaos in the village last night? That was ME!
Psychotic little bugger. Begone. I have no time for you.
You can't catch me you big lug of man!
I don't need to catch you. But if you get near me, this here axe is going to make you five times shorter.
SOMEONE HELP ME. This big mean blacksmith is trying to hurt me, a cute little gnome.
Okay. You asked for it. Leave me be, gnome.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: I am so happy to see you my love!
Oh, princess. Well, I'm certainly happy to see you, too. What brings you here?
You of course! I'm so sad about the arranged marriage to the Prince of Uzekaml. i love you.
Ah. I thought... maybe you had gotten used to the idea. I wish there was something we could do.
Maybe we can run away? I have a sister who can marry Prince of Uzekami if I'm not here.
But if I run away, who will care for these sweet unicorn?
We can find other unicorns for you. My father has plenty of amazing groomers
You are much sweeter than any unicorn I've seen, princess.
Then please let us run away! I know it's so beautiful in this Unicorn Palace but being here dampens our love.
I never could say no to you, could I? I just hope the king understands.
He wont my love. We will have to go far away. I can get in the vaults to give us money to survive for a while.
Well. You certainly bring us plenty of action. I was getting bored here. Though it sure is quiet.
We will settle down someone else and it will be quiet again! We can be safe a few kingoms over.
I trust you, sweet. I put my fate in our bond.

setting.name: The witches cottage
setting.description: The witches cottage has a huge cauldron in the middle of the cottage. There are shelves of glass jars that have things like spider legs, dragon toe nails, and fairy wings.  The floor is a dirt floor and the roof is made of wooden brooms.
setting.background: The witch was banished from the kingdom, so she needed a new home.  She built the cottage from the sticks she gathered from the forest floor.

speech: Stop assassin. Why are you here?
I'm on a mission
Stop. I know spells. What are you here for?
I'm here to kill the king of course and there's nothing you can do to stop me
You idiot assassin. This is my cottage. No king here!
I just came for supplies. Didn't think you'd be home.
Can you not ask nicely? I thought you were here for me since I work for the government. Maybe we are on the same side?
You never even gave me a chance. Give me the toe nail and I will kill the king.
Who will you put in his place assassin?
Not really my call on that but I don't see why you couldn't fill the position
I don't want to rule. I just want to be here in my cottage getting paid for working for government.
What kind of government work do you do exactly?
Espiionage against the king.
So we are on the same side
action: steal Dragon toe nail from witch
steal Dragon toe nail from an assassin
give Dragon toe nail to an assassin

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Hello Queen. Thank you and your husband for having us here tonight.

Ah but of course, of course.  We love haven't visitors, don't we dear? No, no, don't speak with food in your mouth, my kingly turtledove.  Now then, good Dignitary, I trust your journey was not too strenuous?
It was a bit bumpy but my guards made it all well.  May I have this m'lady? A gift for me coming so quickly.

Oh -ahem- yes well, I suppose if you must.  Though I will be expecting certain, well, something of a reciprocal nature.  We must keep up good relations now mustn't we?  I wouldn't want people accusing you of theft.
Queen, we both know I am here to talk about the accusations against you from the King of Uzekami. He says you stole gold from him to create floors. -looks at floors-

A direct person, aren't we?  I thought we were to wait til the morrow but, if you insist.  If the Pretender to the Throne of Uzekami wishes to fling about accusations so carelessly, he should choose a weaker target.  Surely your spies cannot have missed troops massing at the border?
Oh, yes I saw. I am impressed. Sadly,  King of Uzekami has already massed his own way before you. Queen, I AM on your side. He is a pretender and his adultery ways are sickening.
Hm, well then.  You must have something in mind to buy your way into our court.  What do you offer of yourself?  We are more than pleased to assist in tumbling that revolting toad from his seat.

I just want this suit of armor my Queen. You and your husband are the leaders we need.  The people respect and listen to me. With me in our court, we can cut down this rebellion. Your kingdom will be twice the size.

Intriguing.  I admit I find your offer quite tempting indeed -no dear, the chocolates are in that secret compartment in your throne's armrest, remember? There you are, don't mind us- I find your ambition... refreshing.  It is good to see a man who is not afraid to seek power and seize it.
I seek power for the people. I do their bidding. I hear their talk. King of Uzekami terrifies them. Your husband is the one on their lips. And we both know you are the one pulling strings behind him.
Indeed.  Well who are we, then, to deny the will of the people.  I believe, should you prove as impressive as you appear now, that we shall make a fearsome alliance, you and I.
We will make an amazing alliance. I will also be able to spread your amazing name in my travels and gain you more alliances.
Not here... in front of prying eyes.  I shall arrange for us to have a more... private audience so that we may discuss your... place here, in our Most Just war of Liberation.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Hello king. May I help you?
Hello goddess, I have come to seek your advice.
You must bow before me.
I came here to worship you and your godliness!
Then speak. I will help you faithful one.
Is it truly my divine right to be king, just because my father was before me? Am I doing a wrong in the world?
You are meant to be King. You are a better King than your farther ever was. You need to marry my King. You need an heir.
I don't think I can marry another king, because I already have a beautiful queen by my side.
She won't give you the heir you need. I have some beautiful servants here that will give you the heir the kingdom needs.
Why would I marry a mere servant, when I can have a beautiful Queen to myself?
Are you denying me?!
I am not, I am denying the servant!
My King, your Queen can't bare children.
I will find someone else to bear my children, as I am loyal to my wife.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

speech: My back is aching after a long day of hauling rocks.  I'm glad to see you are alright after the attack, guard.
I appreciate the kind words. I understand a hard days work. It is for sure not easy in this nasty swamp.
I fear I will one day be swallowed up by it.  Have you been out here all night?
We all fear it. Yes I have. Nothing is more important than protecting the king. And you? How long have you been working out here?
I have been hauling rocks for the master wall builder for 16 hours.  Only four hours left.  I hope one day to be an apprentice to the wall maker.
A true worker of the king I applaud you work and wish you good fortune. I have no doubt you will be the wall maker yourself one day soon.
Thank you for your confidence.  Thank you for keeping us safe at our work.
It is my honor to serve the king and his followers. As a soldier it is my duty and will protect the King with my life as we should all do.
Verily good sir.  I feel we all do our small part, but I am tempted to quit at times...do you ever contemplate revolt?
Haha absolutely not! Such statements against the king mean you lose your head. I quite like my head. This wall will hold correct?
Oh indeed.  Hahahaha.  I was only kidding of course.  I better be moving on so I can keep my head also.
I would suggest keeping such silly thoughts at bay but there is no reason to be frightened. As long as you do your job and I do mine everything goes perfectly.
Sounds great brother.  We will all do our parts and keep the king safe at all cost.  I'm glad we had this talk.
Keep up those thoughts and keep up your strength. The king shall reward us both for our loyalty.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Why is such a pan in my kitchen
Perhaps the budgetary demands of a request to have everything made of silver was a bit much...  Your highness.
I am the king, I get what I want. You take this pan I'm sure the kingdoms paupers would be happy with it
Yes your highness.  Although I am no longer a man of the cloth.  After seeing what certain shiny metals can do to even preachers I changed my ways
What do you think I should do about this affront to my station?
Do I have permission to speak freely your highness?
granted

Well, as you know your guard has the mightiest of weapons..  But perhaps we could smelt the silver from this kitchen to forge them better weapons.  These copper pans and the like do just fine for cooking.  Forgive me if this seems rude your highness
That is a wonderful idea, then we can take over Landon and will no longer worry about the cost of buying it

Yes.  And although I am but a preacher, I have heard of their mines..  Perhaps we could find even more precious metals there.  With your permission I would like to say a prayer and bless you your highness.
granted, then fetch me my generals so I can plan the grand campaign
Thank you!  I'll be sure to fetch them at once.  Thank you for your understanding.  I only wish I had come to you sooner about this issue to avoid such distress.  I've been praying over it for days.
I am a fair and reasonable king, do not let it happen again. No fetch my generals

At once.  Good bye my King.  I hope this will allow forgiveness from the Gods.  I haven't been myself lately and I hope I am not punished too fiercely when I meet my maker.  You have given me a new hope.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Why might you be here!
Just browsing. Does any of this stuff look valuable to you?
Not for me .I am immortal and only have one task. This treasure has no worth to a slave like me.
Would you mind if I take a closer look at this here silver.
I don't mind at all. Are you in need of more?
If you wouldn't mind too much. What can you tell me about this gem? It seems nice.
I have no knowledge of the gem. Do you have intentions to hurt the king?
I could care less about the king. But this coin looks nice. I'm just going to put it in my pocket for a minute.
Do you think you can defeat me? I  am immortal. I am unable to be defeated in battle.
Yeah, I've killed a bunch of people too. No one cares. Do you think I could sell this plate for a lot of money at the market?
The Plate is priceless. You needn't worry of guards. I am the kings only guard. As long as he isnt harmed .We are brothers
Hey, you and I are getting along just fine. Why don't you help me gather up some of this stuff and I'll be out of your hair in no time.
Look at these Gem encrusted Goblets. These will fetch a fair price at the market.
Thanks for your help! With all my new found riches is there any chance you'd be interested in becoming my new bodyguard? I'd make it worth your time.

setting.name: The town square
setting.description: A small park plaza with many trees and flowers, a small gazebo in the middle for larger gatherings. It has lamp posts all throughout as well as being well kept.
setting.background: It's a small park plaza in the middle of town where people gather and spend their time relaxing and socializing. It is the  main area of the town.

speech: Mmm look at all this delicious trash.
Jay! Hello! It's been so long. How have you been, old friend?
Be gone with you, you silly animal. I have worms to eat and people to attempt to hit with my droppings.
I can't believe you don't remember me! My feelings are hurt!
Oh I remember you all too well. All of the slobbering was a dead give away. Last time we met, I left completely soaked.
Oh, I'm sorry. Do you mind if I have some if this food? I'm so hungry ever since I left the castle!
You stupid mutt, come back with my bread. I was looking forward to eating that.
Come into the gazebo; we can share!
Fine, but if you slobber on me I promise, I will poop on you later.
I'll certainly try my best!  Such a beautiful flower over there. It makes me miss the king.
Yes, the king was a great man. His son is a real piece of work. I think taxes have tripled in the past few months.
Can you keep a secret? I know someone who may be able to help us. Would you be able to fly in the castle gardens and gather news?
Well, I guess I can try. With things as they are, most of the guards are half starved, so if they catch me, I am pretty sure they will eat me.
Hm, maybe we should try another tactic. If we can prepare them a meal with the leftovers the castle throws out, we may be able to bribe the guards to join our forces.
action: put trash bin in small gazebo
get trash bin from small gazebo

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: I want to spend some time with my money. Go away.
You thief! You know fully well that the tax money cannot be taken without the king's consent. He will hear of your treachery
Know your place, fool! I am your prince! You will tell the king what I say you wil tell him! Now, kiss my hand.

Kiss the hand of a traitor? I think not! Your father is blinded by his affections for you, but I am not. When your crimes come to light, you will be removed from this court. The King would have done well to listen to me when I told him of who you really are
So, you, in fact, are the one to be labeled "traitor". Tell me, betrayer, do you value the welfare of your children?

You think you can threaten me, how funny. It is your word against mine, and would the man who saved the King's life ever lie to him? Anything you do to me I will have done to you a hundred times over when you are cast out and can no longer compete for my influence.
Dead men cannot speak! Take this!
No weapons allowed in the kings court? Only for those who cannot improvise!
You will not leave this room with that. You will not leave this room alive.
Then that will make two of us
Let's finish this, betrayer!

You prove a worthy adversary, but in your struggle you have become distracted, and have lost your prize. You know full well that when this goes missing, the King will have both of our heads. Unless his power is taken. Leave with me and speak of this never, and surely you will be king by morning. You are a strong man, sharp and powerful, unlike your father. Together we will conquer the realm.
I don't trust you. You're as ambitious and as manipulative as myself, which makes you the most ambitious and manipulative person in the entire kingdom.

I am a wise man, gifted in the natural and the divine. I could have taken this at any point - after all, I keep the King's accounts. Why would I have waited for you to be here? I can see it, you long for greatness. You want to make this kingdom greater than your father ever could. You need a man like me to do that. And I need a strong ruler on the throne who will follow me. Imagine what we could be.
action: steal Gold from a royal prince

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Hm, where did I put that churner?  That milk won't turn inta butter on it's own.
The milk churner is over there, by the iron grill.
Ah thankye good sir.... sorry, I don't believe we've met.  I'm Mary, I just got taken on to do the cows here.
I am the gamekeeper and a very important person. The king sometimes visits me to hunt foxes.
Oh, well then, pleasure to me you, your ... your lordship? Your grace?
You shall call me your liege or you'll go back where you came from.
Ah, y-yes, your liege - I mean, my liege.  Please don't sack me, sir!
That reminds me, that utensil belongs over here!
Ah, sorry, so sorry.  Tis only my third day here and I didn't know!
Never you mind. I am just upset that there aren't as many foxes as there used to be...on account of us hunting them all the time.
B-beggin' your pardon, my liege, but... aren't ye worried about being cursed by the faerie folk when you hunt the foxes?  I heard Tom the Tinker say that faeries were in the woods nearby
If we find any fairies, then we will cook them on the grill over the fire!
Oh, my.  You must be the bravest man in the whole kingdom!  I don't know any folk whose no afraid o' the faire folk.
Are you mocking me?

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Ah, y-your Highness! I wasn't expecting you to be coming for the sword yourself.  My husband's the blacksmith here; he just went to the village for an errand.
I can't believe you mean to keep me waiting. Have you anything to offer the king for this inconvenience?
Well, if you'll forgive me for being impertinent, my King, there is the heavy tax that you imposed just this past season.  We've naught too much else.
But really, isn't everything you have already mine? I am the king.
Pardon me, your Lordship, but those tongs were, um, just in the fire... that iron stays hot for a while...
I knew that, I meant to burn my hand! I did it on purpose. Don't be so naive.
Of course... most wise King... of course... Your wisdom is widely known throughout the land.
Now, show me your first aid kit. I need to make sure this shop is up to code.
Oh, hot-hothothot..!
Where's your husband? I can tell you my father never had to wait for a blacksmith before. I find it offensive.
Your father was a great man.  He never had a harsh word for anyone and was a kind ruler.  It is astonishing, indeed, that you remember him when you act in such a contrary way.
I can't tell if I should be offended by that. Are you insulting me?

Your Highness' wisdom is outshone only by his own high opinion of himself, so I've no doubt that you need not strain overly much to puzzle it out.  Now, give me your hands, before they scar from those burns.
You are so kind..I think...I'm not sure. I'd like to leave now. This place is too hot.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Hrm.  This chamber is far too musty... a true ruler would make sure that even their torture chamber was clean and tidy.
Spoken like a soft, weak, liberal ruler. Exactly what I'd expect from you.
Just how your weak mind could come to any conclusions is behind me.  But by all means, expend your foolish breath with weak prattlings.
I can't wait until I finish building that wall. Then I'll never have to deal with the likes of you ever again!
Ha - good look financing your latest lavish castle without the levy from the Inner Duchies that support me, never mind a wall.
You will pay for that wall, and every time you complain the wall will get 10 feet higher!
Ha - even know your mind slips into meaningless gibber!  You churl, you have no right to the throne.
I was raised to be ruler! Perhaps you need to taste my blade to learn that lesson.
You can't even hold this properly!  How can you defend the kingdom when you can't even defend yourself?
You fell for my trick you fool. That knife handle is coated in poison. That's why I was holding it like that.

Even should I die here, the kingdom will split.  The Inner Duchies will know foul play when they see it, and you'll have a warring kingdom on your hands.  Even in death, I shall smile as your precious throne is burned in war and chaos.
The only thing that will be burning around here is your poisoned corpse.
Perhaps we should die together... brother!
Nice try you silly person! I shall bury your body in the bottom of the wall and you will forever protect my kingdom.
action: steal a knife from the king

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Thank you! Peace is my priority.
how are you sir? do you need anything?
Good! I am fine.
well let me know what you may need if you desire anything
I could use a glass of water after climbing all these stairs.
of course i will be right back
Thank you! Tell me a little about your kingdom! How are things?
the king seems to be striving which is great, i love seeing him succeed
Where is the princess this lovely evening?
im not sure, last i saw she was in her room
You are a fine servent everything is sparkling!
Thank you i try my hardest, keeping this job to feed myself is priority
I heard your kngdom is having money issues. Is this true?
only the peasants struggle

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The red velvet curtains provide privacy and speak to the washing away of sins as the repentant person leaves the booth. The solid oaken bench provides no comfort, and hurries the churchgoer along in their confession. Behind the sheer screen is the waiting priest. Ornate designs are carved into the side of the confessional. Above it is a painting, dulled by age, but still depicting Jesus' death and resurrection with resounding clarity.
setting.background: The confessional is as ancient as Catholicism itself. Since the beginning of the Sacrament of Penance, this tiny, benched room has provided countless sinners with respite from their sin.

speech: Your sins are forgiven, go and sin no more. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be upon you.
thank you father, its been a struggle
Fear not, dear child.  Thy confessed sins have been washed clean and are remembered no more.
how has your week being bishop
Always blessed, always blessed, though much is expected of me.  As you know, the wedding of the prince fast approaches and there are so many preparations!
i can imagine with such a large ceremony it must be difficult
Are you not also, as a member of the choir, undergoing great and lengthy preparations for the ceremony and celebration?
well its much simpler learning new verses and nothing else
Why surely the King has high expectations of a most impressive choral presentation!  I must speak to him at once; we must not disappoint his majesty! Surely you could speak to the choirmaster?
trust that we know what we are doing, i simply mean one task does not consume as much time as setting it all up
Of course, I have misunderstood you!  Go now, and reflect on this painting of your Lord and Savior as you go; remembering how he died for you and will be with you always.  I must attend to the King!
have a blessed day sir bishop
fare thee well, and safe journeying to you.  I shall no doubt see you again soon in the confessional!
of course sir

setting.name: Marketplace
setting.description: Merchants call out their wares and try desperately to get the attention of the wealthier passerby. People from all over the world hustle to and fro, some keenly eyeing the many tapestries, spices, tools and foods, others openly staring in wonder. Still others hurry along, heads down and avoiding eye contact. Colors, smells and sounds assault the senses. The cries of the gulls can hardly be deciphered from the chatter of the crowds, the ringing of the blacksmith's hammer, the bells of the nearby shipyard, and the hollers of the merchants.
setting.background: The marketplace began with the founding of the port town. Gradually as more and more ships rolled in, more products were available, until the marketplace became fundamental to the success and well-being of the town. When the marketplace thrives, the town thrives.

speech: hello jester, how are you today?
I am gr... gr... great! It is a great day to dance!
well that is nice to here, im simply here to pick up paints for my next piece
I would love to help you! Howver, I need to practice singning and learn new dance moves if I'm ever going to be worthy of preforming infront of the king!
this paint should do nicely, and this new painting tool will be nice
Wow you picked out some great colors! You should paint a portrait of me singing and dancing for the king!
i would but im swampd with commissions
That's okay. I will still be the greatest jester the king has ever seen! What are you going to paint if not a portriat of me?
i have a landscape the king wants me to paint
You paint for the king? Can I come with you to meet him? I will entertain him with my awesome moves and sing while you paint the landscape..
we will see some day
The market place sure is busy today. The food smells  lovely and all this dancing is making me hungry! Are you getting hungry?
i am i may buy some spice to make food with
I could go for a spiced turkey leg. I could eat a whole horse right now!

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Well, well, well. Aren't you a fine looking hunter.
Hello. What might you be doing here?
We came here for a meeting and I'm just doing a little sightseeing.
"We?" Quite strange to be having a meeting in the Abandoned.
No, our meeting was yesterday at the castle with the King's Council. There's no funny business here friend.
My apologies, friend. My boys here wanted to explore, and we weren't expecting to see anyone
I think I got turned around a bit. I don't see much here to look at. What do they call this place?
The king never gave it a name, so we just call it Abandoned
Come on! That's a horrible name. I'm gonna call this skeleton Donald.
Well, this land is barren. It's too hot for any life, and there's nothing of value here. Not unless you need a skeleton for potions.
Why are you hunting in a place with no animals? Is there anywhere near here where my new friend Georgie and I can get a pint or four?
I'm here with my two sons. They wanted to do a bit of exploring, just to see what is out here.
Sounds plausible to me. You're all welcome to join me for ale. My treat.
Thank you friend, but I'm afraid my boys are too young to enjoy ale, yet. As a hunter, I need to keep my head clear, as well.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Dear kind and gentle Sir; I do beg thee to take a bit of pity on me and provide me with any kitchen scraps that may be available.  I have not eaten since yesterday morn.
I am sorry my friend.what is your name if i may ask?
I am too worthless to be spoken of by name in your sight, kind sir.  I am most humbled that you do but speak to me.  Might there be any gleaning in your fields if there are no kitchen scraps?
Don't be afriad
Oh, kind sir; you cannot know what grief has befallen me.  My young son of but 7 years has sickened from eating from the waste in yonder yard.  But I had nothing to offer him and he was so hungry!

I am sorry my friend.But to let you know I work here as a farm worker where I feed the animals and attend to the gardens, as you can see my quarters are very dirty but let me get you something from the house
Thank you so, kind Sir; may the Most high God bless and keep you!  Know that I am most willing to scratch the ground for leftover carrots or wilted cabbage.  It is all a blessed gift to me.
Welcome, but allow me get you some cooked food. I can also arrange and get you some carrots which you will take away with you.
Your kindness will not be forgotten, good Sir, in this life or the one to come!!
Amen. but also pray for me, I am struggling here in my own ways but I believe God has a reason why I have to stay here and for his Majesty

Surely you will be blessed for your kindness.  May the Good King see your faithfulness and dedication to him and reward you greatly.  I will most gratefully go and feed my son now.  Blessings be upon you!
Bless be upon you too. Kindly wait I rush to the farm and bring you some carrots and cabbage for your family
forgive me my forwardness; I cannot help myself.  I have so rarely experienced such generosity and kindness in this world.  But thanks be to God, who watches over us all.  His ways are mysterious!
Welcome the father in heaven will continue to bless you and your family as well. Say hi to your people

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: I think I deserve a glass of wine. After, the battle my royal army just won. I think the king would agree!
The king may agree, but does the lord? I think so.
I know for a fact the lord would agree! Here's to winning yet another battle! Have some wine good fellow!
Thank you brave knight. Would you care to tell an old prior the story of your battle?
It was a gruesome battle over the land we concured thier whole army. Even took home a few prisoners.
My my, what will you do with the captured prisoners?
After they are interrogated we may behead them or turn them into servants. The king will decide,
The lord would prefer mercy, as they were only defending their homeland. We can understand that. I will pray for them regardless.
The lord may prefer mercy but the king shall decide thier final fate.
Ill drink to that
Another round to celebrate our victory! This wine tastes as fine as victory!
Amen knight.
A great battle is a terrible thing but in the midst of blood and carnage, there is sometimes also beauty, beauty that could break your heart.
I have seen many young knights come back from battle and talk of beauty, however there is also great sadness and loss

setting.name: The Chapel
setting.description: Quiet and serene, the chapel is lined with oak pews where worshipers can sit
setting.background: Made 100 years ago, this chapel has a long history in this town. people have gathered here to worship for 3 generations!

speech: Hello Bishop! It is good to see you today.
Good day to you as well, Father.  Have you spoken to the servants concerning the repairs that must be made in the chapel in preparation for the Prince's wedding?
No, but it is on my list. I have been very busy trying to get our soup kitchen up to speed.
Ah, yes; that is most certainly a constant concern.
Now, do you think we may be able to raise some money at the Prince's wedding? It would go a long way towards helping the poor.

I cannot think that money raising at the occasion of the Princes's wedding would be well received by the King!  But perhaps we could consider a local fair to provide a bit of cheer to the townspeople.  I know times have been difficult.
My people cannot subsist on cheer. They need food and shelter.
And I do not suggest that cheer alone will suffice!  But the heart may be encouraged by a bit of cheer and meanwhile we must earnestly pray for better crops this spring.
Back to the Prince's wedding, what are we going to do about his wife. We are sullying the church by even letting her in here. She is not pious enough for our Lord.

Surely you must restrain your tongue, Father! If the King were to hear such a remark..... it would not bode well for you.  Let us leave matters of the court in God's hands.  Perhaps I could speak to the sisters at the nunnery about donating bread to the needy.
Don't act so holy Bishop. We all know about your reputation in seminary. I think Sister Margaret is scarred for life!
Best be warned Father! The power of the crown is on my side and I would not be so quick to pass judgement on matters you know little of.
Okay Bishop. Perhaps you'd like to explain why the church has to send 10 gold pieces to that woman in the next village with the odd looking son who shares your large nose.

It's time for you to tend to your soup kitchen, Father! Off with you; I have more important matters to attend to, such as having these pews restained and polished in preparation for the wedding!  Good Day!

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: You have summoned me, my Queen?
Yes. Tell me how wonderful I am.
Why of course, Your Highness. You rule the Kingdom fairly so that your subjects love you, your taste in sculpture is impeccable, and you have the loveliest countenance in all the land.
Wow. Be careful, flattery might get you somewhere. You busy later tonight?
I would not say it were it not true, Your Highness. For all the years I have lived here, I have known nothing but your kindness. Does Your Majesty have a request?
Yeah. I'd like you to visit my bedchamber at midnight. Come alone. And bring your smile.
Your Majesty...I... please forgive my surprise at your forthcoming.
Your surprise has only begun. Prepare your mind to be blown. Frankly, the king's been on his stupid crusade for far too long. I'm lonely.
My Queen, are you comfortable? Let me fetch you a pillow to rest upon. King Reginald has been gone for quite a time, and without any news from the encampment.
Goodness. I want to talk about something other than the king or war or fetching.
Ah yes, very well. My apologies for bringing it to your attention. Please, sit and relax Your Highness.
You should relax with me. You look tense.
Your Highness, you know as well as I the risks we take if caught by the Council.
I am Queen. There is only risk if I say there is risk. Now leave me and return tonight. I've grown bored with your caution and prudence.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Hello, loyal knight. What are you doing here?
Your Highness, I come to retrieve my robe.  It holds magical powers which offer protection in battle! I count it as my prized possession!
Be more attentive, knight, as leaving things behind like this is a sign of recklessness!
Nay, your Highness!  I purposely placed it here earlier, knowing that you and her Royal majesty would be dining.  It is loyal to me, but when asked, will protect others as well!
It protects others even when they are not wearing it themselves? Either way, go back to your post!
Of course, your Majesty!  I would do no other than to obey your ever command!  Long live the king, and long live the robe!
That's right, knight. True loyalty is a promising trait in you!
You will find none more brave, more true, more loyal amongst your ranks!  Would that I lead your Royal armies, there would be no chance of defeat!
Well if we find that you are truly worthy, in time, you will eventually reach that position.
It be but your loss, Your Highness, if your kingdom were to be called to battle but not under my leadership!
You're very persistent, but you know that you haven't been here long enough for us to assess your potential yet.

Look upon the strength of this massive room, your Majesty!  The hewn heavy oak, the gigantic chandeliers;  they speak of the strength that lies within me; I am destined to be your champion and lead your troops into battle!
Enough, knight! You need to remember who rules over the other, now you will respect our will and decision of leadership, understood?
I'm on my way then - only hope for your sake that you see who I am meant to be before it is too late!

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: -and so then I said, that's no turkey! That's my wife!
Ohhh I knew you were the right choice, what a natural fool you are!
Now for my next display of entertainment and spectacle, would His Highness prefer another story or perhaps something different?
Hmm surprise me this time around.
Very good, very good! I've been working on this next one.
With the way that you hype it up, this better be worth it.
Your Majesty, I request your participation. Think of a number, any will do. But don't say out loud.
Okay... I've chosen one now.
Now, Your Highness...Double that number, then add 10.
Alright I've done that as well. What are you getting at, fool?
Take your sum, and divide in half, then subtract your original number.... You're now thinking of.....5 are you not?
Hmm... yes I am, that's quite incredible fool!
Thank you, Your Highness. It is an honor to create new ways to entertain you!
Of course, fool. Keep this up and you will be a fine addition to the kingdom.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Well you appear to be the Queen of this area, am I right?
These are my Kings lands, and mine as well
Well I am just a traveling king, and it is always good to know who is in charge of where you travel to.
Do you like the garden?
It's quite nice, yes. What is grown in it?
Roses, lavender, hedges, and many other flowers
Good choice, I would've chosen nearly the same
Where do you hale from?
Ohh just a neighboring kingdom, that's all.
Here is a rose, so you may remember our kingdom
That is a kind gesture, queen. I will remember it as I continue on my travels.
Where are you traveling to?
Just scouting neighboring kingdoms to see what they are like and whether to trade and commune with them.
Do you need lodging for the night?  I'm sure the King would like to meet you.
