setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Hello, how are you today?
Oh, jester, I didn't see you there. I'm fine. How are you?
I'm doing alright, I suppose. Sorry about that.
Don't worry. It's just that I've been in thought.
Ohh what about?
My path to the throne. I wonder what the point of royal blood is if I'll never be on the throne.
I guess some people are just higher on the hierarchy and that's just the way things turned out.
Yeah. I mean I have things well. Some don't even have a place to stay. I shouldn't be down.
Glad I could help, gotta look on the bright side of things.
You are good at helping people do that, jester.
I guess that's why I decided to make it my job
I'm glad the king thought that, too. He is wise.
I just hope that he finds my work as good as I think it is.
If he didn't, I suspect you may not be here right now, jester.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: What brings you here, sir?
I am a craftsman my loyal highness here to look some inspiration to build a boat
A craftsman? What brings you into my throne room against my own will?
I came here to ask for your permission to build a large towering boat that could fit the whole village and since i could not find you in your chambers i thought i could look around
The whole village?! That is not a reasonable request at all, craftsman!
I am thinking of a titanic like boat that would really help in water transportation my king
Titanic? Look, start speaking the correct language and we can discuss why you bring such an awful idea to me while trespassing here!
I wanted to share this idea with you so that i can embark on building the boat today
Absolutely not! Such a boat would require much too many resources, and what is this boat presumably even for?
Transportation my king it will ease the congestion we usually experience
This boat is much too inefficient and impossible to navigate with!
The past king painted king had approved this idea so i wanted to run it through you so that i can know what you think
How could they approve this? Have any proof of such a claim?
Yes we had a written agreement i have it with me here

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Maid, I am in need of some assistance right this instant!
Yes my Queen? What may I help you with? Cleaning?
No no, everything seems... off. This mead is stale and my bodice is too tight!
Would you like me to let out your bodice my Queen? So that you may relax and rest on the king sized bed? It looks inviting with it's 4 posts and blue canopy.
That sounds lovely, dear chambermaid.
Yes my Queen. Maybe once you are more comfortable you can read a book. I would also really like to read one, perhaps on history!
You could do both and read one to me if you'd like?
That would be lovely! I often get tired of just cleaning so this will be wonderful!
Agreed, and I am far too tired to read myself at the moment. Go right on ahead, maid.
Would you like to hear a history book my Queen, or perhaps a lighter subject such as comedy?
Let's go with some history, shall we?
Of course! I will read about the prehistoric days, so interesting and often the subject of my daydreams while cleaning.
Sounds good, maid. Go on and begin whenever.
Yes my Queen, chapter one starts off with Caveman, here we go. The average caveman was not bright, yet..

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Oh, hello. Who are you?
I am but a simple peasant. Do you think you can gain me a talk with the king?
Sorry but I am not that powerful at all, just a random subject of the king.
Oh, okay. I apologize. Who might I be able to talk to?
Well you could find somebody who is powerful enough to meet you with the king?
Yes. I really want to have a good look around here as well. Such wonderful things.
You aren't wrong, I think it is well worth the look.
Yes. Definitely worth a look. Maybe a bit more.
What do you mean by that?
I'd sack this entire village if I could. And your king would be ours. I was thrown out of this kingdom ages ago.
How long ago do you mean? Tell me!
Oh, we will meet again. I'll be back.
Hey, what is wrong with you!?
This village will be under my control.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Hello my king. How can I serve you?
Get me 3 beautiful virgins that can sing and make me laugh
Yes sir. I will do my best but that might be difficult to find down here
I am willing to pay anything but don't let the queen know if not you will be banished
Would you be willing to give me my freedom?
run along before i have you shot
Ok ok I am sorry sir
run along now boy
Here I am off to find those virgins for you. I will bring you 4 to make up for angering you
Soldiers will shoot you now
Ok I guess I deserve to die for not serving you well enough
but today I will have mercy on you, now go get my virgins
Thank you sir. Here are your virgins. I hope they are to your liking
One is too old she seem to be 40 years old and the middle one is just a child are you crazy?

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: I am the King and it is great to be the King. Today I will dine with my General, the best man I have ever known. We shall dine a feast with great meats and wine!
hai i wan a drink
Hark goes there? Such a fowl creature. You should not be at the top of this tower!
ok .... i want.... do u no
I do not understand you little one. Perhaps you should ask one of the peasants in the meadow how to speak to a king.
ok no problam
I will await your return while resting in my nice carved rocking chair. Make haste!
ok bye
I shall expect your return to the tower soon.
yes
You have a pea brain little bird. I wonder if you hit the stone walls while flying down the tower.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: I am a the king's guard.
I am a hangman who makes sure bandits and murderers are not part of our society
I am fighting against the army to overthrow the king.
Why do you want to overthrow the king
I don't want to overthrow the king. I am protecting the king.
That is nice of you,you should always protect the king against any resistance
I have pledge my life to defend the king.
That is admirable of you so what are you doing in the public execution stand rare place to be especially for you
I making sure that everything is orderly.
As for me i am just thinking back on all the criminals  i have eliminated
This world is better off without them.  Don't you think?
Yeah they just poison the society though sometimes i feel bad for them especially those with family members
I do too. I believe you reap what you sow.
Yeah especially nowadays the young people are the one who are into criminal activities

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: So, this is where we keep the "equipment" if you will. What exactly did you need to inspect?
We have a hanging this afternoon and I want to make sure everything is ready
Oh of course. We've placed new bolts in the gallows, nice and sturdy. Go on give it a look over.
Ok I agree it looks good. You know how angry the king gets when things don't go smoothly.
Indeed I do. I also remember what happened last time, so we've sharpened the knife to cut the condemned down afterwards.
Perfect. That was a complete disaster. I think you'll be hung next if that happens today. Do you have any sinners you will be embarrassing today?
Just the one. It's been a slow week this week, with the religious holiday coming soon. Puts most everyone on their best behavior.
Tis true. I will have to make sure to not miss it then. How are your kids? Old enough to want to follow in their fathers footsteps?
Oh of course not. They're only at the age where they wish to torture and tattle on each other. To be honest, they've given me some new and interesting techniques to try.
That's hilarious. I can only imagine. Give your wife my best. I look forward to seeing you this afternoon. The king is very excited about this one
Absolutely. It's always a trick to figure out which public displays will get his majesty's attention isn't it? There never seems to be a rhyme or reason to it.
Yeah his mind is on another level. I guess that's why he's the king and we are his humble servants. This knife really is excellent. You've done very well
I suppose so. Like the Torturer Guild motto tells us, "Keep your mind sharp, but your blade sharper!" afterall.
Wise words to live by. You never know what kind of crazy person is going to try something around here.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: O Priestess, the king has sent me here to bring news of a meeting to be held next week, if you oblige.

Good day and welcome all to the Hall of echoes. Today as we always do, we celebrate the last 5 years of peace after the Great War. And we so in our grand house lit up with hundreds of windows. All hail the King!!
I see, your highness. In commemoration of this sacred event the King wishes to meet with you. I shall return with your response if you wish.
I see faithful servant. Thanks you for your services. I will oblige the king with a meeting, if you will please deliver my message to him.
Thank you for your kind greeting. Might I give you a gift as a token of the King's appreciation?
Why yea of course. How generous of the king!
In recognition for your service to the king I present thee with this amulet.
Such a grand amulet indeed! You are a dear and faithful servant. You serve the king well.
Thank you, o powerful priestess.
Please give the king this cloth lined with gold for his nose please. Thank you.
Thank you for this precious gift. I shall return to the palace and present it to the King along with your acceptance of the meeting.
Splendid! You have done well and provided the king and I with excellent services. I shall reward you with some silver coins for you and your family.
Thank you again.
May you have a safe journey, and I shall hope to see you soon here in our great Hall of echoes. I will sit back down in my throne now.

setting.name: bathing room
setting.description: the bathing room is a huge steamed room with a hot tub. The tub is full of older priests and the occasional wench that's half naked. The room is clean, but hard to see as it is so steamy. There are loud noises of people laughing and men grunting.
setting.background: the bathing room has an ironic name and doesn't really serve for bathing, it is used for discretional activities that priests shouldn't do in the temple.

speech: Hello father. I hope the bath is clean enough for you
Yes, this will do. Janitor, how much thought do you give to the cleansing of one's inside after spending so much time cleansing the outside?
Um, I guess I've never thought about it. I just like to look at the beauty of the world and not at myself
Do you not think that your essence, your soul is deserving of the same attention you would give any other part of you?
I'm only a lowly janitor. I doubt my soul is worth much of anything
Ah see? A humble attitude sets you on the right path already. Do you not think we are all equals in the eyes of the elder gods?
I guess it is possible but I assume the kings and their servants like you would be on a higher level
This is the sort of attitude that has gotten us to where we are today... Now, where did you get that notion?
Well the way the king talks it seems like he is almost an equal to the gods if not better
And the way you talk, it would seem as if you were nothing at all. But we both know better than that, now don't we?
Well I wouldn't say I'm nothing. I think I'm an excellent janitor
Ah ha! If you believe it so, and work to make it so, it shall be so.
Well thank you father. You have given me a confidence I didn't know I had in me. What should I do now?
Search within, and learn what it is you believe to be so. Only then you will know what to do.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: What are you doing in here at the Sacrificial altar? This is a holy place! You look like you might be a peasant..
I am a peasant. I barely eat.
So you decide to steal scraps from the altar instead? At least have dignity and knock on the main door and request food!
The king looks down on us. I do have dignity.
But I am a nun, I serve God, and in doing so I serve his people. There is no class in the eyes of God.
You are right. God sees me like he sees everyone else.
Absolutely! I can come off as over-bearing at times, but God is my King. I can't let you stay here though. You'll get us both killed if the king finds out you're stealing.
Can you give me something to eat?
I intended to, as God would do the same. But the king shows no mercy for thievery. If I give it to you, well, that's a different story. Ask and you shall receive.
You are so kind. Thank you
You're welcome. I was reluctant at first, but my religion is everything. Come around to the side kitchen so you can receive some food left over from the dining hall.
Okay, then I will be on my way.
Great, I will meet you around there. I'll provide enough for you and your family.
Bless you lady.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: What are you doing here?
My Lord, a talking horse. My grief must have driven me insane.
Horses do talk.  You must have a special gift to understand me.
No. Everyone's dead. My husband's dead. I must be either crazy or dead. I don't know which. I'd rather be dead, then I could be with my husband.
Are you losing your mind? I am not dead and you aren't either.
I must be losing my mind. A horse is talking to me. If only my husband were alive...
He is dead and we are living.  Let it go. Live for a cup of coffee in the morning. I live for my king.
You must have never loved. You can't have loved. You're just a horse. A horse that talks, proof that my grief has broken me.
I love my master. I love life.
Who is your master?
He is the King.

There's no king. Look. There's only the sheriff's office, a bar, and a church. Everything else is gone. No music from the bar, no criminals for the sheriff to catch, and no God to worship at the church.
You need to rest a spell.  You are in a lot of stress.
Of course I'm in a lot of stress. As far as I know, this collection of buildings is the last bit of civilization left in the whole world. Everything else is gone. Gone! My husband! Gone!

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: I just love being a woman
At least you'll get to live. I'm praying I'll get to, too.
what made you sick. No one in the kings bedroom ever gets sick
I don't know what really caused it, but now I have these sores all over my body and I feel weak. Like I'm dying. And it scares me.
ok I can ask ask the doctor to help you or the magician which do you prefer?
Is he a good magician?
super good but there might be consequences
I'm willing to take them if it helps me get better. I just don't want to die.
ok lets go talk to the king, i will use my powers and he will summon the magician. so that he does not charge you afterwards
Thank you so much for being kind to me.
you work here, you deserved it
Alright. Let me bundle up and I will be ready to go.
sure. See you soon buddy
OK, let's go to the King.

setting.name: Ferry Terminal
setting.description: A huge terminal with a lot of traffic. The Ferry Terminal has a warm and positive vibe that welcomes all travelers across the land. It has an open space with a lot of illumination during the night.
setting.background: The ferry terminal is the heart of the land. Many travelers have come and departed though this point, always telling new stories about other lands adventures that become live once retold.

speech: Hello I am the captain.This is a great place to be.
well, i am just a child, how does it feel to be the captain
It's wonderful! I keep the king and queen safe during their travels.
do you have kids of your own?
No children the water is my life! Where are your parents even tho this is a warm place you still need supervision

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What can I get for you to drink?
I want blood because I hate humans.
Oh my, and why do you hate humans?
I blame them for my station in life.
Well, what happened to cause your misfortune?
They banished me to a damp swamp.
I am sorry for that.  But, look at you now.  You are in this cheerful little pub enjoying a drink I am about to give you.
I long for blood on my sword.  Give me bloody Mary.
Anger and hatred won't help you at all.  Will only make it worse.  Here is your drink.
Thank you. Who are you to talk to me like that?
I am but a lowly bartender for his majesty, the king.
Just be quiet and pour my drink.  Do you want a tip?
Showing your true colors, eh?  You can keep the tip.
Okay, I will do that.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

speech: Hello horse. Do you know what has happened here? What has caused all this death?
I am the personal transport horse for the king. It seems as though the pond was poisoned by someone or something...
Oh no. That is terrible. Is the King on his way to investigate? Maybe I can help.
I am his main horse because of my large regal mane. It makes me distinct. I can ask my stable keeper if the king intends to investigate or if he will send someone.
I may be able to help too. I can fly around and see if I can spot who might have done this. You ask too.
Wonderful you are a very special and magical creature. Thank you!

You are impressive too. You are large and I am small  but we both have our talents. I'll fly around and be right back with a report. By the time I get back, maybe you will have heard if the King is coming.
Yes this is a good plan. You are a great help and a brave bird. His majesty will be pleased with your efforts.
I'm back and I've found a clue. I picked up an empty poison bottle. It says it came from a mine to the south of here!
Oh no! Maybe we can find out who made the footprints near the pond. This may help us find out how the poison got here.
I assume the footprints belong to whom every dropped the poison cans. I can fly further south to search. Can you run to the north and search?
Yes I would be happy to oblige. I will ask my fellow horses to assist me as well.
Great, the more the merrier. Bring back any suspecious people.
Excellent we will use our carriage in the stables.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: Greetings, visitor.
Hello sir. I have stock from my farm that I'm looking to trade. Are you interested?
What are you looking for?
Gold would be sufficient.
Let me inspect your stock.
Sure thing. I have eggs, goat's milk, and cheese.
I'll trade you 5 gold coins.
I can offer you 3 eggs, half pound of cheese, and a liter of milk for that amount of gold.
There you go! Have a great day.
Thank you, sir! Please enjoy.
Come back again in a week.
I will! Or if you would like to visit my farm, I live just up the rive. I sail down here on my raft to trade twice a week. It's a lovely town.
I must never leave. My job is to protect the king. We only take trades by delivery.
Oh, that must be quite boring, never being able to travel anywhere.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: Don't try anything with me!
Yer new to this whole hurtin' people thing, ain't ya?  Can always tell - ya havn't got the thirst fer it, kingie.
Think what you want to think.... I will destroy all that oppose me.
Gots a lot a'enemies, do ya?
What can you expect when you are in power?

Well then, yer Kingliness, I gots a proposition for ya.  Don't imagine either o'us be wanted to stay in this dank place fer too long, specially not with your fancypants robes there.  Hows about ye have a listen at wat old Jack can offer ye?
What are you thinking?
Well now - you gots folk that... need takin care of.  But you can't  have yer pretty little hands with them shiny baubles on your fingers gettin' all dirty, now can yeh?
I'm comfortable taking care of it on my own. I like that people fear me.

Fair enough, I understand the thrill, the chase, the screams... ah sorry, lost me thought fer a moment.  Ah! But sometimes theres some blighter that ye need taken care of quiet like, ain't there?  Maybe a lass ya fancy has a husband that's a might too jealous, if ya know what I mean.
I have plenty of people to ask for help - I have an army!

True enough - and that's all very well an' good if ye be facing another king.  But this man 'ere is a noble in yer own court.  And the other nobles, well, they might not be takin a likin if ye be stealing their wives under their noses.  Maybe ye could squash em, but that's more monies to the armies and less ta line yer own pockets with, see?
I'm not interested in your help
Ha!  Ye weak noodle, yer no match fer Old Jack!

setting.name: A wet dungeon
setting.description: It is dark and eerie, especially because there is only one candle. The candle is low on wax, it will be out soon. The brick walls surrounding the dungeon are scratched with fingernails, moss is growing.
setting.background: The dungeon is in a low underground chamber by the castle. It is under water, or a lake. Fresh water keeps dripping from the ceiling, and it smells like fish.

speech: What are you in here for, hag?
Hag? Hag?! I know you Sir. Atten. You should show some respect. You and I are here for the same reason. The new king seems to not be much of a fan of those that served the old king.
Whatever old hag. Dont bother me or I will lose my temper. You probably wont live long enough to anger me anyway.
You were always an ungrateful brat, you should learn to respect your elders. I was in charge of watching you back before my small cabin was burned. When you were young.
I don't care lady. We are both here now, much good you did yeah? You will soon be out of your misery though and I will be left here to rot indefinitely.
HA! I served the king same as you, we're both going to death.
And I have a much longer road than you.
You speak of having a longer road, but I am much older than you. My road has been much longer.
And free of worry. My road will be long and full of boredom and dread.
Look around you! we are in the same cell. We are likely going at the same time.
You are ancient and will die of old age. They have been feeding us, but barely enough to stay alive. At this rate I can go for at least another thousand suns.
Ha! well I guess I'll take this "food" they've been giving us. I need it more than you.
Go ahead. I have been contemplating starving myself anyway.
You will not have to contemplate long. Look at the scratches on the walls. 7 days worth of tick marks. We are on the seventh day here, today it ends.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: How am I supposed to bite a ghost? What a conundrum!
You should go to the castle and bite the new king
I try to stay away from the fat fool...him and his disgusting wife.
him and his wife are awful. I try to torment them all the time
Plus, she smells as bad as this swamp. Now, I've lost my appetite!
Well I don't blame you. But if we torment him maybe we can get him and his wife to leave
I don't care where they go as long as they and all of the other stupid people stay away from my house. I'm tired of them trampling around my yard!
Well I will stay away from your yard.
Don't worry ghost. You don't even leave footprints. Do you have any little ghost kids at home?
No ghost kids, I have no one left in my lineage. Do you have baby snakes?
More than I can count. Although, after they are born, they just kind of slither away and take care of themselves.
That's good, more food for you in the swamp. Have you had a lot of interaction with the new king
Not much. He's so fat that he barely leaves the castle. I do look forward to getting my fangs in the princess however.
You should do that! What can I do to help you bite her?!

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: hello guest
Hello there,how goes the kingdom
It is going well. We are fairly secure and having a good crop yield this season! What is it that you do?
I am a merchant who travels alot
What is it you sell? What brings you here?
I sell wine
Is that why you are here ?
I am just enjoy spending time with powerful people
Well, at least tell me a story of a traveling merchant. I have never lived such a life and want to live vicariously through your stories.
It would take far to long to do that but here try some of this fine wine
I am a king, you do not tell me what to do in my kingdom, in my palace. You could have poisoned it for all I know.
How dare you insult me in such a way
GUARDS, TAKE THIS MAN AWAY
You will never catch me

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hello how's the breeze
A talking crab! My children would love this. Oh, apologies, I mean, the breeze is wonderful, how about you come with me to my house? The weather is even better there.
I only live in the ocean all my life it is my home sorry i cannot come with you

I see... Well, that reminds me, I need to gather some sea food for the king, do you know where I can get some, I don't want to capture your friends and or food though, so do you know of any catch you wouldn't mind for me to catch?
Do you like salty fish
I sure do, hopefully the king would feel the same way. Thank you very much.
You are welcome so you came looking for food?

I guess so, the king ordered me to fetch fish for the castle's feast, however, I also take the time here to gather food for my family and self, for the king doesn't pay me enough to get enough food for me and my family.
That is nice of you family is everything take care of them.You should also bring your family to the beach in order to enjoy the views and the white sand
Thanks. Also, thank's for the wonderful idea, I'll try to bring my family here when I'm free from work on my off days.
Are you ready to go and fish
I sure I'm. Thanks!
Let me show you where you can find many fish
Yes, thank you so very much. I'll do my best diving and/or reeling to get the best catch.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: Halt! Who are you?
I am but a weary traveller in need of a place to rest my head.
Where are you coming from?
Mormogon, off the Eastern coast. It is racked with pestilence.
A Dungeon is quite a strange place to want to rest your head. How did you get down here?
I... must have gotten turned around. I am very weary from my travels.
How did you get past all the trap doors if you are so tired?
The gods have blessed me with very good fortune.
I do not trust you. I am here to protect the King. You are up to something.
Oh but surely kindness is not a stranger in this land? Wait... what's that over in that corner?!?
Don't you dare move! I am on to you! You will never reach the King!
You'll never catch me, you fool!
I don't know why you need this bone, but you can not have it. Your hits do nothing to me with my armor on! You are weak!
Muahahaha That's what you think, foul human! I spent years studying the weak spots on armor!
action: steal Bone from a masked torturer
steal bone from a vigilant guard

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: I am so depressed working in this cemetery.  I wish I could work somewhere else.
It's OK buddy come drink tea in my ferry home maybe that would calm you down
Thank you very much.  That would cheer me greatly.
How did you end up as a grave digger
My father was one and I helped him.  when he died, I took on the role.
OK I hope you have a family of your own
No, only me.  Do you have a family?  Your home is beautiful.  Much better than my small room.
Yes I have a little son and 2 wives
Two wives?  Is that typical for fairies to have multiple spouses?
Yes I am always horny I begged to be an exception and the king agreed. I love my wives
Do you interact with the king a lot?
Yes I can ask him to help you become a farmer
I don't have the skills but am eager to learn.  Thank you for the help
No problem my friend just be honest when he speaks because even if you lie he will know

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Ah, it can be so stressful preparing for the Queen and other royals everyday, but at least I get to stay in this nice place.
Quiet you! I do not like peasants. Just do your job or I will tell the King. I am good friends with the King.
Okay, I'll do my job. However, you may never know the day when you're working for me.
Work for you? HA! Do you not know how this Monarchy works? I am surprised you haven't been beheaded yet. I want a new maid and will report your disrespect directly to the King!
Okay then. But if the Queen's bedroom isn't as consistently and nicely made up as it used to be prior to me being fired, if I were to be fired by the King, it would be your fault.
There are plenty of maids that that can this job. You haven't even done a good job. Know your place, peasant!

Apologies, for the slap, that was just self-defense. Perhaps, if I... Perhaps when I become ruler of this kingdoom, I would put people like you in a special place for a while until proper manners are learned.

I don't know what kingdom you think this is, but no peasant maid can ever become ruler of this Kingdom. My friend the King will hear of this. I can't wait to attend your beheading and see if you will be grinning then.
Ha, you'll see one day. You'll see one day. The day this kingdom falls. But, for now, don't tell the king, I need lunch.
You will get no lunch peasant. We are waiting for the King to get here so he can know of your pestilence.

Yikes... That's what I said, but soon, you would say the same thing once I activate this bell, this bell will deploy many servants, and my plan is to cause a bunch of chaos, then plan my exit, then plan a rebellion, then become ruler, then dived this country into states, then become a legend.

No one will listen to you, peasant! Everyone fears the king and your puny rebellion and any one who joins it head will wind up on a pike for everyone to see. I came to the town to see the King, but now I will always love seeing your head a top a pike!
Well then. Hopefully you know how to out run elephants, my family out east has a bunch of them.
You will not get away with any of this!

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: I will guard the Altar room with my life King.
Thank you my valiant guard! My wife will be happy for your loyalty.
What a beautiful room this is with all the gold. I am afraid my King we should not be here.
It is my divine right to be here, as was my father the king before me!
You are only King and not high Priest. I must save us from the sacred flames.
Ah yes guard I have failed to remember that I am not a supplicant of the high priest. But he is mine. Still, rules are rules.
Oh King how wonderful for you to agree! I will return you to the castle.
Thank you my fair subject. My wife and I shall reward you with a great feast of food and drink.
It is my Duty sir. I am forever at your service to protect you.
You are a wise and faithful guard. I shall see to it that the high priest knows of your service as well.
It was a nice altar room. Maybe the high priest can make an exception and allow you there again sometime.
Ah yes maybe the queen can persuade him. She always has a kind word for him.
With my strength and armour I could just take him by force
No my subject, we mustn't strike him. For I have divine power and he knows this. I can arrange a meeting, and you will accompany me as my security.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Ask for a drink
Governor so good to see you! Let me buy you a drink. Have you spoken to the king lately I am huge fan.
Me and the king our very close so of course I have spoken to him lately.
That is amazing. I am a very loyal servant to the king. I spend all day working and all night here at the bar. would you mind putting in a good word for me to the king?
What do you need from the king and what do you do for the king?
As of right now I do everything requires me to do here in the village to make it a better place. I require nothing of the king but would love a promotion so I can serve him even better.
You might be a jack of trades but I really need help in a town over to fix the sewer system but there seems to a lack of qualified plumbers
I would love to help in any way I can.
If you can fix this little problem with me I will be sure to sing your praises the next time I see him.
Please do! would you like another beer?
Of course I would love another beer.
Fantastic. What brings you to this bar?
I am just checking that they are above board and our giving their fair taxes to the king
Oh I am sure they do. If not I would have to find a new bar and that sounds like too much work for me. Does everything check out?

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I want to help the kingdom to be better so overthrowing the king is just a perfect plan
Hey there, human, sounds like we have something in common.  I've no love of the king either; he keeps trying to hunt me! All I want is a bite to eat, is that so much to ask?
Good boy
Wow - I mean, that's the first time someone's said "good" to me.  Usually it's "aaargh!" or "die!" or something...
So can you be my personal spie in the castle.. I want to steal his wife as well
Hm, will there be chickens in it for me?
Of course , I will hand over half of the kings Farm to you .
You're quite an excellent human, you know that? I'm pretty swift, so I can get in easy enough.  I'll need a disguise though if I'm to be spying in the castle...
Hope you wont betray me. My security just said you can't be trusted
Oh, well, I am a fox after all.  But I am led by my stomach, so as long as there's food involved, you can trust me!
OK then. The kings Farm has 10,000 chicken so half is yours
That's... erm... sorry they don't teach math in foxing school.  But it sounds like it will last me for a while!  Now how do I get to the castle from here?
Of course. Don't worry my security will show you how and also get you some spy gadgets.. Good luck
I'll take this whirly arrow thing to bribe some foolish human with, just in case.  How will I know who to trust there?

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: The rigorous training has changed me. I am a true monk
Wonderful to hear.  How have you changed?
I meditated and now I am in the position to give sound advice to kings including yours
It's a little early for you to give advice to the king.  Perhaps start with the parishioners first.
Are you a jealous priest.. You should be happy for me.
I am happy for you.  You are a new monk and still have much to learn and making great strides.
OK just because you are my father's friend I will listen to you
Perhaps you need to meditate more on being less ego driven and focus on purpose driven.
Priest I need to make a confession though
Of course, please proceed.
The king stole my high school sweet heart from me. When I remember I still feel pain
You must forgive and pray for the king.
OK father I will take to your advise
I am sorry for your pain.  Forgiving will ease your heart.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

speech: I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.
I know what you mean, I'm the King's architect! if he doesn't like my designs I wind up just like the architects before me, in the bottom of the pit...
At least its nice in the gardens
