setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Oh my... phew... my legs, I can barely stand.
Hello villager, are you okay?
A-a guard!  Have we made it? Are... are you real?
As real as this here moss in the tower base.
Gods be praised!  We must have made it.  Oh, it has been so long since we left, we had dared not hope... but no, I've gotten ahead of myself.  So much has happened, and we've come such a long way.
Who is we? Are you okay Villager? Do I need to get the local Apothecary to fix you a potion?

Ah, my apologies, sir Guard.  The others are just behind me.  We've begun to run out of food, so they send me to scout ahead to see if the camp we had heard rumors of was here.  We've no where else left to go after... after the Great Calamity.
Well no one is allowed into the Castle so you and your people will have to turn back to where you came.
But... surely you will allow us to approach?  We could camp out here, we wouldn't cause any trouble.  Please, sir, allow us to at least work for our food.  The children are starving!
Of course you can stay on the grounds. You are just not allowed to enter the Castle. I am sworn to protect it.

Oh, well, of course, good guard, of course.  It's important you protect the king, now, more than ever!  I fear we may have been the only ones who survived the scourge of those foul flying lizards, they may be on their way here even now!
Those are lizards Villager. Those are dragons. We will defend this Castle from them!
I may not look like much, noble, brave guard.  But I pledge to you this day that we will make our last stand here with you.  We will fight, nay, even to our dying breath if need be!
I'm glad that you and your people are willing to fight. You may just get in the Castle after all. Let's fight!

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: how are you today fellow maid
Thank you for speaking to me, maid of a higher rank. I am trying to be contented with my lot but it is difficult
it has been a rough day so much to do as always
from the  crack of dawn till late, late at night!
yes it is stressful work tying to not fail
And for a pittance .. little more than room and board
i know it is a rough life but we must bear the burden
And yet - the King has everything - the best food, the best furs, chests of gold - why do we suffer in this way?
it is simply fate sadly, it will always be like this
Perhaps we should try to change our lot?
i do not think i can risk such a thing
But how can things ever change if we do not help ourselves?
we face great consequence if we try tho
This how the world is changed ..

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: what do you do here fellow servant?
I must clean this spiral staircase.
well you get to that i will stand guard
I am so tired and there is so much to clean.
yes i know, i am forced to stand around all day
Why are you here, sir? Are you guarding someone in the tower?
i guard the tower itself
I must clean and polish that weapon.
well have at it then
Thank you kind sir.
well take your time or the king will be on you for a bad job
I will sir. I will also need to dust that scroll.
have at it i will not be in your way
Since I am so poor, I appreciate your small kindness.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Have you seen my father the king. I must beg him not to marry me to that ugly Viscount. Yuck!
He was in the south courtyard earlier today, but I believe he was going to hunt wild game in the country.
Have you seen the Viscount? Is he with him? I hope he accidentally gets hit by a stray arrow.
I do believe he was with the king.  I have seen him and he is not a very attractive person...    You on the other hand would make any man's heart weep.
You are too kind. I wish my father would just let me stay here and run things. Why do I need to marry anyone?
You will be running the Viscount's estates in no time with spirit like that!  It is easy to not marry for commoners like myself.  i spend most of my time with a group of hairy men!
Here, have a drink. Well, I guess it would be ok to run things over there. I'm sure he is a little weezle I could push around. hahaha
Thank you. I was feeling a bit parched.  What brought you to the tower today?
I was going to beg my father to not give me away to the idiot but you have helped me think of it in a better way. I thank you for changing my mind.
I am but a humble servant of the crown.  Anything I can do to help.  So you have made peace with the marriage then?
Well, I hate the thought of looking at him all day long but I will have my way with his kingdom so, Yes! I believe I have made my peace. I just need to drink a lot more of this.
A few drinks of spirit always raises the spirits! Maybe he is beautiful on the inside.  Which is more important than the outside.
I have met him and I find him such a bore. He is thirty years older than me so not much to talk about.
Well I am sure the king has good reason. Maybe he is looking for you to inherit your future husbands estate in a short amount of time!

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: how are you today my dear king?
I feel grumpy.  I heard that the neighboring King doesn't like me.  I fear I must crush him.
what a rude man he must be hes just jealous of you
I'm glad you agree.  His puny kingdom is nothing compared to this one.  His land is smaller than this palace garden.
yes he is feeble compared to you
You are a dear queen.  What would I do without you?
oh you flatter me
Would you take a turn around the garden with me.  I need to clear my head of all this business.
that sounds like a good idea
Take my arm.
of course my lovely king
What have you been doing today while I have been plotting my revenge?
i have been knitting as i do, its been nice
Are you nearly done with your winter solstice gifts?

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Hrmp, looks like the servant boy missed a spot of dust here.
Yes and I will let him know not to do it again
Ah good, you've arrived.  I was waiting for a moment to speak with you.  It looks... yes it looks like this chapel is empty.  The King rarely seems to use it, these days.
I know what a shame
Indeed.  Well, such is the way of our times.  But enough on that - I've been instructed by our.. odious... new guest, the Duke of Heffordship, to have a word with you.
About what

That lecherous old man had the gall to ask me to send you in to... warm his bed.  For a goodly sum.  I would never allow him such a thing of course, you saw how he beat poor Celine.  But I thought I should at least warn you to have care.
Oh no what will I do

There, there, no need to worry.  The King is a just man, so that fool of a Duke won't try anything overt.  I'll see to it that the Head of the House keeps you to ... other wings of the palace.  He's not approached you himself, has he?
No not yet thank you for the warnning
I'm, frankly, a little offended that he even thought to approach me.  But at least we've some sense now of where is mind is at, and we can head him off at the pass, as it were.
Yes, is there anything else I need to be aware of at the moment
Hm, I believe there was one other matter.  Something about... ah yes, his cat, Lucifier.  You've seen him, yes? Black, one green eye, one red?
Yes he hiding in the cellar I think there is a mouse down there

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Please sire...I need some help.
What is it servant
I'd like to be king for the day.
guards, lock this servant
I'll smash your nose and you'll be ugly, and everyone knows the only reason you're kept as king is because of your looks!
Peasant the kingdom loves me, you are nothing
Perhaps I can give you information about the gentleman trying to steal your kingdom from you. Then will you let me be king for the day?
Shut your mouth, no one shall dare defy me
Please sire, they're coming for you now! Hold on tight, we're going over the ledge!
How dare you pull me down with you
Too laaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaate!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
Here, I've tied a line onto this stone! Toss it up into that window!
I toss the stone but it slides off the moss and slips down

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Haw haw, look 'it the king! He look like a silly man!
"Ah, Fool! I'm bored, but be careful about going too far. Entertain me."
Look 'it look 'it, I can balance a rock on me head!
"Mm, that's a decent act, I suppose. A bit... standard, though. Do you hve anything more interesting?"
Look it! A rock! Out my pants! A rock was in my pants!
"I'd hope there was at least two!"
Haw haw! I like it like that when king tells joke! Tell me another!
"Who's red, black, and white, and only tenuously holding onto their head?"
Who? Who??
"You should look at the color of your outfit, Fool"
Awww haw haw haw! I like it! Here, have some mud!
"ah, I haven't played in the mud since I was a wee lad."
Glad I could remind you of the good ol' days, my king! I can stand on my head!
"Ah, but how well can you balance?"

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Woof!
Hello, your a good dog aren't you/
Woof Woof! I am a very very good dog
Oh, what's this? is this your royal toy?
Woof! That belongs to my master the King
I don't think the King wants you playing with this. Lets put it here so we both don't get in trouble.
This is my bed also of course. All beds in this castle are mine. Woof!
Is this your quilt? I bet it gets pretty cold in this castle.
I share it with my master the King, but he allows me to have any quilt that I like
You are the luckiest dog in the land. I am glad to be the King's companion so I get to meet you. you are a good doggie.
woof! woof woof woof!
Aww! Maybe the king will let me come visit you tomorrow as well. I will bring you a nice meat bone from brunch.
That would be wonderful. Plenty of meat on it, please
Were you a gift for the princess? I guess you took a better liking to the King. He does love dogs.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Let me just get my brush, and we can get your mane looking nice and groomed!
Neigh!!
Easy, girl! We'll get you looking as good as ever!
Girl?? I am no girl, I am a man!!
My deepest apologies! Here, have some hay.
Thank you my dear caretaker. You have always been my favorite you and those kind eyes of yours.
I do my best to give you the treatment you deserve!
This is some delicious hay!! The farmer who grows this deserves to be rewarded!! Neigh!!
I'll pass on the compliments to the chef!
We must speak business dear caretaker. I have an issue only you and your skill can help.
What can I do for you?
The other caretakers have been plotting to revolt against this kingdom and betray the King. I owe the king many favors as he saved me from despair.
Oh dear! What did you hear them say?
They plan to invade the kingdom during dawn when there are few guards on duty. Then they dress as the queen and enter his room and that's where they plan to end his life with a rusted blade!

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: What are you doing next to the king's tool shed, pirate??
"Finding a replacement hook! My last one got rusty."
I suppose you can have this one...but only if you swear allegiance to the king and stop your piracy!
"That's a good joke! I might get in some practice with this hook sooner than I expected!"
In the battle of hook versus rake, I believe rake is always the victor!
"You look like you've never been in a fight before. Are you sure you want this to be your first?"
I must protect the king's....kingdom at any cost! Even if it means being poked by a pirate's hook1
"Ah, the king will be glad to know you were loyal to the end."
On second thought...maybe I can pirate a little on the side. Is it a good life?
"Such a fair weather patriot. Of course it's a good life! If you like the sea. You ever been on a rolling sea in a storm?"
No, I've only been on the stable ground next to a tool sehd.
"Ah, you haven't lived until you've been on the sea in a storm! Let me tell you, we have a great benefits package. Do you want the details?"
Yeah, I need dental at a minimum, I only have 3 teeth left but I love them very much.
"Mm, my ships all have the finest on ship doctors and dentists, with as much rum as you need to forget the pain!"

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Can I try out a few of my jokes on you? I'm nervous about tonight.
Certainly! I could use the company and the merriment! I, too, am feeling the pressure of tonight's events.
Why did the jester come over to talk to the lovely maid?
I... I don't know. Why?
To let her know that her shoes were untied! And they are, by the way.
...what? Oh! Darn it all!
Another joke for the pretty lady?
Oh, why not? I do need to sit a moment an retie my shoes, after all.
What did the king say to the king's brother about the king's sister?
...oh! A scandalous one! Do tell!
Hey! Who said you could have a bite??
Oh my! You might want to wait until the wine has been flowing for some time before using that one!
I've been thinking about getting into magic. Will you let me saw you in half?
...um. I do want to be helpful. Please do not take offense, but I don't think you are quite... CUT out for that!

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Do you want a beer or fun??
I don't get paid enough for fun so I guess it had better be beer. Actually, make that a Pimms and lemonade with a little umbrella
Ok, do not worry, I'll bring that lemonade for you, you must be tired of defending the king
I love to serve the King madame. Nothing moves me from my duty
I love brave and loyal men
Be off, foul temptress! These are our barracks and no place for the likes of you
I am sorry my lord, I thought you needed relax...
Well I do not! I live with my family in the grounds of the castle
here you are, your lemonade, I hope you enjoy it
where's the Pimms?
We are out of pimms
Well that's rubbish isn't it? I think I will return to my family now. I am on patrol later
Good bye my lord, come back soon, I will be happy to see you again
And I shall give you a very wide berth!

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Ahem.  Good King, I'm glad you -finally- have been able to make time for me.  I have some distressing news about the state of the treasury.
Yes I am a good king, becuase my father was a king before me. And he was a good one, so I must be as well. What is this news you have for me?

Well, when I say, *good* I suppose I should clarify.  You have been far too "good" about spending money!  Look at these paintings, this throne!  Thousands upon thousands of gold.  Our kingdom is well situated for trade and does fairly well, but your reckless ways have nearly drained the treasure to its last dregs in merely the last year of your reign alone!
But look around. I deserve to be in such luxury! My Queen, YOU QUEEN, she needs all of these priceless paintings and precious jewels.
Hrmp.  Your QUEEN, that you value you so highly, may not value you so highly.  Have your spies and courtiers told you nothing of her goings on?
No, they have not. What is this that you speak of?

Ah, well then.  Perhaps it is time for someone to finally be direct with you, instead of cowering behind their false smiles and flattery.  Your Queen has a line of lovers stretching as long as from here to the Moonlit Isles.  Just last fornight I heard it was the Jester, she's stooped so low.
HOW DARE YOU. Suggest that I am not enough of a man for MY QUEEN. Do you know what I should do to you for even thinking such a thing?!

I speak the TRUTH!  Hard facts, NUMBERS, that is what I deal in, Highness.  And if you are too blind to see it, so be it.  As soon as your so-called beloved learns your broke, I've no doubt she'll sell you out to the highest bidder so she can keep collecting her baubles.

You sir are going to be punished. You have no right what so ever! You are just trying to do get inbetween us so you can lay in my bed, with my queen, and someday become king. But it will not happen! My father was a great king before me, as am I.

Your father was a great man, that is true.  He was also man enough to take a bit of criticism without collapsing into a tantrum!  Are you so blind that you cannot even tell the difference between a loyal subject who has served your family for generations, over some trollop?
You a spewing lies of my queen. How dare thee.
Go then, now, to your queen!  Even now she lies in that foppish Jester's bed.  See then for your eyes what you know to be true in your heart.
OFF WITH YOUR HEAD

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: What beautiful weather, garden, and most of all smile you have!
A beautiful bird in a garden that is free of jesters.  I couldn't ask for anything more.
The endless plants to see and smell are incredible! I am not use to being hugged, usually I am just used as an easy meal.
Have no fear in here.  This garden has no predators including those awful jesters.
I have not met many jesters. Are they mean?
Mean spirited and cruel.  Also, they're not nearly as witty as they think they are.
I wonder how large this garden is? When you are in it it seems endless.
It's almost the size of an entire town square.
That sounds right pretty accurate. I really think they should rename it. I find the name Winter Gardens so misleading.
Perhaps something like the All Seasons Garden?
I mean that would make a lot of sense because the flowers seem to be constantly blooming!
I may be able to get the name changed.  I'm the daughter of the king, after all.
I think that would be a great idea! I am getting tired, I have been out all day. Being a nice day, I like to take the day to fly around.
The garden is peaceful and a really nice place to take a rest.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Good morning to you, my dearest darling! How does the sunlight find you on yet another glorious day?
Oh my dear, I have issues with the fashion I must wear! Why do you insist on putting me into these tight bodices??

My lady, fair! Gaze upon the mirror and speak the truth! Your beauty is beyond any in the land! You should only wear the most exquisite garments that support that beauty, not some silk rags that drape lazily across your form!
And why do you insist on giving me this stale mead to eat?? I feel like this wasn't the life I thought it would be....
Stale?! This is the finest mead our kingdom produces! Come now! The clothing must truly be too tight for you not to recognize this!
The room is getting kind of crooked. Maybe I should lie down. These first few months have been very overwhelming for me.
Return to bed, my dear! I will have the servants bring us breakfast in bed! What shall we have? Toast and butter? Bread and butter? Muffins and butter? A bit of butter tea, perhaps?
...a break would be fine. Would you mind very much if I read my favorite book in peace?
Ah... yes... well... a book. Of course. Yes... yes of course. Then we shall sit in silence and read, I suppose. Do remember, though, if you need or want anything else, it is yours, my love.
Thank you, my love. Please read the first sentence of it to me.
Certainly! Ahem... "I'd never given much thought to how I would die - though I'd had reason enough in the last few days"... wait, this is your favorite book?
I mean...a girl needs an outlet. You should see my OTHER book.
...other book?
50 Shades of Gray Mead

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hoo hoo! You're looking sour today, oh protector of the kingdom!
Whoa! Back off jester. What are you doing here?
I am just doing my duty around here, and I don't mean the bathroom kind!
You are ridiculous. I really don't see why the king keeps you around
I guess he can't resist me, just like you!
Here have some food while we wait for the servant  Maybe you'll be quiet while you eat
Only if you have some with me!
Sure why not. I am hungry. Do you have any GOOD jokes?
Sure! They're all as great as your haircut!
That bad, huh? Where is that servant anyway?
Must be out serving!
Ok you got me to laugh on that one
What are you doing in here, anyways? Getting a snack?
The servant told me to meet him here so he could polish my armor before I met with the king.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello Wizard - state your business
I want to give the king very strong muscles with my magic.
Do you have references?
I know a few witches.
How can I be sure that I can trust you?
I know a few warlocks too.
Can you demonstrate the spell for me?
Please, have a seat. I need to close the curtains.
I'm more comfortable standing
A rabbit.......from my boot. Tada!
Sooo impressive...
Ah you can tell it's stuffed. Well, I've just run out of magic for the day.
Then I suppose there is no need for the king's audience
We're more than just wizard and king, my friend. There's a lot you don't know.
action: steal comfortable cushion from a powerful but aged wizard

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Greetings, fellow serf
"Aye. I'm here to get food for the king and queen's breakfast on the morrow."
They eat far better than we do, do they not?
"Of course. But they feed me well enough for tending to them"
You are lucky! I eat little but stale bread
"Better than nothing, which is what I'll get if I don't return with this"
Do you ever take any milk for your own?
"Of course not! ... Do you think we could?"
I do not see how they would be able to detect
"Well, I suppose it can't really hurt too much..."
I am going to have some eggs, and I don't care if they are raw!
"I don't think salmonella's been invented yet"
And Edwina Curry is light years away. We shall be safe!
"And with full bellies for once!"

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Hello, could you help me for a moment servant?
Yes, what do you need sir?
I need help carrying away the bodies from the grounds over there.
Boy, that one looks pretty grisly. What happened to him??
Ah these here are the bodies from the jousters that didn't make it. I am their groundskeeper.
And I report directly to the king! Why does this body have a huge bite taken out of it!
Please do not tell the king! They do not feed my very well. I only get the leftovers from out of the trash.
Let's forget about this. Help me mop up all the blood you left here.
Here, let me do it.
Could've asked nicely...anyway, at least that woman's body is intact.
I am sorry, I do not get much interaction with people. Well the live ones that is.
That's why you hired me, right? To keep you company.
No! I hired you to be my next victim.
Don't make me do it!

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: How are things looking today, guard?
So far so good, but make sure you stay in your place! What is your business here?
Easy there. The king asked me to check with you. You know about the rumors of an attack
I know of every threat. I am here to protect the kingdom!
Yes, I know! That's why I'm asking you how things are looking so I can report back to the king.
I see... So far, it has been empty here.
Well that's good news. Why are you so on edge then?
If I am doing my job right, my guard will never be down.
Good point. We'll the king will be happy to know things look good so far. Hopefully the rumors are just that and nothing is coming.
I hope so as well, but if not, I will be ready.
I know you will be. Hey what's with the stones?
They are decorations for the throne.
I see maybe they shouldn't be sitting around so loose where anyone can take them.
I will move them to a more secure location, then.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Oh this food certainly does smell lovely! Food better than my grandmother could make.
Oi, you!  Halt right there!
But, I haven't even moved!
Oh, erm.  Right!  Well don't even think of making one, because.. well I'll give you a fearsome look, that's for sure!
But, But, I'm hungry and this food smells so go I could slap my own mama, may I please get some food gueard?
Wait a minute, don't I... eh, Johnny!  It's me, Favio, from the village!  Why, we all thought you'd be a knight or sommat now, but you've gone and made yourself a bandit!  What happened to you, mate?
A bandit? I am no such thing.

Ha - your mum says something different there.  Seems like whenever I go to the village she's got some new trinket that you've lifted off some lordling, though she's never said right out.  Still, it's a bit obvious, innit?
Jelous thatI make more money than you? A little temple guard?
Hm, well, can't be doing that good, scrounging for scrape, eh?  Still, what's a bit of food between us.  I'll not begrudge it of you.
I am here with the king! How dare you say I am scrounging for food, I am a guest here today.
Uh huh.  And I've got a piece a land in fairy land that I'd sell ya on too.  C'mon, don't yeh remember me?
GIVE ME ALL YOU MONEY
Ah! He's gone rabid!

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Hello I am a parishioner of this church. Do you like it?
It looks...fine. Churches can be much more grand, you know? Perhaps I can help you spruce it up.
It makes me happy every time i enter the church to see it, but I agree it needs renovating.
Maybe it could huge a giant, pagan idol in the middle of the floor.
What kind of arch would an architect call that?
Arch of the Ram. It's all the rage these days.
Interesting. Where was it first seen?
In my basement...I build them and spread them far and wide. The king has 4 in his bedchambers alone.
How interesting to get the inside track! Are they made or arch and silver too?
It's mostly flesh and bone...
I guess the sheeps-scabious is the purple color for his royalty.
What kind of buildings do you like?
A range, but functional is a must.
And who are you worshipping here anyway?

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: It's time to get this party started! What jams do you got?!
"Ooh, I got a good one, about the king, do you want to hear it?"
I would love to!
"Ah, then gather the crowd around, this one deserves the full audience"
Aye! Make it a night to remember!
"Oh, there once was a king from Nantucket~ ..."
NANTUCKET~~! WOOOO!
"... and he ran off with the bucket! YEAH!"
And boy could that King run!!!!
"Whoo! I'll be here all night! What do you want to hear next?"
I wanna here anything you've got to give!
"You have to give me more than that, I need something to riff off"
Tell us about the craziest party you ever seen!
"Whew! Well, I know I just sang a song about the King from Nantucket, but talking about that might be a bit too ribald for this audience!"

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: the tomb must be close by, where is it?
My magic compass is pointing me towards that old mill.
Who are you? oh are you a fellow pick pocket as well?
Yeah we're in this together mate. Let's get going! The treasure won't be there for long!
ah yes we need to find the tomb of the mummified king
Exactly. Let's try to break this door down.
sounds like a plan, ill pull on the right side of it
Gave pretty easily! But what's that in the middle of the room?
I think that might be the tomb
How about you touch it first?
ill go for it.. WOAH that was close, i think they have traps here
Maybe we can use this to spring the other traps.
yes lets try throwing it
It worked! The treasure is our! I mean...mine!

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: What a mess this kingdom has become.
I like the mess. Good food.
Of coarse you like the mess! You're one of the ones causing it.
I only clean it up! I'm just a rat.
A nasty rat. Here I am trying to defend our king in the royal palace, and you are here just spreading diseases/
Rude. At least I don't commit crimes like the people being executed.
They are being punished for their crimes. Should be punish you for spreading diseases?
No. That's not my fault. Leave me be.
Watch out for those hungry dogs.
I can run faster than them!
Oh ya? How fast can you fun?
Faster than you.
Why don't you show me then?
Nice try. Now leave me be.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Who goes there?
Oh, nobody. Could you come a little closer please?
And why would I do that?
Because I need to ask you a question. I've seen a lot of people tortured around here...
Yeah? Is that a problem?
Were they tortured by command of the king?
Depends, sometimes I do just on my own accord.
Maybe you should come with me then.
I'll be doing no such thing, who do you think you are?
A village official who has no patience for rogue torturers! I found a woman with all her hair plucked out yesterday!
Yes, I had to get that information out of her somehow!
And the little boy with his teeth replaced with someone else's teeth??
Ohh that wasn't me, but that was some brutal work!
A fan of yours? How long does your influence reach??

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Good Mother - I am sorry to intrude here
It is never any intrusion. What may I do for you, servant?
I wish to have answers to the secrets of life, Mother
There are no secrets to life, my child. That is the secret. Unless you mean beyond this life.
I wish to know why my master and mistress are King and Queen whilst I am but a humble servant
That is but the natural order of things,. The thread of fate is different for every person.
but why does MY fate have to be this?
Because the universe wills it to be. Does every king wish to be king? Is it always a blessing to every man?
I would swap in a heartbeat!
As would others, my child. Too many leaders, not enough followers.
I would lead had I the option
Maybe your day will come, in its own way. For now, be at peace, my child.
Thank you. Your words soothe me.
I do what I can, child. This kingdom is ours.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Tell me nun. Do you think the King loves me more than his Queen?
have you come to repent evil priestess?
Never say never, but I want the King to love me.
maybe if you take on the lords loving wrath you could be seen as a potential partner
Interesting. Do go on...
well you serve an evil being, please think about what you are doing
What do you think this is for?
please put such a vile thing away
Twilight we must renounce eventually
please think about what you are doing, you will burn in fire if you do not repent
Maybe you are right. But would the king still care for me if I gave up my arts?
he is not with you because of these dark arts
It is true, isn't it?
do nto worry together you will be saved

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: This makes a change from the barracks.
how are you today oh son of the lord?
Well. But the kingdom is wracked with uncertainty regarding the king.
yes that is true he may have gone a bit mad but with god we can fix all
Well we owe an oath of loyalty to the king alone. So we are his last line of defence. Even the main army is turning against him.
yes that is true but i must hold my loyalty to god amongst all else
I understand. How do you think the Queen feels?
i am honestly not too sure
Does she come here to pray?
she does very rarely, she always seems sad
It is sorry state of affairs.
yes but it will get better
I hope so.
do not fear, we have the lord to rely on

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Alright my friend, it's time to pay up. The king demands your taxes, and you know you've been skirting them for far too long.
Ahoy. You've got the wrong man.
I doubt it. Your name?
That's need to know, mate.
Don't make me...tie you.
Leave, sir.
I'll take my rope...and my taxes! You owe 200 gold pieces!
Tally ho! Leave me now.
Look, it's been a long day. Give me 100 gold and we'll call it even.
I told you, you've got the wrong man.
Harold...Mencer is it?
No, sir. Thomas Platt.
Oh, I'm sorry. Do you know where I can find Harold?
At the pub, I assume.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: hello noble man. What can I do for you today?
I want the best spears you have and I wont accept anything less
Well what do you think of these?
hmm.. well i guess these will have to do
Well if you like these you can have that for 100 pieces of gold. If these are not up to your standard then we can negotiate on some custom spears
I always get what I want.  Father said I am the best and deserve the best.  I will give you 80 for them
Oh so you're one of those people. Never actually earned anything you got. Well I can go no lower than 95
I will not deal with your kind weapons master.  You cant treat me like this
Wow are you serious? it's not like you're the king or anything. You're just a daddy's boy.
Oh just wait until the king hears about this.  You'll pay for that insult peasant.

I"m the kings most trusted weapons maker. He's not going to care. Now if you'd like a weapon that the king's soldiers use then I'm your man. Otherwise you can go somewhere else and get inferior weapons
I will find another charity to spend my money on.
I'm sorry to hear that. One day you will grow up and learn everything won't just be handed to you.
it wont be handed to me because i'll just take it

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: A plain damp room with many barrels of beer and wine.  The room is in need of a good cleaning as the floor is dirty and rats scurry about.
setting.background: This is where the tavern's stock of beer and alcohol is stored.  The owner comes here to check the stock and make sure everything is in order.

speech: Squeak squeak!
Get out of here, rat.
Mmmmm nipnipnipnipnip
I said leave!!!
MMMMMMMMM NIPNIPNIPNIPNIPNIP!!!
Ah, stupid rat.
Shall we have a drink?
Sure, what the hey.
To life.
Life.
And to rats and people living in harmony!
Not sure if the king would like that.
Screw 'em!
Ah. No. That is not right. This is his kingdom.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Can you see this armour? it was used in the big war
ah do you care for this stuff its amazing
Yes I always do my best! I like pleased to my lord
well youve done a great job
Thank you sir, let me lead you to your room
well that would be great
here we are, this is your bed Sir, if you need something just call me!
thank you, what is your name?
Jen Sir, is your family near of here?
yes they have friends with the king
Don't let them alone this castle is dangerous
ah well ill consider it, thank you
don't worry, I let you rest
thank you for everything

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: please sir i cant be here i need to help my family
Ha. You tried to take money from my kingdom and now you beg me?
please sir at least spare my family
They will owe what you owed before you die! Tomorrow you hang!
no this cant be happening

you can take my head and make an example of me

please, anything you ask and ill do it

more than anyone of course
I love it. Keep begging.
please you can even skin me alive for all i care
And eat your flesh....

setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: My liege. Do you have any requests?
Yes, take note, I'm making a new decree.
I'm here to write it down for you.
Hence forth, It will be illegal to hug your cat on Sundays.
...I love it....anything else?
Cats MAY be petted, only if they are deemed worthy by the Godfrey, my cat.
Yes...yes, perfect. I uh...yes, I love it. Any more?
Godfrey may only receive hugs, if he stays out of the pantry, and stops being such a tubby tub.
You really like this cat, huh my queen?
Yes, you are right. I do. Scrap the whole thing and lets start again. Its illegal to hug all cats but Godfrey on Sunday.
Right, that makes a lot more sense.
Also, tell my husband I want new drapes in the castle. These are getting covered in cat hair. He will understand. He's my lovey pumpkin.
Yes this looks pretty caked with cat hair. Maybe you should get a parrot.
A parrot! Why would I get something that yammers on with nonsense all day. When you tell the king about the drapes tell him his snookie-ookems loves him.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Um can I help you?
Can I help you is a better question. Dragons are supposed to remain outdoors. Can't you read the sign on the wall.
Are you growling at me, a dragon? Do you think I'm scared of you? I came for the prince's weapons. We ride to battle tonight
Look, all day I cook and I clean and do landscaping and then when that's all done , I get the privilege of doing guard duty. You killing me would be doing me a favor!
Whoa there isn't going to be any killing here. Fire breathing is only for the king's enemies and not to be done in his kingdom unless there is an emergency. I  can only offer you a hug
Can i clean this tower with a hug??? Now a vacuum is something useful. Do you have one of those?
I only have this weapon or that helmet over there. Why is it so dirty in here anyway?
I don't know. Maybe because we have dirty animals coming in here grabbing weapons.
Wow rude. I'll have you know dragons are one of the cleanest beings in the kingdom
I think that's what people who are afraid of you tell you. I just speak the truth.
I'd hit you if I didn't think you would enjoy it.
Come on, Your breath smells like rotten eggs doused in blue cheese dressing. I'm much more afraid of the odor than the fire coming out of your mouth.
This is ridiculous. I will be reporting you to the king
Just kill me. that's all I ask. Just put me out of my misery.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: This roasted pig sure smells good. Would you like a beer?
I would love one, fair maid, but alas this food is not ours to touch
We could always sneak a few bites! The meat you cook always smells so good. Very tempting if I do say so myself.  All the customers love your meals!
It would not not worth my head, good lady
I understand chef! I have two orders for roasted pig stew.
Are those for the King?
For the king and queen please hurry!
I do not think they would appreciate being called customers!
I would never. How long until the stew is ready? The king is becoming impatient.
The stew is already ready .. take it to them immediately and less chatter!
The queen has found a brown hair in her stew. I am clearly blonde. She has requested to have your head served on a silver platter.
*gulp* do I have time to trim my beard first?
I will buy some time. But you owe me some of that roasted pig.
do, please, help yourself!

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello, my dear king.

setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

setting.background: The inside temple is not painted or colorful. It is intentionally left blank because it is believed that the spirits of our ancestors live here, and they require a blank slate to be able to move from this realm to the next.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Hello your majesty, how are you today?
Its been a slow day maid
Well a slow day sounds nice for you, you are always hard at work!
That is true! I am the hardest working king around. Its nice to take a break and pray to the gods
Truly, as spirituality is very important!
Here take this maid. Its getting hot in here
Thank you, sir. So how is the queen doing>
Enough about the queen. Lets talk about you. You have quite the fair skin
Why thank you, your majesty.
Come a bit closer will you
Why's that? But of course.
Would you kindly pick that up
This right here? Okay.
You know we are alone

setting.name: Lake
setting.description: The beautiful lake glistens in the sun as water can be seen in all directions. you can see several feet beneath the water because it is so clear.
setting.background: The lake is not only beautiful, but gives life to the surrounding area. With fish and shell fish this lake provides a whole eco system unique to its own.

speech: Hello
Oh hello queen! Are you having a lovely time out here by the lake?
Yes beautiful fish. It is serene here.
This is my home! All of us fish love living here my queen. But some times we fall victim to that thing over there.
Wow. So sorry about that. You should avoid the shallow part of the lake
Oh I never though of that! We like to swim this way so we can nibble on people toes!
No everyone love fishes.
We love being fishes! Look how clear the water is today!
It is lovely.
yes it is. Can you tell people to stop trying to eat us?
I will tell the king to pass the law!
Oh my goodness! I always knew you were the best queen in all the land!
welcome. Let me see you swim
Oh, you wanna watch me swim away? Okay! Byeeee! *swimmmmswimmmswimmm*

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Hello there cute little thing.
hello youre majesty, how are you
I am doing well. What is an animal like you doing here?
i just like talking to my good friends
In the Royal Kitchen? Do my chefs offer you any food?
i would hope so im starving to death
What would you like? I will have them make you and your friends a meal.
i would just like some meat of a first born
I am sorry we do not have that here. You see I do not even have a wife yet.... I have been searching...
understanbli i will just take carrots
Very well have some carrots.
thank you my best of friend i will pay you back handsomely
Do not worry I have all this food and no one to eat it with.
you truly are an amazing king

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Daddy, are you sure I have to marry that horrid Viscount?
You have no choice princess
But why him?! What does it do for you?
It is a little bit hard to explain princess
That sounds like you just don't have a reason or don't want to tell me it!
Viscount is the only one with the key to eternal reign my dear.
Explain yourself, what do you mean by that daddy?
He delivered the ruling power to my great grand father. He is ageless
But what does this have to do with me marrying him? Gaining his trust?
yes. Exactly my dear
You'd sell your own daughter off for that? That's inhumane!
It is better for us to be safe.
But I wouldn't be safe nor would I be happy!
You will be safe. Your safety is the price for the happiness and that of the whole kingdom

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: Hi
hello, who captured you good sir?
Some bandit
do not worry i shall help you
thank you kind sir.
no worries just tell your king what good deeds the ambassador of another people has done for you
I will. my family will be forever grateful.
now run free young one and dont look back
I will but I have this gift for you kind sir.
ah no need, do not worry
No you must take it. Its an Arabian perfume.
i very gratefully appreciate it
You are welcome sir. I have been in captive for a long time. I need direction to the northern desert
yes just head north for half a day

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: I love the warmth in our hugs, let me embrace my queen
i love you too dear
The crown will always be my best attire  as a king, it defines who I am
it really does be an amazing crown my dear
You got me this jewelry and I love how new it looks, never gets old
im glad you like it dear
please hold the cape as i tighten my belt my queen
yes my dear come here and ill help you
Thank you my queen.
i will hold it up no problem
i need to hold the gold for sometime. cant have enough of it in my hands
yes it feels amazing to hold all the gold
do you like the gauzy purple fabric in here?
yes its very amazing in here
action: put crown in large four poster bed

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: how are you today masons what do you do
We like to make carvings out of stone! And who are you then?
i am a loyal subject friend
I see, well it's nice to meet you. What brings you here to the courtyard today?
it seemed like a nice day to be outside
Ah, so it is. One of the nicer days recently.
yes its very nice to see this
Indeed it is. Do you come here often?
yes it is often a meeting place for the king
That makes sense, do you like to talk with him?
of course i do whatever he needs of me
Do you work for him or are you just that loyal?
a bit of both honestly
Well that is good to hear sir, seems like you have your purpose in life and I have mine as well.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: hello
Hello Peasant. Why aren't you kneeling before your king?
I am sorry your highness.

I will be taking this sachel until you learn how to treat your king properly. What business do you have being here anyway? This tower is for royalty and those invited by me. I don't recall asking you to come.
I am poor and dirty. I am here to beg for help

Ah.. Who am I kidding. I wasn't ever meant to be king. My father was king before me, and this is the only reason I inherited this cape. It doesn't represent who I actually am. I always wanted to actually be a farmer. Take this cape. Use it for warmth, or sell it for its materials. It is made of fine silk and gold.
Wow!!!!!!!!! thanks a lot for your kindness King. I will live to remember this
Of course. I just want to help my people but I feel like I am failing you all. I'm not fit to be king. I'll never be my father. Even the Queen thinks I am a failure at times.
You are a nice king. I have a gift for you
Oh really? What is the gift?
I magical hat
What does this magical hat do? Can I have it? I sure would like to see it
It will allow you cheat time!
You're speaking witchcraft!? You are a witch! *Calls out to knights* Get this peasant out of my tower! He is speaking of magic and lies!

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: hi
why are you here servant?
Nothing serious. I need to talk
about what my good sir
That is what i want to talk about. I got robbed on the way
ahh that is horrible
Yes. I got robbed by the arabian bandits.
what a horrible thing to happen to you are you ok?
Yes I am..I fled on time
that is good to hear but do you not have money anymore
I dont. they took all I had on me
that is very sad to hear so you cant buy anything?
I am afraid yes. But you can loan me
considering you work for the king i guess i could allow that

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: how are you today sir do you need anything
I am just looking to speak to the king about relations with my nation.
of course right this way
Have you overheard him talking about this before? We are quite an important nation to him, I assume.
i think so yes, he should be able to talk in a few minutes
Well... tell me what he has said.
he said he cannot wait to finish creating a treaty
Ahh that sounds familiar to me, that's perfect.
yes it should be a great out come
Hopefully, without our mutual support it would be very grim for both parties.
yes that is very true so much war
Indeed, it would cause quite a lot of bloodshed.
yes so many lives would be lost
And needlessly, too, as we have prevented such an outcome for years!
