setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: hello king how are you this fine day
I am doing well. But I am quite hungry. If you could bring me some of that small fruit over there, I would appreciate that.
yes of course here sir
Ah yes this tastes so good. Better the orange than you I suppose right? Is there a reason you came to me today?
i am just here to serve as always ir
Okay good. Because if you were to try and challenge me, we may have issues. I had to attack a few other bats just the other day. Even in larger numbers they cannot withstand my power.
of course i would never do that my lord

Good, good. What is this paddle laying down here? I have yet to see this. I guess I may find use for it soon. Let me ask you this young bat. Would you take interest in working with me, and helping me fight off the other smaller bats? They taste quite well.
yes i will help however needed
Here, take this paddle then. I want you to go over there and smack that bat across the head with it. We will feast on him.
yes i will do so immediately
Yes, Yes young bat. Get us our food for the night. You are learning so fast. OOH, OUCH. Wow you really hit him hard! You're stronger than I thought! I really think you have potential
take this you wingless freak
Young child. You're making me emotional. I have never seen a bat with such passion for killing. You are officially my apprentice. We will do great things together, I hope you know.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Hello
Hello, your majesty. Are you doing well today?
I am not happy
Oh? Tell me why and I could try to help you?
There is problem in the palace. My brothers are trying to usurp my reign.
On what pretense? That sounds absurd!
Hatred. Envy. They wont let me rest...I am just tired of the whole thing
What can you do about it? Is nobody defending your reign?
Just the queen and few subjects,
Will that be enough though?
Thats all I have
Don't be down, king. I know plenty of subjects that would fight for you!
Please get me more wine
Yes, sir. I'll ask the servant here to go get some.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: I wish to be a queen soon
How soon? Since that shouldn't be for a long time.
Soon, so that i get a king and rule over the castle
Well sorry to say but unless someone kills your mom or dad you have got a lot of waiting in store.
I dont want them dead either, but i will be patient as I get a handsome prince
Well that's fair, princess. What are you doing today?
I am arranging my  jewelry , its a nice collection
Ahh it really is nice. Are  you hungry at all?
I will just have a bite, thank you
Of course, princess. Take as much as you would like.
Its lovely, guess will have more
Go right ahead, it is so fresh right?
Yah, how do you make this meat?
It is just marinated in wine and seasoned with salt and pepper before being cooked for 30 minutes.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: hellos subject are you also here to serve the king
Yes sire
its quite the rewarding work
Where is my post sire
next to the king you are used as his meal
Hi
why do you say hi now? we have already talked
Sorry About that. I am having a tough day. Can I get a break today
of course it is no problem, are you ok
Thank you very much kind sire. I will make it up
of course show me how hard you can work
Alright sire. I will carry out any instruction as soon as I am fit.
yes i like the attitude
Thanks a lot sir

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Hello
Hello small child. Who do you belong to? I didn't even see you come up here. This mountain is very dangerous. You should be more careful
I am..I am stringer than i look though
Don't be so foolish child. Does your mother know you're up here? One wrong step and you'd be falling for thousands of feet.
Wicked king you are!
Hey! This is my crystal ball. Where did you get it from? So not only did you steal my crystal ball, but you had the audacity to climb up the summit with my stolen goods?
I saw it on the royal field. It is not my fault. You cant blame me for that
*Picks up rock and fumbles with it in hands*. Ah, you are right young child. I shouldn't jump to conclusions so quickly. So tell me, what brings you up here?
I want to have an overview of your beautiful kingdom

It is quite beautiful isn't it? Here. Take this rock. It's a piece of the summit and you can remember this view every time you touch it. Then you won't have to risk coming up this dangerous path again.
Thanks a lot kind king. What brings you up here?
I am here to get away from the burdens of a king. I have to sit on my throne and listen to complaints all day long. Who do I get to complain to though? Nobody. That's who. It's hard.
Uneasy is the head that wears the crown. The responsibility is just too much
Maybe I'm not meant to be king.. Maybe I should take a break from it all.. Maybe I should just jump...
action: steal a crystal ball from child

setting.name: scenic overlook
setting.description: This lovely clearing overlooks the great mountain range. It is covered in wildflowers of all different colors. There are stone benches where one can sit.
setting.background: The scenic overlook is the most beautiful location on the trail. It was made to give people a place to sit and reflect on the beauty of nature. For many years, people enjoy it. There have been many proposals and was even a wedding!

speech: Hi
Why hello. You look ill. Are you okay? Oh.. Your breath reeks of booze.
hahahhaha...I am living my best life
Here. You may want to read this. It is an Alcoholics anonymous book I used to read through. I struggled with alcoholism myself.
I dont have a problem with drinks. It is the drinks that have a problem with me. They wont let me be!
Hey, listen. I know the struggle. It'll be okay. Just focus on the natural things in life. Look at all these wildflowers. They're beautiful! You don't need booze when you can enjoy scenery like this!
I agree with you. I dont like reading though

Ah, oh well. Not everyone can be saved. I just think you could benefit from living the life of a traveler such as myself. I could even tell you your future through my fortune telling abilities if you'd like? Maybe it'll help you see where your future is heading.
Please do. I have always wondered what the future holds

Look into this wildflower. Do you see this blue petal? That represents the sadness you will have in the future.. Oh wait. What's this? There are many other colors surrounding this petal..It looks like you'll actually... Be filthy rich and become king?? How is this so?
Wow!!!! How can I avoid the sadness? I so want to be rich and be a king.

You have to look deep within. Really meditate on it. What makes you sad? Is there a reason why you drink? Maybe to avoid the pain? You may be a rich king one day, but unless you work on your issues you will be a sad king.
I lost my mum at an early age

I'm so sorry to hear this. Just imagine how much good you can do once you're king though. You can change all the things in this world that your mom would be proud of. You can make her happy by making this kingdom a better place!

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Who are you all and what are you doing here?
Hi, we are doing nothing much, looking for some company.
In the king's quarters? Are you mad!?
We work for you, do we not?
This is a room in which you are only meant to step foot in upon our demand, understood?
Yes ma'am!
Good, that's what I like to hear.
I finished my assigned tasks for the day., I wonder if you have seen any lonely men around?
Perhaps outside of the castle? Best to check there first.t
Great I will go check. How did your banquet go?
It went very well, thank you. Some of the food was a little bit below par but apart from that, it was nice.
A woman like you should get our more.
How so? I am more than happy with the king!
Yes, he is great. But he is getting older. And sometimes it exciting to be with someone strong and inexperienced.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: I LOVE GUARDING THE CASTLE
You should. Thats your job
yes, i have to make sure that the castle is all time protected
You know, ever since I was appointed by the king to treat with a distant kingdom, I have always marveled at your disposition.
Thank you for that Ambassador
You are welcome. Just keep at it ok?
I will try my best at all time
Great. So keep protecting the queen at all time.
I will Ambassador
Great. Now have this
I love it, will help me during dark hours
You welcome. I havent seen the king, where is he?
The king might be in the castle
Ok. Thanks for that information. I need to speak with the head guard. I overhead some scoundrels planning to murder the king.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Greetings farmer. I am here to see about a purchase of some food.
Ah, well what'll it be sir? I have a lot of crops to sell!
And fine crops they appear to be. I am in need of some corn and rice.
Well no problem! We've got plenty, how much would you like?
As much as this will give me. I supplement with the fish I catch.
It does seem to have some good heft to it, let me go get it all then.
That would be nice. And rice also. Would I be able to also get some wheat.
I'll go see if I have any, we just made a huge sale of wheat earlier!
Maybe I can help you with this.
Hmm that could be quite a help to me.
You are so lucky to work so close to the King.
Ohh I know, it is a privilege to have as much impact on this kingdom as I am able to.
Yes, although it is much to busy for me. I prefer the quiet of the ocean as I catch my fish.
Different paths for different people, as they always say. Though I can see where the appeal of that comes from.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Your highness and your ladyship. I am hear for what you may need.
Well, servant, you need to do your daily list of tasks. Cleaning, cooking, all that!
Of course, oh Great King.
Where do you intend to start?
I will start on your royal throne. I am so thankful to have this fine work you have given me.
Of course, servant, now begin your work.
I will your highness. Is there anything else I can do for your greatness today?
Well tell me when you are done with your list of work and I will have you deliver a message for me.
I am ready now your highness.
But you haven't cleaned the floors or cooked anything!
I apologize your highness. With night coming on, I felt it safer to deliver the message now.
It is quite alright, we will have a knight escort you so there is no need to worry.
Oh, thank you. You are of course quite right.
That I am, good servant. Now, begin where the list tells you to begin.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Oh hello your majesty, you alright today?
Indeed, I am doing very well today, this is such a wonderful place to be
As am I. I can't wait to show that neighboring nation what our army is made of!
Yes, the time will indeed come to do so
I know, sir, but I just want it to be soon.
Why? I fear you are too eager for a war
I mean I am the army's officer, I strive to see them improve and what better way to see that?
You couldn't even dodge that, how am I to trust you in this fictional war of yours?
Don't push me, old man. I can make your death look like a complete accident and nobody would say a word as they trust me too much.
And you just said that in front of my wife, there are witnesses here you fool, I'll have your head.
Said what? I didn't say anything at all! *whispers to you that you have no evidence and that I can tell them that you are senile*
Very well you shall have your war! In fact I'd like you to be the first man on the front, I'll get the rest of your men ready, you go out there and announce the arrival.
That's quite the change of emotion, but I am more than happy to take that on!
Very well, Well off you go then, serve our country well. I'll also ready a messenger to go ahead of you

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: "Sir, where are we headed?"

"I understand, sir. Do you think we have enough provisions to find land again?"
Aye sailor. We picked up enough at the last port to last us a fortnight at least.

The king and queen have entrusted me with the duty of keeping you all safe. I do not intend to dishonor them.

That's right. Even I haven't been told what exactly this artifact is. I was simply instructed to meet a man at the last port who gave me a wooden crate.

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: Here to get some water for yourself as well?

I don't see a reason to hate anyone when I haven't even met them before. You seem alright to me so far.
You're so kind. How far is this place from your home?
Only about a 20 minute walk down from the nearest village. Yourself?
About an hour on foot and then a 20 minute donkey ride. My feet are killing me.
Wow, that's quite a while away. Where do you hail from?
I come from the village next to the magical forest, although we are forbidden from entering it.
The magical forest? I hear that village is quite powerful from their usage of their magical surroundings.
Just the opposite, we are repressed and get no clean water. The king does not care about us.
Well I should rephrase, your royalty and army is quite powerful.
Maybe so, but I wish I lived in a place that looked like this beautiful lake.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: I am totally fearless
Aaaand the wind blowing thruuuuu her hair-Hicc-what?
have you ever visited my dungeon?
Naaaah... want one?
Guards, seize this man!
Oh, Sir Rodney said, uh... what did he say?.... Oh-hiccup. He said something about your daughter being held pasta...Hicc.
What? how can you talk about the princess casually do you want to die?
No killing the messenger! Hicc-although I think he wants you to pay him postage.
Guards, look into what this mad man is saying immediately
Sir Rodney said I could have all the beer I want if I delivered the message-hiccup.
where is this so called rodney, I will strip him of that sir title
He's with the Earl of Panxbury, yer highness. They live on the other side of the glen.
ok guards send 10 soldiers to go and arrest him at once
Thank you for the beer, yur highness!

setting.name: fitting room
setting.description: The fitting rooms are small, with a few chairs and a mirror. The chairs give an aura of mystery and wonder. They are a dark blue... that seems to glow green. You have a brief compulsion to grab one and take it home with you, but you quickly regain your wits. The mirror is oak wood and the mirror itself is very sleek and shiny. It looks quite important.
setting.background: This shop features a lot of wonders from around the continent. The owner of this shop has gone to a lot of trouble to get all of the items. Every so often, he asks lucky shoppers to aid him in his experiments. Assuming that it is a man. Nobody knows for sure. Some claim it is a young lady.

speech: Good evening good evening sir!  Can I help you?
Good evening to you .What a nice clothing line you've got
Indeed indeed, all locally woven cloth. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Well,if you can be generous enough to lend me one of your cloths I have an important function to attend
I am sorry good Sir, this is not the Oscars. If you wish to have one of my outfits you must pay!
I just said I can't afford it for now but I promise to return same in good condition!
That is not how it works .. get out of this place!
Please your really have to help out here.I have a date with the king
And you are resorting to borrowing clothes? Disgraceful!
You don't have to be this difficult. We all have trying times in our lives
I need the money to feed my family - we are on the verge of destitution!
Then we all are in same shoes.Guess my visit to the monarch could yield some good fortunes
For yourself, perhaps, but how will it help me?
What goes round come around.You help me with my demand ,and you'll be rewarded

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Jester, what is this here flower doing? Does it squirt water?
HELLO
Hello, Jester! I've just returned from a quest and am tired. Please perform for me!
I wish i could , i dont  know why the king hates me
The king hates you? Perhaps you are not funny and do not please him. Hop on this table and put on my shield and armor.
yes, i love jokes and humor
You look mighty humorous in that armor! I'm afraid you wouldn't make a very good knight.
i would try my best
Perhaps you can please the king by eating flowers? This always puts a smile on his face, and they don't taste too bad.
i dont like flowers, i wouldnt love the taste
Oh, but you should give them a try! Put on some salt and pepper. Tastes like chicken!
ooh, really, then i wount mind
GRAND! The deed is done. You, Sir Jester, can now put a smile on the King's face again!
I hope i really do

setting.name: Cold storage room
setting.description: The cold storage lies just beyond the cottage door. In it are various harvested vegetables, fruits, and nuts. Cured meat hangs from the ceiling by thin rope. The room is made of wood, and the wind whistles through the cracks.
setting.background: The man of the house built this room for his wife as their family grew. Originally they only had a larder and root cellar for their harvests, but with new mouths to feed came added need for more space for food. The family works together to fill the cold storage room during harvest time.

speech: hello family off humans how are you
Ah! A talking mouse?! I've never seen that before.
yes well in these times you get a lot of magical creatures
It is a bit cold in this storage room. Are you okay to live here Mr. Mouse?
yes my fur is great insulation, why are you here tho
I came to get some food for the feast we are having tonight. Need some of these vegetables and nuts for the big roast! Thankfully that thief is sleeping.
yes hes quite the troublesome fellow, he nearly killed me
How about we get you out of this cold room and you come live with the family? Hop in this pouch!
ah thank you ill take that offer kindly
Yay! Glad you decided to get out of this place. I think you'll find the family safer.
yes i think so too, you all seem very king
We try to be. Family is the most important thing to have.
yes it really is though i lost mine long ago
Was it during the Dragon attack?

setting.name: Bright Path
setting.description: The bright path is lined with roses, lavender, daisies, and lilies. Apple trees sit on a pristinely-manicured lawn. Hedges in geometric shapes sit just beyond the path. The path leads away from the castle and down to a pond full of fish and swans.
setting.background: The bright path provides the perfect respite for guests who want to take a walk and enjoy the fragrant night air after a party. The queen takes this path often with her maids. They walk and gossip about court life.

speech: Ugh, these roses are TOO smelly!  I shall have to have the gardener trim the back by half at least!
hello queen would you mind throwing me in that pond before i die
Gah!  Ugh, you'll all slimy... I suppose... ugh, there you go, you disgusting creature.
thank you though no need to be rude, what brings you here today

ahh what a pain that must be

well i imagine the king handles all the important work anyway
Are you... are you saying that I, I the QUEEN, am not important?  The King must first see to MY needs before I would even THINK of letting him run off with those boooring advisers of his.
i simply mean he must deal with the important political decisions
Hmp!  Well.  Best that someone else deals with that dry nonsense.  All "The people are starving" and "oh the drought is bad this year" nonsense.  As if anyone cares!
well its a good thing im a fish
Yes. Well.  Just mind you stay in your pond, I'll not dirty my hands again to pick you up!
yes i would very much like that, good day

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: 'Tis a shame I've nothing but this cabin and you, old friend.

I'd not let him take you - I'd rather he took me first.  Such a rotten man, to think of eating dogs!
thank you so much for your kindness
The King seeks to take everything else - it seems that kindness and goodwill are all we have left.  *looks in the pot*  And day-old stew.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Ahh!  What are you DOING in here?  Can't a Princess at least have some privacy in the bathroom?
The king ordered me to protect you always
Well can you at least... turn around or something?  Goodness, you must be new.  I will NOT be stared at in here!
I am new. I only joined the royal guard two moons back
Well! You'll have to get used to my way of doing things.  I'll not begrudge you your duties, but we must have SOME propriety, mustn't we?
Yes we shall!
Well then... Guard... you have a name, don't you?

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

pray for me father
Of course, sir. You should pray yourself, as well.
Ok

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: Come forth, animal. Do you speak? What is your name?
I am but an animal that lives under the bridge. I don't have a name, King
Ah, but you do speak. Under a bridge? Are you a troll?
I suppose I am a troll. I like to scare people that pass the bridge.
Why would you do such a thing? Weary travelers are meeting here for a campfire. Do you hurt them, or just scare them?

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

speech: Hellooo?  Blacksmith fellow?  I demand service!
i am a knight good sir, the blacksmith is out at the moment
