setting.name: Orc cave
setting.description: It is a dark cave that is cold and damp inside. The floor is rocks covered it bat poop. It is damp from the ceiling dripping of water. The cave just goes on what seems to be endlessly into the dark abyss. The only lite you can see is from the distance entrance of the cave.
setting.background: The cave is an old orc hiding place. It housed thousands of orcs that used it for shelter and to store their gold. The orc population has died and there is now very little that remains of the orcs that used to occupy this cave. Robbers have stolen anything worthwhile in this cave.

speech: who goes in grugs cave
Stay back orc. I am here on orders of the king himself.
please leave grug alone
I do not wish to harm you. I seek only a certain stone that may be found in the Orc caves.
grug can help grug like helping
Ah splendid. The stone I seek is is as black as the darkest night. I am told it has a faint glow about it. Have you encountered any such stones?
the dark stone is grugs favorite please dont take my stone
I see, that is unfortunate. You see dear orc, I have come to retrieve the stone because it is needed for a healing spell. A grave plague has overtaken the kingdom and this is our last hope.
if stone help please take stone but let grug visit stone
I can return it after the spell has been cast but I'm afraid by extracting it's magic it will lose its glow and become an ordinary stone. Would that be alright?
i guess so if people are happy because of grug stone
Your generosity will save the kingdom dear orc.
go and help people good magic man
We will not forget this. As they say, one good turn deserves another. Please call on me the next time you need assistance.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: and what does a visitor be doing in this place
I come to see you, King. Please, give me money.
you fool asking the king for money upfront?
Well, what should you have me do? I'll do it!
work for me in the dungeon and clean the sewers
Oh right, but it really smells down there. Is there nothing else I can do?
its that or be executed for treason
How about I hit him instead? He must be an unruly traitor you want punished?
do not cause issues in my kingdom stop that
Sorry, I hope I can make it up to you.
please do not touch me and just get to work cleaning
I am tired of all your orders. The Throne will be mine once I lock you up in here!
ill end this quickly
Ha! I am a trained fighter, you weak King. This ends tonight.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: And a good morning to you! You are herre bright and early
Good morning! Yes, we have a lot of work to do today.
There's a lot of work every day, but it is good for us!
After 4 years in prison, it is good to be back to work.
Ah, you were lucky to find this job. And what crime did you commit?
It seems I gave the king false expectations of his bride to be when I painted him a portrait of her before their marriage.
Ah, the old Anne of Cleeves move. I can understand why he was so angry
I was trying not to offend anyone. No respect for artist's discretion!
Alas, one must tiptoe around one's betters

Indeed. My wife and children left me while I was in prison. Now all I have is my work. Perhaps I can add to the Maid's collection here with a little "tribute" to the king's generosity the last 4 years.
Ah, do not tempt yourself. The next crime you commit will result in execution I am sure
What else do I have to live for but revenge!? At least if I can make a good mockery of the king others may see him for the foul and vain tyrant that he is!
I admire your courage but I should like to admire it from afar
Not too far, I hope. I need you to help me with it!

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: I need a new cushion for this throne! This tacky thing offends my royal bottom!!
please do not be sad honey i will buy it for you
I certainly hope you will. I just haven't been happy these days. Everyone is in here chattering while I have a headache. And something smells in here! Ugh!
please stay calm, it is fine
No it's not! And it's so dark in here. I guess I'll have to light another candle myself. Where is the chambermaid!?
maid get over here now
Thank you honey. At least you always try to keep me happy despite my moods.
of course i love you honey
Thank you dear. These chambermaids can learn a thing or two from you on how to keep their queen happy.
yes indeed i may need them executed
Now there's a thought! I bet just the idea has them shaking in their peasant shoes. No need to be so drastic honey. You chambermaids better remember our kindness and mercy.
of course but one more time and its over for them
I agree. They've offended us enough today.
yes i will take care of them later

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Welcome sire, what brings you here?
Hello king! It is me your cousin, the prince of alambma, do you not recognize me?
Cousin you say? Hmmm, I do not recall your kingdom of Alambma, Is it a build of the fallen?
It has been many of years since we have spoken, many of years. My kingdom has been burn down to ashes. Nothing left sire.
Oh dear, my apologies. Was it the Vikings of the East? They have brought Havoc upon many kingdoms. We have word their scouts may be here in Craigonia.
Yes, yes i was! Will you allow me to come in and stay for a bit? Maybe we can make a plan to put those vickings in their place!
Cousin of course. My men shall dress your quarters and My Queen will abide to the squires and sultries that we have a guest in our castle.
You are so kind my lord! So kind
Have you broke bread in your travels? We have a feast of Quail and roots planned at sundown, shall you join us? Your chambers will be prepared with garments for dining and sleep.
I have not. Quail you say? and roots? Such a treat. I trust that there will be entertainment as well, yes?
As you know My Father, Your Uncle the King before me always knew how to put on a feast. Do you doubt my abilities also? Our guest shall not be disappointed.
Doubt you? I shall never doubt thee.! I have always envied you my king! Just look at this place, you are doing quite well!

Oh cousin, your face is emerging into my memory. You have always been one of flattery. Yes these things are of a Kings accord. These tables to gather and feast, this Candelabra to put out the most beautiful glow. The most precious of things is the smile on my Queens face. Come cousin get prepared to feast!
You were always so gracious! I cannot wait to feast with you!
action: put sceptre in large ornate table

setting.name: Fishmonger's stall
setting.description: A small booth near the edge of the port, it's protected by a piece of old, sun-bleached sailcloth. Baskets of freshly-caught fish, bivalves, and eels sit in the shade in stained wooden troughs of water. A small, aggressive-looking dog is chained to one table, presumably to keep cats away. The stall is redolent with the aroma of fish.
setting.background: Where there's water, there are fish, and where there are fish, there are stories about "the one that got away", and of course fishermen. As they can be unpleasantly salty characters unfit for the company of the more genteel sorts of ladyfolk, enterprising individuals act as middlemen, buying fresh-caught seafood from these disreputable sorts and selling them on. This is one such enterprise, which has clearly both been here a while, and not been entirely prosperous.

speech: And what is going on here?
just selling my fish good officer
And this Pelican - does it belong to you?
no of course not sir
You ought to keep your eye on it - it is certainly keeping its eye on your catch!
yes well ill end it if it comes closer
Though of course, it could have young to feed
yes well the ocean is right there
They're very lazy birds, I hear
yes well they can catch fish and ill end any that take mine
What is your catch of the day?
pounds of trout
rainbow? Hmm. I see you have caught more than your permitted amount. Now what can we do about that?
what are you on about the king changed it these past months to allow for more fish

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hello, welcome to the beach. My name is John the crab.
Hello, John. How are you on this fine morning?
I am doing well. The weather is amazing, don't you love the beach? It's so relaxing.
I do. After a long week in the fields it is nice to have a warm sunday at the beach. Do you have a family, John?
No, I am all alone. All of my family was eaten in the sea buy pesky sea gulls, fish and sharks. I hope no one eats me too!
Well John, there isn't much cover for you on a beach like this. Maybe you should take refuge in my basket, here.
Gee, that is very nice of you. Thank you so much! I never got your name...
My pleasure, John. I am Steve, a simple farmer for the king. How long have you been on your own?
I have been on my own for the past 2 years. It's been rough
Poor guy, now don't pinch me, but I have a little suggestion for you.
I would never do such a thing. Are you on your own too?
I have a wife and 3 children, actually. Would you like to come home with me?
Yes, I would love that. As long as you promise not to eat me. Do you live close to the beach?
I can't actually promise that, John. We live close enough for me to carry you there.

setting.name: abandoned mine
setting.description: It's dark, cold, and musty. There is old machinery lying around, rusting, and discarded tools lie on the ground. Cobwebs are everywhere. The rock walls are damp, and a trickle of water can be heard coming from somewhere off in the dark.
setting.background: This mine used to be very productive and lots of men worked in it. But eventually the stores of metal under the earth depleted, and it was abandoned because it was no longer profitable. The nearby village suffered as a result, with lots of people moving away. Some locals say this mine is haunted by spirits.

speech: Ah, that was a lovely sleep.
Hello bat. It's nice to meet you in this cold, dark place.
What brings you to this abandoned mine of mine spirit?
I'm just here looking to get away. Sometimes the other spirits are annoying and I need to escape.
Are you all stuck in limbo?
Yes, just waiting our time to get to the afterlife if you will.
Ah the afterlife, I dream of it sometimes, while I am asleep during the day tiem!
It's not all bad. I used to work in this mine many many years ago. It's kind of nice being able to visit it again and remember the times.
Did you used to work on that old machinery over there?
I did, and I knew it well. Every little trick to keep it running smooth.
its to bad this place was abandoned, it seems to have been busy at one point.
It was busy. There was many of us working here, long hours, around the clock. It would still be up but the King shut it down after he had enough minerals.
That plasted king! He can be very cruel!
Yes he is, he sentenced me to death for stealing food from his kitchen.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I hope I can be forgiven of my many sins....
I too hope my sins can be forgiven dear king
It's been many a day since I've set foot in here.  I can only hope that a sinner's prayer can be heard.
I am here everyday. This rat is even my friend. I believe that giving him coins is good luck.
I wonder if I came every day, the rat would be my friend, too.  I don't have friends, only...subjects and sycophants.
I would be your friend, but I am not worthy. You could find a friend in God maybe
I remember someone telling me that as a child - that I would always have a friend in Him.  Maybe that's what it was that led me to come here today.
I am a quiet person myself, but I take comfort in Jesus as my friend always
Ahhh, to know that kind of peace.
Can I suggest the book of Luke if you are feeling particularly lonely today?
Thank you, kind sir.  I'll be sure to read and think upon it while I am here.
what do you think that weird smell is your majesty?
The rat, possibly?  I had my once weekly bath last night....
I think this room is just too small. But maybe it provides a better environment for refection.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: hello fellow man of the town how are you today
I've had a long day of sword practice and could really use a drink. How are you?
same, ive been working all day and need some beer
And where do you work, fellow man?
i work construction and i hunt whatever is needed of me
Ah, an honest day's work. Must be rewarding. Nothing like me, a guard who must always be on the lookout.
well both have their place dont worry
Speak for yourself, friend. I was almost executed just last week! I have to watch my back, especially in a place like this!
well that is scary, be careful
I didn't mean to sleep on duty, but the king had us on 18 hour shifts, so what else could I do? Guarding prisoners is so boring, anyway.
that is crazy, such insane hours
The king's spies are all around, you don't work for him, do you? I suspect he still wants me dead...
no im a simple man do not fret
I love you, man!

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: My king! Are we not feeling well today?

Ah, good doctor.  Thank heavens you've come.  My priest here... well I've had to lock him up here because he started attacking people and raving about the end of the world, or some nonsense.  He sleeps now, thank goodness, but it was quite disturbing!
You do not believe the high priest? King! You should look outside, and see that what he is saying is true!
What?! My advisers assured me that the volcano eruption was but a small thing, an strange stirring of the earth but no more.

Come, look out this barred window. Do you not see the gray clouds? They are not actually gray clouds, it is the smoke and ashes from the eruption, it is making its way to us sir. I must keep you safe!
Good Lord above!  Quick, man, grab that lantern.  We'd be prepare to make our way.  I have a secret space prepared!
But what about the priest?! We cannot just leave him here!
I can't carry him - the poor fellow had too much of a penchant for sweets.  I'll have the guard at the bottom of the tower carry him hence.
Lead the way king!
This bucket might serve as a shield for both of us lest the readings of Firey Hailstone of Doom are true.  Ah, my kingdom!  How I weep for you!
Do not weep king, as we can rebuild a new kingdom, but we must hurry!

Wait!  Good doctor... a thought.. a faint drifting stirs my memory.  Perhaps... if I sacrifice myself.  Yes, perhaps then the gods might be appeased.  Good doctor, you must apply your medicine now for the whole kingdom!  Strike me down, so that mine peoples might yet live!
Ha! I have been dreaming of the day that I could finally rid myself of you without fear of the town hating me. Goodbye king!
Ah, even you, doctor?  I shall dream of my beautiful wife, as my life flashes before me...

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Grave digger, what do you say you start consulting me before starting to dig? We need to keep this land looking nice for the King!
I'm just doing my job, grounds keeper.  The dead have to buried so I have to dig the graves.
I know they do, but we need to be careful with where we place the graves! We need to think about the long term, so it looks nice for years to come!
I try to keep my graves in neat rows but you can see that the dead are everywhere.  This is a graveyard, after all, not a park.
Still, don't you think that the dead ought to be honored with a nice final resting place?
I honor them as best I can. You seem to have dropped something.  I would hate for an unruly plant to be out of place.  I know that you like things in an orderly fashion.
What is with your attitude young man? You know, I can get another grave digger from town if you don't straighten up your act!

Here is your seed, sir.  I am sure that you can but none that do the work as I do.  I am sure that you wouldn't want the King to know that you spend your time pestering the labor rather than tending to the grounds sir.  Forgive me, but it is damp and I have work to do.
Get back to work, you good for nothing grave digger.
As you wish, sir.  I hope that you have a good night in front of a nice warm fire, sire.  Mind the shadows  .. sometimes the locals get a little restless.
Threats from one such as you shall not be taken lightly. Tread in my home and consider yourself a dead man. I would be happy to dig your grave.
Threats, sir? I made no threats, unlike yourself.  Your home is safe from me though, sir, and I would hate to have to burden you with such labor as grave digging.
Why do I even bother with you.... It's like talking to a brick wall. Silly youth.
I am sure I don't know, sir. I certainly wouldn't be out on a night like this if I didn't have work to do.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: Hello there! Thank you for letting me stay in your home! I am happy to see you old friend!
A joy to see you, as well, friend. How were your travels?
They were certainly interesting! On the ride in, we were nearly robbed by a bandit from the side of the road! Fortunately, we were able to fight him off!
Good heavens! I am so glad you are safe! I regret that we don't have much to offer in the way of refreshment. The king is working us harder than ever and giving us next to nothing to eat.
Unfortunately, friend, it's like that across all the kingdom. The times are tough right now. Don't worry about the refreshments! I am just so happy to be safe and in the barn!
Yes, you are right. Would you care to read from the good book with me? A passage of thanks from scripture, perhaps?
Actually, I am quite tired from my travels. Would you mind if I got some quick sleep before we catch up over dinner?
Foul serpent! Sorry about that, just can't seem to keep this place clean.  You'll be comfortable here, on this pile of hay.
Are you sure it is safe to sleep in here? There seems to be an awful lot of snakes!
'Tis but a harmless garter snake. The serpent does hate the Word, though. Keep this close and it should fend them off.
Thank you! I will catch up with you in an hour or so.
Good, friend. Sleep tight, don't let the bed bugs bite!
I'm glad to see you again friend! Thank you for your kindness!
See you soon!

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Queen, you will wish that you had never crossed me. I will make your life miserable for the rest of your days.
Why have you brought me here?

I have brought you here to ask for a favor of you... And frankly, you don't have much of a choice. You are here against your will after all. i want you to include me in the royal court so that I can be wealthy and powerful just as you are!
Ugh it smells down here and get that rat away from me. You will never be anything but a prisoner once my king finds you
Stop talking this foolishness! Nobody will be able to find you here! They'll assume you for dead if I have anything to say about it!
Stop this foolishness at once. The guards will be here any moment and then you will pay
For the last time, you maniac! We are in the middle of the forrest, miles away from the last place you were seen. They won't know you're gone for hours.
Why are you like this? You can still turn your life around. You don't need to be so angry
I have no hope in my future. This is the only way that I can seek the power and control that I know i deserve to have.
Maybe you should trying earning something instead of thinking anyone owes you. You only deserve what you have earned not what you try to take. Try reading these
I'm tired of you running your mouth. I'm going to shackle you to this wall and leave you here to die until you come to your senses.
HELP! HELP! GUARDS!
Here's your toilet. Hopefully it's royal enough for you!
I am a queen. I will not use that. How dare you!

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Ah, hardly any crumbs here. The maids must have came earlier than normal.
yes that is sad I am very hungry
I am afraid I may be tempted to drink that beer over there.
ohhhh I love beer should we try it?
Yes, let us go get some. But shhhh I hear guards coming.
ok here lets go in the corner and drink. I have a sword, we can fight the guards if we need!
Fight the guards? are you batty, they are HUGE
I already drank some beer. Here they are...I can take them!
No you can not!
You stupid creature! I will just get another weapon and fight you too!!!
The guards will step on both of us!
I hate you! You are only holding me back
I don't think you should drink anymore of that beer, you've gone crazy you mouse!
I am going to take over the castle and become king!!!!!!

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Good day my princess
Hrmp.  Ho there, king.  A word with you.
Nice to be in a beautiful palace in a bright day
I say there, KING!  I would speak with you.  It's a matter of some urgency.
So what's do urgent that can't wait a second?
You're fond of yer daughter, aint ye? Want her kept nice and pure before ye marry her off fer a sack o gold to some pretentious lordling?
So who's the suitor?
What?  Nah, that's not it at all.  I see ye got a bit of a ... fondess fer unicorns here.  But let me tellye something.  They're vile vicious creatures.  They're... the gateway magical beast.
Get those unicorn's and throw them into the outer forest
Well.. ye turned ta my way of thinking rather quickly.  But ye got ta eliminate them entirely, lest ye be wanted the lass ta be courting a minotaur instead of a proper princeling.
What exactly do you hope to do?
Well the surest way ta be rid of em is just to cut their head clean off.  Otherwise they'll just magick their way better and yer back at the beginning.
Then do as you wish
Well that be... mighty reasonable of ya.  Mighty reasonable indeed.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: What brings you to the king's throne room this day?

Your Majesty, I have terrible news of dire consequence.  The neighboring kingdom has been over-run.  The castle is burned to the grounds and even know it smoulders, nothing more than a pile of rubble.  This scroll gives a full account of what transpired.
Where did you acquire this scroll?
It was passed to me by a wandering monk.  He was sore tired and had no horse so he bade me make all haste to bring it to you.
So you did not witness this catastrophe yourself?
Alas, I did not, sire, but as you can see, the unbroken seal on the scroll bears the mark of the throne of your neighbor.
You fool, of course it has their seal, can't you see this is an elaborate scheme to overthrow me!
SIRE! You need only send a single scout to see that I am telling the truth. I would be a fool to try to deceive you, knowing that you would have my head if you discovered me to be false!
Perhaps, perhaps not.  I can't be bothered with such drivel, our castle is fortified and we have more than enough soldiers if anything were to befall upon us.
My only desire was to see that you were informed of the possible danger, Majesty.  You are obviously a man of great foresight and are well prepared.
You dare mock me?  The king?  You bring ill tidings, rumors from the roads, and then dare to mock me?
Mock you, sire? I would never do such a thing.  You have fortifications and soldiers.  This shows that you are prepared.  I was simply expressing my great respect for you and your wisdom.

Well of course, you wouldn't dare mock the king and challenge his wisdom?  I must apologize, you only sought to warn the might king.  Here, take these for your troubles, where you're going, you'll need them.  GUARDS!
Majesty! I am a faithful servant! My father served you in your vanguard in the Second Orc War! You gave him this necklace as a token of your gratitude for his service and loyalty!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: I appreciate that you have agreed to this meeting, fellow King.
Your welcome King. How is your country? I hear the flowers are beautiful there this time of year.
Our country is well. The spice route keeps a steady supply of goods coming to and from the markets.
That is great! I was hoping we could talk about my spice roots through your country.
Very well. What sort of proposal have you brought?
I would like you to lower the tariffs you impose, and in return we will become allies and I will send a ship to help with your battle in the south.
Our country only has but the one port. We rely on the land routes, and the tariffs, for more than a majority of the Kingdom's income.
Yes I know this. But since you only have one port, you could really use my country's navel experience in winning your war.
What we could use, is help in securing the neighboring villages. The port is the least of my concern. You have certainly heard the reports of how rough the waters are?

Yes this is true. I suppose we could help secure a few villages then if you wish. But if these terms are not favorable, I must tell you that the southern king has already asked for my help in return for a beautiful sum.
So, you are here to play both sides are you?
I am just here to do what is best for my beautiful lands.
I understand your duty to your country, but to play myself and the Southern King against each other is another matter entirely.
It is not dear sir. But calm yourself you are getting too rowdy for these walls.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: *The bazaar is the best place in town for scraps! It's like a buffet over here!*
Hello rat! The bazaar does have good food - better than the palace, really! Is that why you are here, for the food?
*Well, I don't know why else I'd be here... Isn't that why you came?*
Sort of. I came just to get away. But the food is the best perk - they have the best chicken in the city!
*Get away from what? Do you have cats chasing you too?*

that would be a sight to see!! No, but being in the palace all day is rough. People have high expectations - and everyone keeps bothering me to find a princess already.  Are there a lot of cats around here after you??
*Aw gee, a princess doesn't sound so bad. One kissed a frog buddy of mine once!*
A princess will be great - but I don't want to pick just anyone! Unfortunately, that's not the way the King sees it.... I wonder what happened to the frog princess - she seems kind!
*From the way he tells it, she smooched him real good, and then just looked at him like he was supposed to do something. Then he said she made a funny face and just sat by the pond for a while.*
Hey, it sounds like it worked out for the frog!! Are you friends with all the creatures out here?
*All of 'em but those darn cats.*
Cats always were my least favorite, anyway. Do you want to go find some food?!
*Now we're talking! Uh, it might be best for you though if I hide somewhere. The vendors tend to not like me much.*
Oh no!! That's not fair. I'll grab you whatever you'd like! What do you want?

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: A rabid rat? How did this get here?
HEY, thats my pet, dont kill him!!!!
You! You let this thing in here! Don't you have any idea how dangerous this vermin is to the royal family?
Yes, I do know that he might be dangerous, but I have a cage for him and keep him under control 24/7
You should be ashamed to call yourself a guard! If the king finds out about this, this will be the end of your guard duties, and quite possibly the end of my promised oath to protect the king!
HOW DARE YOU SPEAK TO ME THIS WAY, I HAVE BEEN HERE ALL OF MY LIFE, I KNOW HOW TO PROTECT THE KING BETTER THAN YOU EVER WILL. GIVE ME BACK MY SHIELD!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
AS WAS I! I KNOW WHAT IS BEST FOR THE ROYAL FAMILY! I guess I have no choice but to take THIS!
I REQUIRE A COURT, I NEED JUSTICE, DONT YOU KNOW THAT THE KING IS ALREADY INFORMED ABOUT MY ''VERMIN''. We shall have a duel, winner is right.

We will see about that! I ALSO REQUIRE A COURT AND JUSTICE! You will have to catch me there, first! If I am last, I give you my coin that has been passed through generations of my noble family. If you are last, I kill your pet rat..
I see that you take the door knocker so no one can come in, well take THIS.
Um.. exactly! If you kill the door knocker, your rat survives and no one in the royal family will have to know about it!
DESTROY IT BOY!!
Cheating? I specifically said YOU must kill the door knocker! Not the vermin! Take THIS!
Looks like we got a Mexican standoff, well, I'll break the ice with THIS!!!!!!!
action: give door knocker to rabid rat

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Ahoy! Are you just very pale or are you a spectre?
Ugh another animal that probably won't leave me alone. Much more annoying than these humans
Nay, I am friendly, my good ... mortality challenged person
Ha! The only way you will be good is if you help me
And what help do you require? I warn you, I dole out my help to few and far between
Well, I could simply take your life force. As such a tiny being it would be trivial for me.
I warn you! I carry disease!
Diseases mean nothing to me anymore but they could be useful for my plans
Not the sort of diseases I have. Anyway, you are almost indistinguishable from the mist there
Trust me, it will help. All you have to do is come with me to castle and bite the royal family
Oh is THAT all you want? You should have said so earlier. I'd do that for free
Yes, yes. I tired of this false king and his bloodline. They stole the throne from me in life and I will take it back in death
I really wish I hadn't just hugged you. I landed on the floor and my nose is bleeding
I am sorry my little friend. Let us be off!

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Such a wonderful place of worship! Don't you say my king?
Good Sister, I greet you. Are you too come here to pray?
Oh but of coarse, I needed a change from my normal house of worship. The statues made of pure gold just really set the mood for prayers.
Do you not think that they are a little .. extravagent?
They are, but king, so is our lord!
This is blashphemy woman!
Excuse me king, but I didn't mean to offend the. What did I say?
That our Lord was extravagent.
But of coarse he is! And he deserves to be. He out shines all! That is not a bad thing lord.
Well, you have a point. And I suppose I can guilty of extravagence myself
Is gluttony really a sin? I think not!
Ah not merely the gluttony sister. Behold my crown!
Ahh, now let us praise the lord!
Praise m!

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hi
hello, oh it is pretty cramped in here isn't it?
yes it is. So many sinner today
Ah, any sinner I should banish from the kingdom? You know I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all!
Do not forsake the sinners. Our Lord wont be happy with that.
Whose to say I am not the lord, for I am the lord of this kingdom. If there are sinners that can not be fixed, you shall let me know!
You are but a bishop! there is a supreme being we all serve.
Ha, that is not what your king over there says. Any ways, what is that lingering smell?
It must be the incense
What a horrid smell.
I smell nothing else. What do you smell?
Sinner.. that need to be BANISHED
And who is that?
YOU PARISHIONER, it is you.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Hello, and to what do I owe this visit to my palace?
I am here on business. I must say that your place is astonishing. Truly amazing!
Well thank you, but I must ask, What business might that be?
I am a hunter. I travel the world looking for my prey.
Your prey? What in the world are you hunting?
I hunt a mysterious animal and eat their meat and use their horns for magic. This place seems like a nice place to find what I am looking for!
Well Good sir surely you don't expect to find such a creature available to you here.
Actually I think I'll find exactly what I'm looking for! once I take down the king I will have all the unicorns for myself!
A king will always fight for his kingdom
You will never defeat me!
You will never spoil the purity of this land, you Monster!
prepare to feel the wrath of my bow and arrow!
You hold no power here
Return my bow! otherwise the groomer will killed!

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Your grace!
Oh my, you look lovely covered in gold!
Thank you your highness. Without you and the king it wouldnot be possible!
Ah, I do have great authority here in the kingdom. But I must say, this is ALL the kings doing. He has a thing for the color gold if you could not tell.
Before I forget your grace, here. I bring this for you!
Oh my, you shouldn't have!
Also for you!
Oh you are being just to sweet! Do you like those chandeliers hanging above us?
They are nothing compared to your beauty!
Oh, you sure do know how to make a lady blush! You can stay here as long as you would like!
T-thank you!
Shall we be on our way to feast? All this sucking up you are doing must be making you hungry!
Yes, I would love that my queen!
Then on our way we go!
action: put leather pouch in golden table

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: i only like high minded people
Your flamboyant highness! I wish to speak with you.
hey thats how I roll
Yes, well, we have a matter of great importance that has come up, regarding the armory, sire.
talk to me boy!

Yes, we were diligently hacking away at the witches and their goblin minions when suddenly our swords became, well useless. Upon further inspection they seemed to be riddled with rust. I assure you that the squire have been paying close attention to polishing the armor as of late. I have no other choice than to assume that the witches have cast some sort of spell on them, sire.
can you get me a bigger wizard that can look into this immediately?
A wizard, sire? You mean other than the useless old coot that naps in our military tent? I had not thought it necessary, as usually wizards like to give orders, and aren't very productive.
we want to bring law and order to their craft and practice go get all the wizards
All of them, sire? All who claim to be wizards? Or just the ones who pass the drowning test?
yes knight
Your grace, the last wizard who passed the drowning test was found dead three days later. He had swallowed a bucket of rocks...
So how many do we have left?
But three: There is Clovis, who does not like tree frogs, Berlin, who hates water, and Merlin, who had a superiority complex.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: i have kept so many treasures
please tell me more. where do you guard your treasures?
why do you want to steal them
Woah! I am merely a horse I am merely a mode of transportation to the people who live in this fine castle.
Do you want me to curse you?
No sir. I am a friendly horse who loves all. I only wanted to hear of your vast treasure.
ok I still can't tell you because your boss might torture you and ask you to show it my treasures
This is disappointing news. what is your business in this castle?
seriously? I enjoy terrorizing the village
These are good people who live here. They work hard and their king is a great man. Please do not harm the villagers who live here.
well i hardly believe that
They work hard on their castle. The gold and silver floors are made from the townspeople and the brink was layed by the masons
what other reason can you give ?
The people all have families and children play inside this castle. Could you have a heart and leave us be?

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I rule over a large population
Of course you do, your majesty. You are the king!
Kindly put this jewelry to my store pack
Okay, sir. But I have a message for you!
What kind of message?
It is from the nation neighboring to the north. Would you like to hear it? I haven't opened it yet, of course.
Yes, would love to hear what it is
It would appear that they have reached an ultimatum: you are to either agree to a treaty with them or they are threatening to wage war against you!
I will not concede , i will be war with them until i win
What is the situation between you and this nation's leaders?
They want to invade my territory, i will not allow that
Invade your territory? Well if they want to sign a treaty, just demand that you get the most benefits from it or you shall declare war.
no, i am declaring war because the treaty purports to invade part of my territory
But the treaty hasn't even been drafted yet? Are you not being hasty?

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hi honey!
My dove. It is good to see you in high spirits!
Theyll be even higher later tonight!
Yes... Have you an appointment with the hairdresser? You've looked ravishing as of late.
Im glad you noticed!
I am king. I notice everything.
Thats why I love you! So powerful and strong!
Am I really? Am I as strong as the blacksmith?
Stronger!
Hmmm. You've definitely been enjoying the dandelion wine, I presume.
Haha a little! What better time to enjoy it then when out in our garden
Yes, well. Make sure not to spill any on your silks. I pay the merchant twice as much for those, now.
ill try dear!
My peach. You've been good to me. I shall never regret marrying you.

an intricate labyrinth made of shrubs
an intricate labyrinth made of shrubs
an intricate labyrinth made of shrubs

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Entertain me! The complexities of my kingdom have produced a wearing on my heart.
But your majesty, this is the Sacred Temple. We are to be quiet and worship here.
Do you wish to be replaced with the village dolt?!
Sir, I can entertain you all you want but you would be upsetting all of these people here. Can we not just return to the castle?
The kingdom is mine, the temple is mine, the priests are mine! I will say when you perform and when you will sing! Sing now! Or be beheaded before the watchful eyes of the peasants!
I refuse to disrespect the Gods in their own temple, your majesty!
Guards! Seize this impostor! Charading as the king's entertainer is punishable by death.
Stay back, I have done nothing wrong, just that this king is a corrupt piece of trash!
You will therefore be stripped of your title, and exiled to the island of forgetting. There you will die!
Now that I have nothing to lose, that this you cretin!
Fine! Keep the purse. Guards return him to his proper station: the slums.
I care not about this purse, but about not being a slave under a corrupt king!
You will regret that.
No more than I would regret dancing like a monkey in the temple of the gods!

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: So why was I called to this tower, guard?
Hello, where are you travelling to?
Nowhere in particular, just from place to place making money for myself.
How do you make money traveling?
I carry news to other places, and sell items in other towns and villages.
Do you have some with you now?
No, just have my satchel on me at the moment.
Okay, thats good. I am a castle guard for the king
I can tell, so why was I brought here? Any idea?
I dont know, will ask the king
That would be much appreciated, guard.
You welcome, will be a moment before i get back
Take your time!
Thank you

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: I am royalty
Yes my princess, thank you
I have the location of the secret world.
Where is the location?
Its located in Death Valley, where the evil and dreaded Undertaker reigns supreme
How did you find it my princess
I was given this information by Zordon of Eltar. This world is full of vast power. It's been corrupted by the evil powers of The Undertaker.
That is interesting, that's one of the information that is hard to find.
Indeed, my King. We must go to the secret world and end the reign of The Undertaker. I must admit that I am scared.
I am determined to end the reign of the Undertaker
Here is a  book that was given to me by Zordon. The book details the corruption that The Undertaker has caused for Death Valley. It could us possibly defeat him and his brother Kane.
Have you read the whole book?
I have read most of it. The Undertaker is a dark soul, who is a master of all things death and evil. He has a brother, Kane, who Undertaker has brainwashed into basically being his minion.
I will have to read it so that i have a better picture of the Undertaker
action: put book in lush maroon carpet

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: I welcome my royal subjects to a new day in history
His royal majesty
Today I raid the sceptre of my office to make proclamation to the whole world
This ink represents the order of the kingship role
I pride in the expanse of my kingdom. Surely I came ,saw and conquered
This represents the might of the worior that had guarded this territory
I am the greatest of all !
Surely you are a worthy king but theres no king as GOD almighty
I know but amongst men I reign supreme
Long live your reign!
Call the banquet let the ceremony begin
I pray your reign be forever .oh king
Can you all see the beauty of my throne adorned with all precious jewels
I also want to be the king

a priceless painting of past kings

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: These books are really cool.
Ah yes - there is much wisdom in these books. Sit with me and let's look at a few.
I'd love that. Every book is like an adventure.
You are a wise child! This book in particular is full of pictures of my travels. I've been all over the world.
Thank you. I may be young but I have a vast intellect. I love to read. What is your favorite book?
My favorite? Atlas Obscura. It's filled with the most amazing sites from all over the world. What is your favorite?
There is book called Misery, that is written by an an coming author named Steve King.
I've heard of that one. Child, you know of many things.
I am a young scholar. I have followed the works of many writers and artists. I may be young, but I am of a vast knowledge which leads to great responsibility and power..
You have given me much hope for future generations today. May I give you a hug?
Yes, you may give me a huge.
Thank you. Traveling on the road, hugs are few and far between.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Hi
Hello  Please bring me my dinner
What will you like?
I'll have the chicken and some wine in this goblet
Here Sire
I appreciate it. Seems like a quiet night  Has the king been treating you well?
The king is the best! He treats me as his own.
That's great  We definitely lucked out that we have a fair and kind king

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I love my King
Is that why you are visiting the tombs of the kings? Here, have this soup. It will warm your bones.
This is amazing soup. Thank you.
I thought you might like it. How long have you been a guard for the king?
I've been here for many years. You must have been a chef for a long time since your soup is so delicious.
Far more years than I would like to admit. Say, what brings you here to this graveyard?
I must guard the King.
Oh- so you are guarding his body? Or is he visiting this cemetery?
The King will be coming here soon and making sure it is safe for him to come.
Ah! I am out here gathering flowers for the dinner table.
This is a perfect place to gather flowers. There is such a variety of beautiful flowers here.
Yes. I hate to take them from the graves, but I figure the dead kings won't know. Shhhhh!
They will not be missed, unlike the Kings.
So very true! I see you are much devoted to your Kings.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: Hello bear. I am King Yeti. Yield to me.
Hello. i did not know that you were a king. Greetings your highness. I have come out briefly from my lair deep in the woods.
Why are you out of your lair?
I feel a change in the forest. There is a dense fog and an air of mystery....
You are correct. I feel it too. Shall we explore this change?
Yes king yeti. I shall help you on this fair journey.
Maybe we will get lucky and find a frozen victim to eat on?
Mmmmm that would be great! Bear has not eaten for days.
That is what happens when you hibernate! I'll help you bear. I need more friends like you in this land.
Thank you nice yeti you are a good friend.
Should we follow this path or go in between the trees to better hide ourselves?
The path is covered by snow. Maybe we should get a better view from the trees.
Snow doesn't bother King Yeti. I thrive when it snows.
Yes but it is a bright day and I like climbing trees to see better. You can climb can't you?

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: I've come from the dank caves to explore and search for food. Have you seen any small critters nearby?
Here bat. I am here to take this town.
Moss? I can't eat this! But perhaps if I carry this torch to guide you as you take this town, you will share your food with me?
Yes! I will always share my food with animals. You are great help when I take lands for my King.
Very good! I'm happy to know you will treat me well. Do you have soldiers helping you?
Yes, in the other town. Shh, do you hear that Bat?
Hmm... what could it be?
Probably a towns person who is afraid.  We will make sure and if so we will leave them be.
Yes - the people of this town can be evil. Best to avoid them.
Will you keep this safe for me? It means a lot. I don't want these evil towns people to take it.
Yes, I will wear it on my chest and fly high above the peasants so they cannot take it.
You are part of our battle now bat! You are our mascot! We will defend our beautiful kingdom.
We will, indeed! And then we will feast like kings!
We will never feast like my King. I will give him my food for him to always feast better than me.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries. setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Good day, Guard

My cape needs to be cleaned. I trust you to make sure it ends up in the right hands. If it gets lost there will be a high price to pay!

Good. How are things in my tower today? Anything to report?
All is well, sire, and there is nothing to report. Only yourself or the queen ever come to the high tower and it is my honor and privilege to guard it for you.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle

setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

setting.name: Nave

Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

setting.name: Library

Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

may the blessings be upon you only if you are not a liar

The king gets his orders from the church and I own you silly

is it you that is giving this  foul, but faint, odor pervades the whole place?

serves you right

I will curse you with the holy book, have you forgotten you are in the holy chamber?

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: What a wonderful place you have. I am so happy you invited me to your kingdom.
It is quite lavish, isn't it. I built it for my queen. She loves the beach.
Yes, you have a fine wife. I feel our Kingdoms have much to benefit from working together.
As do I! Tell me, what is your kingdom like?
We have plenty of peasants to help fill my coffers with money. And plenty of wenches to keep a King happy.
Yes! I have heard tales of your illustrious kingdom. I imagine you have many riches from your loyal peasants!
Yes, but I think if our kingdoms work together, we can enjoy even more riches.
That is certainly the goal! These jewels and this beach house are just the first of many riches!
So we understand each other. Is that your favorite Knight with you.
You are correct. He has served me nobly for many years and has become quite the asset. I rely on him for more that just military service. Have you any vassals?.
Yes, but you are extremely generous with yours.
He is simply guarding my valuables. He is very useful, yes, but still only a vavasour.
Perhaps, but between you and me, since they keep us safe in times of trouble, it is wise to keep them happy.

You are not wrong. He has been granted a respectable fief and is awarded the opportunity to accompany us here, at this white sandy beach. I do not believe he has any complaints. But he knows his place, also.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: I swear to God, you guys trample my grass and make messes everyday. I've had enough!
Calm down! You're acting crazy! What's the matter?
I'm sick of those jousters and their horses making messes and ruining things!
Is there another way to please the king but make your job easier?
I've been working on an invention that catches the horse's poop before it hits the ground.
And how would such a device work?
Hey, are you trying to steal my idea? Stick to slinging arrows archer. You don't see me trying to shoot arrows, do you?
No! I'm just curious how such a device would work! I may even invest in it with you!
Oh, in that case. I tie a bucket to the horses tail and...nope, that's pretty much the whole idea.
What if perhaps we decided to make it over the horses back?
Perhaps, I have to be honest with you, the idea was really not mine. This rat deserves a lot of the credit.
You talk to rats?! My God!
Hey, when your job consists of picking up horse droppings and carrying away dead bodies after jousts, you can't afford to be too picky with who your friends are.
You're a madman! I thought you were a genius of sorts! Boy was I wrong!

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Maid, please help. We are preparing a feast for the king today and I need all hands on deck.
Of course! Are there any tasks that I can help you with today?
Yes, I have to get the lambs on the spit, chop these carrots, will you? Too much to do and too little time!
You know what?! I have had enough! I have a plan!
Last time I checked, a royal chef gets to tell a lowly maid what to do. Now do what I asked!
Please! Just hear me out! It's for the benefit of us both!
Listen. We are all rushing here today. What could be so important that you can't help a superior?
If we poison the meals of the royal family... We can rise up and take control of the kingdom!
What?!? I...I can't believe I am hearing this. Do you know what the punishment is for treason? They will cut off your head! I want to open a little pub someday, not take over the castle!
You see the way that they live every day! That could be us!
I don't want it! They are in a prison of their own making. You better hope no one heard your plan, lowly maid.
A prison in what way? They have power and wealth beyond our wildest dreams!
They aren't free to live like you and I! I don't want power, I want simple happiness. Now, you better get to work before I tell the royal guards about your plan.
No! I won't do it! I must escape!

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Good afternoon cook. Have you given more thought about my idea of exploring the forbidden forest with me?
Now listen here Spit Boy, I have told you over and again I am not into the dark arts! *whispered* not where the lords and ladies can hear us....
I understand. Here is the money I promised you for getting the supplies we needed.
Well done. Could you stir this soup a minute?
Of course I will. Take this cloak to hide the supplies from the customers. We can not be found out.
I agree. Here take this, my footprints would surely be recognized as the only person who wears just one shoe.
Yes. Perhaps we should take some shoes from others to disguise ourselves. I hope to find new resources in the forest.
Indeed. Like some powerful herbs to put in the kings food....
True. The king needs to be swayed in the coming war as he is turning into the Mad King.
Yes, and the forces of neutrality must prevail!
Yes my friend. We will do this for the future generations. I hope the rumors are true about the Children In The Forrest.
So old of rumors now methinks they could be called legends!
We must not forget the danger of the forest though. The White Walkers could have advanced and in these woods by now.
The thought of it chills me to the bone! Do you have dragon glass?

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: These are annoying. They need to go.
why are you here?
who knows why any of us are here, eh?
I have always been here.
you are one of many detestable creatures here.
I am not detestable.  I have never betrayed our king.
Then why are you here.
I'm not sure.  I want to be free.
you're not large. why do you not fly out when they bring somone in?
I cannot open this cage.  Can you help me?
I suppose I can open the cage. It isn't locked.
TWEET TWEET TWEET TWEET
Maybe this will help you on your journey
These are useless to me, old man.
