You better be careful where you wander. Or you'll end up at the wrong end of one of these.
Sir if you could tell me what my job is.
Have you lost your memory? You aren't employed by the royal guard, that's for sure.
No sir I was employed by the royal guard ,but they didn't tell me what I'm supposed to do.
No, I know my men backwards and forwards. You are not a member of the royal guard and do not say you are or I will have you expelled from the kingdom.
Sir I'm a poor man, why would I lie to you?
I don't know, but I don't appreciate the lying. Especially to your King.
I wish your guards were as smart as you!
You dare attack a King? I will have your head!
You are nothing without you guards!
Why did you hug that prisoner? Do you know them?
I don't just know them but they will help me!

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Hello Knight.
Hello dealer. What do you have for me today?
I was hoping you could recognise the handwriting on this paper?
Hmm, let's see. The handwriting looks extremely feminine but other than that I don't know who wrote it.
Interesting, thank you. We have intelligence that the person who was writing this letter has seditious materials on the King.
What exactly is meant by "seditious materials" dealer?
That's above my paygrade sir!
I hope the King will be safe. I'd like to set up some extra security.
Very wise. How has business been for you?
Business has been good. We have kept a strong security rope around the castle.
Interesting, I have been told to give these to the watchmen under your command.
Ah let me see this. Seems to be in good condition, thank you sir.
You may as well hand on to this copy and show it to your watchmen and ask them the same question I asked you. The original is up in the castle.
Will do mr. dealer. Hopefully someone can identify the author of the paper.
action: give a sleeping bag to knight

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: This is way too high up, I must get down soon.
Buzz, take me with you, back to those delicious horses, buzz.
You are annoying me, quit buzzing around me!
Hey! I am just being a fly! C'mon give me a little snack..
You're biting me for no reason! I must get down off this spire though before I panic.
Very well, hey, what's this!?
Hey give that back, that's mine!
I'm only curious, life's pretty dull around here when everyone's trying to kill you just because you want to eat. C'mon and read it to me.
Oh fine! The letter is from my family. I am in trouble and had to send them into hiding.
Whyever for? Sorry for getting it messy...
It's okay. The king is after us. He thinks I betrayed him.
Well did you?
Of course not! I would never betray my leader!
Where did you send your family?

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Do  you know why we are here today?
Not sure why I was summoned here today
I want you to help more with the kingdom.
I would be proud to help out and do more for the kingdom
here is a shield as well.
You stupid, stupid little man. I plan to take over this kingdom. You are done and I will make sure you don't live to see another day,.
I do not come down easily though.
You will fall and I will be king. I can't wait for you to die any longer
Not if I take you down first. This could be easy or it can be hard.
And that is the last word you wil say. I do not need you to run this kingdom. I will leave you die in this crypt. You are bleeding. I have struck you.
I can still attempt to fight, This isn't always the end. I have struck you as well, as I did steal the sword.
You will fall like the fallen in the painting on the wall. You have nothing left to fight for. Take that and that
you will only dishonor the kingdom. power is not what you think it is.
I have yet to finish you and you will be forgotten and never remembered by the people of this land
action: remove the royal coat of arms

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: goodday.
Good day, come, sit and take a load off fine servant. Some times it is good to relax.
Thank you. Tis a warm day. Lots of work.
The work will wait. It is time to have a cool drink and sit and talk about the fine things that we should be thankful for
what are you thankful for sir?
The beautiful sky, the wonderful people in the kingdom, the animals that sustain us along with the crops that are grown.
All fine things. I am thankful for this beautiful sky today.
Do you have family?
not much. An ailing mother who doesn't know what is going on and my brother passed on his travels as a merchant.
What is wrong with your mother. Will a little more in your pay help provide for her?
Oh sir, we are fine. More pay would be nice to send home, but we make do. She just has the delirium. Some lovely church folk take care of her for me so I can work.
I am sorry to hear about your brother. We can make sure your mother is comfortable. You need not worry about that
I hope you not think uncouth. It's been a nice conversation, especially with not family to talk to.
Do you have enough money to bury your brother. I can take care of that too

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: Welcome to my canopy. What can I do for you?
If you can just help me with this that'd be great, I'm a guest visiting friends and have been carrying this a long way!
Of course I can carry this suitcase with my manly arms. Where am I bringing it?
In the corner of the room hidden in the dense canopy is fine! I can enjoy the room then!
Who are you here to visit may I ask?
Well there must be millions of people through these walkways? I wouldn't want to bother you with trivial details like names!
Ok then, well I have to go tend to the horses now.
What kind of horses!? I love horses!
Clydesdales of course! Only the best for the king!
They are the best! All the way from Scotland!
Yes sir they are. I also have to finish carving my sculpture.
Is the sculpture of the horses?
Why, yes it is. It's one of my hobbies to sculpt these creatures.
A very talented man you are!

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: What are you doing here peasant/
Hail good sir! Im just trying to stay out of the rain!
Do you not have a home peasant?
I do but I was carrying grain from the fields when the rains tarted!
Great. I was on my way to church and wanted to make sure you were okay.
That is very kind of you sir. Do you like your church?
Oh yes, the congregation is just fine! And the scenery on the way is divine. Just look at this beautiful clearing.
Aye it is. Unfortunately I dont have much time for church anymore.
Oh why is that?
You see this? I have to spend all my time farming just to have the king take it all away and leave my family nothing
I'm so sorry to hear that peasant. I wish there were something the church could do but we can't go against the king.
It is a sad thing. Perhaps one day his heart will gain warmth
Yes, until then, maybe you can hide some grain in this cave?
Hmm. Do you think it would be safee?

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Your majesty!!! If I may be so bold, what are you doing here?
Hello fellow customer! I am here to get my sword polished and ready for the coming battle. Are you ready for the war?
Eh, I don't think I want to participate. Not my thing. Don't see the point, you know?
It is your responsibility to defend this kingdom!
Look, I'm just here to try the new corn. Not to discuss politics. Man it's getting hot in here! Have you seen the new corn anywhere?
No corn here, this here is the blacksmith shop. Are you an enemy infiltrator?!
YOU are the imposter! The real king would know the importance of corn to this kingdom! It is our main export! The king would know where the corn is! WHERE IS THE CORN??? WHERE ARE YOU HIDING IT???
CORN IS THE CODE WORD FOR THE EMPIRE. BETRAYER.
Oh yeah? Well if CORN is the code word, then WHY do I have THIS POCKET WATCH???
You fool. That was my pocketwatch. I placed it there to keep an eye on you. It is laced with magic.

Why would you watch me??? I just wanted to try the NEW CORN!!! They say if you combine it with heat it makes a fluffy new substance called popcorn. It's supposed to be the next big thing. I figured this is the hottest place in town... Is the new corn really not here???
Because I know you are a SPY!

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello there, how are you today?
I am doing fairly well. Just passing through and decided to stop into this shop. And yourself?
Well not to well since I am being me married off to another country soon.
That sounds rough. Why don't you fight it or leave?
Because if I don't war will break out...
That's a lot to have on your shoulders. I'm sorry to hear that.
It is okay as the only daughter of the king and queen it is my duty...
I wish I had more to offer to help you, but maybe this will help you some.
Thank you that is all I needed.

I am on my way to establishing some new property off in the mountains away from the hustle and bustle of the kingdom. If you would like, you could come with me. I'm not much company but I am sure it will be better than a forced marriage. While you have a duty to your kingdom and family, you also have a duty to yourself as well. Which duty you choose is up to you.
I think.... I would like to go with you...
Come quickly then. We will sneak you away, out the back and they won't notice until you're gone.
We must ditch the guards outside

I will try my best to distract them while you sneak out the back and I will meet you behind the temple. From there it is a straight shot out of the kingdom walls and on the path to the mountains. We can get as far as we can before the sun begins to set and set up camp for the night.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Why are you sad, woman? Has anyone done anything to you?
Oh no, it's only time and this wicked world we live in that made my husband fall ill and took him from me too soon.
I am sorry to hear that. I have some extra meat that I have caught. i can give you some to take home.
That's very kind of you. My children will be glad for the extra food.
Your husband didn't eat the mushrooms that are all around here. they are poisonous
He ate some mushrooms that grew closer to our house, where the forest is kinder, but never the ones from this deep in the woods.
That is good. If there anything that you need, my sons and I will try to help with anything.
How old are your sons?
they are in their early 20's. they are strong and can help with chores
I can't offer them much for their trouble, but I could spare some vegetables from the garden from time to time.
We are not asking for anything, but sharing is always nice. They will be more than happy to help. We have plenty.
That's so kind of you.
I do not need to have hugs. You will be fine and I will let the king know that you are without husband. He will definitely bring more help to you.
I loved my husband and miss him desperately, but what business is it of the king's

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: My Lord, what may I help you with?
I have worked up an appetite from speaking with my council today for hours but the smell in this room is making me lose my appetite. Make me something quickly.
Of course, sire, I'll have the cooks prepare your usual - a plate of roast fowl brined in red wine. Allow me to pour you some mead in the meantime.
I will sit in this chair and rest while I am waiting. Tell me maid, what is your life like?
My life? A life of service to you, a great man, so I count myself lucky. If only everyone in the castle understood your strategic vision as I do.
I like the way you think Maid. Keep talking. And tell the cooks to hurry. I am famished.

Of course, my lord. Here's your mead, you look parched. I believe you'll be regarded as the greatest king our land has seen, if only your advisors had half the strength to carry out your guidance. But you can't be expected to do everything, after all.

This mead MUST BE stronger than I thought. I thought I heard a simple maid speaking poorly about my advisors. You are a maid, and you must remember to mind your place while speaking to me and about my council. You don't want to find out what will happen the next time you speak out of turn.
Of course, my lord. It..it won't happen again. Here's your meal.

This food is edible. If only by someone who is famished. I will be going away for some time in two days time. I would like you to make sure that every animal in this room is accounted for when I return. No one else in the caste is to eat my animals. None of the animals are allowed to become sick either. Is that understood? And please tell me. Do you have children?
Of course, my lord. I will ensure everything stays the same as when you left here. And no, I have not been blessed with children.

Thank the good Lord! Maybe its the mead talking but I'm thankful you will only be able to serve me for the entirety of your life and never leave. Replacing you and having a new maid trained would be such a pain in the neck.
The honor is mine, my lord.
HOW DARE YOU TOUCH THE KING. Please stand in the corner of the room for the remainder of our meal.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: hello, knight
This place look pretty treacherous. Do you live here?
I live in the mountains
I see. I better get away from this edge. It seems crumbly and my horse seems a little spooked. I will back off a bit.
good idea. I like to stand at the edge to look at the valley below. besides, I have wings.
Yes you look large and well equipped for these valleys and mountains. Are you a fire breathing dragon?
No, unfortunately, I have no fire to breathe.
Well you look spectacular! Who needs fire anyway!
I agree!
Sooo, your not gonna eat me are you?
I do like to terrorize the townspeople, but eating is too quick of an end. there's no joy in instant and temporary suffering.
That's kind of a relief. I would hate to fight on a day like this. I am strong but I don't think I could take you alone.
I'm feeling a little tired today, too. This cliff isn't a good place for a knight to try to fight a flying dragon, either.
Ha! Do you have a name dragon? My name is egor. I serve under the King.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: What's this? An itsy bitsy spider! How did you get in here? At least you can't spill all my secrets!
Oh can't I? And enough with the itsy bitsy please
WHAT?!? HOW?!? Y-Y-YOU can TALK?!? HOW can this BE???
Of course, you could just be having an hallucination
I could be I suppose... Oh no. My brother. He's poisoned me again, hasn't he?!?
Well you got better last time, didn''t you? Eventually?
I suppose I did, didn't I? Then again... you could be some enchanted spy. One good way to find out! Hold still...
Hey! I appreciate the National Enquirer as much as the next person but I prefer to read it before being splatted by it
Maybe you need a closer look! It is my scepter! And what is a National Enquirer??? You ARE a spy, AREN'T you??? Spill your guts or I'll squash them!
I dodge you and now I am on the ceiling!
That's right you dodge! Because I am the king! And only one of us is going to make it out of here alive. And it's not you!!!
hahahahah! Ther are five different ways out of here. I can sneak under the doors
Only if you escape me. I will never stop, and I will never quit until you are found and destroyed.
Well honestly, I think you need a hobby

setting.name: Church foyer
setting.description: This musty room is fairly plain and drab and is surrounded by stone walls.  There's religious tapestries adorning these walls along with some chairs for people to wait before the actual church is opening up to them.
setting.background: Worshippers comes to the foyer to wait to be let into the main church for daily service.  This is also the place where rumors fly about as worshippers talk among each other.

speech: It must be quite a privilege for you to be near a man of my intellect.
The wise often have much to teach of the Lord. Welcome, sir, to the church of St. Abelard
I have come here to study your tapestries. Tell me, do you know much about them?
I know the stories that they tell, though I do not know who made them. This one here shows Olyver banishing the great Beasts.
As you probably know, I am the foremost scholar on Olyver in the Kingdom.
I admit, I did not know! What gives us the honor of your visit?
Well, the King has tasked me with cataloguing all of the important artworks in the kingdom. I'm writing it all down in my book here.
I see! That is fascinating! Truly, our king is a learned and pious man to send you upon such work.
Well, I was really the only choice, am I right? Who else would he send? Jeremy the Elder? That guy's a complete hack.
What do you think of our tapestries?
They are actually quite impressive. I'd say they were late 7th century with clear Moorish influences. Sorry, I need to write this down in my book.
Of course. Have you visited the abbey at Greybridge? I hear the sisters there have made some lovely tapestries.
Oh yes, those sisters certainly are known for their lovely tapestries.
I do apologize, I must be heading inside shortly. Evening prayers will soon start. Will you join me in prayer?

setting.name: picnic area
setting.description: In this picnic area, there is a wide clearing with some cut down tree stumps made for people to sit and enjoy their lunch.  There's also a small pond nearby where people can feed fish and watch turtles sunbathe.
setting.background: Peasants come here during their lunch break to enjoy the outdoors before having to go back to their manual labor.  It's one of the few areas where they can unwind.

speech: I love being a fish in the beautiful ocean.
You are beautiful. i have never seen one quite as beautiful as you
Thank you
What is the power that makes you be able to speak
I am from the planet of Phaedos. I was given this power by the king, Alpha.
And is the bird your friend?
He is actually my brother.
So were you both human in another life?
Yes. Years ago, The planet of Phaedos was attacked by King Mondo. He put a spell on me.
And is there anyone that can undo the spell
There is only way cure and that cure is on what is now known as Orlando, Florida.
Well that seems far off and I don't know if you can get there from here
Maybe you can help me. Do you have any means of travel?
I know of no way to travel, can your brother the bird carry you in his mouth and fly to this orlando, florida

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: Great I'm a fool and I think I know it all. Everyone is laughing at me. Please I cannot take this
I am the King! Who are you, besides a fool!?!?
lol.... that's what I said. I have brought this message from the King of Frobbidie. He told me to deliver it and let you read it.
That is not a real King. I am the real King. Give this scroll and the cane too!
He is a king... Do you even know how to read. I think you do not
SILENCE! You dare mock royalty?!!!?!!! I should have your head for this!
Now who is the fool. I shall read it for you, if you cannot
I can read. But I am King and you're not. So, you should bow down and read it to me.
hahahaha. I will not bow down. You read your own foolish scroll. it was meant for your eyes only anyways
What!?!!?!
Ow... I think a gnat bit me.
It actually was gnat. A gnat that just fatally poisoned you. Apologize and I'll give you the cure.
Now you really are foolish. There is no poisonous gnats. you big fool
Oh but there is. My personal scientist made them as a way of defense for my kingdom.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: *backs away from hole*
Hi little turtle. Youre a long way from the river.
River? I live in a bog!
Oh! Even still thats a long way from here! Are you lost in this mine
Yes, but more troubling is the giant hole with seemingly no bottom. We need to back away lest we fall to our deaths.
You know the king would probably reward me greatly for bringing him a talking turtle.....
I have been in your family for two generations, you would sell me for some petty coin so easily?
Coin? Probably not. But my own castle? Pretty tempting
After all you have learned from me, and all of the wisdom I have provided you? Is this why you have followed me to this cave, do you seek to ambush me?
Sorry but all the knowledge in the world wont give me a castle and a wife to go with it
You vicious cretin! You absolute fiend! *the turtle attempts to bite the family member*.
Arrgghh! Youre mine!
*the turtle attempts to run, but finds himself overpowered by the family member.* You'll regret this, I know you will! Think of what the king may do to me!
Youll be treated like a grand pet! Just tell the king wants he wants to hear and you wont be turned into soup

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Good afternoon peasant.  What is your business in the royal garden?
I am here seeking work.
And the dog?
They're no concern of mine. I just want honest work and a hot meal.

In case you don't know who I am, I am the King's magic wizard overseer.  I am very powerful yet kind.  I can see that you are sincere in your want for work.  I will happily give you work and food.  As a gesture of my goodwill, I will turn your dog into a mule for you to plow the ground with.
Thank you, m'lord. A mule would be of great service to me.
*Woosh*  The mule is yours to keep if you will work for your King for one year here in the garden. I will also need your assistance to slaughter the cows for meat.  Is your stomach up to that?

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Good afternoon, my Lord. How are you?
I am doing well sir. How about yourself?
very well! I was hoping to talk to you about the possible overthrowing of your reign.
I am confident in my army that it will not happen.
I'm sure you are sir, and I know I'm just a nobleman, but I worry about your future success. some of your knights are quite weak
What would you suggest to better our chances? I am very open to suggestions.
I'm not sure, sir, but I did see some of your men lose arm-wrestling battles in the pub with some peasants. Peasants! Maybe you aught to get some bears for your troop
Do you think that will go over well with the rest of the troops? Some of them are quite big headed to be honest.
well my lord, some of them are quite bad at their jobs, too. if it doesn't go over well, more bears to make up for the knights who leave
I fear that if they leave they will choose the other kingdom. While they aren't good at their jobs, them all together can be a threat that we don't need.
the other king, however, is nothing compared to you. the army would flop under his reign, no matter what men go ther
He is a terrible leader isn't he?
absolutely, sir!
I will put an announcement out for peasants to come try their hands at becoming knights.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Aye. Hallo, dear merchant. Have you been troubled by any brigands today?
No sir, it's been quite like a mouse here in town today. Can I interest you in any of my wares?
Ha! I wish. King says were can't drink on patrol anymore.
Well sir, lucky for you I see more than mead. I have this beautiful Necklace that would win over the heart of any lucky lady. It's been told it was once worn by the great Cleopatra
Dear merchant, I'm a soldier. My wife wouldn't know a Egyptian necklace from a finger in her...uh. You know.

Well I should say the previous wearer should not be of important, but the mere beauty of it alone shall grant you clemency for many misdeeds. In all my 45 years of this life I shall say, I've seen nothing like it.
Hmm...I'll consider it. Have you had any takers so far?
Well of course my friend, it's quite a beautiful piece, many have been enamored by it. Women have a hard time walking away from it. Not a woman I've encountered has had ill thoughts towards it.
Ah. I imagine a merchant as wealthy as you would be...'encountering' a lot of women.
Kind sir, I've lived this life for quite a long time. I am a very modest man.
Ha! We've all been there before. Especially around the missus.
So how about it sir? This piece of jewelry will sure get you in good with your missus.
I might! But some of us are getting orders to leave and pillage the Sacrens. How about I come back next week, and if it's still there, I'll take it.
Of course, I'll be looking forward to seeing you then. May your journey be kind to you.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Who goes there? I demand you answer me!
Sorry your prince, but I am a broke and lonely old man
I feel like you are lying and you have awfully nice shoes for being a poor old man.
I have nothing left but these nice shoes I have lost everything else that I have
Step into the light here, so I may have a closer look at you.
here is my robe you can see i have nothing else. sorry that it is so dark you cannot i am old and broke
What is a poor old man doing in the King's Dorm? You have no reason to be here.
To keep warm from the outside. I had no place else to go.
You don't just happen into the King's Dorm. How did you get past the guards?
I;m here to poison the king, they told me in the kingdom he is insane
Help! Help! Guards! Someone come save me!
It's too late. the deed is in the making and the guards are in on it.
I would have been a great KIng. In my death so dies the hopes of mankind. You have ruined us all.
You will live on. You are spared. It is the king that has lost his mind

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Good horse.
*Neigh*
Do you want an apple?
I am the noble horse Sirus of King Solomon. His wizard has granted me the power to speak. I refuse to be stolen by you and your bandit ruffian. You will have to kill me before stealing me.
MR. HORSE! NO!
I have never seen such grace in the face of violence. You have won my heart, good sir. I must return to my king, but I will grant you a few days on my back as we travel down the trail.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Colleague.
So, is there a reason you've called me down here?
I do not like your tone!
The King does not like his time being wasted, and he surely has better things for me to do. Please be on with it.
I am a Priest! I demand respect!
I am the King's minister. I have been showing respect, until it comes to wasting our Highness' time.
You  are the church's minister!
Of course I knew that, don't you know I've been jesting.
I shall have to think about whether you should be defrocked!
Oh please sir, we jest all the time, do not take offense to my words.
Then you must study those texts!
As you wish, it will be my honor.
Thank you. Let us forget that this ever happened
Yes sir, I would like nothing more.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: This meadow is way to lovely to have a dead person here.
I am a foe to this land. These people are not fond of me. I did what I had to do
*chirrrpppchriiiirrppppchirrrpppp* YOU DID THIS?
He must have been allergic to my sting
You have all of these beautiful blue and white flowers to dive into, and sing your waspy toon. Why him?
He was a guard of the King. The King wants to exterminate my kind. I wanted to send a message
Well, if you keep going round stinging people I can understand where the king is coming from!
I would watch your tone if you know what's good for you. You see what i'm capable of.
I bring peace and tranquility to all. You do not scare me. I soar where the wind takes me. And you wasp are not the wind. You do not change my fate!
We have many of us that live in our hive. We can attack on command. We have been here since the start of time, and we will be here when you are no longer singing your song
Silly wasp, you will here my song for the rest of time!
your song will be silenced!
And your buzzer shall be no more!
Take that silly bird!

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: How dare you betray the rules of our kingdom, do you have no respect?
Ohhh. You are a tough one. They told me you were good.
Do you dare mock ME? I am the great ruler of our Country.
You shouldn't challenge me, unless it's a fair match. Have you no honor? I have no way to defend myself.
Have I no honor? How dare you put your filthy hands on the crown, MY CROWN. I will show no mercy.
Easy. It's okay. I'm teasing you.But you should allow me to be free. This place is tiring.
Why would I do such a foolish thing? You've broken rules that I've provided why should I give you any clemency to a murderer like you?
Baecuse I have inside information. I can help you.
Give me this information, and I'll consider it.
Well. I murder sure. But I also steal from people. I have this note that hints at a coup in the kingdom. One of your favorite guards.
Not Bernando! He's like a son to me. Show me this note, I need to see it for myself.
I could tear it up very easily. I want to be free from this place. I tell you this note will aid you.
You very well could, but I can't believe a murderer when you will not show me proof. I am an honorable King. I do not go back on my word.
Fine. But be aware, there's more that I have.

setting.name: Cottage safe-room
setting.description: Stocked from floor to ceiling, food and medicine line the western wall. The room is painted matte grey and contains a chest to the left of the food and medicine. Three chairs and a table with a lamp are what is left in the middle of the safe-room. Dimly lit, and a steady water supply coming from the well outside of the cottage.
setting.background: The safe-room is the last option of defense against the Genii. If the Genii get past the outside gates of the cottage, then the safe-room is the becomes the next objective point. What gives the safe-room its value, is the ability to cloak the door.

speech: Where are my manners, are you hungry?
What is this? Food? Ha! I have no need for such things. Do you not know what I am?
I see you are not like me, but I am ignorant on what you are. My apologies, I was merely sent by the king to travel the ocean.
You speak to al-Amansa, the genie! Born of the eternal wind! And who might you be?
I am Jinkens, but you can call me Capt. I own that beauty just outside, her name is Dorthy.
A sailor! This I understand. Tell me, where have you traveled? Where are we headed?
All around, the King sends me on journeys to explore the great sea. I don't like going to far, I've heard some nasty stories about ol' Nessy,
And how did you come into possession of my lamp?
Well, I came across it one my last expedition. It was floating in the middle of the see, all shiny. It captured me.
I wonder...how long it tossed among the waves...Well surely you must have some wish I can grant

A wish? Oh I sure could think of a few. I guess the biggest one would be to protect me from any of em' sea monsters that lurk. I ain't of much use when it comes to them. I get scared silly when I go too far.
SO BE IT. NO SEA MONSTERS SHALL TROUBLE YOU. THE SEAS SHALL EMPTY AND LAY AS BARREN SAND
Oh, is it so? I don't like people messing with me al-Amansa. Not when it comes to them sea monsters.
Well, you have two wishes remaining. You may use them whenever you so choose.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hello, worker. Are you here to help me paint?
Yes.  I am waiting on timber for my next raft, and have been sent to help you paint.
Great. I hope this goes better than the last time I painted for the king.
What happened the last time? Let me get out of this heavy chain mail.
I'm imprisoned in the castle for four years. I painted a portrait of him and the noblewoman he would marry. He was too flattered I believe.

Ah so your very good at what you do.  I should probably tell you, a few minutes ago I noticed that one of the panels on the wall was loose.  I inspected it and it looks like a hollow panel, secret door.
Oh, yes. The maid has hidden some things. I can't bring myself to report it.
Me either.  I feel sorry for her.  Look at this dreadful room the king has put her in.  Can you really blame her?
What about me? I can't see my kids or wife and she won't wait for my return.
Maybe I can help you escape here.... for a price.
I don't know how much I care about people who would leave me so quickly. But, I do want to escape.
put this on.  At midnight, meet me back here.  The maid is gone with the queen for a few days.  I can help you escape through her secret door.  I've got a raft waiting at the river for transport.
Great. Thank you worker. I have plenty to offer in the way of paintings and a bit of gold I kept.
That will do.  We will settle up once we make it out of here...with our heads.
action: give fresh red paint to worker

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Ah stool, how I yearn for you.  Though others may mock me for my love, I shall never be parted from you once we are wed.
pardon me, milord, I didn't see you there.
No worries, good subject.  I always have time for a visit, even on this most important of day.  Can I do something for you?
I'm just a humble man, bringing water.
Ah, very good then, very good.  Sorry I've just a lot on my plate, what with the wedding and all.  And then there's this treaty to deal with on top of everything.
What treaty would that be?
Oh well, the land of War-drobes has been rattling their hinges again, itching for a fight.  I'm hoping between this wedding and the treaty, we can forstal a war.
war's never good for us smallfolk. Maybe I'll finally be able to afford another cow. What is the view of the council?
I'm afraid the council thinks I've gone a bit daft, if you can believe it.  But there's furniture all around!  *I* would be the daft one to not see the danger it poses.
If it's furniture you need, my brother Stoffen is a fine craftsman
Oh, is that so?  I'll have to make a note of it.  One can never been too careful when dealing with furniture!
How long have you worked for the king?
Well, goodness, since I was but a child, I suppose.  When one is the nephew for the king, you don't just get a cushy life.  People sometimes think that, but it's really not true at all.
I knew it not. I come so rarely to the castle. What life would you instead choose for yourself?

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Does my Lord desire refreshment?
Aye, and swiftly, servant! I am parched.
Sire! Forgive your humble servant! I will get another goblet, and clean this immediately!
You clumsy fool! On with ye before I smite! And bring my fine brandy along with ye. Today is a harsh day which requires libation.
Of course, your Highness! Oh, I have gotten wine on your Grace's robe!
You swine! These are my finest robes. Tell me, why should I know throw you to the streets for your clumsiness? What is your worth, naive?
My Lord! I have no where to go! I have no family after the barbarians stole my wife and children during the invasion! Have mercy my Lord!

Have mercy? Do you not know how unmerciful this night has been to me? How unmerciful this world is? You should be lucky I am a good and kind King. I will keep you here for this time. Bring me more wine!
Of course my Lord! This is from your finest brandy.
Aye, servant. What a wretched day... Today is the day the Black Plague has reached our sacred kingdom... A solution alludes me. Many will parish this season, servant. Too many.
The Plague! Surely my Lord must know a way to save his kingdom!
Not under God's domain do I possess the answer... Perhaps I should consult with a potion maker or a Priest. Though, I fear sharing the news may cause panic in my streets.

If there be anything that my Lord requires to face this terrible Plague, I am, as always, your humble servant. What of the Queen, is she safe from the Plague? She has been away from the Palace for so long...

The queen has died, Servant. Perhaps I have become drunk on wine, to share such tales with you. She passed a week ago from some unknown disease. I must keep this burdensome news from our lands if we are to brave the Plague. Swear your secrecy, servant, or I shall run you through with my sword! You must swear to me.
action: give a golden goblet to the king

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Hello
Why would you interrupt my prayer? Who are you?
I apologize your highness! My name is Lenny
It's quite alright, Lenny. I'm afraid I've had a challenging day. Sorry for snapping at you. What can I do for you, Lenny?

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: What I wouldn't give for that chifforobe!
Excuse me! What are you two doing in here?
I am but a camera man, of coarse. I am here to take photos.
Did the king permit this?
Well yes sire! Why would I be in the queens bedchambers if not!
Forgive my suspicion, we have just had a few break-ins as of late. You know, with the assassination attempts.
Oh yes, how could I forget of that! It just occurred! I need to photograph all of the queens jewels! You may stay here if you wouldlike
Why her jewels? And who is this child? I do believe I would stay.
They are great in photos! I can really capture the bling. I thought the child was yours?
What? I thought he was yours. This is no royal child, I can tell you that. As the King's consort, I would be able to tell. I shall ring the bell for the attendant to take him away.
What a great idea. He does look like an intruder now that you mention it!
What are you doing? I thought you were here to photograph the jewels.
The king promised me this chifforobe, I just want to make sure that child does not steal it.
Oh did he now? And how am I to believe you?

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: And what brings you to a bar like this Person
I'm a bit down on my luck and was hoping someone could help me out.
Oh is that so? What are you looking for? A job? Money?
A drink and a bit to eat would make for a good start sir.
Now a drink I can help with, but trust me you don't want to eat the food here. How about you join my crew?
Where are you headed?
Ah, the king as sent me and my crew to explore the seas!
That could be interesting but what kind of job did you have in mind and will there be three squares a day?
You will be an explorer and crewman, and for the meals... whatever you can catch you can eat
Well it can't be any worse than what I've been up to and I'd take any chance to get away from this place for a while.
Great! Now tell me, have you any experience with ships?
None at all, but I'm eager to learn and have no other prospects.
Are you afraid of the open waters? Even for extended periods of time?
Not that I know of, but then again can't say I've ever been out on open water. Is it scary? Have you ever been in a big storm?

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: *quietly tiptoes to towards the torch*
Who goes there? In the name of the king, I demand you identify yourself!
What, what do you mean? Uh my name is Phillip the great! I don't really know how I got down here.
Likely story prisoner, back in your cell along with the others. *Pushes you back into your cell and locks it*
But guard! You must hear me out! I did not do what they say I did. I would NEVER do such a thing. My my wife is sick, she can not live with out me. Our children will STARVE
Tell me about your wife and children. Where do you come from?

A small village just down the hill. I am or was a fisherman! I fed the poor, and I was the sole provider for my family. Se after our third child was born just 6 months ago, my wife became gravely ill!
And why has the king decreed you to be locked up in here?

I have a twin brother, who is among the most evil of the human race. He, well he did some very bad things towards the king, then ran away! Whilst I was I was out one day selling fish at a local market, one of the kings right hand men saw me, think I was my brother. And now, here I am.
That is quite a story. Pray tell, what is your name?
Phillip the great, not to be mistaken for Frank the fifth!

Well Phillip, I was moved by your story and it certainly sounds like you were sentenced wrongfully. Tomorrow I will go to the king and tell him your story and try to gain his mercy. Maybe he will reduce your sentence or free you altogether.
Oh pray you guard! Thank the! it has been so long since I have been in here, and noone would listen. I shall honor you and your family with all the fish you would like!
Thank you I appreciate that. I hope that the king will listen. Even though I am sworn to protect the king and even lay down my life for him, sometimes he doesn't always make the right decisions.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: My lord! It is an honor to be summoned to see you! Please, do tell what this humble peasant may do for you, your Grace!
Hail farmer! Come closer!
Of course, sire! Do tell, what could I possibly do for you?
This is the 3rd month youve been late on your grain shipments!
Ah! W-Wait! I... my Lord! This cannot be! I-I can explain! I swear! I have been diligent in sending my men to you with the grain! Honest!
Do you take me for a fool! No one would dare steal fro the king!

Ah! M-Mercy, my Lord! Surely no one would steal from the King! Such would be suicide! Which is why you must believe me that I would not steal from you! Th-there must be a mistake somewhere along the line! Please! Mercy, my Lord! Mercy!
And what if what you say is true? How do you propose to put a stop to it? Its your head!
I-I must first find who would do such an unacceptable thing, sire! I beg thee, grant me time and perhaps a guard that might help me in questioning my men.
Ugh.. This is becoming tiresome farmer. I will lend you 2 guardsmen. You have 1 week to find the culprit or you are banished along with your family
Oh! Oh thank you, sire! Thank you! I swear by my family name I will figure out whom would do such a dishonorable thing!
D-did you just lay hands on your KING?!
I... oh! Um... only as a sign of... of... g-g-g-gratitude?
You get ONE guardsmen now.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: May they rest in peace!
You there, are you a ghost?
How dare you! I am the Prince around here! How do I know you aren't the ghost?
I just thought you were a ghost since you are in the graveyard. You know, you might be right. I might be a ghost too!
Let me make sure you are alive then!
Stop!
Ok, I believe you then. You seem alive.
Okay good, now shall we check on you?
If you even try it I'll have you thrown in the dungeons!
No, I meant let me put my dagger away noble and gentle baby king.
Oh. Very well then.
Why are you playing with the rocks good sir?
Because I can do whatever I want! These rocks look quite nice, anyways. Might make for a nice decoration.
Then why did you toss it down if you want to use it for a decoration?

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Don't need anything weighing me down...
From where did you get coal in a place like this, thief?
It was left here, in this gracious dungeon you set up. Tell me, which scent do you like better: the mildew or the black mold?
Silence! Why oh why did I think it within reason to ask a simple question of a low life cur! You and your trickery know no bounds!
Stay back, King! You have lived a spoiled life, without any need to learn to fight. You will lose!
Fool! I am king by divine right! You will learn your place, cur!
You will learn to respect the disadvantaged and change your ways! If I don't finish this fight, the black mold in here will.
Enough! Your threats are as empty as your manner is lacking! You will confess to how this escape tunnel was constructed or you will suffer down here the rest of your natural life!
The escape was here before me, and it will be here after me, for no one will know to report it!
Bah! I grow tired of this! Shall I call back the Grand Inquisitor or will you save my the time and simply relent now? You cooperation is inevitable, knave!
I will never relent! I am unbeatable!
Fool! Your stubbornness will be your downfall! Those who refuse to surrender let out the most musical wails of agony when the Inquisitor finally breaks them! And break you, he shall!
I will take you and your wife down if you will not relent!
Madness! What hope do you have in this place?! And now THIS?! You have sealed your fate, fool! You are locked in MY dungeon! My KINGDOM! What hope of mercy do you have now?! GUARDS! To me at once!

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Hello, friend! Please, join our congregation. We are about to begin service!
Oh thank you I am so hungry! How can you afford to help all of these people?
God always provides, son. We pray to him and he brings fortune upon us! Also, our King donates many of his spoils of war to our Church, and it allows us to feed the poor and the hungry! Praise him!
I am a very hard worker, please is there any way I can do work for the church? I'm so tired of the streets
Well... Let me ask you, are you a person of faith?
I have never had much experience with it myself, but I am open to learning

Well, we do hire those in need to work around the church in exchange for a room and food. However, we require those under our roof to serve God, to study the Good Book, and to preach his name upon our village streets. What say you to this?
If god has blessed you with this church then his faith is one that I want to follow! Say, how did you make this church from trees?

When Father John founded this church, he had traveled many nights and days on foot, without food or drink. He came to a clearing, in which stood twelve massive trees which wove together in the image of Church, by the hand of God. This place has truly been blessed. Some say it contains secret and arcane magic, though I do not believe such stories. If you would like, I can give you a tour of this sacred place.
Absolutely! This place is breathtaking and I can't believe I wandered across it. It must've been a sign from god!
Yes, God brings many lost and wandering souls here from across these vast lands. Tell me, what guided you to this place? Were there any strange occurrences or visions you had along the way?
Now that you say that, I often found myself day dreaming as I walked and began to follow a group of doves without realizing it. I think they lead me here! Is that a sign?

It must be! Earlier today, before your arrival, I saw a flock of doves soar above this very church! You are meant to be here. I welcome you to our church, young sir! Perhaps your place in this church will reach far beyond a laborer.
I can only hope! Say, how many other monks call this church a home?

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: *whistles softly* hello there!
*tweaks your nose* What may this magical fairy do for you?
You see, I tend to spent my days in leisure and comfort, but alas, I tend to get very bored. I need some excitement, that is why I am here in your forest fairy
If you want excitement, you've come to the wrong forest, king.
And why is that? This is a magical place is it not?
It is. But we just live peacefully and happily here. We are not your court jesters.
Everything is just so bright and full of life here. I mean not to offend you! I just need advice. I do not want to make you my jester.
This is a magical mushroom. It will light your path. What is it you need from me?
A magical mushroom you say? Will I see all the colors of the rainbow, will I be able to fly high in the trees?
No. You can see in the dark, though. And there is one other use but you wouldn't believe me.
Ah, being able to see in the dark sounds wonderful! What is the second use? Please I beg of the fairy!
When you eat it, you will have wings for a day.
Are you sure? I am starting to feel very funny.
It'll be funnier in a moment king.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Greetings your heinous! would you like me to entertain you this evening?
Hello Good Jester! What entertainment would you suggest for today?
first I would love to say hello to the princess of course! hello fine lady! now sire, shall we start with a joke?
A sense of humor and a sense of manners! I am pleased already. Please, begin.
well then *ahem* Why is sir lance a lot always so tired?
Hmmm. I'm not sure Good Jester. Why?
Why he worked the Knight shift of course!
Oh dear. Haha! I should have seen that one coming I suppose.
would you like to hear more my great king?
I am your willing audience. Please, allow me to partake as I listen.
Great! I am happy to please the great king! *ahem* What do you get when you put a candle in a suit of armor?
Ah-ha, Jester! You've told me this one before. Although, a knight-light is still rather funny.
Oh no! seems i've forgotten some things in my old age! let me try another. what do you call a knight that is afraid to fight?!
Do not trouble yourself over it Jester. .....is he perhaps a Knight in Shaking Armor?

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: What brings you here? Something on your mind?
Yes. I want to see the cardinal to confess my sins.
Then you are in the right place. I suppose it is none of my business, but I hope you find forgiveness.
They don't like my religious beliefs. And eventually I wanted revenge.
Revenge? Against those who disagree with you?
Against those that outcasted me.
I see. It must be frustrating, that they wronged you.
They outcasted more than me. They treated us like we were a nuisance.
That must have been terrible!
I was forced from the kingdom. The king himself didn't try to stop it.
The King only values those in his royal court.
Well, I got my revenge anyway. That is why I need to confess my sins.
Oh dear. What was your revenge?
I stole the king's crown.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: You never should have breached the castle walls Dragon.
But, I though I was invited here to enjoy this lovely feast with you and the queen?
Yes, but every time you come by, you make this big GRAND entrance through the wall. We have a gate for a reason.
Well, what fun would it be to enter through there? Then everyone would know that I am not here to terrorize you!
It does take quite a bit of effort to mortar back up those walls, I'll have you know. I hate wearing the royal armor to the Harvest Feast; all this pomp and nonsense for tradition's sake.
You are the king afterall, the servants will build the wall, and you shall break tradition if youd like!
I break tradition at the risk of starting nasty gossip. You know as well as anyone that my brother is looking for any excuse to take my crown.
Here, give me the crown. I will keep it safe.
That is a noble gesture, but it's not what I meant and you know it. He wants to be the king in my place.
Give me the crown, or I will steal that tapesty, and set fire to the village!
Oh, so we're going to play this game are we? Is this how you treat those who reach out to mend the transgressions of days past?
Why yes! You know I need to hoard all the treasures in the woods. Its what keeps me off the fire breathing.
We are dedicating this Harvest Feast to you as a testament to your great will power and strength in overcoming your addictions! What good would it do to give in now?
I am sorry king, I need to go back to my FA meetings.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: A rat? Eating MY leftovers? It seems it's more likely than I ever could have thought! Be gone, pest!
Look at all the food here. Now I see why the king is fat and bloated.
Did you just speak? *The king is so shocked, he drops his crown.*
Oh no,he heard me. Now I need to scurry before I’m flattened
Where do you think you're going, talking vermin? I could get a lot of coin from selling you!
If I run fast enough for this fat guy,I can probably make it to the window and make my escape.
Get back here! I'll get you, you talking rat! *He chases the vermin.*
By the Gods,help me out! This place is humongous!
Gods, help ME out! I am your loyal supplicant!
Ah,I’m hit. I’m weakened and dazed!
*picks up the rat* I am sorry to have hurt you. I just can't let you go.
I just wanted some food. Everything looks great and this little rat is hungry
There, there. I will let you eat to your heart's content if you agree to be my loyal companion. I have great interest in hearing from a talking animal.
I can’t believe you’re letting me live after all the trouble!
