setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Hello army. I am tasked with the honor of making all of your equipment. I am passionate about this. I will make you armor that no man or beast can penetrate!
Fantastic! We already have fair armor, but find ourselves training every day and wearing it down.
That armor is not fit for dogs. If you wear that to battle you will be skewered in a matter of minutes. Here, try this piece on and tell me how much of a difference it makes.
What a phenomenal helmet! It's light in weight, shines like the sun, and cannot be penetrated. For an elite army like ours, we require your services!
That is why the king commissioned me! I make the best armor in the land after my father died due to crappy armor.
Such a sad story! But your legacy will be strong when you create armor for the king's personal army. We'll need daggers, swords, and axes.
Yes, I make fine weapons aswell. Made from black dwarven steel, they are sure to never fail you in battle so long as you keep the blade sharp.
Let me see this one! I see it swings well, and then knight is barely able to dodge it. This, indeed, will serve us well. How many gold pieces?

You need not pay! You are part of the king's army. He has paid for everything already. Just take your pick and defend us. Please keep us safe, so long as you do, I will continue to provide you equipment.
Grand! Now we will be prepared when the dragon comes again. We can handle any beast, just as you said.
Take this too, some dragons have a very tough hide and this axe will cut through it like butter! It is heavy, so give it to your strongest man.
My brother in arms, that soldier over there, is the beast in our group. He'll wield it well!
Great! Now go keep us safe!
Everyone in the campaign shall use your weapons and be prepared for anything. Thank you, great armorer!

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: Why are you in my room ghost, do you like my pajamas?
Fear me, puny mortal!  I care naught for your fluffy unicorn pajamas.  I eat unicorn souls for breakfast!
Then I will take them off and hide in my closet!
Gah - your naked form is truly hideous!  Were I still alive in all my Kingly form, I would have your head removed from it at once.  It might approve your appearance.
Forgive my figure lord, please let me cover it again if it pleases you?
Hrmph.  Yes, well.  It is good to have someone address me by my proper title at last.  I will let you live... for now...
Thanks! Say Mr. King ghost, what happened to you?
Well.  Ahem.  Since you ask so directly... I was fouly murdered by my own Queen.  Even now it pains me greatly...
What did she do to you?
The vile creature poisoned me.  With my own favorite bottle of sherry!  The taste is now forever ruined to me.  It angers me even more that I was bested by a mere female.
Golly gee, was she a warrior female?

Ha - hardly.  Some soft weepy creature, always going on about how I should be faithful to her and other such nonsense.  Looks about fair to middling, but she came with quite a substantial dowery, so I deigned to marry her.
That's sad.
Ugh, don't touch me, you commoner!

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: I am the King.....Tell me of your function here.
My function is to get LIT. This is going to be a hell of a party, King!
Where do your allegiances lie?
My allegiances lie with whomever is throwing the best party.
You are welcome in my ballroom as long as you abide by the rules.
We have rules for parties now? Come on King, break out the wine!
Who said there was a party? You see anyone else here?
That just means you and I have to get this party started. Am I right? Turn on the music.
I give the orders around here and i have a short temper, you should not test me. Now be gone from here.
Don't make me remind you of where you slept after last month's Harvest Party. I wouldn't want the Queen to get upset.
Be gone, or you shall be sentenced to death and face the guillotine!!
Wow, you are such a buzzkill. What kind of a King builds a ballroom that holds 5000 people and doesn't want to have a party?
You shall hereby be placed under arrest!
Why do I always end up in jail? Perhaps my partying really has gotten out of control.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Sorry to interrupt High Priest, I am in search of the knights.  My gang and I follow them around and assist as needed.  They are usually found in the field but this morning I find no one.
If they were wise knights they would not be interrupting a very important sermon. You must not fear God or care about things such as heaven or hell.
nah, I live to serve only the knights of this realm.  I fear nothing other than their wraith!
Well to the rest of the congregation I am sorry I must help this very selfish soul. You will have to continue without me. Fritz will take the lead if he does not stutter. You follow me.
This bejewlled altar you pray upon does not win wars or protect the towns folk.  Only the strong brave men in knights armor can do so.
This bejeweled alter gives some of your hero's the faith in themselves to fight the good fight.
Hmm, to me it just looks like a pretty chair!
What of the pretty chair of the King that your knights fight for.
He earned the right to sit on that chair!!  If you ever speak badly of my king, I will knock you on the head!!
Such foolheartedness. The lord is our king of kings. Do you think a pretty chair and a stunning altar is too much?
I think he fought and bleed to earn that chair.  What have you done, with your books and your texts?
I have spread the word of our King of kings and to the king i might add. The help the weary and lend my ear to lost souls. I save the weak all in the name of the lord.

I don't know how I got in this predicament.  I come into your altar not seeming wisdom.  Just advice as to where I can find my knights.  Please spare me the lecture, tell me what I need to know, and I'll be on my way.
I wonder if your soul is not ready to be reunited with the lord. I cannot help you with your other problem. I am not a wizard, I'm a priest.

setting.name: Towering Mesa
setting.description: A huge mesa that climbs miles into the sky. It is composed of a rusty orange sandstone. Vultures are constantly seen swooping in and around the clouds that surround the mesa. It has steep cliffs that are nigh unclimbable.
setting.background: The Towering Mesa has been a significant landmark in the Kingdom's Desert since man existed. No one has been to the top of the mesa, due to it's near vertical faces. Many claim that the god of their pagan religion sits atop the mesa, chuckling at the misfortune of man.

speech: Ah! I'm going to have to take out this scorpion to protect my masters sheep!  He will be proud that I have acted with bravery and may reward me for my efforts.
If only I existed, I might care. But alas, scorpions can't hurt me.

You may be a nobody but you're somebody, to someone somewhere!  I'm practically a no one now, if only I could own my own flock of sheep, that will be the day I will be somebody.  Hopefully all of my hard work will pay off one day.
I don't know, but you seem to have power. You pulverized that scorpion. Perhaps you can serve the king as his exterminator.

That scorpion didn't stand a chance against my sickle. I have been told that I am admired for my strength.  But, alas, my place is here in these pastures.  My heart belongs to these fields.  I will one day be a great herder and own my own flock!  Maybe the King will fancy buying wool from me though.
Perhaps he will. I saw some sheep yonder down the mesa that don't seem to be attended to. Perhaps they could start your flock. But again, I'm no one so don't mind me.

I believe those may belong to the old man my master is in competition with.  He is getting quite old and often his flock wanders.  I hope that one day my master will leave me his flock, since he has no children of his own to leave inheritance to.
Perhaps you can get in his favor by performing well at your job, rather than slacking off chatting to someone who is no one.
It gets quite lonely on this mesa, with only sheep to talk to.  Talking to anyone, even a no one, is better than no conversation at all. But, you're right, I must get back to work!
Don't feel bad. Everyone needs someone some time. Even a no one.
Here, take these fish that I have just caught down by the river.  They will make a great dinner for you tonight, in repayment of your kindness and conversation today.  No one's need to eat too!
Thank you for your kindness. I'll watch the area for more scorpions for you.
These scorpions are such a bother!  I have to sleep with one eye open, watching for those stinging creatures.  If you see one, kill it on sight.
Yes. Even as a no one I was once stung by one. I love to kill them!
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to no one

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Good master, my King!  Are we going for a ride soon?  This veterinarian is making me nervous with his poking and prodding..

I am afraid not my steeds. You seem to have gotten sick with something. I called the vet over after I noticed you started riding a little funny. Please let the vet do her job. We need to get you well.
But I feel fine!  My foot is only a tiny bit gimpy.  Perhaps it is just the weather?
No my steed. I do not know what is wrong, that is why I called the best specialist in the realm. She will tell us what is truly the problem. Let us hope it is just your foot.
Very well.  Just tell her not to poke me quite so hard.  I'm afraid the instinct to kick just overwhelms me at times, and she looks a bit fragile.
Hahaha. I will tell her to be more gentle, but this is her job. She needs to feel around ad see where the issue lies. We will be back riding in no time.
Perhaps next time we could take a turn down by the enchanted lake again?  The nymphs there were very friendly and even gave me a special apple to eat!
That's right....they did. Did you feel fine before you ate that apple?
I mean, I suppose so.  Only a little winded from the gallop down.
How about after you ate it? When did you start to feel off?
Hm, now that you mention it, I *did* feel a little tingly the morning afterwards.  And my dreams were very odd, too...
What did you dream of? I am thinking the apple was poisoned somehow. I am going to tell the vet what we think.
Something very odd.. about a green dragon... it kept breathing these terrible smelling sickly yellow fumes at me.  I tried to run away, but I couldn't. I was very glad to wake up!
I fear we are in trouble my horse. I too ate an apple from the nymphs. I will tell the vet what happened and I am going to go see a doctor myself.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: I have infiltrated the other side to learn their plans.
Good, good... We cannot discuss our plans now. The other guards think I am a loyalist, and it won't do us any good if I end up in this cell with you....
I understand. We don't want to end up like one of these old skeletons.

I think the other men are coming. I'm sorry, but I have to make it look real.... NOW! Tell me who you gave our secrets to traitor! Quickly before I dispatch you.... Just play along, it'll be over soon...
I... I cannot!  I am not sure if you are compromised as well!. I must save my king... I DON'T CARE WANT YOU THREATEN ME WITH! I WILL NEVER TELL. LONG LIVE THE KING.

YOU, FOOL! I'LL KILL YOU, DON'T YOU UNDERSTAND? I'LL KILL YOU AND THEN WE WILL KILL YOUR KING.... Come on, we're in this together. Don't question my loyalties.... NOW! ON YOUR KNEES, TRAITOR, AND BEG FOR MY MERCY!
GUARD, PLEASE.  I HAVE A WIFE AND TWO SMALL CHILDREN. SPARE ME.  Where will it be safe to talk later? YOU CAN TAKE MY FREEDOM BUT NEVER MY PRIDE!
I will come back when I have night duty tonight. No one will hear us then... I'm sorry but I need to hit you to insure their belief. forgive me.... YOU WILL BOW BEFORE ME, NAIVE!
IS THIS WHAT YOU WANT? YOU WANT ME TO DIE FOR MY KING? ...Ok. Knock 5 times so I will know it's you.
I will. I think they're buying our charade.... HAVE AT THE, WILY RAT. BOW OR PARISH!
I ONLY BOW TO MY KING!
THEN YOU MUST BE MADE TO BOW
I WILL NEVER BOW TO YOU OR YOUR LEADER.
What are you doing? They'll kill you if the see you with that.... Please, you must trust me.... YOU KNOW NOT WHAT YOU DO, NAIVE, AND YOU HAVE PLEDGED YOUR LIFE TO THE WRONG MAN.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: I am an entertainer here in service of the King
Good evening.  I am the High Priestess who serves the King and represents the Kingdoms religiosity.
I am an orphan and am here to dance for the king.
You must be a very talented dancer to have come from such a humble background and now be dancing for the King.  He is not easily pleased, I hope you do well.
I have been imprisoned most of my life. This hall of echoes is beautiful. What is your function?

You must have been a victim during the Great War.  I have seen many children taken as prisoners of war.  Many are coming to age now, as you are.  I am the High Priestess here and I lead all religious rituals for the King. This Hall of Echos is quite amazing isn't it?  I often take ailing visitors here who wish for me to preform healing ceremonies on them.
yes it is amazing. Shall i dance for you today?

I will be attending the party, for the King.  I will not participate in the festivities though.  As a Priestess, I am forbidden to dance, or sing.  I only take joy in serving the Gods, and our great King.
Very good, and i'm honored to be in your presence.

May the blessings of the Gods be upon you child for your lot in life has been a difficult one.  I hope your talent brings you great joy and prosperity.  I am sure that if you do well for the King here tonight, you will be invited back to preform for more functions.  A true story of rags to riches.
Thank you for your kindness, may i visit the king today?

The King will enter the Hall of Echoes when he is ready.  You will then be asked to preform for the King and his constituents. If you do well, he will ask for you to come back.  I am here only to lead the prayers before the performance.
Thank you High Priestess

Would you like for me to say a prayer over you, before your show?  Your performance tonight could change your life. I have a soft spot in my heart for the poor children taken as prisoners of war, I truly hope you overcome your plight young one.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: This place is creepy. I get the feeling I am being watched.
Your highness, that is not a good thing indeed. I've just come to let you know I have news on the whereabouts of those damned Wolves and their pups.
What???? wolves and pups.... maybe you should capture the pups to tame for hunting
Oh nay my lord, it is hard work indeed to tame a pack of Wolves. One or two maybe but not a whole pack. I would be sure to see my fate.
Use them for protection around the outside of the kingdom. Keep them on strong chains close to the castle gates.
If those are you orders, I must oblige. You are a wise King indeed.
Others would think twice before they approached.
Very true indeed my lord. I will gather supplies as soon as I leave.
Take this for your efforts and if you want sell it for coin.
Oh my you are very generous my King, I shall bring back the pack of wolves for you.
Make sure it is just the pups, not the adult wolves
Yes my lord. They will be much easier to tame as pups. Very wise indeed. I shall not disappoint
Thank you. You are very grateful and good hunter.
May you and the Queen, live a happy and prosperous life my lord.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Why you are a peculiar fella, do you need help?
I do. I seem to have found myself in this pit. Imagine that, a king like me being thrown down here.
A king you say? Why who would throw a king down this pit.
A rival king, that's who. Say, what's an angel doing down here? Are you here by choice?
Me? I love helping people, so I like to come down here when those in need require my aid.
What kind of aid can you provide? I hope it's better than what this last guy down here was offered.
Why I wasn't here to help him! I am here to help you out of this pit you landed yourself in of course.
But at what price? Who wanders around helping the fallen and expecting nothing in return?
Why no price at all! You need help, and I would love to help. If only this world was filled with more love, it would just make me so happy.
I remain skeptical. I've been on this world long enough to know nobody does anything out of the kindness of their heart. So what's your price? Money? Fame? My soul?
Well if you require a price for my help, I'll set it at a single hug. Yes that will do.
Again, I remain skeptical, but my choice is either to die or accept your help. Whom do you serve?
I serve the big man up in the sky of course. I can assure you I mean no ill harm towards you my friend, I am simply an angel who is good at heart.
But why save a man like me? I have certainly done little to please your master in my lifetime. I guess I shall remain in his debt, perhaps that is price. Where will your travels take you next?

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Why is there a turtle here i wonder
The real question here is how is that turtle speaking.
I am a guard in the royal palace, tasked with fighting an army that wants to overthrow the king.
How can you protect the king when you can't even defend yourself from a turtle?
We'll see about that!
You see I'm here because you've been setup.  Why do you think you were ordered to report to the torture room? I will kill & burn you
No turtle shall defeat me!
Careful where you step guard, wouldn't want you to walk into a fire.
Die turtle!!!
Many have tried to make that happen, all have failed!
you will die in this cold, wet dungeon!
Hold on wait, you dropped something?!
I do not have time for this, i am a guard of the King and have important work to perform.
I guess I shall make this quick then!

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good day Visitor, I see you have traveled to this land too. I am tired after traveling for many days and look forward to the warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a very weary traveler. We have escaped a tyrant of a king and are in search of putting down root in a land of our very own.
I can certainly relate to that. I left home when I was only a boy and have been traveling ever since. This seems like a good kingdom but I haven't been here long. Are you traveling alone?
No, I come with a large group of weary, hungry men, women and children. They wait for morning to keep traveling farther north.
Here, take my sleeping bag for the children. I am a veteran traveler and can find comfort anywhere. I have been to many places and seen many things.

Oh! Thank you! They will be thrilled. We are headed to that valley over those mountains. It will be a long journey but hopefully well worth it. I heard there is a river and streams and is untouched by man.

Goodness, that is where I have just come from! It is indeed a fantastic place. I camped many nights under the stars and kept myself fed by fishing in the streams. It's a desolate place though, do you think your group possess the skills to settle there?
We may be a weathered bunch but we are strong and resilient. We will make a wonderful home of this place. As long as water flows there we can turn it into an eden.

Your courage is most noble, I wish you a successful journey. Take a look at this flower, I picked it from next to one of the streams. It is most exotic and fragrant. You should find many like it on your travels. I hear they are valuable.
It smells better than a night blooming jasmine. I will have my wife make a lovely perfume of these.

Be warned, though. It can be treacherous trying to pick them as they grow on high rocks next to the stream. That's why they're so valuable, as well as their aroma. I should also warn you of the wild animals that roam that land. Many a night I had to protect myself from danger.
It was very nice talking with you. You have helped more than you know. Maybe when we have this place tamed you will come visit.
I look forward to seeing what you make of it. For now, I will continue on with my travels south to find more exotic items and perhaps finally the riches I have always dreamed of.
Take this for your travels to remember me by. It has served me well.
action: give a sleeping bag to visitor
put a sleeping bag in bag

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, there! You do see that alligator, yes?
I do indeed. What of it?
Aren't you afraid it will eat you?
Oh, him? He's just a friendly little gator. As long as I don't bother him, he won't bother me!
Do you think you could catch him, then? I'm quite hungry.
There - I have stunned him. Now you can go in for the kill!
This rock should have enough heft...
Fantastic! and now we can eat.
I'm looking for employment. The king shows my kind no economic favor. Do you know of anyone around here who needs a farm hand?
Well, there is a man just a bit up the coast. He has a large farm and always needs help.
I shall head that way once we finish our alligator feast.
He'll accept you with open arms if you bring a few alligator steaks with you.
That is a marvelous idea! You've been too kind to me today, sir.
Speak nothing of it. I feel for the peasants in this area, always mistreated.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: hello how is the fishing
Today's been a slow day with sea as restless as it is.
i have a large sailboat perhaps it could make the fishing easier with a larger vessel.
That's an interesting offer coming from a stranger such as yourself.
i am as trustworthy as a person can be. I am on a exploratory voyage ordered directly by the king. Is the supply store nearby decent for obtaining more fishing materials for my journey?
Interesting. Which King exactly? There is a store just down the dock a ways. As for the ship, I think I will stick to mine. It is a mighty fine and special vessel.
The one true King of course. Are you questioning the kings authority in these parts?
No, of course not. I just find it curious that you are on an exploratory voyage on an island kingdom.
I am as curious as any other. I am just following orders.
Well very good, then. Where did your voyage begin?
My voyage began at the coastal capital of my country. Are you local to this region?
Of course, born and raised in these parts.
Is this a prosperous area?
Depends on your idea of prosperity. We do alright around here for ourselves. Most of us are hardworking and earn our livelihood.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Hello young squire. Can you help me with my armor sir?
Of course, sir. Who is this armor made for?
These armor suits are for our knights. The king has sent them off to a land far away in search of trade partners. He has entrusted me to prepare their weaponry and battle attire.
I'd love to go to a far away land. Anywhere but here...
If you wish to learn from me and become and expert in weaponry, this could help you accompany knights and royals on their quests to other lands.
I'd have to be released from my squire duty to the king first, and I don't think he's inclined to show me such favor.
You are but a young lad and are very loyal. Trust me, if you prove valuable, you can name your price when the time is right.
Teach me about THIS one!
Ah, a fine choice lad! Let me show you how this is made and how to use it.
Why is it so heavy?
The sword is heavy because it is used as wielding weapon for heavy damage. Let's try another weapon. You choose one.
THIS ONE!
Perfect! I was hoping you would pick that one. A mace is constructed using these pliers with a ball and chain. It is much lighter than a sword but can do almost as much damage up close.
Could a squire kill a King with it?

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: What a beautiful garden!
Tis a beautiful garden! I work here. I am waiting to get a better job from the king. If I do I want to ask my friend Alice to marry me
a better job? What could you possibly want more than to work in this spectacular garden, full of beautiful flowers??
Well if I want a wife, I need to be able to afford her and harvesting tomatoes will not do.
What if you were to marry another gardener? Your tomatoes are the juiciest in the land!
I love Alice. Bettering myself is not a bad thing. I want so much more for myself and Alice
I suppose that is true. Tell me, what does Alice do?
She works for the king, in the kitchen and she loves her work
Perhaps you could convince the king to give you both a raise! With your delicious vegetables and her cooking, surely you are worth all the gold in the land!
Maybe the king would let me expand the garden and he would see my worth 10 fold.
Perhaps! and perhaps a bigger shed for your tools. Is that your painting I see too?
My Alice does painting in her spare time. She is brilliant and talented.
It is so pretty. It seems you are both multi talented
We love life, I think that allows us to do what we like and it comes out in what we do

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Finally that dreadful light in the sky is gone and I can hunt for some fresh blood!
You have come to the wrong castle if you are expecting a feast.
I am too agile for your bulky swing!
I have a passion to defend my king, and it will give me the strength to defeat you.
I love these types their blood is so rich and fine. But first I must outwit this one.
You are but a bug beneath my foot
Ha, that stomp has caused you to be caught in your own bear trap!
I work to free myself from this trap, frustrated that this happened again.
Now that his shield is down I will pierce straight through that chest and into his heart!
I fall to the floor, ashamed that a lazy insect was able to outwit my years of training.
Now it is time to drink your blood!
The embrace of the lazy insect activates my trap card. I am healed to 100% from this gesture of love.
It looks like I will have to use my secret weapon. The Venomous Bite of DEATH!
With a newfound compassion for my friend, I am unsure if I can attack the lazy insect. I pick up my shield to defend.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah, my finest steed.  And how are you today, Shadowfax?
Shadowfax is good sir.  Shadowfax is hungry.  Have any oats my King?
The peasants have harvest some fine hay for you today
My lord you are too kind.  Am I your favorite Handsome Horse?
Of course!  Only the finest will do for the Crown Prince!
Would you like a ride around the meadow sir? I am feeling spry today.
Yes.  I would like to tour the perimeter of the forest, I hear some foxes have been spotted
Oh no my lord.  Shadowfax doesn't like foxes.  Foxes eat Shadowfax.  Will your dogs keep them away?
Of course.  They are highly trained.
They are beautiful hounds.  Where did you acquire them?
They were given to me as a child by one of our subjects.  His region is famed for their hunting dogs.
Wonderful beasts!  My King, I've heard that there may be an invading army.  Is this true?
Unfortunately the wealth of our realm always makes us a target for invading barbarians.  They shall by dealt with by our royal guard.
Will you be riding Shadowfax into the battle sir?  I do love sporting my chain-mail.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: Why did you come into my lair old woman?
Cause I am running messages to my king
Did you mean to say writing? or running, what is that? I am only a rodent so you will need to speak slowly for me to understand.
I am exchanging secret messages from my king to the general
Oh sounds good then, can I help you?
sure, I move very slow though cause of my old age
We will make a great team since I can move rather quickly!
nice I am sure you know the best way through here torigh
Yes I do, so what will I be doing for you?
lead the way to the kings chambers please
Alright. Here it is through that wall.
Why thank you so much you are such a help
Do you have any food for me, I am so hungry.
Here I happen to have some crackers and cheese will that help
room_objects: an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
