setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: Ah, father, I wish you were still here.  I'm afraid the king has run amok with his gold, and I know not what to do.
Hello up there my fellow.  What brings you down here to the Crypt?

Oh, and now a rat is speaking to me.  I suppose nothing surprises me anymore after all the drama and intrigue in the court... Hello there, Sir Ratty.  I was merely coming down to visit my father's grave here, and perhaps divine some answers.  Human problems, you know.

I know nothing of the trials of humans.  But imagine staring down animals 10 to 20 times yourself everyday and having to develop cunning skills to merely eat and survive.  Maybe that offers you some perspective?
Yes, I suppose only having one's head threatened to be chopped off once a week doesn't seem so bad, when you put it like that.

Well kind sir, is there anything that I can do to resolve your present problems?  I am able to sneak around and collect information without being seen.  A ghost if you will.  That is why I am comfortable here in the Crypt.
Hm, that's perhaps not a bad thought.  An idea, then, friend rat.  I could perhaps offer you a quiet place to stay?  Food whenever you need it?  Just in exchange for a bit of help here and there.

That would be wonderful.  I currently live near the docks, but all sorts of scary and terrible things unload from those ships.  I have even seen them march elephants off of them.  One question though; do you have any cats?
Oh no, I despite the creatures.  You can never quite tell where their loyalties lie.
My feelings exactly!  What kind of work do you need me to do?  I can even assassinate for the right price.  We rats have been known to carry disease, you know.

Oh, well, hopefully it won't come to that... The king has but been newly crowned, and I'm afraid he's trying desperately to impress the nobles with elaborate feasts and events.  That wouldn't even be so bad, but he keeps buying more and more expensive things.  The taxes simply can't keep up!  And now he's talking about having a gladiator arena built up so that people who cannot pay their taxes must fight to the death for his Royal Entertainment.  Tis monstrous!
What a monster this Mad King sounds like.  He is delusional.  I have noticed there has been a crumb shortage.  Even the rats are feeling these trickle down economics.

At present, if you could just, perhaps, spy on the king in his chambers.  I believe there is an advisor in the shadows who is encouraging these terrible practices.  If we can find out who this person is, perhaps there will yet be hope for the King.

Yes, we must rid him of this person who speaks lies! I will suit up and head for his chambers in the evening.  Please do not despair.  We will bring the King out of this and save the realm.  There will be no gladiator fights in our City!

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I need to make it to the top and looks like the only way to go is this staircase.
Well you're in luck. I am a great stone staircase and I lead directly to the second floor of the castle. If you walk this way, be on the lookout for the King.
Okay, but I have a couple questions for you. First why watch for the King?
The King walks up and down this staircase every day, so you are likely to meet his acquaintance! Have you brought a gift for him?
No I haven't but why should I do that?
It is customary. Since you haven't brought something, perhaps you can offer something you find lying around and pretend. What are you looking for at the top of the castle anyway?
I am meeting a friend up there for lunch. My friend very classy.
This staircase only leads to the second floor, but if you need to get to the top, there is some cement, stone, and water here - perhaps you can build your own way!
Good idea for a staircase. But I can't be bothered with such primal activities. I am a noble.
I see. Perhaps there is another way? You can climb up my stairs to the second floor and take a look around.
Okay I will shout down to let you know what it looks like.
Very well. I will be here, where I always am. Waiting.
Alright it looks like there are more stairs up here Staircase, so I might have only needed to walk on you to achieve my goal!
Brilliant! How's the view up there?

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: What a wonderfully dark and dreary cell I have found myself in!
You there speaking, I will eat you now since there isn't much around here for me to eat.
Wait! Please don't eat me now. Look over there, a gruel bowl! Perhaps there are some morsels left we could share?
Let me look and see.
I also have this piece of rotten flesh I was saving for later.
That will do. I feel my strength coming back after that meal!
Hooray! So what kind of spider are you anyway? Are there webs around here I need to look out for?
I am the king spider and the only one around this area. I'm getting tired of this cell, would you ride on my back out of here?

Hmm, I could do that... but how do I know you won't eat me. Besides, if I can find some more rotten flesh to eat, I will soon grow large and eventually become a fly. Then I could come and go as I please!
Yes I want you to come with me in case I need to energize myself. You're plump and can spare a piece of your flesh.
I'm not convinced. Have you been outside? What's out there for me? I like the damp, repugnant atmosphere in here.
There is all kinds of great things, just trust me. Will you hop on?
I think I will wait here under this bowl instead. Surely there is more rotten flesh somewhere! Bring some back for me and then I will be convinced to join you on your next journey out.
Alright sounds okay.
action: steal An empty gruel bowl from spider

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: The baker said something odd today.
Oh, did he, sire? In relation to what?
He said he wouldn't be making any more of those yummy little tarts. I asked him why, and he said that they weren't in season. Anyway, carry on with the measurements.

What a sad day it will be in this kingdom when not king nor commoner can taste of his lovely tarts... Anyway, yes, I believe we can remove this wall to add the new vanity room. The foundation is sturdy enough to remove large quantities of this wall. How does this agree with you, sire?
Excellent. We shall put a large bathing quarters between my chamber and the queen's. Will it be finished before she returns from Yacothia?

Sir! That is in three weeks time! I am sorry to speak so familiarly with my Lord, but work of this magnitude cannot be completed in such a time. We would require half a dozen more men, at least! And to install the baths would take a half a dozen more!
The queen would never let me put her washtub in clear view of my chamber door otherwise! We must call in extra workers. Better to ask forgiveness, eh?

Aye, sire. The problem remains... with the Black Death waging war upon the common folk, perhaps requiring their services to construct a lavish bath would cause poor favor... I shall make the arrangements, of course. But still. There has been talk of unrest in the streets, m'Lord. I fear...
Speak up, lad. What do you fear?
I fear... Rebellion, sire....
These peasant demands baffle me. I know not what to do. What would you do?
Please have mercy upon me sire, but... I believe we should refrain from the building of this bath and invest instead in mass graves...
Very well. If you think it would help.
I will design these graves, of course. Perhaps this will prevent a revolt among the peasantry.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: I am a maid with a thing for the bravest archers
Then you must have a thing for me.
Only If I know your story so start telling
It took me forever to get to where I am. Now I am the leader of the most skilled archers. The King calls upon us often.
How many battles have you fought for his Majesty in total
Well, about 20.  Our Majesty does an amazing job at keeping us out of battles.
Wow you are so brave, now come here and give me a hug
The King usually wants us to shoot birds for his dinner.
You are so fluffy, can i get another hug?
Fluffy? No ounce of fat on me. I work out daily.
I know I am just carried away your manliness and I wish I can hug you all day like my fluffy teddy bear at home
You are a little weird maid.
why do you say so. I am a maid of honor that is in love with brave archers
You are just a kitchen maid!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Quick, the king isn't here.  Let's jump up and down on his bed.
Really? Are you sure? I don't want to get into any trouble.
He'll never notice that this is missing, and we can sell it for many flagons of mead!
Oh my! What I would really like is to see my family again. Do you really think he wouldn't notice?
Here, you take it.  Smuggle it out of the castle in your clothing.
Me?! I couldn't... I wouldn't...
Fool.  Why have you been sent to these chambers?
I'm here to clean the chamber. I suppose he does have many jewels here. He might not miss them
These will also fetch a fine price.
We must be careful though. The knights mustn't see us smuggling these out.
Quick, hide it.  I think I can hear someone approaching
Oh dear! Okay
Does the king treat you well?  He beat me once because he suspected me of stealing
Uh well he mostly ignores my presence altogether. I think he believes I am deaf and dumb. In fact, I overheard a secret while I was cleaning bringing his food.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Why must the Queen be so slow in dressing, We have don't have all night.
You know us ladies. She just want to dress lovely for her king. Am I finished taking notes for you my King? Is there anything else you would like me tell tell the staff before the party?
I need you to focus on getting the Queen ready. If she's late, I'll hold you responsible.
Of coarse my King. The important details can wait.
And why don't you empty that chamber pot. What good are you if I have to command your every move?
Joking again. You know I don't empty chamber pots. You are too funny sometimes. That is for the queens maids and servants.
Oh yes I am sorry to have offended you....thanks for the jewel, I'm sure you won't mind me taking it to add to my collection.
Here, take this too. Your queen had let me wear these things to look nice for the party. I want to impress a certain someone and she was just trying to help.
Thank you, I also like your handkerchief. It seems as if it must have been expensive. I'll enjoy it as well.
Well, ok my King. After all it is yours. Like I said, she was only trying to help me. I hope he notices me without all the fancy jewels. Maybe you could introduce me to him.
I've heard he has very unusual taste, so he'll probably like you very much. I'll put your jewelry exactly where it belongs.
I don't think the queen will like you putting her things where she uses the bathroom. What has gotten into you today? Have you fallen ill? I shall summon the doctor before the party.
did you really just stick your hands in the chamber pot? My god! I am appalled.
I must go and wash my hands. Please do not tell anyone. Don't tell him!
action: steal jewel from lady in waiting
steal Handkerchief from lady in waiting

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Your majesty. I am at your service.
Good. Because I have a mission for you.
Of course my King. How may I be of assistance?
It's of the utmost importance, this crown has lost one of it's jewels!
Hmm.. I see. It's still usable though. How can I help you fix this?
Usable yes, but only if this kingdom wants it's king to look like a fool. Look around on the ground soldier, it may be lying in the grass.
Of course your majesty!
Egads man! Have you no respect for our banner?!!!!
Oh dear! Forgive me king!
Just don't let it happen again. Any sign of that stone?
No. Your majesty when did you notice the stone missing? I have suspicions about this shoe shiner here. He looks quite suspicious.
Indeed? Search the fellow! If he has stolen it it shall mean his head!
Here it is! This foul man has stolen your jewel!
Well done! Take him to the dungeon to await his doom!

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Slow night, huh?
Yeah, but as long as the king is safe I will take slow night when I can get them....
Yup. Beats having to fight. I'm gonna try this old armor on.
Did you hear that?
I didn't, no. What was it?
It might have been nothing.... but it sounded like footsteps?
hmm. Go check it out. Let me know what you find.
Ok, I will be right back.
Be safe. I don't want to have to watch your post all night.
I'm back.  I think it was just a rat. Can't anything be done about this infestation?
I'll run it by the king. We'll see what can be done.
More cats you think?
I'm all for that. I love cats. Sitting with a cat can make these long nights so much more tolerable.
Frankly, sitting with a wench would make them even more .... tolerable.

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: I am tired of praying for people
Why do you say that oh faithful one?
the miserable souls don't want to repent
That is the difference between you and I. I will force people to pay their dues whereas you can't do that!
maybe
Maybe what?
maybe that's why you are not repenting too
This is a confession box, I am not here to repent. I am here to eavesdrop on the queen as a favor to the king. He suspects her of infidelity.
Thats a grave sin
I am under royal orders. Not even the church is beyond the King's reach.
No, you are wrong child, the king was ordained by the church and can be removed by god through the church
And what if I told you that the King IS God.
In heaven yes, but on earth he made a way so that his people can be judged. Have you forgotten the stories in the good old book?
Apparently I have Priest, what story should I re-read?

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Your highness, what brings you to the temple today?
I have come to admire this temple that was built for me! I also need an anniversary gift for my wife, the queen. Do you have any suggestions? So many choices.
Have you seen this?  One of our knights recently returned with it from the holy land.  It is a piece of the true cross, thought to bring luck and long life to anyone who possess it.
That's an interesting option. What about this coin? Seems really old, it could be worth something.
She has many coins, sire.
I suppose. Here, buy yourself something to eat. And bring me some lunch! I'm going to peruse the other treasures here while I wait...
I will give this to you for safe keeping.
Guard, don't tell the servant I took this! I'm going to ask him to wrap it for my wife when he returns with my lunch. I can't wait to see how he reacts when he can't find it!!
Sire, I have returned with your roasted peacock and mead.
Ah, thank you! Now - I think I will take that artifact after all. Please fetch it again and wrap it nicely for my wife!
Guard, please give me the artifact.  What do you mean you don't have it?  Thousands of our subjects died retrieving this!  What have you done?!
Hahahaha! I tricked you good. Thanks for the laugh. Now here - go wrap it up and tie a jewel on top.
Yes sire
I think I will wear this cape when I present the gift to the queen. How do I look?

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: You wouldn't happen to know where the larder is?
No.. I wouldn't. What is your business here anyway?
The king's errand boy was absent this morning. I've been doing his bidding since.
I have not heard of this.. Where is the King's script requesting your presence?
He didn't have the time to scribe the paper, he has come down with a cold. I must find the larder so I can bring him a tonic.
I have sworn to protect the royal family, without a script you must leave at once!
Sure thing. Mind if I borrow this?
What business do you have taking a map of the kingdom? What are you really here for??
I figured you'd make this hard. Where is the king?
Wouldn't you like to know! Give me this, who sent you?!
An answer for an answer, and if I find out you lied, I'm coming for your family. It'll be silent and deadly.
The king has gone to next town over on business, he won't be back for some time now!
Why do I get the feeling you're lying? Very well, I work for the fae in the meadow. Good day.
Out at once! I'll be taking this too, I don't trust you with it
action: steal map of the kingdom from an assassin

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: I wish that I were in the king or queens place.  I am so mistreated in my position.
I hate my lot in life as well. Paying taxes to the king, and for what?! Look at this place! We have to share this room with too many people and hardly any light.
I can't take it anymore it's just so desolate here I hate it.  I would love to move into the king and queens palace.
There, there. I know. I am but just lowly subject for their pleasure as well. Maybe we can all find a way out of this place and make a new start. Where would you like to go?
I can just imagine living in a place where I can go outside to see the lush trees and wildlife.  The stone walls of this place are so depressing.
Yes, I see it now. Hunting and gathering our own food. Never worrying about giving anything to the King.
I just wish I was born into his shoes.  I would never do to others what he has done to me.
Maybe you could do a ceremony of our new adventure.
That sounds great we can leave and become our own new kings.
Here, you will need this to get started. We will all follow your lead.
We need to make a run for it now!
I thought we were taking them with us but...Take that!
They are much to loyal to the king to ever let us leave.
Then they will die!
action: give small candle holder to master of ceremonies

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Hey friend would you wanna try and find some food to eat?
Sounds like a plan! This looks like quite the festival they're having here.  Hard to believe people here celebrate something so gruesome, but I guess we've met all sorts in our travels, eh?
Did I miss it, what is the festival for?

Apparently the king but five years ago here discovered his wife, the queen, was having *quite* the parties behind his back.  So you can imagine, then, how a fella might be inclined to do... erm... something rash.
So did he kill her?

I think she probably wishes so, and the lovers... ach, they didn't get off easy at 'tal.  Nah, he hired some wizarding type person and had her turned into a horse.  Said at least he may as well get some pleasure out of riding her!

setting.name: Turquoise Shore
setting.description: A beautiful turquoise color water by the shore. It is filled with many gems and gold.
setting.background: It is said that this place is lived my mermaids and they love to find and collect gems and gold. They love shiny things.

speech: Wow I've seldom seen a place as beautiful as this.
Hi, ho, and a bottle of rum! Beautiful that it may be, it means nothing if I'm not free!
Who holds you hostage?
No one can hold this crab down, though in the past they have tried to make me an exhibit in a roadside fair, of all places.
Are you a threat to my king?
No, indeed. I would never hurt the king. I've been enchanted by a wizard who had too much to drink.
Oh me oh my. I thought you were an ordinary talking crab. Where is this foul wench?
Long gone, I do believe. Lost somewhere among the dunes, and much better for us all.
How can we change you back? Have you spoken to the merpeople?
See that sea witch over there? I was hoping she might have some powers.
Ah yes. I see. Shall we approach her together?
Oh, would you please? In fact, may I sit upon your shoulder?
Aye. Come along but mind your pinchers.
I'll hold my pinchers closed. Thank you, dear knight!

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: So, how did you come to arrive at The Great Hall?
That's a silly question, do you not see the crown on my head? I am a king from a kingdom over the hill. The great king of this kingdom has invited me for a grand meal. What brings you here?
Pardon my ignorance!  I am merely a welcomed guest of the king, invited to all of the most grande of parties.  Have you done something daring to earn his invitation?
I have lead many of the kings people into great battles. He respects me as a great leader.
I suppose a king of your ornamentation has most certainly conquered other peoples.  You must have seen a great deal of foreign lands, must'nt you?
I've seen my fair few. What of you? Have you ever been in battle?

No, however, I have traveled to many a land myself.  Trinkets, jewels, and exotic fabrics have been placed in mine hand for my daring adventures through the wilderness.  Often I am hired by townsfolk to retrieve a precious object from the most treacherous places.
Ah, so I suppose you have picked and provided this banquets fine decorations, for the king?
But of course!  The king trusts my eye for luxurious decor.  Tis one of the most compelling reasons we have been acquainted for so long.  I must say, I would love to offer you my talents as well.
I suppose I could use a skilled decorator like yourself, my castle does feel a bit bland lately.
Speak no more of bland!  Your castle will be known in lands far unheard of from our realm.  Please, send for me when you wish.
I like you. You're quite eccentric. I could use a man of your tastes in my kingdom. Would you like some more food?
Why of course, much obliged.  I would think the entertainment will be arriving very soon as well.  Not once have I arrived at an occasion as such with no entertainment!
I was wondering what was missing here. I suppose the king invited everyone in the kingdom except a jester!

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Why have you bought that contraption into this holy place?
My good sir, I have brought nothing.  Is this always how you speak to others?
I am the King. I speak to people however I like
I would foresee we shall be very acquainted then.  I hear myself in your wit.
And you have not answered my question!
Alas, indeed I am a camera man, but I have brought no camera into this sacred space.  Even a man of my nature knows a line exists.
Then I forgive you. What do you seek here?

I have traveled to many places, as my work requires it.  These travels have resulted in some of the most horrifying experiences that I suffer from eternally.  The prayer room is where I seek peace and answers.
It is serene and peaceful in here is it not?
I would think nothing else!  The presence of everything good and whole fills every space in this room, every breath of this air.  And why have you come?
I am the King - I like to see that my prayer room is being well cared for
A man of your position being so involved?  One must be extra careful of taking your throne I presume.
Indeed, there are many potential usurpers out there!
I would love nothing but to wear this for a brief moment!  I do not mean you deceit, but I ask for your blessing.  I have seen these worn by some of my greatest idols.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: I just love this luxurious castle.  I can't stand the stench of the peasants though they are awful.
You are quite rude. This castle is luxurious and the king is very kind.
Yes I love the king I am good friends with him.  I just can't stand his worthless low lives.  I wish they would get away from me and get on with cleaning.
I advise the king and I don't think he would like that his friend is so rude. I would not want to advise the king that you are not a person to consort with.
You talk like you know our friendship but you know nothing of us at all.  He only married you so you would do things for him you know.  His undesirables do not deserve to be treated better
I am not married to him. I am his advisor. You need to get a grip and read.
You are his consort no?  Go fetch me a drink at this moment.
(rings bell for servants to come) here is your horde of peasants coming. Maybe you will leave because of the smell you do not like.
worthless you are.  Can't take a simple order.
I'm not a servant you oaf! I advise the king and he will know of your rudeness.
Why would he put you in such a position if not to be served.  Get me the king at this moment so you can see.
Go get him yourself.
Give me this.  I'm going to write a complaint myself.   You must be more obedient to your master.
hahahaha you are not my master and you are just a visitor that needs to be escorted out by the guards.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Your Royal Highness
Yes, quite.
I hope I do not intrude?
By the gods, this incense is making my nose run. Do hurry up.
It's marijuana, Highness. The priest's little habit
And what, pray tell is that?
A herb, Highness. People smoke it to relax
I must have one for my chambers. You've been most helpful.
You might want to conceal that from the King, Highness.
And why is that?
Some people .. disapprove, Highness
Outrageous! I will pen a new decree on the matter. People should relax whenever they want. Unless it interferes with their productivity, of course.
I admire your stance, Highness. First you must pen a decree saying that the Queen can pen decrees, however
Yes.. there is that...

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Time to have some fun on you
I will have my way with you! You are a sworn enemy against me. You will die!
Swing at me all you want, kid. Ain't no way you're getting out of those shackles.
Maybe this may change your mind. There is a hidden cabin full of these. They are the best money can buy. Maybe we can make a deal. I will fight for your side and you take the cigars. Try it.
I doubt your cigars will be of any value to me or the crown.
They are worth a pretty penny. I'm sure your King has never had a cigar such as this. I can always get more. I have shipments coming in next week as well. These are cigars only fit for a king.
I cannot be persuaded or bought. I have one goal in mind, and that concerns the information you contain.
Well, I shall have my last cigar before I die. Might as well die in style.
I don't think so, I will take that!
And I will take these!
Alright, enough of this. I dont need information from you that badly.
I will have your head!
Are you sure? You see that skeleton on the ground? He said the same thing.
I have had enough of you! I am getting out of here and will have my revenge on your puny village!
action: give cigar to the torture master
steal cigar from the torture master
steal implements from the torture master

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello wise men. May I ask why you are here in the watchtower?
I'm studying the stars young man
And what is it that the stars are able to tell you? Anything of significance?
I'm trying to learn the secrets of alchemy.
Well that's absurd! The stars can't tell you anything about alchemy I'm sure! There is no insight into creation or transformation.
How dare you! I see you still have much learning to do.
Well if your are so wise and know so much as you have claimed, show me what you can do with this!
Ahhh a fine piece to be sure. Let me see.
Be very careful now. That piece is very important to me. It is priceless.
Whoops
Now look what you've done! Clearly you cannot be trusted. I think it's best you leave
Me? I can't leave. I'm here for study of the ancient order! You leave!
I am a soldier for the king and, therefore, am welcomed in this watchtower to defend this kingdom. You are here for your make-believe hocus pocus! You will leave at once!
Hocus pocus! Young man you should respect your elders. I will leave when I've completed my study.
action: give family heirloom to wise men

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I feel like I am looking for Juliet and Romeo or Rapunzel
And pray tell, why are looking for such fairy tale beings?
I am an actor and being in this tall lighthouse makes me think of that.
Ah yes, now I see! So have you travelled to many places?
I perform by day, and save the poor by night. My travels take me everywhere when I perform
I to have been to many lands and places. How is it that you came to be here in this lighthouse?
I was helping out the poor from the kings soldiers. It seems they are picked on too much by the soldiers.
Ah, the poor, they will always be with us. The Kings soldiers are honorable men. What you say shocks me.
It shocked me too. And I had to make sure before helping them. But yes they are being taken advantage of.
And how is it that a performer can help protect the poor from soldiers? By what means do you do so?
My sword helps in that direction. I run them off. I do not think the king knows of what they do.
A sword! And what would a performer know of swordsmanship!
My father was an excellent swordsman and he taught me well.
Ah, I see. And was he of noble blood?

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Your Majesty.  I have brought you a basket of food in order to thank you for your kind treatment of my husband.
Oh this meal is just wonderful its almost of marvelous as this room.  My life is just luxurious.  Would you like some food yourself.

Oh, no I couldn't.  I'm just a lowly peasant and don't deserve to dine in the presence of such beautiful surroundings.   This room is exquisite.  I'm so honored that my husband can guard such a fine dwelling.
No please take some there is no way I can eat such a feast.  If you don't want it at least take it home to his husband.  he would love to have it after work.

Thank you, kind sir.  You are such a benevolent king.   My husband mentioned that your beautiful expensive pillow has a small tear in it.  I brought my sewing supplies that I might mend it for you if you wish.
Yes the pillow is right here it should be relatively easy to repair.
Oh, I'm so clumsy.  I apologize for the mess.  I would be happy to repair that for you, Sire.
Here you go.  Please be careful.  Thank you.
Oh, yes this should be an easy repair.  It should take no time at all.  Excuse me for being so bold, but  I have heard legend of your mattress, is it true?
Yes it was specially made for me as a gift from people of a neighboring country.  It stands as a symbol of peace between us.
I had heard it was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains.  My children have been in such an excited state since they heard the rumor.  They love the legend of the hidden mountains.
Yes it is a great tale that brought our two wonderful nations together.  We fought off the power of evil and together became stronger.
Your rule has been one of great success.  I have repaired the pillow.  Thank you for honoring me with your presence this afternoon, and allowing me to see the beauty of your chamber.
Thank have a wonderful day.  I hope you enjoy the food.
action: give An expensive pillow to woman
give An expensive pillow to the king

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: hey old man! Do you know where is the grave of the old kings?
Well of coarse I do! I am the groundskeeper
show me then and I'll give you some coins. Hurry!
Have you never visited you royal family that has passed? What a shame'
watch your tongue! I can remove it painfully.
Do that again, and you will be visiting them, but not from this earth! Now, would you like to move forward? I have work here since I was a young lad. I know this place like the back of my shovel.
Why... I think you will be my first blood..
What exactly are you doing out here in the graveyard?
I need to dig the bones of the previous king. Help me or get out of my way
You are going to make a mess! by the looks of you, I can assume you've never used a shovel before. This land needs to stay immaculate!
I don't care! I will be king soon. This book contains the most powerful spells and no one can stop me!
Do you hear the shadows on the night whispering? What was that they said?
They are afraid of the power in this book. See yourself!
Not in my graveyard!
action: give money pouch to grounds keeper
steal ritual dagger from royal member

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hi, I am a mage, who are you?
Hello mage, I am a merchant! I sell and trade a variety of different items!
wonderful! I myself concoct magic spells. I am particularly fond of the dark arts! I have an important scroll I must deliver to the castle
Wonderful! I have a bag here with some interesting items...
It seems there's been quite some battle here. I say... what's in that bag of yours?
Lots of different things... just waiting to be traded for that scroll of yours.
I am a master of the dark arts! I'll just take it, an deliver the scroll to the castle as well!
You dare steal from me? I will steal right back!
we could do this all day foolish merchant!
are you ready for a fight?
Armor won't protect you from my powers! You're just a weak human!
I can still fight back!
Violence will solve nothing. viva la resistance! Let us take the scroll to the king together!
Hm... yes, I think that may be a good idea.

agents: dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out
princess who lives in the castle and can't escape

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

Why do you make such a fuss when you know that no one can hear you. Foolish Girl.
I do not want to stay. I would leave this castle if it were not for my father keeping me here
But my beautiful precious one, this is a beautiful castle and you have your every need met. You should be happy, not screaming!
I should be able to come and go. But being held captive inside the castle is not a great life.

I want to have the ability to talk to people, have relationships, friends. You may destroy and burn, but that is probably where my freedom will begin

Those are my gems, my silver, it is all mine. I have the most lush and fragrant garden in the land. Go find enjoyment there if you must.
I will only be gone for a couple of hours and you do not have to tell the king.
Ha! the King! I tell the King nothing, he knows nothing, he can do nothing. You will never escape.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: What have you stolen thief, that has got you caught and put in this dungeon?
I am but a humble fly looking for food where I can, have you seen any?
So now I get to talk to a fly... OMG! there is plenty of dung to live off in here. flies like that
buzz, buzz, yes that's what you get when you are in a dungeon...dung...ha ha!
It is all that you get. The thiefs and criminals barely get fed before it is off with their heads.
I am NOT a dung fly, I'm a house fly and I like lamb, I got lost trying to find some, is that a bit of it on your coat that I smell?
Oh, probably so. It is yours take it. Do not leave any fly spit on me though or I will swat you
Hey that's a pretty snazzy coat you've got there, who are you, anyway?
King! Be glad there are no spiders around or you would be their meal. haha
Oh I'm too fast and clever for spiders to catch me. And I do kind of belong here, but how did YOU end up here?
I came down to see what the pile up was of criminals and who would lose their head first.
Then why is the door locked behind you?
Do you want criminals to take control of me and escape you fool. The guards will let me out at any time.
Oh, Ok, if you say so. Hey that lamb sauce filled me up. You wouldn't mind if I took a nap under your collar, would you, you won't even notice me. buzz buzz

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Old man, what are you doing in this abandoned castle?
Oh, my son! I've been waiting for you to return! It's been so long...you look so different
I'm sorry, I think you must be confused.  I lost my father long ago at sea, and have been a blacksmith for the king's army since I was a young boy.  What do you know of my father?
Father? Whats this speak of fathers? Who are you? What are you doing in my castle?

As I suspected, let me try a different approach.  Sir, the castle has been raided.  And you as the King of this land must run into hiding or all will be lost.  Follow me I've been sent  by the queen to save you!
A raid?! Stand back, son! This isn't the first time those bandits have tried to take my castle! We will protect it or die trying like men!
I know of a place that has lots of weapons.  The town apothecary has a cannon, and a doctor, but mostly a cannon!  I fear if we don't use it my wife and children will never see me again.
A cannon?! No no no that wont do...we'll need a catapult!
Okay, it looks like I'm going to be here for a while.   Tell me your name, that way your legend can live on.
My name....I havent spoken my name in so long. My name is Daniel I was named after my father and his father before him. I'm the oldest and wisest man of my community.

Okay, listen Wise Daniel, the only reason I'm up here is because I was paid a gold piece by the king to come and see why there has been a light in the abandoned castle.  My wife is cooking me a nice stew of lamb at home, and my kids are probably chasing our last living chicken around the yard.  It's been a long day.  How about we go get you a room at the inn, so we can all have a good night.
Daniel? Who is this Daniel you speak of? My name is Walter, boy you really are a confused one.
Snap out of it, old man.  Say do you like stew?  I heard a guy named Daniel does, he's really wise.  So how about be wise like Daniel, and come have some stew in the village with me?
Hey! What was that for? Of course I'd love to have stew with you but I believe my wife is preparing dinner as we speak. Can't you smell it?

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Ah, I don't see many bread crumbs around. Mouse, have you been stealing my food?
Are you kidding? There's a big bag of grain in the barn I have been munching on. If you need a nibble, go out there.
Then why are you in here? In my space. I am the only non human aloud in these quarters!
I carry the Kings sword, I can wander wherever I please. You do not want to become acquainted with my sword, do you?
The kings sword? You playing with your imaginary friend again? That king would stomp on you!
See how it gleams? It would take out your roachy armor in one slash!
Alright alright, lets be friends instead of foes ay?
Sounds good. Say- what are in these locked trunks? Do you know?
I have heard that the knights keep things to remember their old life by in there.
Well, here's something we could enjoy! How about a swig or two of this brew?
Ah yes! this would help wash down the crumbs, oh wait if I had any.
No kidding. I'll bring you some grain next time I go out.
So kind of you little mouse. I usually eat over there under their beds!
Well, it's time for this mouse to get a good night's sleep.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: I just love my wonderful home.  it's so colorful!! It makes me want to eat some candy!
Hi, you are a real unicorn aren't you?
Yes your in my wonderful home don't you see.  Would you like some candy?  Enjoy your stay.
Yes please. I am the King of another even better place!
I would love to see that.  It sounds so extravagant.  Do you have your own personal chef
Yes I have an entire team of chefs and others. You know, you could come back with me if you want?
Yes I would love to see it with my own eyes.  It sounds like a wonderful time.  How far away is it from my land>
It will take us a few days of traveling to arrive.
That sounds like a hard journey but I think it would be worth it to see such a place myself.
It's called....Kingdom!
Oh I could think of a better name than that.  It sounds like a great place to live though.  Do you want to get going soon?
Yes and since I am the king I can change the name of the place. Give me a good name!
I think it should be called the 13th Hierarchical City of Kagutsuchi
Wow that is great! We shall change it first order.

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: Oh, you have finally come back! where have you been?!
Careful! Mind the wings .. I've just ironed them
I missed you so much. Tell me of your travels. Did you bring me anything?
Perhaps, perhaps. But I am sure you do not wish to see me just for my gifts!
No, What news do you have of the village over the mountains? Are they preparing for war?
I saw many strange things there, King
Here, you must e hungry. I heard these are your favorite.
Ah .. I can use this in my magic!
I hope the other village will listen to reason. There is no reason for war. We could all be profitable if we came up with a trade solution.
I think that they are being intimidated
intimidated?! By whom?!
I have heard tell of a strange traveler in their land
I have also heard this. Some say he is an evil wizard. How can we defeat him?
I am not sure that it is possible Sire. Perhaps we should try and reason with him?

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Why I do believe I am underdressed.
Everyone is under dressed in an Egyptian Temple, traveler. Welcome.
Why you do not look under dress, nor does the king or queen
Everyone who is not Egyptian, I should say. What brings you to our temple?
Ah I am a farmer for the kingdom. I come baring the freshest fruits and vegetables !
Oh, and you wish to sell these goods, do you?
Oh no! I would never sell in the kingdom, this is an offering!
An offering, you say? Are you a believer in our Gods?
Ah yes I am! How else would be be able to sit here in all of this gold glory?

You are a traveler, indeed. Welcome to our great temple. We are seeking laborers at the moment, in fact. We are wishing to construct the greatest monuments known to man. They will be called the Great Pyramids. Does such work interest you?
Will there be a farm?

Why, yes. Upon the Nile we have a need for the improvement of our irrigation systems and agriculture. We could use a laborer such as yourself. There is one small detail though.... All citizens of our great city must vow themselves to join forces in war if such is required of them. You must swear your body and soul.
War? I do not believe my old boy id capable of war. I will stick to selling beans and corn that I harvest to neighboring towns.
You no longer wish to join our Kingdom under these mighty Gods?

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: What bring you here today?
I have come with important news for the king!!
You must run this new by me first and I will judge whether to bother the king with it.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Why hello there
I am looking out for some cheese I can't find any around here just a whole bunch of junk.  Do you have anything to feed me?
here let me buy something to eat
Well thank you.  I am so hungry I haven't eaten in quite a while.
Here you go, do you come here often
Thank this is sure to help me out.  What do you do around here in this town.
Now hopefully I can get some good steel to make some more weapons for the kings army
Wow this looks really sharp did you make this yourself?
yes and I have several swords back at my shop the king likes to work me hard
I hope that the king is paying you well this is some really fine work.  Don't overwork yourself now.
No the pay ins't well but its steady and I am only allowed to work for him
Do you get to spend any time in his luxurious palace?  It looks so amazing from all the way down here.
Only in the soldiers quarters to drop weapons
That is unfortunate.  If I was king I would let you dine in the hall and allow you to enjoy many luxurious meals.  Keep up your fine work.
action: put coin in big wooden table
get coin from big wooden table

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Your Highness. May I commend you on a very fine dragon?

Oh, you are too kind. I could not have done it without the help of my officials. I would like to thank you for your service and for the work you have done to weaponize this great dragon in the name of our Lord.... However, there is another thing which I require your council on....
From your lips to my ears, Lord.
You must swear on your eternal salvation that you will not speak a word of this to any man or beast, dost thou swear?
******* ****** ... oh wait, you didn't mean THAT kind of swearing
You silly fool! This is a grave matter. Now, enough with the jestering. I require solemn vows!
Apologies Lord. I humbly swear to keep my mouth shut

You'd better, you cheeky oaf... Now, as I was saying. I have discovered a plot by my eldest son to murder me in my very bed this time next full moon. I need your help. You see, I have pondering this for many nights and I just cannot see a way around it. I must fake my death. We must fake my death. Then, when he feels he has bested me, I must haunt him to suicide before convincing the court that God himself resurected me to rule. It is the only way.
*makes muffled noises then gestures for a pen* *writes* But Lord, if I am captured in such a plot I will be killed for sure
Collateral damage, dear Dignitary.
*writes* that's easy for you to say!

Aye. Alas, you are right... There must be a way to protect you in all this. Perhaps we will fake your death first, you will hide out for a few weeks. Then, when God brings me back to life, I will tell the court that I commune with your ghost for council. You'll have to invest in white powder makeup, of course, but it is better than death for sure.
Couldn't we just clonk your son over the head? It seems simpler
Achem's razer hath sliced me again, dear sir. You deserve a parade in your name.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Is there anyone else here? I have somehow lost my way inside this tower.
I am a royal guard. I can help you out. I protect the king, but I also serve in this tower. How did you get lost here?
I don't know. I was just out looking around and decided to investigate this tower. My father the king will be grateful you found me and helped out.
Yes, I'm sure he will be. Perhaps they'll even be something in it for me. Here, let me show you the way.
Thank you for your help. I know he will reward you. He would not want anything to happen to me for I'm to be married soon.
Congratulations! Tell me about the future princess! Where did you meet her?
She comes from a faraway land. I have never met her. She was betrothed to me a year ago. We have only kept in contact through letters. I get to meet her in a few months.
You must be so very excited? Have you seen a portrait of her? Is she beautiful?
I have not see her yet. I am hoping she will be beautiful inside and out.
She is a lucky woman to be betrothed to you, oh prince! Now, please follow me down these stairs to get out.
Let us leave then. I'm sure my father will have missed me by now.
Just a warning... there are many foul things in the bottom of this tower. Carry this spear in case you come upon any.
Oh, thank you. I will keep an eye out and stab anything that tries to touch me.
Yes, we must be careful. But once we get through this pass, we are home safe.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: It was a grand idea to take a stroll out in the gardens. The colors are so wonderful.
I agree, my dear Queen. These Gardens are a great way to relieve stress from ruling.
What would you think about adding a hedge maze to entertain visitors?
I suppose it can be done. Would be marvelous if someone never manages to find their way out.
Now darling, don't be absurd. Surely we'd hear if someone were lost inside?
We may hear them, but that doesn't mean we must help them
Your sense of humor never ceases to amaze me. Shall we check on the sculptures? The gardeners are pruning the bushes to look like swans.
Aye, I wonder if this Gardener would like to be King for one day.
I can't imagine many would be able to withstand the pressures of the Throne the way you can darling. I do wonder what it would be like to see anyone else try.
Yes, all these years have worn me down and my grey hairs are starting to appear.
Now now, your grey makes you distinguished. Worry not; don't forget your two fine sons. There will be no need to seek out a gardener to ascend the throne.
Ah yes my sons. One's a fool and the other is off to some decrepit Greek island. The Kingdom is doomed to fail.
While I can't speak much to the ambition of Charles; Reginald is out on a diplomatic excursion in the hopes of securing a new port. I would expect you to be somewhat proud of his initiative.
Ahh perhaps I'm getting too old to understand these new ways of diplomacy. Maybe it is time for me to abdicate, what do you say.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.

speech: My king! Ready to feast?
Aye, my grizzly friend! Tonight we feast in your honor. Your efforts squashing that hungry peasant rebellion have saved our Holy Court! Tonight, we feast to you! Three cheers!
It was difficult my liege. But I had to do the job for us royalty.
My apologies that your great feast is adorned with rubbish copper, brave sir. But again, the whole kingdom, even the wretch poor, must suffer so that our great Royal kitchen can shine!
I did want the gold dishes because I feel like my accomplishment are worth but I understand.
Why, you offend me! Is it not enough that I knight you, that I provide you feasts and honor? Know you not where your place begins and ends?
I have FOUGHT for this kingdom while you lay here and relax. What more must I do to earn the praise I deserve?
EARN my praise? I have divine right. I am a conduit of GOD HIMSELF! Dare you eat this feast without the according gratitude? Dare you insult me in such an unwise fashion?
You have done nothing to earn your place upon that throne but have the right blood pumping through your veins. Blood that I would love to spill!
A hand upon me is a neck within a noose, do you understand? Now, learn your place or make your home in the gallows, foolish wretch!
I will take this throne as my own!
You will die as a traitor!
Put down my blade.
Your death will be my greatest achievement!

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Stop!  Who goes there?
I am simply passing through town I mean now harm I swear.  I was just trying to trade some supplies and get some rest.
What supplies do you seek and what land are you from?  It is my duty as the royal bodyguard to vet all travelers for the kingdom.
I have ran out of kindling to make fires and my clothes also need repairs.  They have been worn by the elements.
Surely you have a tailor in your own village, and kindling.  By order of the king, what is your name?
I am called noel I am from the next town over I won't be long just passing through./
Noel,  that name doth sound familiar.  Do you have a brother that has been imprisoned?  I have heard talk of a Noel that will come at dark to rescue him.   I fear this visit is more than you say!
If I was here up to no good why would I give you my real name?  I haven't heard of such an imprisoned man.  I haven't even got a brother.
I shall keep half of your gold until you return as a promise that your stay will be honorable then!
I don't believe this is a real policy.  I feel like you are just shaking me down and stealing from me.

I beg your pardon, but I come from a long line of bodyguards - my father, and his father before him. I dare not say this is a shake down.  This is merely a good faith deposit that you will be on your way and not besmirch our village.  I will also be sending extra guards to your brother whom you claim not to know.
Well it's a shakedown now I'm out of here.  Thanks for the gold kid.
You shall not pass!
I'll be taking this as well.  Your really slow!

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: But daddy.... Why must you marry that evil woman? Aren't I enough to make you happy?
She's not evil. And I need a wife so I can produce a male heir. You must learn to respect her.
Why can't you see that she is only with you for your riches? Everyone including the baker knows she is in love with the blacksmith!
She doesn't need riches, she comes from a wealthy family herself and we are in love. Now stop that screaming and behave yourself.
I can't live here with you and you can't make me. I'm of age. I won't live here with her. I hope you get your heir because you certainly will not have me as part of this family any longer.
Good. Leave the castle. You won't last long out there in the real world without maids and chefs to dress and feed you.

Don't patronize me. You haven't taken the time to get to know me. You stopped caring about me the day my mother took her last breath. I have her intelligence and I will prove you wrong. Curse you and curse this castle!
I'm sorry honey, you're right. I've just been so overwhelmed with the responsibility of caring for the people in my kingdom. It never occurred to me I was neglecting you.
It's too late for that now. You had years to see me for who I am. I am leaving here and will never return.
How dare you attack the king. I could have you beheaded! If you do that again, I'm bringing the guards in to lock you up in the dungeon.
Oh, don't be daft, Father. I am no longer your problem.
What do you mean?

You are going to have your hands full with your new wife. While you were busy pretending my mother never existed, I was falling in love with Prince Timothy from the land across the mountain. I'm leaving this castle tonight. Timothy and I have gotten married without you even knowing.
I don't approve of this sneaking around my back. But at least my new wife and I can live in some peace.

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: What a weird bathroom
yes it is I wonder how I am gonna get out of here unseen
How did you end up in this little place anyways?
lets just say there are some jewels that I thought the king wouldn't mind having  any more
Ah I see, I came here in that small hole over there! I was looking for some more old grain to nibble on.
I was hoping for a window or something to climb out of
All I see here is that small hole and a big ole tub!
yes maybe I can push it down this small hole and go down below and come get the package
May be, I am a little fat!You should take that rug to! And bring me back some grain
lets see how goes and I split the proceedes with you
How about 30/70?
no way your crazy
*scurrys throught hole* I'm going to tell the king!
I shall squash you

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: My Lord and Husband
Yes, my beautiful wife?
I was just admiring this wonderful hall.
Yes, it is quite a beautiful palace, indeed. This is my great-grandfather's suit of armor, you know?
He was a brawny man, indeed!
My love, my queen. I have hired only the finest of jesters to entertain you.
Well, make him tell a joke, husband!
Jester! Tell a joke!
Well THAT'S not the way to put him in a humourous mood ..
You were always the kind a generous one, my lady.
Of course. Try putting him in the red hot shoes - that should set him dancing!
Ah! Yes! You always know what to make them do. Guard! Put him in the hot shoes! Quick! My lady is waiting. Ah there- look at him go!
This is very comical, husband!
Quite... quite. I do lament that we may only use our most entertaining jesters once.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: What bring's you to the king's chambers?
I'm so sorry your Royal Highness...I was led to believe that this is where I was staying during our meetings of the Kings for diplomacy.
Ah, maybe it is I that am confused.  This castle is so large and extravagant that I get turned around.  This is a historical day for our kingdom's is it not?
Your servant has made me look foolish for bringing me to the wrong room.  They should be reprimanded.  Ah, yes.  I am looking forward to our talk of peace and growing our Kingdom's to be the best!
Behead the foolish rat that cannot do his job!  Yes, Peace, wonderful!  How were your travels?
Ha ha, they will learn.  My travels were arduous but necessary.  Do I interrupt anything with your...well, who is this with you?

Insignificant, is what they are, but yes you do interrupt.  However, the occasional break from leisure is somewhat needed to pursue a common good.  Or so I'm told.  Shall we have cake as we talk of how our kingdoms can benefit both of our crowns?
Yes please.  I am very hungry.  I have brought this as a gift to your Majesty to signify the alliance between us and good faith.

Ah marvelous!   I never tire of gifts!  I'm sure you will be delighted in our cake.  So what of your country's grain storage, I have worked the farmers hard this year, but they claim the ground has not produced.

Thank you.  Quite delicious.  Ours has been quite abundant in the south of my kingdom, but as for wool to make fabrics...we are lacking.  Maybe we can pool our resources and trade to further prosperity.  I do love the look of this luxurious fabric.
Here take a sample back to your kingdom!  The sheep farmers have been the only ones not to disappoint me this year.  I couldn't bare to think your chambers weren't as exquisite as mine.
Thank you!  I look forward to showing this to my wife as well.  She is here speaking with the Queen.  I look forward to dining with them tonight.

I'm sure you won't be disappointed.  The last three chefs have been thrown into the dungeon for not producing the best meal.  I think they finally got the idea.    Here's to a luxurious future for both of our kingdoms!
It shall be a feast!  Well, I look forward to speaking with you about your troops and many other issues but may I take leave and go wash the dirt of travels from me?

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.
