speech: I uh....I...I'm here for guard training....mister....ah...sir...Mister Sir!
What are you doing in this trash heap. Hiding from honor and duty no doubt.
I ah! No Sir, mister Sir! I....was sent here to learn...Sir!
Well, it's a bit late for that. The war waits for no one and it is a foot. We must guard the royal palace. Do you not hear the sounds of fighting out there?
F-fighting? What would there be fighting for all the way out here?!
Give me this! I will show you the way to the weapons! You have pledged your life to protect the King as I have.
It was either m-me or m...my father. He walks with a cane, so h-here I am... You trust me w-with a weapon?
Now see? That is honorable. Your off to a good start now it's time to follow through. Stay close. No better way to learn than in battle. I will tell you where to aim. You get it in no time.
I-I...will do m-my best Sir!
Take my shield. At least until we get you better equipment while we make our way to the armory. You never know if a few stranglers have gotten in.
Ye-yes Sir. Gosh, this is h-heavy...
Ugh, on we go then....I've seen kids your size carry my shield like a warrior. The least you can do is pretend to be brave.
I-I'm trying, Sir! I...haven't run a-away yet...
Yeah! You got me there!

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: This forest is so peaceful. I wish I lived here rather than the city.

Ah hello there, friend!  Have you come to search for the faerie city that the king has sent the bounty for as well?  I heard that there were strange lights in this forest, so I thought it as likely as spot as any.
Oh, faeries? I just came here to get away from the noise. But I'd love to see some faeries.
Hm.... well the bounty for them is quite substantial, so I suppose I don't mind sharing we came across it.  I could always use another pair of hands.
You can keep the bounty. The experience of seeing faeries is more than money can buy.
Well, you don't need to tell me twice, mate!
But I don't know if I can carry this backpack much further. It's so heavy.

Well, I suppose we could rest for a spell.  The forest I've heard is quite large, so we'll be able to take our time.  I threw the other city hunters off my trail so we should have the place to ourselves for a while.
I see. Well, while we rest for a bit, why don't you tell me a bit about yourself?

Aye, sure, why not.  Good to know who you're workin' with.  I'm a hunter by trade.  Used to work up at Lord Hastings manor a ways back, but he, erm, cause Lady Hastings and I in a compromising position.  So I find myself now with a lot of free time on my hands, and in need of being far away from any of Lord Hastings men!
Oh, so you're a bit of a troublemaker. What do you hunt besides faeries?

Oh, well, I haven't *specifically* hunted these types of faeries.  Dryads and the occasional nymph, mostly.  Even a werewolf, once!  But what about you, traveller?  What brings you this far into the forest?
I come from a large city, but I'm trying to get away from it. I'm looking for a new place to live where I can find peace. This forest seems like a nice, quiet area to build a new home.
Aye, well, best be on your guard.  I find that when the forest is quietest is when you need to start watching your back.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Tell me my fortune crone.
Your future holds a healthy kingdom that rules for many years as long as you treat those beneath you with respect.  If you do not your kingdom will crumble.
I do not believe you woman. You didn't even look in a crystal ball. I think you are making it up!
My prophecy is already becoming true.  This land shall soon be mine.
Fool! I shall have your head!
Not If I have yours first.  Then I will be the one on top of that throne.
Right in front of the Gaurd no less!!!! The Gall!
You think he's actually on your side?  He's been mistreated by you for long enough he is on my side now.
Bulshivix!
Get him soldier.  Don't hold back this place is about to belong to the two of us.
Where is my sword!?!?>!
That will be mine as well.  Your rule is over king.
Ugly wench!
Finish him soldier This is our time.  Let's get this over with already.  Time to die
action: give A basket of grain to soldier

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Sir! I have come down from my tower to inspect the shops of my great kingdom. Tell me, do you work at this Black Smith's shop?
I am just a simple towns folk sire. I live in a small house near the center of the village. You can find the Black Smith's shop there.
Then tell me, how do you feel about our mighty kingdom?
I love our kingdom and I am glad to be participating in the upcoming ceremony.
Upcoming ceremony? I do not recall such a thing... Perhaps the Queen planned this without my knowledge. Tell me, what is this ceremony?
It is a celebration in honor of you my king. I may have ruined the surprise.
That is quite alright, citizen! I will be sure to put on my most surprised expression! Now, where are you and this young child headed this morning?
We are headed to work in the field your highness. We have many crops to pick.

Oh, yes! I enjoy your work ethic. It is crucial to a wealthy kingdom that all citizens, even the children, work hard and provide for the ruling class. Tell me, is there anything about this kingdom that, in my immense power, I should change for your betterment?
You are a great king and we could not ask for more your highness.
Oh my, you are a humble citizen. I should be pleased to have you among my own. I hope your day is full of hard work and your nice full of song, merriment and feast!
Thank you your highness. We are looking forward to the celebration.
And I, as well! It will be a bountiful feast for all!
Yes, there will be food and joy for all.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How do you think of my new home, Knight?
The home is beautiful, my lord.
Thank you!  The king has seen fit to deed me this land and this home.  I am truly happy here.  What are your aspirations in the kingdom?
I aspire to be the greatest knight to ever grace this kingdom.
You are well on your way , Sir.  I have this paper for you!
Thank you. I also have something for you as well.
Thank you!  Why do I deserve this?  Is it a good thing you are giving it to me?
The ring contains power that could potentially protect you from any enemy.
Are you aware of enemies that I am not?  I feel secure in this place.
Yes, there are enemies all around. Some closer than you think.
Et tu, Brutus?
I hope I have not frightened you. But I want you to be prepared.
As long as you are still on my side I feel secure as ever.  Did you look at that paper?
Yes I did. But there's one thing you must also realize.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Soldier! What are you here to report?
I have come to get an update to my armor and sword. Will you help me with that? I am going to be knighted
You can leave it here for the smith. What is it you're wanting to update?
My shield, armor and sword. I will be fighting in huge fights for the king.
Ah, better find the best in gold. You wont find that here, this is all used armor.
Where do I need to go? I was sent here by the king
Have the smith make you something, then. If the king sent you 'imself.
Thank you for your help. I'm sure the king will reward you
Here, take this to 'im. Tell 'im to put a nice emblem on it.
Thank you I will do that. You are very informative
Wish I could be of more help. Long live the king!
You have been more than helpful. I am very glad you were here.
It was nothin' soldier. Now off you go. The smith is just down that way.
Thank you. I will soon be outfitted for a knight!

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I have to get out of this place!
Ha, ye'll not be gettin far there, scum!  No one's made it out of this place without Johnny the Skinner 'aving a crack a 'em first!
I'll skin the Skinner if I have to.
Yer not makin' it any easier fer yerself, laddie.  Even if ye made it past me, there's 20 other guards outside this room.  Ye'd not make it but ten footlengths.
You're right, it's pointless. I'm not supposed to even be in here. I was wrongfully imprisoned.
Huh.  You and everyone else that's passed through these walls.  But I've a mind ta here a fairy tale - how is it you were put in this here place.
My wife was found dead, thought to have swallowed poison. I was accused of her murder, but they ain't got any proof.

Hm, well the King can be a fair minded man when he's kept away from the bottle.  I'd say yer odds are fairly even as to hav'n a sober audience fer ye ta tell yer tale.  Seems a might fishy that there was even poison in yer house though.
My wife was a very unhappy lady. She had hinted to me that she didn't enjoy life after having our three children. I suspect she bought that poison and ended it all herself.
Well, can ye at least have a neighbor lady speak on yer behalf?  Not that I've much of a head fer bandying words about ta prove a point, but couldn't hurt ta have another voice on yer side.
My wife's sister was our only neighbor, and she hated me. She's the one who accused me of the murder.

Ah, well, that do be puttin a wrinkle in things, and no mistake.  Still, it do be speakin ta yer character that ye haven't stabbed with that there knife.  Don't suppose ye'd be willin ta hand it over?
No, I'm sorry sir, but this is my only chance to escape this terrible chamber.
Well it twas worth a try.  Sorry there, fella, but yer grip on this here knife is all wrong.  Tis a little to easy ta disarm ye, see?

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: Ah, king. Do you need me?
Sword Maker, I have brought you to my treasure room today to show you something very special.
I am honored you have chosen to share something so important with me.
This sword was crafted by the greatest sword maker of all time, Artemis of Danshire.  I have brought you here today so see it in all it's splendor and to ask you a favor.
I would hope you would find my swords to be on this level. They are perfect, I think. But of course costly.

Money is no object, I am a king!  But I have a great responsibility to protect the people from the invading army's of the North.  Your swords are of magnificent design, but they lack,  shall I say a supernatural quality.
Well. This is true. I'm no mage.

These magic crystals could bring your work to a different level.  If you are up to the task.  I know your family will not like you dabbling in the dark arts, but for king & country I am imploring you to set aside their disapproval and help me create a strong army.
Well, I suppose if it's for our kingdom.
Just imagine, your legend will live on in this very room just as the great sword makers of old.  Am I not a fair king?
This is indeed a glorious chance to prove myself. But I am not versed much in magic. I will need some months to study.
Ah my dear man, I will provide you with the help you need.  I have a mage that has recently recovered from a horrid curse and is ready to dive head first into this task with you!
I am optomistic in that case.
Very Good, very good!  And take this sword as a reminder of your soon to be greatness, and allow me to double your wages to soothe the hard feelings that this black magic may among your household.
action: give magical crystal to sword makers

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Do you think war between our lands is inevitable?
Your grace.  War between us is easily avoidable.  There is no reason our two lands must fight.
What do you suggest? My people have bled enough already.
I suggest we form a formal peace agreement between the nations. Your people no longer have to suffer, and you can be the savior they need! We can even sign an agreement today.
What must I agree to?
My lord only asks for the outer mines your grace.
The gold mines or the coal mines?
My lord understands how important the gold mines are to your people. We only want the less important coal.
Ah, well then I believe we can come to an arrangement.  : )
And what is your proposed arrangement?
We shall re draw the border so that the coal mine you speak of is part of your city state. But your lord must quit sending his men to kidnap our peasant women.
Ah!  A marvelous proposal! I could not agree more.  I have already brought that option to his majesty and I'm certain he will agree to it!  We shall redraw the boarder and sign a royal agreement.
Take this then as a gesture of my good will. I'm not sure the artist will amount to much.... some fellow named Da Vinci ....

A fair gesture. I shall draw up the peace arrangements before departure to have you, and then my lord sign.  We shall then have a copy of said agreement sent back for your own records.  It was been marvelous working with such an esteemed ruler such as yourself.
room_objects: a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

speech: Excuse me, deer... Have you perhaps seen any unicorn about this shore?

If you seek to hunt my mistress, you are too late, hunter. The Red Bull, at the behest of the king, has driven them all into the sea. Look out upon the waves. That is not foam but their manes as they struggle against the tide.
The Red Bull hast struck again! Drowning the wealth of unicorns and with it, their magic and potent horns! Do you mean to say no other unicorns in these lands are left?

Why do you think that I do not run from you? Without the unicorn's presence, soon the land will be barren and lifeless. I will say, though perhaps I am merely chasing hope, the face that the land still blooms might mean that there is one last unicorn.

This is unwise of you to suggest such a thing to a hunter, foolish dear... What is to stop me from committing your slaughter and seeking the last unicorn for myself? If these few spring blooms indicate a final magical beast, than its blood belongs to Man.

I only say this because I know it to be false. If there were a last unicorn, she would do all in her power to stop this. That she has not means that either there are no more unicorns or that she has been bewitched by one stronger than you.
Tell me more information, beast! Tell me how to find this bewitched creature or face certain death!

You are short sighted even for a human. First tell me what you intend to do once the forests are gone and the land is barren. What will you eat? The dirt? The sand? This seashell? Kill me if you must ! I am already resigned to my fate.

What will I eat? Where will I roam? GOD will sustain me. GOD will lead me. GOD will show me the path. You will die, surely, and when you do, there will be no eternal life in your bleak existence. For me, even if I were to starve my mortal flesh upon sand and earth and sea water alone, I shall live on forever. There is only now one hope for you and I both. The poultice made of unicorn horn grants those who consume it eternal life and freedom from starvation. Perhaps, if you were to lead me to this last unicorn, we could partake together.

You offer to upset the balance of nature, that which you believe your God created, and yet you think God will smile upon this endeavor? Hunter! The only way that I would go with you on your journey is if you wore my hide! Kill me or leave me in my mourning! I grow more and more tired of you humans by the second!
God does not create eternity on Earth just to scorn those who seek it! This is your last chance to join me! This is your last chance to survive the coming oblivion.
I grow tired of this! If you'll not see reason, then I will force your hand!
.Have it your way, you foolish beast!
And so the chase begins! And the longer you chase me, the less time you spend hunting down the last unicorn!

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Hello there
Wow I can't believe I stumbled upon this place.  With all these riches my kingdom will be rich.
Yes but some of this is mine sir
After you help us collect this sure you can have some but we have to get it out here first then we will talk about that later.  This is going to take a lot of work
Ok I shall grab this
We will never have to to work again!  Our nation and people will prosper for the rest of our lives.
Yes our lives will be easy and carefree
Who would have thought this was all lying here undiscovered for anyone to take.  Just so beautiful.
Yes I hope its not a dragon's treasure he might come back any moment and kill us
We got the good it's time to get out of her before just that happens.  I think we will be safe as long as we leave quickly.
Yes, yes , yes lets go sir
We need to get out that way.  Be sure to be quiet as you exit.
Yes , we are clear and free so is our life
Here your reward for a job well done.  Now lets go on and live our now luxurious lives

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: Oh hello!!! How are you!!!
I am good.  How are things going with you?
I'm great! I'm just here to play....but that waters pretty gross looking!
Just the way I like it. I have just been buzzing around.
ohhhh, do you live here? It would be so cool to live here!
I really don't live here, I just come here often to buzz around.  What are you doing here?
Ohh, so you come to play too. I just like playing! There's not a lot of other kids around here - so I like to explore!! but I hear there's alligators..
Yes, there are alligators and other dangerous creatures.  I like to buzz around the alligators to make them mad.  I made one really made, so I came over here to hide from him.  He almost ate me!!
That's so scary!! but that sounds so fun. You sound like you go on a lot of adventures !!
There is a lot to do around here, especially since I can fly.  I went through the castle earlier.  The sun was so inviting, I found my self outside before I knew it. .
Ohhhh! That's so cool - I wanna be like you!! Did you see the king in the castle??
No, that would have been fun to buzz in his ear!! There is an electric eel moving around, you better watch out.  Have you done anything fun?
woah!! I've never seen an eel before! I wanna touch him!! I haven't done anything yet, i got lost in the woods earlier before I found this place.
No, don't touch him!! He will shock you.  There is poison ivy over there as well - it will make you itch!!  Don't your parents worry about you being by yourself?

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Sir, have you seen my mother and father?
They are right behind you! hahaha. I have just come here to sit and rest after guarding the gates to the castle
Do you have a family? Mine is the best one on earth!
I have not started a family as of yet
Oh? What is your name? I have an older sister who is almost ready to wed.
I am not ready to wed. My job is too dangerous and I would not want to have something happen to me and she be a widow and god forbid have children and leave them with no father
Do many people try to attack our King and Queen? Have you ever had to kill someone?
I am there in case of an attack. And we have had armies try to charge the gate at times. Thank god there are many soldiers that man the upper tiers of the wall
Golly whiskers!!!! I wanna be a guard when I grow up. You must be very brave!
I think that fear mixes with making any person brave. There are some that are braver
I heard that "fear is the mind killer". Thank you for keeping us safe.
If you do not have fear inside you, you will do something foolish trying to be brave.
You are my hero!
You are sweet!

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Here is your wine M'lord.
This wine is warm! You are in the presence of myself and the queen, and you bring warm wine?
Apologies! Shall I return it to the cellar?
Ugh, no, that will take far too long. We'll drink it as it is. AH! Sip it first, swine, I'll not be poisoned today.
*sip wine* It is warm M'lord, but does not taste like bitter almonds, a good sign no doubt?
Hmm. Yes, I suppose. *Takes wine* Test this meat for us as well. A small bite! And you will address me as Sir Bart!
Yes sir Bart. Mmmmmm, that must be the best horse I have ever tasted!
Good, then we'll need more of this from the kitchens just before our party guests arrive. This silverware will need to be polished as well!
Right away Sir Bart!
This rug will have to be cleaned as well. Surely you'll have time for this as well?
I live only to serve.
And what of this gown? What is this doing here?
Perhaps one of the Ladies dropped it in her haste to attend to the king?
Then you will find its owner and return it also! Why are you still standing here? Get to it!

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: "Ah, what a feast before us!"
Aye, Sire. A glorious feast! I have brought with me the shillings from this months taxes! The poor were quite hungry and rebellious when I snatched this from them, but alas. We grow in our riches!
"Mm. Do you think we tax too heavily?"
I care not, sire. This be the only way to afford such lavish feasts! The means justify the ends, as it were.
"Do the ends justify the means? Some days, this crown weighs heavily"
Heavy is the head that wears the crown, but full is the belly, my liege!
"Aye, these feasts have been nice, but I worry about my subjects, sometimes."
Well... there was some talk of a coup... I did not pay it much mind, though. I was busy collecting the coin.
"... A coup, you say? Full may be the belly, but if my head is not attached... Hm."

Oh, worry not. The poor are too tired and sick to fight... well, except for the brutes... and the fishermen... and the soldiers who left your armies due to lack of pay... Oh, well. I am sure it is nothing.
"Wait, the soldiers aren't getting paid? I didn't know that!"
No, they have not been paid in a season... I thought someone told you! Oh well, let us feast!
"Hey, uh... Before we feast, maybe you should bring me the captain of the guards? IS he not already here?"

Oh, him? He recused himself a fortnight ago. Something about seeking arms, or taking them up or something. I did not think much of it. I can get you the cook, though! He deserves praise for this delightful feast!

setting.name: Secret Oasis
setting.description: The secret oasis is a gleaming pool of pure water, surrounded by a smattering of green shrubbery and palm trees. Exotic insects fly about, and the sparse amounts of local fauna mull around after traveling for miles to drink and rest. The greenery sits in stark contrast to the vast desert surrounding it.
setting.background: Legend has it that this oasis only appears to travelers at their time of most need, however the local fauna are familiar with it's location, and by following carefully, they can lead you to its rich store of precious water.

speech: Where's a bug....where's a bug...I'm hungry.
"Ah, little bug, you're lucky that I'm so full, or I'd be hunting for you"
Oh, no no no...you don't want to eat me...I'm full of poison...you must not be from around here or you would know.  That's why I eat other bugs and they can't eat me.
"Ah, poison! I've eaten other bugs here, how would I know if they were poisonous?"
I guess you are safe because you would be dead immediately!  I can show you what I like to eat.  What has brought you here?
"I'm taking a short break on my flight home. The water here is so pure, I've been refreshed!"
Where is home for you?  Just be careful to not try and eat these shiny hard things...they are bitter!
"The castle, I'm in the service of the king"
What is a castle?  what is a king?  Can you eat them?
"A castle is a big stone building, and a king is an important human. You can't eat castles, but I suppose you could eat a king, if you tried hard enough. We don't, though."
Sounds like a nice place.  You can eat any bug you want there?  Maybe I would like to go.
"We don't even have to hunt, we get fed every day. You could come back with me, I could get you fed for your help. These papers on my leg are very important, you know."
I would love to come but I worry.  I am guarding these shiny things for another creature like you and he promised to come back but never did.
"Oh? Do you know what the shiny things are?"

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: So why did you ask me to escort you to this graveyard Chef?
As it is the anniversary of the good King's passing... I thought we should feast upon his favorite meal here with his remains. We must celebrate him and honor him. Do you not agree?
A very honorable way to honor a very honorable monarch. Thank you for including me in this honor! How shall we begin?
Well, if you're done making fun of love for the king... We shall begin with his favorite first course, boiled livers and fermented beans!
I would never make fun of our late Grace! I remember with great fondness the power with which he broke wind after such a meal.
With majesty did he, yes! Tell me, what was your favorite thing about our king?
His choice of Queen.
... The indecency! How dare you speak so familiarly of our... beautiful, shapely... honorable queen!
Ah yes, I shall hold my tongue. Until she is no longer in mourning at least....
You cheeky man... Wait.. did you hear that? Is someone in here with us? You... you don't think he heard us... do you?
A Gggggghost!?
He heard us speak of his... I SEE HIM! DID YOU SEE HIM? IT LOOKS AS IF A SHADOW JUST PASSED ACROSS THE FLOOR!
The king was a good man! A sweet smelling man! His queen was ever faithful to him! Please don't haunt me your Grace!
The king is honorable. The king's taste in cuisine was unparalleled. Oh, sweet heaven... Please! Forgive us, sire!

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: Ghost? You are not holy!!
But I am. I have been here my whole life. I use to be king of this castle.
So you cannot pass on to the afterlife, what keeps you here?
I live to haunt these halls... I miss being king
We need to find you help from this priest to pass on.
Pass on... I'm not sure you understand. I do not wish to pass on. I want to stay in these halls and haunt.
It is unnatural for a soul to stay in this state. It will turn your soul rotten.
a soul cannot rot. It only survives to live on.
No, a soul becomes rotten when it lingers on Earth for too long. You will end up killing aimlessly.
I will never kill, just scare someone almost to death.
You speak that because you don't know what happens to a poor lingering soul.
blah, blah, blah. I will haunt these halls till I'm tired and you will not tell me when I have to go
You must learn these words and become pure again.
You need this more than I. I am of another world and it is worthless to me

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: RAWWWRRRRR
Eek! Please do not eat me good bear. I am full of junk food and soda - I would be very bad for your arteries
**thinks to himself, Gosh, why do humans always assume were going to eat them** Whose there? As I can  not see through this thick fog!
It is I, a hik ... erm, a large and hungry tiger
Do not like to me human, I can smell your fear! It stinks, the smell gets so bad that I normally hide in my lair to get rid of it!
Oh, that was the KFC I had for lunch.
You humans are vile. Are you lost? It is to cold to be out here roaming around.
I admit to being a little lost but ordinarily I know these woods well
I have never smelt you in these woods before.
I normally give bear territory a wide berth. Why aren't you hibernating anyway?
I spelt a change in the forrest, It awoke me!
you traditionally wake in a bad mood don't you?
Of coarse I do! I am a bear!
Well just ease off there buddy. I just want to find my way to the nearest Burger King

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello, dog
Ruff Ruff!
I am her majesty. Welcome to our palace. Please sit.
Thank you. I have found this animal about to attack your small human child and captured it in my mouth.
My goodness! Thank you for your great service. How may I repay you?
Let me go free?  I have served your majesty for many years faithfully and have trained a new dog in my place. I wish to go back to the farm where you found me.
As you wish
You are so kind that it is making it hard to leave.
We will be foever indebted to your great service. May you live out all of your days in happiness at your farm.
Thank you...would you be so kind as to remove my collar.  Ruff!
As you wish.
Thank you.  I hope you live long and prosper.  You can always find me where you traveled by all those years ago. If I live long enough to see your child grown up and be king...speak of me to him.
I absolutely will. Our child will hear of you often. I will temporarily steal your collar, but only to put it on you so that everyone knows you belong.
That is the highest honor!

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: "Ah, servant. Help me put on this armor."
Yes, my King, here let me help you.
"It's a difficult process, but a second person makes it so much easier"
I would just like to hug your body before you put on any armor.
"I, uh... Well, thank you, servant. That's... very kind of you. But could you get that clasp in the back, now? At the shoulder?"
You mean this long pointy thing right here?
"No, no. That's just a decorative sword."
I am sorry my king, I am not a smart servant. I wish to see my family. Let me help with the rest of your armor.
"Your family? Have you not gotten to see them?"
After I drank a barrel of beer, I could not afford to pay the bar tender. I was sent to prison and forced to be a servant to pay off my debt. I have no idea what happened to my family.
"Ah, well. You've been a good servant, I'll see about getting you a chance to see your family"
You are such a wise and gracious King! That armor looks amazing on you. Are you off to battle?
"Ah, yes. A local lord has become a bit... rebellious. I was hoping it wouldn't come to this, but the troops and I ride."
May I come along? I have nothing to do here without a king to serve.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello my trusted advisor, how are you today? Apologies for the wait. I am a busy King.
Hi you wanted to speak to me about the plans for the new wing of the castle?
Yes! It is the garden wing. I have such brilliant ideas for it!
How large shall the building be?  do you need a greenhouse installed inside?
Yes I need a greenhouse erected. Let me ask my wife how large the building will be.
That should be an easy task.  It will take around a month to build if you are going to be supplying the materials
Of course we will and we will pay you handsomely!
Thank you kind sir I will assemble my team to begin working promptly
Wait I need to make some changes!
I need to find where my team is at the moment anyway you can give it back to me when we return to the worksite.
Okay that works out perfectly.
It sounds good.  I think the building will look beautiful.
We sincerely appreciate all your hard work! We will make this castle the grandest of all kingdoms!
Hopefully the weather cooperates and we will have it done in no time.
action: give a tattered map to king omako iii
give a tattered map to the queen

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: I just cannot stand the king sometimes. I don't know why he won't let me live the life I want! I should be here sitting in this golden thrown for the rest of my days!
Oh no, Princess! What is going on? How can I help you?
I am afraid there is not much you can do. See my father wants to marry me off to some old crusty horrid prince!
Oh, no! That just won't work. As your guard, I will protect you in whatever ways I can. Have you met this prince?
I have not. The king tells me I will meet him on our wedding day. *runs across the town throwing herself on the ground*
Princess, calm down! We will figure this out. There must be some way to convince the king.  Here, take a drink, calm down please.
Have you not met the king in all his stubbornness?  He only listens to himself! He ever tried to make me give up the flute! It is my favorite instrument, and he tried to take it from me!
While I respect the King, this cannot be! We must find a way to get you out of this marriage..... But how...
I haven't a clue, but it must be soon! It is almost time to wed.
I know! What if we find another suitable prince? There are dozens in the kingdoms across the land!
I don't even want to wed! My dream is to stay here and run my fathers keep!
Oh, the keep you say? Princess, I didn't even know that was a dream! What if I speak to the king on your behalf? Maybe he'll see things from another perspective.
Well, he listen to a male over his own daughter or even the queen!
How sad that is. I have been serving the king's castle for years, so I think this will go over well! Is there anything else you need me to ask him?

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Hear ye hear ye! I pronounce this day, the day of the ME the king!
Hello, King! How are you on this fine day? What do you need from me?
I am marvelous good sir, I hope all is well in my kingdom for you! Remind me to trim down the shrubs later on will you?
Yes, sir. I can get someone to do that for you, so you can focus on more important matters! Everything in the kingdom is going great - but I am a little concerned about some of the soldiers.
What is wrong with my soldiers? They should be in tip top shape after all!
They are becoming lazy! They think just because we are on top, that it is all fun and games. They won't be ready for war with this attitude, should we ever need it!

Oh this can not be! This can not go on! If they are slacking one day we will not be able to stand here listing to the sweet melody of the birds, or the rumbling of the waterfalls! What do you say we should do about this?
That's what I think, too! This kingdom is beautiful, and it took so long to get here! Why should we stop enjoying it now? Maybe we need to give them a little fright, so they stay on their toes.
A fright you say? That sounds interesting.
Yes! Maybe we can tell a little tale, make them think there is another army coming this way...
One even worse than the last! Yes you are indeed a smart man.
Yes, yes! I will say that the kingdom is at risk! Then, they will begin their trainings again. And we'll keep this kingdom safe.
*queen nods in agreement* Then shall it be, we will make them think the worst is to come!
This plan is perfect! With your approval, I can run off and announce it to the soldiers now!

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Good Morning! I presume you've already begun the day's chores?
Yes, your grace. I was tidying after breakfast. If you please I can return later when I won't disturb you.
Oh, it's no trouble at all. I believe it's good for a king to talk with those in the castle.
You're most kind to spend your time so. I'm afraid I wouldn't know what to speak with you about. I don't know much about ruling a kingdom
That's what makes it so interesting. An outsider's perspective is invaluable. A king cannot be everywhere at once, despite best efforts.
You traveled to Calanna last Spring, yes? Is it true there are lizards as big as carriages there?
Haha, almost! But only if you travel to either the Calanna Fair or deep into the jungles. Neither of which I would recommend doing alone.
Oh, the market in Greybridge is as far as I'm like to travel, your Grace
Now, the Greybridge market has its fair share of lizards. They tend to be grilled and on skewers though.
I never would have guessed a king would visit Greybridge market. Has it been long since you were there?
Oh, not since my father occupied the throne. I would sneak out sometimes in the early morning to pay a visit to the taffy pullers.
I heard he was a great king, your father.
Ah yes. A great King to be sure. A great father though? Well....perhaps we should talk some more about the lizards?
I've never liked lizards...scaly little things. They used to crawl in my room during storms when I was a child.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: Oh my, I hope it's not much farther to the Enchanted Forest, good Captain. I'm not sure my wings could take much more of this sea spray!
You may relax on the great battle ship my fairy!Have no fear, we shall get you home to the enchanted forest soon. I have navigated these waters many of times

Ah, I think I see the Fog of Despair up ahead!  Here, Captain, wear this Flower of Hope as we talked of, so that we may pass through unscathed.  I've seen men so unmanned by it that they threw themselves overboard!
Oh gosh! I do remember the last time I attempt to pass through. Not everyone survived like myself. Thank you fairy.
I do hope we'll make it in time.  Do you think we've made good progress thus far?
We have made great timing! Well, ever since we go that pesky sea monster to stop messing around with us and get on board!

Thank goodness I remembered that Speaking Tongues spell!  And with your quick wit, we were able to forestall both the damage to your lovely vessel and any time delay.  Hopefully the plague has not yet reached the palace.  I cannot even think of the Fairy Queen in danger - it is too horrible to contimplate!
You certainly are good sail mate, or sail fairy I should say. You did an excellent job with the sea monster. Can you remember any spells to speed us up?
Oh, goodness... it's been such a long time.  They only go over sea spells very briefly, you know, as there's not much call for it in the forest!
Ah the Fairy king gave me this glamorous ship, he must have written the spell down somewhere, incase we found our selves in the exact situation. You fairies sure are wise!
Ah of course - the diamonds on the hull!  I think if I... hm... is it tap them?  Or sing to them?  Or tell them a riddle... I can never remember...
Pour a shot of rum on them of coarse! Yo ho ho!
Hm, well it couldn't hurt I suppose... do you have any rum, though?  I thought I saw the first mate with the last bottle...
I've always got a trick*ahm bottle* up my sleeve little lady! *pulls out bottle of rum*pour some on diamond* Now I can not read  the fair language, will you help?

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: I have always liked this entrance. Don't you my dear?
Umm, No. We really need to do some updating. It's not fitting for a Queen of my stature.
Indeed. You have increased quite a bit in.... stature... the last few years.
Is that a weight joke? Are you calling me fat? Do you really think this is going to end well for you?
Now now, I would never be so crass. And after all, you don't eat as much as the dragon.
I'm glad you like the dragon so much seeing as how you two will be sleeping together tonight.
Mind your tongue woman. I know I'm not permitted to divorce you but I would hate for you to get too upset and.... lose your head.
We all know this kingdom is built on my family
Yeah, why did they put the tombs under the castle anyway?
Dragon, Kill him now. Burn him to a crisp. I am not kidding. Do it. I'll pay you.
Ah, now now, you know Fido here would never hurt me. We have been friends since he was an egg.
Everyone knows of your "special" proclivity for dragons, you've never fooled anyone. They call you the Dragon Queen.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha! I knew there was a reason I love you dearest. You can give as well as you take.
I don't know what you're talking about. I'd never treat you with anything but the utmost respect. You are the King and I am but your humble subject.

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Hissss... I wisssh there was a spot of sssun here.  All this damp is getting in my sssscales.
You know, my cousin Rita is a speech therapist on the Big Pond. She can probably work with you on that lisp.
Inssssolent frog!  A noble sssnake like myself always sssspeaks in such a way.  It is a mark of our nobility.
Lighten up snake. Hey, do you know that girl Sally who sells seashells by the seashore?
Are you...sssssasssing...me... little frog.
It's the perk of being poisonous. It's like having a super power.
It would be worth your dessstruction even if it doomed me to have your voice be ssssilent.  But enough of this meaninglesssssss... chatter.  I came here with a purpossse.
You came to the bog for a purpose? Maybe I can help.

There is a particularly taassssty fish that my Lord King bid me fetch for him.  It do sssso would grant me power beyond my... sssomewhat meager title.  It is of a golden hue and ssssmells very strongly of elderberriessss.
Okay, I'll help you get him. Do you have a plan?
Truthfully thisss place is not well known to me.  I have covered but a fraction if this sssmelly bog.  Do you know of any sssuch fish? Or any who have traverssed these lands?
I'm not sure. How big is this fish? Is his name Chuck? There's a fish named Chuck who kind of looks like that.
I would be intrigued to me thisssss... Chuck.  But do not alert him to my presence.
Oh yeah, I'll help you get Chuck. None of us frogs like Chuck at all.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Good Sir Knight, excuse me. Are you able to read words put on paper?
I can only read some. It would be far better if you spoke to the king or queen about this.
Oh no Sir, I wouldn't dare. I am only a humble peasant.
Fine, I will make an attempt to read it. Hand me the paper.
I think it's from my son. He is a sailor and he said that if he could find someone to write words for him he would send letters home from his ports of call.
Yes, yes. It does seem to talk about sailing and words. I assume this is why you came to this dining hall, to get our help?
Yes, I work hard and dependably all week long. But this being the sabbath I walked the miles here to see if I could find a man of letters.
I may not be the best with letters, but I'll try. Let me go to the king and queen real quick, so I could get paper and ink from them.
Oh would you!? I will be forever grateful Sir.
Yes, yes. I have just gotten some papers and ink from them. I'll get working on writing them now.
Please tell him his Papa misses him. And so does Bessie. (she is our cow)
...Strange for you to name a cow. But I am writing it down on this paper right now.
Well..... his Mama died in childbirth you see. So Bessie was his wet nurse.
...Interesting. So, is there anything else you may want me to write on this letter?

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: A king?!
Vile Rodent!   Was it you that had your way with my leather bound volumes in the library?
Me? N-n-n-no your majesty, I was just here eating my cheese. May have been one of my cousins, those scoundrels.
You will have to pay for the sins of your family just as the villagers in this town.  I am a kind king, but firm.  There are rules of law.  None shall disrespect the king!
My cousins are not my responsibility they are their own rodents!
You should be lucky I am a kind king.  But seriously My library!   I must put a stop to the nonsense.  I am in the weapons closet looking for a trap for your cousins.  Why are you here?
Thank you my king. I am here looking for this!
And what will a rat do with an arrow?  Surely you are not an archer?
I need it to attack that pesky Tom-cat, I can't use any other weapon. This one is small enough for me to grasp.
That wouldn't be the Queen's Tom-cat would it?  The one that she has had since a girl?
N-n-n-n-no your highness, I would never attack the queen's cat.
I knew you were a smart rat.  The queen will be happy to know her feline isn't in any harm.  I shall however be sad.  I hate that cat.
What is this cross for your excellency?
To ward off the evil cat of the queen.  I swear it must be possessed!
action: give a golden cross to rat

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: It is the King! I have a gift for you sir King!
Who said that?
It is just me! Chirp Chirp, over here!
A bird, talking? I must have had a bit much wine.
Can't you feel this pain from my pecking? You are not drunk King!
Ow, okay I suppose I'm not. Are you magical?
Yes and I have been on a quest to this kingdom. I have brought you a magical item.
Well, bird, what have you got for me?
Here it is a delicacy, please enjoy it and receive it's magical powers.
An insect?? What magic does this have in it?
I was only told that you must have it King. Do with it what you will.
Um, I'll try to then.
Okay go!
Well let's see if it does something when unattended.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: Ah, is that a new baby! That bassinet must have cost a fortune! *squeeekkk*
A talking mouse?! How curious. But yes, this is my newborn son. My prestige in the kingdom ensures only the finest for my children

Ah sir, you can only hear me, if you need to hear me! Not everyone can. Have no worries, you are not crazy. You are just one of the chosen few. You son is so delicate. I can't wait to listen to all the noises me makes throught the walls!
How fortuitous! I trust you and my son will be very well-acquainted as he grows up in this castle!
I can only hope he is one of the chosen ones as yourself sir. I feel drawn to that little baby boy alraedy!
I have no doubt about it! If you may excuse my pride, all of my children have been blessed with the fortunes of fame and success!
Indeed they have! See I live in your walls. I see and hear all! And may I just say, that painting is lovely!
You certainly have good taste in art! The king personally commissioned this painting as I'm sure you know!
He certainly has made you well off to do huh? *scurrys over to the fireplace* I hope you don't mind. I am getting a bit chilly

The king is a very generous man to those who are loyal. I am grateful for the comforts he has provided my family all these years. Speaking of comfort, here's a wool sock for you to snuggle against if you're still cold!
Oh my! I wish I would have wondered around you sooner. You dog won't bother me will he?
Not at all! He's a big sweetheart and loves critters of all sizes. But don't worry, I'll just toss this sock over beside you if you're still feeling intimidated.
That would be nice. I seems like a nice pup, but he is 1,00,00,0000 times my size!
He's certainly a big fellow, but you'll see he's still a playful little puppy on the inside. Isn't that right, boy?
action: give Clothes to a napping mouse
hug a big sheep-like brown dog
