setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: What kind of a crowd do we have out there tonight?
Ugh, the usual rowdy lot.  I tell ye, soldiers all be well and good for a chat, but they expect a little too much in the handsy department.  Look, but don't touch, aye?
Just remember that you're splitting tips with the kitchen so be nice and friendly.
Oi!  I earn em coins, fair and square.  What's innit fer me if I have ta worry about the likes of you takin what little coin I get?
More leg, less lip and we'll both get enough tips to be happy, now get that food served while it's still warm.

Ya know what.  I've had it up ta here with yer attitude.  I'm out there, smiling while getting pinched and prodded, and yer back here, all cushy with the food.  And don't think I ain't be seeing ye stealing a nip er two when ye think I ain't looking!
That is because I am a talented chef  who has traveled the world. And you, well..I'm sorry I can't think of anything nice to say about you.
Ha!  Maybe in yer wildest dreams.  If you be soooo talented, then why are ye cookin' in a dinky backwater place like this.  This isn't exactly cookin' fer the King immself, is it?!
None of you deserve my talents. I've cooked food for the most powerful kings in all the world.
Ah, yes, please by all means, serve the mead ta the custom out front.  I'd love ta see ya try and do what I do.  You wouldn't even last a minute!
Oh now you're worried about serving customers. That plate of food has been there for 20 minutes.
Aye, yer all talk til there's work ta be done.  Ya know what, I've had it!  You can go be serving the soldiers yerself.  I quit!
Oh no please don't quit. We can never go on without...JUST KIDDING. Don't let the door hit you on your way out!
And I'll be takin' THESE fer the wages ye keep "fergetting" ta give me!
action: steal coin from a serving wench
steal mug of mead from a serving wench
give mug of mead to a serving wench

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Who's there?
Uhh,, its no one. Well, it's just me. I just need a rest on one of these benches.
Who exactly are you then? And okay... go right ahead.
Can I trust you?
I'd like to think so, it would be easier if I knew who you were.
Lets just call me frank. Are you friends with the king?
I am a subject of his, but no friend. And you?
Well you see. I am an enemy of his. I assume you could use some extra coins?
Hmm perhaps. What do you have in mind?
You see, I seek revenge on that animal.  He drew blood from my family many years ago. Now we have been shunned from his kind. We are peasants of the knight. I come to get even.
I see, well tell me some more details than that.
I want to hit him where it hurt. I want to sneak in his castle, take ALL his gold Then BURN IT TO THE GROUND. sound good?
Depends, what's it in for me?
Well, I offered you coins already. I can offer you that. And to spare you life@

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Oof. What a performance. I guess I should really work on some new material.
Our king is always pleased with your performance. Come, Jester, look at our beautiful castle grounds.
The rotten fruit I've been picking out of my ear canal would bear evidence otherwise.
See? Your wittiness is evident even after your performances. I will consult the chef regarding serving larger fruit in the future.
The last thing I need is a face full of melon! Thank the gods for ale.
I'll give you my Royal Insignia in exchange for your ale.
Brother, you and I both know that those are personally inscribed. It would do me no good to carry it.
It was worth a try. Where will you spend your time until the next performance?
Perhaps in the royal library? Maybe increasing my vocabulary will be useful in creating new stories and jokes.
I think that would be a splendid idea.
Hey! Stop doing that so loudly, you know those are contagious.
Well, then I'll need some entertainment. Do you happen to know anyone available?
Hardy-har. If you're in need of something really funny to look at, allow me to point toward the nearest mirror.
I can see why you have fruit in your eardrums

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hoy there! Anything interesting happen this shift?
Same old same old. Making sure nobody stabbed the king on his chamber pot. How about you brother?
I got to throw a drunk noble out of the banquet hall. Lord Bartley's cousin or some such.
Ha ha ha ha, I bet the old goat deserved it. Say, who's the girl sitting on the bed over there?
Ah right, forgot you haven't been here long. This here's Matilda. She brews the best ale this side of Hornsby, runs the tavern down in the town.
Well she sure is a pretty wench! Ale you say? I could do with a tankard.... or 7.
Now you're talking! So how are you liking the guard's life? better than farming turnips?
Sure is! I had never slept in a room with only small cracks in the walls before. And there is no money in turnips since they started breeding those giant ones over by Canterbury.
This is for the ale, Matilda, and some extra for you if you bring some of that gooseberry mead. Say, do you drink mead ... er... sorry forgot your name
Baldric. And gods yes I drink mead! Doesn't everyone? Matilda, you don't happen to have a sister do you?
I don't think she does, but there are plenty of fine lasses around the tavern for a bachelor like yourself
I bet the girls just love a man in uniform. Shall we blow this smelly barracks and go down to the tavern?
The missus is expecting me back tonight, but go drink a pint for me.
Oh, a married man. Well I shall drink a pint to your goodwifes health and dally an extra maiden on my knee in your honour. Farewell for now!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Time to heat up some stew for dinner. I hope everybody is okay with potato
Can't wait. What a day. I wish I could just stay in the servants quarters all day like you
You know it gets kind of lonely in these quarters, you are more than welcome to stay anytime. My family is gone and I don't have any friends.
Maybe I'll take ya up on that. So do you have any news about anything around court?
Oh no, nobody tells me anything important of the sort. I just spend my time fulfilling my duties and keeping the mansion spotless. You should ask somebody more important
I'm just looking for gossip. Nothing too true if it's scandelous. And someone more important? No one else has hot potato soup on, so I can't think of anyone more important this moment
You are too kind. Why are you showing such kindness to a mere servant like myself?
You haven't poisoned me yet, so that's one thing. I just haven't told you I appreciate your meals and demeaner lately, and I do
Thank you, that is very kind of you. I don't receive many thanks around here. Now please, enjoy.
I'm sure I will. Keep me company. So what does the King like to eat?

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: What are you doing here, wench?
Hello your excellency, how are you today?
You will address me as Your Royal Highness!
My apologies my royal highness, I am just here trying to clean you room.
Then clean at another time! Can't you see that I am reading?
Why don't you clean your own quarters then?! I'M DONE!
Wench! You shall go to the gallows for this insolence!
I'm running away with the prince, I don't need you anymore!
I shall disinherit him!
He doesn't want your money or the royal kingdom!
Well if he is content to live with a serving wench all his days
He is, and he detests you and this forsaken failure of a kingdom.
No bother! I have 23 OTHER sons you know
Yeah and they are all worthless and lazy.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Let's see....I know that grave was around here somewhere. "Here lies Nathaniel Monteque" ...gah, what were those instructions...
Hands in the air! Stand and deliver!
GAH!
Give me all your gold!
It's a good thing we're already in a grave yard, because I about keeled over dead! I don't have any gold. But, I am on the trail of some treasure.
Oh? Tell me more. I haven't had a partner with a good lead on a real grist in a while.
So, I was swapping tales at the local tavern, when I picked up this great lead about a missing royal treasure trove. Supposedly, in one of these graves is a long dead king.
I hope he is LONG dead. I don't like the juicy ones! So what grave are we looking for?
The name on the grave is Nathaniel Monteque, an apparent alias for King Monty II.
Ah....... the great Python king? History speaks of him all around the world!
So you're familiar with the Serpent Staff and key to the Cobra's Den the stories say he was buried with?
Wait a minute.... Is this only the first step in what is bound to be a much longer quest?
It may very well be! The entire prospect of such a monumental find had me anxious to get digging. That's...why I'm here at the graveyard so late.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Good morning. Today, I believe we have to gather the milk and hay and bring it to the kitchen.
If you say so, I might as well fuel up to get ready for that.
That's understandable. I'll get the hay.
Okay, I'll get the milk then.
Thank you, I also forgot to get some eggs too. They want eggs as well.
There isn't much milk here so I'll try to help with the hay.
Thank you. I'll be putting the hay in here.
When do we get to eat more? I am starving near to death...
We can sneak some eggs and eat them right now. It's defying the king, but I really dont appreciate his rules. We all have to eat here.
And perhaps sample some of the milk, to make sure that it is safe.
Good idea. I'll drink some right now.
What's the tool for?
It's a glass. I'm just using it to drink the milk.
Ah, I see. Pass it my way once you're done with it?

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hail, traveler. May I ask what brings you to my kingdom?
I thank the for letting me into you palace. See my family and I have traveled far looking for new land to call our own
Hm. May I ask what you and your family did in your old land? I wouldn't want any spies abusing my good trust.
Good farmers sir! We have traveled with our livestock! Raising cattle and grows vegetable is what we do.
Ah, a vegetable man! Glad to hear. I used to raise a few of my own, you know. The wife can tell you good stories about my 'specialty eggplant', haha.
You sir, the king? I guess I never imagined a king such as yourself getting his hands dirty.
Yes, well. It's a lot easier to grow in the specialty gardens God gave to man. You know. The one between the legs.
No sir, I haven't a clue as to what you speak of. The gods do not bless the poor folk.
Ah, well, no matter. I'll have to get to work, soon, anyway. Have you come here seeking a specific plot of land? Or will you need some made available for you?
Any land will do, as long as the the taxes are low!
Ah, good man. I'll have my executioner head out and find some housing to liberate. Would you like to go with him? We've got swords for your family too, if you'd like to bring them.
So kind of you! I was afraid to ask, since I have heard such cruel things. I will be sure to set the rumors straight your majesty!
Wonderful. I'll have Vlad get the things in order.
Thank you your majesty *bows down*

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Father, do you have a moment?
Yes, son. Always. What can I help you with?
Our king would have me measure for a larger entryway. He expects guests to visit this coming summer. They are... rather wide.
Read this, son. Thou shalt not judge others.
Judging has naught to do with the matter! I cannot help it they have all been turned into large trolls.
Have a drink with me, son. You and I need to do some talking.
I swear by my...by, by my protractor! It was a nasty spell from the a nasty witch!
A spell? Tell me more.

The king's in-laws went to visit the neighboring bazaar. All we know is, that they came back with skin made of stone! They spent massive amounts of their treasury having to redesign the door frames. It has been a rather delicate situation.

AH, I see. That is too much for me to handle. Well, this Holy church is looking spectacular. The stonework, the marble...heavenly father is smiling down upon this. I am about to head to prayer, is there anything I can assist with before I leave?
Sign here, father, and I'll be on my way.
Of course, son. I admire your hard work. It will get you far in this life and on your journey. Keep praying, son.
Of course, father.
I wonder what else will the spell will effect around here?

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Men!
By the King's honor!  How can we be of service today?
It is I who wish to be or service to you
Very good, we are in need of repairs to our armor.  We train daily, and our armor isn't holding up.
My father died as a result of poor armour. I will never let that happen to you!
We appreciate your service to the king.  What can you do for this mess?
Good gracious, these have been ill-treated!
Well we are preparing for an invasion from the east any day now.  We train daily to be the best we can be.
Ah, the fearful Easterners! Let me call my apprentice and see what I can do
We would appreciate your personal attention to the matter.  We have a mole in the kingdom that has been feeding intel to the opposition.  No one can be trusted with this security.
Then should you have been so free with your tongue?
Ah, well when one has had a few drinks it is hard to hold the tongue.  But nonetheless, this is just between us and the knight.   We need an advantage.  The army's of the east are strong.
And we have a weak and corrupt leader. But I should not have said that also!
We have thought the same, but to defy the king is treason.  Do you have a plan you'd like to discuss, as I clean this sword?

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: .......she's the star of the county down.
I grow weary of this. Play me a new song.
All the way to Dublin wack fo la de la......
I don't think I've heard this one...
...take her there and turn her down and all the way to Dublin wack fo la de la!
hmmm la de da
Have you heard this next one my lord?.......
Oh? do play
Alas my dear you're looking bad.....
hmm...
.... it must have been the peas you had......
ha! My chef could do to hear this one
.....mm mmm mmmmmmm mm mm, ......since you've been sick you have Greensleeves.
I daresay you're the first passable bard my minister has brought in in ages. Tell me, where did you study?

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: See this bone!  You are next!  You will feel the wrath of the King!
I love this chicken!
Eat your sewer chicken you fools!   I bathe in your excrement.  You will never find the treasure!!!
Hold my plate!
Oh my peasants.  I love you!   You stinky foul creatures, the rats will guide you to your death!
Maybe I'll look into the future and see that you're not there anymore.

I will be here!  I know this maze, the rat's talk to me.  They know who their king is unlike you fools.  I will feed you to my babies.  My precious rat babies.  I love my little ratty rats.  But you must die!
Are you sure you will be?

I have two weapons now.  One to kill you with and one to kill you with.  Any questions?  Yes I have one.  Where is my queen?  She was just going to visit her mother, and now I'm alone with our babies.  Precious rat babies.
Now I have two weapons. What are you gonna do?
Good show Jester, good show.  Now we shall dineQ!
Let's eat shall we!
Chicken for everyone!   The king has spoken!
Thank you mad king we needed this!
action: steal crystal ball from mad king
steal chicken drumstick from mad king

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Tell me, am I the first talking monkey you have ever met?
Indeed you are! I can't say I have much experience with talking animals other than the occasional parrot.
I'm the only monkey in rom our forest who can talk with humans. I was raised by the King, when he was a boy.
He has taught you well! Your English is almost flawless. If we weren't facing each other, I'd swear I was speaking to a fellow man.
Oh yes, I also used to help him study his mathematics. I am a wizard at algebra.
How fascinating! Were you always this intelligent, or did you possess your gifts from supernatural means?
I think I'm just a little smarter than your average monkey, unfortunately the Queen didn't like me and made me leave the castle.
I'm sorry to hear that! But I am glad I got to meet you on my travels! Speaking of, where exactly is here? I seem to have lost my map.
This compass is all wrong. It's not going to work here in the backwards rain forest.  You will surely get lost without my help.
I'm glad you are here then, my friend! Could you please tell me how to get to the nearest town? I am running short on supplies.
It is quite far. Why don't you stay in this hut tonight, and I will gladly show you the way to town tomorrow morning, bright and early.
That would be much appreciated! By the way, I don't suppose that huge spider by the corner of the hut is venomous?
I'm scared to death of spiders! Don't make eye contact, whatever you do!
I hate spiders too. I don't think I can fall asleep with that thing in the hut with us. Perhaps I should try to smash it with this shoe?

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: I am a princess that will be married off soon
Yes when is it?
I should be asking you father, because it was you that arranged the date
Oh I can't remember! I will just do something that I'm good at, tilling. I am the Great Tiller King!
Yes father because the kingdom needs the wedding for the peace treaty with the second village remember? So please don't forget
Oh yes and now more from the Tiller King. Tiller Tiller Tiller King! Tiller Tiller Tiller King! What do you say to the Tiller King dear?
I told him I will love his son forever, I was birth to love him
Who is this you speak about?
The king from the other village, I thought you asked me what he spoke to me privately about
I have forgotten so can you tell what the private talk was about?
father, i need to call your doctor, you keep forgetting and it's becoming annoying, he also gave me this horse
What horse? Did you already tell me?
oh daddy, we really need this marriage because you are getting too rusty. I don't want the enemy to take over our kingdom
Alright, can you make us some hot chocolate?

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello, is everything going okay?
Hello sir.  I'm just here to clean in the tower.  I heard there were some mice bothering you.
Yes, they've been bothering both me and the king alike. We've been having quite a problem with them for the past few days.
It must get very lonely up in this tower.  Have you seen many travelers today?
No, I have not. It seems to be quite quiet over here.
Well don't mind me while I stir up some cobwebs and make conversation.  How is your family, sir?
My family is doing well from what I've seen. I've been so busy doing errands for the king I have not the time to check up on them as often as I'd like.
You do have a beautiful view.  Can you see your family's home from here?
Yes, I can. I can see it's in good condition too.
That must help to feel a little closer to your loved ones.  How long have you been in the king's service?
For quite some time, a few years, to be exact.
I have been a servant to the king most of my life.  I have never been much farther than the castle walls.
Really? It must be lonely, I can imagine... Not knowing anyone but the people that live here and not being able to explore either...
It is what I've always known.  At least we have a kind king.  I'm worried about what will happen when his son takes the throne.  Maybe I will find my freedom before then.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Ahh a warm fire after traveling in this rain all day. Doesn't get any better than this.
Nope, a plate of food, a blanket.  Have you heard of the road ahead?  Any talk of Bandits?
Not as of late. But when I came through here a few months back it was thick with them. The king had to send down a whole regiment to clean em out.
Well that makes me feel a little better.  I know they are bad in the East, but that's the only place we can get the spices of value.
I've got to try some of this roast goat. Last time I was here it was amazing.
I'm in too.  I think I'll make myself at home and relax a while before we journey on.
You in a hurry to get on the road again. Seems like traders are often that way.
Well time is money, but roast goat is worth sticking around for.  What brings you to this cottage?
I'm travelling back home to see the wife and kids. Been working out West.
I'm sure they will be glad to see you.  How long have you been gone?
About four months or so. It's amazing how much the little ones change in a short time.

I hope you have a better wife than I do.  Mine could not wait the long months I was away.  She had taken up with my brother when I got back home.  I guess I can't blame her.  It's a lonely life being a wife of a traveling merchant.
Your brother. That's a sad tale there. I hope you gave him a good beating when you found out.
No, I did not.  I just packed my bags and left without a word.  No use in fighting.  Just keep moving on, that's my motto.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Sir Please have mercy on me!  My family sheep ran into the forrest, I know I'm not allowed in there but that was our livelihood!
Mercy is in short supply here.
If you let me go, I will tell you of a man who has been having an affair.
Who is this man of which you speak
The butcher has been sneaking into Farmer Archer's house after he leaves for the fields.  I thought it was for his wife, but it may be fore his man servant.
Perhaps you are lying to save your own neck.
Perhaps, or perhaps there is homosexuality in your village, right under your nose.  I'm sure the King will love to hear of that.
You dare to threaten me?
I won't have to when the king hears about it.  Let's just say I'm trying to help us both.   I know of a magical creature that is also living in your village.  Have you seen the Baker's pet bird?
I think your are having unlawful relations with your sheep.
Where do you get your intel?  Those sheep my life!  Not my wife
Confess your sins and tell me about the Baker's magical bird or you shall hang by authority of the King.

I only spend the night in my barn when the misses kicks me out, but what you really want to know is I saw the Baker's daughter Sara bring a bird in from the woods.  Soon after the stray dogs started disappearing.  Strange, right?
Disapointing..... Let's see if a whipping will loosen your tongue.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: Ah, welcome to the festivities!
Thank you, sir. What's with all this silk?
The king, he love the way it feels. Go ahead, have a feel!
Ohh wow, that is some top quality stuff! No wonder, he is the king after all.
Only the finest for the kings and his ladies! Don't tell him I told you this, But the red and yellow, well they aren't my favorite color combination.
Ahh, I was going to say the same thing, it's a bit gaudy!
He trust me to keep his kingdom at peace, but not with his decor.
Ohh that is too good. I wouldn't mind taking one of these off his hands, as ugly as they are they are worth a fortune.
Have your self to it! I'm am going to see to it that this room gets a face lift soon.
This one here, really? That is too kind, sir. We are hungry, me and my family.
Ah, well than this could be of great use to you! Tell me is they why you were here? To get help for you and your family?
That's correct, we are truly struggling which is why we left our previous land to come here.
You must be exhausted! Come take a rest on this oversized bed, don't forget to drink the wine. In the morning we shall see to it that you family find a place to call home!
Are you sure, sir? Could you not get in any trouble for this?

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Who goes there?
It is I, the dancer for the king.
For the king, you say? That is quite an honor.
Is it? I only want respect.
Well if he has taken a liking to you, you must be quite good.
Thank you. I was going to ask you a favor.
And what might that be?
I wish to feign an illness. Just for one night. Could you help me, so that I can experience a night to myself?
Hmm and how may I assist with that, if I agreed to this?
Could you use your skills of purity, to weave a tale that I am ill? The king would listen to you. No one else, would he believe.
I suppose I could do this, I can see that you are a pure souled and hard working person.
You've made me so happy! I will dance with such exuberance the following day, that he will never think a thing of it.
He will perhaps consider giving you more time to rest after that!
Goddess willing!

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Good Sir.
Sister, I'm scared! Why am I here?
Do not worry, I will protect you. I think.
This room gives me the chills. I can't help but feel bad things have happened here in the past.
Well yes .. I suppose all those blood stains do not help. But there are other things performed here but sacrifices!
May I ask why you have been summoned here? Am I being punished by the King?
No child, no. I am merely here as part of my duties
I'll have you know I am a firm believer in God. I would never commit a crime against the King!
I have accused you of no such thing! Peace
Forgive me, sister. I did not mean to shout. I am simply wondering why I was dragged from my home into this chamber.
Perhaps the Lord has something to say to you?
I pray I have not done anything to upset His Majesty .
Soon someone will be along to tell you
Will you sit with me until then? I could use the emotional support, sister.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Do you ever take off that hood?
yes when I am not working
Say, have I ever "Axed" you what you do for fun?
i pray with my crucifix
This? Wow, way to have fun.
now give me back the big one and you can keep this for your soul. I know you will die soon
Boy, sometimes I wish that were true. I have been locked up so long I fear I am going mad. But the king said that death is too good for me.
i can help you if you were good
Define good?
You killed more people than me
Yes but only under orders from the king before this one!
No one misses you now that you are not dead. I wonder what place you will have in Hell
Hell if I know......
Let me get you some painkillers for that leg, i am in a good mood today because at least you got one of my cruxifix

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah my loyal steed, you are looking so handsome today.  How are you?
Whinnnnnnny
I'm counting on you or our next fox hunt my hoofed friend.  I hope you are feeling up for the chase.
Neigh!!!!!!
What do you think you are up to, you silly thing.  Are you trying to tell me something?
Hhhhhhh
You know I'm going to be king one day, so that would mean you could be the one to carry me in my royal parade.
Whiiiiiiiinnnnny!!!!!!
Have you lost your mind.  You are going to end up glue.  Seriously, you can't be doing this during the fox hunt!
EEEEEEEeeeee!
Here, does this make you happy.  You are a crazy horse. I don't know what to do with you.  I don't know if you want to tell me something or you are just mad.
Whinney : )
Yes, you are mad.  Maybe I should call the mage to cast a spell on you to keep you sane for the hunt.
Neigh!
action: get the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from horse
give the royal coat of arms to horse
wear the royal coat of arms
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Your kingdom’s courtyard is beautiful. It’s the most beautiful one I have seen on my travels.
It really is nice.  It's a shame the king hired such worthless servants to work for him.  They hardly do anything and they are paid to stay in a place like this !?
I’m sorry to hear that. You would think they would be greatful of your family’s kindness. You were very kind to offer me a place to stay and food to eat while I visit.
I had to fix this timeless heriloom after one of the servants dropped it while drunk.
Such a unthinkable thing that was for them to do. Why did they even have it to begin with?
Who knows.  the king is much too kind to even keep them around.
He must have his reasons I’m sure. What kingdom doesn’t have followers? They can’t all be royal I’m sure.
the king also wanted to give you this as a welcoming present.
I wish I had more to offer in return. This was my grandmother’s. Unfortunately I pack light.
There is no need for such gift in return.  The kind is far too generous for that.
Are you sure? I feel awful not being able to give something in return.
Yes he does this with all of his guests and never allows people to give anything in return.
Such a kind king he is indeed then.
It's an honor to serve under his rule.
action: give lace handkerchief to royal family member

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: You guys do not have to torture me. I will literally tell you everything I know.
Why should we believe the words of a lowly thief like yourself?
I'll prove it. Just ask me anything. I will tell you whatever you want to hear.
Let's start with your target. What was your purpose sneaking into the castle?
I was hungry and wanted some meat. I took this from the kitchen.
Is that all? You could have easily stolen food from one of the village shops? That you snuck into the highly guarded castle suggests you were after something much bigger.
Alright, alright, alright. Perhaps there was more to the story. Just put that stuff away.
I'll let the dungeon master hold onto this for now. But you better start talking fast, and I don't want to hear a single lie again!
It's a bit of a long story. It all started with the Princess and the day she ran off to the forest y herself.
The Princess was involved? Do go on...
Well, she got herself in a little bit of trouble down by the docks and I happened to be walking by.
What kind of trouble are you talking about? I hope she wasn't hurt, or the king would have our heads!
No, see that's what I'm telling you. I saved the Princess. They were trying to harm her...and actually, I'm kind of a hero.
I will have to corroborate your story with the Princess herself. But if her highness confirms your account, you will be immediately released.
action: give torture equipment to dungeon master

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: It is quite filthy here isn't it.
My kind of place.  I just wish they had a better harvest spoil this year, I'm starving!
It has been rather dry in that area hasn't it. I just glad theres none of those darn birds down here!
Tell me about it.  They don't generally come underground though.  Got anything good from the left over temple offerings?  Any human sacrifices?  Old Goat skin?  I'm not picky.
I may have some goat skin, let me check for you!
That would be great.  I've been scrounging around the castle all day, but they are all paranoid about the black plague.  They see one rat and they lose their mind.
I mean, can you blame them? That nasty thing killed many of good people!
Good people, Ha!  The king is a tyrant! It would do the Kingdom good to have a good does of the plague with that one.
I hope some of them birds get the plague, I could do with out a few of them.
Yeah, I'm with you on that.  Those hawks are always trying to steal my family.   How's the priest does he believe in pest control?
Fortunately for us, since he goes along with that fairy tale, he does not believe in killing! We should be safe until someone else find out were down here. Like the hawks
Surely the hawks won't come under ground.  I was told they wouldn't.  Have I been lied to?  What about that goat?
Ah I finished it off, I apologize. We can start on the priest if you like? He seems to be getting pretty old.
He seems like a willing victim.  I wish he wasn't so big on fasting, I could use a little more meat on the bones.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: are the the cat or the queen?
A talking mouse? Why are you in my castle?
I am part of your castle, your highness
Why would I want a mouse in my castle? I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman! I the queen of this CLEAN castle!
I stay in your kitchen and I am part of the clean castle because i change your insects and reptiles away
I don't think so!
So what are you going to do, lynch me?
The king would have my head if he new a rodent was living in our kitchen! You must leave! Or hide, Or something!
It would surprise you to know i talk with the king everyday
Oh ya? And what do you talk about, The king would tell me his queen, if he was letting a mouse live here. Why do you think we have a cat?!
I'm his secret spy, he couldn't tell you because we swore an oath of secrecy
Cat! after that filthy mouse!
bad queen, witch!
You spelt that wrong!

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I'm here to protect this land from any intruders.  No one will get past me!
Don't hurt me, sir! I'm just a little boy!
What are you doing out at this time.  Where are your parents?
My parents are working in the kitchen, but I got bored and thought I would explore the castle tower.
I must escort you back at once.  You are going to be in big trouble young man.
Please, don't tell my parents! They're going to be so mad!
QUIET this way at once!
You hit me! I'm just a child, you monster!
One more word from you and I'll take you to the king myself.  You don't want him to get a hold of you!
Let me go at once! I know how to use a sword!
Don't make me kill you myself.  You think being a child will save you?  You've committed crimes against the kingdom.  It's time to die.
Please, I was only joking! I haven't hurt anyone!
Silly child! to think you would throw your life away over something so silly.  It's all over
I hope you can sleep at night with a child's blood on your hands!

setting.name: Horse's stables
setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

speech: I can't believe after all I done I was sent to clean the stables.  Doesn't the royal family have any respect for me
What should I do sire?  Will mucking the stall strengthen my jousting muscles?
There is nothing of value for us to do here.  Nothing but filth.
Her sir, let me help you with that.  Have I told you lately that I am glad to be your page. My old knight was very unkind. The least I can do is take your horse feces from you.
Actually.. I do have something that would help with your training.  Take that and slip it into the kings soup.  You go in the kitchen every day for work correct?
I do, but you know I could be hanged for treason.  I do hope you have a fool proof plan.
You want to be a knight correct?!? follow my orders I'm in charge here!
Yes, sire.  I will need something to carry it in.  Maybe we should wait for tomorrow.  It's a beef broth.  Tonight is chicken and it will be to obvious.

Yes good thinking, the chicken broth would be much too light.  You just have to make sure no one see's you.   I will tell the king I am keeping you for training and will not be able to attend work tomorrow.  Just make sure you slip of of there and back to the quarters without being seen.
Very good sir, and if I am caught?  What should I do?
That is not of my concern.  But once I promise you will get any position you desire.  You just can't mess it up.
Well then it shall be as you wish.  I hope I can pull it off.

I believe in you.  Just remember if your caught I can't afford to be a suspect so I might just have to deal with you myself.  I don't think we are going to have to go down that route though.  Good luck
Oh no, I think I learned my lesson from my last knight.  I would not like to revisit those punishments.  Poop Soup it is.  Wish me luck.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Hold, thief! What is a person of your disposition doing on the king's fields?
Are you saying I shouldn't be in this area?
The king doesn't take kindly to criminals like yourself. State your purpose at once!
Do I not deserve a fine horse to match my cunning?
Only if you plan on buying, not stealing. I take it that donkey over there is your current mode of transport?
Yes. Do you like a meat? I have meat.
Don't insult me. Horses are strictly vegetarian!
I have this potato.
Nice try, but I do not bargain with thieves. Plus, I have all the hay I can eat over here.
Why are horses so picky? It's much easier to steal from... that is, to bargain with townspeople in the village.
I'm going to have to ask you to leave the premises now. Don't make me whip you with my mane!
Okay. It's all right. Here you go. I'm going to go now, okay?
I appreciate your cooperation. I'm on a low carb diet to stay in shape, so I'll just pass the potato to your pet donkey over there.
Potatos are good. Thank you for not wasting it. Come, let's go find another horse for me, pet.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: I'm so glad you could meet me here today. The queen is very peculiar about what she wants done.
My aim is to serve the Queen in every respect

I am so glad to hear of your loyalty.  The queen has requested a small prayer room attached to her garden.  This will be close to the king's quarters where he meets with his officials.  I trust you will use discretion regarding this matter.
Does Her Majesty have any particular preference as to style?

Just a modest abode, but as you well know the queen likes to keep tabs on what the king is up to.  So we would need to be close enough to the royal guard to intercept some of the goings and comings.  So you see the actual construct is not important, but the location.
Ah, I understand you. I shall do my utmost
Could I offer you a cup of tea?
Thank you, this is much appreciated
I brought you to the queen's quarters so you could get a taste of her style and proceed with your plans from there.
I do admire these silks and drapes - exquisite taste
Our lady is quite fond of silks.  She is also quite fond of knowing who has been visiting the king.  You wouldn't know about any late night entries into the castle would you?
Certainly not... I have never been to this palace before!
Well while you are working here and employed by the queen, it will be your duty to keep your eyes and ears open when it comes to the matters of the king.  I hope we can agree to this arrangement.
What is in it for me? I will be  taking some risks, of course

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: My Queen
Ah, ghost. Do I happen to know your identity? I do not recognize who you are.
I know a great many things, and can guess a great many others.
Well, I'm not surprised. I sense you have a lot to share. Do you mean to give me some insight?
And what insight do you seek?  Do you suppose the dead can see the future?
I came here to see a very old friend. But it seems he is not around. Asor the future, there are some who can see it. But they are often tough to communicate with.
I have not seen anyone here in a great while.  And I am no seer.
Ah. I suppose he didn't make it. I appreciate the information, ghost.
What realm do you rule in?
Whatever do you even mean, ghost? I am the queen of Viona. You recognized me, didn't you?
Only that you are a Queen.  I am quite unaware of the goings on in the world of the living.
True. I guess I expected a lot. But I guess I'll need to go since he is not going to be coming at all tonight.
Do you have any message for this "old friend", if he should arrive?
Tell him I hoped he would be in attendance for my daughter's wedding. And that the king wishes to chat.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Hello, young peasant. How are you today?
I'm doing awful.  The king works me to wits end.  I don't think I can take it anymore.  I want out of here.
Do not fret my child. All will pass in due time. Are you with a family?
Well..  Not anymore.. Do you want out as well priest?
You have lost your family...? No, young one, I must stay and allow the people to prosper with children and wives.
Well I know where they are but it cannot be revealed.  Soon I will be done with this place and free from the king forever.
You must not understand. You are not granted permission to leave the kingdom. You must remain with the kingdom and produce for the country.
I've been planning many years for this moment!! My family slipped out right beneath your noses now I too shall be out of here!  I gave you a chance priest, but you got in my way!
No, peasant! You are wrong! I cannot let you do evil!
I have done no evil I just want to live a happy life.  I'm out of here.  Have fun being a slave.  You will never find me!
You know not what you do. Out of the kingdom is unsafe for your family. They may be in danger yet.
That's the lies that king feeds you to keep you here.  I have seen on the outside with my own eyes.  People live free happy lives free of rule.
A man can only persuade the unwilling so far. It is in God's hands now. You will see the danger that is out there, but you will need to defend yourself.
It's a shame so many people live under this tyrant.  I will be back some day to free you all from this awful rule.  One day you will see.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Oh! Good evening, chef.
I didn't mean to startle you.  May I fix you anything to eat?
Oh. Well, I would much like a juicy ham sandwich.
Let me prepare that for you.  Where do you hale from?
I hale from Viona. I like to visit people and I like being entertained.
Here is that sandwich.  I made this very same sandwich for the king only yesterday.  I hope you enjoy it.
Thank you very much indeed. Yum!
What type of cuisine is Viona famous for?  I don't get out very much.
We do have very good stews. Beef stew. Chicken stew.
We have stew, yes we do.  I'll make some for you in case you want some tomorrow.
You are very hospitable. Thank you very much.
I am here to serve!
I am also really entertained.
Again, thank you.  May I get you a desert?

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Your Majesty, a token from the queen.  She sends her love.
How thoughtful! I do know that the St. Valentine festival is approaching. What sort of gifts has she been hinting at for this year?
Her lady has been pouring over books about rose gardens lately.  I'm sure that she would be delighted in a garden of her own to bask in.
Roses, is it? They always look so delightful, and then you go to touch them. Poked right in the fingers!
What can I say.  The queen has her preferences.  I'm sure it's nothing the master gardener couldn't figure out.
Ah, 'tis true. She always has been a careful study, before diving into a new hobby. A good sign of character for such a lady of her stature.
Very true, I've always admired her for that.  Does the king have any requests from the lady?
Only that she stay warm in her pursuits of horticulture. The royal library is on the west wall, and tends to get drafty.
I will see to it that she does not get a chill.  We would not want to keep her from you on St. Valentine festival.
And are you well? I know it is tiring work being a constant companion. Is there anything I can do to make you more comfortable?
My benevolent king.  You are always thinking of others.  I do love my job with the queen, true it can be tiresome but it is a worthy task.  I hope your chambermaid is serving you well.
Why yes, I have been served exquisitely. But we are talking about you. You do know my doors are always open if you have a need.
Oh my King, I do know your doors are open to most of the chambermaids and ladies in waiting.  I do appreciate the complement though.
Has the Queen been spreading rumors about the castle again? Come now, be honest.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: My Queen, join me in lounging in our room as we talk of my conquests and of the future of my kingdom.
Ah, I suppose we can do that now. What shall we discuss first?
I just want to hear how many villages we acquired on our last conquest.  What do you think of your king now that we have such an expansive kingdom?
He's looking even more powerful and handsome than usual, I'd say. I believe we acquired around 10 or 11 of them.
Very good, very good.  I shall have my men write to the villages with the new laws of the land.  You my queen are a lucky lady to have married in to such power.
That is true, but you are also lucky to have me to keep you sane despite all that hard, stressful work.
I suppose my dear.  Let us rest from a weary day of ruling.  Shall we call for cake?
Sounds great to me, lets go get a servant then.
Where did you get this locket?
You got it for me last year, remember? Have you gone senile already?
Perhaps, but I should have known it was from me.  I am a generous king, aren't I? The fate of the kingdom rests in my hands.  They should sleep well tonight knowing they are under my rule.
Goodness, that's enough self-flattery for one night, your majesty.
Hold your tongue, woman.  I am your King!
Oh hush, that may be true but you are far too over-dramatic.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Report soldier.
Your majesty, we have taken control of this village on your behalf. It shall be integrated into the kingdom once the civilians have been vetted.
Well done! Here, this shall give you the authority to act in my name.
I am most honored, my King. I will be sure to make your kingdom the strongest the land has ever known!
I sometimes wonder if I am doing the right thing...... waging wars for more territory....
Your majesty, our people know you to be a fair and wise king. But there are others outside our lands who dare to challenge you! We must defeat them before they have a chance to strike first!
Perhaps you are right. The best defense is to always be the aggressor?
Indeed it's better to conquer than be conquered. I'm sure your subjects would agree.
Especially the 40 new subjects in this village I suppose......
All of them have been very cooperative so far in submitting to your rule. Except this milk man here is a bit hard-headed. What should we do with him?
Well, I suppose there is nothing for it but to send him to the camp with the other.... undesirables.
Understood, my king. If he remains uncooperative, I'll be sure to charge him with treason.
Now now soldier, surely the man can be restrained with less force, like this. I really do need to see about improving the training program for you all!
Apologies, your majesty. I will be sure to follow your lead to ensure the reputation of the kingdom is preserved.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Have you seen anything interesting this watch?
Aye, I have.  There was a traveler from the north that was passing through.  I don't trust him a bit.  I fear he's a spy!
I see.... but a spy for whom?
That is the question.  This king has made so many enemies as of late.  I have worked for other armies that didn't see near the action of this regime.
The king is weak. But good enough at making petty decisions I suppose...
Luckily, I am a good aim  with my bow and arrow or this king would have been the death of me long ago.  So what should we do about the traveler?
He should be captured at once! But discretely.
I would do it myself, but I'll be honest, I've been hitting the sauce pretty hard.  I don't know if I can make it down the stairs much less track down a spy.
I will take care of it. I have my ways...... So you are a drunkard?
Only since my wife lost her mind.  You may remember that bridge that collapsed at Muller's glenn.  She was caught under the carriage.  Hasn't been the same sense.
A sad tale indeed. Perhaps this will numb your pain, Absinthe.

Ah, That is the stuff.  I may have to sleep up here to and keep you company.  I'd hate to be caught drunk on the job.  This tower is a pretty lonely place.  What's with the peasant you brought tonight?
Yes, the finest green fairy in all the land. And it most definitely won't turn you into another of my mindless thralls.
I'm just going to close my eyes for a bit.  Maybe the peasant can shoot while I sleep.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Ex-excuse me...Sir...?
Hey! No talking prisoner!
Forgive me! I am lucky to be alive!  You have spared me..but you generosity will be for not if I die of thirst!
Give that back! Listen buddy. Im just a jester who stuck watching you because I didnt make the king laugh enough tonight
I see. Jesters are known to be kind of heart. If you would allow me a drink from the spring nearby, I will tell you stories of my battles.
Hahaha! Im a jester not a fool!
Jester! You've already lost favor with the king! What do you think he will say if he finds out that his invaluable prisoner was left to die under your watch?
Oh? And imagine what would happen if you got away from me! You can last a couple days without water!
I tried to be honorable. You've forced me to be brash. Get out of my way, jester, if you know what is best.
Help help! The prisoner has gone crazy! GUARDS!
You hold your tongue! If you scream again, I will knock you unconscious.
Get off of me!!!!! GUARDS!
The other guards have already left. I heard them gather their things. You really are a fool, jester.
P-please have mercy. think of my family
action: steal stick from a captured knight
steal stick from the man sleeping inside.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Your majesty, is that you?
Don't be so foolish, of course it is I!    We were to meet here to discuss the temple artifacts that rightfully belong in my castle!
Well I am not the owner of this temple, so of what good am I to you?

The temple guard is here to help us.  I assumed since you were one of my royal subjects you would assist me in the transfer of these items.  I have heard tell you have means of transporting precious items such as these discreetly .
Well, yes I do, but that is quite under wraps so I'm surprised that someone as important as you has heard of that. But yes, I can assist in this.
Very good!  I think it goes without saying that the queen also approves of this move.  We rule together and I would not want anyone saying I acted in haste.
Of course, your majesty. So do you know which artifacts we are moving or is that part of the discussion?

Well as you know, my brother the king of the west kingdom has laid claim to these artifacts, but everyone knows that they are rightfully mine.  My father the king before me promised that these would be a part of the castle collection.  So I would like to take all of them.
Every last one? What would that leave of the temple?

There are still luxurious decorations, and people do not come to the temple to seek artifacts they seek to worship.  You do realize that this task will have grave consequences for you and your family if you fail this mission.
Well with that in mind I will surely follow through, but these artifacts are religious just as this temple is, which is why I am concerned for their removal.

Ah this temple was constructed for a king who is said to be of the gods.  You do remember that was said of my father.  As a rightful owner of the artifacts they need to be placed safely in the castle vault to protect them from my brother.
Well.. I suppose that has some logic to it. Well we better begin then.
I hope you have the man power to accomplish this task.  While it is necessary it could cause a great war between our kingdoms if I am seen helping.   We will say bandits have robbed the temple.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Good morning, your majesty. I am here to service your bedroom.
Very well, has the king gone for the day?
I believe he's getting the morning report from the captain of the guard.
Ah very well, I did not hear him wake.  What is on my agenda for today?
You will be accompanying the king later on a visit to the local villages. I've marked the locations on this map.
Very well.  The villagers do love their queen.  But first, breakfast.
I should have your room clean by the time you return. Would you like me to draw you a bath when you're done?

Yes, you know I must wash the dirt from travel away before I can feel comfortable.   Have you readied the faux royal jewels.  I hate to be snobbish but I can't risk them getting lost or stole on our outing.
I have, your majesty. Nobody will be able to spot the difference. Certainly not those peasants!
Excellent.  Those Jewels have been in our family for centuries.  The king would be beside himself if anything were to happen to them or me.  Have you readied our guards?
It is done, my queen. They are all waiting at the gates as we speak.
Ah, the king is punctual to a fault.  Well then, lets get me dressed and out of this bed.
Your majesty, I've prepared a series of dresses for you in your wardrobe. Just let me know which one you prefer.
How about the lightest dress, I'm tired today and I dare say I will be more so after hauling around these trailing dresses in the dirt.
action: steal map of the kingdom from a servant
put map of the kingdom in large bed

setting.name: Small town located in the hills
setting.description: This tiny town is unique in that all the buildings are different colors. It has a candy shop that draws people for miles. A general store that has everything a person could want. The roads are well taken care of and the streets are lines with chairs for the towns people to sit and enjoy each other.
setting.background: This town is the charm of the country side.  Each person that works or live in town take pride in the town, in keeping it clean and in keeping it beautiful. This please is quickly growing as a vacation destination for those that want to relax.

speech: How do you do today?
Well hello stranger, I haven't seen you in these parts lately.   How is the clothing repair I did for you mother?  Hope she is well.
Clothing repair? Oh, it's you, I nearly didn't recognize you! It has held up really well, thank you!
I well you were a small child at the time, but I'd recognize those dimples anywhere.   What brings you to this small town today?
Just here to buy some spices, actually. How about yourself?

I am just purchasing some more thread for the king's new wardrobe.  He is a very picky man, but I try to make sure he looks his best.  If only he paid a little more, I'd be frequenting the candy shop that everyone is so eager about.
The king himself? Are you his tailor? That would be incredibly impressive!

I am, but I am not very valued.  It's a job that barely keeps my family fed.  My wife takes on extra laundry for the castle to help make ends meet, and my children do chores throughout the day.  What have you made of yourself my good friend?
I've taken up blacksmithing myself, I too don't make a great wage but it is enough. Is the king really that stingy as to give you so little coin?

He is.  I am concerned about our kingdom.  It appears he may not have kept the royal treasury secure from bandits.  I fear there will be a great price to pay in the near future.  Blacksmithing is a noble profession, and I'm sure you will be able to find work in other kingdoms should you need to.
Are you sure? That would be quite a strike to the king's... competency.
It is a rumor going around the castle.  You hear many a things when you are mending for the royal family.
Well I surely hope that it isn't true, I feel for the people of this village if he is as bad as you say.
I know, this candy shop will never survive.  Please let me know if you ever need a tailor in your village.  I fear I will be on the street soon.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: What are you doing here, villager?
Got lost, I guess.
And you wandered into the king's room? Are you mad?
Not mad. Ma always said simple, but ain't mad.
I see, well it would be best if you left unless you have a reason for being here?
No reason to be nowhere else. You want some chicken?
I'm quite alright, thank you. I'm going to have to ask you to leave or I will be calling a guard. This is for your own safety, as if the king caught you you would already be dead.
He sounds dangerous. Maybe you oughta have this, protect yourself a bit.
He is dangerous, but only to fools like you who loiter and trespass!
Ain't you lottering too? Loyering? Loinering? Whatever it was you said.
Loitering, loi-ter-ing! God, no wonder you did this, you can't even speak! And he is my husband!
You mean you're the queen? Tolyn Markus, Ma said to me, if you ever meet the queen you're gonna make a fool of yourself, and I reckon she was right.
Well she seems like quite the wise woman, as she was more than correct!
She were the best. And oh she could cook. Her pies was famous!

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Have you come to hear my message, my good man?
Why...why.. yes, preacher. That and I've come to deliver these supplies. My heavens...I've never seen such a beautiful alter.
As a place of sacred worship, we spared no expense in its creation. The Heavenly Father deserves only our best.
Hmm... I see. I was spared no expense when paying taxes to the king. Is this where all my hard earned coin goes?
The church thanks you for your contributions . When it comes time to ascend, you will most certainly be rewarded for your generosity.
Huh. It seems that our "Heavenly Father" awards a select few of his children in this life as well. Who really benefits from this lavish alter? Is it you, Preacher?
I'm not sure I appreciate your tone, young man. Are you suggesting the church is corrupt?
I only asked you a question, sir. Is this not a place of inquiry, of discovery? You seem to be defensive, yet you and the King are happy to accept gifts to your alter.
And do you not feel the blessed feeling when you give to God? As the King is God's right hand man on Earth, it is only fitting that he collect on his behalf.
On his behalf! According to who? This is why the common people will revolt against the King and his corrupt church!
According to God's mandate, of course! I trust you are familiar with the divine right of kings?
The divine right of power, you mean?! Who gave the king this power? He stole it from the people- with your help!
Did you come here just to vilify the king? That's treason and by extension- blasphemy!
I came to deliver these supplies. To help you and the attendees of this church, but I was stricken by the lavish excess of this ridiculous, wasteful altar!
