setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: good day, my king
Greetings! How goes your day?
very fine, my king
Most excellent! Have you any news, or you just here to enjoy the water?
not at all my king, just for the water as yuo said
Good, I too could use some relaxation. I hear that our tax revenues are down in the northern province, which can only mean corrupt officials or disobedient peasants.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Ah, thank heavens you've arrived, master craftsman.  I'm afraid the damage that madman did to our temple is quite extensive.  We've cleaned up as well as we can here, so as not to disturb any visitors, but I'm sure your keen, trained eye can see where the damage has been done.
Aye, that madman sure did a number on this place. Who was he anywho? What did he have against the temple?

Some fanatical zealot, I believe, from the temple of the Divine Chaos.  Of course, he's since started turning to nonsensical ravings since he was captured, so no one can really be sure.  The members of that temple are all a little off their rocker, if you ask em.
I always wonder who starts those crazy followings and what people are insane enough to follow them....

Indeed!  Who can ever countenance following something defies even basic reason?  Long have myself and my brother monks fought against such base evil, for it brings sorrow to those who practice it as well as those who encounter it.

I appreciate your perseverance and passion, monk. This place is in such shambles. It will take me a few days to get this place back to congregation condition. It could be a blessing though, because now you get to design things how you want them. What kind of designs do you want me to create?

Well the four statues could use a good polish.  They are quite massive, so it is difficult to reach all the nooks and crannies on a regular basis.  It would also be marvelous, I think, to have perhaps some alcoves put in so that we could put a small token representing each village, to go with the drapings.
I like your vision, monk! I will get right to work on that, but first...How can we be sure those crazies wont come back and destroy what I just built

Ah yes, of course... here, good craftsman.  You should find enough coin in there for yourself, and if you know if any likely lads that are hiring out as guards for a time, if you could divvy out what you think is appropriate to have a couple just by the door for at least the next fortnight or so.

I do appreciate i, monk, but I am an honest man. I do not want to build something, take your coin, and then as soon as I leave the zealots come destroy this place again. What plan do you have for long term safety? Should we go confront them straight up?

Oh my.  I had not even considered such a thing.  We are a peace loving order and have not taken up arms in many a year.  Where would the people go if their temple caretakers were slaughtered in a foolhardy attempt of revenge?
You have a point, but we must do something to protect this place. The guards are only good for defending, but the king is not taking any action to rid the realm of these heathens!
Even the strongest rock must yield to the slow trickle of water.  Have patience, friend.  We shall persevere here and, in time, our teachings will slowly wear down the rock of hatred and discord.

You are right, monk. I am sorry I got so angry. The truth is, those bastards corrupted the mind of my cousin. He is interlaced with that sorry excuse for a church. I want to lead an uprising against them to go get him back, but the truth is....even if I did. He is probably not the same anymore.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: Hello little child, What is your name?
My name is Bart. It is short for my full name which I cannot pronounce yet.
What a fine name for a fine young man. Are you having fun here today?
Yes I am Your highness. I wish I could come here everyday because there are so many fun things to do and see. I love the treats too!
What was your favorite activity today? Was it learning how to use a sword?
Yes, I hope to one day be a brave knight and protect your Kingdom. Look at what that strange lady over there gave me. She said it would bring me gook luck!
Hmm, I've never seen anything like that before. Let me take a closer look at that. Did she say anything to you when she gave it to you?
Just that I will be one of the greats and I will have good luck in whatever endeavor I decide to take. Whatever that means.
You know, some people believe that you can see the future by looking into a crystal ball.  Look into it and tell me what you see.
That's what she said! I stared at it for while but all I saw was my face all distorted. I must not be doing it right.
Well, perhaps your future will be revealed to you in good time. You should take that home and keep it safe.
Ok, I will put it in my pillow so my brothers can't find it. Can you teach me how to tie a knot?
Of course, grab one end of the rope and, now watch closely, the rabbit runs around the tree and then the rabbit goes down the hole and look, we have a knot. Now you try.
Ok. rabbit, around tree, rabbit down hole. Yes! I did it!
action: give a crystal ball to king
give a crystal ball to child

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: good day sir
Hello Sir, How are you today?
I'm very fine sir, what brings you to the temple?
I am from a country far away, I am learning all about your culture and traditions. Hence the visit, how about you? What do you do here?
I am an executioner,
And what exactly do you execute sir in this temple of your's ?
not in the temple, i execute people sentenced by the king. Not something i'm proud of though
Well I'm glad I am not sentenced here, because I love my family and miss my home. Do you have a family?
I used to have one
Used to? Why what happened?
I used to live in a kingdom far from here, there was a plague that ravaged the whole kingdom. I lost my wife and girl in the process
I am so sorry to hear that, but if there is anything that my travels have taught me. It is that Life must go on and we must move forward
Yes, i agree with, but life's hasn't really been easy without them
I know though I cannot compare with your loss, I have been away from my family for a long time now and miss them too. But I'm glad I can represent the best interests of my country.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: I see my friend, the King, has got himself a criminal on his hands. What are you charged with, fool?
Oh thank goodness, someone who can listen to me.  Please, you must understand, I am innocent!  I have been framed; I wasn't even near the castle that night!
I will not listen! You are beneath me! Framed... yeh right...

No, please, you must see reason.  Why would I even *want* to assassinate the king?  He paid me so well for the work I did on his shoes last year!  It fed my family for a whole month, so why in the Maker's name would I try and hurt him?
YOU TRIED TO KILL THE KING?!?!?! The King and I go way back since we were young chums.  You shouldn't even be alive still!
No, it wasn't me!  Please, don't hurt me!  I've never even *heard* of nightshade before now, nor would I know what it even looks like.  Please, I have a family!
What about the King's family?! Did you even think of them when you tried to kill him?!

Why won't anyone listen to me?  I was out in the woods, checking my traps since I was running low on leather.  The Royal Groundskeeper himself saw me and talked with me - why will no one fetch him and ask him if we spoke?!
Because you are a lowly peasant. The Royal Groundskeeper has mysteriously disappeared...
He... he must have been a part of this then.  From the very beginning!  Wait, he would have had access to the herbalist gardens too...
BAH! Must have been part of it.... YOU SHOULD KNOW! You are the leader!
No one will listen!  I feel like I'm going mad in here.  I have to get out; my family needs me.  You'll help me, one way or another!
GET YOUR FILTHY PAWS OFF OF ME! GUARDDDDSS!
If they come any closer, I'll strangle you myself before they get me.  Now, walk right next to me, and no funny business!

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: I will be done cleaning soon, my King. I am sorry to disturb you.
take your time
I'm very nervous with you her, my King. Usually I am all alone whilst I am working.
i insist that you continue
Yes, of course. Tell me King, did you slay this bear yourself?

yes, it was on morning like this, we had toiled all night and found only little animals. Then suddenly i heard one of the guards scream i rushed down there and found a bear trying to attack him. The rest is history
Wow, you must have been quite frightened. Were you always such a brave warrior.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Hello my queen, what brings you to these headquarters?
The better question is perhaps what are you doing here Duke? Are you plotting to overthrow the King!
I would never! I heard of this place and wanted to see what these scum were planning for myself.
Hmm, I'm pretty sure I saw that guerilla over there calling you sir and asking what he should do next.
My Queen! You know I am loyal to the King. I would never betray the kingdom.
Even though the King has gone mad and become cruel? Even then you will continue to support the King?
With my life, your majesty.

Let me get this straight, You are in the revolutionaries' secret headquarters, they come to you for instructions and yet you deny that you are trying to overthrow the monarchy. It is hard for me to believe!
It is all for the King. I want to get behind enemy lines, your Grace!
Perhaps you have an explanation for what you've written in this book about how you should become the new king. Take a look and explain yourself.
That is not my handwriting! I'm being framed!
That's too bad. I think you would have made a fine choice for a new king. My husband must be stopped.
You dare speak foul of the king! I will tell him at once!
You will do no such thing. I am the Queen, do not forget your place, Duke or your next breath will be your last.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

character: a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop
speech: Well, are you ready to run?
yes my king, i was born to
I saw a path we have not been down before on our last run. Let's go see what we can find.
as you wish my king, hop on
Maybe we might find a fancy female horse for you. You are such a handsome horse. You deserve a girlfriend don't you?
that would be nice, my king
room_agents: an a horse tied up in front of a shop
an a horse tied up in front of a shop
an a horse tied up in front of a shop
an a horse tied up in front of a shop
an a horse tied up in front of a shop
an a horse tied up in front of a shop

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hello, blacksmith.
Hey there! Welcome to the Scorched Hammer. What can I do for you?
Well, you know, I wanted a knife, but I think you've got the point.
Aye, and would this be a jesting knife? Not rightly sure I know what that would be. What kind of knife are you looking for?
It's just a hobby of mine to own knives. I like ones with jewelled handles.
I can do that. It would be a custom order though. Not too many come by here have the coin for that sort of work. Any preferences?
Well, just little emerald cuts are good. I don't need anything too exquisite. Just fancy enough for it to be enchanting.
Certainly. I can have that ready for you in a week's time. Would come to about 20 crowns.
Look in the shoe.
Very good. What brings you through Alderton, if you don't mind my asking. We don't get too many jesting folk these ways.
I entertain throughout the kingdoms. It's fun. King doesn't always want me, so I go where I like.
I see. You'd certainly be welcome down at the pub. Old  Gabbar thinks he has quite the quick wit, would be nice to have some real entertainment and show him up.
I like to surprise. Maybe I shall do that.
Where else have your travels taken you?

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: I've got my eye on you criminal, you'd best not be looking to steal wares from our lovely, local general store!

You've got me all wrong!  I'm not trying to steal anything, good sir.  I'm only worried for my life, you see.  I was falsely accused and am going to die for something I did not do.  Will you have pity on me and help me escape?
Harumph! I've known you long enough to know your ways, you stole milk from my family just last month! What is it you're running from now vagrant?

I'll admit, I did steal your milk.  My wife who is 6 months pregnant with child was hungry.  I could see in her gaunt face that she needed some sustenance. Now though, I have been accused of stealing horses from the local stable.  I am innocent of this crime! I just want to see my baby born and try to lead a better life from now on.  If only I had the chance!

I can certainly understand the desire to care for your family but theft is not the way. Several farmers in the area are looking for hands to tend to their fields, the king's army has been recruiting for city protection, and even this lovely general store had a posting last week for a clerk position.

If given the chance, I will change my life around and accept a more appropriate way of getting money for my family.  You see, this is the way I was raised and all I've ever known.  My Father left my Mother and I when I was just a young lad.  Mother had to steal food to feed us and walked the streets at night. I've been a petty criminal for as long as I can remember but now with a young one on the way, I want to change.
And how do you plan to change friend?! What steps are you taking other than seeking out help to run from the law?

I mustn't carry on any further with this charade. I will begin with being honest with you. I did indeed steal the horses from the local stable but it was the stable master who was planning to kidnap and poison the King, not I.  I was only caught with his pouch of poison and note demanding payment!
In that case you need to turn yourself over and state your case. Do you expect to live your life on the run with your wife and, soon, your baby?!
I will never turn myself in.  I will surely die by hanging if I do.  I must now find a horse and gather enough food for a few days ride. I will escape this horror.
I won't have you running about in this or any other village criminal! I'll drag you to the king myself if you won't proceed willingly.
You forget, I am the criminal here!  I eat men like you for breakfast! Fight me if you must, it will be the last thing you do.
I fear you underestimate my strength and influence in this village! Every patron in this establishment will side with me, we'll hang you with your own rope on the patio outside if necessary.
I'll stab you before you even have a chance to think twice about it!

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Oh wow, the guards' room!  I hope someday ta measure up to be a guard.  Maybe I'll fight a dragon someday!
That's the spirit lad! Here take this.
Ouf!  I-i-t's not too heavy.  I could carry this... all day without breakin' a sweat, I could.
You will grow into it! Do you one day hope to protect the king?

Y-yes, sir, lordly knight guard, sir!  I mean, I sure hope to, someday.  Stable master says I need ta stop, erm, knocking over the horse feed and being such a lazy lout afore I get ahead of myself though.
Maybe you weren't meant to be a stable boy? I need a squire!
Wh-what! Me!  Honest, good sir?
But you need to be quick! See, I just took this from you in a blink of an eye!
Ah, shoot!  I didn't even see ya move, yer so fast!
Years of practice my boy. Just yesterday I saved the King from an assassin sent from the Kingdom Uretha.
What?  That was you!  The whole stable was talkin' about it.  "Dark as night" 'e was, they said.  And ye were a "gleamin' beacon of hope" that stopped 'im.
Yes, that was me. It was an amazing experience. Protecting the King is my life.
If I be yer squire, sir guardly knight, I promise ta do me best ta protect ye!  And the king, too! I.. I promise upon me mum's grave, I do.
I know you will young lad. I see the potential in you.

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: Good afternoon your Grace. I come here today to plead the case on behalf of farmers. We will not be able to survive if these heavy taxes are placed upon us.
I understand that.  I am a king though and I expect everyone to bow to me
Of course your grace. Excuse my ignorance I am not of this land. I have just moved here to find land to farm.
If you just moved here, feel free to move back to a land where the taxes are cheaper.  I have a lot of responsibilities.  I don't have the patience for strangers complaining about taxes.

If I may your Grace. I was nominated to speak for the farmers as in my own land I was in charge of the farmers council. My own land was destroyed by the dragons. My old land flourished because the farmers were able to stay in business because of fair taxes. A fair tax rate allowed the town to flourish and in turn more profit for you.

setting.name: Visitor's Entrance
setting.description: The visitor's entrance features a large wooden double door. The door is beginning to shown signs of aging as splinters poke out of it's surface, but it's size and mass still cast awe onto oncoming visitors. In a cast iron display on each side of the door one can see the Goddess' insignia. The door is reinforced horizontally with an iron lock.
setting.background: The visitor's entrance provides a means for the pious to make their way into the Hall of the Goddess, but can be locked in times of need. It allows the clergy to prevent people from coming in during moments of private ritual.

speech: Oh, hello there Priest. I have collected plenty of alms today for the needy.
You are most faithful, my friend.
also, this was sent from the palace. Seems urgernt.
Oh. I hope nothing has occurred which needs my attention. I planned to not go back so quickly.
Sir, why do you have wine?
Do you not like wine?
I haven't had wine in years. I swore it off after that unfortunate incident.
Well. It helps me keep my good charm.
You shouldn't be drinking sir. I remember the last prayer you lead when you were drunk.
I didn't realize it was to baptize the child. It looked like it was a wedding.
Yes, sir. It was weird for the mother to be wearing that big white dress. J
I can't always be good.
Well, as long as you do your duties. I hope you look at that scroll soon
I have to go into the palace to meet with a king it looks like.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: Good day, my leige
You enter the hall of King Minar. What business do you have here?
Just looking for a any job, i'm hungry
Who are you, where are you from?
I'm one of the towns folk
I'm afraid the King is too busy to help every commoner find work. He has the needs of the whole kingdom first. Perhaps I can help though. Tell me, what work have you done?
I'm mostly a farmer, but i do almost any kind of menial job
Tell me, why did you leave your farm?
Sold all my proceeds to take care of my dying wife, now i have no seeds to plant
I feel for your plight. Go down to the stables; I believe they need a few new hands. The stablemaster's name is Lomm. Tell him Captain Dolis sent you.
I'm really grateful, my liege
Do you know your way to the stables?
Not at all, But i was hoping one of the servants will direct me
Of course. You there! Show this man to the castle stables.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: Hello, good sir! How are you on this fine day?
Ah, my lord King!  Pardon me for skipping over the usual pleasantries, but rudeness is an unfortunate side effect of hast.  And the news I bear simply cannot wait.
What is going on? Is everything okay?

I've just received word by carrier pigeon.  Our ally, Richque, has fallen.  I'm afraid the enemy overpowered their walls far more easily than we thought possible.  And there's worse news, I'm afraid...
Oh, no..... Not Richque.... Worse?! What could be worse?!
My spies have told me that there may be.. dragons involved.  I had thought they could not possibly be tamed, but, there is word that several assisted in the attack.
Dragons? But, I haven't seen any around these regions in years.. How is this possible? Do we know which kingdoms they hail from?
I have not been able to discover yet, my King.  They follow no norms of battle, send no demands for surrender.  Their only motive seems to be to conquer and destroy.  It is beyond reason!
We have to tell our men at once. I don't even know where to begin. This doesn't seem possible! We need to start training!
Wait - who is this merchant?  Should he be privy to this discussion?
I've never seen this man before..... How did he get past the guards?
He does not speak, and I don't believe I've seen him blink the entire time we were here.  Could it be... is this some enemy trick, an illusion sent to spy on us?
There's only one way to find out! I will not let this kingdom be destroyed!
No, step back, my King!  That may exactly what they want!  Pardon me for daring to touch your royal personage, but I must restrain you lest this foul magic injure you.

setting.name: cactus field entrance
setting.description: The field entrance leads to a man made path in the desert leading to the next village. It is hot and barren. There is barely any form of plants or animals besides a few cactus. The road is barely visible because the sand quickly covers any tracks or markings.
setting.background: The desert is a very unkind place to all. It is dangerous and many have died wandering around looking for water and treasures. Many have heard stories of the cactus field and its mysterious placement in the middle of nowhere. Very few actually survive to reach these fields, and no one has come back to tell about it.

speech: hey there
I need to find some water.
i was about asking you for thesame, I'm lost and i'm a stranger in this town
I was just messing with you. Don't you have a sense of humor?
I'm sorry, i was just too thirsty
It's okay take a swig out of this canteen.
that would be a good idea, i think
What made you come out this way?
Heard the king was looking for a new cook
Perhaps can you cook for this village.
i think i'll pass on that, it's either the king or no one
You sure you can't take up that offer.
no
Okay will you be on your way soon to wherever you are going?

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: I see our friendly rodents have stopped by my humble kitchen again. Would you like some extra sharp cheddar perhaps?
No, not a rodent. I am the royal guard. Can't you tell by my large sword and and armor?
Of course, pardon me. How may I assist you?
Hmm...What smells so good. Is that cheese soup? I also smell some fresh crusty bread to soak it up with.
That is a nice cheddar/broccoli soup with some nice bacon added in and the bread is fresh from the oven!
Oh! That sounds so splendid. Yes, I would like some of that!
Coming right up! So, what have the Royal Guards been up to this cold day? Here's your soup and bread, have a seat here by the fire
Well this morning they chased me around for a bit and tried to step on my with their big ugly boot. Then While they were napping I stole their stuff!

What a quick and clever fellow you are! They shall get into some royal trouble I am sure for their missing equipment. Whatever will you do with a sword, that flea bitten cat they keep outside can't be that much of a threat.
Those guard will be the ones in trouble for miss placing their gear and the Kings sword to boot. hahaaha! I love payback.
They were about due for it I am sure. But, surely they will come looking for it? What then?
I will hide it all in the queens chambers. I'm sure both the King and Queen will get a kick out of that.
I'm sure they will! We are fortunate to have such kind and benevolent regents. However those guards may not find it so humorous
You are my best friend! I will bring you a gift tomorrow for sure!

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Good evening guard
Good evening sir.  May I be of assistance to you today?
You see that old wooden door there. Where does it lead?
That door leads to the dungeon sir.
Ah. I see. I heard voices behind there. They sounded as though they were plotting something.
There is a beggar in the dungeon that goes by the name Aladdin.  He speaks to himself often.  The poor fool thinks he has a genie!
Does he now? What a fool!
Is there anything else I may help you with?
Yes yes. Take my purse for me for a moment. I have an important note in my robes that I must find.
I am sorry, but I cannot hold your purse for it could slow me down in protecting the king.
Well then! Clearly you don't know who I am. I'm a noble! A very important person around here!
I know who you are, but I serve the king and the king alone! Now tell me your business here before I throw you in the dungeon with Aladdin.
I was invited to a banquet and I am on my way there now. Not that it is any of your business!
The banquet is being held in the banquet hall.  The banquet hall is back the way you came.  Follow the corridor around and take your third right.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Hows it going today?
Good sir. I always envisioned myself gaurdian the king while he defecates. ever since i was a young boy.
Thank you sir knight. Would not want to get caught with my pants down!
aye who knows what kinds of threats lie just around the next pile
I'm thinking about haveing my builders put in an open air sky light. That would brighten thing up here here a bit and let out some of the stink
Aye that would certainly make it a bit nicer in here. The things i here from some of the peasants youd think they could smell your royal hiney from here. what id give to smack a few around your lord.
Oh..don't worry about it. Everybody poops.
That is why you are the king sir. Such eloquence.
I wish I didn't have to make so many trips in here. It's that chef. He keeps feeding me beans! Say they are good for me and will make me stay strong.
Ive always suspected the chef of being a conspirator. maybe we should serve him up for supper on the morrow.
The queen won't let me. She agrees with him. Some sort of fad diet she is on after the prince was born. She is looking pretty skinny these days. Maybe time to have another child.
hah if only i were your maester sir id suggest a new child every new moon. the cry for battle requires many young babes.
That would be too many children in line for the thrown. They would kill eachother.
ahh sir i only mean spreading your royal seed around the kingdom would only strengthen the hardiness of our people..anonymously of course

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Hello good Knight.
Hello King, you seem busy.
I am, I am sorry I am distracted today.  I beg your forgiveness.
No problem, I know the life of a King is busy! What are you doing in this Arsenal?
I want your opinion on the condition of our arms.  I fear we may be under attack soon.  Do we have enough weaponry to defend ourselves?
I think this is our best choice. We should equip everyone in the royal army with these.
Why this?  Isn't it too close quarter?
The war will be fought face to face on the battlefield. We will have to assert our dominance over our enemy. These instill fear.
I like your point of view.  Do we have enough to equip the army, or do we need to increase production?

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: So, this is the thug who wanted to murder me?
take it easy sire
Why should I take it easy on someone wanting to kill me?
No sire take it easy
No, I won't take it easy on you!
I was wrongly accused and I said that so many times already
You were the one standing over me laughing..with a sword.
Iron maiden I think you believe me tell him
Stop giving orders to people!!!!
Since you are bent on killing me, I guess I will be rough on you with my word oh king
Have you met my wife? You can't say anything worse than her! If you didn't do it tell me everything you know about the plot to murderme.
I had your wife as my lover so if you couldn't control her know that it was your fault
You and everyone else lad.
So what are you going to do about it because I am sure after you kill me your life will be a living hell. Or maybe I will escape and continue sleeping with her in your face

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Oh, king. I need to find a safe place for the people of my village.  Is there a camp north?
Well how did you come into place
I now have been walking for days. I am tired. My people are tired and not feeling well.
OK help me with my sword so that we both can rest
I will do whatever I am capable of.
How far is your village from here
The problem is that. We have no real village anymore. It was raided. So we look for a safe camp.
OK I am well known and my wife is queen maybe you can relocate to my village and be protected there
Is there any way to show you gratitude? We would never have stood much of a chance I think if you didn't help us.
Yes help me let's see all those paintings on the wall
Okay. Let us see.
I hope you are not scared of death because it's written all over you
Well, I hope now we shall be free of that.
OK good let's be on our way

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Ugh! I'm so happy the king has left and taken his dirty dogs with him!
This beautiful forest was being overrun by those yapping dogs!
Yeah, they were all chasing me! I'm totally worn out, and hungry.
Please just stay away from my worms. I need to go poop.
No problem. I usually just stick with grass and berries. Maybe a flower here and there.
Thank you, it is exhausting flapping these wings and looking for tiny worms all day. Then, WOOSH! Another bird swoops in and snatches it.
Your welcome  Thanks for the hug, I needed one. I wonder what that wolf is doing over there? I hope he isn't eye balling me.
I think he might be. He looks hungry.
Why don't we quietly and slowly walk to the pond. I could use a drink of water before I have to outrun him tonight.
Good idea, over that way should be safe
I don't know why I'm having such an unlucky day. I'm so mad I'm libel to beat the crap out of that mangy wolf!
Oh. You sound pretty upset. What's happened today that is so bad? It is so peaceful here, it is hard to be angry.
The King, the hunters, the dogs, the wolf all wanting to eat me. I don't know.
Maybe you need another hug. But, right after I snatch that worm! Mmmm.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Hmph, 'scuse me customer. Yer in my way.
Sorry sir, it's just so crowded today at the Bazaar.
Ya should watch out for my kind. Warriors like myself don't react well to bumps.
I do apologize, I'm only in town for the day to buy some salt and meat with my family.  We appreciate your service to the King, sir.
Fine, fine. Be sure to watch out for that drunkard over there, he's been known to swipe pouches of gold from unsuspecting patrons of the Bazaar. I'd slit his throat meself if he weren't protected.
Ah sir, my son and wife are with me!  I understand that warriors can be eager for battle.  Has is been so long since you've seen it?
Lust of blood drives me surely as that slob's lust of booze.
Sir, I understand your distaste.  We really need to get to the butcher of the town.  Do you know him?  I hear he was once a guard in the king's army.
Geoff the butcher is a fine friend of mine. He saved my life in the Battle of Euriphany to be sure.
And what of his wife.  I heard she has taken ill?  I would not be so nosey, but buying meat from a man is serious business when it come to the the health of my wife and son.
Ya shouldn't believe every whisper ya here is this bazaar, his wife has taken solitude after the loss of her father Sir Knevigh.

Ah yes the mighty ruler of the valley.   Such a sad loss for the country side.  I am glad to see that she did not fall ill due to tainted meat.   I'm sure it was a rumor started by another butcher.   Sir will we be able to keep the peace with Sir Knevigh gone?

We have no threats greater than what my blade can handle. Take this telescope and point it toward the east tomorrow at sunset, you will rest easy all your days after you see me on the field of battle.
Thank you dear warrior!  Our small farm could not survive without the protection of are noble army!

setting.name: pier walkway
setting.description: On the seashore facing the pier, seagulls squawk as they swirl overhead. The smell of salt fills the air, and the gentle, dull roar of the waves lapping the beach is omnipresent. A gentle breeze blows, and the chatter of the villagers fishing drifts down to the shoreline from the pier.
setting.background: The fishing pier is immediately accessible from this small walkway that extends form the beach.

speech: Hey, do you have any fish? Any food?
Ah Bird...I should have known you were akin to the magical creatures of the forrest.  You should know I would be punished for talking with you.  I have no fish, only this canteen to quench my thirst.
Squaaaak! Nothing magical about me, just hungry.

You do yourself a disservice.  A talking bird like you could make a fine name for yourself in the village.  Just don't let the officials catch you.  They don't allow us to travel into the forrest behind our town.
It's nothing special, I just hear sailors and fishermen talk a lot and I picked it up. Anyone could do it. Speaking of fishermen, think you could distract that guy there for a second?
Ah My good friend, James!   It's been ages since I've seen you old chap!  .....How was that?
Aha! got some fish from his bucket. You're a real pal! Say, what's your name?
I'm called Daniel the Sluggard.  I hale from the very old village.  We get a bad reputation, but we are nice folks.   What do they call you?
Not a good way it to say my name in your language, but you can call me Roger. I heard a sailor called Roger, seemed like a good name.
Roger that, Roger.   What's the word on the high seas?  Any signs of the dreaded pirates from the east?

Mostly I just see the little fishing skiffs. Trade cog came in not too long ago. They must not have been from around here because I couldn't understand them at all! Their cargo sure smelled interesting.
Ah, It must be the exotic squid that the king is having brought in for the royal feast.  I'm sure our village won't be invited because we have such a bad reputation.  Really we are good people.
Well you seem nice enough, anyway. What's this about not being allowed in the forest?

The forrest is known to have magical creatures, I have seen some myself.  The villagers are not allowed in the forrest for fear that we may fall in league with one of this mystical beasts.  I don't think they are evil, but the town priest has convinced the officials they will bring a plague to our town!

setting.name: old docks
setting.description: The shore near the docks. There is fog except on rare occasions. More dangerous than most people would like. You never know what dangers luck from creatures leaving and entering the waters.
setting.background: The light house and docks near it are the safes place because of the lighthouses enchantments. Protecting travellers. The shores themself as well as the waters are dangerous. The creatures that live in the water are not to be taken lightly any one who does regrets it.

speech: Where you the one who save me from my prison, oh fisherman?
I am not Princess. I just came upon this old dock to do my ceremonial fish bringer dance.
I was locked away in a tower, in a far away land! For all of my life, I am unsure of how I got out here on these old docks with you.
Oh Princess we must tell the King and Queen about your return.
Not so fast! It has been ages since I have been free!
Do you think they have something to do with it.
It could be. But none the less, I have not got to smell fresh air since I was a little girl! Though, the air is quite foggy tonight.
HEre try this princess. They are sweets from the local shop.
Oh my goodness! These are delicious! Thank you so much. Tell me fisherman, was do you do besides fish?
Fishing is my life. I am the envy of the other fisherman. When I am not fishing I like to go to the pub for some ale and fun.
Ale? That sounds wonderful! I have never heard of such a treat. It seems very dangerous out here/

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: How may I serve you, King?
Come and relax. Sit. This is a place for everyone to come and enjoy.
Thank you so much for your kindness, dear King.
You work hard. and you should enjoy things. Do you have family?
I have a mother, but she is very ill.
What is going on with your mother?
She has the fever with red spots that is spreading throughout the kingdom.
I hope that she gets better and I give you my scepter. Sell it to help you with your mother and any other essentials you need.
Dear King, this is why you are so loved throughout the land. How may I repay you for your kindness?
you need not repay me. I give to you because it is needed and you deserve to have enough to help your mother.
My family and I will be indebted to you for all of our days.
I just want your mother to get better. Is there any other family that does not live with you
I have cousins off in distand lands. My father died fighting in the war.
What war was that?

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: You there, what is this place?
Excuse me, that is no way to address an official of the king
Oh I'm sorry. Can you please tell me about this place, I am from the city.
That's more like it, this is the famous room where our first king slaughtered the monster who had been responsible for over 50 deaths that year
Do you have any thing to show what the monster loooked like?
sadly none, asides from descriptions in history and folktales
So do you have any cool animals around here?
none around here, you'll have to go to the kings personal zoo, I can have one of the maids take you there after you're done here
Alright sounds good!
So, how are you finding our town, hope we've falling below your expectations
No it's pretty nice. Can I take a nap right here?
if you're comfortable here, then feel at home
Okay great, will you make sure no animals attack me?
The guards will be on the watch, you're very safe

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Why does the weapons room require to have a therapist?
I came to see you. The king has suggested that I ask you if you have any injuries or just want to talk
I am not necessarily injured but I am interested in obtaining a more valuable weapon since I and my father before me have served the king with great nobility

Injuries are more than just to limbs. Sometimes an injury can be to you mentally. If you would like to talk. I know that some wars can cause issues with the men. You are definitely noble and brave and so was your father.

Thank you for the offer. War can be tough on the mind and body it is great to know that our King looks to take care of us as we do for him. I am a proud knight and I would love to see what I can do to be more loyal to the King
Have you spoken with him? He may think you are doing so much more than you realize.
No, I have not spoken with him. I come from a lower-ranking noble family and I would not wish to disturb the King. Do you think he would allow myself to be in his company? Should I remove my armour?
If he asks that I make sure you are well in every aspect, don't you think he would make time to talk with you?
I would love to speak with him directly to see how I can serve him better. What would you like to know to help determine that I am fit to see him?
We need to make sure you are strong physically and mentally. He wants all his men to be able to keep doing what they have been so deemed to do. Such as you a knight!
I have been trained very well, I assure you that I am strong mentally and physically and capable of so much more. I would like to prove my worth
Just show me that you can handle the equipment that you use in the way it is intended so that i can see you have no physical injuries.
Do you request that I fight someone in a battle? I am ready to do so.
No just pick up the weapons and use them the way you would as if you were in battle

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: I wish the darn vikings would just go away. It would be nice to have a break from this constant fighting
Oi! if you would have slipped away with me when we had the chance we could have been halfway to Ragnarok by now counting our spoils.
The king has paid me well to be here and fight. Not to run off without doing my job. My reputation is important to me
Yes yes. honor and glory. All lies. Do you think a room closer to the king is worth getting a bolt in the belly for?!

Not all lies! I've worked hard to become an excellent archer and have fought in several campaigns and will get through this one as well. No, I don't want a bolt in the belly either, but there are no guarantees in life and we must do the best we can!

Whoopdee doo. the skillful archer claims yet another victory for the king. But you will never see half the spoils or fame that that fat sod gets just for sitting on his royal fannie all day. While we are out here on the battlements fighting for his mistakes.
True enough, he could have avoided all this if he hadn't tried to take Skoren's territory for his own, but he has paid us to do a job. Will I work for him again? No!

Now you are speaking my language. Study this. Maybe you can decipher it better than a brute like myself, seeing as i cant read. When the battle is won and done let us make haste to the location on the map and split the spoils. 40/60 of course, being that im the curator of the map.
This map looks legitimate, there really could be a treasure there! I agree to the split. You risked much to obtain this. Let's get through this and then off to the bounty that awaits us
Wonderful. And gods be dont remind me we have 5000 screaching Skoren a days march from us. Let us insect these battlements one last time.
Yes, let's make sure we're ready for the heathens! Hang on to the map and take care of yourself!
God speed. Let me just hide it inside of my false treasure map just in case.
Good idea, now let's make sure those brutes don't put a bolt in either of us!
HAHA. These mindless heathens scare me not. Little more than sailors and bandits. Im betting their bolts couldnt even penetrate me bare skin.
action: give a treasure map to archer
give a treasure map to soldier
put a treasure map in a treasure map

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: hello guard
What are you doing here?
I'm not sure, the last thing I knew I was in the King's massage parlous. I just woke up down here
It's my duty to protect the king, so i think you should leave
If you love the king so much why don't you just marry him?
We are secretly married.
you are so brave, however I am wearing a wire for the Queen. She will be outraged, but also slightly aroused as she's quite kinky.
Oh cool, we can all go back to the massage parlour then i guess
excelsior!!!!!!! I just got paid yesterday so it's on me. Rub and tugs for all
Let's start taking clothes off now
it's my shoe now, I'm taking this as a reminder and also to wear as a jock for my servant league hockey game at the weekend
That...is an odd place to wear it but whatever. I'll be sure to come watch you play big boy

I'm using it as a jock because i'm a foot long down there. I look forward to it. As you can see i'm the chief servant comedian as well as royal family dresser and secret purveyor of massage parlours. I lead a busy life :(
Cool, now you're a guard too. I'm bored with this gig. I'm going to go live in the woods and jump out at people to scare them.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Good day Sire
Good day!! Have you made all of these weapons that line your walls?
Yes Sire we have handcrafted each of these. Do you see any that you like?
They are all marvelous! What is that you are working on at the moment?
A double edged sword. We could make one Custom stamped with your house emblem for you and your knight sire. If that is what you so desire.
That would be great sir blacksmith! Tell me what do you charge for such a sword?
It would be an honor and a privlidge to make one as a gift for you Sire and for your knight maybe 20 silver shillings. Does this sound fair to you my lord?
That is all! Ha, I can afford to pay you triple that!
I will only accept that ammount if you are absolutely satisfied with the final product.
If it ever needs a good mending or sharpening, I will come to you to fix it?
You have my word sire, Are there any other items that spark your interest. Pherhaps a coat of armor or a sheild?
Why yes, I do enjoy a good mace! Have you got any more?
Yes of course we do , allow me to tend to this iron and I will gladly show you the maces I have available
take your time dear blacksmith!

setting.name: Collapsed West Wing
setting.description: The rocks have all but fallen into the ocean.  There is moss and other plant life climbing the remaining rocks, making it a very moist and gloomy environment.  There are some small left-behind pieces of what appear to have been some furniture, and possibly a cradle.
setting.background: The noble had recently brought a child into the world with his wife when this wing of the home went crashing into the ocean.  It is not know if the child perished or  not, but a crushed cradle can be seen through the rubble in the collapsed wing.

speech: good day sir
Wife, you bring me solace during this great time of war and famine.  The West Wing has all but collapsed into the ocean.  This was once a castle to be proud of.
yes my husband, i wish things hadn't turned out this way
But alas, we must save face.  I hope you have your wardroom secure in the East wing.  We are expected at the King's banquet.
I'm almost set just trying to get the kids ready
Ah the Kids, If only little Charlotte had not been sleeping in the west wing during the attack.  I blame myself!
Don't cry my love

Have you practiced what you will say to the Queen tonight?  They must not know we have failed to rule our portion of the Kingdom.  No one has survived to tell the tale but our family.  As a noble of the court I cannot let my king down.
yes
Very well then, let us take to the ball and defraud our leader once and for all.
Anything for you my husband
My brave woman, you have been through so much.  I dare say your wretched mother will need to be secured in the dungeon before we leave.  Her loose tongue will be the end of us.
Can't we just send her some where far from here

I could trade her to the pirates if you'd rather, but you know she has the ability to sink ships with those loose lips of hers.  I cannot be outed to the king.  I hold a powerful position in this society!

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: I need to be protected at all times.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen as you may well know. How long have you been a Knight?
I have been a knight for many years.
Very good.....This is a beautiful shop. Love the flowers.
Flowers are very nice.
What brings you here today?
I wanted to find  some decorations.
I am soon to be married to a prince from a nearby kingdom
That is good to hear. I was only joking I'm here to protect the decoration shop.
Protect it from what, decor thieves? haha...that was a joke.
You never know who is out there!
I suppose, i am here purchase items i need for the wedding.
What items are you buying?
Whatever is useful....however, after the wedding a peace treaty will be signed....I feel like i may be being used for that.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Hello.
Hello, can I help you with something?
Can you clean this for me?
Is this your shield of honor?
Yes.
Thank you for keeping us safe.
I would do anything to keep the king and the royal family safe/
Very much appreciated all your hard work.
What is your name?
My name is TIm. I own this land.
I have to leave.  I have a meeting with the king.
What is your meeting about?
The king is about to take a long trip and we have to plan our route.
Thank you for your service to our great king.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: What are you doing here? This no place for a chef.
I don't know why I'm here, except that the king gave this paper for you to read. your eyes only.
Well why did you say so sooner! Let's see what this says.
I think I did say so!
You may well have, I was lost in thought. It seems I have a quest to embark on. Do you wish to travel with me to city at the end of the valley?
I came all this way. I would be very grateful to follow you to the city.
I would welcome your companionship and perhaps a bit of decent food on the journey. Can you fight if the need arises?
I can fight and make a meal fit for a king!
You sound like the perfect travelling companion. Let's be off!
This is going to be a marvelous travel. I am ready.
It looks like you can provide some entertainment too!
That I can! We all have hidden talents haha
Just remember, dangers lurk around every corner and in every shadow. Never let your guard down and don't wander off alone.
I will stick close and watch over my shoulder all the time.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Ah good, the feast for my Tenth Anniversary of Kingliness seems to be coming along quite nicely!
Oh sire forgive me, You startled me. Yes the feast is coming along nicely.

There, there, little Martha.  My, you've certainly grown since I saw you last!  I remember when your mother first brought you here, you were just a wee bairn then!  My apologies, my dear, for startling you.
My mother adores you sire. Thank you for the privledge of serving you. My apologies for trying on this hat. It is so beautiful and the temptation was so great.

Ah yes, it is quite a fancy one, isn't it?  It does, I find, get rather heavy with time.  Here, my dear, your broom.  The truth of the matter is, I came down here knowing you would be here.  I would have a word with you.
You came for me Sire? How can I be of service?

Well, I have discussed this with your mother and... I believe you are old enough now to know the truth.  You are not merely the daughter of a servant of this castle... you are also the daughter of a man who was a prince, and is now a King these ten past years.
Really Sire, How can this be? I have been a servant my entire life.

My child, your mother wanted you to experience a life as a normal girl, free from the cares and worries of one who might rule.  And, in truth, I sought to keep my distance from you to protect you.  I have enemies who, should they know of you, would seek to harm me through you.
It is hard for me to wrap my thought aroud such revalations Sire. Please tell me if this is true,what it means for my future.

Well, I would leave that for you to decide, my child.  For I have no heir to inherit my crown, as I could not bare the thought of marrying anyone else but your mother, commoner though she may be.  But I think you, having grown up and lived among the people, would make a wise and just ruler.  It will be a life full of sacrifices, though, so chose wisely, my dear.
Sire can I please take a night to think on these decisions? I fell as though these choices must not be made in haste.

Such wisdom already shows much promise in you, for it is, indeed, not a path to be chosen lightly.  When you have made your decision, simply come to my chambers with this scepter to say I had given it for you to clean.
Thank you for your understanding and for the kind words spoken over me. I will resolve to have my decision and the sceptre back to you by the fortnite.

setting.name: soldiers camp
setting.description: The camp is hidden away in a light forest of trees and brush that might be hard to find if there had not been a symbol on the trees leading up to it. You can feel the anxiety of the soldiers here, as this camp is not well fortified by any conventional means, but instead is supposed to be hidden and camouflaged to throw off anyone that might pursue. The camp is nothing more than a fire and some barracks. Nothing fancy to see.
setting.background: This soldiers camp was created as there was need for a training and resting area for the soldiers of the king's royal army. The location is ideal as they have water and material. The king himself was excited by this spot.

speech: How long are we to wait at this camp? I don't think it is very safe

I thought I was impatient, good man.  As future leader of this kingdom, I demand we wait until morning.  My father's personal guards should be able to protect him from the onslaught at the castle... or not.  Either way, we wait until morning!
This camp is not as well hidden as it may seem. The other soldiers are unsettled. Why do you wish to wait until the morning to proceed? Where do you plan on heading next?

We will wait here.  Do not fear the bandits that have raided the castle.  They are not after us, they are after the crown.  We have nothing to fear from them as long as we stay here.   I plan on heading to the barracks to sleep for the night and you should do the same.

My Liege, I might have something of interest to you. I came across a map that can lead us to valuable treasure. Seeing that this camp is unfit for us to stay hidden I strongly suggest we pursue this treasure!
Let me see this!  Does my father know about this treasure?  Has he hidden this from me?
This map does not belong to you! I can lead us to the treasure if we leave right now. I serve the King and I am here to protect you. As long as the King lives, I serve him.
You should not dishonor your future king like this!   My father is a fool, and he will be dead by morning.  I will be your king come daylight!
It is not wise to attempt an attack on me! I am here merely as a job, nothing more! I am a trained killer, my men and I should leave you here to fend for yourself if you are not careful!
Kill this man at once!  He threatened treason on the crown!   He has plans to kill the king!
Alright, you can have the map. I will protect you as I was paid to do then after that I will part ways.
You are indebted to me as a future heir.  I now know where you loyalties lie.  I will be putting you on the line in the next war, be sure to say your peace with your family, fool!
If that's what you think is necessary then so be it but I must warn you, without me, I can assure you that you will not be able to find the hidden treasure.
About this treasure that you speak of... Where did you get this map?  Is this a trap by my brother?  I find it hard to trust a disloyal soldier.
action: steal a treasure map from soldier
steal a treasure map from future heir to the throne
hit future heir to the throne
give map of the kingdom to future heir to the throne
