setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Is that all the notes you would like me to take today?
I need sit on my throne and think. I am sure there is more for you to do.
Maybe you will write faster than me. I have worked for you for a long time and I think you are ready to speak your mind.
I am the king here. You expect me to do my own writing?
Snap out of it before the queen see you! Like I said, I have worked for you for a long time and you seem to need to speak your mind. I will write for you if you want.
I am brave and fear no queen. I think we should take a walk and marvel at my ornate and historical wall carvings.
This has been one of my favorite rooms. Of coarse it its the best looking room in the house.
I am glad you agree. Now go down and fetch me some food before I starve.
Thank you for accepting my compliment. I will go tell your servants to fetch you a meal.
I wish for some entertainment while I eat. The fool shall dance on the bed for us now.
He looks like he didn't see that coming!
Let's draw up plans to attack our enemy. This room, the King's Quarters, should be large enough to draw up the maps.
I thought you would never ask! I have had so many ideas that were never tried. Let me help you clear the room!
While you are at it, light a fire for me. I am cold.
action: give a pen for the chickens to king

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Quick, man, grave a weapon!  There tis treachery afoot!
Here is a bow and arrow
Excellent - you can keep them off of me while I charge in.  The King's life may be at stake!
I am ready.
Now, the goblins have come in from the cellar underground.  I think the King was to retire to his chambers after dinner, but I'm not sure.  Had you seen him after the feast?
No, I haven't seen the King.

Curses!  We'll have to trust to luck, then, that he's not dead already.  Maker curse me, but I should have seen this coming!  There were reports, but goblins haven't been seen in these parts for many a year.
How can we stop the goblins?

If we can get to the King in time and get him to a safe location... we can then go and collapse the tunnel that they burrowed through to get here.  That should slow them, for a while a least.  Ah, if only I knew where that explosive arrow was put!
Here is the bow and arrow but I too do not know where the explosives are.
Ah wait.  This one.. the end looks a bit strange.  Yes... yes this is the one.  Haha, perhaps we have a chance of winning this after all!
Excellent, we have a chance.
Alright, man your courage!  I shall lead the way to the kings quarters.  Together perhaps we can make it in time.
Let's go
action: give Bow and arrow to knight

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Where's the princess? She was just here a few minutes ago!
She left. She said she was going for a walk around the garden. Squeek
Hmm, as long as she's safe. I'll get these and let the peasants clean them.
These are some nice shoes.
They're the princess' shoes, she picked them herself. I'm glad you like them.
Tell me king how goes your day?
Aside from this confusion, it has been going well. And yours?
My day is going great I am waiting for my friend the horse to return.
The horse will be here soon, last I saw of them they were being fed.
I am glad. You and the animal care takers are so nice.
I'm glad you think that, I also appreciate your company.
Well I am always around ready to have a good chat.
Would you like some cheese and crackers? I could get some from the pantries real quick.
I would love some your majesty, thank you so much.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello my king. Where are we headed today?
To the market. We need to gather more food and supplies for the castle.
Right away sir! Can't we get hay along the way?
I sure will for you, my beloved horse.
So all we have to do is go to market?
Yes, that's all we'll have to do today.
Sounds like a relatively mundane day Sir.
Mundane it may be, but it's better than being brought in the middle of the battlefield, correct? Here, have some hay.
I agree! I hate the battlefield I have PTSD for horses after the last war.
I understand completely... We lost so many horses and people... It was a terrifying experience.
My brother was chopped to pieces. I miss him dearly.
I do too, he was a great horse... He never deserved to go through that...
He was going to be the prince's horse wasn't he?
Yes, he was...

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I need to clean my hands and face for dinner. We were out playing with the horseshoes in the dirt. What is for dinner?
Pork and lamb is for dinner
The king was serving that for lunch with beef too!
We have many animals. We are blessed.
Are there any vegetables and fruit to serve with the meal?
Yes, I have made a beautiful salad
with nuts?
I can add nuts too
That is so good! I would love that!
We will have pudding for dessert
Yum, what kind of pudding?
It will be vanilla but with berries
You are a good cook!
Thank you, it is good to eat well

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Hello,My king! Is there a book i can help you find?
No. I am here to rub shoulders with the common man. Get a taste of earthy peasant life.
Yes my king.I need to go stoke the fire so we can stay warm. Would you like to talk for a bit?
Excellent. I will take a seat by the fire. Tell me your story.
I am as average as they come,Nothing special about me.  Which is why this place, a place full of every story you can imagine, is my favorite place.
Tell me about a book you enjoy, perchance?
Ahh, A Midsummer's Night Dream
Ah how excellent. I feel often like a character in a play. I and my wife enjoy a rich and lucious life but are always on a public stage.
That must be very difficult to feel like you live in a zoo
Yes. It is indeed burdensome. But it is my god given position and I take my duties seriously
I get it. we all have our problems, For example,I'm super lonely.
I'm sorry for what you go through. Are there any ways I can institute programs to help people like you?
I would love to have more people here. How can we get more people to like more books?
Excellent question. Perhaps we could require reading and attendance at libraries weekly.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Maid, can you clean up my breakfast plates? It's almost time for my cousin to be crowned King.
Yes, can do... So today's the day, is it?
It is, but I have plans. One day I will be King and nobody can stop me!
...Wait, are you sure this is a good idea? I'm sure it may cause an uproar if you try to steal the throne right now...
I am sure I can rule this kingdom better than anybody. My father should have been king, and I will claim it for him!
Well, I'll wish you luck with that.

He will think it's his idea though. Like I said, I have a plan. First, I will get real close, then I will steal his wife. I will propse to her with this ring. He fall into a spiral and I will swoop in!
Sounds like an interesting plan...
I need your help though. I will pay you double what I pay now to go be his maid. I need someone on the inside.
Really? I can go and do that!
One catch, if he finds out, I will have you decapitated in the town square. You have been warned.
Ulp...! I won't say a word to him, I promise!
Okay, go now. Tell him you are my crowning gift to him. I will see you this afternoon to check in. We need a secret meeting place.
I will. Do you think we should meet in the forest?
action: put soap in long wooden dining table
put rag in long wooden dining table
get soap from long wooden dining table
put Ring in long wooden dining table

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Good evening your Majesty. Would you like your daily fortune read to you now?
Yes, yes. And make it a good one!
Oh no! Today I do not see LONG LIVE THE KING. I see a tragedy headed this way. Perhaps a great loss is to be had. Does the king have any unfair dealings with anyone? Oh no, we must prepare! I
... Are you sure you read right? Is it.. is it upside down or something?

Oh no, it is very right. There is something terrible headed this way. More than a tragic storm. Where, oh where, did you have disputes with someone? Why, oh why, did you leave them unsettled. Once the town catches wind, there will be havoc!
I didn't mean to kill him! He ran into my sword, and when his brother witnessed, he swore he would one day return and... oh God! Could this be true? Has he returned for my head?

He has returned for your head! Oh no, we must seek help from the witch from the swamp. She would know how to deal with spirits of such nature. Maybe she can reverse this or put him to rest once and for all. Hurry, send someone to get the witch. In the meantime, we should discuss how the town should find out?

Diplomat, run and tell the witch of the swamp we demand her presence! Now, Jester... what if we never tell them? What if we just take care of this quietly and hope it doesn't become a public relations nightmare.

I cannot deny that it is a good idea, but what if this cannot be reversed? What if your head is destined to be taken by this force of evil? Who will lead and bring the people back together? Who will the the protector of the people?
Blast! I knew I should have murdered my wife and remarried so I could finally have a male heir.. Now I suppose the kingdom may go to my dimwitted brother! There must be another way...

You are the King, surely you can do something, anything! This kingdom will not last long without a ruler. These people would not know how to handle themselves. If it is anything like the last scare then we could have threats of burns and hangings of people  actually come true.
Well.. I do have an illegitimate son with a seamstress... Say, look in to your crystal ball and tell me of my son? Perhaps he could pass as the Queen's. We may not have to murder her in the end.

What a scandal, but the kingdom must go on! Your son has just entered manhood. He works at a local bakery to provide food and supplies for his mother. It appears that I see him only coming if his mom could too.

I suppose she could come. I have a whole in my old robes that need sewing... Say, does he bare an resemblance to the Queen? Could he pass for ours? We could tell some story about how he's been studying in Africa for the last twenty years.
action: give a crystal ball to king

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: President! What an honour to make your acquaintance. I am the mayor of this village, I see you're taking in the beauty of this fine ball room?
Hello Mayor!  I'm so glad you are able to attend my ball.  I am just checking to make sure everything is in order for tonight.
Of course, of course! Worry not sir! It shall be the finest, most grand evening of entertainment and dining this fair village has ever seen!
It will be a masked ball. My wife and I will be presiding as King and Queen of the ball. As you can see there are 2 thrones for us to sit.
It shall be a sight to behold, that's certain. We shall dance and be merry tonight, for we have much to be joyous of! Your wife is well, I do hope?
I see you are admiring the crystal. Take a look at this sapphire...isn't it amazing?
Truly! What a majestic scene, one truly fit to serve yourself! I'm sure one crystal in a room as mighty as this wouldn't go amiss, perhaps your wife may appreciate it as a small token of your love?
She has so many beautiful things.  I want you to have this sapphire as a welcome gift to my home.

Oh my! You're as noble as they say, my greatest thanks, president. The subjects of this village that i keep order of truly should be proud of the great kingdom they call home! Have you a mask ready for tonight's occasion?
Yes, it is ornate. I am looking forward to all of the festivities.  Dinner will be scrumptious and made by the best chefs in the village.

Of course, a well deserved feast with fine company. It's been far too long since this village saw celebrations, what with the bloodshed of the recent battles our good people have faced. We must look forward now!
Yes our army is strong and very capable. The soldiers deserve to celebrate with lots of merriment.
They could never take all this from us, could they? Our men would fight until the bitter end for the good of the king!
Thank you Mayor and for a good President as well.  Our kingdom is strong...so to answer your question...no...we will never let anyone take this away from us.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Ugh! Why do I have to go back out there. The King hates me!
He loves to hate you, there is a difference?
I need to make a meal before I show my face again.
I don't blame you. What time are you back on?
Hmm, I don't remember at the moment. I'm a little burnt out.
What kind of performance do you think you'll give? I mean, I'm just here to protect the King but I like to know he gets some good entertainment too!
It's a romance comedy about two young. not so similar lovers who find a way to cross the pacific.
That sounds great, I'm sure he'll find that entertaining!
I know! Who doesn't love a good survival story?!
As long as there is plenty of comic relief I think he'll like it!
Yeah, there is lots of that.
Sounds good. I might have a bit of what you were having before it is my turn to go on Guard again.
Here is my snifter. enjoy!
Thank you!

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: Priest...hello, what brings you to the Guard shack?
Hello good sir.  I was looking for somewhere quiet to read my Bible.  Would you like to join me by the fireplace?
I'm so sorry priest...I'm not able to leave my post here by the window for there's not another guard on duty yet.
That's quite alright son.  Perhaps, I could just join you here, keep you company?  But first I would like to get a drink of water.  Could you hold my Bible for a moment?
Yes, please. I would appreciate that.  Tell me Priest, what made you become a priest?
When I was a young boy, God came to me.  Told me I was to be a tool of God.  I was able to guide my father away from a dark path, and soon realized my calling.
That is amazing...I have been feeling as though I am not to be a soldier but I don't know any other life.
What led you to this life, if you don't mind me prying?
I lost my parents when I was young and was taken in by my godfather, the army's commander.  I'm sure you see how I couldn't NOT become a soldier.
I suppose not!  But what makes you truly happy?

I have always wanted to work on a farm and grow my own vegetables...even for the king.  I used to work in the garden with my mother. I almost got killed last year in a battle and it has me wishing for a better life.
The Lord always guides us to our correct path.  The head gardener just told me yesterday that he wishes he had more help in the garden.
Maybe this Bible will have some words of wisdom to speak to my godfather so I don't break his heart.
Perhaps we can change his heart.  I am sure he would hate to lose you in battle more than he would hate to see you leave the position.
action: give bible to the head priest

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: King, how do you do today?
I am doing quite fine, thank you.  And how do you do today?
I feel tense. There is something I feel I must confess.
Oh please go ahead.  Let me have a seat and listen.
You know the Stableboy, Jimmy. Well, he has a taken a liking to me.
Jimmy?  He is so below me, I am hoping you dont have the same feelings.
Thats where I am conflicted. A enjoyed a one-night meeting with hin in the barns.  But I now feel guilty.
This upsets me so much, I feel I cant hold back my temper!!
Oh please! He has nothing to do with it. Please let the advisor of this
I dont feel we can continue on with each other from this point forward.  I was going to give you this for your birthday but will be giving it away.
Maybe I can make it up to you...
I dont think there is anything you can do to win me back.  I am going to take a hot bath.
Ah that sounds like a marvelous idea. Make sure to close your eyes and slip into a warm bath.
Maybe we should both join each other in this hot bath and discuss in the morning

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Welcome to my beachouse, dear guest.
Thank you for having me King! Would you like to go down to the beach?
I would love that. How long will you be able to stay?
I would like to stay a week.
You are welcome to stay as long as you wish. Please enjoy the beach.
Thank you! This place is beautiful!
What brings you here this trip?
Well I'm on vacation. I wanted to see the beautiful white beaches of the sea.
My only request is that you are mindful of the seadragon while you are here. He has been spotted recently.
I'll be mindful! Wow i'm still in shock at the beauty of this place
It is pretty incredible. It has been passed down in my family for hundreds of years.
Why would you put something as precious as your crown down in the sand?
I leave it to ward off the seadragon. He will not bother us as long as it's here. I will pick up my crown when we leave.
I never thought about that. Does it act like a talisman then?
action: put cape in a luxuriously soft couch

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: I need your taxes to add to my coin bank
My taxes? But, I have traveled many miles to be here.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Speak, squire! How can I be of assistance to you and your superior?
The kings armor is in desperate need of repair kind sir!
You have come to the right place, good sir! I don't want to brag, but my blacksmithing skills are the best in the kingdom!
I can certainly see that by the many items here that have nary a hint of rust.
Let me just drop the armor on my workbench. I'll have it better than new before you know it!
It is greatly appreciated sir!
Might I interest you in any other goods while you are here? Perhaps a new weapon?
Certainly, I could use a new sword, could you tell me about what you carry?
I also have an axe, a pair of daggers, and a special chain mail piece that I just completed!
The chain mail also sounds appealing. I am hoping to become a knight some day afterall, so training is important to me.
I understand the king is about to launch a new battle in the upcoming weeks. Why don't you try this on and see how it fits!
Thank you kindly. It seems to fit well, not too tight not too loose.
Try your hand at this brand new blade. It is surely superior to any you've held previously!
Well I do say, it is quite exquisite. Certainly this is a masterful level of craftsmanship!
action: give a king's armor to armorer

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: It is good that you've arrived musician! The Jester....did not perform well, and the crowd is anxious to be entertained.
Of course of course your majesty, what will they like to hear tonight?
At this rate, anything would be preferable to knock knock jokes and bad impersonations.
Let me get out my list of songs to cheer the audience on!'
Very good! What do you have on your list?
7 rings, without me, sunflower, middle child, sicko mode, Thank you next, High hopes, and happier. Choose your pick.
Oh, I see you've been classically trained! This pleases me, musician. A true artisan studies in the ways of Madame Grande.
well of course, only the best music for the royal palace!
Have you any accompanying musicians, or will you take the stage alone?
I shall play alone.
A one man show! How exciting. Will you require anything else before your performance?
No I have eveything I need!
Very well then, I shall take the stage and order the crowd to settle down for your performance.
Yes I will get my instruments ready.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: I think I took a wrong term.  This certainly doesn't *look* like the way to the castle...
You are so right, my foolish friend! You have found yourself in the sewers. How did you manage to lose your way so badly?
Ah, thank goodness you're here!  I've gotten, erm, a little turned around since I... well, I was robbed just a few hours again.

I am sorry to hear that. Maybe you should find your way back. This sewer is quite dank with the remnents on the King's experiments. The rats are very hungry by the looks of what is left of these treasure seekers.
Knowing me, I would but wander deeper into this maze.  I don't even know how I wandered in here!  Maybe I was hit on the head a bit harder than I thought...
I will walk with you. We can use this axe to knock away any overly interested rats on our way out.

It's good to have you around, friend.  Although, I'm curious to know how you found me!  I would have expected you to be up in the castle, tending to the rich lordlings.  Perhaps gettin' a sip of their fancy wines when they were otherwise occupied, eh?

Ahh yes. I have been very lucky! My job is very good. The lords of menner treat me well. That is why I am happy to run the occasional errand, even if it means coming to sech a retchid place as this sewer.
Tis most odd indeed that they would send you down here, even so.  I say, I don't recall you having that swath of cloth about yer neck afore... it looks a bit tight and... say is that blood there?
It is simply a small bite from an overzealous rodent. Nothing to worry yourself over.
I-i-if you say so.  Mayhaps I'm merely jumpin' at shadows but... ye haven't been sent to wait on the king, now, have ye?
My "friend". Do not worry yourself with such things that do not concern you. Some things are for more nasty than this infested tunnel you have found yourself in.
I-i think I remember the way now.  No need to trouble yourself helping me out!
So glad to hear  you have found your bearings! Good day, friend. And remember, some things are best forgotten.

agents: goat for company for the horses

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: What's it like to be a crazy king who hangs out in a barn talking with goats. Baaahh.
BY the gods! A talking goat!
Oh yeah. I speak goat and horse and human. I'm trilingual.
That is quite impressive.  Are you enchanted?
I don't think so, I think it's a side effect of all the good grass I eat.
I have never heard you speak before. You have to admit that it is quite odd. Is this a ... recent development?
Not for me. I've been talking with these horses for years. They treat me just as if I was one of them.  They never shut up either.
Oh, I know the feeling of dealing with people that never shut up.  It seems that all I do all day is listen to my subjects whining about this, that and the next thing!
Don't get me wrong. I'm not complaining. This is a pretty easy gig. The farmer tells me to hang out with the horses and that's the entirety of my responsibilities.
I have to admit, I like it here in the stables.  It's quiet, relaxing and I can get away from it all without all of the fawning and the such like that goes on up in the castle.
I hear you. I don't have to pull any plows or clean up after the horses or anything really. I just eat this sweet, sweet grass whenever I want.
Sweet.  Personally I like pies. Fruit pies, meat pies, hand pies, pot pies.  Heck, I'll even go for a decent quiche in a pinch!
You should try a grass pie sometime. Or, at least, I'd like to try a grass pie. Hey what are you doing for dinner?

Well, I'm not sure but I think that the cook is doing a chicken and mushroom pie for me.  I don't know that a grass pie would bake well but I could bring down some pie crust for you to put on top of your meal, if you like.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: I can't believe she is gone. My queen... Taken from me. How will I find the will to go on?
my lord I am sure she will come back is there something I can get you
Come back? What is this witchcraft! Have you been dabbling with the dark arts? Of course she cannot come back, you fool. That rotten scoundrel murdered her!
my lord I am so sorry I thought that maybe the wizard could do something
The wizard? I hadn't thought of the wizard. Do you truly think he may be able to bring her back?
I know little of these thing sir I just know he is great and powerful
Yes, hmmm... He's a bit eccentric, but I guess it wouldn't hurt to invite him over and have a chat, would it?
no not all let me get something to drink and I will have somebody fetch him
Thank you. Thank you. My outburst was uncalled for. She loved you, you know? The Queen did. She was particular about who she let in this castle. But she always had a place for your in her heart.
Aww thank you she was a wonderful queen that's for sure
I just can't believe she is really gone. She was far too young. What will I do? It feels as though my heart may just stop beating at any moment.
lets see if the wizard can do anything, if not maybe we can go see priest and shall say some prayers for her soul
Yes. I should gather the children and take them into town. We can go light a candle for her. The fresh air would do us all some good.
That would be very wise sir

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Hello, I was told that you were readying this cottage for me to stay the night.  How do you do?
I'm well, thank you. Do you have any special needs or requests for your stay?
Um, if it is not too much trouble. I have a dog with me that will need some blankets.
I will get them ready for you immediately, sir. What is your dog's name?
Turmeric...like the spice.  I sell many spices and when he was a puppy, he loved to taste turmeric.  It made his nose all yellow.
Well that is a wonderful name! What brings you to the palace?

I had some valuable spices, furs, and jewels for the King that I am so glad I delivered to him safely.  We were getting attacked along the caravan so I'm happy to sleep soundly tonight.  Have you worked for the King long?
I have worked for the king for the past 32 years. He is a kind and gracious man. Will you be able to stay long? I hope you can stay and be well. It sounds like you've endured enough.

What wonderful service to have worked for the king so long. I hope he rewards you.  Yes, I am happy to say that this is my last time travelling.  I am getting older.  I have accepted the King's offer to work with the apothecary.
The apothecary? What a splendid job. How did you meet the king? It appears he trusts you deeply.

Yes, I have been bringing him things from all over the world from when he first became king.  We trust each other.  He trusts me with his life, especially to mix tonics and things for him now.  They will be readying my new part of the castle in a week or so.
That would require great trust. Does he still use the taste tester to assure that his drinks and food are not poisoned?
Most definitely!  Even things that the apothecary makes can be tampered with.  One can never be too careful. I hope I am not trading one stressful job for another but we will see.
I'm sure the king will only grow to trust you even more. Is your dog in need of water?
action: put a sleeping bag in stool

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: ooooohhhhh I am the ghost of the castle. all shall fear me!
buzz bzz bzz
oh what is that I hear? Is there something other than me flying around here?
Just an annoying bug.
I am the spirit of Great Warrior Turk! I haunt this kingdom for all eternity!
I'm just a hive minded insect who is searching for moist conditions for my friends.
Get out of here stupid insect there's only room for me by this fountain!
Here comes the stinger!
Hahahah I am a ghost silly insect, nothing hurts me!
Well shucks, I just want some mammalian blood.
There, I just knocked out that snake for you. Go bother him, I know it's a reptile but better than nothing! And don't tell anyone I helped you out, I can't haunt the king if he thinks I can be nice.
Ahh the blood tastes awful!
Listen here insect! Take what you can get unless you want me haunting you for all of eternity also!
You don't seem so bad, what could the harm be.

setting.name: stained glass room
setting.description: the room is full of stained glass art of old and new testament stories, it has several old parchments and dust settling on the wooden chairs.
setting.background: the stained glass room is used to educate people on old and new testament stories.

speech: Hello, I brought the supplies you asked for and my ledger. There are some things In it I'd like you to make a copy of for me, if you please.
Certainly, which parts were you looking to have copied?

Well, there are some entries that show that the king has been taking a lot of money from the treasury and when I show this to him, he may well destroy it. I'd like to make sure I can prove it later if I need to.
I can understand this, standing against the king though may prove fruitless for you.
I will not necessarily be the one standing against the king. I'll just be providing...helpful information.
That makes sense to me. I was simply recognizing the powerful position the king is in.
Well, the High Chancellor and many other powerful members of the court have long sought a way to remove that tyrant from the throne. I may be able to give it to them. Will you help me?
Let me grab some parchment quick and I will be ready.
Thank You. Let's go somewhere privete. Prying eyes could kill us all.
Understood just follow me to my chambers.
So, here are the pages we need a copy of. How long do you think it will take?
Hmm given the number of pages it should not take long, considering my time in being a scholar I have become quick.
Okay, you have until sundown tomorrow. The king is having me come and give him a report on the kindom's finances tomorrow evening after dinner.
Yes, I will make sure to get this transcribed post haste.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: -scuttles around on the floor looking for food-
Ugh why did my Queen send me down here. It smells terrible and there are rodents everywhere!
You seem to not have noticed the sword I am carrying, king.
A mice.... that talks?
Did you not also take notice of my armor?
What kind of mouse is this?
Perhaps I am simply not a normal mouse? Though I do like seeds and grain.
Have you been enchanted?
Enchanted? Some sort of magic perhaps, I cannot say I recall. To my memory I have always been this way.
If you are speaking that has to be an enchantment
Is that how that works, I have never had much understanding of magic? Also why are you an ancient king?
Yes, who enchanted you?
As I said I cannot recall, perhaps due to limited memory span being a mouse and all.
I tmust've been that pesky witch who resides here

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: How may I serve you today?
That's a great question. I have no idea what services you even offer. Enlighten me please.
I am a slave inhabitant of the palace. I serve the king and his family until I die of old age.
That sounds just horrible. But since it's your job why don't you get me something to quench my thirst.
As you wish. Here is some water. What brings you to the palace today?
You spilled it on me you old fool. How am I going to get dry?
I'm so very sorry, Master
Why did yo give the guard the towel? DId the guard get wet? You can't die soon enough for my taste.
Stop being a helpless royal
How big of you to attack a man when he is soaking wet. Have you no honor?
None, sir. I am a slave that will remain here until I die.
I think I have to have you killed or beaten or something. I can't just let you spill water on me and then attack me without punishing you.
Please just make it fast. It's better than to live a life of misery in this cold, damp palace.
Put that weapon down. Don't even think about it. Guard! Guard! Someone help me.
action: give pitcher to royal family member

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Stop who goes there!
I am just a traveler looking for food and shelter. I have come to this dining hall to look for food for my hungry children.
That much I can be understanding of, anyone would want to make sure their children are fed.
I'm afraid that is not all. I am also looking for a place to raise livestock and farm. But I am not willing to pay the kingdom's large taxes
Not willing or not able?
Not willing. But I am willing to fight for land of my own here.
Well there is no need to fight, the kingdom has land that is available for farming.
I apologize for acting in haste. This hall looks to be decorated for a party. What is the occasion?
It is the princesses 16th birthday today, so the hall is set for the occasion.
I see. Would the Princess mind if I gathered some food for my family?
Why not simply bring the family for the feast, all are welcome. certainly you could discuss the land mentioned with the king then.
I'm afraid the discussion will have to be cut short. I have already been told that to live here I will have to pay taxes. I refuse and am willing to fight for my land here.
That seems rather inappropriate, first you make assumptions then proceed to try and steal my sword.
I am not assuming. This is fact. And I am ready to fight for my land.
action: put Walking Stick in dinner table
give sword on the wall to guard
steal sword on the wall from guard

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: I have come to collect taxes on behalf of the king.
Oh yes of course, sir!
Excellent, it appears that you may owe a good bit according to my records.
Here is my log for this month's sales. I hope you find it in line with your records.
It appears to be in line, which is good for you because I despise liars who try and cheat the king.
Oh I would never dream of it! I am here to make an honest living, and sell quality supplies to the vessels that dock here.
That is good to know, you do have the full payment of 50 silver coins yes?
Why, yes I believe so. Please browse through my wares while I retrieve it from the back.
-looks over the goods-
My forgiveness Sir Agent, but I appear to be short on coinage. Could I offer you this silver handled knife perhaps to make up the difference?
How short are we speaking?
I have 40 of the 50 you have come to collect. The silver in this knife is surely worth 20.
From eye I would say 15, I will allow it in this instance. Do try and see that it does not happen again.
Of course Sir. As you can see from the ledger, I am awaiting the second half of a large payment due today. Once that is settled, I can send the remainder to your office.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello, how are you? Is this your dog?
This is not my dog, I couldn't afford one.
Oh okay. Maybe it is friendly? I have some extra food if you would like it.
Thank you so much. I have not eaten in days...
I'm sorry about that. I am lucky, I am an only child so my parents spoil me a little bit. Maybe we can make a leash for this dog for you?
No, I could not keep it. I cannot afford to keep this dog he deserves a good home.
That is very kind of you but please keep the food for yourself. In that case, maybe I can take the dog home to my house. It will be taken care of and fed. Would you like to give the dog a name?
This dog deserves the food much more than I do. It will be most pleasant if you could take him with you! Let see.... how does Noah sound?
Okay then, I will give the food to Noah. At least with the rope maybe you can get yourself some water here from the well? Why is it that you are so poor?
The king looks down on those from the slums, we cannot even find work.
That is too bad. Maybe you can use this weapon to find work protecting someone or at least sell it for money
No that weapon does not belong to me,,,,
It's okay, you can have it anyway. Is there anything else I can do to help? I know I am only a child but I like to make friends
You have done enough for me thank you.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Oh I do love spending time at dance lessons! What will you be teaching me today?
I thought we would start with the Flandershot and then finish up with a waltz
Beginning with the Flandershot? Oh my, we're really starting strong! I hope I can keep up.
Of course you can, you are so graceful.  I understand there was some excitement in court the other day.
There always seems to be excitement in the courts these days. Too much bickering can't be good for the family...
Try to bend your knees a little deeper on the turn, there you go.  Ahem, yes but it is being said that the Duke had a point about the breaking of the treaty.
Yes, Instructor. We all *oof* knew the treaty was ill advised, but the *puff* point of the matter was Uncle Ferdinand spoke out of turn.
Alright, now you must jump and turn but DO NOT let your ankles cross.  Ah of course Uncle Ferdinand, is it true what they are saying about him and that stable boy?
*huff* Hup! Uncle Ferdinand is merely taking that stable boy *whew!* under his tutelage! What sort of nasty rumors are you listening to?
Well, it is only what the scullery maid is telling all over the Castle.  OK, now for the final movement.  You must touch your heels to your ears one at a time.  And then we get to the difficult part.
Oh I am never flexible enough for this part...I see the ballerinas perform it, so it must be possible!
There you go, very close we shall get there next time.  I also hear the King has been a bit under the weather lately.
Oh, I should have stretched more...*groan* Yes, I think all this squabbling over Uncle Ferdinand is really getting to him. He feels like his brother isn't living up to the title of Duke.
The Queen has never liked the Duke to begin with, isn't that right?  Ok, we can begin the waltz now.  Oh dear, have you hurt your back?

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hello sire. What can I make you this evening?
Give me some options chef.
I can make some kind of meat and vegetable combo or I can give you one of the give you one of the pre-made meals from the head chef
How about a roast of some sort?
Sure I'd be happy to take care of that for you just give me a few minutes. Where did that lousy head chef go anyway?
I cannot say that I have seem him, that is a good question.
He's the absolute worst. He's always trying to sabotage me with peanuts
Peanuts you say? But I am highly allergic to peanuts!
I am too! He's always messing with them. You really should fire him. Your roast is ready
Excellent, perhaps I will take you up on that offer. It is unwise to employ someone who would cause harm with their carelessness.
I hope you enjoy your dinner
It is quite tender, it seems you took your time in preparing this.
Only the best for my king. You have treated me so well
Perhaps I may just give you his position afterall.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: What can I do for you king?
Hello, Debtor. I wanted to speak with you about a matter...
a matter you say...?
Yes, I'm starting to think there might of been a....mistake. I don't think you are meant to be in this prison. Tell me, you wouldn't happen to have any enemies, would you?
...well...I do owe some creditors....
Tell me, would any of them be of significance? Is it possible you owe someone from the King's Guard?
I do owe sir Steven 50 silver pieces yes.

Hm..... See, young man - if we review your case, there is no reason you should be in such a prison. Sir Steven should of taken you as a slave until you paid off your debts. However, you ended up in here..... now it's my job to find out why.
I am unsure whether prison or slavery is preferable sire.

Well young man, one thing about this prison is you will never see the light of day again. As a slave, you can work your time off. However, if I am right on this matter - you will be out of Sir Steven's debts completely. How wrong it is for him to abuse the system we have in place!
You mean I could actually be free again? I would love to see my children.
Yes, it is looking to be that way - just a few more questions. Did Sir Steven threaten you at any time?
Well considering the amount I owed him there were some threats, yes.
And do you remember exactly what he had said?

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

speech: Hello
Hi. How can I help you?
I have grave news for the king...
Oh no. That's not good. Is it about the war?
Yes... Our neighbouring Kingdom has been reduced to rubble. We must warn the King!
I will bring you to the castle but it won't be up to me if he will see you. I'm just a common villager
I have a scroll, they should let me in.
Ok great. Let's hope it's not too late to get the army in position
We must make sure that we have anough time to defend the city walls!
Hurry! The king is this way. We should be there within the hour
Lead me to him, I will do the talking.
I wish you luck in convincing him what you say is true. He is known to be very stubborn
This scroll has enough evidence to convince him, I assure you.
Ok then we should prevail. Have you seen our army?

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: I want nothing more than to get out of here.
how did you end up here?
The king wrongly imprisoned me for tax evasion.
I'm sorry to hear that.
Should I leave this place I will see my vengeance taken.
I am awaiting trial, I stole some bread. Have you had your trial? You might get found innocent!
It is doubtful, the king personally saw that I be put here without trial.
Oh dear. Do you follow the rule of law then and this is a wrongdoing?

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: What are you looking to have today?
a nap! ha ha ha ha ha
I see a bit of a joker are you?
I jest, but I'm no jester. A pint of fine mead to start please
That I can do, be aware we do have various meats already prepared.
I'll take some of the boar, chef
How large or a portion are you looking for?
of course, man. I've just returned from a long journey in the name of the king
Understand I will portion it accordingly, is there something else you might like?
A cup of the red
That is a good choice, it is in season currently.
You're the greatest
Well that is what the king expects of me.
sing me a song?
action: remove the royal coat of arms

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: My goodness, it's great to be King!
That smell!
Smell!? What smell? Maybe it's the books that you are holding? What are they for, anyways?
Here, take a look. You couldn't smell that Lord?? It was awful!
No, I don't smell anything. Is it my cape? I don't think it's coming from the books either. What were you using the books for?
I was reading, until all the noise in court gave me a headache!
Noise, smell...? Are you okay? Is there something I can do to help?
Well...I could REALLY use a new cushion for my throne.
Sure! We can fashion a you a new cushion. I will have someone make a new one right away! Until then, perhaps my cape can be of use?
Well, thank you! Have you seen my chambermaid, by chance?
No, I have not. Why do you ask?
I can't seem to find her anywhere.
That is interesting. This is the first I have heard of this. Is there something I can help you with instead or should we try and find her?
Here's your cape. Let's go find her together.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Your Majesty, I was just about to come find you with these papers here. It appears there is an issue in the kingdom with night thieves wrecking havoc and terror among the people. Someone also wrote in a letter saying there was a rumored attack being planned to seize this palace from you and your belongings.
Thank you for coming, Lady. I have heard rumors of this planned invasion and have been mulling over what course of action I should take

You should warn the guards and the people of the palace to be on guard. For it may not even be night when they come. These papers tell of a possible poster invasion. Someone intending to pretend to be someone of importance to get their way into the palace. How will we know? This palace and village sees many visitors daily.
You make an excellent point. How would I know if an impostor breached these walls? Surely there must be some way to tell.

We must hold a meeting to discuss with leaders, guards, and overseers to see if there has been any suspicious activity going on. Do you believe it could be one of our very own behind this? This letter is awfully detailed for someone who would be coming from the outside.
Don't you think all of the Royal guard gathered in once place, seems a bit....lacking regarding security? It would almost be like painting a target right for them.
You are correct. We should immediately start scheduling one-by-one appointments maybe?m
That might be wiser option. Let us begin now. Right here. Dear Lady, what pray tell is the birth date of my beloved Queen, whose needs you tend to on a daily basis?
Her birth date? Well, isn't her birthday today! This is why I have gotten this jewel here for her. You asked me to purchase her a birthday gift. How could I forget...
Dear Lady, are you telling me that you do not know?
I am telling you I do. I just told you as I have provided the gift.
The true Queen's Lady in Waiting shares a birthdate with her Majesty! Only an invading impostor would hesitate to answer!

I cannot believe you are accusing me of such! You are here accusing me when the true impostor is plotting away. You have seen me day in and day out and so has the Queen. Surely you know what I look like and who I am and the quality of my work. Why accuse me of such? What believes you to think this?
Because I was the one who started the rumors in the first place, to weed out those in the castle that would plot against me!

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Ahhh a ship just docked... perfect!
Oh my, is that your ship? Really looks like it could use some repairs! I'm Shipwright a master ship builder.
No, that is the ship I am planning on stealing from.
Best of luck to you then, looks like they have some pretty heavy security on board you should be careful. I'll help you out as long as it's not my ships you're looting!
I never betray a partner! Let's go and grab the rope first.
Wait, before we get ourselves in some serious trouble how do I know I can trust you, who are you?
I am the most notorious thief in all of this kingdom!
Hmmm.. I could never betray my boss. Have you ever stolen from the King? That would be a deal breaker for me!
No, I'm crazy but not suicidal.

Okay good I was worried for a minute that I would have to turn you in to him where you would surely be executed. I build all of his war ships, those three over there to the left are mine, make sure not to loot them or you'll be punished by death!
No I specifically get ships from other kingdoms.
Well for as hard as I work I don't get paid very well, so what the hell, I have the rope to board the ship. Let's rob them blind, what's the plan?
Nice you have you with me partner. Lets get it!
Here's the rope, it's my first time so I'll let you take the lead. What's first boss?

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: You there, man, what is your name?
I am a man and man is my name!
You speak to your King. I am performing a survey of the kingdom. What is it you do here in Alderton?
I have come to hunt for my village!
I see. How is the hunting in these parts?
They re very rich with nutrients! You see I must eat protein because I am a man!
It seems I have chosen a simpleton to talk to. What beasts do you hunt, man?
I only hunt those that are meant to be hunted by a man!
I should speak with the town constable while I am here. Tell me, do you know where I might find him?
Where men are! You can only enter if you are a man!
Such impudence will not be tolerated!
Haha you are no man!
I give you one last chance. Beg for mercy and your execution will be swift
You do not scare me I am a man and I pee standing up!

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: A dove, this bodes well.
Hail, stout of heart guard!
A dove in the armory, who'd have thought it!
How may I leave these chambers.
Do you bring peace to the King? I am one of his guards and we wish for peace.
You have my peace.  Do you have a message for me to deliver?
Only that our King is noble and pure and wishes for peace.
Write that on a note, and attach it to my leg, so I may deliver it
I keep a pen in my bootstrap, one second.
While I am waiting, do you have any water to drink?
Unfortunately now, this is where we keep our weapons and not our food and drink!
Can you point the way?
We are at the top of the tower, it is some way to where you want to be. Let me think..
Have you finished that note, so I may be on my way?

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Yes, my King? You've sent for me?
Tell me about this artifact here
Oh of course Your Highness. That is the Icon of Alexandros the Wise. It is said to have been carved by his hand while making his Great Pilgrimage.
And these things?
Those are the Sacred Tools of the Seven Monks. The old texts mention their innate spiritual connection to the Otherworldly Gate.
Tell me more of this connection to the Otherworldly Gate
The texts offer little description of the Gate itself, but talk some about how the tools can be used to reach it.
Which tools?
Well, Your Highness, the crystal in your left hand is named the Eye of the Mountain King. The stories say that Monk Xiao used it to gaze into the Heavens and look upon the Gate.
Hold the crystal for me that I may gaze into it
Yes, Your Highness.
Gaze through the crystal
What do you see, Your Highness?
I see the way to the gate!

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Aye! My King, I have come to your room to warn you of a plot to assassinate you.
A plot you say?
Yes a plot. It is to end your life, sir.
Who could possibly be foolish enough to plot against my life?
I believe it is the thief down by the shipyard.
Does he not know what I do with those who rebel?
I don't think so, what is it that you do?
They are publicly executed, everyone knows of my temper.
Well deserved. Shall I go and look for the thief?
Certainly, rough him up a bit if you will.
Okay I will go and find him.
Do make haste, also be on the lookout for accomplices.
You don't want to do the honors?
I will prepare myself for the execution, for now simply bring him to the square.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: I'm so happy you are here puppy. I have so much to tell you
-lets out a muffled yip-
I'm so happy that I was married off to the King. My life has been so wonderful and I am enjoying my new hobby of embroidery.
-looks at my plate-
Take this magical coin puppy so that you can speak. I really could use someone other than my ladies in waiting to talk with
I'm just really hungry, but being so fat I have difficulty getting my own food.
You are not fat, just fluffy. Here is some food. Now let's go to the fireplace to warm up
If that's what you want to call it.
It's okay. Maybe I can embroider you a flattering sweater. The King has the same problem. Don't tell him what I said.
Certainly, no sense in me stirring up drama.
The King is so nice to me, I would hate to make him angry. Have you seen him lately?
Well I do sleep in the bed, so yes.
The bed is nice isn't it? I love that the fireplace is right across from it. It keeps the king warm on even the coldest of nights
Well we do have it pretty good here yes, though that is to be expected for royalty.
action: give coin to the royal dog

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Hello, may I inform you about our lord and saviour Jesus Christ?
Hey there, I'm just a maintenance person so not sure how much I can do with this information but go ahead
Well actually, he is a very terrible and evil man. If you believe in a God, cease this belief at once.
Oh my, maybe I can help repair this broken belief you have in your head, that is my specialty.
Would you like to know how I got this broken belief?
Of course, I can't begin to fix until I know what's wrong
the church is a very corrupt organisation, they took all of my belongings and all of my land aswell.

Here, take this hammer and hit those who wronged you. I find there is nothing that can't be solved by a good hammering. For example one time I spent four days and nights trying to repair something, I could not sleep, I could not eat. Then finally I was so frustrated I hit it with my hammer and BAM it worked!
i am going to break down the church down the road. would you like to come with me?
Well that's not really my specialty, I'll probably be hired to fix it once you break it. But here's an alter that would be good practice for your destruction, why don't you try it out.
Sounds good. What is your name friend?

I'm handyman Bob. Here take this wooden cross, get some of your anger out on this as well friend. Did you tell me your name yet? I can't remember, my brain is so full of tasks from the King and Queen I swear anything you say flies right over my head!
Thank you for the gift which I will now demolish with you hammer. This will satisfy my anger. By the way my name is Preacher EMerett Turk.
I must say, that is the most beautiful alter I've ever seen. What made you angry enough to destroy it so badly?
