You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: What are you here for soldier?
I am here for your son.  Send him out to me.
what do you need from him?
It is none of your concern.  Send him to me.
What is this for?!
He is under the suspicion of the Crown.  Please do the right thinge her ma'am, it will go better for everyone.
Fine. I will retrieve him.
Thank you.  Make sure he is unarmed...Actually I will follow along.  I need to take him by surprise.
Fine. Come along.
May I ask if you know where your son was last night?
I am not sure. He is grown.
If you say so.  He sure doesn't act it from what I have been told.
no need to be excessively rude. I am taking you to him to get your job done.

Ma'am, this will go better if you don't act this way.  I am an agent of the crown and have the full protection of the King.  That means if you attack me it is the same as attacking the King.  Do you know what the punishment for that is?
action: steal a treasure map from soldier
steal a treasure map from lady of the house

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: Whoooo goes there?
I am an outlaw, who is there?
Whoooo do you think?
Wait, a talking owl, what are you doing in this jungle?
I was placed here by the King to keep my eyes on the outlaw jungle.
So the king seeks to keep an eye on my hiding place does he?
Of course he does. He wants to make sure his outlaw's are safe and happy.
Even though I am always causing mischief in the town?

That is the least of the kings worry. He wants me to give you a message. He wants you to go to the next kingdom and bring back that kings daughter.  He wishes to wed her and join the kingdoms by force.
I assume there in a reward in it for me?
But of course...you know our King is generous to those who do him favors. May I tell him that you are willing and able to do this for him?  I hear she is a beauty but very strong.
Certainly, I am always out to make a buck.
Hmmm...make a deer...would you like some gold as well? I hear the monkeys laughing. Good luck on your quest.
Thank you, I will return.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Hello there guard how may I help yiy
i am here just protecting the king how are you
Good just gave my confession and feel much better
glad you feel better
yes much better any news in the kingdom
no news in the kingdom I am missing a shoe though
How  did you lose a shoe thats crazy
when i was protecting the king maybe you took it. was that what you where confessing?
Not stealing a shoe that's for sure and that is between me and god
i guess that does make sense
haha, I hope don't get in trouble for the shoe though
no trouble at all
Thats good well I am gonna heading out here soon hope you find your shoe soon
yes and i need to protect the king shoe or no shoe

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: How are you today noble?
I am fine as am I always your majesty. How are you on this beautiful day? Aren't the flowers gorgeous in this light?
They certainly are, sometimes I enjoy a stroll through the courtyard to clear my mind.
Well your majesty there is no clearing my mind today...I'm waiting to speak to a fairy about the food they left for us yesterday.
What about the experience troubles you?
The fruit was over ripe and the color was off.
Strange, what could make a fairy do such a thing.
I of course am not aware but I plan to get to the bottom of it. Dear King please tell me true...have you seen the villagers laugh at me?  I think they are laughing at my leggings.
Well they are a bit different, why would you choose neon pink leggings with green polka dots.
The merchant that sold them to me said they were the fashion and I thought they would look nice while walking in the courtyard.
I do believe he was simply trying to take advantage of you considering your status and wealth.
Well I never...I will certainly have a stern word with the merchant after I have a stern word with the fairy food delivery.
I certainly would, taking a noble for a ride certainly is unreasonable.
Ride...where are we going King?  Well I'm going to sit her for now and look at your beautiful garden.

setting.name: Pet chamber
setting.description: You see dozens of tiny luxurious cages where the menagerie is kept.  Instead of metal bars, the cages have bars of clearest crystal, and within are every sort of animal that walks, crawls, flaps or slithers.
setting.background: All of the rarest and most beautiful animals are sent here as tribute, buy they are sad and need to be petted and played with. Unfortunately you can't reach in to touch any of them.

speech: How, oh how, can I escape this cage?!
Who goes there?
It was assuredly not I, a lone animal trying to get back home. I wonder if I can fit between the bars of this cage?
How can you speak little one?
I've had a spell cast upon me by an old, ugly hag.  I used to be a boy... Now, I am THIS...
How did you get placed into the king's menagerie?

I have lived under the bridge outside of the castle for many months now.  The King was crossing over the bridge one day and I jumped out and scared him.  He fell off and into the water.  I suppose he was humiliated and wanted me tortured for the crime...
That would explain why he asked me here.  Have you tried explaining what you are to anyone else?

Yes, it matters not that only a year ago I was a small boy.  I have disrespected the King and apparently now I must pay. I would have been put to death had I not been such a curiosity.  Seeing as how I can speak and all. I guess the King will show me off at parties and gawk at my misfortune.
Is there any way that you think I could assist you without compromising my own placement with the king?

If you want, I can scream in pain whenever the King is close to the door, he will think I've been punished.  I suppose living here in this cage is better than under that bridge.  If only I could reverse this spell one day though, I miss being a boy...

Eventually the king, and if not him someone else, would become suspicious of our endeavors due to a lack of wounds on your body, no matter how violently or painfully you may scream.  A scream of one in pain is also different than a scream you can produce any other time, and I'm sure the king knows how to tell the difference after all these years.
He doesn't want me dead, only tortured or punished.  Maybe you can tell the King that you cannot torture me without killing me. He may not want it done then!
If you are not tortured, I'm sure he will find something just as unpleasant to put you through.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: How are things coming with the crops this season?
The crops are not doing so well, can you help?
What exactly would you ask of a wizard such as myself?
Maybe you can create a potion or something for the plants! Do you have any botanical notes?
That is simply a hymn book, I do many a work for the king and as such no longer require a tome for my magic.
I don't understand you sir, I am just a lowly peasant of simple words.
In simple speak, I am a great wizard of immense magical power.
Thank the gods! Can you help us with the crops?
Certainly, let me consult my vast knowledge. Also what is the cause of the downturn in the crops?
It must the drought, can you make it rain?
Sure thing, let me just prepare myself mentally for a moment as I focus on the intent of my will.
Oh great!
And now with the magic words Ius iurandum iracundiae, may the rains come and soothe the land.
Praise the gods, it worked! The drought it over!
action: steal hymn book from wizard overseer
give hymn book to wizard overseer

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: what do you want?
You know it is my job to protect the king! You are being charged with conspiring against him so I have to make sure you are not up to no good.
life is hard.
I know it is, but don't make it harder on yourself.
what is your plan with me?
It is that you wait here until you are tried.
fine fine. i won't fight.
That is more like it. You don't want to end up like the others who have conspired against the king.
no. i am tired of fighting and trying. honestly being in jail will be easier.
That's more like it. As long as people are not harming the king then they are okay with me.
hey now, I don't need hugs
I am only trying some positive reinforcement. Have they told you when your trial is?
no I know nothing
Hmm. I will see if I can find out your date.

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: What brings you to this temple, Squirrel? Are you seeking nuts?
Oh yes, I would love some. I usually run away from humans, but this building... wow, this building is phenomenal.
Then you must read this and praise the Lord, only then will he grant you some fine nuts.
The Lord? Who is this you speak of? How will he give me nuts? Will he give me nuts to last the rest of this year?
The Lord is who has provided us with all this beauty. There, there all will be answered soon. Now read.
Read the plant? This plant has no value to me... for I am a squirrel. You said he could give me nuts, but you give me a plant... Wait a second, is this here a peanut plant?
Indeed, this plant will blossom with peanuts come summer and will provide you with a lifetime of food.
... I have found something no other squirrel has found. Perhaps I am now the KING OF SQUIRRELS!!
Easy now. You must take care not to eat too much, or you may become too fat to dance.
Fat is what I need. Surely you know I go into hibernation soon. Tell me, before I go into hibernation, can I uproot this precious treasure and take it with me?
You must share it with those around you. Take it, its all yours! Be sure to Praise the Lord!
And will I take this plant with me when I die?
Pass it on to your kin, so they may also enjoy the fruit of the Earth.
But how will I do so if I do not know when I will die? What if it is stolen? Can you tell me when I will die?

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Free, Free at last. I am finally out of prison.
Why were you in prison?
The king imprisoned me for painting a picture of the queen. He became jealous of me.
Is that right, the King is known to be rather.. possessive. Say, will you paint me?
You are very beautiful to be sure, but the last time I painted a beautiful woman, I ended up in a dungeon.
You are too kind. It would be worth going to the dungeon again, as I will pay you a pretty penny.
Very well, but your clothing is not ideal, do you have anything else to wear?
I don't have much aside from my working clothes and this chain mail, sadly,
Hmm, now you are getting closer, but the clothes still don't feel right. Do you have any ideas?
Now I can see why you got in trouble with the King! Sneaky painter you are.
Please, I cannot defend myself. I am a lover, not a fighter. You show such passion. You must let me paint you!
Hows this for passion? Why don't you paint me in front of this grand wall.
Yes that is perfect. I must remove my shirt to get comfortable so that I may paint you. Your beauty will transcend this dreary maid's room.
I might look more feminine if I put down this bow. Paint away!

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Care for some water? I also have the scrolls to deliver to you from the King.
Hmmm, What are the scrolls for?
He told me I could not open them, that only you could. It is rumored that there is doom coming upon the King... maybe someone plotting to kill him.
I'll open them after my ceremony. I need to prepare my speech for my wedding
But the king said it was urgent. How will I tell him of this news?
Tell him he can wait. If he wouldn't treat all the peasants like cow manure they wouldn't try to kill him!
How do you know this assassination will not take place at or during your wedding? If I take this news back to him he will surely want to have my head for not completing the task as he told me to.
I don't know, nor do I care. HE comes crawling to me when he needs my help but treats me terribly any other time
So, we wait. We await his execution? You might as well do it yourself then... or maybe you are? You are the right hand man at doing it for the king...
Get a hold of yourself man!!!!!!!!! sit down and gain your composure!
How dare you attack me? I may have been wrong for accusing you of such, but I am TIRED of being treated like less by everyone in this kingdom.
I apologize dear subject!!! Please forgive me

You have earned my utmost respect for taking the time to apologize. I will surely deliver this message to the king that his request will wait until after your glorious wedding, for you deserve it. If I must take a hit or beheading for this, I will.
Why dont you stay for the ceremony? Here you can wear one of the two hats that I was wearing!

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: I should head back to the Castle soon to haunt the King in earnest.
Watch out for bats on the way!
I said I should, but I will haunt here a little while longer.
Oh, are you scared of bats?
Not particularly, are you?
No, but I thought that's why you decided to stay here longer
No, I am was once King of the Castle - I'm not scared of much!
That's true, being a ghost I wouldn't think that you would be afraid of much....
What about you?
I'm mostly afraid of animals that are bigger than I am, mean ones
So I guess most bats don't scare you either? Unless they are like fox bats?
No, bats don't scare me at all, I rather like them!
Do you like the King. I don't like him because he is of a rival clan.
I don't much about him. But his servants give me scraps of food. I like them...

setting.name: Turquoise Shore
setting.description: A beautiful turquoise color water by the shore. It is filled with many gems and gold.
setting.background: It is said that this place is lived my mermaids and they love to find and collect gems and gold. They love shiny things.

speech: Good evening mermaid, how is the water today?
It's lovely! I'm swimming with my friends, the dolphins.
Dolphins are so majestic, though the king hasn't figured out if they can be used for water travel yet. Is the other kingdom across the ocean still preparing their invasion fleet?
They are. Will you and the other nights be able to protect the kingdom?

I hope so. We don't have a very experienced navy, so the war will probably get to our land. Our knights are very experienced with land-based combat though. If they land we should be able to hold back the invasion.
Here, noble Knight. Please take my necklaces. They will bring you good luck.
This water is so pure and blue, but it will run red when the war comes. I hope our navy can buy us some time or maybe even hold them back.
We mermaids will do whatever we can to give you advanced warning and slow them down. In exchange, will you offer us as much protection as you can provide?
We can, though we can't protect you from land. Perhaps you can swim alongside our naval fleet as they patrol our shores.
Absolutely! We will stay close by. They appear to be getting ready to attck within the next few days.
I hear the dolphins are very intelligent. Do the mermaids train them?
We do. They are our loyal companions. Come, see for yourself. He will let you ride him out to sea.
Maybe they can serve as scouts for the navy. The enemy will never suspect them. Our ships will be ready for the invasion.
You are so smart, Knight

setting.name: Abandoned Mine
setting.description: A crumbling hole gapes in the side of the stone, surrounded by rotted wood timbers. A few rusted pieces of block and tackle lay half-buried in scraggly grass. A strange sort of humming noise emanates from within.
setting.background: A generation ago, people sought their fortunes here. After a decade, they'd discovered heartbreak, sorrow, and agony. If fortunes were to be had, it evidently wasn't here. The miners - the lucky ones, anyway - moved on. What spends its time here today is anyone's guess.

speech: Anything to nibble around here?
If you like Hay, yeah. But that's pretty much it.
Where is the Hay?
Not here in the abandoned mine it is back in the stables.
Ah I see. My legs are not as big as yours so it is not such an easy journey for me!
I do have amazing legs don't I? The King picked the best horses.
They are rather impressive What are you doing here?
I don't know, I was let out to roam and ended up here.
Fair enough. I like dark places and nibbles.
Can you help me find my way home?
Maybe, where is home? the stables you mentioned?
Yes, back at the King's castle?
Hmm. I probably can. I know the Kitchen pantry at the King's castle.
You've been in the Caste? Are you royalty?

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: Hey royalty let me out of here
WHat have you done to deserve such punishment?
I didn't do anything. The guards won't listen to me
All of the prisoners here say that. Of what were you accused?
They say I was plotting to kill the king but I would never do that. I love the king and I would never hurt anyone
Hmmm...do you have any family or friends who would verify that? I could send a page.
My wife. She has stood by me this whole time but no one will listen to her either
I will hear what she has to say. You look very thirsty. Would you like me to have the guard fetch some water?
Yes. Thank you. They treat us so badly down here.
Consider it done. Who accused you of plotting against our king?
Some man I never had seen before. I bet he was the one doing it and looking for a fall guy
I wonder if I can have him tracked down. Where did you last see him? Can you provide a description?
He was in the courtyard. Tall, maybe 6'4"? Crooked nose like it had been broken
I will send a guard to see if we can find him. What is your wife's name?

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Greetings, your majesty! I am most humbled you have requested my presence here!
I need to have someone defend me against the priests judgements.
What have you been accused of, my king?
great sins against my people
And just between the two of us, is there even the slightest hint of truth in these accusations?
No. That is what is frustrating. These are all made up lies told by my people.
You have nothing to worry about, your majesty. Justice will always prevail when I preside in the court.
I am glad. Have you spoken to the goddess yet? She sees all. Maybe she could help us achieve justice.
I was just about to. I'm sure she can corroborate your confessions of innocence.
Tell her that I have not stolen any money from my people
She has confirmed what I believed all along. That there is no corruption in your heart.
YES! I am free! Join me for a feast tonight!
I would be most honored, your majesty!
You have dropped your book! Wait, what is this? The title reads "How to accuse someone of lying." HOW DARE YOU! You have been trying to enslave me!

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Good evening. How are you?
Just fine, your majesty. The king sent me to see how you were doing.
How thoughtful of him. I am not feeling well. Do you know someone who can make a potion?
I will contact the apothecary at once! I hope you recover quickly, my queen!
Thank you, dear consort. What may we provide you with in exchange for your loyalty?
Working for the royal family is reward enough for me!
Who is this sweet child with you?
Oh, he appears to belong to one of your handmaidens. I am not sure how he snuck into your bedchamber!
He is adorable. I thought he was with you. How is everything out in the kingdom? Are the people well?
I'm afraid we are in a period of recession, your majesty. Crops are not as plentiful as past years, and the people continue to protest against the king's taxes.
I had no idea. I will talk with the king tomorrow. I am sorrowful to hear of their suffering.
I know the king is doing his best, but I'm afraid his approval rating is dropping fast in the kingdom.
Well we will need to fix that. Is there any talk of mutiny?
The king has preemptively arrested the loudest of the protesters. But I don't know how much longer we can hold off a full revolution. Hopefully, things do not take a turn for the worse!

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Hello assistant, are you ready to torture today?
Always
What are your favorite instruments to use?
It's not what you use, but how you use it.
Well which do you prefer?
I like them all.
What about this one?
That one's a bit much to start with.
fine, I'll save that for later.
Where would you like to start today?
I'm not sure, I think we need to start with the person thee King wanted us to torture.
Who is this person?
You.
You show your true colors!

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Welcome to the bar, woman.
Thank you!  What are you the governor of?
I am governor of this province. I manage all of the cities. I am responsible to the people, but most of all to the king.
I am married to a rich man.  You are probably responsible to him too.  ;)
I doubt it, unless you are the queen. What brings you to the bar this fine day?
I am just here to get a drink.  I think I might find another place though.  This bar has a lot of undesirables
It absolutely does. You would be wise to protect yourself.
Are there any other bars that you recommend?  You are the governor here I figure you know the places.  I don't want to mess up my best dress
Take my notebook. It has a list of all the places that are safe, as well as places to avoid.
Thank you!
You're welcome, dear woman. Please let me know the name of your husband so I can send a page to let him know you are well.
His name?  why?  Do you want to tell on me?   He doesn't know that I'm out!
Oh my! Why did you leave? Your secret is safe with me.
I was just looking for a good time.  I'll be back tonight.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Princess stop your incessant crying
Alas, woe is me! I will never be free from this prison cell!
Be quiet and listen to my whispers...this priest is more than meets the eyes...he is a wizard in disguise.
Waaaahhhh, why can't someone come and resc......wait, what did you say?
shhhhh....I and the priest are here to give you comfort. Hold this hat.
Oh, thank you! Please tell me you have a plan!
quiet now we wouldn't want the guards to here. We will freeze the guard and escape this place. Your father has sent me to do this and i'm happy to do so for the gold he has promised.
My father? The king? He knows I'm alive? How is that possible? What did he tell you?
Silly girl I am a powerful witch
Oh, why did my rescuer have to be a mean old witch? Why couldn't it have been a handsome prince?

I move my cloak and now I'm a handsome prince...is this better lass? Your father saw in my looking glass where you are and he quested me to find you...so let us remove ourselves from here. The guards will not stay frozen for long.
Oh! Yes, let's go. But...I have been in this tower so, so long. I don't know what it will be like to go outside.

You are a beauty young princess. You will make the king very happy. You are to wed a prince from a beautiful kingdom.  His father is dying so he will be king soon and you will be his queen....now let's get out of here!
After you! I do not wish to stay another moment in this place.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Can you turn the light on guard?
why do you need the light
I like to see what I am eating when I eat and it is the King's birthday so it is a special ocassion.
I will allow it- but only for a short time.
Thank you.
You're welcome
We're both hired guns I suppose. Got to look after each other!
My only loyalty is to the King.
So you wouldn't change your job if someone paid you more?
No I am proud of my job as the guard.  I am a very important person in the castle.
Good point well made sir.
Would you change your job?
Some might say I am driven by money, or what I like to call 'appropriate fees'
It sure is hot in here.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Oh my did I hear a ghost?
Booo! Hahaha
Oh dear ghost please don't scare me so. I have lived a long happy life and I don't want the life to be scared from me by the likes of you.
Oh silly old man. Are you really afraid of ghosts?
No just don't like to be startled is all
Why are you in this castle when it is falling apart?
I came to give it a last look over before going to the new castle in the north
Do you remember the old king that used to rule here?
Yes...he was a true and noble man.
I am that king.
Oh your majesty I pray you will not roam these halls forever
Thank you. I would hug you back but obviously as a ghost I cannot. I'm afraid I'll be here forever. And once you leave it will be a long eternity
Can you not touch my clothes and follow me from here?
I can try. Did you feel that?

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: I have unfinished business in this life before I can move on!
I am sorry to hear that my ghost friend. I am Knight. Were you a knight?
I may be or not. I do not like to tell people who I was in life
Why?
That is my nature. I am usually suspicious of everything, like this quarters
You understand that is natural that I would ask that when we are in the Knight's Quarters? I hope you understand.
Are you dumb or something? That does not make sense at all
You came right through me there Mr Ghost. I was only trying to help. You see, I have always been charged with caring for the
For the what,knight??? Can you finish a sentence??
for them.
You know what?? I am just tired of you babling.Get ready!!
You can see what I am nodding towards, this the Knight's Quarters of the Castle. The other three quarters are for the King!
If youknow that much, how come you are asking me about the exit???
You are funny.

setting.name: The werewolves tavern
setting.description: The tavern looks like a regular pub on the inside, but when you walk in there are chew toys littering the floor.  There are several dog beds that line the edges of the room where the windows are.  The bartender has a uniform on that is covered in bones
setting.background: The werewolves tavern is suppose to be a discreet place. No one wants to go in because they will probably never come out.  The only person that has dared to go in is the witch because she has a spell that makes her invisible to the werewolves.

speech: Here, kitty-kitty. Would you like to be my familiar? Let's get you out of this dog den.
meow and thank you dear witch. I would love to be your familiar. Will you pet me please
Why yes, kitty-cat. Tell me, what is your preferred name?
my name is calico and i love to eat...do you have any yummy treats?
Hmm, maybe when we leave I can find you something good to eat. Before we go, I need something from this place--a container of werewolf blood for a spell I'm conducting.
Hmmm...i like to stretch and purr...i hide from the wolves. Can you do this by yourself?
Yes, Calico, just guard my book while I deal with the werewolves.
yes i can take a nap on the magic book while you do what you must
As you can see, I am the most powerful witch in this land. I can easily protect you if you will serve me well.
I pledge you my nine lives for your protection kind witch.
Thank you, Calico. I believe this is the beginning of a long and fruitful partnership for us both.
I hear that the king is giving his daughter a party at the castle and there will be lots of food dropped on the floor for a hungry cat.
I have what I need. This blood will allow me to freeze my enemies on the full moon, including the king and his fool guests on the night of his party. You shall feast from the high table, my familiar!
Oh this is turning out to be my most lucky day. I do love a good leg of lamb and there will be fine ale for you!

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hello dear princess, please tell me the king is going to provide us with the supplies we need?
Why should I care about that? I ma a gorgeous princess with a lot of things going on for me
With that attitude, you will never run this place efficiently!
Who do you think you are? I could have you arrest and executed for that
For I am asking for no trouble. I am coming to speak to the king about our agreement on supplies. I assumed you were delivering the news to me.
I told you I do not care about that, is beneath me.Look at all this gold.That is all I care
Silly girl! One day all this will be taken from you!
With this body, I will rule the empire
More like lose the empire! One who is all about materials and themselves will never be a successful ruler!
Look all this food on the golden tables. Do you think I would let all of this go away one day??
You will because you are foolish and prideful... There is always pride before the great fall.
You are just jealous because you will never have nice things like this in your life
I would rather be who I am than to have the personality of a person such as you. If you will not give me the answer or help I need, then I will just take it from you!
This food is only for nobility, not for peasents like you

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Sire.
My dove.
How are you?
A bit stuffy-headed, since winter began. I must be coming down with something.
I am sorry to hear that my love. You look much better than all your nobles, even if you are feeling ill!
Such pleasantries. You must be miserable cooped up in the keep. Why don't you go riding on the morrow? Your mare needs some exercise.
Oh do you think? Maybe you're right. I was thinking about getting a new cushion for this throne!
What are we reading, dove?
Cheeky! It is about Antarctica!
Oh, how nice. Another tropical foreign land no doubt.
Well, we need more information on it as far as I can tell! I'll let you know what happens at the end!
Well, it's your book. How's the mutton?
It certainly smells better than the Lord who offended my nose with his odor!
Which lord is this? I will have his head for not bathing before presenting himself before my queen.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Greetings, peasant. What do you have for your prince today?
I am not a peasant, I am a citizen of this village. I make weapons for the King.
Very well. I ask you again, what do you have for me today?
I have the weapons and armaments the king ordered!
Well done. Here is your payment as promised.
Thank you, I need this for my children.
This vase looks lovely. I think the Queen would love it in her bedchamber.
Yes it does look nice, but is it her style?
I'm no expert in art. Maybe you can tell me more about its history.
Well this is about 3 centuries old. The Queen is a modernist.
Thank you for your guidance. I guess I'll pass on the vase. I'd also like to sell this weapon I'm carrying. I have no need for it now
But.... I made that... for you.
I think you're mistaken. This is the new sword you made. That one is old.
I made them both, you can
action: put A porcelain vase in big wooden table
get A porcelain vase from big wooden table
put weapon in big wooden table

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: What are you doing here rat?
I do as I please! I am the scourge of your kingdom!
Back off! or me and my friend will kill you.
You can try, but not before I've passed on the plague! Soon you'll be sick like everyone else in the village!
You insolent rat! You have rabies not the plague!
I have both, which means I'm angry and deadly!
Me and my knight friend will know cut your head off and feed it to the prisoners!
Now I have the sword! But if you are willing, I will consider a truce. Get me some scraps from the king's table and I promise not to get too bitey.
You fool! I am simply a guard, I cannot steal from the king himself!
The more excuses you give, the more I want to bite!
Fine, fine... I will fetch you some cheese from the dining hall.
Yes, thank you! and some bread.
Don't get too greedy now, rat.
I am a rabid rat. It is in my nature to be greedy and angry.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I am planning a reception for the King from the kingdom to the north
Aren't you the king??
Of course I am you fool...of this kingdom!  The king to the north wishes to wed my daughter to form an alliance and I expect the guards to protect everyone while he is here.
Yes, your majesty.Your wish is an order
I want guards inside and outside of the castle at all times. This king from the north has many enemies.  There is extra gold in it for your guards.
yes sir. I am ready for battle if necessary
I have seen how the guards look at my dear daughter and I am aware of her beauty. I want her to be safely wed by winter.
If you take her to the tower, it will be easier to look out for her.
I want her to be happy and safe.  She will attend the reception but I want you...guard...to watch out for her directly.
Thanks your majesty for the vote of confidence.I will give my life for this cause
I expect no less...if all goes well on the night of the reception I will meet with you again here at the tower to discuss a lady in waiting and a parcel of land for you.
My sword will be use for the defense of your daughter.Do not worried about her

You are an honorable man and as such will deserve nothing less than the title of Duke.  She is my only daughter and the kingdom can use some friends to the north.  You did say you are not wed....am I correct?
You are, Sir.Serving you is the only thing it matters in my life

a the captain of the guard

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Beautiful place to read.
Ah, it is! Hello your majesty. What brings you here today? I am here all the time and have never come across you. What a pleasure!
I like to get out sometimes to see my kingdom.
Who tends to this garden? It is always exquisite, and I have always dreamed of running such a beauty.
We have a dedicated group that cares for the grounds. Are you a student here?
I am at the local university. I study plants. This book here is about plants. I could tell you all about plants and how they reproduce, but you probably would not understand.
I may be king, but I have interests of all kinds, including plants. Are you enjoying the book?
I am! I am learning more about native and invasive plants. Knowing about the bad ones is just as important as knowing about the good ones.
Very true! Do you see any invasive plants here?
This is the Royal Gardens! I would be ashamed if I seen such here. I do not, but I do see many surrounding this palace...
Good. I don't have to hire new gardeners.
No! But, I would love to have the chance to work with those who work here. What are the chances of this?

You are bright and I like you. I have it on good authority that your chances are good. Come back tomorrow. I will tell the gardening crew to expect you.  It's so wonderful to meet a young person with such passion.
And how about a keeper around the actual palace? Do you have that?

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: If only I had gotten him to be kind earlier... maybe he wouldn't have locked us all up.
Who is this he you speak of, and what relation do you have with him?
My son, the King. I somehow raised a war-monger. He has made prisoners of us all, and why? His mother didn't teach him to be kind.
And his father? Or was your son born a bastard?
The King before him.
Were you married to this son's father?
Yes, and I signed an agreement that if anything happened to his father, my son would become king.
Who raised this child? A nanny perhaps... he seems to have lost his mind throwing his elders and family into this thing. What does this child need?

I raised him! Do you think I would allow a nanny to meddle in my methods? He simply wasn't a kind boy. He played jokes on the other children. Somewhere between his childhood and adulthood, he decided that it didn't matter what I said anymore.
Then how dare you blame yourself. Some kids simply go out and have to learn things on their own. Some cannot be helped...
I've raised a monster.

Now, now. How could you have known your child would have grown up for the desire to do such? Look at Lucifer! He was an angel, many say one of God's favorites, yet he is now the greatest enemy of God because he chose to be.
What shall I do with him? I cannot cast out my own son.

No, do not do such! We need to get out of here, and you need to plea with him. Get him to remember who you raised him to be. If all else fails then he should be outcast! We cannot have such a tyrant ruling this kingdom.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hello traveler, what brings you to my court?
Hello your majesty. I'm just a humble traveler seeking shelter for the night.
I am happy to help, as long as you keep quiet since the chatter has been hurting my head today. We have a spare room in a shack near the city walls.
Excellent, thank you your majesty. I don't suppose you know if there's any bandit activity in that area?
Not that I have noticed
Excellent, that's good to hear. It's my first time in this area and I'm rather nervous about the idea of bandits being around. I'm worried they may be tempted to steal the spice I'm transporting.
My guard will keep you safe, you have my word. We treat travelers well in my kingdom
Excellent, thank you!  We're on our way to travel East to trade our spice and appreciate having a place to lay our heads for the night. Your kindness does not go unnoticed.
You're very welcome, I pray to the gods that your travels from here to the East go well
Thank you! And might I add, this main hall is quite beautiful. I especially enjoy the tapestries you've set up here.
You're welcome. My guard here actually picked out designs surprisingly enough
Well that is a surprise! They may need to consider a career change if their eye for interior design is this good.
I agree, but for now I need them by my side. Between you and me, he will be the kings replacement if I have my way
Oh wow, I'll be sure to keep that little piece of information quiet should I encounter the king.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Am I noble king?
Yes you are father
One day son this will all be yours.
Hopefully not to soon father, may I try this on just to see?
My father let me try it on for size so you may too.
Thank you sir, it is much appreciated
Ah, a little room to grow! But a good match nonetheless!
That is true, I hope that the years of training will help me fit into these clothes
That's it, everything has a home in this perfect house.
I agree father
A tidy house means a tidy mind!
I agree, I will do my best to keep my quarters tidy
How are your studies going?
They are going well father, I have been studying on diplomacy and hand to hand combat

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Greetings, what brings you to this smelly pile of refuse today?
Well, when you put it that way, haha. I was eyeing that crossbow. I might be able to make it work if I scrounged some string.
Well, consider it yours. As I've been relegated to the worst guard duty in history I'm not too keen on asking too many questions.
Just like that, huh? I wonder why they want you to guard it?
Not sure, honestly. Maybe I did something to piss off the king. Shame too, I'd do anything to defend him,
Well, it beats rounds! At least you can stand still for a change.
I suppose, I suppose. I am employed I guess, so things could be much worse. Say, if you don't mind my asking, why are you looking for a crossbow?
I used to be a merchant. Now, I'm looking at becoming a poulterer. As I have no means of obtaining fowl, a crossbow suits me fine.
Well I hope if works well for you. If there's anything else here that catches your eye help yourself to it.
If I take too much, there won't any more trash to guard! They'll have to put you on privy watch, harhar.
Haha, yes, this may be true. Still, I'm just frustrated that I can't be out fighting against the invading army. I've actually been considering abandoning this post to go and prove my worth in battle.
Well, perhaps this is a test from the gods, eh?
You may be right. Still, it's tough to just sit here and watch the garbage with all the fighting going on.
You'll get there one day! Just keep your head up.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Nice bar, am I right?
What bar? I have no idea what you are talking about. What we should be discussing is when you are going to have the cushion on my throne replaced. I am tired of asking you about it.

I am sorry, Queen. I was making a Joke, as I am the witty king. What am I supposed to do about your cushion? From the divine, I was given the responsibility of King; not these lesser duties. Why don't we ask someone lower such as the gardner to take care of this task?
You promised me you would have it taken care of. I naturally assumed you would deligate. That is what you do, after all.

Don't you see this majestic cape I am carrying? What about this beautiful crown and robe? Both you and I are royalty and deserve more than to worry about small issues such as cushions. Why don't we enjoy this beautiful scenery?
Oh my god! Why is it so loud out here? I have such a headach!
Oh no, what is wrong? It doesn't seem so loud to me. Here take my cape to cover your ears.
I don't want your silly cape! I want my cushion to be replaced and for the guy who just passed to take a bath!
But you are my wife! I, as the all powerful King, will make everything right. Let me direct one of those I rule over to replace your cushion. Should you sit on the stone bench to relax?
Relax? you expect me to relax when so many things are undone?
Why are you so unhappy my love? Here, I will make sure this smelly gardner fixes his disrespect towards you. Does punishing him make you feel better?
No, my king! He has done nothing wrong! I am so sorry, gardener.
I am sorry my queen--as we rule this kingdom together, I did not mean to do you wrong. Please accept my apology as your king and the divine ruler of this kingdom.
I can't stay angry with you, you silly man.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Hail and well met!  I am on my way to the King's service, and he has asked that I visit the lord of each demesne on my journey, to see if there are any troubles that must be discussed in court.
Hello! And how are thee? There are no troubles here to report, only taking in this beautiful view of mine!
Aye, it is fair this land of yours.  I am but passing through, but I must profess an interest in this historical.  What can you tell me about your land?
Very good question Sir Knight! You see, I had won this inn during a pit fight on the kinds birthday! Can you believe it?! This is mine!
A fellow man of the sword!  Tell me the tale of your fight - it must be one of the ages to win such an Inn-Tower such as this!

You see, it was a harrowing fight! My challenger more beast than man! We clashed for what seemed like hours, but also seconds. I came out on top, only barely, with my sword at his throat! Do tell, have there by any troubles in neighboring lands? Should I be concerned?

A fine tale, I should like to spectate one of your bouts should I pass this way again.  Truth be told there is nought but banditry, and the of miscreant who breaks the kings peace.  I hear there may be war again on the continent, as the King's cousin seeks the ivory throne once more.
Well, should any bandits, miscreants, or enemies of the king come on my land, I shall teach them a thing or two! Haha!
Hah, with this blade?  *Takes a practice swing*  A fine heft to it - a weapon of quality.  Where did you ever come by steel such as this?
I had done some work for a wealthy merchant once, to protect his caravan from raiders. As a thank you he gave me the sword. But as for prior to that day, I have no idea the life the sword has lived.

A fine blade is hard to find - though harder still is to find a hand worthy of wielding it!  Did you ever find yourself in the King's service in your younger days?  I could not be prouder to serve such a noble monarch as ours.

I have only fought for the king for the honor of the pit, but not more. Our words are few the rare times I have been in his presence without blood and sweat coating me. But I stand by him should he call.
Show me your best move!  I prefer a double-feint before a quick jab to the ribs, though I'll aim for the eyes instead if my opponent is carrying a shield.

I'm not much of a performer, it just is a natural reaction. I won't lie, when i'm in a fight, and i'm in the mindset, i do tend to tease a bit, make my opponent swing as I dodge, watch him get slower, then as he swings, duck around to his backside and claim victory.
action: give sword on the wall to lands lord

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: My humble liege, may you have mercy on my poor soul
Humble..ha!  I am your Majesty and you stole from the kitchen...why should I have mercy on you?
Because you are a merciful leader, I promise I will change my ways
I am the King and as King I look down on all who would subvert the kingdom! You stole bread that would have been on my table.
If you shall not pity me then prepare to die
I have learned many marshal arts and have taken the knife from you.  The guards will shackle you and you will die in this place!
Now that I have taken it back I shall stab you
I tire of your games prisoner. You will die here shackled in this damp and dingy place with only the rat to keep you company. Farewell prisoner!
Then I shall die with this rat as a best friend
Wait...what...the rat has turned into a witch and has vexed me to save you.
Die king, thank you witch
I have failed my kingdom by spending way too much time with this prisoner in this torture chamber. The Queen will now reign.
I shall embrace you until you breathe your last breathe. I am sorry but I did what I had to for survival

Wait...what....the witch has spared both of our lives.  Please join me in my kingdom and I will host a lavish party in your honors.  There will be many loaves of bread and you can takes some home to your family and steal no more.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

So what new wines are in for us as the summer approaches?
The finest gold can buy, or our knights can carry. Haha! Sir Edgar returned from France with some cases of very fine drink!

setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Who goes there?
You're replacement as king
In your dreams.... *yawn*
I am sorry, you're highness, please take this gold as an apology

I guess I'll die

I have no outs, my life ended the moment I failed to kill you

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

Been there done that. He didn't enjoy the comments I made about his new wife.

We must be brothers! I couldn't help it when she walked in with that beard.
Oof, you should see how long it's gotten now
Longer in feet than the king is in inches?

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Oh man!
How dare you
Not my hats! How dare you!
I demand that you stop dropping all of your things in my beautiful Dining Hall
Well now I have dropped everything.
You shall not act like this is the presence of your king
