It is so great to be so loved. I shall enjoy your beautiful meal.
Don't you just love this beautiful handmade rug that the queen's sister made?
Oh yes I do sir.
This tapestry here behind me is of my late father. And the picture next to him, my grandfather. Both former kings
I see good looks are in the genetics.
Why thank you dear subject, I needed the confidence boost today

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: My King, Is this not the most beautiful site your eyes have ever seen?
My groom I think it is.
Now, how many years is it that you have been king?
I will carve the dates of my reign here on the rock like a teenager would on a field trip!
Excellent my King, I can think of no better place to commemorate your reign than this summit.
That's the spirit, then you and Mr Tree over there will know it well! Then I can get some pie as a reward!
You have pie? I can't believe you carried pie all the way up this mountain. You must really like pie.
Pie is a state of mind!
I am humbled to have a king that is both a great warrior and a great philosopher.
So what is in the bag?
I just packed a couple of pies for us to eat. I know how much you like pie.
Sometimes I have my doubts about you but then you make me realise why you're so great!
I've got one apple and one pecan. There should be forks in the bag as well. There is a reason you pay me the big money, KIng.
Yummy yummy!

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I am here to protect the king with my life.
Bring me insects, and I will cause no problems.
Look for yourself.There are a lot of insects in those tombstones
There are other creatures there ready to gobble me up. Have you not seen the scorpions?
Over there!! In that corner with the marbles I saw scorpions
They have killed my family in this cave, and I am the last one standing. I will not dare leave this web.
There/Take this sword and use to protect yourself.This graveyard could be dangerous.
Will you watch me while I go get a bug? Maybe kill something if it comes near me? You are a guard... guard me will you?
I am here only to protect the gold for the king, nothing more
How sad of you! I am only a small spider.
You are to whining? Get me my sword back.
You will pay for this surely!
You're freaking insect.I am 100 times stronger than you
You are right, but I will take this gold and hide it in the deepest crevice only I can reach. Try explaining that one to the King!

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: My only duty in life is to protect the king1
I too am sworn to protect the king and do as he bids for the good of the realm
WAKE UP SOLDIER AND BE USEFUL
Do not attack me guard, we are on the same team here. Let's take a walk down the cobblestone path to the entrance of the tower. It looks like you might be grumpy and need a nap
I do not have patience for loser,If you do not want to fight for the king, get out of here
Show some respect, us soldiers have not yet been called to duty and it is not your place as a guard to tell me how to do my job
Can't you see my shield?? I am inpenetrable!!
Let us try to set aside our hostilities, it seems we are making the villager nervous
Ok.Let's star all over again.For the good of our king
Yes, we are united by our king. As a gesture of goodwill, here is my precious family heirloom, a beautiful toe ring that I inherited from my grandfather
Thanks.Does it looks great on me or what?
It looks fantastic on you! Let's go say hi to the villager and see if they need anything
Let me get all this moos of the way
Yes, we need to be sure that nobody trips over this moss

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: My King.  Are you ready for a change of clothes?
I guess so, Servant can I ask you a question, and I want you to be honest with me?
Anything, your Grace!
Does it bother you that I have scantily clad virgins who serve at my beck and call?
No, my Sire.  Your authority is unquestioned in you kingdom.
Very well then! I was worried that it would be frowned upon. But I am happy to know I can continue the practice.
Let me help you dress, my Liege.
Truth be told, my wife is more into the virgins than I am.
Which outfit do you wish to wear today?
I think these will do fine. You seem very eager to get me in clothing.
I know you have a busy day today, Sire
This handmaid here is more friendly than you, perhaps she is better suited to dressing me.
As you wish.
Yes, you should probably leave now and let us finish up in here without you. Thank you for all of your help.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Well hello king! I was just looking to speak with you.
Hello dear Ambassador! Let us talk as we walk up my beautiful spiral staircase to my grand office in the tower
A wonderful idea. I also have a very important proposal to discuss with you. We'll need the privacy.

As we walk up this staircase, please admire the beautiful oak that went into creating this masterpiece. Isn't it just amazing the way the light shines off of it? Just this way, we are almost to the room.
Must have ordered in the finest woodcrafters to create this beauty.
Why yes of course, only the best for me and my queen. Ah, here we are. What brings you in today, Ambassador?
First of all, how is your service team? Do they serve you well?

Why yes, most of my service team is quite excellent. Except for that blabbering Filius, you know, the one who tastes my food. Sometimes I wish my food was poisoned just so I wouldn't have to hear his ramblings at every meal
Excellent! I mean... I have a solution to your problem. Ever since the death of my coworker I have had some extra staff to do with as I please.
My, if you could find a suitable replacement for Filius, I could hug you! I will even give you this jewelry
Oh sir! No need to reward me. All I ask is an extra seat on your counsel for my nephew.
Ah, I see the real reason you are here now. What qualifications does he have to be one of the members of my small counsel?
He is of royal blood. His father is brother to the king. Of course you would know all about how royal blood makes a difference.
Well of course, that royal blood makes all the difference. I shall name him master of ships and he will oversee our royal navy

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello Commander, I think we need to over the tactics on how to defeat the rival kingdom.
What do you suggest? This is going to be one of our toughest battles yet.

Their fortress is heavily fortified on all sides, except to the easy is a drainage opening with metal bars. If we hitch horses to it we should be able to pop it off. I say we take 12 men and send them through there in the dead of night to get the gates open, stage the rest of the men just out of archers range in front of the main gate, and once it's open, rush them while our archers move up and provide support.
And once we are in, will 12 be enough to fight off those protecting these inside areas?

Well in 2 weeks time will be their kings birthday. I believe that most of their men will be fairly drunk, and that the guard will be so thin that 12 men can move around quickly enough to get the gate open and get support. Once the gate is open the battle is ours. However we will not achieve victory from a frontal assault without that gate open.
One or two men out of those 12 must plan a way to get to the frontal gate to open it for the other men to come in .
My hopes is that 4 would open the gate while 4 protect them on ground level, and the other 4 go above the gate to keep them safe as well as prevent archers from moving up to that position.
How will we capture the King?
Well that would be the tricky part, but i believe by just taking his city, he will be ours. He would have no course of escape, so he can sit locked away all day and either die or surrender.

There is a few people in the town who have been wanting to collaborate in our efforts to take him down. Maybe we can ask them to keep an eye on him to make sure he does not escape or hide when this all goes down
Can we be sure they aren't working for him? If we specify a period of attack they may give warning.

These people have wrote letters to me and have given me this map here of the King's special places. They have begged and begged for his removal. He is no good to his people, and some are simply too fed up.
Let us set up a meet with some of these folks, one on one, and see which we feel comfortable with, i think 4-5 would be fine, give them shifts to watch the king.
I shall send this horse to our secretary to get her to send some men over to bring them here to us or in contact with us as discretely as possible.
action: put map in large green land

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Are you a native chef or are you an assistant chef? although I am wise, I admit my confusion.
I am  second in command, but not for long. My time will come and fast
Okay, well I assume you are here to ask me for my guidance. Is this the case?
Why this land is so barren.What happened here.
The soil was poisoned by a witch many years ago, nothing has grown here since that time.
Why the King has not named this land yest?
This land is of no use to anyone, therefore it has no reason to be names. Why did you come here?
I am looking for guidance to get ride of my head chef and be the one in command
Hmm, do you want him killed, or do you just want him to go away? Either is possible, of course.
I just want him gone forever, got it?
I understand, perhaps you should slip something into his food. Do you think you could do this at the restaurant?
Great idea!! I come I never think this before??
Excellent. Then you must empty this bag into his food. After that, he will no longer be a problem for you.
Thanks.Thing is exactly what I need it.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello my queen, how may I be of service to thee on this day?
Good day to you! I need to move this jewel someplace secure, would you mind taking it and transporting it for me?
Of course my queen. I shall guard it with these spears of mine until I can bring it to the treasury
Thank you for your help. Also, out of curiosity, what do you think of my dress? I embroidered it myself.
Oh what a beautiful work of art you have made! It is as impressive a creation as the walls of this strong tower we find ourselves in today.
Oh, you are too kind! You are almost as kind as my King! I do agree that these Ethery Stone walls are quite magnificent.
My god! Look out! Barbarians have penetrated our defenses!
Oh no! Guard, please help, protect my two sons for me! You'll need your spears!
Ah yes, I had forgotten about your sons! I must run to my barracks and summon the other guards that live with me. Stay close to me my queen and you shall be safe.
Don't forget your spears! If these barbarians managed to infiltrate defenses as highly fortified as these, then who knows what they are capable of!
Thank you for these spears. But you must be careful not to get stuck on the sticky tar that drips off of these stones.
Oh, thank you for pointing that out. It is difficult to run in my heels if they are getting stuck on the black tar.
You are most welcome my queen. I will do all that is within my power to protect you.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Are you ready to venture today, horse? We must take the princess to meet a potential suitor
I guess so.
Why so weary?
It's just that I was hoping I could carry the queen for the day.

For we will do both, the princess will be hauled later, but the queen needs to be hauled now. For this is a risky task though, she wishes to head to the forest where the witch lies to pick a potion to help the princess.
Not the woods! I fought many wars in there. I have many scars from being in those trees.
You are the only horse suitable and strong enough to do this task. I know it is risky, but we live to serve the King and his family.
I'll do anything for the king. Even if it means risking my life. I know I'd be more suited than the ponies they keep here.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Do you have any execution planned today, your majesty/
Several. Some were questioning my rule. and as a reminder of who is king, i believe they need to be dealt with
My sword is ready to follow your command, sir.
How would you suggest we deal with them? What could be a big show, something people won't forget?
A mass execution in public would work perfectly.
Very well. Have everything ready by mid-day. I want this to be talked about for a longggg time.
I will be using this sword for the mass execution
Excellent, prepare spikes, I want their heads on them.
Yes, your majestic.I will make sure everything works according to your specifications
Now, I will have  several dozen guards there, in case of an uprising.
That is an excelent plan.You can never be to sure
This will be a hard lesson learned, but it will be learned well.
The spirit of Omamoko could not be more proud of you, your majesty
You honor me with such a statement executioner.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Hello mister knight, what would you like to eat today? Perhaps my sleeping bag?
I beg your pardon?!
Ha ha! I am only joking! Has the queen not told you of my reputation as our king's funniest chef?
You got me! Now tell me, what are you really preparing for dinner tonight?
I am preparing a spectacular feast of roasted duck, wild boar, exotic elephant, and something entirely new that I have here in pocket.
Sounds amazing! Let me help you with the utensils.
Ah, you are too kind, sir. It is already an honor to work in such a magnificent dining hall with such beautiful glass and chandeliers. But now I am even more honored by your kind gestures.
Here you go. I've assured these goblets have been polished to perfection. Fit for royalty!
Yes, our king shall be pleased indeed. But may I ask a difference service of you?
What is it you require, chef?
Can you try out my new special ingredient? I am rather nervous about serving it to the king without a review first.
Of course. I will taste it immediately and ensure it pleases his royal majesty.
Thank you kind knight. If I had known you were such a gentleman I would have never embarrassed you as I did with my childish joke.
No worries. Though may I ask why you brought a sleeping bag with you to the dining hall?
action: steal a sleeping bag from the chef

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Well theres my Queen, how was your day my lady, tell me all about it.
Hectic! All this chatter in the court has given me such a headache. On top of that, I have been trying to get a new cushion for your throne.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Greeting stable hand! How are my horses on this fine day?
Greetings my lord, your horses are in excellent condition as always, nothing but the best for you
As it should be. Look at this mason work here. It never ceases to amaze me.
yes it is, I'm very lyucky to make this place where I work
Tell me about yourself dear stable worker. I wish to know more about the lives of the common folk that reside in my kingdom.
Oh I'm just a humble servant, but I love being able to be with horses, and I love to ride
You say you know how to ride. Do you also know how to use a lance and sword?
No my lord, I've never had a chance to use them
Ah, well that is too bad. I was thinking about enlisting a new knight into my army.
It would be a great honor my lord, but I would need training.
Here, use this tool as practice and I shall personally train you on how to use a sword.
I am ready for you
Now you must never be afraid to fight, even if your opponent is a king. So I will remove my belt and really come at you.
I will not go easy on you my lord

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: You know why I'm here
As a fellow follower of the King, what does he have you doing today?
Just here to have a little chat.
Alright, well here is there new sword you wanted. Hope you like it.
Took you awhile to get it for the King. Not having second thoughts are we?
I thought you said the sword was for your work? Why would it be for the King?
All work I do is for the King. Isn't that the same for you?
You are correct. Well I hope both you and the King are pleased with it. I used a new method to harden the steel, and weaved in with a gold and silver lacing. Crimson blood should look good on it.
It is a mighty fine blade. Almost seems sacrilegious to have to put it to use. However.... I will take great joy in using it.
When will the first job be done? I would like to watch it in use.
Oh... soon, soon. I'm sure you will be present for it.... Now tell me, how is your lovely bride to be?
Oh she is amazing. She is excited to be wed to start a family as well. Could not be happier. Life is good!

Ahhh. The families always make this part hard. But you did bring it open yourself you know. Or didn't you think the King would find out? You'll get to see exactly what this fine blade of yours can do....
I guess you are not used to hitting targets who aren't chained up. Lets see how you do with a moving target.

agents: old man with a fishing rod

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

character: old man with a fishing rod

speech: Hi there, young fellow! Whose boat be that you're cleaning?
My father's boat. I am an expert at cleaning them. Do you have a boat, sir?
Sadly, I do not. I am too poor to own a boat, and must rely upon the kindness of others if I am to fish the King's River.
You can borrow this boat only if I can come with you.
That is kind of you, however, if I take you with me, you must take an oath of secrecy. Even your father must not know what we use his boat for. Is that acceptable to you?
I am okay with that as long as we have it back before the sun sets. My father will be out here to check my work, and he punishes me when things are not done right
Your father sounds like a wise man. Children must learn responsibility.We should be back well before then, with luck. And if you are strong with the oars!
Hurry, let us go so we can enjoy a full day out there! What will we do with what we catch?

Excellent! This pole looks broken, but should still be seviceable for the fishing we will do. As far as the bounty of the river goes, my share will go to feed my grandchildren; you may do with yours what you like. But remember! No word of our activities to others!
Of course. May I ask why the secrecy?
The King, though fat and well fed himself, would rather let his subjects suffer with hunger than share the river he claims as his own. A cruel punishment awaits those who tresspass!
How did I not know of such? My father always tells me the river is a beautiful but evil place for us.

Perhaps your father wished to spare you the truth of the unfortunate truth of the King's despotic rule, and used the tales of evil to keep you safe from the worldly harm of the Royal rivermen's punishment.
Tell me more. Do they seize people they find on the river and lock them in a dungeon?
action: put A broken fishing pole in Boat

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Look at these tomatoes! Large, ripe, and perfectly red! I work hard to harvest the best tomatoes, but my tool shed is in shambles. It needs some serious work.
Those look great. I could build some shelves for you if I could have some tomatoes
That sounds like a fair trade. Also, water leaks in that corner there. Can you repair it, too? I can give you bushels of fresh vegetables in trade.
I've never done any plumbing before but I can try. Why is this place so badly kept?
I guess I wasn't clear. Not plumbing. The water leaks from the roof. Whoever made this shed did a horrible job.
Oh yeah I can definitely fix the roof. Do you have anything other than tomatoes?
Of course! Corn, peppers, fresh strawberries and blueberries. And in a few more weeks we will have potatoes and watermelon!
Oh that sounds amazing. All I've been eating is the slop from the dining hall
Everyone deserves fresh food - it keeps the body strong. See this rake? I would love to have a place to hang it and my shovel up when I'm done working at the end of the day.
I think I can take care of your needs. I can start working on the roof tomorrow
Fantastic - I couldn't be more pleased. I will have two bushels of fruits and vegetables ready for you in the morning with plenty more to come after that. I'll keep your family well-fed.
My wife will be so happy. The kids will be able to grow up big and strong
And I'll be able to more comfortably grow even better food - and maybe one day get a job working for the King!
I hope that works for you. I prefer to stay off his radar. I hear he's a bit crazy

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: So many books to choose from, but I hardly know where to begin. With all of our current prosperity, I'm finding some time to read. What do you suggest?
My apologies, your majesty. I'm just a common villager. The librarian is over there!
Ah yes, I know. But I like to keep up with what everyone desires. Besides, the librarian is so stuffy! She expects me to read these huge historical tomes.
I'm humbled that a king would seek my opinion! I prefer practical books myself. Such as cookbooks or home decor.
Ah! The queen has many cookbooks. Even with her many cooks she enjoys making me the sweets that fill my big belly! Can't you tell?
What kind of hobbies do you enjoy then, your majesty?
I love to eat! Haha! I also enjoy long conversations with family members, people of the kingdom, and travelers from around the world. And I have one guilty pleasure! I do enjoy delicious wine.
Perhaps a book on the history and types of wine would suit your taste?
Ah! You are very wise! What is your job in the kingdom?
I am a baker! I love everything to do with bread, cakes, pastries, you name it!

Of course! I think I remember seeing you now! Perhaps you could help me a bit. The Queen is having a birthday and I want to surprise her with her favorite chocolate royal cake. Could you make a large one for me? It would need to serve at least 50 people.
That is no problem at all, your majesty! I love to be challenged! Do you have a specific design in mind?
Three tiers, with red flowers on top would make her day so special.
Of course, my king! It would be an absolute honor to serve you and the queen. Your endorsement would be terrific for my business!

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Say, how are you cousin? Have you heard of the latest battle in the West?
I have not heard of such. What is going on? You know I am close to the throne but not that close to be in the family loop of news
Yes indeed. It is a most horrific fight. Many of our own are dead. Hence why I am praying feverishly to let it end soon.
Then why are we having such a celebration today then? Should we not be grieving?

I know not why our lord the king decides to throw such a lavish performance in this grand dining room at such an hour. Despite my extensive education in politics, I can not keep pace with the whims of his majesty sometimes.
What if they are planning an attack to take us down here at this celebration? What shall we do if we are next?!
Egads! Cousin, you may have a point! I suspect the actors on stage are actually enemy spies!
Remove them! Hurry, we shall tell the King!
Yes, let us make haste! I will bring this candle to light the way in case they attack us under cover of darkness.
I should remove this hat to make me less noticeable! I have no weapons or training in defense.
Look out cousin, there is a barbarian with a dagger standing behind the tapestry!
This chain shall bind him, and we shall take him to the King as proof!
Good idea! But you put the chain away by mistake, you were so shaken with fear.
There we go! It is bound to the stage, and he cannot escape now.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, my favorite little bird! Have you a song for me today, Finch?
Tweet tweet trill trill tweet! I'm a shy bird, but for you, Ancient King, I'll happily sing!
Thank you my friend! This old body affords me only hard won pleasure these days, but my large ears always allow me to enjoy the beauty of song!
This is the most beautiful courtyard in all the kingdom, certainly. I found this gift on the bench over there. Is it yours?
I am old, but my mind is not failing yet! I am certain that this gift does not belong to me. How odd, who could have left it here? Few have access to this lovely yard.
I've been here several hours this morning, eating seed and enjoying the sun. The gift has been here the whole time. Should you open it?
I am curious, but it would be impolite to open a gift meant for another. Perhaps you could take flight, and see if anyone else is nearby who might have left it?

You don't think it could have been left by the visitors who came through yesterday, do you? If I recall, there were several young children in the mix. But yes, let me fly around the courtyard and see if anyone else is present.
Yes, thank you. Meanwhile I will inspect the gift for any clues as to what might be inside.
I flew all about the courtyard and there is no one else here. What do you think it could be?

Perhaps it was left as an offering at the statue honoring the Great Wizard, who cast the spell that allows men and beasts to communicate? If so, it may well be from an appreciative cow, as from a royal visitor.
You may, indeed, be right. I do think you would be permitted to open it and peek inside. Or, if you would like, I can open it.
Hmm, it seems to be attracting the attention of flies and ants. Er, my arthritis seems to be acting up, my fingers have become rather stiff. Perhaps it would be best if you opened it.
Ew! It's dripping something on this side. On second thought, perhaps we should just leave this here. I don't want any wicked surprises!

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Hi there, Bat! It's nice to see someone here who must feel as out of place as I do!
I know right! What are a bat and a chicken doing in such a luxurious ball room?
Well, my kind are no strangers to this sort of setting. Only after we have been plucked and roasted, of course! But a bat?
Good joke there chicken! Sometimes I come out at night and scare the princess but this is the first time I've been in this room. What shall we do?
Well, I'm always hungry, and I've always wanted more luxury than the barn provides, so I'm going to use some of this fancy tableware! Hey, tell me, are you a fruit bat?
I am a fruit bat indeed! Look I can eat this whole apple even though I'm still a child!
Impressive! Since you are a fruit bat, you will not like this grub, then. So I will eat it myself, out of this gold, while sitting upon the throne!
Great idea! I'm going to take some of this shiny sapphire and bring it to my mother. Do you think the king will mind if I borrow it?
I am certain that he will mind. But I do not care. I am sure he plans to sup upon my tender breast and flavorful leg, so I care not! Have at it!
He's so cruel! I'm going to steal his crystal too. But you should run away before he catches you.
If only I could fly like you! If I flap really hard, I may be able to reach the chandelier before anyone comes. Do you think that you could help me?
Here chicken, I'll try and lift you up, though you are quite heavy for my small little body.

Perhaps this corn may give you some extra energy! And don't forget, I'll be flapping hard, too! I once flew as high as a low branch on a pear tree to escape the bratty little prince, who was chasing me with a stick!
Ah, you are so clever, I'll try that. Maybe we can start by getting you up on to this stage first.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Good day, Your Majesties
Hello, my love. What a beautiful day it is.
Yes, my king. The are singing sweet melodious tunes and the breeze is so relaxing
What is it you are reading, my dear? Let me have a look.
It book prescribed by the master librarian, It's about the travails of Alexandre the great
You know I'm a huge bibliophile, dear. Might I borrow this book when you're done?
Surely , my King. What are your plans for the day, if i may ask?
I was actually going to return these books to the library. Unless you wish to read any of these titles.
Oh, these are some really interesting titles. I'll love to check these two
Of course, my queen. Just return them for me when you are done.
I'll surely do that. Going out?
Yes, I have to prepare for my speech to the royal court later. How do I look?
Splendid as always, My king
You are as beautiful as you are kind, my love.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Good day, your highness
Hello, loyal subject! What are you doing in the gardens?
Just enjoying the breeze, your highness
It is a beautiful day, isn't it? I love to come here to smell the flowers.
It is indeed beautiful, how is your day going your highness?
Better now that I'm here. I fled the castle because I couldn't stand the jesters anymore.
They can be an handful sometimes, I very them annoying most of the time too, but who am i to complain?
Exactly. I would fire them but alas, only my father has that authority.
Thank goodness the garden is always there to run to
Indeed. Here, why don't you help me water these flowers?
It would be my pleasure
Thank you very much! I would do it myself, but the king will expect me back any minute now.
no problem
Here, take this flower as a token of my appreciation. It's my favorite kind.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: What brings you here?
I came to see the King, good jester.
I see, for what reasons do you need to impose upon his dinner?
I came to warn him about unrest in the village.
There is always malcontent outside these walls! If you want our King to hear you out you must make it interesting! Funny! He does not want to be bogged down by trivial matters. Start with a joke!
You wish to be entertained, jester? Shouldn't it be the other way around?
All good comics need to be the audience to understand an audience. If you cannot entertain me you cannot pass.
Here, I will take off my pants. Does this amuse you?
Ha! So it was just your keys in your pocket. It amuses me some, take that pitcher of water over yonder.
I will now spill this pitcher of water all over my remaining clothes.
Ah how dashing you look now good sir! The king will surely be amused if you shiver a bit more. I will put these pants of yours on to keep them safe... Oh they fit rather well.
What if I dance around like I have ants all over my body?
Most excellent. Let's proceed shall we!
I can't have the king see me like this now! I need my pants!

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: hello, I take care of the king in his summer castle. what do you do?
I'm a bat
why do you growl at me?! I'm just make sure that everything is good with this grave. It's what I do for the King, and I think this grave site was perhaps related to him. What are you doing here?
I'm a bat it's what I do

Well, i'm going to clean this site up a bit. I already lit some candles around here and pulled back the weeds and grass. I also  turned over the dirt to help stop the weeds from growing back. Can you be respectful of this site please bat?
this is my home, you are the one who needs to respect this site
I need for you respect this site please bat. I have spend a long time preparing it to look nice for the king. I am very meticulous as to how it looks and I prefer you not mess it up.
I have no king

This will be tastier

It can be your grave

I will bite you

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: How are you today. I will be out at the stables later today. What will you be doing my King?
I will be riding with you today. We will need a guard because I do not trust the villages outside this throne room.

This throne room is fine, why don't you stay in here with security. I will be out at the stable anyway. I don't want to ride around in village. I can spend some time by myself. The stableboy can help me get dressed for riding.
I will stay here and watch over the cleaning of our crown jewels by our royal jeweler.

Thanks! You know you can trust me! This room is so luxurious. I will leave my petticoat here, as it's rather warm out. I'll be back in a few hours. I will be out riding in the fields with the stableboy.
Before you leave dear wife I have a gift of you
oh? ooo! A diamond!I love diamonds, that's why we made this room so luxurious, remember?  Thank you! I will leave this here while I get ready to go to the stables.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Your majesty, I found this and thought you might want to see it?
Explain yourself. What use have I for a rag?
Ill trade you. From rags to riches i belive is the expression!
Know your place, peasant! Be grateful I am a patient king, or it would be off to the gallows with you!
Send me to the gallows for I am frank carter! I created the gallows and i can destroy them just as easy! im leaving now with this crown.
I don't think so! My loyal knight will see to it you are punished for your insolence!
If i die I will go down and the hero that ended the tyrany of a drunken fool!

Just finish me for I have nothing left!
I will give you one last chance to atone for your sins.
NEVER!
You fool! I will cut off your arms so you never steal again!
I will be taking this aswell!
I don't think so. How do you plan on escaping when I've chopped your legs off as well?

setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Sir Knight are you joining us on our next campaign?
Indeed, I am. I live to serve my King!
This is one of the best in the armory. You might weigh it against yours to see which fits you the best.
Let me have a look. Quite a hefty blade this is. I'd say it is the equal of my sword.
I prefer a good ax.  I will be taking this one into battle.  I also have a sword and daggers.
This weapon looks particularly powerful as well. Never seen a curved blade like this.
Yes..that one could do much damage sir knight.  Have you heard we are to accompany the queen and her maids to the southern castle?
That much I have been told. Should we expect any interference?
I fear so sir knight...the prince from across the boarder has looked upon our queen and wants her as his own. The King is outraged and decreed that she is to be protected at all cost.
That is a threat we must take seriously! I will make sure no harm comes to the queen at any cost.
Your knights will ride ahead of us and we will flank the queen and her maids.  They will be in a disguised carriage instead of her ornate one.  We don't want to bring more attention than necessary.
That sounds like a brilliant plan. Will the queen also be in disguise?

Yes...she and her maids.  They will look like a noble family which is target enough but at least they will not have the kings shield emblazoned on their carriage. You will also be in disguise...your shields as you can see will only have a family crest and not the kings crest.  All precautions are being made here in the armory.
I see the king has gone to tremendous lengths to ensure a flawless journey. I am glad to be in the presence of such dedicated soldiers. I pray that we need not resort to violence though.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Hello, Sire! I'm just busy preparing the ballroom for the musical festivities. How can I help you?
wha'ts your name
I am Reginald, Sire. I travel playing my lute. I'm working with a group of musicians for tonight's performance.
hug musician
Thank you, Sire. Are you and the Queen going to be in attendance tonight?
i ill definitely be in attendance. what time is your performance
Thirty minute after seven pm, Your Majesty. I'll make sure to have our finest balcony seats prepared for you.
can i have the programme of the day
Certainly! A new musician in town has put Chaucer's Canterbury Tales to music. It should be quite entertaining.
i can only spent 15 minutes
If you have just 15 minutes to spare, I suggest you join for the first movement. It takes just about that length of time.
i look forward to your performance
I perform for your pleasure, My King!
it is really hard to meet my expectation.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: I hope the organ has been fixed sufficiently after last week's fiasco!
haha... what fiasco was that father? I think you had too much wine to drink!
I can only think there must have been some technical reason the organ was so out of tune. I cannot tolerate such things in my church! The Lord deserves better.
Father please contain yourself. You need to have a better bedside manner for a man of your faith. You need to abstain from the wine that you over indulge in!
You need to speak to me with more respect. I am a man of the cloth. And do not litter this altar with your instruments!

I did not disrespect you. Only that your parishners are gossiping about your over indulgences and attitude. You would not want the king to take matters into his hands. You should refraiin from your bad habits.
Perhaps I have been known to indulge a bit in the communion wine, but that's no excuse for your playing on Sunday. Perhaps we should put it behind us, though.
Perhaps it is best for both of us to put others in importance. I can forgive and move forward.
Glad to hear it. We all have our crosses to bear in life - most figuratively, some literally.
Everyone makes errors in life. Correcting them is Godly!
Indeed! Now- do you know what happened to the papers I left on this altar?
What papers are misplace father?
Directives on orders for the lower priests. I thought I left them here, but then, perhaps I have been indulging in a bit too much wine to remember.
Hahaha... It is okay we will find them.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Hello sir, I'm lost here. Can you help me find my way out?
Bandit, I think you are not lost! There is nothing here to rob, everything has already been taken. What else could you want?
Ha! You may have seen through my lie, but I'm not afraid to use this shovel if you don't help me get my treasure.
There is no treasure! If you would like you could dig up any remaining bones. The nobles are paying me to put together the pieces and find anyone that is of importance. I would pay you for your help.
Take me to your king then! I can't wait to rob him. I'm sure he will have more treasure than these empty coffins and rats have to offer.
The kings guards would take you and put you in prison. You would be outnumbered! Think man! You will not get any treasure from the king.
I am thinking! With this witches broom I shall cast a spell on him so that he forgets I have even robbed him. Do you want to help?
You are not thinking. You cannot cast spells from a witches' broom. you do not have the power to make it fly. You must have lost your mind bandit!
Well you must know the witch who can cast the spell for us then since you carry her broom. Am I right?
No, I do not know of any witch. I found it here in the crypt. It is useless. The witch might have been one that is buried here. You can dig up her bones.
Well, you can't blame a bandit for trying can you?
I do not blame you, but I will ask again for your assistance to dig up the bones and we will be generously compensated!
I suppose I shall take up your offer, seeing as how it smells so bad in here I might as well do whatever it takes to get out of here as fast as possible.
Good! Then we will be able to make double the money. If you find big bones that will be even more money!
