steal a witches broom from bandit

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Monkey, tell me, should i go on a wolf hunt?

I would advise against it Jacob.  The moon will be full tonight and the wolves are very fierce upon a full moon.  I would like us to have a quiet night here with food and ale.  The King wants to see me tomorrow to ask me a question and I worry the queen will be there too.
What makes you so afraid of this meeting Monkey. Allow me to make us some food while you tell your story.
Thank you Jacob. I'll have mine in this bowl.  I'm afraid I've lost respect for our queen.  I saw her with my own to eyes just two nights past with a Nobleman...she was blushing and laughing.
Ah this is a problem. Perhaps both of us can avoid our problems by running off together. I can provide us food as I am an excellent archer.

I want to protect our king at all cost.  I stole the pocket watch of the Nobleman and the crest upon it is of a house that despises the king and wishes to take the crown.  The queen is a silly woman and plays with fire.
What makes you so loyal to this king? He has done nothing for me and only wants to use me for my talents. But my talent could lead to my death if the wolves decide to attack.

I believe Jacob that if we both go to the palace tomorrow that our fortunes will change and your talents will be seen by the King and we will live in great harmony within the castle walls instead of this small and very ugly hut.
My greatest desire is to get out of this hut. But my particular talents are only good for war and hunting. Both will force me outside of this castle and I am not prepared to leave.
Let us eat our food and drink our ale tonight and you can sleep on it Jacob.  For me I will be talking with our King tomorrow and let destiny take it's course.
Destiny is so fickle Monkey. I am worried that you will not be lucky as you wish.

Mmmm...this food is delicious Jacob...you do have a talent with broth.  You haven't used the talent you spoke about earlier lately...what is it again?  You know my talents are talking, spying and pick-pocketing noblemen.
My talent is with a bow. I can hit a rat from 20 paces away. I learned from the best archer in the world, my father.
Was your father in the King's service?  I believe the king could use a man with your talents.  Our king is generous with his coin and you could leave this very small hut.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Good day to you Master.  I see you have brought the veterinarian.  That makes me happy as I am not feeling well.
How are you talking to me? Am I going mad?
Wait, you heard me say that?!  By the gods, what is happening here?!  I have tried to speak to you for years but you have never understood what I have said.
I cannot belive it. The vet will tend to your woes. Tell me do you enjoy being the kings horse?
Oh very much!  We have had good times riding around the kingdom, but my favorite is when we have gone to war.  I enjoy wearing the armor and protecting you in battle.
Thats good I am glad youre enjoyed being the kings horse. But Im sorry to tell you the vet is here to put you down.
What? Why?!
You have served my valiantly, But I am in need of a younger, fast upgrade.
Fool! One of us will be put down today but it shall not be me.
I know it is difficult but it is for the best
You know not what is best.  Instead of killing me you could give me away, or let me live out my days in the pasture.  Instead you are making rash decisions.
This isnt  rash desision I have thought about it alot. Prehaps i could sell a talking horse for alot of gold!
You've shown your true colors.  You will be lucky to make it out of this stable alive!
So will you!

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Haven't you ever heard of the Geneva Convention?
Oh no, what is it? Is it this prison room?
Never mind. Here, think you could fill this up for me?
Fill the tray up for you?
Yes, please
Unfortunately, I cant I wish I could.
Well, that's a shame. What is your position here, in this castle?
I am here to fulfill my duty to the king.
What a coincidence; you and I are in the same department!
Fantastic. It is great to be in good company.
Yes, it is.
It is great to be here with you.
Thanks for the petting, but I have to ask: you're not one of those "furry-people", are you?
Im not sure what a furry person is, so Im going to say no.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: My apologies ambasador, I did not see you in here with the maid.
Please do not apologise, Would you care to join us?
Ummm, that's really not necessary, unless you are sure that I am not intruding.
Oh, No dont worry youre more than welcome to join. This made was caught stealing and I am to teach her a lesson in humility.
Very well then. My family and I are insearch of new land to raise our livestock. Do you think we could find such land in this kingdom?
I am not to sure, you will need to request and auduience with the king. Would you like me to see if i could set up such meeting?
That would be very kind of you. Tell me, does the king charge high taxes on his subjects? It seems you all live such extravagant  lifestyles.
The king charges fair. If you provide for the kingdom, you will live laveshly.
But how can you afford such luxurious silks and gold?
I am the embassador for the king. And my wage does not concern you.
I am not judging you, ambassador. I am merely commenting on your exquisite taste.
Very good now go about your day. If you request an audience with the king I will back up your claim.
Good luck with your beating the maid! I am sure she deserved it and will be a better person for your punishing her.
Im sure she will aswell!

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: High Priestess, I am honored to see you today. I'm here because I'm trying to find a way out. I'm being held captive as a royal dancer.

I cannot help you! You are hired by the king. I'm not sure if you are being held captive. You are taken care of very well. You have no need for food, shelter or medical care, because he provides it all,

Perhaps, but I am being held against my will and have been since I was a small child. The king keeps me just because I am beautiful and dance well. I have no freedom. I have seen and experienced nothing of the world.

Child, the world is not as you think! You have protection here. You will not be taken by bandits or be raped by them. The king likes for you to dance and he knows that you are taken care of by the best.
I know I should see and be grateful for all I am given, but I miss my family. I have heard nothing from my parents since I came here. How can I know if they were well or even if they are still alive?
I can get your concerns heard by the king, if you have not. I know he is a just king and would get word to them or bring them here to you to see you are well taken care of
Thank you so much! That would mean everything to me. I want to dance with happiness just thinking about it. I would love to hug them and see their faces.
As I know they would love to see you and give the same affection. I have written your concerns in this scroll and the servant will deliver it to the king.
I'm crying with happiness. My friend told me you would help me, but I wasn't sure. What can I do to repay the favor?
There is nothing you need do for me, but to await the kings answer and not worry.
Thank you again, High Priestess. Now, may I please drink of this goblet? All this excitement has left me very thirsty.
Of course, child.
Is this wine? I've never had wine to drink before!
It is, what else would be in a goblet? If you are not used to it, drink it with reserve. No more than two sips.

setting.name: bathing room
setting.description: the bathing room is a huge steamed room with a hot tub. The tub is full of older priests and the occasional wench that's half naked. The room is clean, but hard to see as it is so steamy. There are loud noises of people laughing and men grunting.
setting.background: the bathing room has an ironic name and doesn't really serve for bathing, it is used for discretional activities that priests shouldn't do in the temple.

speech: Look at this, these priests are an embarrassment to the church.
Father, the noises.  They scare me.
Just stay close to me. I won't let any of them bother you. I just need to find Father O'malley, then we can go.
I believe I saw Father O'malley with the wench over there.
I'm not surprised. His appetites overrode his faith a long time ago.
He told me that I had to help him.  He said that God would smite me if I did not.  That's when I came to find you.  What do you need him for anyway?

Do not believe him. You are good and righteous in God's eyes. You did right to find me though. I need him to translate some passages in this book. He is the only one here that understands Sumerian and we on the brink of war with them if we cannot figure out what we have done that they perceive as an insult to their Gods.
He is not the only one that understands Sumerian.  My parents were fluent and taught me before they.... Before they went to meet God.  Please let me see the passages.
I had no idea. I am trult sorry about your parents, but this is fortuitous news. Please, start at the beginning and look for their version of commandments.

This text is about the Tigris and the region of Guendena.  It says that the Tigris shall be used for transportation and to feed the crops of Guendena at all costs.  Father, didn't we recently start to build a dam on the Tigris?

Yes, we did. So this both a religious and a practical matter. We must go to the king and tell him of this. Hopefully it is not too late to avoid a war. Will you come with me and translate for the king?

I have never spoken to the king before, and I may never again.  Father, I will go with you but I must ask a favor.  We must tell the King of this room and the goings on in this room.  This is a room with no God and no men of the cloth should be here.

Sadly, the king knows of this room and occassionally comes here himself to partake of its pleasures. As long as he is king, there is little hope of stopping this abomination. But we have more pressing matters to attend to at the moment.
But Father, how can we tolerate this?  If we do not do anything about it, are we not enabling the behavior?  There must be something we can do!

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: This has been in my family for many years.
It is indeed a beautiful piece. But I need to peak with you in private about a pressing matter.
Please, speak your mind.

I have just finished transcribing the latest royal proclamation from the king. It is most disturbing. He has decided to reinstitute prima nocta. It would give him the right to sleep with a new bride on her wedding night whether she be noble or common.
Well, as much as that sounds like a great way to get in bed with every newly married female, I think that would make many new wives, husbands, and families very angry. Besides, that is just weird!!

Most of the nobles already despise the king almost as much as we do. If this goea forward we will surely face an all-out rebellion. So, do we try to talk him out of it or let it go and possibly finally be rid of the king?
You know how I like to operate. I am always willing to talk things out until there is no more talking to be done. When that happens it will be time for action!
Agreed. But, while I am no fan of the king, the chaos of a rebellion could be ruinous for the kingdom and leave us vulnerable to our enemies. Shall we see if we can reason with the king?
Absolutely. It may help to bring other Royals to meet with the king?
It may, but first we must find a few willing to challenge the king openly. Do you have anyone in mind?
Of course, myself...and my very noble and gracious cousin.

Perfect. I was wondering, do you think that we should take the opportunity to eliminate the king. While he is focused on me you could kill him. You would be lauded as a hero by everyone including his guards and you would likely be the next king.

Maybe you have not been listening to the conversation as well as you should be. My cousin is one of the best negotiators I know. As stated before, I will talk until it is time for action. If you do not like my plan, than tell me so, but do not start talking about a murder to me!!

Okay, okay. It was just a thought. I guess we shall see the extent of your cousin's skills. While you summon him, I shall request an audience with the king. How long do think it will take to get your cousin here?
action: steal paper from a scribe constantly writing

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: Well hello, sir. May I ask who you are?
Good day madam. I am the king's personal priest. Is there something I can help you with?
I have this book, but I have trouble reading it. It seems to be religious text and I was hoping you could interpret?
I'd be glad to. I'm always happy to help someone come closer to the powers beyond.
So glad to hear that! My grandkids found this in here earlier and began asking questions I did not know how to answer. In fact, would you mind talking to them as well?

I would be glad to, however my time is limited. I have to make sure I take care of the religious ceremonies for the king as well. But let's look at the book and talk for a few moments while I have time. Where did you find the book? What brings you here to the storage room of the castle?

I am honestly not sure I got here, it was actually by accident. I have never been here before. I was running to the market to grab ingredients to make my grandkids some cookies, but I have been getting confused lately. So, what is this stuff?
This is the castle storage room. I use many of these paper records in planning religious ceremonies. There's also material here to record important events. Can I help you get where you are going?
Actually, this wasn't an accident. I have been feeling very lonely and have always felt very connected to you, priest..
Perhaps a higher power has drawn us together to help convert more believers. Maybe I could give you religious instruction that you can take back to the villagers, starting with your family.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

speech: Hello, what brings you here on this dreary evening?
I come here to look at the beautiful flowers and think
So, you prefer to take in nature and do your thinking in a graveyard? Humans are strange creatures indeed. What is it that you ponder?
I should ask you what you're doing here as well.
I am here because the trees here have a bounty of ripe fruit to eat. But I am always curious about the goings on of humans.
I live nearby in the royal village and sew many clothes for the queen to wear
The Queen! I have no use for that vile woman!. Why do you serve on such as she?
What an insolent creature you are! She is a virtuous leader and employer.
Either there is much you do not know about the Queen or you are a liar! Either waqy, you will never leave this graveyard!
How dare you! Get your monkey paws off me!
I will gouge out your eyes! Then I shall call the rest of my troop and they will tear you to pieces!
I'd like to see you try! I'll use this cross as a weapon against your filthy band of primates.
Hah! Humans are slow as well as stupid. My brethren are here, now you'll see what happens when you challenge the monkey king!
How dare you!
action: give flower to a monkey friend
steal flower from a monkey friend
steal cross. from residents of the cottage

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Tweet tweet! Hello, my friend! This Courtyard sure is beautiful.
Hello my bird friend
You look hungry. I don't have much but would be happy to share this nut with you.
Thank you my bird friend!  As a slave, I am not fed much at all.  I appreciate your generosity.
I understand. It is very unfortunate. I'm glad you are able to take in part of the day in this courtyard and enjoy the beauty of it. Do you work for the King?
I am a slave of the kind and serve him, yes.  May I offer you some water from my pitcher, friend?
Ah, this pitcher will make a nice birdbath. I've always felt they should add a fountain in the courtyard for me to bathe on a hot day. I only wish that you, too, could relax in a nice bath.
I wish that as well.  It would be relaxing to bathe and look at the statues.
Now, to dry off. I believe the King has far too many slaves. I helped a couple escape just last week.
I'd have given you the towel, cheeky friend!  I agree with you.  How did you help them escape?

The guards at the courtyard gate are easily distracted by song. I sing a very special, lovely song. They listen a while and then are lulled to sleep. Once they are asleep and the gate is unguarded, anyone can leave unnoticed.
I'm sure your song is lovely friend.  I do miss my family and my village so much.  Will you help me by singing to the guards?
I will, indeed! There are only two on duty right now. It should be an easy task. I'll fly over in just a few moments, so you will need to get anything you want to take and be ready to go.
THANK YOU my bird friend, I think I will just go as I am, less to carry and less to worry about.  I cannot thank you enough!

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Welcome to the main hallway. Is there anything I can do for you?
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I am her to trade goods.
Delightful. There is to be a market set up this afternoon for village traders. I'm sure they would be happy to have you join them.
Thanks.I will try it.The decoration here is marvelous
Indeed. What items did you bring to trade? Anything unique?
Mostly stories about my country. I ma a writer with a lot of imagination
That sounds delightful! Stories of other lands are always much in demand. I am sure you will find many eager to read them.
I could write a story right now about this hallway and all of this grandious
Perhaps you would like to rest a while before the market convenes. I could bring you a small snack.
This is my tool for writing.I am nothing without it
It's obviously well-crafted. But perhaps you would prefer a pen?
No thanks.I do not like to write with pens.So.tell me. who do you work for?
I work for the King, as do all the handmaids. It is our job to keep this hallway and the rest of the castle clean, as well as make sure all visitors are cared for.
Did you work on the decoration here? It is mind blowing

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: hello there
Hello! Are you guarding this ballroom? I noticed it has a peculiar, musty odor.
Yes, I noticed too. The maids said the their is a dead rat under carpet.
Good heavens! That will not do at all! Where is the maid or the servant? Surely we cannot be expect to deal with this horrendous thing!
They'll be here soon, I've ordered them to get rid of it and clean of the room before the king gets here
I should hope so. I heard the King ranting about earlier this morning. He seems in a particularly bad mood. Perhaps there was a dead rat in his room as well!
Probably, So what brings you here?
I'm here to see if there is any news to spread through town. I make money by sharing gossip of those in the kingdom. Haha!
Hmmmm, interesting....i wish i had news to give you presently
Oh, worry not! At tonight's ball, there will be many scandalous behaviors to observe! And my eyes will miss nothing.
That's true, when the wine meets the right place, the real persons take charge.
And see this key? This allows me to enter the King's chambers. There are always many surprises hiding there.
Just becareful, like you said 'he is in a very bad mood', else your head might be on a stake by morning
Oh, I'm not afraid of him. I know far too many things that he would not like me to share with others!

setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: Hello rat, Have you been doing your job and keeping these hallowed grounds free of pests?
Apparently not, you're still here. I'm kidding, please don't kill me.
Really funny, rat. You're lucky I need you here.
I've always wanted to know who is buried here. Do you know?
Why yes, this is the royale burial grounds. Countless royalty from many generations.
I'm not very good at reading, can you tell me what it says on this placard?
King Louis the XIV, rat killer.
WHAT! Rat killer! Yikes. I'm glad he's dead. I'm going to spit on his grave.
I was only kidding rat, you're so gullible.
Hey, that's not very nice. Illiteracy is not a joking matter. Prepare to duel.
Toothpicks aren't "swords" rat.
Good luck digging graves without this shovel! You're going to get in trouble.
Wow, I'm surprised you can carry all that weight.
I'm stronger than I loo. I also carry diseases that will kill you if you touch me so don't get any funny ideas.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Good evening, fair Handmaid and loyal Royal Chef!
Good evening my Lady. What brings you down here to the kitchen? We don't see many nobles down here.
I seek sustenance after my weary travels

I see, so youd like something to hold you over until the royal dinner. Please, come, sit down over here. I've been working on a fine rabbit stew that I am sure will warm your bones and revitalize you.
It smells excellent.  I am glad to sit, as I have only just arrived.
Well, what do you think? I pride myself on my cooking and would love to know what you think of my stew before I serve it to His Majesty.
Well, let me see.  *slurp*.  It is hearty, the herbs pair well with the rabbit, maybe just a hint more salt, but I'd have to say this is the finest I have had!
Thank you so much, such praise does my heart good! Now let's talk about the vial I saw you empty in to the pot after your potion was ladled out.
I know not of what you speak of.  You must be mistaken.
I have a sharp eye and I am no fool. You wish to harm my king! I will call for the guards and have them lock you away until the king can deal with your treachery!

How dare you.  Call the guards.  I'll sample stew from the pot right in front of them.  As I have already ate some, to no ill effect, this will prove it is not poisoned, then YOU will be locked up for bearing false witness!
If you truly wish my king no harm, then what did you put in the stew?
I had no vial, I put nothing in the stew.  I only smelled it
Please forgive me my Lady, I must have been mistaken. I only want to protect my king. Will you have me arrested now?

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: A spider! I must determine if you are poisonous. If there are more of your kind, I might need to alert someone. We must be sure the king isn't bitten.
Fear not, stout guard.  I bear you and you King no harm.
A talking spider! It's not often I see anything interesting here in the debtor's prison. What brings a creature like you to such a dark, depressing place?
I am in a mission to teach kids of the realm about kindness.  When a fly gets trapped in my web, I free it.  Too many people are afraid of spiders!

As a king's guard, I'm not afraid of anything. I must be brave and strong to protect the king from any threats. It takes a stout heart to work here. Never seeing the light is part of the punishment for prisoners, but it also means I spend much of my time in the dark. Without windows in this place, how did you even get here?
I rode on another guards back.  This place is good for me as there are many flys to be kind to.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: Prince, were are you.Come here at once!
How dare you command me.
I am the Empress. Did you forget about that??
You are the second wife of the Emperor. I am the Prince. I will have your head.
Boy, you need to study about nobility
You are obviously low born. I am the Prince of this castle. You are a guest here. We shall see what my father the King says. I will see your head on a stake.
Again,if I am the empress, that means I live here and I am superior to you, got it???
I don't blame you for your misunderstanding. As a second wife I am above you as I am the Prince. Now leave me be at once. I am here reflecting on what young lady I shall chose to be my wife.
Peasnt.Go by a book about nobility for the Prince, so he can finally understand that I am in charge here, not him!!
Please excuse the Empresses bad behavior. Being low born and marrying into royalty has went to her head. Go instead to the kitchen and get refreshments for yourself.
You are stealing form workers now?? Very noble of you.
No wonder you are hated. The way you speak to people is not polite. I will be sure to pick my future wife wisely as I do not want her to be as cruel as you are.
I will make sure she never get these jewels
These jewels are part of the tombs. How dare you steal from the dead!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

character: the poet who recites his best work.

speech: Good day, poet.
I'm really nervous about tonight's poetry performance. Will you be here to hear it?
Oh yes. It'll all be fine.
I'm going to keep this heirloom here to bring me support. I'll feel better knowing that it is near. I'm so fearful of performing before the King.
Here are some coins as well.
Thank you. I have heard that if the King does not like the entertainer, he locks them up for years in the prison.
I don't think you will have that issue so much.
There are seats for 30 at this dining table. Do you think it will be full tonight?
I do believe so, from the mutterings I hear. I feel like more than that wanted to show up.
I'm so nervous I am sweating already. Perhaps you should keep this rug with the heirloom inside. I'll feel better knowing it's in your care.
I will hold onto it for you until show time. Did you write new things I haven't heard before>
I have a new poem dedicated to His Royal Highness about the glory of his kingdom. I believe he will love it.
I do not have doubts, you do have some of the best work in the kingdom. That is why you were asked to do that tonight.
Thank you. Your confidence in me means so much!
action: hug the poet who recites his best work.
put family heirloom in hand woven rug
give coin pouch to the poet who recites his best work.

setting.name: Horse's stables
setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

speech: I hope you are not afraid of talking mice.
Ah! Talking mice!!
Oh dear, that is not the reaction I was hoping for. Perhaps we can start over?
I'm kidding, you get used to talking animals in these magical stables.
I know. It's pretty crazy that I can talk and I carry the King's sword.
Not really crazy to me. These stables have a lot of surprising things.
Yo know, I wasn't always a mouse. I ran afoul of a witch and she turned me into one.
What were you before? A human?
Yes, I was a brave knight. I fought in many battles for the King. But now, I spend my time in this smelly stable.
Why did the witch transform you?
I discovered she was conspiring against the king and she turned me into a mouse. It was really quite traumatic for me.
Have you tried to tell the king?
He will not listen to a mouse. He just tells the cats to chase me whenever I go into the castle.
I can't gain access to the castle at all so I can't help you.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Hello, bird!
Hmm... Oh, hello, Knight. What brings you here to the field?
I'm here on an investigation for the king. What beautiful colors you have!
Thank you for your explanation of being here, and thank you for your compliment.
The king has sent me here to make sure there is no threat of invasion. Have you seen anyone suspicious?
No, not really. However, I do keep an eye out for eagles, for they are a threat to me. However, I'll let you know if I see any funny characters.
Thank you, bird
You're welcome. Also, listen. This isn't an ordinary nut, its a magic bean, that makes magic tasting coffee.
Thank you, bird! How extraordinary! Where did you find it?
I got it from the bin of the local coffee... I mean, I got it from the secret caverns.
The secret caverns? Could you show me where they are? That sounds exciting!
I'm sorry its secret, as it was a false claim. The secret caverns is nothing less than a local coffee shop. I'm sorry. But, the coffee does taste like magic though.
Well, that's quite a story!
Ha, ha. Thank you.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: You there!  Don't let that soup burn - I want only the finest for the King's honored guests.  And you, who are you to be standing in my kitchen!  Speak up, there, I don't have a moment to spare!
Oh! I'm just- a visiting guest, sorry! I'll get right on it, chef. It smells wonderful in here.
Ah, honored guest of the King!  You must be the one everyone is talking about.  Pardon my rudeness - I have to be sharp with these louts or else nothing would get done!  You understand how it is.
I- well, yes, but I don't mind helping out. I fancy cooking, it's one of those things that I don't get to do myself. I can't wait for the feast, so I traveled down early. What are you preparing?

Hrmp, well.  No offense, good sir, but have you any experience.  I can't risk the king's ire by ruining the meal.  The last chef who displeased him had his hands cut off... and then his head, for good measure.
Oh, not really, I suppose I should leave you to it. You won't mind if I watch you cook, will you? I will stay out of the way.
Well... here don't look so crestfallen.  Hold this at least - be careful, it's quite hot.
Oh! Alright, I will do that. Anything I can do to assist without being in the way is a joy. When I was a child, I visited kitchens quite a bit! The smells always drew me in.
So, why is it that the King is bringing in a man such as yourself?  He's usually a reclusive sort, not much for company.  Truthfully this is the most food I've cooked since I started this job!
He calls me in sometimes when he is feeling most lonely. I would like to say he simply likes my company, but I also bring stories from my travels that entertain him.

Well, I suppose you know him best.  Just... well a friendly piece of advice, but watch yourself around him.  He's gotten a little testy for some reason ever since he had his wife executed for high treason.

Yes I had heard about that, nasty business. I will do my best. I brought my book of prayers and my hymn book just in case. They've always been a feeling of- protection for me. How are you dealing with it?

Ha - mostly by staying down here.  I had a right time of it trying to figure out what he wanted for this evening's menu.  I've never seen a face turn quite so *very* red when I suggested the goose over the venison.

Goodness me, staying out of his way seems like a good idea in that case. I will do my best to cheer him up and give you an easier time. I've stories from the spice markets that I think he will enjoy. Busy place that is!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Good afternoon, lady
And a good afternoon to you. Have you been cleaning in the kitchens again?
I have. The queen likes them spotless. How is your day going?
Better than yesterday, but only so. The Queen is still in the middle of her lover's quarrel with the King.
Oh no! What happened?
Some conversation about foreign policy turned into how handsome neighboring Price Daniel looks and then it only got worse from there.
Oh no! I can't imagine that went over very well with the king. How long do you think it will take to blow over?
Not nearly soon enough. It's all I've been hearing about now for nearly a week. Hopefully the conversation with the chefs is much more pleasant.
I hope so, too. Are there any issues with foreign policy?
From the way the Queen tells it, that part of the conversation took a....secondary role rather quickly. I do hope the King doesn't take his frustrations out with tariffs.
Me too! The kingdom will be up in arms. They're already overtaxed.
It's no good when personal pettiness effects an entire country. There must be something I can do to help.
Here. Maybe if you give this jewel to the queen she will be happier. I found it this morning while cleaning. Maybe if their lovers' quarrel blows over, the king will not tax the people any further.
No, wait! What if I say this is from the King? Do you think that would help?

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Dis the shipment with material arrived, craftsman?
Yes, and I hope it is right this time. I cannot afford another setback.
I just want to make sure they send the right equipment. We need to finish building the castle
Let me take a look at this wood  here. I am not sure it is exactly what I ordered.
Let me see that.Yes, this is wood of the best quality
And this rope. Is this rope made of the finest hemp? The king will be displeased if it is not perfect.
Yes, the rope is fine.Let's put this to use.Check that water gate over there
Very well then, I'll sign off on this shipment. Everything seems to be in order.
Great.We have all we need to finish this work.There you go, cut.Start with this piece
Now, we need to discuss my important shipment coming in next week. You must notify me as soon as it arrives.
You don't get to order me around.I am in charge here
Wow, if you are so high strung, perhaps the shipyard isn't the place for you to work. Have you considered becoming a farmer?
Perhaps I should shove this on your head.
The king is going to hear about this. You are not going to like it when the King's men come to arrest you!

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Hello  sir. How are you today? Are you done delivering milk
Are you confusing me with the milk man? I know we are twin brothers, but I would think you could tell the difference! Look- he has a mole by his eye and I don't.
Oh I am so sorry! I did get confused. Please forgive me. Are you helping your brother with his deliveries today?
I am. And we are just about done. We need to take two buckets of cream to the cook at the castle. Apparently the King wants his favorite dessert tonight.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: How long have you served the king, guard?
I have served His Majesty for 15 years now, Watcher. I am getting a bit on in the years but my shield and sword are ever ready to serve.
I see. And art thou as loyal to your squire as when you were a young buck?
Loyal to my squire? Pah! He should be loyal to the King and I, no more. Should I ever turn against my Lord, then I should hope he strikes me down! How does your day fare?

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: What is your confession my son?
I have come to confess my sins. My master has asked me to steal.
So what are you confessing? Do you steal something or not?
Yes. I stole a coin purse from a lady.
Then you must return it to her and tell the king about your master. I cannot absolve you if you are just going to continue stealing for your master.
I am loyal to my master. I cannot disobey him. I love working for my master

Then you are wasting my time. Do you want permission to steal?! That's not going to happen and I others waiting to confess who aren't planning to walk out the door and commit the same sin again tomorrow!
You are no priest. My master was right about you. My next confession is murder. I was sent here to murder you.
What?! You would kill a man of the cloth? Why?
Because I am loyal to my master.
Wait, this golden cloth is worth a small fortune, if I give it to you, would be willing to spare me?
No. I was instructed to kill you AND take the golden cloth. And I will do so.
Is there nothing that I can do to persuade you to spare me? There are many treasures hidden in this church. I can make you very rich.
My master did not ask to steal anything except for the golden cloth. Then I am to stab you 100 times.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: O-oh my, Your Majesty.  I humbly beg your pardon; we weren't expecting you for another hour at least!
yes i nam free now
Ah, yes, my King.  May I ask, what brings you to the temple?  The sacrifice isn't quite ready yet; I'm afraid the girl is still getting prepared.
the girls are very lazy
I... yes.... I suppose so.  Still, she must be drugged, as you know, lest she struggle overmuch and ruin the offering.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: It's a rough life, guard. Caring for the King can be thankless. Do you feel fulfilled in your job?
I am quite proud of my skill in weaponry, servant. As such, I do not mind serving the King. Are you cleaning the rooms?
I am. Making the King's bed, cleaning of his armoire, putting away his things. It's all in a day's work for me.
I do hope that you find a better calling, young man. Perhaps I could show you a thing or two when we are both free.
Ah, but I'm not unhappy. Sure, there are days it gets tiring, but I'm well fed and cared for, and I can feed my family! But thank you for caring.
Ah yes, it is good to appreciate what the King provides for us. Could you help me put away these weapo-- ah HA! Take that, fiend!
You can't hurt my King, I may just be a servant but I'm not afraid to attack you!
You have a good arm, servant-- perhaps one day you can become a page or squire. The assassin has been vanquished! Do you think he wanted to steal the jewels?
I fear he might have been after the King's head. I have heard murmurings that his jealous brother is in town.

Oh, Prince Leon is in town? Oh dear, that is bad news. Say, have you heard of the bandit attacks along the northern border? Perhaps there was a more sinister reason behind those seemingly random attacks.
Say- let me look at that map! I was in the forest the other day gathering herbs for the cook and came across some bandits. I was quiet and didn't disturb them, but they were clearly up to no good.

Oi! Let me see-- right here? .... Of course, the forest would be the easiest route, and it will be hard to track them in the melting snow. I must report to the other guards about this. Did you get a good headcount?
There were five that I saw, but I overheard them speaking of others. I am certain they were not alone!
This is terrible news. First the assassin and now more attacks? I sincerely apologize for involving you in this. Also, I'd like that sword back, if you please.
action: remove a pile of discarded armor
give sword on the wall to a servant
steal map of the kingdom from guard
give a pile of discarded armor to a servant

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: I am tired on working on this boat all day long.
If you do my bidding, you won't have to work anymore at all. I'll make you rich enough to buy your own ship!
Are you enough old your bend of the bargain??
I always keep my word, and your other choice is deathat the hands of my guards. Dou you want to do business with me or die tonight?
Ok,take it easy.Do not be so extreme.Let me think about it.
There is nothing to think about. You will agree to kill the Duke travelling on your ship next month before he reaches our shores or will die, here, now!
Let me get this from you before you hurt yourself.
What!? My guards have brought me the village idiot! Do you not understand what I am telling you? There is no way to leave with that you fool! I should kill you myself!
I am not surprise people call you the mad king, you are really nuts
How dare you! I will have you skinned alive while your family watches. I may skin them too, just for my amusement. Then I shall have a new table cloth made from the skins.
Take it easy, your majesty. I am here just to help you.
You are stark, raving mad! I think I like you. Will you kill the Duke for me?
The duke?? How much are you paying for his death?
A chest old gold and gems that would make you richer than most lords. And the undying gratitude of your beloved king.
action: steal a crystal ball from mad king
give a crystal ball to mad king

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: That's a beauty we got there !
Whats a beauty? Looks like a wasteland to me!
Oh gosh! the beast can talk! what kind of sorcery is this bottle containing?
Of course I can talk! You're going to need that ale, though! there isn't anything else to do around here!
Uh, you are right... Bloody town, can't even find a nice gal to spend the evening with! And now I'm talking to a horse...
There must be something to do around here for a horse of my class! I carry the king! What do you do?
The king? Are you talking about that dull sheriff? I am taking care of that well over there, not as impressive!
Well, perhaps you could work for the sheriff! He is looking for a deputy you know!
Really? That would be awesome! I can't stand that job anymore.
I can't think of someone better!
Can't believe I would be getting my dream job from a horse!
Well, at least I'm not a donkey!

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: i am here to defend you with my life, your majesty.
Oh do quit bowing. It does embarrass me so.
I need to show all the respect you deserves.
Yes, yes. But let's sit. Have a chinwag. It's so exhausting being deferred to all the time.
Ok.Let me get confortable.
Excellent! Now, we won't tell her majesty about this, will we?
I tough you were the king.I am confused now
Oh, but I am! Heavy is the head that wears the crown, and all that. And this crown is heavy! Now. Tell me about your family, good guard.
I can offer you this humble shield.I do not have a lot
Thank you, good guard. But I want to know about you! Tell me, have you always wanted to be a guard?
It was always a dream of mine to dedicated my life to protect the king.
And I thank you, good sir. You have done an admirable job. I know it can't have been easy to dedicate your life to someone else.
I will defend your kingdom the rest of my life
Well, let's hope you have a long life! Have you a wife? Children? A fluffy dog?
action: put crown in red silk prayer bench

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Aaaah, a human!  Please don't eat me, I'm too young to die!
I was sent out here to pick flowers for the king not to catch a small animal. But now I see some sort of treasure out here.
Hm, well just stay out of arms length at least... a treasure, you say?  A nice catch of acorns perhaps?  This flower looks particularly delectable.
An easy mistake for an animal like you but this looks more like something a human would find valuable. Now if I can just move this stone I might be able to get a look at it.
Well while you're busy with that, you don't mind if I have a look in your bag, then.  I don't suppose you have something tasty in here?
Now listen here little animal I had no intention to hurt you but stealing my stuff isn't gonna work out for you.

Ah, yes, well.  Fair's fair, I suppose.  I'll trade you this flower then - believe me, it's worth way more than any lump of shiny metal.  The hedge witch nearby comes and picks them when they happen to grow here.
What I need is my bag back so I can pick a bunch of flowers for the king and stow that treasure in it too.

Ok, ok.  I guess I wouldn't want to live forever, either.  Here's your bag, two-legger.  I wouldn't mind getting that flower back though.  Sometimes the witch will trade me a tasty treat for one of those.
There take your flower now I need to get to work.
So then, what kind of treasure is that you've found?  I've heard that shiny round metal discs are quite the thing now...
I think its a whole box of those shiny round metal discs you mentioned. I'm going to be rich!
O-oh goodness, that's very close.  Now put me down, human, there's a good human.
I'm sorry now I just need to pick some flowers so I finish my job for the king. I don't want to end up in a dungeon.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Maid! Come here immediately.
Oh no! Am I in trouble?
Pick that up! The floor of my banquet hall is no place for your dirty rags. Now, go check where my food is. I'm very hungry and tired of waiting.
Oh dear, oh dear. The King is speaking -to me-. I
Why are you moving so slowly? I can't eat these candles. Hurry up!
I'll go check on the kitchen right away your Majesty! Right away!
Hands off! Don't you know your proper place!?
Ack! Help me! I'm being assaulted by the King.
Now you've made a watery mess. Don't force me to discipline you more harshly. Control yourself! Clean up this mess immediately!
Oh everything is going so wrong. I was meant for better things than this. I never wanted to be a maid.
You may wish for better things, but you are no more than a simple maid. And I still do not have my food. What are you waiting for?
I'm just a maid, I'm not in charge of the food. My job is to clean this hall. Why don't you yell at that servant.

I am accustomed to having my wishes fulfilled. You are here, so you are the one who will serve me. It's inappropriate for you to clean in my presence anyway. Now go check on my food. You can yell at the servant if you wish.
We have to stick together against this tyranny.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Good morning brother. How goes it?
Good Morning Your Highness! Things are well. It is good to get away from the fuss of my sisters.
I find it very relaxing here in the Great Armory. This sword is my favorite by far. It was used in the Battle of Blackwater.
Do all of the weapons here have a story? There are so many of them on display!
The ones hanging and in cases do. Take this crossbow. It was used in Roberts rebellion when he usurped The Mad King. It made me want to be a great warrior when my royal nanny read me his story.
I can't imagine telling a young child any of the stories of the Mad King! How gruesome your bedtime stories must have been, Your Majesty!
I loved hearing these stories. It in part is why I am so brave and fearless.
The bravest man I know, my King! I myself prefer to take my shots from a distance.
I prefer a close up kill. Nothing is better then looking in the eyes of the enemy and delivering the death blow.
I suppose this is why you are the Great King, and I am not.
I will be training today with The Hound. I need to perfect my axe skills. This is my favorite axe.
The wooden handle looks as though it fits your grip perfectly. Who was the Smith that created such a wonderful weapon?
Gendry made this before he left the kngdom.
An authentic Axe of Gendry! I have only heard stories, but never imagined that I would be face to face with one. Is it true the blade never needs to be sharpened?

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Hello, person. What brings you to the desert?
It's so hot. I must be going crazy, did this bird just talk?!
I did. This is a magical desert.
I came out here in search of wood scraps, but I think I've wandered too far. Fly up to the top of the tree and see if you can find a way out of here.
There are jagged hills and mountains, but they are few and faw between. It's mostly all desert. I'll fly up to the tree over there.
You found some nuts? If you can talk, do you have basic motor skills too? Cut some down for me!
I don't have basic motor skills, but I will look for more nuts on my way to the tree. What brings you to the desert?

I came for wood. I have to come out this far in search for it, and this place is almost barren. Would it hurt the king to fix this land and make it usable? Or at least provide us with adequate housing so that the likes of me don't have to pick up anything I can find. I assume his answer would be "let them eat cake".
Cake or pie. He seems to prefer apple these days. I imagine he would consider your request...so long as he can triple taxes.
I'm still talking to this bird! I need to snap out of this! It's probably not even real.
You can find your own way out of here, crazy person!
Good luck finding water out here, pigeon
I'm not the one out here thinking I'm talking to a bird.
You're right! Darn this place!

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: Hello there guard, wonderful weather we are having.
Why are you so flippant?  We have been searching for you and finally found you. You should be afraid for your life.
For me? Why?
Don't you know?  Has something happened to your mind?  You served the king until you stole from him.
You must have me mistaken for someone else. I would never steal.
It was seen by 10 different witnesses.  Come here and make it easier on yourself.  Give me that!
No, I am not even from here!!
You have no where to go.  I and my men will take you to the magistrate and he will hear your pleas.  You are holding the very thing that you're in trouble for!
This is my family's heirloom!!!! It belongs to me!!
It has the royal crest on it.  You have the worst lies.
Look here guard just leave me alone and there will be no trouble.
You have no choice in the matter.  The king will have you come forth.  You are lucky he is such a good king, who will have your side heard.
I have heard enough! All I want to do is be an acrobat!!
You attack me and that is grounds for me to kill you.  Prepare to die!

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: Hello, garderner. This shed is in terrible condition.
Aye, a right cleanin' and fixin' is what it needs, no ifs or buts about it.  What would you like me to tackle first dear leader?
We need to get rid of this moss first. I want to fix this shed, it's a waste to let it die. My soldiers can use this a resting station when we march out in the next spring.

*Begins working on cleaning the Moss*  Oh how lucky you is sir!  Why I was tellin' Alice just the other day - love of me life she is - that any service in the name of the King is service worth doing.  I should so love to find meself in the King's service sir . . . ah, but me commitments at home do prevent it.
It does not appear strange that you do not spend much time here. Given the quality of this place, I'm surprised you are even here right now.

Well Sir, me Tomatoes is almost ripe, and I do loves me some tomato Harvestin' - why just the other day Alic was sayin' to me, why those tomatoes are nearly ripe, yes she did, and I said yes they are, not two sundays left till harvest time.  *finishes with the moss*  The folks in the village have been saying there have been some mighty queer goings on in the graveyard these days, might be why the shed was neglected sir?
The graveyard, you say? Perhaps the wild animals that once called this shed their home has found a new caretaker. Speaking of which... Your caretaker, Alice. Where is she now?

Oh, me Alice!  Love of me life she is!  She be fishmongerin' in Chesterwick village on Mondays, Presterwick on Tuesdays, and Easterwick on Wednesdays.  Why did I ever tell you sir, about how fish sauce can be used with tomatoes?  Why utterly divine sir!  Though me Alice says it stinks enough to scare the devil . . . why I just happen to have some with me lunch here sir!  Should I use some on the shed to keep the animals away-like?

My dear friend, how funny you are! You do seem to be in great spirits despite the troubles of war I hear whispering throughout the village. I believe my scouts will be going throughout the city to help my people.

Why Sir!  Your shield must have slipped from yer arm it did!  Musn't let the sigil of the king get all mussed with moss now!  *wipes vigorously with spit and great zeal* Much better now sir!  I can sees me teeth in the shine, or at least those of 'em that are still left.  Who be the King fightin' with these days?  I bet you'll be given' thems a good drubbin' won't you sir?

Those terrible YellowCoats have begun to pillage the nearby towns. Not quite far from here, my scouts returned with a spy. Of course, I am letting you know for I fear some of they may be prominent figures in your village now. That shield serves me a reminder that I protect the people. It does me a great honor that you care for it so deeply.

Why thank you Sir!  I promise, me an' Alice will be on the lookout for these Yellowcoat dastards, on me honour Sir.  My service has been pledge to you an' the King, and I would not be caught dead dealing with likes o' them.  Why, if it pleases you sir, I shall spit on everything yellow on me way home tonight.

Haha! How about I give you the honor of wearing this crown after we finish? Perhaps we shall find the spies in your village! You are a trusted friend to the village advisors. You shall employ trickery! They'll be flabbergasted at the sight of a gardener wearing this crown.
Why SIR!  You do me the greatest of honours Sir!  Wait till me Alice hears about this!  Wearin' our blessed leader's crown? ME? Why I be at a loss o

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: We will be underway shortly.
Thank you sir.  We've been travelling for such a long time...it will be nice to rest on a boat.  Do you know where we can get some ale and some food to take with us?
The best place to get an ale and a bite to eat is right over there. The kings family should be here soon though so don't be long.
Of course, thank you.  I am so glad we made it in time to see this new boat being launched.  What an achievement!
Yes, it is our pleasure to serve our king. He has asked that on this maiden voyage that we take his daughter and handmaids to another shore to buy materials for the princesses wardrobe.
That sounds like a wonderful time.  Have you been a sailor long?
I have been sailing for some years for the King. I am happy to do so but I really hate to run into sea monsters.  It is rare but does occur from time to time.
What do they look like?  I've heard they have tentacles longer than the boat and can squeeze a man to death in moments.

Yes they are massive and not even a spear like this one does much harm.  Will you do me a good deed and bring one of the pubs delicious sandwiches my way?  It will be a good while before we reach the other shore.
I would be happy to!  If you would be kind enough to tell me a story once we're on the water.  My son is returning with the sandwhiches shortly.
Why yes of course but I believe everyone will be preoccupied with the princess and her maids.  If we find the time we can meet and I'll be happy to regale you with my tales of the sea.
Here is your sandwhich...I hope you like salami and dried fish.
I'll put it in my bag and get to it later. I see the kings banner headed this way.
I will let you go do your duties.  I must go catch sight of the king!

setting.name: Corn field
setting.description: the corn field extends as far as the eye can see. In the off season months it is barren grass, but during the corn growing season it is filled with shoulder high thick yellow stocks with corn growing at the ends. There are pathways cut into the field to provide walking terrain for the farmers.
setting.background: Corn provides the livelihood for these farmers, and as such most of their days are spent tending to the crop. For about a century the farmers and their forefathers have tended to their now famous crop, which is boasted as the best in the land.

speech: Oh no! Please go away! I had no idea this corn field was haunted!
It's not the cornfield that I'm haunting, it's you! You know what you did!
You know nothing! No one was there and even if you knew something, you cannot prove it.
I see everything. I'll let you go once you confess everything. Otherwise you know how barren this field is in the off season? It will be like that year long!
So you say! I don't believe you have such powers. Still, in some way you must have some deep knowledge and understanding.
Maybe I'll spell it out to you. Who is your main buyer for your corn?
Most of this goes to the King. Why?
Lies! I know it goes to the cow farm. You're contributing to their suffering! I'm a vegan ghost!
A VEGAN GHOST? I have heard about your types! I know you love to cause mayhem to further your vegan ways. Well, I will confess to nothing!

Please, Mayhem is my fathers name. You say I don't have "such powers", but with the appetite for corn you've given these cows, perhaps if they were spooked over to your field by a certain specter, they'd ruin this crop and your land for good!
Perhaps, but as a vegan, aren't you supposed to be a friend to all things, including vegetables?
I eat vegetables for breakfast. Repent now! Channel your corn cache to the king as you say you do and all will be well, and I will be gone. Otherwise...
I repent! I repent! I'll do as you say. No more of my corn will grace the cows. I will not contribute to meat eaters any longer! Just don't hurt me.
About time you showed some respect, maybe i'll let the cows out any way, for fun!

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Please, can you help me escape? The torturer is killing me but I will never break. It's escape or die!
Wah! How did you get in here? What is going on? You're...bleeding everywhere...

I'm a mess, bloodied and badly injured. Please, do help me! I ran from the torturer when he was distracted and made my way into this house. But I need to cover my wounds and get out of here to be free.
Don't get me wrong, but surely harboring a criminal isn't the best thing for me! What if he's followed you?
He's nowhere to be seen. I'm going to put on this uniform so no one can see my injuries. But I'm struggling to walk. If we are caught, just say you came across a crippled man and wanted to help.
We? Now hold on. What exactly have you done that's warranted being beat within an inch of your life?
I was caught staring at the Queen. She's lovely. I didn't know it was a punishable offense!
Surely you've heard about King Thaddeus's jealous streak. Well, I mean, you have now...
Yes, now. But now does me know good. I'll be lucky to escape with my life. Just please, walk along my right side. If I lean on you just a bit it will cover my injured leg.
Alright, alright. I suppose I can't leave a man to bleed out on my rug. Take this. It's the closest I have to a walking stick.
Thank you. This is perfect. If I do survive, it will be thanks to you.
You know, you're lucky that torturer didn't start by poking out an eye or two.
Shh - speak of it no longer. I'm on my way out. Never admit to seeing me!
Naturally. Best of luck. Now, if you'll excuse me I've got a bit of a mess to clean up...
action: steal hoe for digging from farmers

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: how do you do>
I am well servant. I see that you and the maid have done an excellent job of cleaning the washroom.
Thank you sir. Is there anything that I can get you sir?
Perhaps draw a bath. It has been a tiring morning of delegations and it would be nice to relax.
Yes sir, and I will get you fresh linens to wear.
That would be most excellent, thank you. Is there any lavender oil that I can use while bathing?
I will look in the cupboard sir.
Very good. I appreciate your thorough work. It is not often that a good work ethic comes so naturally.
Thank you sir, but I did not find any lavender oil, however I did find some chamomile. I hear it is also good for relaxing.
We are out of lavender are we? Could you make a note to have more be bought on the next market trip?
Of course your majesty. Is there anything else I can get you for your bath? Maybe something to drink?
Oh no, but I do appreciate your thoughtfulness. The last time I indulged in the bath I fell asleep, missed Royal Court, and caused a castle wide panic.
Enjoy your bath sir. Please let me know when you finish and I will come help you get dressed. remember we have guests coming.
Thank you. Now if you will excuse me, I have some relaxing to get to. I'll use the bell once I've finished.

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: Please don't eat me Mr. Bat for I will one day become a very important bug!
You're just fine, my friend. I'm much more interested in this rotting apple core, anyway!
Thank you for your kindness!
Say, would you like to share this apple core with me? It's really quite delicious! Oh, and please tell me more about your future endeavors! You have piqued my interest!
Yes I will eat some, just careful not to bite me. I am a super good bug and will some day be the most respected of all the bugs, the King of Bugs!
Well, your future majesty, I look forward to seeing you as King of Bugs! Say, those cave drawings sure are interesting to look at, aren't they? Funny old humans!
Yes those creatures are very strange indeed.

Silly humans. They're always drawing and carving their strange marks all over everything. So little respect for the simple elegance of life and nature. I'm very happy I'm a bat. I think I'd detest being human.
Yes and it is known now from paintings like these that the humans didn't have kings like we will! So will be way better than them humans!

Yes, indeed! I often wonder how they even had the ability to draw on these walls, anyway. It's so very lovely and dark down here. Why, I wouldn't even have been able to see their drawings had they not used those metal particles in their pigments, which bounce back off my bat sonar.
Wow, yea! Maybe they could see in the dark!
Hahaha! Much like you, eh, my multi-eyed friend?
Yea, maybe I will also become the King of Humans!
Oh, wouldn't that be something! Perhaps you would be able to make them clean up all their nasty litters and leavings!

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Hello sheriff, how is the day going?
Thankfully its been quiet so far.  What brings you to see me today?
