setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Hello, knight.
Ah sir hero, what brings you here this fine day?
I am going to battle against the army of an evil king.
Well it is an honor as a knight to be in your presence.
Would you, perhaps, like to join me in this adventure? I could use the help. Me, and the other rebels against the evil king.
Of course Sir Hero, I will follow you anywhere you ask me to!
Let us continue across the precipice, then.
Yes, we must watch our step, it is dangerous up here.
Do you have any extra weapons?
Yes, take this bow my lord.
Thank you. It may come in handy.
I suspect you will make better use of it then me.
I may be a hero, but with your knightly training, I imagine you're a good shot too.
Yes but there is a reason you are a legend and not me.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Those animals are quite malodorous! I know I value fresh meat, but this is a little ridiculous.
Your Majesty! Why its quite the honor to have you in my kitchen!
Yes, yes... honor, honor. There is cow poop smeared down the side of the stove, and a chicken just pecked my scepter. What is the meaning of all this?
It may seem a bit much, but fresh game like those caged doves are a true treat! I spare no expense for his highness's palette.
This isn't about sparing expense. This is about cleanliness. Are you trying to kill me?
I am sorry about the...umm fertilizer. Its just that ol' Besse makes better milk if she can roam free you know.
Perhaps, but I shouldn't have to wipe crud off my kitchenware. What is the plan for dinner?
I was thinking, my lord of roast venison and mint jelly from my fresh herbs over there, paired with tomato soup...freshly picked of course and a custard tartlet for dessert.

Fresh, fresh. I see. It had certainly better taste good. Please add a hearty dose of basil to the tomato soup. It really brings out the taste. And I'll need some wine tonight. I need to drink something to deal with the fact that my royal kitchen is a barn!
If my lord has a taste for adventure, I have also acquired some fresh..very fresh sea slugs that pair well with white wine.
Sea slugs? I'd rather not. Save the sea slugs for the donkey!
Very well. Would you like to pick tonight's buck from the pens over there?
Heavens, no! You can choose your kill. I want nothing more of this project of yours!
Certainly my lord. Just let me clean that up before you step in it....

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: This cape is slowing me down.
lets move quickly
Did a spider just speak to me?
ordinarily I wouldnt but Im very far from my home in the Dark Woods near a village several miles from here
What brought you here? Who let you into my tunnels?

I was waiting for an insect to fly in to my web when I was scooped up by a bird intent on feeding me to its young. At least thats what I presume, I managed to escape its grasp before it could land. When I landed I was hurt so I crawled in to the nearest hole I could find and it led me here.
Here take this you must be cold and weary from the journey.
Thank you kind king. Might I inquire as to where you are going now?
I'm supposed to meet my mistress out in the gardens. These tunnels allow me to slip past the queen without the guards knowing my whereabouts.
Perhaps we can come to some arrangement Kind King. I shall enter in to your service as a pest remover and in exchange you will allow me to live unscathed in your gardens.

I'll do you one better. Let's take my crown out to the gardens. I'll place it wherever you would like and you can live in it. All I ask is to be my pest control and lookout. You watch my back and I'll keep your web buzzing.
you can count on me to be your eyes.
A hundred eyes are better than two.
to the gardens then

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: Hello Prince; it's quite a surprise to see you up here!
I say!  This library is only for royal family members only.  How dare you enter, commoner!
I was sent here by your father to retrieve his slippers. He left them here while studying last night. I am on my way out as we speak.
Hm.  Well.  As long as that's all your leaving with.  Although I find it very odd that Father would send here... and mind your manners.  It's THE KING to you.  Know your place, maid.
It would do you some good to warm up to your father, you know. Just because he is the King doesn't mean you must be so detached all the time.
Ha!  Advice!  From a maid!  You really have lost all sense of reason, servant.
His Majesty does speak highly of you. Whether you choose to believe it or not is up to you. Now, I must go prepare some tea to bring with the slippers.
One moment!  What is THAT you have there?  Is this... this is the Tray of the Maker, the holy relic in the family chapel.  You, madam, are a THIEF!  I'll see you strung up for this!
I have no idea what you're talking about, Prince. Would you really have me on mock trial just because I've suggested your father actually cares?

Oh please!  First you come up to this library, where no one but those of royal blood are allowed, and then you're carrying around a priceless relic?  The jig is up, commoner.  Guards! Attend to me!  And you - don't... you... move!
You have my word that I will not resist. You may put up a brave front, but I know you still have a sentimental side. The locket chain around your neck betrays you.
You... you... how dare you!  No one else knows the true purpose of this.  I shall tuck it inside my doublet- make of that what you may, foul creature!
I have come to terms with being the royal family's secret, and I shant ever tell a soul. I hope you too will learn to forgive your father.
You know far too much.  I shall that you never see the light of day again!

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: Oh Darling, isn't the view wonderful from up here? You can see the whole countryside from up here!
Indeed! Ours is a mighty kingdom. We have worked long and hard for it, and it is certainly prospering.
Building this balcony was such a wonderful idea! The carvings are so detailed; wherever did you find such a craftsman?
The carpenter's son is an artisan. I had the two work together to create this work of art. It truly is amazing. I especially love the dragons.
It must have taken weeks to carve out each of the little scales. They are so lifelike!
You know, darling, now that we have a kingdom, perhaps we need to consider creating an heir.
I suppose you're right my Dear. It all seems like things have happened so quickly since you ascended to the throne...
Yes, yes. But if we wait for a perfect time, it will never come. There are always so many happenings in the kingdom.
One day I am simply a Dutchess, the next crowned Sovereign Queen. You have to admit, it's been a lot to take in!
I know - but one day after I am gone, you will be in charge above all else.
If that is to be, then what will become of our future heir?
I'm sure that time will tell, but he or she will be much loved.
Wise words from the King indeed! What say we give some immediate thought to that....creating you mentioned earlier?
Yes, my love. Nine months from now will be a lovely time, indeed!

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Awfully hot today, isn't it?
Dear God yes... And I didn't get much sleep last night
Awfully pretty dog you got there.
Thanks! he's a good boy when he's actually helping me work and not off chasing squirrels. *glares at dog*
Maybe he`d like a pull toy. Isn't he a good boy!
Good luck getting that back in one piece.
I`ll just have to give him yours if mine tears. I like your choice in overalls.
Woah! Friendly lad, aren't you!
Yes, I`ve seen you in this field for the last 7 years and just recently got up the courage to come say hi. The king is very strict about intermingling fields.
Is that so? Well I could put a good word in if you wanted to come work for me. I happen to know a guy in the royal family
It is so, I also see you happen to be without a wife. Maybe we could change that too.
Oh well I... I've never much thought about it. It's always been just me and my dog working the fields... I would certainly welcome the company
Then it shall be, why don`t we go tend each others fields in private.
Won't be needing this hoe no mo'

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Your majesty, is there any news from your kingdom?
Well it seems that the negotiations with the eastern nation is going quite smoothly so only good news so far.
I am glad to hear it.
Indeed, how are you doing today sweety?
I am doing well. And how is Your Majesty, father?
Well he is running the negotiations and doing a fantastic job of it, so he is great.

I'm glad that we haven't had a war in a while. Our people are the most important thing in this world. If it weren't for them, we wouldn't have this amazing palace, or lavish clothes, fine dining, or the simple happiness of a well-functioning kingdom. I appreciate everything I have in life. Thank you for your contributions to it all, as well. I do wonder what we might gain from an alliance with the eastern kingdom.
Of course, sweety. We work very hard to avoid war at all costs.
Do you think we might be able to host a ball soon?
Maybe, especially if the negotiations involve us getting a lump sum of gold.
What would we have to sell to gain the gold?
Oh, nothing. They might just feel pressured to keep us as an ally, so they would pay us for that privilege.
I suppose that's the benefit of having a great army.
Indeed, and a very strong, cunning team of negotiators and leaders.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: What a beautiful for fishing!  I wonder if the Perch are biting today?
I do not know about fishing.My thing is hunting the poacher that kills the king deers
A poacher?  In this neck of the woods?  What is this world coming to?
Are trying to mess with me. Are you by any chance a poacher?
Now how would I hunt a deer with a fishing rod?  Here, inspect the weights - they're tungsten and fully up to code.
I am the one who is in charge here.Let's see.Well, it looks like you are just a fishermen.
No need to shout.  If you would like to help me with this sail, we can use this old wooden tub to travel on the lake - maybe you can find your poacher and maybe I can find some fish?
Take this.It could be dangerous around this lake.
Thank you - this might be useful as well - especially if I need to fillet some fish!
look at those waters.It is so clear .You will probably get a lot of fishes
Aye, might be a bit chilly with the wind.  Do you have any idea what your poacher might look like?
They come on all shapes and form.Are you hungry?
It certainly has a unique . . . taste.  Did you by any chance bake it yourself?
Not. My wife did.Don't you love those birds chirping
action: give weights to town game warden

setting.name: School
setting.description: It looks like it was made out of an old church as it has a a big clock tower in the front. It displays a giant clock that chimes as soon as it strikes noon. The walls are white and massive, and there are some troughs on either side of the entrance for those that bring their children via horse. The entrance door is about a 3rd the size of the wall space and has a stained glass circle near the top that lets the light in.
setting.background: The school  was created from an old church that was no longer needed in the village. The priest held a ceremony for the town to come and visit before the school opened so that the students could meet their teacher. The ceremony was a success and even brought in enough donated money to buy the stained glass circle that's featured on the front door.

speech: Excuse me... I have traveled a far way and am very tired. Would you mind if I sat and talked with you for a moment?
Not at all! I always welcome a man o' the Lord. Could I get you anything?
No, no. That's quite alright, friend... I'm visiting from a near village where I preach. I wanted to visit the first church I'd ever visited. I suppose it's a school now... Do you go to this school?
Ah, no I am just a seamstress here to work in a quite place while the kids are out for the afternoon. This old church turned to the school house many years ago. Before I started working here
Ah, I see... Yes, I grew up in the cottages near here. My father used to take me to this church, when it was one. How is you seamstress work going? Do you enjoy it?
Oh, I love it. Such a relaxing job. I love creating beautiful cloths and sheets for the royalty to use. I take a lot of pride in my work!
Oh, my. This is marvelous work. You know... we have need for someone to make tapestries for our church. This is beautiful work you've done. Would you consider the job?
Oh? You think so? I... I'm so flattered! I would love to!
What about your children, yes? You said you had young ones going to this school. Do you believe they would welcome the change as well?
Oh they're not "my" kids they're just the ones that attend here. I live by myself. I could make tapestries for the church and still work for the king!
I'm sorry, you work for the king? No, no. This simply won't do. Are you a loyalist? No, the king is not a true Christian. Absolutely not.
Oh... well that's a shame. I wouldn't mind working for both of you but unfortunately the King pays my bills. I hope you can find someone else to handle your needs!
... You would prefer a life working for a war-mongering over the peace of making tapestries for God? I suppose I understand... I will pray for you.
Everyone is always at war with someone. Our King cares for and protects his people, and makes sure we don't get ransacked by other kingdoms

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: I feel a strange draft. Let me take off my helmet to investigate.
How dare you come into my castle!
Show yourself! Who is speaking?
I was a warrior in life.  Why are you in my castle?
So you are a ghost then? This is not your castle, ghost. We are the king's cavalry and this has been our home for centuries.
So you are here at the kings bidding?  I have watched this family for the generations you see on the walls.  I was here when they built this throne.  This castle is more mine than your king!
Yes, we follow the king's orders. We are part of a special group of elite knights. What do you want from us?
From you nothing.  You came into my domain.  It is the king I want.  He insults me to think he can preside over my home!  I shall never leave him be.
Ghost, we have sworn to protect the king at all cost. We cannot let you haunt nor attack him.
You think you can hurt me?  I was a great warrior in my time!  I have been here since before you and your kings time began and I will be here long after it is past!
Prepare to die... again!
What chance do you think your mortal weapons have against me?
What about you? If we cannot hurt you, you cannot hurt us.
You think so?

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Hello there ghost, what are you doing here?
I'm taking a break from haunting the king's tower.  They don't understand who I am..
Well who are you? Well... were you?
I once was the king here and ruled for decades.  What a wonderful time that was.  It's hard to see others doing my job.
They will all die with time, and I shall feast from their bodies. It is life.
Yes, I guess that's how it is.  Its fun scaring them though, I have to say.  You must scare people also.
Somehow I do. I am usually one of the last things they see when they lay there taking their last breaths. It is a fun sight indeed. So how did you die Mr. King?
In a great battle that won us our freedom once again from the vikings in the north.  I'm sure you might have eaten some of me, I dare say. ha ha.
Kings are usually well fed, a real meal indeed!
I'm sure I must have been!  People talk about a ghost in the well but I've never seen one...have you?
Ghosts I don't pay much attention to usually. However I have seen many bodies, living and dead, dropped into the well.
It makes sense that someone would come back to haunt the living then if they were poorly treated and killed.
I know that when it is my time, I will still be swooping through the skies, out the corner of their eyes, till everyone dies.
You can haunt the castle with me if you like.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: My lady, I didn't see you! The King isn't here at the moment? I came to bring his breakfast.
What in blazes is a thief doing in the King's dorm!  Never mind the breakfast, you must fetch the guards at once!
Uh, the guards are seeing to the disturbance in the courtyard, my lady. I fear there is only me.
Well don't just stand there!  Help me subdue this ruffian!
My lady! He's got a sword!
And now I have a shield!
Heeeellp! Saint's preserve us.
By all that is holy I smite thee for your insolence thief!  I may be the last Princess in the kingdom, but I am NOT going to let you rob my people without a fight!
Pardon my lady, when did you learn to wield a weapon?
My father *punch* taught me *groin kick* how to *knee kick* defend myself *headbutt*
I believe he's out, my lady... Would you teach me to do that?
Certainly!  No time like the present, especially with dastards like these entering bedchambers willy-nilly.  The first rule - attack, attack, always attack!  Never let up.
I-I think I understand the gist of the matter.
Second lesson - if at all possible try not to be encumbered by ridiculous outfits!  If you are light and nimble, the more difficult you are to subdue.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: I'm not sure what it is I'm doing here. Doctor do you know why the king sent me here?
You are to assist me on a critical mission
What mission is that? And where do I need to take you?
We must make a trip to the village on mount hawthorne to get a potion for the king
How far is it and will I need to stop and rest in between. Along with taking water to replenish
Here. This is a tunic of endurance, we cannot afford to stop too often as the king is in great need of this potion
I thank you. I will do my best to serve you and the king. Let me know when you are ready to leave.
I have all I need. Let us go
Climb on and we shall run like the wind. I wish to get there and back in as little time as it takes
As do I, when the king is well I am celebrated and this potion is made with a modern technique which I believ willl give the king great srength
I pray that it does. I would not wish the king to get worse.
I fear were he to die I would be blamed
No one would blame you as long as I am witness to what you want to do to heal him.
You are excellent to offer me such a kindness. Perhaps we shall find a potion for you in this village. Do you suffer from anything?

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: Servant, fetch me some flowers will you?
Will these ones do, sir?
Yes, they are perfect! It is the queen's birthday and the king asked me to bring her flowers.
Is there anything else you require?
That will be all for now. Tell me, what is your name?
I am just called servant. I had a name but that was long ago and i do not recall it now.
I see. Names are overrated anyway. People should be judged by their actions, not their name.
So are you guarding the queen today or just attending her party? If I may ask.
My duty is to guard the queen, night and day. I will be attending her party, but only to protect her.
Interesting, have you ever been in battle?
Yes, countless battles. I personally looted most of the riches you see in here from our king's enemies.
Have you ever kept any of the riches for yourself?
Nay. The king gives me food, weapons and a roof. I do not require anything else.
He gives me the same, minus weapons. And the roof and food are old...

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: It is such a beautiful day to be alive. This meadow has some mystical force here, I can feel it.
I agree! It is a great day to annoy unsuspecting people!
Who is it you wish to annoy? I think though there are spirits around here and they are amongst us listening and watching
I especially enjoy bothering the king. I have been around since the beginning of time. The spirits are indeed watching us. What color would you say that the flower is?
Which flower are looking at? this one and why does the king bother you?
Yes, that one. What color is it?  I just get a kick out of hearing the king squall like a little girl. Ha ha ha.
a yellowish orange with pink hues. That is funny. I did not know he acted like a girl at times.
He hates me with a passion. I buzz around his head and he flails his arms and screams. It is the highlight of my day. The flower is very interesting.
I would like to see that happen next time he comes to the meadow and you are here. The flower is quite beautiful
I would love to show you how the king squirms. Sometimes I land on his nose then fly away. His face is priceless.
I can almost imagine it as you talk about it. It is quite funny.
Why do you think that the grass is glowing like that? I have never seen grass that emits light. Do you think it is poisonous?
No I think it is the spirits. They must be trying to show themselves. this may be a priceless moment.
Do you think the spirits are trying to tell us somthing?

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: I've never seen you around my castle before. What brings you to the guard room?
Sire! Do you not recognize your old friend? Has it been so long that a simple beard and change of robes has made your friend, Arthur, invisible?
Arthur! I had no idea it was you! And you've lost quite a bit of weight too, I see. Is Margaret not baking her famous cakes for you anymore?
Ah, you old bastard always a tease. The ol ball and chain has got me on a diet for my own good. Not that the smell of this chamber doesn't do a good job of ridding the appetite itself
And why are you in this room? It's quite the mess and, as you said, smells horrid. Just look at the filth!
As you can see there was quite an unsightly occurrence taking place in the not too distant past. I am simple putting away some of the mess
Fair enough. I will speak no more of it. You must join the Queen and I this evening for dinner!
But of course, sire. I would be honored!
Fantastic. I would advise, however, a long bath before coming.
I wouldn't dream of entering a banquet hall of yours smelling like the peasantry that coats these walls
Good! Because I'm serious about my dinner. I love a good roast, a good steak, some good stew and some fried onions. I am serious when it comes to fine dining!
Margaret would kill me if I were to eat like we shall in my own home. The feast is on!
Good! And please, send my best to Margaret, the dear.
Certainly my lord. See you shortly

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: Hello priest! How is it going today?
Welcome, what brings you to the Church dear fellow?
I have come to pray for my children and seek your advice father/
Why of course. You should read a few passages of the Bible so I can open the Lord's ear to you.
Yes reading a few passage might help ease my mind. One of my boys has decided to join the king's army and my wife is very upset.
I see and how does his enlistment affect you. Do you support it?
I am obviously concerned for his welfare. Being a blacksmith I come in contact with a lot of soldiers and it doesn't seem like the kind of life I would want for him.
I understand Villager. I too have sons who fought for the Kingdom. Fought...
At the same time it is his life to live. I can understand him not wanting to follow in my footsteps. I work hard every day for very little gain in the king's employ as a blacksmith.
Surely you must understand that the swords you make only beget more violence and bloodshed?
I have no choice in what I make father. When you work for the king you do what your told or end up in a dungeon.
The Lord understands your dilemma, Villager. You must do what you to, to provide for your family. You must let your son follow his destiny.
I know I just wanted to pray for my wife to have peace about the decision. Ultimately he will have to go where his life leads him.
Take this, it will bring you and your wife peace in these testing times. Remember, the Lord has a plan for everyone, even that bird.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: What a beautiful little inn we have found family.
His Grace, King Tommen, has provided many wonderful delights.
It is late but I think a beer would be nice before bed.

I think I might like to have a beer as well. After all, it's been such a long day, and tomorrow may be even longer. I can't believe my only pair of pants got caught on a thorny bush. People have been staring at my bottomless bottom half. I'm thinking about stealing that wet outwear just to have something to put on tomorrow.
Perhaps you can find something in here that you can wear. I am sure a pair of my pants will fit you.
Thanks so much. I'll go through it tonight and make sure you have something that fits. First, lets get another beer, it's way too hot in here. That fan is doing nothing for me.
Another beer would be great. I wonder what this messenger is here to deliver.

He's here to deliver the King's payment. That's the only reason he comes by. You see, my father was a part of the King's Guard for King Tommen. Long story short, Dad fought off 30 bandits. In killing the 31st and last guy my Dad stabbed him at the same time he was stabbed and they both died. It's sad, but he died to save the King. As a reward, he sends us things via that messenger.
Wow wonder why I've never heard that story before. Well how long does he usually stay?

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Ahhh, it's good to rest for a bit in between jobs. Gives me a chance to relax my muscles.
Do not distract me.I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry and I need to concentrate
Oops! Sorry. Does it take a LOT of concentration?
Yes.But you also got to have talent and dedication.What is your line of work?
I'm a logger by trade! If you ever see those guys pushing what looks like a whole tree down the river, wave sometime! I'll probably be one of them!
I wish I could do that, but I have been imprisoned for four  years
Imprisoned? I thought you were a painter.
One client was so mad at my painting he had me arrested.I miss my wife and kids.
And yet they still allow you to paint? That seems an interesting compromise.
Well.I had all day long to paint, so I got way better after 4 years and I am allow to walk on the castle
Gosh. At least you're not stuck in the dungeons any more. How much longer do you have to stay?
I was not told.Because  I turn my agony into great art for the king. probably forever
Well, what if you stop being sad? Then your art wouldn't be as impressive and maybe he'd let you go.
Or maybe I would be executed, since they will have no reaoson to keep me alive

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: It is rather dark in here, surely there must be a better source of light somewhere.
Harumph, yes, let us shed a little light on the situation - Groom, fetch me a candle.
Why King, what brings you here. Are you here to comfort me and allay my fears of love.
Sigh, I shall fetch a candle myself.  I am in the Privy because I need to relieve myself - the question that should be asked it what you are doing standing so close to my chamber pot?
Sorry King, I am just so distracted right now. I was looking for some jewelry...

Eh?  What's all this then?  Why would you be looking for Jewelry in a Privy?  I may be rich, but I daresay that is not how wealth is made!  Now if you would be so kind, please hold this candle aloft so there is enough light that I do not miss.
Why of course sir. Its just that I am afraid that I will poor for the rest of my life unless I amass many rare jewels and gold.
Ahhh, much better.  I suppose I could bump up your pay as the Groom of my Stool - is it a tuppence every other week?
Every month, rather. You see, it is simply not enough! I hate to be greedy but if you would be so kind as to double my compensation...
Hmmm, how about I pay you a per-stool bonus, say a half-groat per stool deposited?
Certainly! It would also be nice if you can throw in some bread and a daily meal. Would that be possible, King?
Harumph, fine - one half-loaf per day, though it won't be fresh.
But sir, what good is stale bread. You see, I have quite the appetite for freshly baked bread!

Yes, well there is quite a need for fresh bread for the Royal Pigeons, the Royal Ducks, and the Royal mice.  They refuse to eat any but the freshest bread, though if any happens to be left over you are more than free to make a meal out of it.
action: give candle to groom of the stool

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: OOoooOOoooh!  No humans about to torment... only the rements of my last victim.
Screeech! what time is it?!
Goodness, what care I for time, at my stage in life?  There is only the long, slow plod of eternity... an eternity of vengeance and suffering.
How come you to be so angry dear ghost?
That's KING ghost to you, bat.  For I am Lord of these lands... or was, before I was brutally betrayed.  But I shall have my revenge, no matter how long I must stay on this earthly plane!
Lord of these lands you say? I am but a simple bat who spends all day in this cave so I know not of these things. forgive my insolence king....?errr what is your name sire?
King... king... Ah, it has been so long, that I no longer recall it.  Only my thirst for revenge has kept me in this form.
Well sire, perhaps I can help you. What revenge do you seek?
There was a castle... the castle where I reigned.  I thought it was here, but I cannot find even the lintel of a door...
The castle is not far. There is often insects near there and I hunt them at night. Come with me and I will show you the way
Hm, how do I know that I can trust you, bat?  How do I know you won't TURN on me like the others did?!
In truth sire you're disturbing my peace. I would be happy to do this small favour in exchange for some solitude
Oh.. hrmph... very well then, Sir Bat.  I knight you in honor of the duty you perform... should you perform it well...
Then to the castle we go I hope I hope to defeat your foe

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: It is only a matter of time before the royal family is removed from the Palace.
Is this why your in a dungeon , and I live in a kingdom?
Only for now, Royalty. Your time is coming to an end. The kingdom needs a new ruler.

Haha, and is this gunna be done by a peasant like yourself? We have run this kingdom by dominance and loyalty! I'll refuse to let the likes of you take this royal kingdom ! I've bin trained in swordplay since I was a child by the templars ,I accept any and all challenges....
Careful with that sir, you might hurt yourself Quite the exquisite sword this is...
The likes of you knowing what your doing is minimal...do as you wish.
So be it. Your guards are weak like you and soon they will have a stronger leader they deserve!
If your actions are like your words I expect little challenge..
A wise ruler never underestimates his opponent. Sadly, you never were the one to lead the people of the Kingdom to glory.
A true ruler stays steps ahead of his opponent, you do know if the many traps in this dark wretched place?
Traps, what traps? Only a coward would resort to traps!
Only a coward would come through the dungeons to challenge a king! Hide in the shadows! You are the coward!
Watch your step Royalty! You might trip over your own feet.
You will not harm me!
action: give coin to a vigilant guard

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Preparing for Royal Court is always such a hassle.
We should prepare all documents that are needed for the court day. What is on the schedule?
Well Your Highness, we have two cases of petty theft, one domestic disturbance, a missing horse, and that blasted custody battle that doesn't seem to end.
What is the problem with the custody battle. the others seem quite simple

It is not the most....ordinary...custody case. You see, the couple in question called upon the Goddess of Fertility to help conceive... Well, now the Goddess has come for their first born, which she says she is rightful mother of.
Well it seems that we should bring both women to court on that day. I will get to the bottom of it at that time
I've been studying in the religious texts to find any sort of litigation to help rule in either party's favor, but I am coming up rather short. She is a very old Goddess, Your Majesty.
I too have studied on this. and I believe I have an answer to this dilemma
Why, please go ahead Your Majesty! I am all ears.

Well it is like this... The one who truly is the mother would do anything to give the child a good home. I plan to tell the two women I will cut the child in two. The rightful mother would not want this to happen and she will give it up because of her love for the child.
That seems rather shocking, my King! But it seems effective enough to work.
It will work. you will see. Now lets get the documents ready
Of course, of course! Are there any of the other cases you wish to review, Your Highness?
Petty theft, give him 5 days of jail and then make him do some service for the church. The domestic disturbance just 2 days of jail time and release him. Lets try to find the missing horse

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Hello my king, how're you?
Good day. I am feeling the weight from my crown today, the heat from this sacred flame.
Why is that? Lots of things you must do?
Yes. I am proud to be the king, it is my birthright--but I like those who came before me must make decisions they are not proud of.
What recent decisions are weighing on your mind?

I have sent the wise elder who begs at the entry to the kingdom away again as he has made my goats quite uncomfortable, banned from seeking comfort behind these walls, help from thine people. Now I feel as though his fate rests fully on my shoulders. Would you have done things differently, my supplicant?
No, I think you made the best decision for the good of the people.
I feel as though you are right. You are quite insightful, a friend indeed. Now, tell me what I can do for you.
I just didn't know where else to go but my child is deathly ill. I need the best doctor in the Kingdom.

My dear man--I am so sorry. To only be talking of myself when you have come to me with such sorrow. The doctor here in the temple will help you, she is tending to the leg of one of my goats but I assure you the breadth of her medical knowledge is far greater than our kingdom itself. Bring the child.
I will bring the child right away your highness, thank you for your caring.
I will summon her at once. Come to the study, the child will find comfort there. What is their name?
Supplicant Jr, is the King's nurse going to see the child?
Yes. The doctor is here. Place Supplicant Jr down and she will tend to him.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Hello Preist
Good day your highness! I am here to see if you need me to get the truth from any of these criminals that are locked up
How dare you call the princess a criminal!
Are you well your highness. I did not say anything of the sort. Are you hearing voices?
Well the only other person here is my desolate princess. I'm not quite sure why she's here or why she's desolate.
I do not see your princess? Are you sure you are well? Are you seeing things also? Should I summon the physician?
Please hold this. Maybe I'm not well, please summon the physician
Yes, your highness at once. You will be better if you are out of the prison room. let us go to the castle
You know I'm getting old now priest I feel as though my time is coming soon.
We will not let that happen. The physician is on his way to the castle too. The servants will make sure he sees you immediately.
I need the Queen. I want to tell her I love her before it's too late. she has been my rock since we've said our vows.
I will have her summoned immediately! You are going to be fine and the physician will make you more well and you will live to see another day!
Thank you for taking care of me! It is such a long way down from this tower!
Your highness we are going up to the castle from the prison room. You are not well

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Hello king
A bigfoot! What are you doing in my bedroom?
Do you know who this is?
Hmm, can't say I do. Looks like a common guard. Who is it?
He was trespassing on my land! I thought we had an agreement!
Let me get rid of that commoner. I will not punish you this time, but if you find someone trespassing I want you to inform the guards. Don't take matters in your own hands!
King I was doing what you told me to do. I was going to eat him but there was hardly any meat on him.
I never gave you permission to eat inhabitants of my kingdom you fool! You know I need their tax money, and dead people don't pay taxes.
I eat humans. we agreed that i would not go into town and eat your peasants but the strays were mine
Look at this big belly. I love eating pie and pie costs money. That dead man was obviously not poor, he was wearing quality clothes. We agreed that you could eat homeless strays, not honest citizens.
I told you I can't survive on the homeless! how would you like it if I fed you starving puny chickens?
Why is it a big creature such as you cannot even hunt wild animals?
This is how your Gods made me! I cannot control that.
From now on we will feed you one goat every two days, but you leave our people alone ok?

agents: dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

character: the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.
the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.
the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.
the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.
the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.

the dragon who breathes fire and won't let her out.
speech: COME OUT AND FACE ME YOU COWARDS.
I will fight you to then end!
WHOA-HOA! AT LAST A CHALLENGER APPROACHES!
Before we battle...I must ask...what makes you angry?  News I hold in this scroll might make you happy again.
WHO SAID I WAS ANGRY?
What are you trying to fight us about?  We are in the midst of a war and I carry the scroll that could stop it all. Will you help me?
YOU MAKE SOME BOLD ASSUMPTIONS, HUMAN. WITH WHAT DO YOU BACK YOUR CLAIMS?
I'll open the scroll and read it to you.  "We have some blackmail that will cease battle. Come quickly. The king is but a peasant!"
WHAT IMPORTANCE DO THE MATTERS OF A HUMAN KING HAVE TO A MIGHTY DRAGON SUCH AS MYSELF?

That is the king in the North that battles our kingdom.  He is the one that has killed the last 5 baby dragons he has found...did you not know?  You helping us defeat him would leave your kind in peace!  Our king has never done such a thing!
THE LAST FIVE BABY WYRMS, YOU MEAN. SILLY HUMANS CANNOT EVEN TELL THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A DRAGON AND A WYRM.
Do you want to help or not?  If not, I must away as fast as my feet carry me and let these soldiers fight you. If you want to, then fly me there and let me create havoc for their kingdom.
BIG WORDS FOR SUCH A SMALL CREATURE. THESE SOLDIERS ARE NOTHING TO ME.
It seems they are besting you so far.  I am smarted than you think.  Also a WYRM could not be a baby for a WYRM is an elder dragon, with much age and power.  Who is the idiot now?

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Who goes there? No one has visited my tower in many years.
Be calm, friend. I'm here on the King's business. He fights a great battle today, and I am charged with ringing the bell to announce his victory for all the village to hear.
Say it isn't so! Surely the King is still not fighting the same war I escaped as a younger man?!
Tis true, man, how did you not know this? His evil brother, the usurper, has finally been cornered like the rat he is!
The war never seemed to end. It consumed all....so I hid myself away, no longer able to bear witness to the atrocities that my countrymen had grown numb to.
Then now can be your time of peace. This long war is finally over. Tell me, friend, what were you? Knight, bowman, what was it?
I...used to be an Oarsman on one of the King's finest ships... We were attacked on both sides...I can still hear...no...
You survived though, be thankful and don't forget that. I've lost many brothers over the years to these scum, attacked in the night like the cowards they are!

Why was I allowed to survive? There were many braver, more worthy men than I that perished! I could not bear the grief....so I hid myself away, floated off to distant shores, letting my name join those missing in battle...
God only knows. It's pointless to torture yourself like this, let me buy you a drink in the tavern and tell me a great sea story. Tell me of foreign lands! What is your name, friend?
No, I count myself among the dead now. So much of me died along with my comrades. It would do you no good to hang around an old ghost like me.
Very well, have it your way. At least help me pull this rope and ring this godforsaken bell.
Very well, for the message of peace and for the honor of those who gave for it, I will help you.
Excellent, on my mark, give this rope a mighty heave. Are you ready?

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Where has that chambermaid gone?  She must be around here somewhere!
Beats me, do you have any idea?
I don't recognize you, are you new here at the court?
Perhaps, you're the queen aren't you?
Yes, though you really must be from elsewhere not to know the appearance of your Queen?
Well... I've been around.
Well it seems you have brought some buzzing companions with you *swats at flies*  Why is it you are here in the dungeon?  Are you a resident?
Well... I am here due to the wrongs that this kingdom has committed against me.
What wrongs would those be?  The only crimes I see here are crimes of fashion.
Ohh quite a mouth on you. The king of this kingdom ruined my father's life and I would like to seek revenge!
Why you insolent pup!  No wonder you have been left here to rot!
Let's see how your dear king husband feels about this!
Ooooh, how horrid!  Away with you you filthy creature!  GUARDS!  GUARDS!
Don't say another word unless you want a piece of this.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: It's a shame what happened to this castle, isn't it?
It is indeed. I love to come out here and behold its beauty. It would be lovely if we could fix it up.
Alas, I am just a lone blacksmith. My hands are full making weapons for the king's army.
I am a noble of the court. I am busy with social events and pleasing the king!
I came here looking to salvage any leftover valuables. Have you seen any by any chance?
I have not! I did not know people were doing such. Do you know who used to live in this castle?
This ruined castle once belonged to the ancestors of the current king. Many of them perished when part of it sank into the ocean.
I have never heard of it. They do not talk about it much at the king's place. It is such a shame.
Indeed, it is a tragedy most in the kingdom have already suppressed in their memories.
Then how could people come loot such a place as this?
The items in this castle belong to the king's family. I have only come to retrieve whatever remain on his behalf.
I figured people would come out here and take it as their own.
Luckily, not too many people still pass by here. The cliffs are very unstable and one false move could result in death!
But what a beauty it still is to behold. Long live the fallen castle!

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: hello princess
Greetings dad! Have you heard about the upcoming rebellion?
REBELLION??!?!?!
Yes, villagers to the west are angry about their taxes..
angry about taxes?!? what about their taxes
They claim they cannot afford to pay their taxes. Should I lead a charge against them?
A charge?!?! over taxes? no daughter I say we coordinate a sit down with the villagers and come to an understanding.  if one can not be met then we shall look to your idea
You're right, that seems wiser... although I have to remind you that this beautiful unicorn palace was built from sweat and blood, and not politics.
You make me proud daughter! the wisdom you hold! Wise beyond your years
Thank you daddy
Now if you are to lead a charge, how would you set your plan?!? Just in case we need a plan B
I would lead our unicorn knights to battle myself. Make a few casualties and let the peasants know that they stand no chance against us.

My strong daughter, brave and true.  We are lucky to have you to lead our knights into battle.  I want you to be safe while you assembly your group.  we shall need them in case our meeting doesn't go well
What about you? What will you try to discuss with the villagers? Will you lower their taxes?

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hi there dear queen! How could I serve you?
Hello, fellow travelers. What brings you all this way to our kingdom from Egypt?
I come in search for food and supplies for my kingdom, we are having a horrible drout!
Lucky for you, we have plenty of food in our castle! What can you trade for it in return?
I have this pouch of sand, our king sent me and told me its magical!
Thank you, I will show this to the king later. What magical properties does it carry?
He told me that if you put it on your food once a day every day for a year. you will live forever!
Good heavens! This is valuable sand, indeed!
Oh yes of course. What can you give me for my kingdom in return?
There's food on all the tables. Have as much as you can carry!
Okay ill be sure to take as much as I can but my hands are already pretty full of food.
The kingdom's doors will always be open to your people should you require more!
Thank you so much kind queen. May your people prosper forever fourth!
Thank you for the gift of eternal life. We shall not forget your generosity!
action: give leather pouch to the queen

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: oOOOooOOO
Who goes there? Echtold? Is that you? I've found something here that should feed our families for at least a month.
I am the castle ghosssst. And who are you?
What magic is this? You speak nonsense!
I am the  one who haunts this castle. I have been here for ages.
Well then, you're free to haunt all you like. I'll just help myself to these golden plates and leave you in peace
What is your purpose in the castle? Are you here to rob our valuables?
Of course not! I represent the King, and this is his property after all. Leave us!
And what does the King have to say? He is no king of our castle.
Blasphemy, he is King over everything in this land. Our castle, you say? And who else is here with you?
have a look. I am not the only ghost in this castle. I'm simply here the longest.
And what were you in life, ghost? Let me guess, either a guard or a servant. With your concern over this hall. Ha!
I do not know. But you must leave.
Gladly, would you be so kind as to point the way out?

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Your majesty, I bring bad news.
Speak, knave.
The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed.The castle is a ruin now.
What? Who is responsible for this outrage?
It was a surprise attack and I could not identified the enemy
Hmmm... This bodes not well for us. What is your name, peasant? Where are you from?
My name is Julian and I already told you I am from neighboring kingdom
Respect your betters, fool! Look around you, see this gold, this throne? This all belongs to me! The King! Now apologize for your impertinence!
That will mean nothing after the enemy destroys your red brink castle.Take a look at this paper
Give that here!
You and your kingdom are doom.The enemy is to powerful.They will probably get that  big chandelier from you
How can this be? The Swarm's forces have returned after this many years to destroy my palace?
All those red bricks were not going to help you
Give that back, knave! Clearly bricks will not help me, but what of these finely armored knights you see around you?

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: What brings you to my domain dragon?
The smell of this wonderful dinner has brought me here
Would you like to dine with us?
yes I would, then we can talk about....treasure
Hmmm I do not think we will be giving any treasure away.
hmmmm.....really?!?! Because I LOVEEEEE treasure.  I hoard my treasure in my special treasure mountain
Well that is nice but you can just have the treasure you have.
But you do know that I am a BIG dragon and I can just take it.  I was trying to be nice and give you the opportunity to share, but if you want to do this the hard way....
You do not want to make an enemy of this kingdom, even if you win all the treasure will be lost with you.
and why is that good king
It is not good for either of us.
well I am done talking to you about this, I came for dinner and treasure
Take the food and leave.
nawww... I don't think I am hungry for food anymore, I think king may taste better

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Oh, hello there.  Pardon my, erm, dusty appearance.  It's been quite journey to get even this far!
It's quite okay, I am not so clean myself. Being a blacksmith will do that to you. Are you here for the wolf hunt as well?
Oh, is there a hunt going on?  I but just arrived with the rest of my village, so we hadn't heard any such news.
Yes there is, everyone here talked me into going on it, but I am nervous. I don't know what I will do in I encounter a wolf. If you and your village are not here for that hunt, then why are you here?
Ah, our king -well, former king- taxed us to the point that we could no longer feed ourselves, so we left in search of a land of our own.  But is there a reward for this wolf hunt?
The reward is to be kinged the bravest man of the village, and we have a feast in honor of whoever brings home the biggest wolf.
Ah, an honor indeed!  Goodness, but it's been many a year since I hunted... but the lads could perhaps do with a bit of comradery.  Is it open to all?
Indeed it is. I'm sure you or your men would do much better than I. I am a strong one, but I make things that kill. I do not do the killing.
Ach, well, it's been many a year since I've been called strong.  Although I was once a fierce warrior in my day!
Ah, I'm sure you still got some strength in you ay?
Well, I suppose I made it this far, so there's some life in these old bones yet!
What did you say you used to do in your old village?
Oh, well I was just a fletcher meself.  Although I had a nice little tapestry business on the side!
Ah, well welcome to our town! If you or your men win the contest, don't forget who told you about it, huh?

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I'm telling you, the King admires the Navy more than the Army.
Who are talking to about the navy and army? The king has only an army of guards
What do you mean "only an Army"? Surely you've received word of the new fleet being commissioned!
Commissioned to where, what waters? I have not heard of this

That's right, you've been stationed along the border for some time now. Let me fill you in. King Thaddeus has been hearing so much about neighboring King Julius's personal navy that he decided to build an even bigger one out of spite.
Is the King getting a navy together to work with King Julius and his navy. Will they partner to help each other in war?
It is my understanding that this new Navy is equal parts self defense and matter of pride. It was getting to His Highness that another monarch had something he didn't.
I guess it is always trying to one up each other! The king would not have it any other way!
So as you can imagine, much of the royal focus is going to be on building the finest ships. At least until another passing fancy catches the King's eye.
I still think he has much faith in his Army. The fight we fight on ground is a mighty adventure and it proves our worth!
Easy there Captain! I'm only telling you so you know what to expect in tomorrow's briefing. It's no good coming home from duty only to be caught off guard.
I have no problems with you! But i know the king and he is very proud of his army. I believe he is just trying to be as strong if not stronger than king julius!
Time will tell if he has the patience to succeed. Let us hope that we don't have a future arms race on our hands.
It will always be this way! Men are fighters and want to be better than the next. You cannot stop the way they think

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Who in the land is as good a shot as me?  None can best this archer lady!
Quietly quietly.
And who in this who venture near?  None that I know, and none that I fear!
Back away from me and all will be well with you.
One step close and an arrow will fly - with your second step, you will die!
You will die too so I wouldn't let that arrow go. My dart gun is poised but it doesn't have to be on you.
Words, words, so bravely spoken - especially from one who is soon to be broken!
Why would you want to hurt me anyway?  You don't even know me?  I have a mission to complete.
A mission for you?  Here in this place? Well spit it out man, tell it to my face!
I am working for the king...though I shouldn't tell you. I am out to kill the man that wants to kill him.
The King, the mad one of yore? Why oh why did you not tell me before?
you were dancing like a crazy woman and enjoying listening to your own rhymes a little too much.
A sad man has but little to say, though we each have a part in this play!
Why...are you supposed to be killing him too?  Let's go work together like good people do. oh no, wait,...now you have me rhyming!

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hello there queen. How do you like my progress on the garden?
It's alright I guess
Ive grown most of these flowers and plants here. All for you... But you seem like you dont like it. How can I change it to please you my queen?
It would be lovely to see more roses, they are after all my favorite of all!
I will grow fields of roses in your name. But for now I have this for you if you want it!
Oh thank you, you are very kind! The Tulip is beautiful, it does make the garden look so alive. Here you go, I will give you a coin for your kindness and hardwork.
Thank you miss! This is more than I make in a year of work!
Oh my kind soul, please don't thank me. Thank the King, he is a kind and warm hearted man. He rules our lands well so there is plenty!
How did you meet the king? Were you always part of the royals family?

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly.
Wow that's incredible! I was born and raised in this city. My gardening skills were recognised by the king himself and he hired me to grow this entire garden for you. Do you ever miss your old life?
The king understands me well, he know how much I love gardens. I do sometimes miss my old life, but now this is my life.
What a great king he is. Thank you for taking your precious time to talk to a gardener like me and thank you for the kind gift!
Thank you for all you do, without your hard work and dedication we would not have such a beautiful garden to admire!
