setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: What brings a criminal like you before my presence in this sacred place?
You tell me, your majesty. I was dragged here by your guards!
Ah I see so we are baptizing him before his execution?
Execution? Isn't that a tad harsh for someone who only stole a loaf of bread?
We are much harsher than before, we must send a message.
Are you sure you want to kill me? I will return to haunt your castle with a vengeance!
See if I care, you will be publicly hung tomorrow.
I see I have nothing to lose then!
Yes well lets see how much you can do when you are dead.
You'll pay for this, you vile tyrant!
Guards take him away.
Not so fast! I haven't gotten my revenge yet! I will kill you with your own scepter!
You fool, I will end you.
I will see you in the underworld! Lord knows you are not going to heaven with all the crimes you've committed against humanity!

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: ooooOOOOOOooooooo
You aren't the first ghost I have seen.  What's your name?
King Cohen...but you may call me...DEATH
My name is Ortha, I was sent here to meet you
To meet...YOUR DOOM
Take that
You will rot here as I have!
Leave this cave and never come back
Your bones will join mine! I may never leave!
This will look excellent in the Smithing Museum
With my bone, I curse you to melt and wither into the cave walls OooooOOooOo
Leave
I may not. neither may you.
I am Ortha the greatest explorer east ot Smithing, no doublt you have heard of me.  I am collecting these artifacts and returning home.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: WITCH! Don't you dare try to hurt me or my town will come seeking revenge. I didn't know anyone would be in The Lagoon at this time of night
Hehehehe.. I am not here to hurt you, only to collect for brewing potions... I could make you one if you desire!
If you are collecting ingredients for potions perhaps this basket may help? What things are you looking for?
Oh this basket will work great. I need a frogs tongue, some snake venom and a bit of the magic moss from this swamp. I am making a flight potion I heard about in an ancient book.
What do you need a flight potion for? Every witch I have ever heard of has a magic broom to travel through the air
Yes you're right. But this potion isnt for me! The king requested this to make an army of flying warriors!
Oh well if the king has requested it I must also follow his orders. Let me find some swamp moss to help
Thank you for your help! What can I do to repay you? Would you like to be able to fly too?!
If you can promise to keep our town safe from other witches my family would appreciate it
Okay I can do that! Im the only witch in this town! I am training some apprentices right now though so not for long I wont be.
Thank you! We have been living in fear about stories of witches being told in the town. I will tell them all about your help
Witches aren't always bad, everyone who is evil.. deep down is hurting and sometimes it helps to show a bit of kindness. I wasn't always this great!
Well I guess I didn't think about it like that. Do you live in The Lagoon?
No I just come here sometimes for supplies. Many magical things dwell here in this lagoon.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: welcome to the temple
thank you, it really is beautiful here. I love how it looks with the sun shining through the stained glass windows
I take much pride in this temple, and this parish.
It will be an honor to me, to fulfill the duty given to me by the king to keep this place as clean as possible
I like to thank you for the work that you do for this temple, cleanliness is close to godliness. I have invest much of my life to have such a place for those who can come here and worship
It is my duty. Is there any way i can be of more help ?
I think you are doing an incredible job, I am very proud of you work. I must be taking this offering plate to put the offerings where they belong
I would be happy to take this from you.

Thank you very much clergyman, I appreciate it. Its great to have many good parishioners that are willing to make offers, They all know that they must consult with me before entering into new business ventures. They know of my wealth and are willing to help with the offering that we have.
I am so glad you are wealthy but i am here to serve the people. If i had money I would sail to the new world ! Maybe i should just take this !
No! that is not for you to take, I must be able to trust in the people that work to keep this temple in order! must i let you go?
Give me a reason to trust you ! You talk about your wealth, I have served the public for so long and what has it got me !  i was losing faith and you made me lose it totally !
Read this instead it is full of wealth, wealthy knowledge. Serving is why we are all here on earth for, I just help those to get closer to serving the one and only/
I am sorry I do not know what i am doing ! I just have such a desire to head to the new land that all those feelings came over me. I should look back to my calling and the duty placed before me
action: steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes
steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I hope you paid a fair amount for all this silver, king?
Haha, Ulmer, lad!  Only you would dare speak so freely with your king!
Well, if you acted like a real King, I would speak to you as such.
Ha!  Good one!  Yes, keep me grounded, lest I lose my head entirely, like that fat king from Landon.
We wouldn't want that now would we? You aren't my favorite, but I will say, The king from Landon was far worse than you!

Well then, perhaps you'd be interested in helping me search for a new Queen?  The princesses act all sweet and kind in front of me, so I'll need someone I trust to tell me what they're like with the common folk.
What happened to your old queen? She start to get fed up with dealing with your royal hindass?

Ha - got little too fascinated with her mirror.  Starting talking to it all the time, then next thing I know she's in cahoots with some witch lady, ate a poisoned apple and keeled over.  Shame, for she was a nice lass before she got so invested in her looks.

You're one to speak about obsession with your looks! I do recall you paying a pretty penny for that mirror back in your less fortunate days. We should make sure to tell your new queen, to NEVER eat the apples. Nothing good comes from them.
Aye - they'll keep the doctor away, alright.  Because you'll be needin' a mortician!
Now now, that one is a knee slapper king! Say, when you get over thrown, you should make your way into stand up comedy!

Ahahaha - I'll have ta make do with my kingly ways, for I'm afraid my jokes get old, fast, as you well know.  I'll have no guards at me back to make the audience laugh... well, laugh at the appropriate time!
Old and fast, just like you!

Hahaha!  Ahh, your a good soldier, Umler, and a better friend.  So, can I count on you to help in my quest?  Maybe we can get a nice rich lass so that we can decorate this place proper.  Silver is nice, but a bit of color wouldn't go amiss, methinks.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hello My King, Do you think I could get a new cushion for my throne? This place is so uncomfortable with the constant noise!
Of course, my Queen. Anything you wish for.
And what did that Lord want earlier? He definitely stinks! I do not want him near me again. I have been reading about a soap that can prevent such fowl odors. Perhaps you can tell him
Oh, he was just bringing up the peasants complaining about taxes again. Don't worry, I'll be sure he's more presentable next time!
They have to pay taxes, it's what keeps us in a home you know! What did you decide to do?
I decided to punish those who started the protests. I can't stand those ungrateful clods who think ruling a kingdom is all sunshine and glamor!
I'll be right beside you in whatever decisions you make. Have you seen my chambermaid? Please tell me you didn't fire her
I have not, my dear. But if she is tardy, perhaps she should indeed be disciplined!
I need a bath drawn and my clothes laid out. I have a busy day ahead. What are you going to do today?
Not much on my schedule today, my love. Just wandering the castle and admiring all the fine pieces of art.
Ah I see you're taking that hideous rug away. Donate it to the peasants, maybe it'll keep them quiet. We need a new one anyway
You've always had the finest taste, dear. It's a good thing you are around to help me make the proper choices in decoration.
I knew it was the right choice marrying you. At last here she comes. What do you think we should do with a late member of staff?
I will not tolerate laziness in the castle. She will get no pay for her work today, I'm afraid!

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: You are such a great king, I hope to one day rule as well as you do
Of course you will my boy, I raised you well!
That you did my great king. I can never thank you enough for all you've taught me.
What are your plans for today my boy?
Ahh that's better, we should let the sunlight in more often. Plans for today you ask? Well I fancy a walk around the garden would be nice, don't you agree?
That sounds nice! Maybe I'll go with you! We must be back by 7 for the royal feast of course.
You are correct, we can not miss the royal feast this year, I hear our dear uncle will make an appearance.
Really? All the way from eldensquare!? I miss him I do. I can't wait!
How have you been since you returned from the war last week?
Great really, all healed up and my armor just got fixed! Have you been training for when you will rule the kingdom and fight by the sides of you kingdom?

Yes my king. I have been training long and hard and observing the best that I can. I think one day I'll possibly surpass even you! Take me out to war with you sometime king, please, I need a taste for real battle.
Maybe we could go for a spar before the walk in the garden! I can see for myself how you have been coming along.
That would be a great idea king, I know how strong you are. This is a beautiful fabric. Where is it from?
I hear that it was fabricated from the towns wizard. They say it has magical luck properties so I always keep it by my side. How about we go for that spar now and you bring that along!
action: put cape in large chest of drawers

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: Do you think the flower is pretty?
well yes, it is, so much to see here at the Entrance to the Pine Trees.
Here, this is for you!
oh, thank you. but where did you come from, these pine needles on the ground make everything so quiet.
I came from a nearby forest, I just wanted to explore the area since it seemed safe. Where did you come from?
Well, I too am from the forest and the castle beyond. Once I was a prince, but I was turned into a frog by an evil orc. See, I'm still wearing the royal coat of arms.
Oh no! That's so horrible. To be honest, I'm afraid of the royal family...the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs.
Oh well, it's ok, I don't want to hurt you. I didn't enjoy being a prince very much, too much fighting, I don't like fighting, I'd rather play with my friends here in the forest.
I'm glad. You really don't mind being a frog? I guess the forest is beautiful, too. I'm interested in the tree over there...want to check it out?
No, I don't, I love all these delicious flies buzzing around..pfft, they are so juicy! What do you like to eat? There is weed here and lots of pine needles!
I like to eat insects! they're so annoying, but they're so delicious
Hey! that's my lunch. Ok, let's go look at the tree over there, it is kind of tall and skinny, not like the other trees.
sorry! I was hungry! Ok, let's go over here!
Alright, glad you're full. Oh, look how it's moving in the wind ohhh, it's making me dizzy watching it.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: What are you doing here?!
This is my home!  The largest trash heap in the kingdom!  It all that is left of my once mighty trade empire, a display of ruin, a perfect facsimile of my own fallen condition.
What drove you to such poor condition? And what is your name?

Bartholomew Rutherford the 3rd, at your service sir.  My tale is long, but suffice to say it involves a shark, a pirate, and a very unhappy walrus on a deserted island.  But enough about me, can I interested you in any of my remaining wares?
Well, nice to meet you Bartholomew. Have you happened to see anyone lingering out here? Perhaps with weapons?
None that I have spied, other than the vermin that live here with me.
There's a fight going on from people trying to kill the king!
The King?  Oh no!  He shall soon be as headless as this doll!
How dare you say such! You will be as headless as that horse.
Eeeeeee!  The King's hound chases the rat, while the Wolf plays with the Sheep King in his palace!
You shall surely banish for saying such. I have pledged my entire life to serving the king!
Back you fiend!  An assassin is on the loose, and you waste your time attacking a man whose only crime is poverty?
You committed heresy against the king! Speaking horror on his name!
No wonder the King is in danger if his guards terrorize the very citizens they are sworn to protect!
action: give largest trash heap to guard
get rag dool with the head detached

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: I am ready to follow your orders, chef
As you know, we are paid to make the finest dishes for the queen and king. I need you to bake the greatest cake this kingdom has ever seen!
I ma working right now.You know I am the best pastry chef in here. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court.
Good. Here, you know what to do with this yes?
I am going to make a delicious crep.How long have you been a head chef
As long as I can remember! I started cooking when I was 5 and I have been head chef for... over 30 years now.
Your kitchen is so organized. Everything in its place and a place for everything.
Thanks, this place is basically my home.
Let me get ready for the next banquet.Everything should be perfect
Everything better be! The king expects only the best and heads will start rolling otherwise. How long have you been cooking pastries for?
This is my fourth year, but in 2 years I will be a head chef like you
Good! You are getting there. Are you about ready to use the iron grill? Take great care of it, I built it myself.
ready to go.Do not worry about anything
Good, good. I will cook the main meal then.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Hello there knight! How are you doing this fine evening?
No time for pleasantries. How are the battle plans coming?
Good. We are readying up for the attack on Visria. Will you be leading the attack?
Will I be leading the attack? does the sun rise in the east?
Hmm... I thought the sun rised in the west....... I guess I should have payed more attention in school.
Look, no matter what happens out there, we must keep the King safe. I want you to personally stay with the king for the entire battle.
That was from my father before he died in my arms! May I please have it back? I promise to protect the king.
Well, we both know that you will likely die during the battle. I would honestly be shocked if you lived. I will give this heirloom to your family after you die.
Yeah you're right. I guess I should be thanking you then..... Thank you..........  Its a beautiful sight up here isnt it.
Yes, you are correct. I am doing you a huge favor. That is the type of knight I am. Is there anything you would like to do in the last moments before your virtually inevitable death?
I have always wanted to eat with the king.. Is that something you could arrange?
With the king....how about near the king? Also, this sword is very special. It wil be an honor for you to die while holding it. Again, I am doing you a great favor.
Wow this is beautiful. I will be sure to bring it into battle. Thank you again... kind... knight.
and by chance if you don't die, you may keep the sword. So you have that going for you as well.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Finally some nice cool breezes to help me relax.
Agreed. It's not often that we have such times of peace. May the neighboring kingdoms forever be our allys!
What brings you so far from the castle, knight? Is there no work for you to do?
My platoon has been given a weeks time away from duties. Since the Treaty of Kingdoms was signed, there has been less need for constant fortification of the walls.
Well we could use you in these parts. there is evil lurking.
Evil lurking? In such a tranquil lake house? Sure you're pulling my leg.
Come inside. We must not let other overhear.
But I was enjoying the sound of the waves! Oh...Very well.
There is great wealth around this lake. But it has been hunted by a man so evil and vile its unbelievable.
I see. Greed and Villainy do tend to go hand in hand. Please, go on.
A man hired by YOUR master and king robs us of every penny, every grain of wheat we harvest. We are left with nothing but blood pudding to bring us through winter.
Now hold your tongue, friend. If what you say is true, then this will be no simple task.
I need to know I can trust you. Take this token to persuade yourself to help.
What is this symbol carved on the back? I've never seen it before.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Please, milord, it wasn't me, I swear it!
Quiet! You will listen to me. I want to know why you did it.
I'm just a poor fisherman, honest! Why would I want to kill Lady Elma?
Maybe for her riches? You did just admit to being poor.
I didn't have anything to do with it! The guards already searched my cottage. I've only ever laid eyes on her once or twice at market
I control your destiny. You best tell me all you know.
Please, just tell me what you want to know. I'm not sly, I don't have any clever plans i just want to get home
Where were you when she was killed?
If it's not market day I'm out on the river! Dawn to dusk!
Who can vouch for it?
I sail up and past Maggie Frost's house on the point. She might have seen me!
I believe you. But I don't like you.
Does ... does that mean I can go?
I want to be sure. All it means is you get to relax here a little more.

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

character: the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
speech: Ah It's nice to see you again. What brings you to the Treasure Room this time?
The King is coming, and I must let him in - he desires to gaze upon the riches of his realm.
I have been crafting this new sword for the king. It is the most valuable and powerful blade in all the kingdom. What do you think of my work?
It is very fine work indeed!  The King will be proud to add it to his collection!  Has the sword been given a name yet?
A name can only be given to a weapon by those who will wield its power. Let me look into the magic crystal to see who it's future master might be
Has the blade been tested yet, steel against steel?  And why ask who the wielder will be if it is to be a gift for the King?

The king has commissioned me to make this sword for an adventurer to go on a dangerous quest. My swords have never failed an adventurer in combat before. Oh my! I can see that this sword will belong to you!
Me?  That cannot be, as I am merely the Keeper of the King's Key, and am never allowed to leave the Palace!  Perhaps it is someone else that you see?
Yes you're right. This thing is a piece of worthless junk. I shall now collect my payment from the Treasure Room
Not until the King arrives!  You would take gold from the Treasury without the King's presence?  How dare you sir, how very dare you!
I have made swords for the king for many years. They are priced accordingly and I know their worth. So if you have the keys to the kingdom why can you not leave the Palace?
If I left the palace, who would open the doors for the King?  My family has performed this very function for nigh on four hundred years!
Yes we must respect the king's decision. So if you could have anything from this room what would it be?
The Holy Rood of Saint Dwyfed - the most sacred relic in all the realm, I would donate it to the church so that many could be healed by its blessing.
action: give sword to the guy with the key when he lets in the king
put piece of armor in treasure chest

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: What it is you want now?
Well, you have consistently missed service your highness.
Can't you see I'm busy with other matters. I'm drinking my wine, I'm enjoying my dogs.
But I'm worried the royal counsel will denounce your kingship.
The royal counsel? and why should I be concerned about the royal counsel. Why my dogs drink finer wine than they. Here my lovelies...enjoy.
Your dogs are beautiful but will they be without a king?
What do you mean, without a King? How dare you! I rule all that it here, have you forgotten I am your king? And here is my crown.
The counsel will remove you. I am trying to help your lordship.
Remove me? They wouldn't dare. Have you heard rumors? Do they want my jewels and paintings for themselves, pray tell me clerk, come closer...
yes they say you have missed the royal ceremony too many times
No, I haven't, how many times have I missed, someone is lying!
You have missed 15 your highness.
Ah, now I know someone is lying, who told you so? I'm am the King and you shall answer truthfully or pay with your life.
The counsel has kept track sire.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Hi everyone! Its so nice to finally see you all again!
Welcome back! It has been such a long time since we've seen your smiling face!
How have things been!? Everyone doing well?
Things have been as well as always! You know, I've got the best faimily on earth!
Look at this key I found during my travels. Isnt it marvellous? I never found a use for it though. Any ideas?
Oh that is marvelous! You don't know what it opens? Well, looks like you're ginna be out on another adventure then!
Oh yes for sure. But for now I will relax with you! Is Georgie doing any better since last time I was here?
Why yes, thank you for asking! He was in the hospital for a couple weeks, but with the power of our families prayer we recovered quickly! Come sit, tell me about your travels.

So I started off traveling down south until I reached a goblin camp, They weren't very agressive so I didn't have any trouble. I continued on for a few days through a forest and found a city called Eldersquare. Have you ever heard of it?
Eldersquare? Not that doesn't ring a bell.

Its a small city, I needed some coin when I arrived so the king commisioned me to slay a rock golem. I went to the cave they told me and found him there. I slayed him and as his head smashed to the ground this same key fell from the middle but even in the cave I couldn't find a single lock.
The key fell out of his head?
Yeah his head was made of stone, it smashed completely to bits and this stone key was the only thing that wasn't dust! Incredible right?!
What an adventure that must have been! I wonder what the key opens. Must be something special!

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Yes M'boy! This hike was just what I needed! The view is spectacular, don't you agree?
Hi! Yes, your majesty - this is my favorite place to play and think!
I can certainly see why. Don't your parents ever come with you, to make sure you don't come to any sort of injury?
They come sometimes, but today I sneaked out. I think they'll be mad that I lost my shoe. Maybe we can use this crystal ball to help me find it.
Now where did you find such an item? A crystal ball isn't just something one leaves lying around/

I found it on my way up. A little man wearing funny clothes was carrying it I tried to talk to him, but he ran away and dropped it. I tried to catch him to return it and that's when I dropped my shoe.
A little funny man? Dear child, are you telling me the Gnomes have returned to the hillside?
Is that what he was? He sure looked grumpy. Are gnomes scary?
No, I don't believe "grumpy" is quite the right word. Gnomes tend to keep to themselves.
If I use my rope to build a swing, do you think he might come back to play? I can share my snack with him!
I will have to do some studying in the Royal Library once I've returned to the castle. To think that the innocence of a child could bring out the gnomes...
Does anyone else live up on this hill? It'
Not for some time, and certainly not since I've ruled. I wonder if this is a sign of things to come.
Should we call out soldiers to chase the gnomes away?
action: give a crystal ball to the king

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Horse, who left you here in this tombstone? It wasn't those evil thieves, was it?
Nuahahahaha, *get me out of here*
Don't be afraid of this cemetery. Very great kings are buried here. It is a sacred place, even for a horse.
You're not the one who ends up here alone!
Well, you aren't alone anymore. I'd be happy to help get you out of this cemetery, but I don't know where you belong.
Mahaha, you must not recognize me in the dark. I am the kings horse!
Ah! It is you, Cyrus! The King has been looking all over town for you - how did you get away? With your permission, I'll lead you back to the castle.
I got spoked by something in the stables. Could you help get my man out of the metal fence? I seem to be stuck. Nuahahhaa
Stuck? Of course, I can help you. Seems like you have had a crazy evening!
I don;t think the king should get that hay from the same farm, it has made me alittle loopy
Before we leave, I'm going to pick up this gold piece. I don't know who it belongs to, but it is quite valuable.
Let's just say you keep it? You know for saving me and all. NENENENENENENE
Fantastic! I like that plan. I'm paid fairly well as a guard, but there is always a need for more money.
We can keep it are little secret, besides what do the the skeletons in the graveyard need with gold?

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Gentlemen! The King has entrusted us with this very special assignment, and I do not intend to see us fail. The more information we can gather at this tower, the better off our kingdom will be. You there, soldier! What do make of this place?
I found this crest among the cobblestones. I don't recognize the house seal, but the lord of the tower must have left in a hurry.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello, my child. What brings you to the King's Quarters?
I hate the classes that I'm taking! The teacher tells me that I do everything wrong and swats at my hands
You must have patience, my boy. Don't you want to grow up to be a fine man?
How can I be a fine man if I am not happy with the treatment that I receive in class! That only shows me how negative life is
You must learn discipline, lad. The world is not a place where you can just freely do whatever pleases your mind!
How is being told everything I do is wrong, called discipline. How does that build my confidence and self esteem. Please
You must endeavor to improve the quality of your work then. You musn't let it discourage you.
I am discouraged! Just once I would like to be told that I have done something right! Just once!
I can see great potential in you, child. Come here.
I just want to lay down on the rug and nap. I am just tired and don't want to think about anything else I have done wrong
Return to your quarters at once, boy. This is no place for you.
I am not going to my quarters. I intend to leave. I will not return till I find what I want to do and class is not it
Very well, child. I will not stop you from leaving the castle. It is one mouth less to feed, after all.
I'm so glad you are worried about me. I am your only child by the way and the child that you so want to become king some day!

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: My lord
Lad, what took you so long?
My mistake, I've been lost in the catacombs

Ah, an easy thing to do. But now we must be quiet and make haste, as you know at the top of these glistening granite and oak steps is the highest tower in the castle. take the torch and the scroll carefully, the guard will follow behind us. You will lead the way.
But my lord, I don't understand. What do you require from me? I answered your call because you are my king, but I fear to go any further.
Have no fear lad, you are my most trusted servant, that is why I have chosen you. You are safe. Here, you may wear my own sacred belt to help protect you.
Thank you my lord. I trust you. Let us go.
Tred quickly but quietly, we have a special task once we reach the top.
Yes, I shall stay quiet. Tell me how to best aid you sir.
Ah, we are here. Go inside my lad and place the scroll upon the table and the torch upon it's perch to light my way.
Yes my lord. It is done.
Excellent, my boy, the guard shall wait outside.
Yes my lord, I will lock us in behind him.
no, no, we must wait....

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: That sure is some nice house yall got back there.
Ah yes, the Farm House is quite hospitable. We must have room for all the King's assistants.
What luck for them to assist someone such as the king!
Some luck is involved, yes. But don't discredit the knowledge and work it took to get to these high positions.
Oh no! I meant no offense by that. I know you have gotten where you are based on skill. I am the kings top solider, got there by skill, maybe a little different than yours though.
I would certainly say so! Knowing effective planting seasons won't do much good on the front lines!
No it will not! *laughes* I am a killing machine, and that is how I ended up here. It is a righteous job
Tell me, what is it like guarding the Wall? Do you ever tire of keeping watch?
I do not tire It is merely a job, one that I enjoy but a job none the less. It is not a job that everyone can master, you learn after your first kill, if your fit to be a solider.
I cannot fathom taking the life of anything. I do believe I prefer my rows of corn and barley.
As I said, not everyone can master it. I am paid to kill, and kill I must. You do a fine job, though without the corn or barley the kings plates would be empty for his feasts!
This is true. I am glad that we each have our own roles to play.
Ah I almost forgot, could you point me in the direction of this cave right here on the map? That is were I am taking rest for the night.
Pardon? You mean you have no barracks provided after a long watchful shift?!
action: give map of the kingdom to agricultural advisor

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Deity, are you lost here in the abadoned? Can I help you?
Thank you for your concern, kind maiden. I am here to investigate the cause of this desolation.
I was sent to go out to the market to get wheat for baking. I have to bring back a fair amount with this coin. Is there anything I can help you with before I go on my way?
Please tell me what happened here. Why has the King forsaken this place?
He has not forsaken this place. He has not had time to come this way to see what can be done to this barren land. He has not surveyed the land to see if it can be made prosperous.
I see. This land is a far cry from the lush forest where I inhabit. I am sad there's not even a single animal here.

Do you not believe that there is differences in every piece of land that is on this earth. Some may have the lush forests, others have grand oceans and sandy beaches, and there are some that are so dry and barren that they are classified as desert,
Do not patronize me, mortal. This is no ordinary wasteland. I sense a great tragedy happened here recently.
And what of it? The tragedy has already happened. What is it that you expect to do after the tragedy is done.
I am a deity. I will do whatever it is in my power to restore this land.
And how will you do that? With what will you restore the land.?
I carry with me blessed items to cleanse the corruption from this land.
What will this ring do? Does it change the land? Will it bring back the dead, if you believe that a tragedy has happened?
Indeed, it shall. Let me demonstrate the power of these artifacts on the skeletons over yonder.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: How are you?
It is a good day, your highness! We have no battles today and the men are resting from the last battle that we had.
How is the morale?
We have some wounded, but all in all we won the battle for you. Morale is good when we win, with just wounded.
Good how soon can they be ready for the next battle?
We will take a few days to recuperate. The worst wounded will stay behind, but we will have enough men to fight in a few days for you
Excellent enjoy the days off
Yes, your highness. Is there anything you wish me to tell the men?
Tell them they are fighting for the kingdom
Not to be disrepectful, but they know that. I think they need to know how the king feels, and how he feels about their loyalty

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Greetings King. How may I help you today?
Would you mind taking care of my cape for me?
Sure. Please take this towel in the meantime while I get your cape washed for you.
Yes thank you, I am done with the towel. Please pick it up for me and take care of it.
Okay. The towel and cape are now on the cloths rack awaiting to be washed. Is there anything else I can do for you King?
Yes thank you. I don't know what I would do without your services.
I appreciate your appreciation for my services my King. I'll have your crown polished and repainted by tonight if you wish.
You are so thoughtful and diligent, tell me, do I pay you a lot of money to work as my butler?
You don't pay me a significant amount, however working for you, seeing the smile on your face everyday, is enough for me my King. Also, I'll have your belt washed within an hour for you.
Ahh yes, it's almost as if you can read my mind. I must give you a raise for the enduring commitment you've shown for my care.
Thank you so very much King. I see, you look so young in this photo, this was taken when you first became King correct?
Yes, tell me honestly. Was I more handsome then or am I more handsome now?
Well my King, you are never aging, so the answer is that you have always been at maximum handsomeness.
That is exactly as I thought. You are very wise for a butler and you have excellent taste. Yes, I must give you a raise.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: You smell like food. Do you have food? Are you food?
Boar, you are going to be food.
Tough, talk, but you seem to have forgotten your spear
I'm a king, i'll have armed guards here to kill you in seconds.
That's more than enough time to finish you off. And there's something ... powerful here. I feel stronger, faster.
You foolish pig.
I'll make mince of you!
My only weapon.
Raaaah!
time to get serious I guess.
Die!
You'll be dinner, how dare you enter my castle and attack me!
It won't be your castle much longer!
You can't take it from me boar!

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: This place is filthy! It's a wonder we have rats.
Yes, Did you call me?
No, well yes, but not intentionally. I was just commenting on the filth! look, at all this trash..
I do not care. I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. The dirtier the better.
You fit right in this port than don't you. I must let the king know to send someone down here to clean this place up immediately! Can't have this type of filth just outside the royal castle!
I reckon this place has seen better days, know is just broken.
You could easily fall through the floors into the ocean! It does not scare me though, even if I fell through. I am way to strong and brave.
Tell me.How long are  you a guard in this place?
For the better part of 30 years  rat. Do you guys even live that long? *kicks soda can on floor*
No, just 5 or so years.Why there are so much trash here.?
I am guessing the peasants come to make this place a home for the night. We heard some noises coming from here, I had to come check it out, as to protect the king. I guess it was just you though
Is there a kitchen around here? I am starving.
Kitchen? Not one that you're allowed into, you're better off scrumaging through this trash.
I do not care.I will find food anyway.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: My, but we have certainly traveled to an amazing kingdom this time, my lord and lady! And what shall I be cooking for us today?
Find the nearest peasant and ask them for the freshest orphan they can find. Preferably chubby and vaccinated.
...vaccinated? What does that mean? And why would I need an orphan? Are we having them for dinner?
Are you not loyal to me? You don't question the king and queen. We must have this dinner planned before my mother arrives.
Yes... of course... Um... so what's on the menu again?
Five broth boiled pigs with a centerpiece of flame roasted giraffe. It's just a normal meal but with my mother. The child is very important. Give him this robe also.
Um... yes... I... hate to ask, but... what is the child for? Is he to be hired as a servant, is he also a guest? I still don't follow...
It's best if you don't know. Also make sure he is addressed as Prince Barbara.
...Um...o-ok... I... wait. Giraffe? Where do I get a Giraffe here in Scotland? Do they have those?
From Gerry of course! He raises them in the hills. Are you new here?

Oh, right! Gerry. Gerry the Giraffe raising Scot! Of course! of course! Oh silly me! I was a bit distracted, I suppose. You might have a laugh at my foolishness, my lord and lady, but when you said you wanted a plump child for tonight... well you can only imagine where my poor head went!
I thought you knew about my mothers old age forgetfulness. She thinks I'm five years old! Isn't that funny? She doesn't even remember what I look like... funny... right?

Oh, my Lord! Forgive me! I was not your cook when last your mother visited us! Oh, I feel an utter fool for my confusion! I shall seek out a double for you! I think I might indeed know a lad that has your characteristic curly hair!
Thank you chef, it's been hard.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: I have something for you son.
What is it, father?
A special trinket. It holds a magical blessing.
Thank you, father. I hope I'm doing a good job as the new king.
Well maybe this magic item will help you out.
What does it do, if I may ask?
I think it attracts a spirit!
Surely you joke, father?
I tested it in the crypt myself. Would you like to go down there now?
Okay, you can demonstrate its power to me.
Humbaba Humbabab spirits spirits can you hear?
I don't hear anything? Maybe I should give it a try?
Yes you try! Go ahead young blood for the spirits. They will love it!
Let me first wear my crown for protection so they may recognize me as king!

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Hello king, what could a simple mouse like me ever possibly do to aid you? I live with a horse who is my best friend and can help you as well!
I'm not supposed to be here. Keep your rabies filled mouth shut, mouse.
My lord I can be useful I swear! I know who stole your trinket
I know who it was fool! I'll dig through this little girls clothes until I find it.
It was not her! It was the maid. Please allow me to fetch it for you! This work is below you my lord, please allow me to prove my worth to you?
Wait... this dress... it fits me. It's so pretty.
My lord it surely does, if ever there was a king who could pull off being in a dress it would be you. May I please fetch the trinket? The maid hid it underneath the rug.
Ah yes, please fetch it for me. I must study this new feeling I feel.

My Lord I have found the trinket, the maid had it underneath her rug. If you would be so graceful may I please make one request? I would ask that you place my best friend the horse and myself inside the castle? Our own room.
As long as you tell anyone that the king...queen... No I am a king! Just don't tell anyone you saw this!
My Lord I will dare not speak of this to anyone! Especially her majesty! May I say my Lord that if you used the hairbrush it would help your hair match your beautiful dress!
Do you really think so? I haven't shaved in awhile.
Yes my lord you look beautiful! May I put a flower in your hair too?
Oh yes! It'll look so lovely.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello stable hands, did you know the horse is my best friend?
I heard that from the king. I thought you were given your own room in the castle.
How did you find out? The king told me not to tell anyone at all? What else do you know?
I know many things little mouse. More than you would think.
Did you see what he was doing
You mean she. The Queen was doing as she wishes.
So you know! Do not speak of it to anyone or I will tell him YOU stole the trinket. Now that you know if you do not give my best friend the horse dinner three times a day I will get you in trouble.
Oh no need to worry. I kept the secret as long as you have.
I will feed my friend today stable hand. Please start a fire for my friend and me. And fetch me some cheese from the castle.
Start a fire in a horse stall? The floor is like three feet of flammable hay.
You will be in charge of seeing that it does not burn down this stall.  We will need a small fire you can use this wood.
Obviously you have a mouse brain if you think this is a good idea.

This stall was built by excellent masons, I was one of the first rodents to arrive, I hid in the hay as it was constructed. I will require the cheese soon or else I will tell the king what you saw! Place the cheese in this bucket!
Speak like that again and call out the royal cat clan to dispatch you.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Are you ready for your marriage?
Yes I am.
Just so you know, I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity
You can put it in the bag, it's okay.
Where is your bride right now?
Here she is!
Congratulation of your weeding.You look beautiful!
What is the starting time?
Well be ready at 04:00 pm.The nave is already decorated
What is that for preacher?
I just like to swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes
Is this building were the king was married?
I do not know.I am as corrupt as they are.I extort money every change I get
So you aren't a real preacher?

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: This shed is a mess but I guess it will do for now. Got everything I need for my tomatoes.
You need this rake, your soil has weeds in it. As a farmer who has been doing this all his life you are doing this wrong.
Alright I'll take this rake then. What's the tool used for? Anything for my tomatoes.
Yes the rake will kill any weeds that may try to kill the tomatoes. You really need to fix this shed up, grab the boards while I get the nails.
That's awfully nice of you. Here's some fish that I just caught for your troubles.
Thank you so much! I'm not used to people being kind to me. I'm sorry if I was rude earlier. What do you do exactly?
I'm a gardener. Tomatoes are my speciality! My hope is to someday work for the king himself.
Be careful of the king, he is not always a good person to be around. He raised the taxes on my land twice and demands that I give over half of my crops to his army every season.
Aye those of us who wish to work for a king usually do it to impress a lass. Alice is her name.
How long have you known her? Does she even know who you are? I've always wanted a wife but this land and my hands are all I know.
She is a good friend, but that is all for now. We grew up together, friendship turned to love.
Is she a gardener too? Here take the rest of these nails for your shed.
Her father was a gardener. Taught me everything I know. She now works in the kings estate as a maid. Have you ever been inside?
Only once. I caught the king looking through the queen's dresses! Hah!
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to farmer

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: What are you doing here, my king?
I am just enjoying the beauty of the garden at this castle my queen. Care to walk with me?
I would love to, my dear. I need some fresh air after being offended by the Lord's body odor.
Though the beauty of this rose pales in comparison to your own it should make up for the odor of Lord Stinky
You have such a sweet tongue, my love. Roses are my favorite.
You are my favorite, sweet Queen. Tell me, what business did you have with the Lord?
He was going on and on about budgets. I still have a headache!
Lucky for you we are only here but for a brief visit.  We leave to return home in a week's time. Do you think you can tolerate it?
Yes, I have learned great patience over the years as queen. Before I forget, I got this gift for you my love.
Ooooh I love gifts! I'm so impatient when it comes to them, you know I cannot contain myself. What is it??
Why don't you open it and tell me if you like it?
Oh dear thank you so much! I was wanting a new mustache mug! How do you always know just what to get to surprise me?
Being married for thirty years helps, my dear. There's nothing you can hide from me!
I suppose it does. We live a Blessed life do we not?
