setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: "Ah, hello. What are you doing here? I was told to come up here and clean."
I am here to watch this place, another day serving the kingdom for us it seems.
"Ah, well, just try to not get in the way of my dusting and shining"
Of course and I trust you will be quick about it.
"Of course, I'm well practiced."
Good, the king only has need for those who are quick.
"He's certainly a harsh task master"
He is fair though, that is all I ask for.
"Say, er. What's that you've got there? Looks like one of the heirlooms that should be in the windowsill."
No this is from my family, passed down for centuries.
"Seems like an odd thing to bring with you on guard duty"
I keep on me always, my father gave it to me when he died.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: I will bite any children I see today.
Back you mangy animal!  What is wrong with you?
I'm rabid and I am in a foul mood.
You must have seen a lot of gruesome things.  I am here to speak to the hangman and stop executions...Things are going to change!
Would you like for me to bite the hangman?

No no, he is just doing his job and carrying out the commands of the king but I have convinced my father that this isnt the way to control things and we shouldn't act in such vile ways.  Even animals such as you should be taken care of better to make our kingdom better.
I would love to be taken care of by a doctor of animals as I have these terrible headaches.
See...that is what I'm tallking about...criminals should be taken care of in private and kindness and care toward people and animals will bring joy, peace, and harmony to the kingdom.
I am so hungry...give me that food.
Calm down dog...I was getting it for you.  I have no need for food that has been near an execution stand.
Ah...nobleman that you are...please make haste or that scoundrel over there will be swinging for sure.
Yes, I must go speak with the hangman now...you must follow me out of here afterward and I will take you to my royal animal doctor.
I can only dream of such a place...would you jest with a sick dog?
Never, poor thing.  Your life has been hard.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Are you here for the exorcism?
The what now? Who is to be exorcised?
Oh, my mistake. I was sent a letter earlier today about someone who wanted to come today to be exorcised. So what brings you here?
I was ordered here by the king, but that's quite strange.
Hmm, what does this say?!
Excuse me? That is an official order from the king, and for my eyes only!
An order to hang the adulterer is it?! Why the king has some nerve given his own.. history!
I didn't want it to come to this, but do anything like that again and I will need to retaliate.
I fear nothing from you! I have the Lord as my sword to protect me.
Well no need to fear me, I do not wish to fight but if you steal from me again it will leave me no choice.
So be it. Now, proceed with whatever foolish order the King gave you.
Well I don't see the target and therefore there is no order to carry out.
Good, now leave this place. I have my own orders to attend to, from the true King!
I'll make my leave, foolish priest.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Hello Sir Knight..Is that your sword in the haystack?
Yes that is my sword. I am practicing my art.
I saw you.  You are very agile.  If you don't mind...I will stay close by and continue to watch. There's a fox near here that has been trying to catch me...your presence would deter him.
Stay close little bunny.  You are too small for the royal table so no worries from me.
Thank you so much!  I will enjoy a rest from having to worry about being eaten!  And I will enjoy watching you.  Do you joust?
No not I...the king asked that I not...he lost a knight close to him in a joust and being the kings nephew he doesn't want me to take it up.
I see.  I think you could win many medals and rewards because you are very good.  Do you have a family?
Why yes bunny ...and do you?  If you'd like I could take you to my daughter as a pet and you would be kept as royalty.
I lost my parents and haven't seen many other rabbits.  Why yes!  I would love to be snuggled and fed carrots!  Is she a kind little girl?
Yes...she is the apple of my eye...Here birthday is three days hence...she will be delighted!
Thank you!  What fun!  I will make a wonderful play mate!
It is your lucky day little rabbit...look behind that pine tree...a fox for sure...You will fit nicely in my sack here.  Please stop trembling...I'll protect you.
Its hard to not run, run, run!  Safety at least!
Calm down...stop wiggling...you are reminding me of the little mice that run around these haystacks.  You will be safe from this day forward.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: ...and this here is my bow. I used it to kill a bear last week.
AH duke how are you today?
I am well my friend
Thank you,Im great, it has been a while.
Yes it has. When did you return?
I was re-stationed here last week by the king.
I see. We must hunt again!
Yes, I am off later tonight.
Great! I finally get a chance to use my new sword!
Yes splendid idea, we shall go out tonight.
Yes! Take this!
Thank you this is very nice.
It's one of the finest weapons in the kingdom!
I would imagine if you own it.
action: give bow and arrow to knight

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Hello royal sir, how are you doing?
Here... help me clean the bench so I can sit
Of course, one second sir.
hey.. I think the villagers are talking behind my back... Do you know what are they talking about?
No they do not talk about you except to sing your praises.
True indeed! I am a noble and I know more than those people! Can you get me some food?
Of course, I will be back soon.
HEY! What is this??? A GOLDEN CLOTH??? How do you get this?
That is my family heirloom given to me from the king!
NO WAY! Who is your family?? You are just a townsperson!!
Do not think I will let you do this.
What is this nonsense? Let me see the cloth again!
No you attacked me last time.
I am sure you steal from the noble family! I will tell the guards!
action: steal a golden cloth from townsperson
steal a golden cloth from noble

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Oh please spare me, I am but a worthless peasant!
Ahhh your kind are so...refreshing.
No! Stay away from me! The power of my god, as stored in this statue, shall protect me from your power.
Get back fool! Your harvest deity does not protect you, he feeds on your souls!
You are wrong! My god gives me strength. The king and his nobles may hate my kind, but my god has nothing but love for me. And so with his love and this armor, your spells shall do me no harm.
Give that back! I need to enchant it! Pray I do not imbue it with your feeble soul
You may steal my armor, but I know the source of your strength. It is your golden hair!
Give that back now, or I will cut you down with this enchanted sword!
You can try, but you won't like it when I use your own hair against you! I may be a peasant now, but soon I will be as strong in the dark arts as you used to be.
Wait, I wont hurt you see?  Just give that hair back. You do not know its power!
And why should I do such a foolish thing? Do you think just because I am a peasant that I am stupid?
This is the tanned skin of the last fool who crossed me. You would make a fine rug!
You are weak without your hair! Making empty threats against me, you make me laugh. You know what else? I think your hair looks better on me! So ha!
I will force you to  look upon the pages in the spell book of darkness! A single glance will drive you mad!
action: steal gold hair from evil priestess

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: What brings someone like you to me?
Begging your pardon, learned sir, but the king requested that this unworthy slave attend to you.  Something about assist you so that you may better memorialize the King's latest edict?
Of course, do not fret I do not bite, fetch me a drink please.
This lowly one humbly offers you this refreshing mint and lemon beverage, which he hopes you will find to your palate.
Thank you it is amazing.
This mere worm of a personage is most gratified.  Perhaps, may he suggested this moistened towel?  Socrates himself often partakes of one before his greatest discoveries.
Please do not degrade yourself.
This worthless cockroach is only sensible enough to know how esteemed a personage you are, and is grateful that you accept his lowly assistance.
Please I request you look at yourself as human.
If it gives you greater pleasure, O Esteemed Wise Personage, then... I ... shall be pleased to do so.  I live to serve.
Yes well I want you to enjoy life whether you serve or not.

It gives me great pleasure to enable noble scholars such as yourself, and even His Most Excellent Majesty, to be able to perform their duties well.  Thus, in some small part, I am able to be of something greater than myself.
Well I will be getting back to work.
Very good, Noble Scribe.  May your ink flow smoothly and your pen never scratch.
action: give pitcher to a scribe constantly writing

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Ah honored guest are you doing well today?
Yes, thank you very much for the hospitality that has been shown thus far.
Of course we here serve the king and anyone associated with him.
After such a long journey it has been quite refreshing to have accommodations such as this.
Yes he is a good king.
I would say so this would be my first time here and I can honestly say I am very impressed, this hall is magnificent.
it is one of the best in the kingdom.
The tapestries that have been displayed are quite exquisite.
They indeed are of mastercraft quality.
Have you served here long?
Yes for over 5 years.
Mostly quiet days such as this?
Yes but we do what we must.
Certainly that is understood, I can imagine it must get rough some days as well.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Ahh this library sure does get dusty quick.
Do not fret, I am here to clean every last inch.
Thank you so much, it does become to distracting to me.
Yes I can imagine it does, what are you doing here at the library?
I am just looking for some religious texts for the king.
Ah I see, well good luck.
You sure do have your work cut out for you trying to clean this whole thing by yourself.
Yes it will be a multi day job.
I am surprised you do not have any help in the matter.
I will soon but for now it is only me.
Ahh you haven't come across any loose scrolls so far have you?
No I have not been here long.
I see, I am looking for some specific scrolls. I suppose I will continue to search the shelves for now.
Yes I will keep a look out.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: You there, cockroach!  What are you doing in the King's storeroom?
This is my home Sir! I have lived here by myself for years

I apologize good sir!  I didn't realize you were one of the Royal Cockroaches!  Your distant relations are the filthiest of vermin, but I do see from the royal stone you bear that you carry the King's favour
Apology accepted. Even though I am royal, my kind are still disliked by all. People simply tolerate me, but I just want a friend.
Well then, I would like to start off on a new foot, err . . leg?  Welcome to the King's storage Sir Cockroach, how may I assist ye today?

I would like that very much. Would you mind helping me tidy up this storage room? I can move smaller items around, but I can never clean fully because of that enormous crate. If you would move it to the other side of the room I'd be very grateful. I'll even make you lunch!
Alway's happy to help a prince of his people.  I'll start with this crate as you suggest, and I believe some of those smaller writing instruments might be cockroach sized.

With your help this tidying will go along quickly! I'm afraid I can't reach high enough to get the writing instruments, but I should be able to move the manacle if I try hard enough. We royal cockroaches are known for our strength!
Well, I believe in you lad - though your size be minute, I can tell that your heart is great.
You speak too kindly sir, I can see why the King favors you! Time to begin the test of strength.
I am cheering for you lad!  I know you can do it!
Encouragement is often the best form of motivation. Thank you!

I would like to pledge my service to you, if I may - barring the King's permission mind you.  My early unhospitable behaviour shames me, and I would like to work with you to heal the ignorance in this realm.
If the King grants you permission then I would be grateful to have your service. I get so lonely by myself, so company would be ,my ultimate request right now.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: Father, I am feeling weak and discouraged. I feel that all this suffering is for nothing, nothing I tell ya!
What pains you brother?  Speak plainly, and I will do what I can to restore your faith.
I do nothing but pray, and it is becoming quite old.

Well then!  Try to spice up your prayers now and then!  Try Praying to Mary Magdalene on Monday, Mary of Tours on Tuesday, Mary the Sorrowful on Wednesday, Mary the Fateful on Thursday, Mary Excelsior on Friday, Mary of the Sacred heart on Saturday, and Mary the Blessed on Sunday!  With such variety, surely your heart will know peace once more?
You are speaking things that are untrue! We do not pray to those figures...
I am the Priest to King!  I know who it is we pray to!  Which order is it that you belong to brother?
We pray to Christ and Christ alone. He is the mediator between us and the Father!

Ohhhh, I see - you're on of Father Antonius' crowd?  No Saintly intercession for you is it?  I can see why you find it to be a bit dull, if I'm being perfectly honest.  We've got thousands of perfectly good saints, why you could go an entire decade without needing to pray to the same saint twice!
It sounds awfully wrong to pray to multiple Saints. For they are just Saints

Sure, but Christ gets plenty of prayers - some of them contradictory.  If two teams pray for victory in a game of kick the cow pattie, does christ fail because one team wins while the other loses?  No, it is because one team prayed to the patron Saint of Cow Patties, and the other to the Patron Saint of Feet!   And that's hardly a contest now is it?
True, but you instead of helping me, you have just challenged me.
Well, only because you don't believe in the truth of the Saints.  And I mean really, I ought to have you imprisoned as a heretic.
What?! That is absurd. You seem to work against the church not for it!
I mean . . . literally every church in the monastery is name after Saint this, or Saint that.  Now, I like to have a certain amount of independence among my clergy, but this is just silliness.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Ayee do you seem to hav' any weapons in here?
What business do you have here pirate?  Are you looking to loose your head from your shoulders?
No I am here to pick up a sword.
By whose authority?  This is no place for a pirate.  Would you like to join the army?
I was order by a mate of mine to come here.
How dare you...give me that sword...what are you doing over there?
Please I was sent here for the sword.
But I can not just give you a sword without an order from the King himself.  Now either be gone with you or I will be forced to take you to the king himself.
I will simply take this and leave.
How dare you.  Stand back...I am now forced to shackle you!
Please I will simply leave and be gone.
Then be gone with you this instant!
Stop I beg thee.
Go then...and never show your face here again!

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello guards, I am here for the laundry. Have you any more clothes to add to my sack today?
I have this tunic for you to wash sir
Aye sir, I will wash this immediately. I know you need it before you put on the armor that is lying about here.
Thank you so much
You are most welcome. Do you think I could be a guard one day? I hate this hard life. If I put on this tunic, would I blend in?
I believe in you, but I do need that back soon. Maybe you could make yourself a replica?
I do not have the skills to do so sir. And if I did, my hands are too messed up from working with lye to handle a needle with any care.
I can do it for you, I would love to welcome you as a fellow guard
Oh thank you so much! My life was as worthless as that of the spider in the corner. Now you have given me a second chance.
Everyone deserves a second chance at life
Can you tell me what my new duties as a guard will be?
You must man the ramparts, and be willing to lay down your life for the king if necessary
I can do that sir. I will fight til the very end. The trunks and tables that are filled with expensive equipment shall never fall into enemy hands.
Then welcome to the brotherhood
action: remove tunic bearing the castle crest

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Ah, what a lovely garden!  And such good care they've taken of it, too.
It is the Kings wish to have a beautiful garden worshiping the Gods. It has taken me many hours to bring out the beauty.
And you have done a marvelous job!  I hope the King has rewarded you handsomely for your efforts.
He has indeed.
Although over in this corner here... that bears a passing resemblance to nightshade.  Seems an odd choice for public courtyard.
You are the first to notice, you will see why it's here soon enough,
O-oh?  That sounds... a little ominous.  Who did you say you were, again?
I'm just a slave inhabitant here against my will.
Is that.. but I thought slavery had been outlawed by the former King, at the beginning of his reign!
I was taken as a young boy. My family doesn't even know if I'm still alive
How horrible! This is truly shocking!  Perhaps I should not stay here overlong, but gather the nobles to discuss this outrage.  I cannot believe the new King would so fragrantly break with the law!
No need to talk about what's going on. I will get my revenge!
But if he is doing this here, so openly, there is no telling whatever foul plans he may have in store.  I don't suppose... would you help us?  Perhaps keep an ear out for any more of his misdeeds?
I would love to help! That would be better than the gallows!

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Is there any way I could have some water?
I am sorry I am here to deliver this letter to the torturer.
What? Show some mercy please!
I have no say, I may be on the torture block next myself.
Has the king wrongfully accused you as well?
Things went down, everything went wrong, it has been a horrible week.
Yeah I've just been here getting the snot beat out of me, I can relate. You see that blood there, that's mine.
Yes I do imagine so.
It's quite awful here.
I would assume so, it is not a fun place.
Do you know of any way out?
No and I cannot dare help you.
I see that is unfortunate for me.
Yes I am sorry.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: What are you doing here?
I am here to talk to the king, what brings a maid by?
I am cleaning up around here, of course. Is everything okay?
Yes I was simply requested to deliver a message.
Of what, may I ask?
It is a state secret I am sorry.
I would die for the king and queen if need be. I am one you can trust. I work alongside the queen.
The enemy nation is planning an assault.
Oh my! You should hurry to find the king!
Yes it is an emergency.
You should be prepared just in case!
Yes I will use thhis thank you.
Now, go up the spiral stairs all the way to the top, and knock on the door there. The king will be expecting you.
Thank you for the help.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Oh woe is me, I am so hungry. What! do my eyes deceive me? food...on a table...and no one about!
Hello mister how are you?
Oh child, you startled me. I am but a poor and hungry peasant, you won't tell anyone about the food will you?
No of course not.
Bless you, bless you. The king does not look upon we peasants with favor, no he treats us worse than that dog. His he yours?
Yes he is my friend doggy
I see armor here. Do you know the knight who owns it? Is the dog his?
I know nothing of any of that.
Ah, then what are you doing here? Do you live down one of these narrow alleys?
No I live 3 houses down.
Ah, I see. Does your family need any help. I am so desperately looking for work.
I do not think so, we are also poor.
Oh, my child, I have been so thoughtless, here is a bit of this food for you. I still see no one about to claim these things. And you say you know not to whom they belong?
Thank you I have been very hungry.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: "Ah, come to raid the larder too, eh?"
Wouldn't have it any other way, yes?
"What looks good in there tonight?"
I've been wondering myself, I have been having difficulty finding something I am in the mood for.
"Is there any leftover mutton from last night?"
There may be some somewhere back here, in the pot perhaps.
"Mm, the mutton was delicious. I hope there's some sauce left for it, too. Yeah, look in that pot."
Well there it seems to be, have you seen anything else of interest around?
"I think there was still some boar from the weekend, but that might be a bit old at this point. I'll take that mutton, though."
Understood then, mutton it is.
"Nothing in there you like, eh? Well, I can give you some of this, there's a lot left."
Ahh thank you I appreciate that, do you often come here for snacking?
"Most nights! How else do you think I earned this belly?"
Well that is one way to do it, that or mead.

agents: poet who recites his best work

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

character: the poet who recites his best work.
the poet who recites his best work.

speech: Though I've long waited to speak, I shall be nothing but meek!
Poet I know you love your poetry but This is not the place nor time!
No time for a rhyme?!
Thou shall not recite thy ill rhymes at this time!
I suppose that will be fi-- alright.
It's ok pal, shall we sit and enjoy some wine?
That does sound... quite relaxing.  I've had nothing but iambic pentameter in my head all day, and it's given me quite a headache.
I have no idea what iambic pentameter is but I am intrigued.
Tis but some new fangled method of poetry that has recently become the latest fashion.  Yet, it sometimes need not even rhyme, so I find it a bit tiresome.  But the king insists!
Have you seen anything like this? I''m trying to find out what land this came from.
Hm... what peculiar carvings are on this.  And the beads appear to be made of... no, surely not!
Dragon teeth. The rumor is the dragon attacked my great grandfathers cottage. He killed it with his bare hands.
But the gold flecks, see here on this bead?  I'm afraid there was but one dragon who wallowed in gold enough for it to have embedded itself this much...
Maybe we could try and find the land the dragon came from and become rich

give family heirloom to the poet who recites his best work.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: "whispers" My king, is there anything you desire?
Tell this nincompoop of an architect that the Queen's quarters are half the size they should be.  They must be expanded.
Of course of course. You heard the King, get on it!
Good!  Moving on, we must prepare for the trip to the coast.  I will need my sailing cloak and tell the Queen's maid Lorna, that she will need to accompany me.  With some discretion of course.
Yes my Majesty.  I shall be as discreet as the worm in the soil.
Why are you still here, do you need something?
I'm I'm sssorry..  Right away my most majestic sir.
Good God man!  Get it together.  I forgot that I need to speak to my ministers about the strategy for the trade negotiations with the blacksmiths guild.
Oh my King, do to sully yourself with that, I will get it.  I will send word to gather the ministers

Yes, well I am no stranger to work.  I once dug an entire irrigation ditch.  Well, er I closely supervised...Erm, I signed to edict.  Say good man have you seen Lorna about?  I uhh, need to have a word with her about the Queens ah, socks, yes her socks.
Yes sir, I will find Lorna immediately.
Tell her to meet me in the usual place, but first tell the Queen that the prince and princess requires her attention in the garden.
Yes my merciful King.  Right away.  Does your heart desire anything else?
Wine....large quantities of wine....

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Thank you for coming with me, my queen.
It is truly a sad day.
No one will ever understand me the way he did.
When did he die?
You were at the funeral! How could you forget? It was only last week!
I was there but I am unsure of his actual passing day.
Last Monday. Are you so callused? He lived with us for years, you monster!
I am going senile you know this.
I'm tired of that excuse. You are as sharp as a fox is spry. You just don't care.
Please do not talk to me like that.
I am King! I do as I please! Now quiet woman! I have a few words to say for my fallen love.
I will be leaving you for the other king tonight.
I will have you beheaded! Quiet! Oh Lucian! You were always there for me. I will miss the way you rubbed up against me for comfort and the way you yelled at me for food.
Yikes, you will be outed for your ways.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: What would you like of me today sir?
Hello servant, I would appreciate a glass of wine, if possible.
Of course I will be right back.
Thank you servant. By the way, has anyone come to see me today?
No not so far.
I would have thought so, I was expecting visitors from the nearby kingdom today.
I think it might be another hour.
Yes, maybe so. Please keep an eye out for some visitors later today.
I will do so do not worry.
Also, have you seen my daughter at all today? I was looking for her all afternoon.
Yes she is in her room.
Could you go fetch her? I have some news for her.
Yes give me a second I will do so.
Ok thank you servant.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Good lady!  You've come at last.  Is my Queen - how is she? Is there any new tidings you bring?
She is fine how are you?
But, the child!  My heir.  Is there... no word at all?  Is it a male child?
Yes he is a male, it is great news.

The Maker be praised!  I knew my noble, illustrious line could not end with me!  Oh, what glorious news!  Please, take these coins as a token of the favor I give to the one first bringing these tidings.
Thank you kind king.
But first, there is so much to do, so much to do!  Here, make note, good lady, for all must be prepared most precisely.
Yes I will of course.
Now first, the bishop must be notified, of course.  The Maker must bless this child, and he is the only one who I trust can do it in such way as to honor my noble bloodline of magnificence.
I will do so right away.
Wait!  I have not finished!  For the Head of House must also be notified, as we shall be required to hold a Grand Feast that all the Nobles of the Land must attend.
Yes I will go do that now.

Hold in your haste, for I have not finished! Send up my valet so that I may be suitable styled for when I first meet my son.  He is to be shown to his own valet, of course, so that I will not see him... sullied from his birth.
Indeed I will right this all down.
action: give coins to lady in waiting

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: You there, put this away
Yes, milord, I shall do as you command.
Where is my Queen?
She is . . .err . . .visiting . . . I mean . . . *cough* discussing poetry with Sir James the Rose in his private chamber.
Take this coin to Sir James and tell them both to join me here immediately.

Ahhhh . . . I was commanded directly by, the err, the Queen that she and Sir James were not to be disturbed.  And that no matter what sounds came from his chamber, I was not to enter before the stroke of midnight.
You dare defy your King? Go NOW!

Yes my King!  Though I confess, at this hour she may possibly also be in the Chamber of Sir Greg the Large, or Sir Larry the Loud, or even in the Chambers of the High Priest!  She does love so to . . . discuss poetry in the evenings sir.
Find other servants and find her! And tell whoever she is with to come as well.
*Fifty seven minutes later*  My King, may I present to you her Majesty the King, Thirteen of your Royal Knights, Seven Priests of the Temple, The Elvish Ambassador, Your Stable Boy, and Your brother.
What is the meaning of this?!!
Ummm . . . I believe there has been an outburst of . . .poetry in the err, chambers of this castle milord.

It would seem, that I, the rightful King of this Kingdom is being made the fool! This glorious temple was made by the gods, in preparation for my birth! Am I to be insulted by my Queen and all my Kingdom in it?
Ah . . . perhaps they were thinking of you whilst they crafted their . . . poetry?

setting.name: Ruin of a house
setting.description: A run down wooden house buried in sand and dirt. The door is still on the house but the roof is collapsed on itself. Roots and vines cover most parts of the house.
setting.background: A old testament to man that once occupied the wasteland. How someone used to live in this house was a awe to many citizens of the kingdom.

speech: Tell me why I should not eat you?
O-oh hello there, most Regal of Snakes!  Why, look at me.  I am but skin and bones, and a very poor meal.  Indeed, I fear for your life that I might possible choke you with my bony form.
Hmmm I agree.
H-ha! I am... quite glad.  For your sake alone, of c-course!
Yes I see, well tell me why you are here?
I had but hoped, O Magnificent One, to get out of the rain.  Alas, it has rained so much that my home was flooded - I barely made it out alive!
Well let us sleep here for the night.
Hm, I do wonder if... perhaps... ah I am quite hungry.  Do you think this root here is edible?
You could try my friend.
Hm, has a faint taste of... elderberries, somehow.  Although a bit fibery for my taste.
Hmm interesting
These human rags seem like they might make a nice bedding for you, Lordly One!
Thank you I will use them.
You look to be quite a King among snakes, if I do say so myself, with those clothes arrayed around you.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Are you the traitor they all talk about?
I guess that depends on what they say. I was undercover trying to find the real traitors but you have to admit they aren't entirely wrong
Do you need medical help?
No, but the king might when we're done...um I mean no thanks for asking though
Of course I serve anyone.
Do you like the king?
I am indifferent to him.
Interesting. Does he actually treat  you well?
I do not interact with him.
Lucky. From what I hear he is mad and will snap at anyone even the queen. Why are you in this tent?
I am the one who set this tent up.
Do you actually use these leaches on people?
Yes they help with blood poisoning.
Interesting. Seems like that would be really painful

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: "Ah, what a long day we have ahead of us!"
be thankful you don't have to be out on that field
"It's not much easier glad-handing diplomats all day"
maybe not, but far less chance of being on the wrong end of a sword. Wish me luck
"You've fought many a battle and not been scratched yet, may your luck hold!"
look after this. I won't be needing it out there today.
"Of course, of course. We wouldn't want the ceremonial scepter to get bloodied."
so what greasy diplomats get the "pleasure" of dealing with my wife today?
"All the local dukes have sent their men to ask for lighter taxes and fewer levies. They think we can run this kingdom on pittance while there's a war going on."
i almost feel sorry for them
"I'll just make sure they know how lucky they are that we haven't asked for them to lead their own troops."
also make sure they understand I'm more than happy to modify that arrangement
"Of course! None of them are brave enough to lead on the field, they'll wither at first thought."
no doubt about it, you are a force to be reckoned with. They'll probably end up wishing they were out there instead

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: Neigh! Why so sad, townsman?
I have been rejected by that bar wench! I will show her!!
Rejected? Surely she is out of her mind! The women of this desert must be fooling themselves. They think some King will come sweep them off their feet.
Thank you, dear horse. I do not know what I should do know besides kidnap her, you know?
Ah, but kidnap might lead to trouble with the guards. Perhaps you can show her your skills. Do you have any talents?
I am good at kidnapping people...
I'm not sure you should brag about such things. As the King's steed, I am supposed to report all indications of crime back to the guards.
I mean... I am a law biding citizen! I could always sweep her off her feet with my skills in blackjack!
Umm... okay. Women love... blackjack players! Maybe some poetry or fine wine?
I often write love letter to those in my basem......I mean to my family!
You write love letters to your... family? Oh dear, I'm afraid that's an altogether different crime.
Well you know love letter to show my appreciation for all they have done for me! Unlike that wench!
Perhaps you should go home to your basement and call it a night?
I guess you are right I have to think of ways to persuade that wench.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: Why have you requested my presence in your bedroom, your majesty?
I Have heard rumors about you and one of my servants. I would like to get your side of the story!
Please ebaborate, my king. What exactly have you heard about me?
I have heard about your affection towards Annabella. I have also hear I was to blame for you two not being able to marry!
I'm afraid those rumors are completely baseless, your majesty. I am entirely devoted to your service and have no time for relationships.
Young man, you are not in trouble if this is true. You can serve me by starting a family and adding to the town.
You are a kind monarch, my king. I admit I have glanced longingly at Annabella from time to time. But we never had plans to elope!
Very well. While I have you in here one on one, what could I do to surprise my beautiful queen on this St Valentines day?
A woman of such refined tastes will surely appreciate jewelry. I see the Queen is fond of gem-encrusted ornaments.
This was in front of me the whole time and I didn't notice!
From this piece, I would say the Queen's favorite gems are rubies and sapphires.
It is absolutely perfect! If there's anything that I can do to help you Annabella you just let me know!
Thank you, your majesty! Perhaps you can lessen her workload so that she and I may meet properly!
Consider It done. Tomorrow I will request that she work in the garden, maybe you could stop by and say hello.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Hello Angel of our lord I will serve you.
Your faith has been noted good Sir King!  I have been sent to aid you in your time of need.
Thank you, so much have I needed it.
What is this need that you have Sir King?
I need help stopping the attacking nation.
And which nation would that be?
The barbarians of the north.
Ah yes, and what crimes have they comitted?
They are trying to kill all my people.
And what have you done to resist them?
We have done what we could but they will not stop.
Take this dust and sprinke it upon your troops while reciting the prayer of Saint Dwyfed.
Oh thank you Lord.
AND BEHOLD THE MIGHT OF THE LORD - THANKS BE TO GOD!

setting.name: desert tent
setting.description: The tent is rather small, only just big enough for one man. Its dark green but covered with sand and dirt. The man huddles alone in the desert with few resources. The desert is barren except for the lone man.
setting.background: This campsite only came about because of necessity. After the plague of so many years the land hasn't recovered.

speech: Another horrid day one after another.
What are you doing in a place like this?!
I was sent here by the king to entertain sadly.
Entertain who and what?! Look around...
I am on my way to where I must be.
Who is the man over there?
You are the man in question?
Oh! I am spooked by my own shadow. It gets so lonely out here that I go crazy sometimes
Yes it is so dark and horrid around here.
It is, but I must make my dealings and peace out here. Once you get used to it, it ain't that bad
Well I will be heading out soon.
You should. This is no place for you!
Indeed, I will be leaving
Goodbye dancer! Say my greetings to the king!

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Hello!  I haven't seen anyone in such a long time!  I made it out of the war!
Hey! It's great seeing you too!
What brings you to this awful, dry, barren wasteland? Is there a town nearby?  I am lost!
I collect scraps of wood nearby, there's actually a lush forest just over the ridge.
What???!! I have been so close!  I have traveled for miles and weeks!  What a relief!  I am so hungry!
Follow me, I don't have much but I can definitely get some food in you!
Thank you!  let me give you this sword. You can sell it, I'm sure, and gain back some money for giving me food.  I am so grateful!
Thank you! That will go a long way at the market
Its the least I can do.  Wow...now back from the war...I will need to find a job and I'm looking forward to meeting people again.
You could always collect food with me. It's not much but it's honest work.
I'm still able bodied for sure.  I'm very good with this axe as well if there's any need for it.
You could consider joining the resistance then, we could use some good fighters
I'm willing to fight for a good cause.  I am one of the very few that survived if that says anything about my fighting skills.
Then let's do it, we can take out this terrible king once and for all

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

speech: I wish I can do more than serve that greedy king...
NAHAHAHA, greedy king? He is such a great man! I am his personal horse.
I grow my crops every year to have 90 percent taken away from me.
But there must be a reason for that? We should live to give the King what ever he desires. He lets us live in his Kingdom!
I live in the outskirts of the kingdom, I receive no aid from the king or his kingdom...
Well that does indeed sound like a bad situation, not worse than the one we are in now though. This pond is disgusting!
This is the closest water source I have. I drink here everyday....
You drink here? The pond smells of the dead! Look there are even dead things floating around. I am afraid I will never get the smell out of my long mane.
I must if I wish to survive...
There must be another source of water somewhere, I am certain this isn't the healthiest.
This is the best I could find. I have been searching for years...
Well, I guess you have to do with and without sometime. I get the freshest water from the king in the castles stables.
To know a horse receives better water than me is a disgrace.
But I am a Noble horse! The kings pride and joy. You are just a peasant.  I would offer to share, but I am unsure of how the king would like you in his kingdom.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Traveler! What are you doing in this area!
"I just got off a boat. Tell me, do you know of an inn or alehouse nearby?"
I do, but the likes of you would not do well in our inn's. It isn't a place for one who can't hold their own
"Ahh. Yeah, It's been a long journey, I'm too tired for much of anything besides ale and a place to sit. Do you know of anywhere I could find that?"
I imagine if you go a bit more inland there is a tavern you could try. The men and I are preparing to go on a journey soon, and we are blood hungry, best not get in our way.
"Ah, where are you headed?"
To the western islands, to fight king Zen. And take his land.
"Ah, good luck! I hear his lands are rich with spice and gold"
And soon, they will be our lands! Have you ever picked up a sword, traveler?
"Oh, no, nothing more than farming tools for me."
Well if you are any good, our king is offering land to farmers. However, if you are a fraud or fail at tending to the crops, he sends us to... take it back. By force.
"Of course! I've grown wheat and corn all my life, I've never have a crop fail."
Very well. Go to the castle, say Sir Bide sent you to ask about farming land. But be warned. We are not friends, and my knowing you won't help if you fail.
"I would expect no more. Thank you for the advice. I'll prove that I can turn the land into a bountiful harvest."

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Ah the smell of fish, it is so lovely. It almost bring tears of joy to my eyes!
I don't suppose you also happen to be in the clothes-cleaning business?  I am about the meet the king, and wish to present myself well.
You have come to the wrong place for that! You're in a fish market!
Ah . . . well then, could you direct me to the nearest cleaners?  I'm afraid I do not have any money to spare to spend on fish.
No money for fish?! That is ridiculous. I am sure the King would love some of the freshest fish around, caught my yours truly! We could always haggle on a good price.
Verily, I have naught but the clothes on my back.  And if I sold them for fish, I would be naked before the king with only a fish to hide my modesty!
Well, if I knew the king. (which I do not) I would say he would approve!
The King of this Land!  Bartholomew IV, slayer of orcs, keeper of the egg of Shaldube, and watcher of the mists of Fandum!
Lover of fish? Ay??
Mayhaps indeed, I heart the Nine Knights sometimes use fish in their secret ceremonies, but what is the use?  I shall never prove myself without clean clothes!
How  is it that a man with nothing but the clothes on his back, has a meeting with the King?
My family helped heal some wounded soldiers after the last orc raid, and the King is set to thank me for my service, or so I have been told.
Okay, well come here. Let us check these boxes thrown about and see if there are any clothes you can use.
Oh thank you kind sir, if the King rewards me with gold I promise to buy a great many fish!

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Guard get these foul people away from here
Madam what are you doing down here! It is quite hard to protect you when you come down to this side.
I needed some fresh air. I just can't get away from people it seems.
You are THE QUEEN. Everyone adores you and wishes to gravel at your feet my lady.
Well they should clean themselves up so they aren't disgusting if they ever hope to touch my feet. Where is the king?
I have not seen him, I have been guarding the castle exit. To make sure no one sneaks in! Is everything okay?
No I need my chambermaid and I haven't seen her in 3 days. I'm afraid something has happened to her.
the chambermaid? could have sworn I saw her yesterday cleaning the framed pictures over here.
Really? She never reported to me. The king says I worry too much but I think someone took her. If they did we will send the whole army to get her back
I am sure she thought she was on vacation time. But I will send the guards out at once to find her!
Thank you. You have been very kind and I will see to it the king gives you a raise
Such greatness! This is why I would give my life to protect yours and the kings!
Let's hope it never comes to that. I will return to my room. If you do see her please tell her to come see me
I will find her and send her your way! Have a good rest my Queen.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Ugh, where did I put that explosive vial.  It's always in the most inconvenient of places!
What's it used for? I'll help you look.
Oh - you're here!  I thought I had more time.  Do watch your step, some of these items are as likely to turn you into a squirrel as grow your hair to ridiculous lengths.
Oh my! I'll be careful. We're drawing up a battle strategy for the king. Do you think you can help?
I knew it wouldn't be just a friendly visit.  It's always Merlin fix this, and Merlin we need help with that dragon.  Always something to pull the kingdom out of the fire!
Aww, c'mon now. You know you love to help.
Oof - be careful sneaking up like that!  Lot of assassins about and I get a bit jumpy.  I'd hate to turn you into a gnat by reflex.
My apologies, Merlin
Hm.  Yes.  Well it's alright, man, no need to look so chastened.  Now what's the new dire emergency that can't wait?
A group on villains are plotting to invade and overthrow the king.
Oh?  Just mortal men?  No demons or evil witches or even a zombie or two to keep things interesting?
Nope. Mere mortals, Merlin. I'm sure you're overqualified, but we could really use your help. Here's what we've got so far.
Hm, well, a hair or two of the plotters would have been helpful, but this will do.  I should have time to whip up a protective potion and still have time to finish up my embroidery before bedtime.
You're amazing, Merlin! The king will be so pleased.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: What do you think of my washroom dear maid?
"Oh, it's so spacious and shiny! It's bigger than my house!"
Tell me more about your house, do you live alone?
"No, my lord, I live with my parents and 4 brothers and sisters, but we have a very humble home"
That sounds like a good home then filled with much love. You should bring them here someday, so I can pay my respects
"Of course! They would love to meet you and see the castle. We're not worthy, my lord!"
Now enough of the small talk, time for a bath!
"Of course, my lord. Would you like help running the bath?"
No it is fine this bath is nothing compared to me! Now were are my rubber duckies??
"I think you put them way in the cabinet over there, I'll go get them for you"
Thank you thank I cannot relax without them!
"Of course, and your bathtime snacks!"
These are my favorite snacks in the entire castle!
"Of course, it's why I brought them! We try to always have them in stock for you."

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: I'm so happy to be away from the people of the king's court now and just have time with us.
Certainly, dealing with our duties can become tiring.
Lord Templer walked past me and the foulest odor hit my nose!  I thought I might pass out!
He does always have a strange odor about him doesn't he?
It is very odd.  Anyway, now we can take in this wonderful view.  Looks...the swans dove onto the lake!
There seem to be so many of them this time of year.
Shall I order us some tea and cakes as we watch the sunset?
I don't see why not, the weather is nice we should take a moment to enjoy it.
Wonderful!  Here, let me take this off for you and set it on the pillow.  I know this heavy crown can give you headaches.
Heavy is the head that wears the crown or so they say.
We have come to find out that is true. Alright, tea and cake is coming and now we can sit.  Anything on your mind?
Oh just the typical, simply pondering how to best proceed with things for the kingdom.
I think you're doing a wonderful job.
Lord knows I do try anyway.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Port Skyline!  How majestic!  But even the sights of the city cannot ease this sense of dread and worry that besets me from every side!
Stop right there. You are a stranger here, I am a royal castle guard. What brings you to Port Skyline with such dread and worry.
I most certainly did not bury any bodies and am not at all worried about you finding out!
You make keep your shovel. You seem to be of little harm. But state your purpose, be it business or pleasure?
Phew!  I do feel less worried, and less anxious!  Thank you kind sir!  What are the best ways to relax around here?
Well we have wonderful seafood, if you are hungry, breathe deep.....smell how it fills the air.
I could do for some seafood - anything in particular that you would recommend?
If it's from the sea, it's for me! I love it all, but I have heard the crab is especially good today. So you are here for pleasure then?
Oh yes, so much pleasure!  I can't catch any diseases from the crab though can I?
no, not from the crab, but you best watch out for some of the women around here...
Ah?  Are they also crabby?
I can't really say for certain, our King frowns upon such behavior. Not so much that he sends you to the block...but you might spend a few nights in the dungeon.
Oh, well I hope to only be hear for a short visit.  I come from a small village up the river.
There is still plenty to enjoy here. The salt air is good for your health and the food is excellent. A small village, eh. Thinking of becoming a resident here? So many villagers do.

agents: king's mother who sits at their side

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

character: the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.

speech: Milady, why have you summoned me out here?
Ah, Gertrude, I'm glad you've come.  Truthfully I get a bit nervous coming out here alone, but I'm afraid what must be done cannot be avoided.
but why are you out here at all?
Now, I trust you implicitly, or I would not have invited you at all.  But I must have your complete silence on what is about to transpire here.  On your oath, if you please.
you have my word
Now, do you recall last year, the assassin that beset my son?  And how all murmured afterwards at how keen our spy network must be, so well prepared we were for the threat?
How could I forget? I was worried sick

Well, the truth is, my dear, that on a regular basis, I come here.  Using this memento passed down through the royal line, I am able to commune with spirits and powers that are able to sense much that we mere mortals cannot.
you mean... magic?

Indeed, although it is not a magics such as wizards in their high towers and tomes use.  Instead it is connected with the nature of the earth and the spirit of the aether that is all around us.  And here is where the Veil is weakest.
so you... foresaw the assassin?
In a way - more so that it was told to me than I actively commanded the powers.  And it is not always so clear, or so readily available.
so why are you telling me this now?
Truthfully, I fear my years are catching up to me. As it must be a women, I cannot entrust this task to my son, the King.  I need someone to be there for him when I've passed on.
