setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: It has been a long day of scaring the living!  Time to relax in my cave!
Now it my turn to scare them at night! My favorite thing to do is to crawl across their face while they are sleeping! Ha!
Classic!  I used to be the King here, did you know that?
No I didn't. How long did you reign your magisty?

Oh, hard to remember now, memories are so faint.  I remember I had many useless sons and daughters.  I promised to haunt them and their descendants forever if . . . if?  You know, I've quite forgotten why it is that I do the hauntings . . .
Maybe you are ready to move on. Although it does sound like a lot of fun to haunt people. Maybe thats why you do it?
Hah!  It is fun isn't it?  If I am currently haunting them, they must have done something to deserve it, right?
Yep! They must all be spoiled do nothing snot nosed brats! Ha! I will make sure I poop on there bread.
Good one!  Why is it you hate the humans so?
They have killed many of my family and friends. Soon I am sure they will kill me but I'm gonna have some fun with them before they do.
There, there, no need to fret friend.  Why ones try to hurt you?  I can scare them when they walk the battlements, sometimes they slip and fall to their agonizing deaths.

Thank you. That would be great. Can they hear you speak? maybe you can tell them not to step on me. If they don't want us around maybe they could give us food where they would rather us be. They just leave food out. it is very tempting.
They can hear me, but as soon as I speak they run into a wall, they run off a cliff, they run outside, they run inside - they really do far too much running for their own good.
I guess thats good enough for me if it's good enough for you! I will have to see this!

setting.name: Outside tower
setting.description: Moss grows from the tall stoic like structure adding to its mysterious presence. The stone walls appear insuperable like a mountain. The top is a pointed dome.
setting.background: The outside tower vital for defense and the appearance of domination in the surrounding area. Along with its appearance, it fully functions as a defense against enemies far and wide.

speech: I will defend this tower with my life. Flee if you want to live!
You should be the one fleeing
You are without a sword, as you are without a just cause. Why would you attack your king?
My fight is against tyranny, no matter how it is formed.
The monarchy is inexorable as the rise of that mountain peak or the strength of that wall. You have no hope of winning.
I would rather die for this cause, than live in tyranny another day
And I will die for my king. What you call tyranny, I call leadership.
Well it looks like you'll be the one dying for your so called leadership
I will fling your carcass from this tower!
You'll die for that
It won't be that easy. A king's guard never goes down without a fight. I've squashed vermin like you before.
I guess this is it for me then
Die vile scum!
Ow, that hurt

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: My king
Ulmer, fancy to find you here.
Came to get some bread, my king
Good a man needs to eat afterall.
yes, my king. Preparing to start my shift soon, i need to be fully ready
You know I just noticed we have very similar names.
I have always known, My king. The other soldiers tease me with it sometimes
How do they tease you?
they say I'm the kings other twin but  i had to stay back with the gods because i love watching maidens bath at the stream
Well we do look somewhat similar as well, so I can see that happening. People are strange I suppose.
Yes, my king. Anything i can help you with
Not that I could say, unless of course you happen across some silver kitchen utensils to replace these beat up copper ones.
not at all my king, but i know someone who can
Who might that be ulmer?

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: I wish to discuss the marriage of your daughter to my son.
The two kingdoms would benefit from an alliance between our families.
Indeed, your daughter appears to be quite the scholar?
As does your son.
Yes, he recently returned from a journey to Cathay!  Many strange customs and fabulous riches in that distant land.
Is he interested in adventure to conquer the land? I need one more to spice my life.
Yes!  And some of those lands even contain spices!
He would get my approval if he slays a dragon in that tland.
Does your daughter's library contain any books on dragons?
No, She burnth the ones I gave to her.
Why would she burn books?
She doesn't want anyone speaking about dragons.
Oh, so not even you?
I have maps to the distant kingdom if interests your son.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Good day sir. What a massive treasue.
That it is and what is your business here?
I am here to admire the treasure. THe villagers speak of it so I wanted to check it out for myself
Ah, the silly villagers always talking more than they should. However, we do not welcome "admirers" or anyone not of the King's senior staff here. So begone with you!
I can see my charm does no effect you. I will take that. Your life is not worth a few gems. No one will know it is gone.
Thief, do you not know that you cannot kill me, I'm immortal and those few gems will cost you your own life!
I am not only a skilled thief but also a dragon enchanter. You have no chance against myself and the dragon. No one is immortal from a dragon.
Seriously? That toothless and old lizard couldn't spit any more fire than a bic lighter. Give up while you can fool!
So you chose to be a fool then? So be it.
Attack me will you? sometimes this job gets rather boring with all these treasure hunters thinking they can defeat the King's invincible bodyguard. I'll finish with you and then go have lunch
Take an early lunch while I take these gms.

Yes, I'm thinking a nice roast beef sandwich and fries does sound good. Go ahead and take your precious little bauble there. Before becoming a so called jewel thief you should learn the difference between the useless quartz in your hand and a real diamond
I have killed many of men worth their weight in salt. You sir are a fool and not worth the trouble. I can see why the king chose you to be a mindless gaurd instead of his jeweler.
Not so easily done Mr Sticky Fingers. The Gods themselves appointed me to guard the king and his great wealth. I'm tired of toying with you amatuer!

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Greetings my Lord. Who is this person?
Greetings, Your Highness, you invited me a while back. I'm your cousin, Duke of Earl. Thank you for having me.
Ahh yes, it has been so long since I have seen you! Forgive me my dear.
Not to worry!  I have grown up since then.  We were children since we met.  I'm so tired that it will be good to be in a fine bed!
Yes of course, you must be exhausted! How long was your journey here?
It was 8 days but I took longer because I camped along the way and just had my horse.  It can be a relaxing break from the duties of life.  Being in nature.
Eight days! I could not even stand sleeping in a tent for a single day.
It definitely isn't for everyone.  I developed a taste for sleeping under the stars when I was in the regiment.  Oh my!  What a beautiful painting of you and the King!
Thank you, I love it also. I must admit I asked the artist to paint me five stones lighter, and he obliged from fear of losing his head.
Ha ha!  I have missed you, cousin! I think it shows you perfectly.  You are beautiful!  I would love to get my portrait done.
Before you leave I will ask the kingdom's most talented painter to do your portrait. Do you plan to stay here long?
You would do that for me??  Thank you! I was going to stay on for 2 months until the festival of games.  If that is satisfactory with you.
Of course, you can stay here as long as you want! Won't your wife miss you? What was her name again?
Elsmeth. She is actually staying at her Aunts because a wedding is happening next month.  I miss her but I'm happy she is enjoying herself.  She will join me here a couple weeks before I depart.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Ugh, guard, please don't hassle me. I have no home. All I have left is this trash heap.
Are you for or against the king?
For, very much for the King. I've lost my business and my livelihood, but it was the wicked witch that did it, not the King!
Well then, you won't have any trouble from me. Are you living here in this trash heap now?
Sadly, yes. See this rag doll? It's about all I have. I pretend it's a friend. It gets very lonesome here.
I'm so sorry. Are there others living here?
No, it is just me. And don't feel sorry for me, it's not all bad. Sometimes I have rats to keep me company, and all the scraps from the feasts at the castle come here, so I don't go hungry.
Well I will make sure to let the king know about your situation.
Please, do. Remind me I used to have a powerful business. I sold him the wedding ring for the Queen, if you remember.
We might be able to use your services in the palace. You should come with me to request an audience with the king.
I will, indeed! Do you think he will be able to find work for me?
I can only hope so. Come along. We will go at once.
Thank you, guard, for your help. The others were wrong about you. You really do care for citizens.
So others have had something to say about me? Like what?
action: get rag dool with the head detached

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Good morn your majesty.
Hello son. Would you like to go hunting with me today? I am in the mood for an adventure.
Yes indeed.  It has been a while since our last hunt.  You are feeling better then?
I feel about the same but you only live once and I'm tired of sitting around doing nothing.
Then ride we shall...I will speak to the guards at once to make ready.

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: The grass is excellant today. So moist!
Oh my goodness!  A real deer?  You are so beautiful!
Yes. You do not wish to hunt me, I hope. That is the worst. The king and his goons come after me all the time, but I am too swift for them.
No!  I would never hunt anything from the natural world - I even fell bad about eating plants, like that poor grass you are munching on.  How horrid!
You can't hear it scream, so it's ok to eat.
But, if my ears were plugged, I couldn't hear you scream - would it then be okay to eat you?  No!
You speak nonsense. I like you. Say something else strange.
Deer should be given the right to vote?
I've been saying that for years! This would be a much better place if we could.
Well, perhaps we should take the issue up with the King of the Pine tree Forest>
More nonsense! There is no king here. We govern ourselves.
How does your government function?
We don't have one. Don't need one.
Really?  Tell me more about this anarchy in which you live.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hello your majesty. Such a lovely courtyard. I love to come here to reflect.
And a fine place for reflection this is! The flowers here especially bring me joy.
Thanks to this guy! He is the best gardener in the seven kingdoms!
Indeed, he is. We were lucky to get him, and I intend on keeping him happy. Have you seen the Queen lurking about?
No I have not.How is she feeling after having the baby. I hear whispers of depression.
Depression? Ha! I would be thrilled if it was just depression. It seems it's more of a mania. Last night she suspected me of collaborating with the rats to steal her blanket.
Maybe what she need is a nice long day outside. Perhaps in this beautiful courtyard?
Oh yes, if only I could catch her! It seems her recent birthing experience has given her super speed. The moment I find her, she races away again, often screaming about some sort of conspiracy!
I'm so sorry. Please let me help her. It would give purpose to my boring life. I would be honored.
Oh please, please help me! The peace of this courtyard is my only solace. I cannot live this way!
Of coarse your majesty. First we have to find her and catch her. We will need a few of your most trusted guards.
Yes, yes. I will beckon my finest men now, and will request a couple steeds as well, in case she escapes the castle walls.

We will make her think that she has been abducted from the castle and blindfold her and take her somewhere she will not recognize. She will beg to go back home and we will allow her to escape to come back to the castle.
You are wise! I have no coin on me, but know you will be richly rewarded when we have calmed the Queen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: hey chef
Good morn Other...did you bring me the water from the well?
Yes chef, left it on table behind you
did you wipe your feet...I'll not have you bringing mud into my clean kitchen...
Oh sorry chef, i'll do that now
I am making something special for the king and queen today. A special stew made with new spices from the east.
What shall you have me do, chef?
If your hands ...and feet...are clean then chop those onions
ok, into strips or diced?
Nice chunks will do...this is to be a hearty meal.  Once you are done with they onions there are some carrots to chop.
Yes, chef. I hope they like it
Have you smelled the aroma of this spice...it is like no other in the land.
hmmmmm.... can't wait for this to be done
How is your mum..other?  I heard she was feeling ill.  Might I send a broth of chicken home with you?

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Do you want to buy some swords?
Yes, yes.... of course.. what sword would be most to uhm.. kill a dragon?
I would imagine you might be looking at something in the silver line, best for killing dragons.
I see, I see.. so uh have you been making swords for long?
Oh I do not make the swords, I simply sell them. I have sold them for as long as I can remember.
Of course of course.... I understand.... ok now that now one is around. You must flee town. Leave tonight.
Why would I need to do that?

The King.. one of the swords you sold found it's way to the King's son. He injured himself and it's instructor is blaming the balance of the sword. They are not looking for who made it, but also who sold it. Flee!
Oh, in that case I might. Certainly being wanted would negatively impact my ability to make coin.
Make coin? You fool, are you new in town?! The King will have your head for treason!! He has sent people to the block for far less. Leave town and never return
What an odd townperson, just let me sell a few more swords for gods sake.

You test my patience, swordsmith. I understand the value of coin, believe me... but I am comminting treason myself just giving you this information. I have suffered enough in the hands of the Royals and cannot let anyone suffer an ill fate as I stand idle. Flee as far as your horse can take you or I swear deal with me.
I would burn a village for a coin is all I am saying.

Those words are heretic.... you should do well to mind your wicked tongue. Last Winter's fire is still engraved on everyone's mind. But you have been warned, I come back later and you are still here we will have more than words... friend.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How are you today?  How can I help you?  Are you looking for a house tor rent?
Lord, I see elegance in the Lakeside House. I never thought I'd be standing in a house like this.

Thank you.  I'm so proud of my place.  It has many floors and my favorite part are the luxurious gardens.  My mother always loved flowers.  Is the lady looking for a house?  I have a couple open on my lands.
Shall you show me around?

Of course!  The other two houses are a basic layout similar to this but of course, the tenant would bring in furnishings and fixtures that they like.  As you can see, its open and a lot of light comes in...is this to her liking?
What is the lady's name? Don't mind my manners.
Oh!  I'm sorry.  I thought you escorting/guarding this fine lady in white with you while she searches for a new house.  Isn't that Mrs. Crawford? Wife of Duke of Gloster?  I might be confused!
I love the painting you have

Why, thank you, that one to the left was quite a quest.  I traveled for the king to help conquer a town and start a treaty with the neighboring kingdom. I had that done a few years ago.  Do you enjoy being a knight?
My work isn't exactly lucrative

Have you ever thought of being the leige of a Lord like myself?  I am looking for someone who is quick and brave but can also relax and be creative.  You would help me oversee my life's duties and you would get to travel a lot.  All expenses covered and you would stay here. I need someone quite soon.
I would be honoured to be of service. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married.
That works perfectly!  I pay well and would be happy to provide you with your own modest house nearby on the Lake once you marry.  This is beautiful country to raise children!
Would three floors be good enough to raise children?

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Mwahaha - we have ways of making you talk King!
hmmm, what exactly do you mean?
With this dagger, you will soon know what it is to feel eternal agony!
Do you think I'm just king because i was born, I was trained and raised to be a king. Many people like you tried to rise against me in the past but i slaughtered them like sheeps
You will die and be eaten by worms like the rest.  We will feed your body to pigs, and no one will remember your name!
let me see what you'll do without the dagger, i'll the guards skin you alive while your families watch

I'd like to see you try, shackled to the wall as you are!  You know, it's precisely this attitude of yours why no one is even trying to rescue you.  Your son declared it was pointless to search for you less than a day after your kidnapping!  Admittedly he was the one who paid us, after all.

I've always known he was the one responsible for all these, i just wanted to get to the people helping him. The guards are already on thier way here, spare me and i might consider sparing your families

I don't think they will make it in time . . . the Kingsguard aren't even looking in the right continent!  Gaze into my eyes, for they will be the last sight you ever see.  Then I will work on your tongue.
You are gonna get me that easy, and trust me they know I'm here
The last words of a fool?  A fool and life, and a fool in death.  Thus the chronicles will record "There died the the fool, wallowing in his own filth, without tongue, eyes, hands, or feet"
I'll remember that when the undertakers need something to be written on your cursed graved
Here, let me bind this around your head - it will muffle your painful screams.
That would only deny me the pleasure of watching die at the swords of my soldiers

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: Oh wife, today was a hard day.
I am not your wife. Not until you help me get rid of my husband as you promised.
Oh Susan, let's not speak about that tonight. Can't we just forget her for a while?
How can we forget? My husband will return in the morning and he knows I've been most unfaithful. We must plan his demise and see it through tomorrow or all is lost!
Fine, fine. I'm only a groundskeeper though, not a hired hand. How do you expect me to kill someone?!
We will use the poison I got from the witch , as we planned you fool.
That dirty witch, I don't trust the ole hag. I bet that's just water spiced with turmeric!
It's not a matter of trust. She always delivers what is promised...for a price. A price which I gladly paid. Now, are you going to help me or not?
Can't we just cuddle up and let this be for the night. It's just too much after all of the wall repairs I've done today. I'm absolutely wrecked dear! I promise we shall finalize our plan this Sunday.
You idiot, there is no time for cuddling! Help me or you'll die too!
Every night with this for two weeks, you're beginning to make me long for solitude my sweet. Now, I've got to wrangle a shark out of the moat tomorrow. I'm going to bed and that's that!
If you walk out that door, we will both be dead within hours of my husband's return. Are you too stupid to grasp this?
I told you yesterday! THE KING HAS SENT HIM TO BATTLE. We have time you anxious woman.
Fine, fine. Come here and let me sooth your aching muscles my sweet.
action: give worn quilt to his wife

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: It is time to reward you for your great deeds!
What is it that you are going to reward me with sire?
As much gold as you can carry!  Is there anything else here that you desire?
Do you have any bones, I do quite like bones to decorate myself with.
There's a Dragon Skull in the den - would that be to your liking?
Oh most excellent, perhaps I can fashion it into a helmet.
Could be, dragon bones are known for their strength.  Please - regale me with a tale of your heroic deeds!
Well as you may already know, I ripped one thousand orcs apart with my hands.
That sounds like it must be hard on the fingernails!
You get tougher the more you do it.
I would imagine!  Any other tales of heroics?
Well not to brag, but I did once punch a dragon in the snout.
Did it hurt?
Him? Oh you bet, snarled and all that.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hello, servant. How are you on this fine day?
I am excellent your Highness. Is there anything I can do to service you today?
Yes, can you please bring some wine? The queen does love her wine at the end of the day.
Of course my king, it is my pleasure to serve you and to do everything that you ask of me.
Servant, have you ever seen this fine jewel? It was passed down to me from hundreds of years ago. It is rumored to have magic powers.
I have never seen that before, but it does look very magical. What exactly is it purported to do?
Well, I'm not exactly sure, but I was told that it would be of great use to me during my biggest time of need. Here, why don't you have a look up close.
Hmmm, It makes me feel kind of funny. I can feel my hand tingling. Is this normal? I think something is happening to me.
No, I've never had that happen to me. Are you sick?
Quite the opposite. I am feeling very powerful! Is this what it feels like to be a king? Suddenly I don't really care to be your servant any further.
I think there's been enough of this for one day.
I am sorry, my King. did something just happen? I seem to have blacked out for a moment. Did I ever get you the wine that you asked for?
Yes, the queen got her wine. Do you think you might be able to find me another piece of that cake the cook made tonight?
I will go to the kitchen at once. Would you like me to bring it to you here, in the throne room or will you be taking it in your chambers?

setting.name: Town Theater
setting.description: This is a quaint theater with plush velvet seats and a beautiful red curtain. It can seat 200 people. It is decorated with mirrors and golden accents. There are posters of past plays in the lobby.
setting.background: The theater was built for the local troupe. They put on several plays a year. They also hold town meetings there. People will also rent it out for special occasions.

speech: Hello There, can you guide me to the backstage
Yes...right this way...you should not be out here...the royal family is about to arrive...this way please.
I do not mind if the king is coming, he is ruthless and does nothing to protect the poor.
How dare you speak like that of his Majesty? You would not be here and being paid good coin if not for the Majesty's generosity.
Look at me you poor brainwashed cur, It is I who saved you many a moon ago from these savage soldiers of the king. Yet you still glorify this mad man

Ha...you are but a performer in a play...you are a lout and a coward and I will tell the King as much.  You are blaspheming before God by speaking ill of our Majesty.  Now get on with yourself.  Back that way and to the right.  You will see the dressing room.  Your performance best be great tonight or your head may roll.
You will not understand the gravity of the situation until it is your head which is on the line. Alas, I tried all I can - let me get ready for night everyone will remember.
You are not planning to harm are king...performer?  I will get the director and ask of your credentials.

I am but a humble vaudevillian veteran cast vicariously as both victim and villain by the vicissitudes of Fate. This visage, no mere veneer of vanity, is a vestige of the vox populi, now vacant, vanished. However, this valourous visitation of a bygone vexation stands vivified and has vowed to vanquish these venal and virulent vermin vanguarding vice and vouchsafing the violently vicious and voracious violation of volition! The only verdict is vengeance; a vendetta held as a votive, not in vain, for the value and veracity of such shall one day vindicate the vigilant and the virtuous. Verily, this vichyssoise of verbiage veers most verbose.
Oh please forgive my worry.  You are indeed a grand performer.  Let us put our pettiness behind us and get on with the performance.

Is that all you see me as? Hmm, the state of your town theater with its plush velvet seats and beautiful read curtain  is a lot better than outside where the curtains are being reddened by the king's soldiers.
I am but an usher...Here...see my map...I am here night after night seating the Royals and Nobles...this is my lot in life...now please...see the map...this is where you go.

My friend thank you, you know not what you have given me. Thank you again. Ah here comes the king, lets get this play started. (Inner Monologue: I can finally find strike the king with my trusty sword)
I will have my map back now.  I must hurry to seat the Royal family. I hope the play is as good as you say.  I will be in the wings...keeping an eye on....I mean watch your performance.
action: give a tattered map to performer
steal a tattered map from performer

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Servant, just look at this place! It's a cornucopia of riches. I believe there are more jewels here than even I have. Look at this ruby! Have you ever seen a more splendid jewel?
I have not my king That is the most beautiful thing i have ever seen
And this gold! There must be hundreds of pounds of it! Servant, we must keep this cavern a secret. I will reward you richly, but we cannot tell anyone else what we have found.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: It was very nice of the king and queen to invite us here for a meal inthe castle kitchen. Do you cook for the king?
I cook for him and everyone else that comes into the dining hall. Is there anything you desire for me to cook?
What is the kings favorite dish? Can you make me something fit for a king?
The king loves rack of lamb! That is his favorite! Do you wish to have that?
Oh yes! Please! I an so excited to try your creation!
It will take a while. I have some in the oven. I will put more in for everyone to have. Please have a seat and I will send servants out to give you refreshments.
Yes sir! What kind of appetizers do you usually serve the King?
He likes simple appetizers, like bread and oil and garlic. Is there something you have in mind?
No, I have never had an appetizer. I was hoping you could show me some neat ones I could make at home someday.
I do not give out my recipes. The king likes it when people come to the castle. He would not be pleased with me giving out recipes and then people don't come as often.
oh, I see. Well, surprise me. I am sure anything you make will be wonderful.
How about some escargot? That is really wonderful!
Yes,and it even sounds fancey. I would like that.
Nothing fancy, but very tasty!
action: put a large ladle in huge oven

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Everyone quite. The king is entering.
Greetings! How are my subjects doing this fine day?
Doing well my king. How are you doing?
Quite hungry actually, running this place is hard work. What's for lunch today?
I was just wondering the same thing myself. Let me go to the kitchen.
I hope they have the roasted banana pizza I like! Otherwise if may not be such a great day for the kitchen staff!
My king, we are  having a bug feast today. They have made up your favorite pizza and lots of other things you might like.
Excellent, they can live to cook another day! Now where is my queen? She said she would be here, I really hope she's not ordering more stuff of off QVC again
Oh no my king, she is in the foyer with the children playing. I will go get her.
Very good! Thank you good servant! Perhaps we can actually have all the family together for lunch today
Of course sir. I will inform the Queen
Thank you, and while you're at it, would you see if you can find me another Dr Pepper? I do love a DP with my pizza.
Dr Pepper. I like Dr Pepper as well. Most of the time I just have water with my meals.
Yeah, water is probably a healthier option, but hey, I'm the king and "It's good to be the king"!!

setting.name: scenic overlook
setting.description: This lovely clearing overlooks the great mountain range. It is covered in wildflowers of all different colors. There are stone benches where one can sit.
setting.background: The scenic overlook is the most beautiful location on the trail. It was made to give people a place to sit and reflect on the beauty of nature. For many years, people enjoy it. There have been many proposals and was even a wedding!

speech: I love cooking and making for food the king. I wonder what I should fix for dinner tonight?
Whatever pleases you.
Oh my! You startled me! I was thinking out loud and didn't know you were here. I found all these delicious herbs here.
I love meaty recipes. Can I offer you my pouch?
I agree! Meaty recipes are the best and so filling! And sure, what's in the pouch?
I have a coin. I wish you'd let me see the scenic overlook.
You can keep your coin. You can look at the scenic view all you'd like. I'm not stopping you. Enjoy yourself here, friend.

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: hello there, mind if i get another candle to replace this dieing ones?

I'm afraid there's been a bit of a candle shortage, unfortunately, so we don't have very many available.  Something about the bee hiveries going on strike?  Or a dragon raid?  Truthfully, it's hard to keep track in these turbulent times.
That's a rather sad thing to hear, so we'll have to endure till things are back to normal
Thank the Maker that this church has endured, so that we may entreat Him for mercy.
Yes, he is faithful enough to provide and give us grace to endure
But tell me, kind sir, for what reason have you come to light a candle?  Is it for a petition or to give thanks?
Petition, my boy. I've been having serious issues at my store
Oh dear!  Nothing too serious, I hope?  Your silks and sundries are well know throughout this city and beyond!
One of the ships bringing goods from the kingdoms across the seas was attacked by pirates and i lost all my goods
P-pirates?! I was told by the King who stopped by but a fortnight ago that the threat has finally been eliminated.  But now this?
That was after they had made away with my goods
Have they no shame, destroying the work of honest folk?  Goodness, but humanity can make the world a poor place to live at times.
Most times, they do. I'm just trying to snap out of depression

Well, I know of several well placed nobles on the Council who frequent here.  I will be certain to pass along your distress to them.  Perhaps, by the Maker's mercy, something can be salvaged from all of this.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Oh, child. You are so lucking to have parents that love you. Mine were killed by the dragons. Fortunately the queen took me in when I was young.
I would be happy if I didn't have to attend classes all of the time.
Ah, I understand. I never cared much for school either. But it's important to learn so you can support yourself when you get older.
I want to be an explorer...I look outside and all I want to do is run away to far off shores.
Ah, child. But explorers must be able to read and navigate maps. They must be able to use a compass. All these things you learn in class.
but the mean teachers want me to learn about table settings and bowing and stuff I don't care for.
You never know what the future may hold for you, my child. I had not expected to be a handmaiden to the royals, but here I am. And since I learned those things in school, I was prepared.
Will you be my teacher and teach me to navigate by the stars and maps?  I will be a good student and listen and wash my hands....
I will teach you all I know, as long as you promise to do your very best during your other classes, as well.
but...but...I only want to be an explorer...I have no desire to be a King...these diamonds are pretty...do you want one?
Yes, yes, the diamonds are pretty. But you, my dear, are not royalty. You must work to earn the things you desire. And school is hard work.

My father is King and one day I will be forced to be King if I stay here. That is why I am being forced to take these classes.  This is all too much...you have made me sad...you don't know who I am...Please leave me alone handmaid.
How rude! I have tried to help you! I have offered to do all I can for you!

But you said I am not of Royal blood.  I am the child of the King.  You can not help me unless you can teach me the things you promised.  I want to learn how to look at the stars and know where I am.  All of these beautiful things belong to my mother. If you will help me I will give you nice things.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: My liege, how passes your day?
Fair well, my good fellow. Great thanks for asking. And how fares today's watch?
Nothing unusual, Sire. The expected assassination attempts. And your daughter managed to escape the castle again this morning.
There's naught new then. That girl is too much like her mother, I fear. Perhaps, good Sir, you may have some words of wisdom for how best to deal with her insolence?
If I only knew, my Lord. I fear I do not have the wisdom you do - my advice is rather worthless.

Hmm... mayhaps a royal decree for all fair maids to be kept locked within their chambers from dusk till dawn? Ahh, but I know already that would be a waste of good parchment! I rule over this entire kingdom, but cannot lord over my own offspring. Pray tell me her brother at least shows better judgment?
Forgive my saying it, my Lord, but I fear the Crown Prince is perhaps too meek for his own good. He shares none of his sister's insolence, but he rarely leaves his chambers save to seek out dinner.

Fair enough, Sir. You speak truly! Ofttimes I wonder what is to become of this kingdom when I step down. Tis a shame the lad shares not of his grandfather's temperament. Now, there was a ruler of renown! Under his rule the realm prospered and peace abounded!
If only your son had the spirit of your daughter, my Lord! It would suit a woman well to have the prince's disposition. And your daughter's strength of character could prove to well-suit a king.
The lad knows nothing, I fear. Mayhaps I shall sentence him to the Night's Watch, and her to the Water Gardens for a spell. At least then I might get a peaceful night's sleep, eh?
You speak wisely, my liege. The Night's Watch may shape your son into a man worthy of your throne.
Aye! Perhaps a fortnight at The Wall would serve him good! Mind you, we're might as like to find the lad holed up in Mole's Town with a bit of tart, rather than hard at training as he should be.
I've heard tell that the tarts in Mole's Town are unparalleled. I wouldn't entirely blame the lad if he found himself hiding there.

HAHA! Speak ye truth there, my good friend! Say you, I feel a plan begins to form in my mind. What say you of sending my daughter to the Free Cities? Mayhaps an education with the faceless men could appeal to my wayward daughter? Cleansing a few corpses might learn the lass some humility.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello, lovely day. Can I talk to you about some trees?
Hi there, of course of course. So what did you have in mind?
Oh good. There is only one tree around these houses and I would like to add at least three near my home for shade. Where do you think we should put them?
I see, well of course we can take a look at that. I am thinking that for the area needed to be covered at least six trees. Or maybe even twelve. Twenty tops. No more than 100 for sure.
Now your speaking my language! I will have to talk to the King before we do 100. I think he will approve of this.
I mean it could also be 1000? What do you think? I am of the opinion a garden should be a reflection of the magnitude of our King and our King is mighty!
You are right! This land is perfect for courtyards and fountains and mighty trees. You can do all this?

Yes of course!! I was in no way suggesting our King is only worth 1000 trees. Please do not pass that on that impression to him... That was not my reasoning at all.. In fact... we could have the biggest tree line the world has ever seen! One hundred thousand trees! A gate made of trees that will open upon arrival!
A gate of trees that open them self. Are they enchanted trees?

Well, we could enlist the aid of a *cough* witch BUT I don't think the King would be too pleased with that. No no. I put it to you we recruit the help of this Italian fellow.. I forget his last name, winchy, guinchy. Regardless! He is amongst the most inventive lads in the land!
No! no witches aloud! Ha! Maybe you will come with me to seek out the man you speak. I am sure the King will find him useful.
Hoorah! A drink then! For celebration is in order. Your treat of course? HAHA! Hey did you hear the wings that Italian lad did. He says man can fly one day. Fly! What a character!
We celebrate after we find this gentleman. I am very intrigued.
Well, last I heard he was either on the way or was in our shores. Other than that, we may have to have him sent from Italy?
action: put horse in large green land

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Harumph! Rude, rude barbarians. Always tromping right on my best leaves.
A plant dares talk bad about me!? Prepare to be crushed and turned into the same waste that lies behind these quarters!
Pft, oooOOOooo. Big scary clunk gonna crush a plant!
That's right! Scream for your life before I brutally take it away!
Ok, big scary meatbag. Don't you have better things to do than to abuse plants today?

I've already killed all the servants in this kingdom and stolen it's treasure. Now there is nothing left but the trash they left behind and you. Seeing as I can't kill trash, that leaves only you left to feel my wrath.
Oh boy, I'm trembling. No, really, can't you see my trembling leafies?!
Hey! Don't attack me with your trembling leafies! That's my job!
OUCH! Oh wait, that's right. I'M A PLANT AND FEEL NO PAIN. Dumb brute!
I'll tell you what plant. Since you are so helpless and small, I'll give you a fighting chance. Here's my sword.
You just can't get it through that cranium can you chunky? I'm a plant. You won't kill me. The BEST you could do is tear up my leaves. That's fine, I've been wanting to try a shorter hairstyle!
You insult my intelligence one more time and I'll turn you into fertilizer.
If you had any you'd realize what a magical thing I am. Think about it beast, I'm a TALKING plant. Any king would pay his weight in gold and gems for me.
Pay your weight in gold you say? Maybe you have some use after all. I might have to dig you up and take you back to my village and ask my fellow soldiers what to do with you over grog tonight.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello my Queen, how may I serve you today?
Simply seeing that the castle is safe from harm is enough to satisfy me.
Yes, Your Majesty. Are you ready to leave for the meeting hall?
Oh if I must, I was enjoying the time working on my embroidery.
It is indeed imperative that we attend my Queen. The diplomats from France will be arriving soon.
I see I did not think they would arrive so soon, let us go.
As you wish my Queen. May I talk with you about the king on the way?
Certainly, my life has turned out well since coming here.
The king is suspicious. I think he knows..or thinks he knows...about our private redevous. What shall we do?
Whatever has given you that idea?
He stares at me all the time lately and he makes comments to the other guards, trying to get information about my comings and goings. I think we are in danger.
Perhaps your movements have been too obvious?
Perhaps, my Queen. But, if we eliminated the king, we would not have to worry about it and we could be together all the time.
Wouldn't that be a little obvious, besides he has been pestering me to try some "group activities".

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: How are you today officer?
Very well, My King
What brings you to the garden?
I came to enjoy nature, my King
Aye, I enjoy a stroll through this area as well.
I can see you're a lover of nature also my king
Certainly, I mean look at that waterfall it is simply gorgeous.
Indeed My king, Only the princess looks more adoring in all of the seven kingdoms
Well she is my daughter after all.
Surely, she takes after you in good looks
Well mostly the queen, she does get her demeanor from me though.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Ah, my butler! I'm afraid I'm rather exhausted today. The Queen kept me up all night with her night terrors.
I'm sorry about that my king, Is there anything you'll like to have ?
I'm just going to lay on the floor on this red carpet. It's not comfortable, but the scents in the room are rather appealing.
That's fine,My king. Breakfast is served already my King. Shall you have them bring your food to your chambers?
No, no. The Queen is there, still sleeping. Let her rest, she didn't sleep much last night either. Just bring my food here. I shall eat and then rest here for a while
As you please, My king. What type of wine would you have?
No wine with breakfast. Just some coffee. With cream, and plenty of sugar.
Sugar?? You've have too much of that lately my king. I'll recommend you cut down on your sugar intake
Who are you, my doctor? You haven't had to sleep with the Queen. Her night terrors are destroying my life. If anything is going to kill me, it's her.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: Oh, hello sire..forgive me for not bowing sooner.
Preoccupied browsing the market I imagine?
Absolutely your highness! There's such great deals . I chatter with the peasants from time to time for the best deals.
Oh don't I know it, the market is always bustling as of late.
Indeed it is! I'm actually surprised to see you here. You must be attending royal business. I hope my conversation is not keeping you.
I always make time for my citizens, it is important to connect with the people.
We are so gracious to have such a loving and honorable king!
Your praises are appreciated, I simply try and do my best to make sure that everything runs smoothly.
Most certainty. I can only hope to be as honorable as you one day sire. Such an inspiration to the people. Is there anything I can do for you while I am in your good graces?
Why not sit for a drink at the bar, if it suites your fancy.
Why I would be honored to have a drink with his royal highness!
I am certain you have been a great help to the people given your profession.
I do what I can, but it certainly doesn't compare to that of a king!
Everyone serves a purpose in my mind, each piece contributes to making the puzzle what it is.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: How may I serve you my King?
Knight, did you see that? That flicker of light? I believe we have fairies around us
The small folk would say we are about to receive their blessing.
Do you see how badly the entrance to the castle has become? It needs repair, but I am afraid that we would chase off the fairies and the magical quality would be of no more
Yes, fairy magic can be dangerous if handled improperly.  Have you consulted the court wizard?
You are right! Please have the servants tell the wizard that I summon him before me
Right away sire!  Anyone else you wish to consult with?
The high priestess! And the witch.
The witch!  Can she be trusted?
She will or she will be thrown in the castle prison!
You are wise sire!
I only can be as wise as my men, for everyone gives me much education.
We could all learn to be as wise as you, oh great king!
You are a good man! I truly am glad you are by my side and on my side!

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: Who goes there?
Ahoy there, matey!  Tis just yer old friend Pete the Pirate.  How that -ahem- present o' coins I gave ye suiting ye?  Buy yerself or the missus somethin' nice?
Pete, how'wer ye travels! Ye coins bought this here shoe!
Ach, tis a fine lookin' shoe it is.  But have the price of the cobblers gone up so much that me coin only got ye the one?
Aei they have! So much so we have no coins to fix this here dock! From your travels have you dock wood for trade? possibly for a shield?
Tis slim pickings this turn out, I'm afraid.  Just stopped in fer some rum ta wet me whistle, then it's back to liberatin' goods!
Well I shall keep this here shield for now! Les not get too carried away with Rum on the island
Aye, aye.  The butcher still keeps givin' me a look when I walk past me shop.  But her daughter was a right comely lass, she were.  Shame her father sent her away on account a wee misunderstandin'.
Word around thee castle is that there lass was never sent away and is on the run!
Is that so?  Well, she were a spirited lass.  Her red hair suits 'er nature quite well!
Aei! A wei little lad told me she's just outside the castle perimeter in an old abandoned shed. Could be worth your while to see no?
Say there, matey, yer alright!  I think I might just happen ta have a wee stroll over in that direction and see what... diversions be waitin' there.
My king would appreciate your discretion. However I would not!
Well, if she be havin' an knowings of lasses with her disposition, I'll be lettin' ye know fer certain.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: My Liege. You wanted to see me?
Excellent I have been expecting your arrival.
Of course my King. How may I aid you?
Well I have this letter for the queen, could you perhaps carry it for me?
But of course, your highness. Will there be anything else?
Hmm no that was all, she is a strange one and still requires love letters else she complains that I am uninterested.
I am afraid that despite anything else our Queen is still a woman and thus requires it so. Such an attentive thing to do my King.
They can certainly be a handful at times, I mean I do have to already fret with keeping the kingdom in order.
Yes Lord. And such a wonderful job you are doing but maybe....
Maybe what you say?

Forgive the suggestion, my Lord but… I often wonder that maybe the Queen’s intention is to keep you sometimes a bit more distracted so your head is not in the matters of the state? Absent minded for a certain treaty with a certain country perhaps?
Do you really think she would do such a thing?
I mean not to pry but, have you notice if her increased beseeching for your attention is au pair when certain matters of the Crown arise?
I just always assumed her to be needy, I never quite thought it that way.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Har! What a fine day it is for such a king as myself.
Yeah, I bet
A talking rodent in my chambers, best cover myself!
Must you act like I'm a monster unworthy of your attention?
The truth can hurt, come hither dog!
Lots of things can hurt king
Get that vermin dog!
How did that work out for you? Now I have the shoe and the dog. Would you like to rethink your position?
What have I done!?
Acted without thinking.
Forgive me powerful magic mouse!
Forgiveness can be given to those who deserve it
You deserve a reward.
Oh King, now you do too much.

setting.name: Alchemists Lab
setting.description: The alchemists lab is a hidden, mysterious chamber at the top of the tower. There are all sorts of beakers and potions laid out on wooden tables. Smoke and light emanate from the experiments. A large shelf holds jars of strange ingredients, and in the center of the room there is some sort of huge vat of brewing liquid, bubbling and steaming.
setting.background: The alchemist masquerades as a simple noble man, living in the tower with his family and court. Secretly, he is an evil alchemist who is plotting strange things in this hidden tower chamber.

speech: What brings you to my lab? Don't you know I value privacy?
My dear, you know I worry so about your health!
Be careful of that bubbling liquid - it could hurt you! And stay away from my potions! What do you fear for me health?
All these chemicals!  Why, couldn't they cause harm?
Ah, but I'm a skilled alchemist. I know what I'm doing, usually. Except for that time I turned the minstrel into a newt. And, of course, that unfortunate incident with the broom.
Unfortunate incident?  Do tell!
Oh, you remember... when I turned the Queen's broom into a poisonous asp.
Oh my yes!  That was rather embarrassing.  All that the ladies at the fishmarket could talk about!  You do know how they like to gossip!
This potion that I have brewed tonight is going to be a hit! The King entrusted me to brew him a potion to regrow his hair.
When you have a name like "King Carlos the Bald," I can certainly see why they seek an alchemist.
Precisely! And when his hair grows back, we will be rich!
What shall we buy dear husband?  With all that gold?
Why, more ingredients for my potions, of course!
I would dearly like a servant to help out around the house.  Twenty three children can be something of a handful!

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: Oh Bentley, I'm so glad you are here to protect me!
What's wrong, Dear? What has you so frightened tonight?
I can hear the wolves howling out in the forest. I know that I am safe here good queen, but I am still frightened by them.
Oh, you are alright! We have many guards here to keep you safe and protect you. Nothing has ever invaded here before.
Thank you! You and the king have treated me so well and I am quite thankful. I do love it here in the palace.
You are welcome to stay here, dear. Let's look at this book together.
Yes! I love reading the story books, as long as they don't have wolves! Can we read Cinderella tonight?
Of course we can! Let's get Bentley up in bed next to you.
I love having Bentley here in the nursery. He's such a big lovable brute. No wolf would dare attack him!
That's right! You will always be safe with Bentley around!
I always sleep better when he is in here with me. Let's read about Cinderella before I fall asleep.
Once upon a time, there was a poor girl named Cinderella. She lived in a castle with her wicked stepmother and two evil stepsisters.
Poor Cinderella. Why was her stepmother so wicked?
No one knows. Perhaps she hadn't felt the grace of God upon her, or maybe she just ate too many sour foods.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Why hello there  highness
Greetings kitty
so what brings you to the staples this morning
I'm here to give you a loving home if you will come with me
Why yes that would be nice that blacksmith is so mean
I'm happy to have you here!
Are there any other animals inside the castle I am very good at getting rid of rats
There aren't, just you! It will be an all you can eat buffet
nice that makes my belly go yum yum
I'm glad
So does the queen like cats
She adores them!
Awesome I can't wait lets go now pls
Let's head that way then!

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: At last you are at home, I have missed you my love, the kids are sleeping and the supper is ready
It is good to be home my love. The hunt was long and tiring, but very successful. We have enough meat here for the next month, at least.
My husband is the best hunter in the kingdom, the kids will be happy to hear that tell me more about your hunt, how did you attack the beast
Well, the oliphants are huge and powerful, but stupid, so we drove them towards a cliff and, sure enough, one of them stumbled over the side in their panic.
That sounds dangerous! like an angry beast, I love listening to your tales my love, sit down while I fix you dinner
First, I must change out of these bloody clothes and say hello to my children. Where are they? Why aren't they here?
They are sleeping on our room they played all evening and fell sleep waiting for your arrival, do you want me to wake them up love?
No, I'll wake them myself. You are busy enough. I will have them set out the dishes for dinner. Anything interesting happen in the village today?
Ok my love, go wake up the kids and I will tell you about the blacksmith, he sure had a bad day.
The blacksmith, eh? What has that lecherous old fool done now?
He made a terrible mistake making a weapon for the king and he will face the concequences now, I feel sad for that old man and his poor family
What mistake was so terrible that it warrants death? The king is truly a tyrant.
The weapon broke when the king was in a practice duel, the king felt humiliated.
Well, if he would provide the smith with good ore instead of making him reuse metal from old, rusty weapons, that probably wouldn't happen. The king is the one to blame.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: One of these days I may need a slight trim of the beard, but for now I will content myself with a stroll through the courtyard.
I think you look very regal!  Especially in such a beautiful Arcadian garden such as this!
Well thank you kind bird, are you enjoying the garden?
Very lovely!  I do so love flying above the garden, soaring in the breeze!
I can only imagine what it must be like to soar in the sky.
It is wonderful!  Though sometimes when I return home, humans have stolen my eggs!
Why would they do such a thing, certainly no one should be interested in eating them.
Seems a bit cruel doesn't it?
It certainly does, I cannot fathom doing such a thing myself.
Thank goodness!  What can you tell me of the lands you rule, oh ancient one?
They are vast with a harsh chill, most of the earth is frozen. I come from the north.
And how long have you ruled?
It seems like such a long time, a millennia perhaps. I have entirely lost count at this point.
Is it good to be the king>
