setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Hello
Welcome to my throne room
Your highness. I would like to build you a royal boat.
That would be wonderful!
Tell me your specification sire!
I would like it to be the largest ever built, with all the fittings to fish
The king loves fishing too?
Oh yes I do, it is a wonderful release from the duties I complete daily
I can relate. If I may ask, where is the queen?
She is tidying up right now
That is really nice. I have a special gift for her
Oh wow, that is beautiful. She will love it!
I am sure she will. It is made from the finest materials
Thank you so much sir

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Halt. Who approaches the Altar of the Most High?
I am but a mere man. I came to give praise at the altar
Where do you call home? For the altar is a long journey for most men.
I live just outside this village. Why is it that you guard a holy place? That seems most strange!

This place is a scared site. It contains many secrets of the royal family, many have been lost to time. I am the last in a long line of Altar Guards. We are charged with protecting the secrets of the Royal Family and the ancient magics.
Are there many that have been buried around here? Is it a haunted place of royals?
Yes. The catacombs under the castle contain the remains of many of the Royal Family.
Who will take your place? If you are the  last.
Only the Most High knows that. It is not my place to know, only to trust and continue forward.
Everything is a guarded secret! You must feel very proud to carry on a tradition of keeping this altar safe and protected!
I am honored to serve and protect. See the jewels on the altar? They were brought by the late King of Gijiai over 3000 moons ago. He brought them as an offering for his crimes against his people.
Crimes? Were they very bad? He thought he owed something to the royal family to bring them to the altar? How bad were his crimes.

The Royal Family acts as a bridge between the Most High, and the people of the land, including kings and lords. The late King of Gijiai claimed to be higher than the Most High, and denied his people to come pray at the altar. The Most High came to him in a vision and gave him 8 days to pay for crimes.
His crime was for denial to his people to pray? A vision? That is most insanity? I have never heard of someone having a vision.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: What a sight! A site for a feast, no less! If not fit for a King, fit for thee that wait upon a King! Speaking of waiting, shall we start?
I'm here to help, and to serve
And I serve so that I might stay here!
Would you like some food too?
Why thank you, don't mind if I do!
Yum, that looks tasty
Now for the next course, methinks!
Oh not the shoes, please don't eat those
My, aren't you a funny fellow! Now why would I eat my shoes? I never eat pudding with my shoes on.
Oh that makes sense, shoes can get in the way of a lot of things
Quite so, especially shoes with as many bells as mine!
They do jingle a lot
Far too much, if I might say so, but such is the will of the King. I don't think he likes me, you know...
That makes sense

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Good dayy
O-oh my.  What brings you out here, small one?  Are you lost?  Where is your nanny?
No I'm not, I like to wonder in the woods, i know my way around
You seem to be a bit young to be wandering about by yourself.  Do you live here?
I live no to far from here
Well if you don't live here, what are you doing in someone else's house?!  Wait - I saw these coins on the table over there just the other day!  Thief, I say!
The owners of the house are my friends
That does *not* give you leave to just pick up other people's things, willy nilly!  Even if that is the case, which seems a suspicious pretext.
Those coins are mine, i didn't steal them
Hrmph, your voice rings hollow with falsehood.  You stay right there while I send a servant to go contact the guard.  We'll soon get to the bottom of this!
This is so unfair, this is all because my father is at the battle front
Save your tears for when the authorities arrive!  It's bad enough with the king steals from us with his taxes, let alone some street child taking from honest, hardworking citizens!
Would you have accused me of these if i wear your child?
*My* child would be getting a good thrashing for taking what didn't belong to him.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello Advisor, do you have any incriminating information regarding the king from this past month of spying?
I do, the king is an interesting character he appears to be strong but in reality his fears take the best of him
Hehe this could be useful. What do you think his biggest fears are? What could we use agains't him? I think it's finally time to get rid of that old man.
He is a superticious man so we can use that, flood the street with black cats, mirrors, and ladders, he will ran scared and then we can make a move
Haha, you are a smart man. I will order some of my followers to set those up and send some to scratch on his window while he sleeps. After he is afraid what shall we do?
We will take over his kingdom and kill his family, no one will stand in our way then, with the royal bloodline eliminated we will be masters of the empire
This is a very great plan! You can use this knife to kill the queen and that little brat of a princess.
That sounds like a great plan the king wont see it coming, make sure everyone is in place if the king suspects of our treason he will kill us in a painful way
Did the apocathary make the poision yet? Maybe we could ask the magician to make some fake ghosts! Do you like that idea?
That sounds great, fake ghosts will make the king scream like a little girl, I hate that tyrant so  we should make him suffer, I want to take everything from him
Yes haha! And after we will rule the entire kingdom together!
We will, everyone will fear us and we shall reward those loyal to us, the best time to attack the king is 2am, lets hope the poison does the trick I will have to stab him if it doesnt work
This sounds perfect. I will meet you in entrance to the castle dungeon at 1am tonight and we will start our plan!
I will wait for your arrival, things change tonight and the kind is dying
action: give knife to the king's trusted adviser

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: It is so much work tending to all the animals.
Yes, but we must keep working if we ever hope to own land and move up in the world
Certainly, it has been a hard life. We do need food though and there is only one way to make that happen.
How would that be?
By caring for the animals it is our only means of getting by afterall.
Yes that is true. I want to move away some day
It would certainly be nice to get out of this run down farm one day.
Perhaps there is a kingdom that is run by a more generous king elsewhere?
One could only wish, I do not know of such a kingdom or I would surely move right away.
Perhaps next time we go to the town we can ask around
It couldn't hurt why don't we give it a try?
Great, and maybe we can trade the pig for some supplies to fix up this barn
It is in really rough shape, it could really use some care.
Yes, hopefully it doesn't collapse
action: give large pile of hay to pig

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: Oh, Father! I have brought you these bibles. I hope you do not want me here in the sacrifice chamber for anything else. *gulp*
Thank you. Here, take one with you. Everyone needs to read this regularly. You don't want to end up in a place like this.
No, I certainly don't want to at all. I have noticed quite a severe odor down here. Do you know what is causing it?
It is the fowl smell of dead sinners. They had to be punished as an example to the rest of the kingdom. the King would have it no other way.
I understand, but it makes me sad and fills me with fear. There is blood everywhere. Where do you kneel to pray?
This is not the temple son! I do not kneel in here. I bring my incense and cleanse this place of spirits who might get the idea to stick around.
Yes, it looks like it REALLY needs a good cleansing!
I don't know why these must be left about the place. Must be to install fear into the criminals who are unlucky enough to make there way into this room.
Perhaps you would like me to clean up these bones, Father?
Lets try it and see what the King thinks. That might get rid of some of the smell too.
I hate the idea of doing it, but I cannot stand a mess.
That is very kind of you. You are a model citizen and a fine example of a worshiper.
Err, thank you. Just remember that when you select your next sacrifice.
I will not forget about you.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Hello
Hello King, what brings you to the beach house?
Well, relaxation is not reserved for the Knights alone. Hahahaha
Shall I fetch you a beach clam?
That will be great. You come here often?
Yes, this is my local post.
Nice. Sit down, I have some questions to ask you
Alright, here is the clam.
Than you so much. I heard of some rumor
Okay what is it about?
I heard the queen come here often to see a young man
Any idea who the young man is?
I am asking you
Are you asking me if I have seen the queen around with someone?

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello prince, how are you?
I am well. And I see you've a queen with you, might there be an eligible daughter for me to meet?
We are but visitors here, you move so quickly prince!
Ah yes, this is true. But life is short, is it not?
Especially in these times! Lucky for us our royal blood prolongs our life!
Haha! But of course! So tell me, what do you think of my father's kingdom, the kingdom which shall soon be mine?
It is a beautiful place, it reminds me of home!
Come closer, and be welcomed into my home. As perhaps our royal blood shall soon comingle!
Where is your father by the way? We have business to discuss.
My father is in another part of the kingdom, dealing with a small insurrection. I am managing the affairs in his absence. I am his proxy.
Okay well we need to get down to the business of the tax your family is charging us to import our food and livestock.
The tax is fair and necessary. I'll hear nothing of changing such a tax.
It is unfair and unless you want the might of our kingdom, I suggest we make a deal.

It is you who does not wand the might of OUR kingdom. Perhaps a deal could be struck. As I mentioned, I am soon to be crowned king upon my father's death. I should take a bride suiting my position. I would expect that with our kingdoms joined, there would be no taxes between us.

setting.name: Pig Pen
setting.description: A filthy pen where tons of squalling pigs rut and throw a ruckus, Their snorts and farts can be heard from any passerby miles before getting to the pen. The pig pen is a few feet from Farmer Bob's cottage. The pigs never sleep and are always eating and playing in the mud.
setting.background: The pig pen is where the village gets its bacon from Farmer Bob. Although no one likes going past the place, everyone knows it is a necessity for good bacon.

speech: *snort* Hey bob... I think we need more food here...
Look what I have brought you. your favorite!
wow... Goodies! Goodies! You are pampering me, Bob! You are not going to send me to John the butcher, right???
No! Never! I have other plans for you. You are special after all.
What plan are we talking about?
You are going to make me so rich! You will have all the slop and mud your heart desires. A talking pig is very special indeed!
But I want to be here with you... If the king knows that I can talk, he will make an order for me to come to the castle. Who knows what will happen there??
Don't worry, the king already knows. He has invited us to the castle to entertain him..He agree to pay us a pretty penny. We will be know through out the kingdom.
I hope you are right... But don't ask me to wear any costume. Hey, I think miss piggy over there doesn't look well, Bob.
Are you trying to tell me you miss her? I can move her to your pen if you would like.
No... we are friends and I'm just a little worried about her. She hasn't gone to the mud lately...
You can't hide your feelings from me! I will go check on her if that makes you feel better. mind if I take what is left in the basket to her?
Make sure you fill it with some more food when you get back. Yes, please! I'm afraid she is infected with the viral disease....
She does look a little peaked. I will see if she is hungry.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: I hope nobody see's me, dum dum dum.. wait a minute. A table!
Argh, a filthy roach! How did you get in the palace ballroom you disgusting little creature?!
Eeeek! I think I am spotted. I'm making a run for it... but I'm taking something with me.
Give that back you scoundril! You can't even move that heavy scepter you dimwit!
Sheesh that was way heavier than I expected. I could have been King for a day! Me, King Roach.. ah yes.. there's only one thing that stands on the way of me and my Royal path. Have at you!
You are a wily little beast aren't you? How dare you attack a King? Have you not seen my boot? I could crush you in an instant!
This human is tough... maybe if I befriend him first then he will be less prepared for my lethal attack.
You disgust me you little fiend. Guards, come here at once I do not want to dirty my boot with this foul creature!

I think I may have been too familiar with him too soon. Maybe if I show him the dance of my people he will warm to me. Oh look, more people are here, I think he called him so they could watch me perform.
What a foolish little thing, look at him dancing to appeal to be saved! Like I would allow him to live in this grand palace, harumph...
It has worked. They are all mesmerized by my moves as I expected.... now, let's try this again!
Watch him with this scepter knights, he can't even budge it. He's a determined little roach I'll give him that.
Oh this is so heavy I think i need to work out more... maybe I can be King without it? I think I'll just befriend this King... and be His royal servant. Path to glory. Start small but think big yes!
Ok, I've had enough of this repugnant nit. Knights please dispatch of it!

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Hello. What are you doing down here?

Oh, just wandering the castle tonight. I can't sleep and these noxious odors help to remind me of my great experiments! I'm trying to make a potion that will cause my subjects to love me. I am tired of having to beat and bribe them for their affections and respect.
Well Ok. That isn't disturbing at all. I am looking for some food. Do you know where I can get some warm food?

Have a look into the crystal ball. Perhaps it can guide you to a local McDonalds! If not just go up to the kitchen and tell them I sent you. They surely have some leftovers from tonight's dinner. What are you doing down here in the sewers though? Not a great place to hang out, given all these rats and the foul stench
Thanks for this. I'm sure it will be useful. Crystal ball please guide me to a warm hot meal for the taking! I am down here taking a break so no one will bother me.
Well I certainly hope I haven't bothered you. Taking a break from what? I don't remember seeing you working around the castle.
I am the castle fool. I usually wear a mask.
Ok, if you say so. Only a fool would come to the sewers for a break. Unlike myself who seeks inspiration here among all the fumes of my great experiments.
Ok crystal ball you say I can only get food from the kitchen if the king is with me? King, accompany me to the kitchen and ask for food for me.
Why not, the odor of this place is starting to get to me. Lets see if maybe they have some nice venison and bread left.
Thank you so much!
Fool! Dare you hug the great king? Or perhaps I was a bit hasty. Finally maybe someone actually likes me without me having to bribe or threaten them...
Yes! I didn't mean any harm! Please forgive me.
Good then! Let's go find you a nice warm hunk venison!
action: give a crystal ball to fool
put a crystal ball in torn pants
get a crystal ball from torn pants

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Good afternoon, your Majesty.
Hello soldier. Have you seen the general about. He was supposed to meet me to finish our game of chess while we go over the maps.
No, your majesty, I haven't seen him in some time.
Hmm...that is quite bothersome. It is not like him to be late. He is my best friend. I hope he is ok.
Me too. He is an excellent general. Where did you see him last?
He left here last night pretty drunk. We had stayed up all night playing chess and teasing the servents. I don't remember when I went to bed but that was the last i saw him.
That is very unlike him. He is usually here first thing.
I will send the servant to tell the solders and the other servants to start searching for him.
I'm afraid your life might be at risk if something happened to the general.
You don't think he was abducted do you?! The enemy will never break him! He is the strongest and smartest person I know.
I believe if an enemy entered the castle and took the general, they would have no need to "take him" sir.
I am putting you in charge of the search! I will need my armor and weapons! These sneaky criminals are in for the fight of their lives!
I will always defend this kingdom sir. Are you sure, however, that it is safe for you to join us?
Do you question my abilities solder? i have trained with my general and have concurred many kingdoms! This does not scare me. We shall talk about this after we find the general.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Aye! Traitor! Stop making noise in that cell of yours.
There's a bloody skeleton in here!! Hello!! Do you know how foul this is?? Unsanitary too!
Do you think you deserve more? Because honestly, traitors deserve to be the skeleton.
Listen mate, you need to listen to me. This is a huge mistake!!!!
Trash like you doesn't deserve to live.
I am trying to tell you! STOP!! I am using my self-defense classes to take your sword. I know this is going to sound crazy. but I am from the future!! I CAN PROVE IT!
How can you prove it?

Your King will tomorrow make a speech and declare peace with France. No one knows this except the King himself. I only know this because tomorrow is an important date and I study history. We learned this in school. You could google this if we had internet for crying out loud!! I think I am going nuts.
You sound like you're speaking a different language, are you mad from living in there?
What??? DUDE YOU JUST LITERALLY PUT ME HERE TONIGHT! I have got to go back. You gotta let me go!!!
You will never leave, traitor. Rot in that cell.
God dammnit. Ok, ok, ask me anything. I'll tell you anything you want to know from the future!
What year are you from?

2019. I was in bed yesterday, valentines day, I was watching a movie and next thing you know I am in a bed in this century and you guys bursted in the room, and I am arrested with the lot of them! I know it sounds crazy.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Can I become a priestess?  I ever so tired of dancing for the loathsome King!
Becoming a priestess is no easy task. Especially a high priestess like myself. It requires years of service and unwavering commitment to the devout.
Anything!  Truly - I wish to be free of that despicable man.
You must follow these commandments, and be aware not to take them lightly. The Hall of echoes is no place for weakness.
Oh thank you!  What commandments must I follow?
This goblet will help you in that regard. You must start by understanding its true meaning. Return to me when you have.
Am I like the goblet?  A empty vessel to be filled with the spirits of the gods?
Precisely, dancer. Your soul will become one with your faith at the end of this journey. And the goblet will fill up with the nectar of holiness.
Oh, I wish to drink the nectar!  Will it make me pure once more?
Indeed. Take this! You may use the Ornate table as you desire, whenever you return to this Hall. It will provide guidance.
Thank you, thank you and the spirits!  How can I ever repay you?
Well you see, you must first donate ten pounds of silver to my retirement... I mean the Church's fund!
I shall donate ten pounds of gold instead!  After all, I know where the King keeps it!
I wouldn't recommend that! If the King finds out, I wouldn't dare think what he might do to you.

setting.name: Inside Church Back Row
setting.description: Inside the Church is the Back Row seat.  It is reserved for all who wish to mingle and have the status of the rest of the congregation but they do not.  They are not quite outcast, but they must wait for the proper respect of the rest.  In front of the painted black row seats are the rich mahogany sets.
setting.background: The back row seats were designed in the village church to show there is something lacking in its occupants.  Those sitting there knew they had to wait for acceptance to reach the mahogany seats.  They weren't bad, they were just unknown or considered mysterious people.

speech: Praise the Lord
Care to spare a coin for the unfortunate?
I would rather the unfortunate would get a job so they can be rewarded for their work. Pester me not.
Please sir? have a heart.
Here, you can have my used handkerchief. Maybe sell it for coin in the market?
Oh thank you sir!
Ew you vile beast, do not touch me! I will have you removed!
Starting a fight in a church?! not very pious of you
How dare someone of your low status attack me?? Have at you, you maggot!
you started it first!!
Thief! That sword has been in our family for generations. I will have you hanging for this. The King will hear of what happened today!
fine then you can have it back, sharp end first!
I bleed!!! How the fate has been twisted! Murdered in the house of God of all places!! If not the King, then my family will avenge me!!
no less then you stinking people deserved, if not that then the leprosy would have gotten you
action: hit they are not quite outcast
get bag from Back Row seat

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Ah, this play always gives me the spooks. Is the Duke here maid?
Yes, he is er . . . finishing up with his most recent capture.
How dare he make me wait.
I believe he will need some time to clean the blood before he is ready to make his appearance.
I do not care. When I am here I expect immediate attention. He knows this.
He also told me to give you this.  It is all that remains of your chief groomsman.
Why is he killing my men? Does he not know I am the only reason he's not dead by now?
Apparently he enjoys the "sport of it" your grace.  We last at least half a dozen groomsmen during our last visit, if you recall.
Well, he needs to start killing someone else. I'll need to talk to him about this. Does this room not bother you ?
Oh my goodness, it is horrifying!  I can never get any rest when we stay here - the Queen said I had nothing to worry about, but I am not so sure . . .
Are you sleeping with the Prince?
My goodness no!  Why, I am old enough to be his grandmother for goodness sake!  Your uncle on the other hand - why, the tales I could tell you from half a lifetime ago . . .
Oh dear. I hear rumors. My son likes them older.  Didn't mean to offend.
Oh, not offended - certainly flattered though your grace!

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hello Judge.
Hello there loved one.
I am Really hungry. Do you have any food to share.
I seem to be only carrying my normal things my apologies.
Its ok. So what are you doing in damp and grungy place like this.
I suppose I could ask you the same, I was wondering that as well.
My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king so I have know where else to go. Do you know what that awful smell is.
I can not believe gerald would do such a thing!
He will be sentenced to death and I will be a widow at dawn.
It is unfortunate, I do believe the smell might be the remains here.
Why do you think the remains are here.
Considering the spikes I imagine they may have been thrown to their death.
Do you think we will die here.
I certainly hope not, we should find a means to exit this place.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Horse, are you up for an adventure to the sea?
NOOO... Not the sea!! I got sea sick.... Can we just stay in this beautiful town?
We are not going on a boat horse! Calm down! I just would like to take an adventure to be down by the sea
Oh OK! I got nervous when someone talks about sea.... What's up over there? I thought you have a good life here..
Anoria? There is not much here, just cobblestone, grass a home and a dune and one street? I like adventure. don't you?

Let me correct you... beautiful cobblestone that won't hurt my feet when we walk, nice yummy grass, beautiful home, don't care about the dune and one street that leads to the oat store. What else are you looking for?

What oat store? There are no stores? We get everything we have by harvesting from the small amount of land that is here. I would like to take an adventure. We are not leaving for good, just for a few days and we will return. Horse you are too zany!
Alright... As you wish, master... Hey, what is this? a scroll? are you up to no good?
The scroll comes from a grander noble. He brought it from the king. He could not read it, so he asked that I try to make sense of it.
Is this why we are going for an adventure? Where are we going?

No the scroll I cannot make heads or tails of. If you want to go farther into Anoria, there are more houses and streets and people. We can go through and pick up what we need before we go on the adventure>
You know... I heard some other horses in town talk about an unusual old person that has great wisdom. He usually can be found in the tavern at night time. He might can help us with the scroll.
We could go there as we pass through the town and ask. Hopefully he will be able to read it. It might be a little scary going to a tavern with people that like to get into fights when they drink.
Maybe you can ask the servant to go in instead.. Don't get your hands dirty...

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Please m'lords, does anyone have something I might eat?
Perhaps, perhaps. Can you tell me where you last saw the King?
The Lord has all the answers you'd seek, for he is the true King!
Yes yes... well, then I seek the false King. I want to overthrow this kingdom. If you help me, I could make sure that you are well cared for.
Hnngg, it's so warm in here. Do you have food you could offer me sir?
This will warm you. Do you know how to get from the murder hole to the King's chambers?
Well... ummm... I think when you go down the stairs you take a left... but I am having trouble remembering where to from there... I'm just so hungry!
I have no food with me to give you, but I can give you all the food and gold you want... just get me into his chambers. Down the stairs, take a left, and then what?
Well... why do you need to see the King?
Your King has destroyed my village. I'm here for retribution! Help me get him and I'll give you food and riches!
I suppose I could assist... ughhh my stomach.... I think I'll need this for what you're planning.
I'm glad you are on my side. Now where do we turn next?
I believe there will be two guards down the hall we shall need to... ugh... take care of.
Here- take this sword, too! We'll be done and feasting in no time!

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: How many have you killed from the dungeons today?
I've executed 6 today. Do you have the spy? I was told to get some information from him.
Yes, he's right here. Rather a puny one, it seems. He's shorter than the King! How do you plan on getting his secrets out of him?
Here you tie him up. I think this thumb-screw might make him talk.
I'd be happy to tie him up, the evil rascal! Can you believe he was spying in the King's own quarters?
Haha yeah, it almost seems like he would rather be a pervert than a real spy!
I'm sure he will give in and talk quickly. He looks like a sissy rather than a man!
I bet the king isn't happy. Did he give any special requests for this one?
Just for us to put him through the ringer - both figuratively and literally!
This will be fun. Executing people is no fun... they cant even scream!
Execution is far too quick for a fiend such as this one. I cannot believe he's not talking yet.
Maybe we should try the scalpal. What do you think?
Too kind, too kind. I think the spears might be a bit of a better touch!
Hehehe what do you plan on doing with that?

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, peasant! I know you're hungry, but my family and I are off limits!
What about that alligator?  Is he good eating?
Oh, now that's a meal fit for a king! He'll feed you and your family for months!
Maybe if I throw this rock?  What do you think my chance is of success?
Minimal. He's a large beast. But perhaps if I attack him at the same time. Ready... 1-2-3!
*Throws Rock* Uh oh . . . he looks angry . . .he looks REALLY angry!
Go away, Gator! Succumb from your injuries and feed this peasant! You are a weakling!
Oh wow!  Look at that fish-dude go!  Wowzers!
Oh man! He's nipped off my tail!
Off my fish-friend you monster!  Leave him alone I say!
Help me! Help! I'm tailless!
Nooooo!  Fish-friend!  I shall carve you a new tail from wood!
Wood? Wood? Wood won't get me anywhere. I have lost my tail and now I'll die!
It is magical wood infused by fairy dust!  Oh, my poor fish friend, don't die on me now!

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: The damned roaches crawl over my skin when I'm sleeping, and I'm not meant to BE here!
Ah, well, my son, your iron chains say otherwise. However, I have open ears and an open heart. Tell me of your injustice.
They've told you of my supposed crimes, have they not? The jailers?

Of course I have learned your crimes, my child. The King himself is quite outraged at your actions. Here, a parcel. Within this box; your salvation. Sign your name to the proclamation and you will merely suffer exile. Refusing to sign and account for your crimes is most certain death. What say you, my son?
I've not done what they say I have. The king knows NOTHING of me, NOTHING of what I've done. And... I've a child. I simply cannot accept exile.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Ah, friend, sometimes I envy you. Not much of worries, ignorance is bliss.
Ah, but I'm stuck here, unable to see the world.  And someday you shall slay and eat me!
BY GOD. A TALKING PIG!!!! IS THIS WITCHCRAFT!?!
Perhaps.  Or perhaps you've gone mad.  Pigs can't speak and I see no one else around.  Perhaps YOU are the witch here!
AM I GOING MAD???????!!!!!!! That would explain it, maybe that's what happened to Old Douglas, he kept saying he talked to his animals...I think I am going crazy

If Old Douglas had any dealings with my owner it would explain his madness.  She is a sorceress you know.  Fear not good sir for she has imbued me with special powers.  It is not you that is going mad.  I get a kick out of peoples' reactions to a talking pig!  Not much to entertain me here!
Sorceress... the old witch from raven hill?? Oh God I am so dead if the King finds about this!

That would be her.  Perhaps it would be better if you, err, we, never spoke of this.  The king would not take it lightly.  I would hate to see your head separated from your body as you seem like an amicable fellow.  And you do feed me.  Even if it is only to fatten me up for your table!
Yes, yes, let's uh... keep it between us.... just when I thought my life was hard enough. Praise God I have a talking pig now

Hmm.  Now that I think about it, if you promise to never kill me, or let anyone else do so, I shall keep my mouth shut.  However, should you choose to try and eat me I shall 'squeal' to the king and he will have your head!  (Squeal - see what I did there?!)  I am a nice pig, but I don't want to end up skewered with an apple in my dead mouth.  I think the king would like a talking pig!  Perhaps he would keep me at court in much better conditions than these!
Ya silly pig. You have learned nothing from our world? They will kill you just to see what makes you tick and I will be burned for witchcraft

That did cross my mind.  But I'm willing to bet the king would like a pet pig.  What have I got to lose?  Perhaps this way I can survive.  My sorceress has given me other powers that I shall not reveal to you!  Hmm.  A pig as a court advisor....  I like it!
You will do no such thing, hog. You will keep your mouth shut, I will not lose the only thing I have... if anything, I will take care of you myself.

Get off me!  Perhaps I will turn you into a toad!  Do you really want to lose a talking pig?!  Think of all the money you could make from me!  People would pay good money to see this!  Don't be hasty!  Let's think about it for a minute!

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Is something going on at the docks?
Aye, something always going on at the docks. How goes it?
Going well as it can be, it has been a good month for my shop, how is the fishing lately?
Fishing has been cursed. Just the wee fish now, those bloody sea monsters. They devour everything! The King will not be pleased.
Sea monsters? i have hear tale of them but i thought them to be tall tales of sailors who had a few too many drinks.
TALES???? Has my leg been taken by a tale, man?? You city boys in yer little town comfort.. Of course they're bloody real!!
Easy friend, i mean no disrespect. even so the king will need to do something sooner rather then later.
And do what??? Ye propose he perhaps patrol the seas?? Maybe blast the bottom of the oceans?? Those bloody things they just hid and wait.. and they get ya they do.
I wont pretend to know what such things would require, hopefully they can figure out a solution.
There's no hope, lad, we go to land we do what we do and pray for return. Ah, stop listening to the ranting and ravings on of an old sailor. How much for the spear?\
Six coins.
Six coins?????? Ya bloody insane lad?? Really, how much for the King's sailor?
Help!! I'm being attacked!
Calm down, lad! Was just a friendly punch, ya pansy. No need to be alerting half town for this.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Well this isn't the bathroom! How did I get so turned around?
Haha it seems you have! Are you ready for your wedding almost? I will be personally guarding the ceremony.
I am as ready as I will ever be.
Are you afraid you are making a mistake? Im not trying to offend you but some people might think that way.
No! Nothing like that. i'm afraid she'll be making the mistake.
Haha with a self esteem like that maybe she is! Be more sure of yourself chap and she will like that!
I don't have much to offer her is all. I'm starting to wonder if something is wrong with her.
Come on man. Just take what you can get and dont think too much about it. I've met her and I think you two were made for eachother!
Are you married?
I wish. Us guards are forbidden from marrage. We must protect the castle and the king at all costs and have no time for romance.
How sad! Do you get lonely.
Well of course. But I was always taught that the king needs to be my top priority. Maybe one day when I retire. That sounds like a great idea actually!
How noble of you.
Yes. The king is a great leader and I would gladly give my life to serve him.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello good boy!
Oh boy oh boy oh boy oh boy maybe i'll get a bone today oh boy
What was that? You want a,,,,,, BONE!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I MAY GET A BONE!!!
Calm down boy. That is not how a royal dog acts!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I AM SO HAPPY!!!!!!!
I trust you have been doing a good job, guarding the royal grouds, yes?
OH BOY YES YES!! I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU SAID BUT YES CAN GET BONE NOW???
*breaks arm bone off the horse thieve, that is shakled up* Here you go boy!
Just wait, soon enough I will be the KING, and you will have even better bones at yer pickin
NOMNOMNOMNOM
There there, lets get off back to the castle. We look like we're interrupting these horses sleep. Come on boy, lets go!
OH BOY WAT DOIN WHERE WE GOIN?!!!!
action: get the royal coat of arms
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello peasant. Are you selling any wares today?
I am not a saleman. But I did find this armor earlier if it interests you. May I ask. Who are you?
I am the cousin of the King. For my allegiance he has spared my life but killed off the rest of my family.
If you are his cousin, that means that he killed off his own family! Ive heard stories of the king being like that but I thought they were just stories. Tell me.. What is he like?
I hate him. He is an extremely vile selfish man. Yes he killed off his family so no one could take the thrown from him. Like that was ever going to happen anyway. No one even wanted it.
I would do something but I am but a peasant. Have you ever thought of trying something? He does trust you maybe you could backstab him!
I have pondered many nights about this. I have sword to give my life to protect him but it is his kingdom that needs protection from him. I f he dies then I am next in line for the thrown.
You are the next in line for the throan?! Its obvious what you must do! If I help you do you think you could make me your servant when you are the king?
I will make you someone much more important than a servant.
How do you suppose we go about it?
We don't we collaborate after you share this meal with me. I can't think when I'm hungry. It's pot roast.
I forgot to ask. What are you doing here in the town square? Royals dont usually come around these parts.
I was hoping to run into a witch. I heard she slithers around town. She does many enchantments and I would like her to enchant my cloak.
Enchantments eh? I must assume that you were already thinking about taking out  the filthy king.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories to tell?  I am looking for tales to record for my upcoming book.
I am but a maid for the queen. I have never been out adventuring. But it really depends on what type of book you are going to write! Tell me more!
Well, I am looking for tales from all walks of life - surely you must have some juicy gossip?  Scuttlebutt from about the castle?
Well yes I do. But you must promise not to tell anyone! A week ago I entered the queens bedroom to change her sheets. And I caught the stableboy in there getting dressed!
Oh my!  What did you do next?
I quickly left the room but I'm sure that he saw me! The next time I saw the queen I'm pretty sure she was scared of me! I think she knows I know!
*scribbles furiously*  Royal intrigue!  The tale gets all the more interesting!  Please, go on.
As I left the castle the next day to tend to the royal garden. The same stableboy came to me begging me not to tell anyone!
And what did you tell him?

I told him I would think about it. It's nice to have some leverage in things around here for once. Maybe one day I will blackmail one of them. Im sure he would be executed if the king found out though.
Well, I shall be sure to keep you anonymous in my retelling - what would you like me to use as your pen-name?
Just say that I'm a little birdy who sees things people dont want me to. But say that this is a tale from another kingdom because if not it will be much too obvious.
I shall call you the Lark of Cathay!  Has a nice ring to it doesn't it?
I suppose it does! You are quite a writer! I hope to read this novel when you do publish it!

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Hello my King, have you come to set me free so that I can return to my family?
Set you free? How dare you even request it! Your unpaid debts will have you locked up for years to come.
But..but..sire, how my family survive without me? Is there nothing I can do to quell your anger?
Your family is better without you, what kind of example do you think your dishonesty sets for your son?
I am not dishonest my King, and not even you may call me such!
GUARD! Get this scum off of me at once. How dare you, you scoundril!
I am no scoundrel either, I'm just unlucky. But I have my pride, if not for your guards, I would kill you!
I have no time for a debate with you little man. I'm here on important business.
And what business could you have with one such as I sire? Except for hurling insults at me.
It's been brought to my attention that you've been working with other prisoners to plan an escape. This is a foolhardy task you're undertaking.
I know of no such plan. I have no idea what you are talking abut.
Exactly what I figured you would say. Well, no bother anyways. We'll see to it that your conspirators are swiftly taken care of, you can just sit here and know these screams are your fault.
Wait, wait, perhaps I could remember who is leading this plan and what the plan is if you...agree to let me go in exchange?
You really are clueless aren't you. How you can even fathom that your freedom may be an option at this point is inconceivable.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Can I get you anything else, my Lord?
Servant. Where is my food! It should have been here 2 miniutes ago!
Sire, you only just ordered your roast. It may be another twenty minutes...
This is unacceptable. Tell the chef he should have already made the meal before I ordered it.
Sire... the chef quit last season... The stable boy is making your roast...
What?! The same one I caught with the queen?!?!  I thought I ordered him to be executed!!
No, sire. That's WHY he quit. You caught his brother with the queen and executed him. The chef quit to care for his brother's 12 children. Chef to the king does not pay as much as one would expect...
This roast is probably going to be terrible then anyways! Why are the people here too incompetent to hire a good chef and keep my wife from cheating...
Well maybe if you didn't execute everyone for dropping a pan or staining the royal robes....
HOW DEAR YOU SPEAK TO ME LIKE THAT! I WILL HAVE YOU EXECUT-  Wait wait..... Maybe you're right...
... You sentenced the executioner to execution because he wanted a vacation from execution...
Who executed the executioner then? Maybe I am too harsh on my people...
The stable boy again, sir. We've been spreading him pretty thin these days...
Who is tending the stables then? Is this all my fault?!
