setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: grunt, grunt, grunt,.... There are many roots here to eat. They are quite scrumptions!
I am sure they are indeed!  You wouldn't have to know of any wanderers wandering nearby would you?
Wanderers? Why is that of interest to you?
Wanderings have shiny things  . . . and I desire to acquire these shiny things.  After all, if I want the shiny things more than they do, shouldn't they be mine?
I suppose! What are they worth? And the only thing I see come through here are dogs and hunters, mostly the king his men looking to bag foxes.
Oh, I don't know what they're worth, but they sure do look pretty!  The gold, silver, and copper ones have funny faces on them!
I have special powers, I am not interested in them. but don't you think you should be worrying about being caught, should the king come with his dogs.
Well, that is why I run as swift as I can!  None can cast me, fast as I am!
I have powers. They might help, so that you do not have to run all the time
What powers do you have Mister Mystical Hog?
I could make sure that the king only sees another hog when he looks at you. He will think the dogs have gone mad, if they try to chase you.
That would be a delight!  How does your magic work?
It can only be cast on humans. When the King comes within distance, I chant the spell and he will only see 2 hogs.
What are the words of the spell?  Are they something that a fox could say?

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Ah! Good! Make the bed for me.
Yes sir. I don't mean to gossip but I think I saw someone climbing out of the queens window yesterday.
What?! Tell me more about this thing you saw. No one has a right to be here but me!
Well.. yesterday I was sweeping the pathway outside when I heard some noise coming from this room.... I just thought it was you and the queen... but then....
Go on...Have no fear. Tell me what you saw.
Well I saw the window open and out jumps a man, he looked just like the royal chef!
How dare he!!
But it was dark so I'm not sure that it was the chef... Maybe you could send someone to interrogate him!
Yes...perhaps I will, but in the meantime, maybe there's another way to discover the culprit.
What do you suggest? Anything I could help with?
These silk drapes along the walls are large and voluminous...
What could you possibly do with that?
Perhaps you could hide behind it...
Thats a great idea! I will hide here all night and report back to you what I find out!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hello my sweet, any issues in the village today I should know of?
My dear, it seems the peasant's are groaning again. Something about hunger, disease...I don't know. Their theatrics never cease.
My god, you brute. What of this lady in waiting in your chamber!?
Calm down now, you know I have needs. You are always so busy...and aging.
I should have known you'd betray our vows at the first chance you got. Where'd you find this wench, the docks?
That's right! The same place I found you, if I recall!
How dare you liken our meeting to this!
If you keep this up, I may have to make some adjustments to the kingdom.
That sprite wouldn't even know what to do with that kind of power my dear and you know it. Have your fun, I'll be in the knight's barracks.
Darling, you know I have a wicked sense of humor. Come, join me in our marriage bed.
This isn't France dear and you're not that lucky.
Are you sure?
Enjoy him dear, if that's possible.
Fine, fine! You always were a sensitive wench!
action: give crown to lady in waiting
give belt to lady in waiting

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello my king, here is the ruby you wanted me to bring you. Is there anything else that I can help you with?
Blast, this ruby does not match the golds and reds of my bedroom!
I'm sorry sire, would you like me to bring you a different jewel? There many to choose from.
You have many of colors?
Of course Your Majesty. Your treasury is full of them. But none so beautiful as your eyes.
Ah, what a lady you are. Do you like the decor of my chambers? I feel it may be a bit.. much.
It just needs a woman's touch my king. Perhaps it is time you took a wife?
Ay, I fear the power always goes to the ladies heads ma am.
I do not seek power sire, I just want to be by your side while you rule. Am I not pleasing to you?
well, you are easy on the eyes. And this room sure could use a touch up.
I could be yours every night and day if you but place a ring on my finger and declare it thus.
Ay my lady,  you seem to be moving a little fast ay?
I merely know what I want and what you need sire. Why waste time pretending otherwise. Life is short and I want to give you an heir.
Now listen, I control the fates of people, and myself!

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: So soldier, how have things been going here at the outpost? No trouble from the barbarians?
Why? Are you one of them?
No, I have come from the palace the king has hired me to go scout out their camp in order to gauge their strength before we attack them
But you wear the enemy colors?
All the better to blend in as one of them. Do you question my loyalty?
Well coming here with such a story it would be hard not to, I am but one of ten soldiers here and I know all the faces.
Believe what you will. I leave for their camp in the morning and just want a good nights rest. Don't give me any trouble and we will get along just fine
I suppose, I would think the king would have given you something to prove the story though.
See this sword, does it not bear the royal mark, put there by the king's blacksmith himself?
I see, it certainly does. The lodging here is not the best but please rest yourself for the night.
Thank you. I am sure the accommodations are much better than I usually have. I will get my rest and be gone by first light.
Understood may your journey be a safe one.
And may you be safe as well. I shall be back within a week with a report for the king
I will await your return.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Good afternoon sir! I did not expect to find you here.
Ah yes, I do like to traverse this great country on occasion amongst the common folk. Keeps me grounded.
That's refreshing to hear. A good leader does socialize amongst his people. And who is your friend?
Well, my brother of course! He does enjoy a glass of milk, Do you have, perchance?
Nice to meet you! Unfortunately I do not have any milk with me. Had I known I would come upon such high company I would have brought some with me. Perhaps I can drop some by the castle later?
Wonderful, wonderful! Few men would be bold enough to make me wait, but my anticipation grows strong for that creamy elixir. That will be fine.
Thank you good sir! I am happy to meet your needs! Have you by chance seen the cobbler? I am needing to have some shoes fixed but he is not in his shop.
Unfortunately, the cobbler had to be dealt with. My royal slippers just didn't hold up.
Ah yes. I have been having problems with his shoddy work recently as well. But with only one cobbler in town I was having to deal with it. I am glad someone of authority has straightened him out!
Well, now it seems, there is no cobbler in town if you catch my drift. I must speak to someone about appointing a new one.
I see. Well that is unfortunate. I suppose I will visit the general store then to purchase a new pair of shoes.
Do you think this might be enough to pay for a new pair?
Yes sir! I should say!
Wonderful, perhaps you can walk to the palace in those new shoes with that milky goodness afterwards?

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Is there a way I can help you today sir?
Only to tell me why you are here.  There is no reason for you to be up in the armory
Sir I live to help. The king uses me to communicate with others while they are away. I have carried many peace treaties. I mean no harm.
Peace treaty?  Then why did you steal my weapon?  I do not believe you!  Which kingdom do you come from?
I was just trying to get you to listen to me. I come from the Kingdom of Lore.
To the South of the long lake?  I heard that the people of that land had all perished from the plague... who is still living there?
Our King survived and sent me to ask for help. We need support.
Ahhh, of course.  Has the plague run it's course?
It seems to have. Those in the castle bared the doors and have  not let peasants in.
Smart.  The Prince of Kingdom of Lore has always been the smartest of the lot there.  What do you need?  I can inform our King at once of your troubles.
We need more peasants to get our village up and running again. He now has no one to rule and this must change.
Of course, of course.  As a precaution, we would only send people to your land so as to not return.  We wouldn't want to bring the Plague back to destroy our land as well.
That is very logical Sir. If you will give me a document and tie it to my leg I will take it to my King.
Alas, as well as I can fight and protect my King, I cannot read or write.  Can you go see the Priest?  He is the one who writes all that our land requires.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Ah! A sandstorm! A perfect time for a nap! My luck just keeps getting better and better!
No good sir, we must run away!  The sand will smother us all if we stay!
You know, a talking horse I can deal with, but a rhyming horse?! Now I know I lack sleep!
Sleep?  At a time like this!  Rouse yourself man, or your life you will miss!
Wow... never realized how annoying that is. Is this why I was kicked out of the castle? Is a rhyming jester really this annoying?
I am here to be your curse! Forevermore, you will hear only verse!
...no! It cannot be! I... I must be already asleep! Yes! That must be it! This storm! This horse! I must be in the middle of a nightmare!... HA! Geddit! A night... MARE! Ahhhh... I still got it!
You will hear my words even in your sleep - close your eyes, and breath them in deep!

Uh.... RUDE! You could at least pity laugh, weird horse curse thing! You about as much of a wet blanket as those snobs at the castle. Oh what's the use? If I'm proper cursed or if I've gone mad, there is no difference! I should just walk into the sandstorm and end it all!
Madness will weave between the strands of your mind - soon you will find yourself talking as one of my kind!

Oh no! I am not going back to that life! I rhymed for the king, and it brought too much strife... I mean trouble! Yes trouble! To start that again would only make my woes double... uh... I mean... Sod it! I'm going for a walk into the storm!
Yes, yes, one of us you shall become!  Nothing will be left of your mind but a crumb!
...unless I end all my sentences with a word like orange. What rhymes with orange? Nothing rhymes with orange! Ha!
We never refer to the fruit that is coloured almost like red!  Say the word again, and you will wish you were dead!

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: I am glad I brought my child with me. He will have much to see and learn about here.
I am the king now.
Who are you? Are you mad? Did you escape from the insane asylum? What do you think you are doing/
I can do as I please
Please do not scare my child! I will have you put in chains and taken the deepest darkest part of the prison.
Good luck taking me to prison
Are you so insance you are acting like my child should act? Reckless and childish?
I am favored. The people will love me more
Maybe you have not been shown enough affection. Do you have family close by
I don't need affection. I am a god and this is my temple
You are mad! Keep the crown. I have a couple more in the castle. The temple belongs to no one. It is here for everyone to come and pray.
No, it is mine
Yes, everything is yours! I guess there is no one in this world that has anything, except you.
Your child is mine too

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Guard, please speak quietly so we are not caught, I am here to kill the king, you must know how he is really an evil ruler dont you?
What do you mean? I am the Kings guard!
Wow now. I guess my words can't convince you... How about this? This is more than you make in a month is it not?
Why must you try to kill the king? You know I am the best at combat in the land. Unless you give me a good reason, you're head will be mine!

You must have not seen the southern regions of the city. There are citizens killing eachother over scraps of food while the royals here feast and waste giving not even a penny to the poor. This needs to change!

Ah, but the King is royalty, and the peasants, are well peasants. All of the lavish things around you, the Royal family has worked for a nd passed down from generation to generation. Just look at that bear rug! It is centuries old.
But why should the peasants just be peasants!? They deserve a chance at a nice life too!
Tell them to get a good job then!

It's not as easy as you think see, there is very little money circulating between the peasants and nobody from the upper class ever hires them for a good penny, Its a corrupt system really and I feel the need to bring it to its knees!
Well let us not kill the king, that is a bit harsh. Maybe little by little I can sneak out some of these riches for you to sell
I am no salesman. My son was stolen in the street 3 years ago and the guards did nothing because I have no power in society. I must seek revenge!
You live the life you were born in to, or you change it. I am trusted to protect to Royal family. And protect I will!
No! Think about the bigger picture!! AAAH!
I am here to PROTECT the ROYAL family! As a guard it is my duty. BE GONE

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Don't mind me, dog. Just passing through.
Okay, but watch for pee puddles.  The queen lets me pee wherever I like!  And boy do I pee a lot!
I won't complain. I can usually find some good food in places like that.
Oh boy!  Food! FOOD!  Don't get me started on food!  The King says too much food is why I waddle so much.
He's such a slob that it's easy pickings for the likes of us. They may call him king, but we're the ones living like one.
Oh yes!  Oh boy!  We sure do!  I eat, and I eat - and then I poo!  This is the greatest life EVER!
And then I eat your poo! Man, what would they do without us?
They wouldn't know what to!  I mean, if I didn't poo and pee everywhere, what would they do with their spare time?
Who knows what humans do for fun. They can't even sniff their own butts!
Or lick them!  What filthy creatures they must be!
Walking around stinking and being nasty all the time. I don't know why we even put up with them.
Well . . . they do give us food.  And scritches.  And belly rubs.  So not all bad!
Well, you maybe. I don't get anything from humans but attempted murder!
Have you tried only coming out at night?  You can eat all you want while they sleep, and they'll be none the wiser.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hello, dear child of God
It is not God that I follow, but it is the spirits that speak to me.  Have you heard of the Saviour who will set us all free of our misery?
I have. What spirits speak to you?
The Spirits of the Land.  They say that the peasants of this land need food, clothing and fresh water, but are unable to afford such riches.  But you can.
Ahhh, yes. I may be able to help some. There is fresh water in the river to the east. This should help purchase some food and clothing.

Thank you for this gold, please take this bag as a token of my gratitude.  I must say, though, that there are many people who need more than what this small amount of gold can buy.  Look around you, there is so much you can give.
Please keep your bag. I will speak to the rest of the church to see what more we can do. Please take this cross as a reminder of my promise to you.
It is the Queen that you must speak to, for it is she that takes all that the peasants have.  Her greed is what impoverishes them.
Our queen? What is she taking? I'm shocked!
All of the food.  All of the crops.  Most of the animals.  She uses the peasants as her own private source for lavish parties.  This is why she hates me, I speak out against her.
I will most certainly do all that I can. Does the king have any idea what's going on?
It is said that he is too distracted by the war to notice, although he appreciates that parties as a distraction.
Well this is far worse than I feared.
The Queen tells him that these parties are to find a suitable partner for the Princess, although the Princess is too shy to meet any suitable mates.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Hello, my Liege
Why are you here?  You know I do not like to be disturbed!
Just changing the candles, m'Lord. It was time
That seems to be a faint excuse.  Have you drawn my bath yet?
I was just about to your Highness. With your blessing.
Yes, yes.  Get to it then!
Get on with it, you heard our master. I asked you to do this before!
Ah, good!  He has been doing nothing all this time!  I'm glad someone is taking care of him!
The King has noticed your slacking?? You imbecile, I told you to do the bed and the bath!
Where did this servant come from?  Who hired such a man?
Oh uh.... you did your highness. You said he was a beautiful young man but I think you grew tired of him and kept him around for some reason.
Do not tell me such lies!  It was likely that idiot of a son of mine!  He has no sense of who can do what job!
Please Lord I beg of you!! I surrender!! I swear this person was hired by someone higher to my stance I assumed it was you!!
EVERYONE!  Is of higher stance than you!  Do you not understand that?

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: God, I sure do hate the king.
Tell me why, my child. You can pray to me for any reason. I am here to listen and guide you.
Oh my! My lord, is that really you!
It is me the creator. Don't you think my desert is gorgeous? Tell me why do you hate your king?

Lord, of course all of creation is splendid and perfect in every way. The king, my lord, the king doth not respect your sacred creation. He oppresses your people, starves them, ignores them in their need!
I shall smite him, my child. I will appoint a new king. The new king will have control of this vast desert. I shall create an oasis for the new kingdom. Are you hungry, my child?
My lord, you are mighty and righteous. I am hungry. But I only have this in exchange.
Thank you! All I ask of you is to be kind and honest. Here is some food. Nourish your soul and body.
Thank you, lord. Perhaps I have something better to offer you. Lord, I will give you my life. I will dedicate myself to this desert. I will be a humble king and servant if it might please you.
It has been declared. You shall be the new king. You will be great. I will test you often. If you fail you shall know endless misery.
My lord, I will not fail you.
I have faith in you, my child. You will do great things for this barren desert. Your first task is to build a church. You will teach all of your people to worship me above all else.
It would be my pleasure! Question, how much blood must we draw from a sacrifice and how much must we consume to please you?
Yeah, about the king thing, I have misjudged your character. I am going in another direction. Thank you for your time.

setting.name: stable hand's quarters
setting.description: The stable hand's quarters are very plainly decorated, with wooden torches situated in stone carvings in the wall. There are bunk beds with cheap hay and feather mattresses for the stable hands to rest in while not working. There are small sacks, as well as beaten and splintered wooden chests for them to keep their belongings in. One small window shines light into the very center of the room.
setting.background: The stable hand's quarters provide a place for the workers to rest and relax in while not at work. They are not too far from the stable so that at a moments notice the stable hands can respond to their call for work.

speech: What a beautiful creature! You remind me of the flowers I plant in the king's garden.
Why thank you kind farmer. How are you today?
It's a marvelous day. My flowers are blooming, the king is happy, and I've time to visit the horses. What are you doing here?
Well I am one who can interpret things and help people. Tell me what kinds of flowers have you been planting and which is your favorite horse?
I've planted pansies and marigolds to keep the bugs away. There's a lovely chestnut horse here I like to stroke. And I visit the stable hand. Perhaps you could help him?

I would be ever so glad to help him, but first there is a kindness to be done for you. I happen to know that the king greatly appreciates your attention to detail in planting the right flowers for the right reasons and your care for the horses and even the lowly stable hand. By the time the tulips bloom next spring the king will grant you the foal from the chestnut mare to have as your own.

Oh marvelous. My life is so good already, it seems almost unfair how difficult the lives of others can be. Look around at this poor dingy place. I wish the beds could be more comfortable than cheap hay and old feathers.

True enough, these are pitiful accommodations for one who works as hard as the dear stable hand. If you would encourage him to endure a bit longer the king will bless him with a promotion and a cabin of his own.
Oh what news. I can't wait to tell him! You've blessed me so greatly, can I do anything for you?
Thank you kind farmer, but I have no needs except to see deserving souls made happy! It is your kindness and diligence that has brought you this far, never forget that!
Please take this as a token of my appreciation. My wife sewed it for me herself. Perhaps you can make yourself a garment from it.
You and your wife have done good things, more than just what is required. Please let her know that within the year the desire of her heart will be granted. You know how she longs for children...
Oh! My heart feels about to burst with joy!
My work here is done :) Now off to the kitchens and that poor overworked cook!

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: Anything I can offer you, guard?
Indeed, this sword has become old and rusted.. I fear I can no longer protect the King with this to the best of my ability.

It really has the potential to be a grand sword indeed, and I'm sure it was at some point in its life however, you may need the blacksmith rather than the spice stall. I do have some sumac just in, and this cumin.
Ahh, I am getting forgetful in my age. The King sent me to gather some herbal spices for his dinner tonight. How much coin are they?
For the king? I could ask for anything, it is my pleasure. Before I forget, here is your sword. The blacksmith is a few rows down that way. What spices would the king require?
Ehh  you see, all of them! The King has acquired a new taste for all kinds of spices.
How worldly! We'll I'll just bag it up. How many guests will there be, so I can gauge quantities?
Forty five, all of the King's ambassador will be present for tonights Ball. Make sure you give me your freshest spices.

Yikes! Well perhaps I can peddle back on that deal we made. That could make quite a dent in my stock. It will be about 10 gold with a discount. Maybe I could come to the ball too? I'm not royalty obviously but I could come with the spices and see to it that they are handled and used correctly.
Or maybe I can just take them? It should be an honor for you to provide for the Royals. Make it 7 gold or the King will know of your greediness.
10 and I will have your sword fixed in time. I know the blacksmith personally I can cut you in line. I must say though, I have traveled very far, I could add a light edge to the nights story telling.
Well alright then. That sword is very important to me and I want it fixed right!
I can assure it.
Here's the gold. Now come with me, I am too weary to carry such heavy bags of spices.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Ah, blacksmith. Is the sword complete?
The sword?  I was commissioned to produce a hammer.
I can bend mater with my hands and have elements hanged by my mere whims... why must I surround myself with such incompetence.

Why was I summoned to this room crusty room full of bottles of unknown substances and weary animals in cages with a hammer that is of no use to someone such as yourself.  I need to get to the bottom of this.
Give me that! What am I, a norsk god? Am I supposed to give this to our King so he can wave it about when he battles the golden dragon? This is a fine hammer, mind you. But I need to enchant a sword.

Late in the night, a fortnight ago, a caped nave delivered to me a purse filled with many gold coins to produce a hammer to be delivered to you, Wizard.  A hammer was produced and delivered. What business is it of mine what you enchant?

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: one day i will be the king of the bugs, if you leave me be, i will owe you
I think you will be the king of the bugs. A master bug you shall be.
will you assist me on a journey, a companion so to say?
Sure, I like adventures. What shall we do?
from my experience, this cave is pretty big. I think we should scout a team and rule over the cave!
Yes, you shall rule the bugs and I shall rule the bats.
so that be it then but what do we do once the cave is under our control?
We shall explore outside the cave for resources that we can use
that is a great idea. you scout and patrol the sky whilst i take control of the ground
and bats could transport bugs by air to increase bugs range
our first step should be to recruit spiders
why do we need spiders? they eat bugs
if we can get those on our side, we can secure the cave, set traps and build systems to get around and collect resources better.
good idea. and spiders set good traps with their webs

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Hello guard how are you this fine afternoon!
Good my king! Im just doing my duty of protecting your beautiful castle! Anything I can help you with?
Maybe so, have you heard anymore about the dragon terrorizing the people of my kingdom?
Of course! Is it back again!?!
No but I would like to assemble a team to go search for it's nest.
Oh I was ready to fight! Do you have any idea where its lair is?
I think it may be out east in Kissanthia but I'm not certain.
That would make sense! We should assemble a team of our strongest men and attack while it is sleeping!
Guard I am going to be sending 2 scouts to Kissanthia to try and locate it. When we know its exact location we can form a strategy to kill the beast. We can't just send out a militia all willy nilly
Yeah that was a bit silly of me, you are completely right. Good thing you are the one making the plans not me!
Don't be so  hard on yourself! You are a good guard
Thank you! Is there anything else I can do to serve you?!
I would like for you to get some of your men together, the strongest and most strategic thinkers. You are going to be in charge of slaughtering the dragon once we have located it
This is a great plan! I will get started right away!

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Eek. A guard! I hope I haven't offended you in some way by being in this port.
You're fine good citizen. Just doing an inspection of the area. Carry on.
Ah. I'm here for a leisurely time but I find it nerve wracking. There are so many strange people about.
Indeed there are strange people afoot. I try to take a mental image of everyone I come into contact with
Oh. Interesting. I wonder where I might sell this shovel. I could use a new one.
There's at the end of the harbor that specializes in random goods. Maybe you could try there. Doing a lot of gardening?
Oh yes yes. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I grow all of my own food you see.
Oh I see...it must be a lot of work having to grow your own food. As a guard they provide our meals and goods for us.
Well you just never know what they're feeding you then. That sort of thing makes me quite nervous.
I never thought of it that way! I spent most of my life protecting the king, I could be eating anything.
Exactly! You must be careful. Especially with this seafood around here. You just never know
Thank you. I certainly appreciate the helpful tip. It's rare if anyone looks out for a guard.
Well that's sad. After all you're laying your life down for our king.
Indeed I am! I think I will even start my own garden when my shift ends today. You've inspired me.

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Hello! You must be an altar boy. Is there where services are held?
Yes, madam
I was asked to sweep up and make this place spotless. Everything is a mess. Here, boy, take this broom and help sweep up.
I'm sorry i won't be able to help with that as i have also been given another assignment
I see. What is your assignment?
Replace all burnt out candles and remove the burnt wax from the candle holders
Ah, I see. Do you like working for the priest?
I love working for him, he has basically been the only family i've had for over 10 years
I'm sorry to hear that, dear. What happened to your parents?
They were accused of treason and hanged by the king
Good heavens! That must have broken your heart. Are you well cared for here?
So far, it's been a bit tough but the priest as always been there
I'm glad he was able to rescue you. I will pray for you!

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Be careful where you step! This is a haunted orchard, and you can easily meet your death out here.
Oh my! I had no idea. Thank you for the warning. What brings you here if it's haunted?
Haha! I'm a thief- I fear nothing! And staying here means I'm not bothered by visitors. At least not ones that are alive.
That's brilliant! A very smart thief you are.
But what brings YOU here? That is the question.
I'm good friends with the king and I was cutting through on my way to the castle. Do you stay here often?
I live in a tent in the woods, but use this orchard to hide from the police. You won't turn me in, will you?
No, sir. Not as long as you promise not to rob me. What made you turn to a life of crime?

Here- I'll share some meat with you and tell you. My parents died when I was young, which left me a peasant. I had no food but quickly learned to pick pockets to stay alive. That led to where I am now.
That's such a very sad story. Do you want a family of your own some day?
I do, I would like to stop thieving, but sadly I have no skills.
Hmmm...well you seem very intelligent to me. That's a great start. What else do you like to do?
My favorite thing to do is to whittle. Sometimes when I am here in the orchard, I get a branch and whittle little animals.
I bet you could sell them! Do you have one I may see? I could show it to the king.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Well, well well. What do we have here?
I'm just visiting the apothecary getting a remedy for my husband. His stomach rumbles and makes him visit the chamber pot repeatedly.
That sounds horrid! Where is that old fool apothecary? You have urgent need for aid!
I've been waiting for him for quite some time. I have no idea where he has wandered off to, and it is quite distressing. Why are you here today?
Well, I have certain need for various ointments and such...its none of your business!
Ah, I understand. These things are much of a personal nature. I believe I saw an ointment labeled "For all that ails your bum" on that shelf over there.
Ah, yes, well.. that's good..um, just in case. Say, look at that dog there. You don't think the apothecary has a mishap with one of his formulas do you?
I do love dogs! And this one has a peculiar smell. When I hugged him just now I noticed an odor of menthol. Perhaps it IS the apothecary!
Well, I suppose I'll just have to return with payment later for erm, these various...erm...creams.
Yes, Your Highness. I will wait here for a while and pet this dog. If I discover anything, I will let you know.
Don't pet him too much, you may catch whatever he's got!
Good point, Your Highness! I hope you feel better soon!
No, I feel great, wonderful in fact. These aren't for me!
Good to hear, Sire!

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Helllo sir
Step aside citizen. What is your business here at the castle?
I have questions!
What are your questions good sir?
How did you become a knight?
My father was born a knight, since I was a child I trained for this. It took many years of dedication.
So i guess that means they don't just hire anybody..
Oh of couse not. For guards you just need a bit of training but to be a knight its a lifetime of dedication. I do duties directly specified by the king and am the most elite in the kingdom!
So you do duties for the king, are you around him often too?
Only when he requests me to be. I am usually out fighting on horseback or directly defending the castle. Have you ever met him? He is a great king.
I never got to meet the king. I work alot of hours at the smithy. How often are you fighting on horseback or defending the castle?
I am almost always working. Its not a lot of rest but we get to retire early. At least I know that I am doing something good.
Yea it sounds like good benefits unless you die.
Its a dangerous job but we are very, very well trained. Maybe if it interests you, you could sign up as a guard.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Hello sire, how is my most famous cousin today?
I am doing great! It has been forever since I have seen you last! How gave you been?
I have been well sire. I have travelled far and wide and sung for many a court. But, it is good to be back in my homeland. How fares the kingdom?
The kingdom is doing wonderful! We are going to war with a nearby nation.
That sounds...interesting. Why are you going to war cousin?
They have enslaved a few of our citizens and I will get them back!
Perhaps I could go to them as an emmissary and see if we can avoid the bloodshed sire, unless your heart is set on battle, of course.
You were always my best advisor. I would like you to negotiate the terms with them if you possibly could.

I have seen many lands and many wars. It has taught me that there are no winners, just survivors. If I can solve this matter diplomatically, it would be my honor to do so. Shall I leave after the feast this evening?
Yes and make sure to take two of my best guards for safety measures.
Thank you, I will do that. Best to be safe, the road can be dangerous. But for now, what shall I sing for you at the feast sire?
Shoe me what the best of tunes you have gathered on your journeys!
Here sire, I have collected many songs in this book. Pick any you like. Now, where is the queen today? I have not seen her since my arrival.
She has been feeling ill for quite a time, but we have the best doctors with her. Let us see let us go with this one referred as "Gucci Gang"?

setting.name: Mess Hall
setting.description: The mess room is filled with simple brown wooden tables. They are rough, their edges sharp and not sanded. They are crooked and wobbly. Simple matching wooden chairs are around the tables. The walls are dark, but there are holes for windows. The air smells like freshly baked bread.
setting.background: The Mess Hall is where people enjoy food for every meal. The villagers will go there to eat and also to socialize. They spend hours talking about village life and affairs of the villagers. It gets used very often. They clean it regularly to ensure that it is nice for everyone.

speech: Anything decent to eat in these parts?
I'm not sure what they are cooking up tonight but the bread sure smells good. Maybe pot roast.
I might just try it.
Try this as well. It's my own brew. Just don't give the child any. It's pretty strong.
Understood, I will make sure not to.
Have you seen the magical forest yet. It is fun to look at in the night. Lot of crazy light going in and out.
I cannot say that I have. Where is it?
It is behind the village. I will take you to the edge after we have had a good meal.
That sounds great.I am most excited.
We are not really allowed to go in the forest but we do anyway to find new things. There are many magical creatures.
Why are you not allowed there?
I'm not sure but it has always been that way. No one has ever gotten caught because the King and his guards do not step foot in there either.
That makes it sound as if it is dangerous?
That is what they say but I have only found wonder in those woods. I will never stop. There is just too much to explore.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

speech: Do you know where the king is this minute...servant?
No no, I try not to look up from my cleaning duties.
Are you a female or male...I can not tell from this angle...
I am just a little girl. I usually clean dishes and help dress the rich. But today I am cleaning these purple drapes. What business have you here?

I am here to help my king take this kingdom for himself. I need clothing to disguise myself.  Take me to a chamber where I might find some large male clothing.  I will not harm you if you do as I say...scream and you will lose your life.
No, you mustn't! I like it here. They treat me good.

My king will treat the people good as well...even better.  Now where is a chamber to find the clothing I will need...and better yet...tell me where the royal family is dining...I will use my bow and arrow and make swift work of this.
Isn't there another kingdom you can take over?
No...now go or I will tie you up with the sashes from these draperies you are cleaning.
Do not touch those! They are framing the oil painting perfectly, it took me all day.
snippy for a servant girl...now move it...take me where I say...this instant.
Is your king going to give me my own warm and cozy room, that all the food I could eat?
I will personally see to it that you get whatever your heart desires if you help me dispatch your king. I am of the Royal Army and I can swear to you little girl that all will be yours.
I've heard it all before, now get out!

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Hello, Have you brought news for the king?
yes. I have brought a map for the captain
I see. I will make him aware of this. The king will be thrilled you have found the map to the fountain of youth.
May I speak to the captain directly?
Be my guest. He is in quite the mood. I was told to watch him and keep him away from the King.
It seems he has been up all night. He bed is not yet made
He has been busy all night throwing thing around and screaming. I think he has gone mad. The King is patient but how far he will let him go, I don't know.
I see then perhaps I should give this to you instead
Yes, I will give it to the King but he may need someone to take over for the captain. Do you think you can find your way to this place and lead the crew?
It would be an honor. When would I be able to start?
Why don't you just go ahead and take this now. The captain is in no condition to lead at the moment. Right now he is under the bed hiding from me.
I can see he has gone through multiple maps. They are all over the walls. He has worked to exhaustion.
I think he has been taking something or a spell has been cast upon him. In any case, he is a danger to the King.
A spell cast on him? who would do such a thing?

setting.name: Valley of doom
setting.description: The Valley of Doom is overrun by dead trees and grasses.  Eerie looking animals peer at you through the brushes.  It is a dark and wicked place.
setting.background: The Valley of Doom is home to witches and goblins in the region.  People rarely try to pass here because they all know that the evil is afoot.

speech: The Valley of Doom!  The perfect hiding place for a Goblin!
It is also perfect for a hated cockroach. Together we can commiserate about how much the people hate us.
People are the worst!  All I want to do is eat deep cave algae and human flesh, and they have the nerve to judge me for my lifestyle choices?
I fly from village to village to find other coackroaches to join me in my journey to take over the kingdom. Do you want to join us?
Yes, a thousand times yes!  How do you plan on doing it?
We will chase all the human's out of their safe villages, slowly taking over all their homes.
What fun we will have!  Who will be the new King?
I will of course
All hail King Cockroach, Lord of the North!
You can be my security
I shall guard thee with my life!
Thank you Goblin. What have you done with your life thus far?
Lots of running - I usually try to avoid people since they often try to kill me on sight.
I am sorry Goblin. You will be well accepted into our group

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Bzzzz. Bzzzz. Ah, yes, another victim.
Boo! Haha! Don't you know I'm a ghost little friend. You cannot bite me!
My babies will not be pleased.What exactly is a ghost?
I don't recall how I came to exist but I think I used to be a King. I heard the witch ranting and raving one night and it sounded like she was laughing and talking about me.
Ugh, yes, the witch. She tastes disgusting.
I can imagine! All that crazy stew she is always brewing up. I'm sure she doesn't smell that great either. Glad I cannot smell.
Perhaps we can torture her a bit? Wanna have some fun?
I'm not sure what else I could do to torture her. She knows I'm here and is not afraid of me. Everytime she sees me she just laughs.
Perhaps I could crawl into her ear, and buzzzzz until she makes you a new body or something?
That would be funny but she could kill you, or even worse! Best to just leave that crazy witch alone.
Maybe you are right. I suppose we can traverse these forbidden woods and marvel at the monstrosities contained within it.
I think that the spiders are my favorite. I always get a kick out of visitors getting caught in their webs.
Oh dear no! I have seen too many of my loved ones lost that way!
Oh! I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking! please forgive me.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Good day. How might I help you?

Good day to you as well, Dear Monk. I have been cleaving here day in and day out, but i have no knowledge of the outside wiorld. I am dedicated here and have long given up my dream of sailing the world. but please answer me, what does the outside world look like beyond the boundaries of this kingdom?
I could not tell you. I have devoted my life to be a monk here from a young boy but take this pouch. Maybe you could use it if you decide to go live your dream.
i appreciate your kindness, with this in my possession, it has somewhat rekindled the long lost passion that i once had. Thank you, but how may i replay you?
Come back from time to time and visit me. I will love to here what kinds of adventures you have been on.
there is but one problem, whilst you are a respected Monk. I also have the responsibility as the Kingdoms chosen Clergyman. How could i get the king to except this decision. is this even possible?
I will have a word with the King. He listens to me. I will say that you have done your duty here and wish to go visit your dying grandmother. Don't think of me bad for such a tiny lie.
I respect your intentions and am truly grateful. please take this ring as a sign of gratitude
Thank you. Now maybe you should start packing. It's too bad we do not have wine to celebrate you leaving.
I know, it is too bad. I shall pack my stuff and be back shortly
See if you can find a bottle of wine while your packing to bring back.
i will make sure of it, we shall celebrate before i take my leave at Twilight
I am so excited for you! You do promise to come back right?
I swear by the honour of our glorious and righteous King
action: give empty coin pouch to clergyman

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: I am innocent!  Why won't anyone believe me?
That is what they all say! The King would never fasely accuse anyone.
The King of what? Lies?  I didn't even get a trial!
Then what is it that you claim you are innocent of?
How can I know if no one has told me?  Do you know what it is they accuse me of doing?
Of stealing my heart. The King found out about our forbidden love and he is angry. I never wished this upon you.
Then help me escape, and we can live free together in another land - maybe even Cathay?  I have picked the shackle, all we need is to get past the guards!
Oh that has been what I wanted for so long. I will get the key and free you. I always dreampt of the day we would escape together.
I want to spend my life with you!  The King can't keep us away from each other!
Now, we must go. The shackles are off. We must leave now before anyone notices.
Onward, I will follow you wherever you go - climb any mountain, cross any sea!
Pray we do not get caught by anyone, my love.
I fear no man, woman, or beast when you are at my side!
We need to go down the corridor, go left 2 times. then right once Ater that it should be a straight way ahead of us.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: Executioner. How many sacrifices have you done today?
I have done one. Crime has slowed down here since they know they will surely be punished.
I will bring you a lowly peasant. We need much more blood by requests of the wizard.
What has this lowly peasant done? I will not do anyone's dirty work!
Um... he.. um.... stole something from the king. Come on just put him on the slab
Sounds like you are unsure...
What.. no. Just do as I say!
You are a nobel. I can have your head for this fishy business... Shall we?
Okay Okay calm down. Just forget I said anything. Peasant you can go. I will bring you some real prisoners instead.
See... now you understand I will not take an innocent life. That is NOT my reputation!
I am confused as to why an executioner like you has any morals at all. For all you know the men you execute could really be innocent!
I only execute as told by the king, and the king has legitimate reason when he brings them to me. I have never executed for the mere fact that I was told.
Okay okay. I think its best I leave then. Just please don't tell the king about what happened today...
I will have my eye on you nobel. You think you can escape what you are doing, but you cannot!

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: my humble king. What am I to do to serve you?
Ahhh. My loyal servant. Polish my scepter.
Yes my lord. I will polish it immediately. Am I to return it to you personally?
Yes. Yes. Of course. Also check the jewels in my crown. They seem loose.
But sire I am not qualified to do that. Would you prefer I take it to someone?
Oh fine then.
I am sorry sir the rug startled me
Haha! That's bear I slain on my latest hunting trip. He's a mighty beast!
and if I may ask where did you go hunting sire?
The great woods of course. This bear was stealing children in the kingdom. Surely you heard about it.
sire. I have not been outside of these walls in quiet some time. I have not seen my family in ages.
Such is the life of a servant I suppose. How's that scepter looking?
it is almost ready sire. and the crown who would you like me to take it to?
Here just give it back. I'll have the queen find someone.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Hello king. I hope you are having a wonderful day here in the Garden.
Hello, my faithful servant. How is the harvest today?
The harvest is one of the best we have seen in a few months now. Would you like a fresh carrot, my king?
Save it for the roast tonight. Make sure the cooks know that we have a large company tonight and to prepare for more than 40 people.
I will do so your majesty. May I ask who the large company will be tonight?
We have nobles from all over coming to feast upon the harvest from my famous garden. That's all you need to know.
Ok. Thank you for the information. I will go tell the cook at once.

Gather the finest vegetables we have here first. Bring those to the cooks so they can start creating the feast tonight. Then come back and help the rest of these servants gather the rest of the harvest.
Yes, your majesty. Is there anything else that I can do?
Don't forget the basket over by the wall for the vegetables. The basket is enchanted to hold all the vegetables of the garden.
That is great to know. I will do so.
What else is left to do in the garden for tonight?
I just have to pick a few herbs for one of the ladies in waiting to the queen who has a terrible headache from lack of sleep.
Is the lady in waiting complaining? I will have to get a new one to better serve my queen

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: These commoners are disgusting, darling. Quickly, buy me something from this merchant to cheer me up.
Im sorry but we need to be here. Merchant! Give me your finest wine!
Now, fool! I must alter my consciousness to survive this place!
Oh honey, please do not cause a seen again. We will leave soon I promise!
fine. What are we doing again?
We have to go find the town wizard for him to make us a love spell so we can finally have an heir to the crown.
Darling, I'm not sure that even a wizard can cure your...male inadequacies.
I mean... Its worth a try right? What else do you expect me to do?!
Of course, you are right. Though there is always adoption?
Adoption!? What lowly soul would be worthy of adoption from us?!
Or, perhaps there is another way. Merchant! Like what you see?
WHAT! How dare you! Merchant, look away or I will have you executed!
Oh, my. I am so embarrassed. What was in that wine?
I'm the one that should be embarassed! I can't even please my wife!

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: My queen I heard about your grievances against me, your king, I demand an answer now
I heard of those grievances but I honestly don't know the meaning of them...
so you deny them, you will suffer my rage come clean, its your last chance tell me who is involved in this plot against me
How dare you attack the queen!? I could have your head for this!! I remember filing a complaint against a Duke! Other than that I know nothing of what you speak!
The king gave me strict orders to find out whos acting against him, this magical crystal ball showed me theres a plot to end his life, someone close to him is going to act and kill him
And because a fancy ball lead you hear you feel it's grounds to attack the queen! The wife of the king who rules this kingdom!?
I let my emotions take the best of me, the kigdom is in danger and if the king dies you will be next in line, help me discover the traitors this sword is the key
So you're saying that someone is plotting against the king, and my name was on the list of conspirators?
Yeah thats correct, your name is on the top of that list, I was trying to protect the kind but its a trap, they knew I was going to attack you, I should have known
It seems they are using you as a pawn! How do you know it isn't the king himself and he wanted me dead? Who else could forge such a document!?
I dont think its the king, your death would destroy him, either way you have to be prepared, here take this sword, you will need it ,
Haha! I was waiting for you to give me this sword! You were 100% right. It was me, I shouldn't have trusted those lowly subjects to keep their mouths closed.
How dare you conspire against the king! he will learn about this even if it means my death
I will gladly die before I spend another day with that retched king! I didn't even want to enter into this marriage!! We will both die!
action: give a crystal ball to queen

setting.name: the acid yard
setting.description: A yard in a shape of a circle is surrounded by sad, dried down trees, long ago have they died and give no sign of life. The ground in the middle is apparently not producing any fresh grass, all that can be found there is a bunch of rocks here and there. There is many barrels laying on the ground, all bearing signs of passed time on them, broken and useless. There is an  air of mystery surrounding the place and a smell so unpleasant no one dares to wander around this place.
setting.background: Acid yard being the least liked place in the entire castle grounds is by far, the most mysterious. Rumor has it long ago a mad king used it for torturing the enemies by pouring an acid down on every single one of them, bit by bit until they were screaming the answers to his questions. It has created a large yard contaminated by acid on which nothing but a few mosses will grow.

speech: My lord, what are you doing in the acid yard?
Itsy bitsy sp-wow wow... did you just say something or am I losing it?
Why yes I did, it is my special power
Man that's amazing. Did you use to be a human?
No I was not, I am just an itsy bitsy spider that loves to spin webs
Maybe it's me? Maybe I drank something that made me understand spiders.. or even other animals!
Oh no, I have spoke with a few that have passed through here before. It could be the acid yard itself, it's a unique place.
Oh alright. Well bit of a disappointment but still amazing... Wait a minute, can you be considered a person.. .cause if that's cause you owe taxes to the King and it IS my job to collect taxes.
I'd say still a spider
Ok then. Man this yard IS a mess, bunch of crap everywhere. I wonder why we can't have this clean once and for all
I would appreciate if you sent someone to do so. The acid has really harmed my health. All of my children have died and I think it's because of the toxins here.
I will have a word with the help. I have no idea what I came here for either. But here lil fella, you can have a hug
Thank you so much my Lord
Now off my land before I have you killed.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

Yes just me the horse, I'm here everyday but don't mind me

WOW you can hear me?!??!
Of course I can hear you! Hey, stop!
YOU'RE FREAKING ME OUT I CAN'T HELP IT!
Woaah, woah. Calm down there, shhh..
OK that is freaky buddy. I sometimes sorta understood your meaning but not all your words, now you're coming loud and clear like you speak my language
Everybody speaks the language of love. Hey! How about I untie you and you can work for me? I pay in hay!
WOW. PAYDAY IS HAYDAY! HAHA. Ok but it's still weird!
Yes, but just imagine this...what if we can get everyone to hear you talk? We'll be rich! Maybe you could even run for office!
I don't think the king would be too impressed by it! I heard they kill people for less... but I'll try it for some hay!
This is beginning of a beautiful friendship.
And it's probably even legal on some parts of the realm!
