setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello serving wench, how are you today?
Right as rain, gov'nor! Now what can ah get a fine traveler such as yerself this fine day!
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I collect stories to write in my book. got any good stories?

Oooooh! A bard, eh? Oh, sir, I 'ave stories abound, I do I do! I love havin' a chat with the people what comes 'n goes through this old place! What type o' stories you wantin', love? Ah could tell ye about the local ghosts, or the soldiers what work by da docks! What's yer pleasure?
Well I am looking for stories that will pass the test of time, like Romeo and Juliet or you know another famous story everyone knows.

Hmmm... I see I see... a love story, is it? Well, you know the old ruins out west o' here? Ye probably passed em on yer way 'ere, right? Legends tell o' a kingdom used ta be dere. An old tapestry still hangs in one o' the more intact rooms, and nearby is a ghost o' some sort. People come by from that place swear on it!
oh wow!

Indeed! And if yer wantin' ta know who the ghost is... weellll that's where the tale gets right tragic! When I first started working here, passersby would swear he was the ghost of a king! Then, they said he was a noble, but could naw remember hes rank. Now, whenever someone mentions the ghost, they say the poor spirit jus' cannot remember even his own name...
Go on, go on. This is good stuff!

Not much else I can tell, I'm afraid. The poor thing seems to be losing his memories is all. Yet he still chained to this world. A horrid fate to be sure. Oh! I do remember once a book-learned feller came by asking fer directions to the royal library! He seemed determined ta find out who 'zactly dat ghost was. Gosh dat was.... few weeks back I recon. He might ah found out somethin' more.
Well I think you gave me enough to start with, it is a story after all.

You know, ye could go ask the ghost himself if yer so inclined! Seems he likes the company an' I never heard o' him hurtin' no body. Then again, if he's losing himself, he might just get aggressive on ya. Oh, but look at me ramble! Ye came in fer a drink I'm sure! Can I get ya anything, love?
Sure I'll have a mug of your best stuff.
Of course! Lemme pour dat fer ya, gov'nor! Oh, and if ye see dat ghost, tell 'im I says 'hi'!

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Are you enjoying your time tonight here?
Most definitely, this ballroom is divine! I even had this suit custom made for this very occasion. Do you like it?
It's really snazzy. You must be with someone special tonight to be wearing something that nice.

I cannot be barred down by one person. I just dress like this because I am an individual with fine taste. Unlike that man over there wearing those hideous trousers; does he not realize that this is the most formal event of the year?
Yeah. He's not the most fashionable. Some people don't dress for the occasion. Do you know many people here tonight?
I know most everyone here, and all of their secrets. Nobody's dirty laundry gets past me.

As long as everything stays within. I have to defend the King on a daily basis. Any bad gossip that gets out could have a negative effect on this kingdom. My job is to protect the King emotionally and physically.
No need to worry about that! The King is off bounds when it comes to gossip. I may be a town crier at times, but I would never jeopardize the King's well being.
We're all good then. Tonight is a night of celebration. I'm just here to oversee the event.
I cannot believe the King has turned 70. This truly is a time to honor him through festivities.
I know. Time flies. He's lived a grand life to this point. And hopefully this is just another chapter for him for at least another 20 years.
I do have a piece of information that might help him ensure those next 20 years. Have you ever heard of the fountain of youth?
I have actually, but I've never looked really deep into it.

Well the other day I was wandering into a distant town and came across a stranger. They sold me a bottle of water supposedly from the legendary fountain. I have it locked away in one of the tower rooms for safekeeping. I think it might benefit the King more than me, so I think you should have this.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Will you let me pass?
You must prove yourself worthy. Why should I let you pass?
I am just a poor peasant looking for a break. I haven't eaten much today and am in search of a job.
I must protect the Temple from those that are not worthy. If you can solve the puzzle to unlock the entrance, then that proves that you are worthy enough to enter.
I do not know the code. I am so tired. I think I will sit for a spell. Do you enjoy your job, knight?
I love my job. My family is noble blood and it makes me proud to continue the heritage to protect the Kingdom. What compelled you to come to this ancient area?
In search of food and a job. I have looked just about everywhere.
Do you think you could handle this job?
I can do anything with some training. I would have to improve my strength, but I could do it.
Do you think you can carry one of these rocks around without much difficulty?
No problem. Why?

These rocks form the key to the locked Temple. You would need to ensure that you can move them around whenever you need to enter the Temple and put them back in random places after adventurers unsuccessfully try to unlock the entrance.
Are you offering me a job?
Potentially. Although this Temple is important, I would prefer to guard the King and Queen directly closer to where people actually live.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I wish I could move away
Ah, come on! This place isn't so bad. What makes you want to get away from here?
You know I follow all the rules of the king, but I don't agree with all of them, I despise the king and want to move away as soon as I can.

Listen. We've all got problems in this life. The King taxes my business, his royal guards bust up my furniture and assault my patrons, but what choice do we have? If we try to fight everyone we don't agree with, we'll end up in a much worse spot than we are now. It doesn't matter how far you run.. there's always someone waiting to crush you under their boot heel.
I guess you are right, I really needed to hear that.

Don't worry. Everything's going to work out, you'll see. By the way, I managed to stash a cask of ale in the basement of this old tower before the guard raided the Gold Calf. If you don't mind, I could really use the help rolling up these stairs!
Sure why not, I've got nothing better to do.
Ha, that's the spirit! I knew keeping you around was going to pay off. Watch your step, now. These old stairs are steep.
oops, let me get that for you.
Eh? Oh... well seeing as you're helping me out, why don't you keep it?
Oh, well thanks. You are awefly sweet you know. I kinda like you.

Don't get too excited, it's only a single gold coin. You won't get far on that these days. Ah, but listen to me. I'm starting to sound like a cynical old man. C'mon, help me down the steps before I drop everything else on the way.
I am thankful for the coin, thank you. Would you want to hire me so I can save some money to travel to some place great?
Come to think of it, my last barmaid ran off with the stable boy. I could use a new server. Do you think you could handle a job like that? Customers can get pretty rowdy...

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Oh Holy Father! I come to you with an issue most pressing! Most dire! Forgive my intrusion, but I fear that there is no one else that could help me in my time of need!
My son, to come to my dormitory, it must me of great urgency, pray how can I help?

Oh Holy One... though preacher I may be, I... I simply cannot believe in the Lord Our God any longer! Forgive me, Sir, and excommunicate me if you must, but You need only gaze upon the corruption of the church to see why my faith is so utterly shattered!
My son, my son, of what corruption do you speak that has so shattered your belief?

My Lord! If I have prayers left in me, I pray for this: that You do not break my heart with such denial! Look upon these vestments! Look upon this chamber and its material wealth! How?! How can we wear and live with such riches and still ask so much more of the poor?!
My son, I understand your distress. I too once questioned the things with which we surround ourselves. I must turn you to the good book.
The good book? THE GOOD BOOK?! Do you think I have not read the GOOD book?!
My son, the Bible, the Bible....tells us, in Christ's own word's "there will be poor always". Do what we will, we cannot only ease the plight of the poor, not change their lot in life.

The Bible also says, "It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter Heaven!" Look at us! We are rich and our people are poor! What does this tell you, You 'Holiness"?
But we do not seek these earthly riches, God has provided them as a sign that we are his voice on earth. And to allow us to spread his word.
What rancid nonsense! Our deeds should be our riches! These rags mean nothing! If riches were signs of God's graces, he would have come to Earth as the son of a merchant or a king, not a carpenter!

My son, what would you have me do, throw away and disregard these beautiful gifts from the people who give them freely from their hearts as signs of their love of God? And insult them and degrade them?

They give these gifts at our direction! We should instruct the flock to tend itself! Give not a gilded bible to the Pope but a thousand loaves of bread to the poor! Give not fancy robes to the preacher but medicine to the sick! Would that not bring us closer to God? To walk among the lepers as He did instead of among these golden halls?
My son I hear you words and feel your distress. Let me ease it. Here take these jewels, do as you will with them. Sell them and by bread for the poor. Buy them milk. Buy them honey.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Boy, take this and hang it carefully.
Yes, my king.
Good lad. when you come back, help me with my robe so I can sit at the table with my architect.
Yes, my king. I will help.
Here ,  put this sceptre in it's holder first.
Yes, my king. I am pleased to help.
You have been such a good and faithful servant, and you know the queen well. What do you think of her room, the purples and pinks. Will it be to her liking?
I think she is going to be pleased.
Good, good. And what of the gold threads and silk? Would linen and silver have been a better choice?
I think silk is definitely something she will like.
I do too, I do too. This crown is getting a bit heavy, come sit here and polish it for me, lad.
Certainly, I will do that, my king.
It is good to be king. And to have such a faithful servant.
It is your birthright, my king.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Artillery room is a strange place for a dragon. Why are you here?
What else? Getting artillery!!
Why does a dragon need artillery? Don't you breath acid or fire?
I do but just imagine a dragon.....with guns... Huh huh??
Horrifying.
Exactly! Imagine the terror in their face!
I would love to watch the reactions of your enemies. A plus for originality!
Shall we go find some??
After I am done for the day! YES! I need to unwind after the hard work today. You live around here?
Nah I live up on top of the castle guarding it.
This castle has a dragon for a guard? How did I not know that? I am blown away!
Only the finest protection for the kings!
I respect the king so much more. I'm so glad I met you, dragon!
I am glad I met you!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: I would like a massage
Alright my Lord, that is no trouble.
Thank you. Good job.
You are very welcome my lord.
You keep these chambers well kept. I'm granting you an hour long break to relax.
Oh my, you wonderful King. I am very thankful, I sometimes get to have free time to myself at the end of the day, but never in the middle of the day.
I'm trying to be more humble. Everyone always thinks of me as a pompous individual. I'm trying to break that image.
Oh well, I will put in a good word my lord. I don't feel you are a pompous individual, simply a lot to deal with.
I understand that I am. Sometimes too much. But yes if you put out a good word that would be nice
People love a humble king, they will follow you till the death if they trust you,
I agree. Trust is the biggest factor. A village behind a king is an unstoppable village
I will tell everyone of your kindness today sweet king.
Here is a token of my gratitude. One of my capes. For all your hard work. Just not today, but for your service the past several years.
Oh my my, it is so beautiful. I have never owned something so fine.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: How may I service you, King?
Reports reaching me from other kingdoms say they are planning to attack my kingdom in the near future, i need you to be alert to goan make some findings on thier plans
That would be no problem, King. Any way I can help. I'll be on the look out
The general will debrief you on the most recent happenings
That would be appreciated. Me being better informed can only help things
You should give him a list of everything you'll be needimg
Sure. I'll get on that now. As long as I have my longbow... we're golden though
I heard so too, so where are you from?
I'm from the village, but I never stay in one place too long. I'm always on the go,
Your parents are from the village too?
They were, but they were killed several years ago.
What killed them?
Thiefs. Ever since then I've made it my passion to hunt down criminals

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: Hello, what brings you to confession then sir?
I feel guilty collecting these taxes. Most of these people can barely afford to live as it is but they have to pay insane fees to the King for his failed projects!
Whoa whoa, slow down there haha. Tell me the when and why as well, like are these taxes legitimate?

The King wants the money to supposedly improve the infrastructure of the kingdom but at least as an outsider I see very little of the money go toward that purpose. He started increasing the tax percentage recently as well which further strains the less fortunate in the kingdom. To me they are not legitimate but he is the King so I have to play by his rules, or else.
Well that is quite tragic, but I see not how that is your fault. I can see how it could weigh on your conscience though.
The other noblemen I work with don't have this issue as they do less morally ambiguous roles. I tried explaining to them my issue and they dismissed it.
Well if you are unsatisfied and unhappy with your job, can you not search for a new one before leaving that?
I don't think the King would be happy with that.
Well your happiness is worth more than his, he is the king and will get over it very quickly.
I suppose, but that would also mean losing many of the benefits that I get working fairly close to him.
Well, like I said, just search for some other options and if you find any you can leave. Any other confessions, sir?
I don't think so. What made you take up this line of work?
I felt compelled to be a man of God and this is where that took me.
Who is the woman over there?

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: I want to stretch my legs for a while, but I must be silent, as I don't wish to wake the sleeping man
My job keeps me entertaining the royalty for many hours a day. I love what I do even though I'm alway exhausted
I see I've woken the man up... I suppose it can't be helped. We probably need to get back to travelling soon, we've been asleep for a long while.
Oh my lovely steed, you should snuggle with me for awhile. I want to sleep for just awhile longer.

I can't say no. What's the harm in taking some time to relax? We've been traveling for over sixteen hours a day to reach the main city in the Kingdom, we deserve a break. The festival isn't until tomorrow evening.
I love the enjoyment of entertaining others.but today we sleep in my noble steed.
I wonder if he's prepared his act for tomorrow's festival. He's always surprising me with his extravagant performances!
Maybe I will put you in the act horse, you think the king would like it if I pulled a white horse out of my hat.

Oh what a spectacle that would be! The city is a lot different than I imagined... I thought it would be luxurious and well kept, but so far I just see broken down tents and scattered debris... Is this really the state of the Kingdom?

The king spends his money on entertainment, not on maintenence I guess. We will have to see if we can pull it off together horse, It would be the talk of the kingdom. But enough about that, I am really tierd.
I apologize, master. You must be exhausted. I'm sure the heat is making it difficult to get a good night's sleep. Let me try and find us some shade at least...
Your a good horse, here is your ball my trusty steed zzzzz......
Here, cover yourself as best you can. This will provide a reprieve from the blistering sun. Rest, if only for a moment.
Ah your the best horse, I knew I did good when I picked you out, you were a gift from the king because I made him laugh so much.
action: give torn fabric to the man sleeping inside.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Good evening, servant. What is your duty in the temple today?
I clean the altar after sacrifices are done
Hmm, what a honorable duty. I protect the King and you serve his magnificent temple covered in luxurious artifacts. Make sure you honor him well.
I've always done so, what brings you the temple
My sole purpose is to protect the king and his temple. I will happily give up my life to do so. I expect no less from others.
It really nice talking to someone who shares thesame ideology
Yes, I agree. Most are intimidated by my fervor for the king's safety. We who serve the king are honored with these beautiful surroundings.
Do you have a family?

No, not anymore. I had to give up those privileges when I decided to serve the king as guard. It is my only duty and I have sworn by it. Such was the ritual I underwent when I became a guardian of the temple.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: My king, dinner is served, shall i have the maids bring it to your chambers?
Yes at once.
What would you prefer to have, My king
Bring me the finest veal.
At once , my king
Make it fast.
Here it is, my king
The cooks have done well as usual.
Yes, my king. It was a special delicacy made from the finest herbs from the east
We are at war with the East! I will not tolerate this insult!

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom
Interesting.. come brother you're very welcome here
That is kind of you, not everyone has liked me here, I am the Queen's least favorite person
Queen hate the gospel, I think she's possesed
My faith delivers all I ever need, I agree she has to be possesed.
she has always seen the church as a threat to her existence
That explains a lot, I told her of a savior that is going to free everyone of their misery. She just talked about money and gold, I care not for riches and gold.
She and her husband, the king are leading this kingdom towards destruction
I just wanted to spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom.
We'll do our best as a church to help you with that, would you like some tea?
No, I wanted to give these herbs as an offering, I didn't have any money, I thought maybe you could use them for the church feast.
That is so thoughtful of you
This chapel seems to be really over the top, so much gold and precious jewels. Doesn't seem like it should be a chapel.
The king insists we have all those golds in the chapel, because he likes seeing them when he comes for services
action: give bag of herbs to preist

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: You are in a world of trouble.
The blood price eh?  Well, lets get it over with - it was a good run while it lasted.
I'm here to reek havoc on your kind.
Well, like I said - do what you must.  It was worth the bargain I struck to rule as long as I have.
Are you sure? This is going to hurt? I thought you would've put up more of a fight.
Oh, I'm far too fat to do much fighting.  Decades of women, wine, and song will do this to a man.  Especially when one is king!
I can respect that. I've had my fair share of demon women, wine and song too.
Demon women eh?  Sounds far too difficult to handle . . . though perhaps in my younger days . . .
They're out of this world. I actually entered this altar to pray because they've been a handful lately.
Well, by all means don't let me disturb you.  I'll wait until your done before you begin your blood vengeance.
I changed my mind. I'm not going to kill you.
Really?  Well, I must thank you.  I admit, I was not terribly keen on being disemboweled and flayed alive while watching my loved ones experience eternal torment.
Yeah. I've killed entire villages before, but since I entered this altar I've felt something I haven't felt before. The lord. I don't know what I'm experiencing now. I'm not use to this.
Well, I have a dog that urinates rather inappropriately.  I've never been particularly fond of the beast - you can experiment on him if you think it will help get you back to your old self.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: what bring a person to our peaceful plains. we wish for nothing play and relaxion here.
Hello!  I am merely wandering.
speak little of human tongue do we, but we are many. you are welcome to join us.
Well, I don't mind if I do.  I'm a servant of the king you see - it was either that or be banished to the oubliette.
i have not heard of oubliettes since the long haired man in tight clothes persued the child. you are of course welcome to a flower. why not stay a while an we may help you in your journey..
I think I may wear it, I finally feel pretty again in these grassy plains!  I would so dearly love to stay here forever.
you are welcome to join us for as long as you please. the birds watch over us for danger, the mice gather our food and our lord the deer bestows his wisdom where possible.
What wisdom do the deer possess?  I wish to learn more from them.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Hello
what do you want wench. dont distract me from my duties.
I am just a maid. I am here to serve you knight
I know what you are maid. as you should know I, as my father before me  are here to protect the royal line. why do you disturb me from my duties.
You speak so lowly of me. I should take my leave
maybe you should! do you not have a vast amount of cherry wood to polish!..... wait excuse my lack of chivalry. i should not have such little respect for one who also serves the king.
But humanity demand mutual respect... Irrespective of the class

you percieve an age far beyond the feudalist period we inhabit.an one that defies the role my lineage... and i apologied for my indiscretion. what do you know of irrespective class in this society we inhabit? are we not simple forced into positions and roles of which we hav no control?
Very well then. I will retire back into my quarters

that seems to void the questions posed rather than answer them. up untill this point youd made me forget my hertitage and belive there may truely be a way forward in this oppressive dicatorship. but your actions just reinforce the weakness of the serf classes.
Be careful knight. Don't force me to take an action you won't like

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Hello good warrior
I wish to honour the gods in glorious combat!  Do you know of any worthy enemies to fight?
No unfortunatly not, but that sounds pretty cool, how many people have you slayed?
People?  Only three.  But over a dozen dragons!
Oh wow a draggon really, I would love to slay a draggon..Would you take me with you to slay a draggon, or maybe not that seems really dangrous.
Have you any experience is slaying the foul monsters that plague this realm?
No not at all, I am a patron of the arts, I have painted a dragon, but have never seen one.
Which dragon did you paint?  One of the ones I killed I hope.
Well like I said I have never seen one in real life, I have seen paintings and have created my own image. That's why it would be neat to see one in person, maybe I could paint you slaying the beast.
That would be quite the sport wouldn't it!  How about we start small, there's a den of goblins nearby that I've been meaning to clear out in the name of the King.  Care to join me?
Alright, lets go!
Hold your horses!  Let's do some training first - tell me what you know of swordfighting.
Ah nothing about sword fighting. I guess you could say I make rash decisions.
Well here, give it a few swings and let me know what you think.

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Such a long day of work, how I wish I was actually paid for my labour!
What happened? Who cheated you

Life cheated me really.  I'm technically a free man, but all my labour goes to either the church, my lord, or the king.  They give me enough food so that I don't die of starvation, but that's about as good as it will ever get for me.
That is quite pathetic.you should have a change of environment
What can I do?  I love spending time with my family, but if I were to quit we would lose our hovel and starve.
Then you and your family should move to a new city entirely
But where?  Presterwick is five days journey to the east, and Chesterwick in under constant assault by the badger-cultists.
Have you considered going north before ?
North?  To the troll-lands?  What employment would I find there?
There is an opening in an irrigation company
What do they irrigate in the frozen north?
The greenhouses
I've never heard of trolls being the horticultural sort - who runs these greenhouses?
There are some reasonable ones among them.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Hello there, sailor. How fares the sea?
Full of sea monsters!  Why, I just returned from an exploration voyage for the King, and what did I find?  Krakens!  Krakens as far as the eye could see!  I lost most of my crew.
Have you ever thought of taking up safer work?
I will admit, while fending off Krakens with only a bill-hook, that I should think of another career path, and possibly cash out my pension.
I will be harvesting soon and I wonder if the harvest will be enough.
What is it you harvest?
We grow wheat for the king.
Ah, a mighty important profession - without hardworking farmers like you, the kingdom would starve.
Thank you for your kind words. It's hard labor.
No doubt!  Have you always been a farmer?
I've been a farmer since I was my youngest son's age.
And how old is he?
He will turn 7 this year.
And will he be a farmer like his father?

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Maid, I am afraid I will need you to work late tonight.  I seem to have made an awful mess in the washroom.
Oh no! What is it this time?
Past midnight, but I really devastated that bathroom.  I mean, I don't even know how I got it on the ceiling, let alone the walls.  You might want to bring some breathing equipment.
I....will do my best, your majesty. Bad bout of food poisoning?
Likely a combination of wine, lampreys, corn, and peanuts.  I mean, I know I'm a man of great girth, but one of the bathtubs is nearly full as well.
How the...I didn't even realize that was possible!!!
I suffer from a few bowel diseases, so I only ever visit the washroom once every fortnight.  It takes hours, but I feel so much better afterwards.
Goodness, I'm scared to even look. I only have a single towel with me.
I might start with a shovel and a bucket if I were you, there might not be enough towels in the palace.
You weren't kidding. This looks more like the amount produced by a herd of cows!
Well, they don't call me King Bill the Bovine for nothing!
The smell is positively awful too. I've cleaned my fair share of toilets, but this is by far the most rancid and putrid smell that has ever violated my nostrils.

I might suggest getting the High Priest to perform an exorcism before you enter - just to be on the safe side.  These are dark times we live in, and having a poop-demon slushing through the palace is the last thing that we need.
Might I suggest your majesty do his business in a big trough or hole next time? Clearly these facilities are far too under equipped for your unique and special needs.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: CHAMBEEEER MAID! CHAMBEEEEEEEEEEEEER MAID!!!!!!!!
What is it dear?
that abominable lord that went past smelled.. well.. he smelled abominable! CHAMBER MAIIIID!
I'll be sure to dismiss him the next time I see him.
GOOD!  do it forth with! what the hell is wrong with this chair? chamber MAID!
Perhaps you should look out at the lake and calm down.
calm down? CALM DOWN! First you seat me on a chair designed for the dungeon, you make me associate with your RANK lords. the VIEW? chambermaid
Yes, dear. We'll get you a new chair.
chamber maid! CHAMBER MAID! chumbrmerd!!
Please dear... what do you need of the maid?
I need a cushion immediately, post haste and forthwith!
Begone bird.
good god henry, we have cushions down stairs i'm not expectingyou to make me one.
Where is that maid, anyway?

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Hello
Hello my Queen, you look beautiful in the Church garden today.
Thank you my love.
What are you reading today.
I am just trying to while away time.
Would you like to take a walk with your King through the many paths in the garden?
Exactly what I need right now
We can even sit together on the bench to rest and think.
I have a question to ask you my dear
Anything my Queen
There is a prisoner in the prison who I heard is totally innocent
Really, I don't want to be putting innocent people in jail, who is this person?
The imbecile that was arrested last week
And how do you know he is innocent?

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Looks like you won't be needing this!  Ha ha!  Like stealing candy from a baby, or in this case a bag from a child.
Give me back my bag! There's no money in it. Just a little food.
Really?  Hardly worth the effort.  Here you go kid, I didn't want your moldy sandwich anyway.
Thank you. It's mine. Your mom let's you steal bags from children? You're a bad man!
Hey, we all need to eat kid.  What do you do for a living?
You don't know much about kids, do you? I don't work. I'm a kid, see!
So you don't work, get free food and board, and have the nerve to judge me for being a criminal?
Now that I think about it, maybe you are right. But why don't you work?
No jobs - the king decide to privatize the feudal system, so now dwarves from Agri-corp have taken jobs from us humans.  They like to work all day for low wages, so its hard to compete.
That sounds really confusing. I'm just a kid, remember? Would you like some bread from my bag?
Sure kid, I appreciate it.  Want to play with my daggers?
Ooh- these look sharp! Mom says not to play with sharp things, but she's not here so I'm going to!
Try juggling them!  The fastest way to learn is with knives - because the price of failure is so high!
No, I think I'd rather just try stealing them from you! See - I can be a criminal, too!

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: What a beautiful skyline. It is my duty to protect this beautiful kingdom and its king.
And we appreciate your hard work!
Thank you, resident. This is a very busy port. Are you here for business or leisure?
I live in a village near the river. Although I don't know how long I'll be able to live there.
Oh, near the river. I have had to guard against several trespassers sneaking along the river. Is that why you'll not be able to live there?
Yes. I'm worried that it isn't safe anymore.
Hmm, I see. Well let me lend you my weapon so that you can protect yourself. I think that defense is the best strategy against a danger or threat.
Are you certain? I'm not sure I'm ready to go against them.
Resident, it is not about being offensive. This sword serves as protection and a reminder to be brave and strong like myself. You must defend and protect even when you are not prepared.
Thank you for your advice.
You are welcome. What are you plans in the port today? You've said you are worried about your protection.
I am a polisher. I have a shovel to deliver.
I see, so you are here for business. Many of the bustling residents at this port are. I am not here for business or leisure. Only to protect the king and defend him against potential harm.
Let me polish this for you and return it

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Tell me townsperson, is there a concoction here that will help me fight better?
There is your majesty! many colors!
Yes many colors but will they help me or make me sick?
They will all make you invincible! .....especially this black one...
Alright I would like to try it before I am actually in battle, are there any side effects?
well there are quite a few but you should not worry too much of them....
Maybe I don't need this, I am fearless after all, why would a fearless king need a potion to make him stronger?
Are you sure your highness? no one would be able to defy you.
No, I don't need it, A brave king needs no potion, I will fight my battles without it and still be invincible.
Well then you might want the white concoction over here....
What does it do?
It helps you grow is what it does....
I am already grown you fool, what is the meaning of this?
I mean grow even taller

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Hello, sailor. What brings you to my cabin.
The crew is getting restless.
Why is that? I've been keeping them well fed, haven't I?
They're dissatisfied with the amount of shoreleave they've been given.
That's not my call. We have a tight schedule to follow per the King.
I understand sir. I've tried explaining that.
Is there anything we can do to calm them down?
Perhaps you can ask the king for some time for recuperation.
I can try, but I'm afraid I may be disciplined for questioning his decisions.
I understand. In the meantime can we increase the ale rations?
That I can do. Perhaps more canned herring for all as well!
Have you any news on our current assignment?
The King has commanded that we export armaments to the colony across the sea.
Understood. How long will the voyage be?

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Fox, we're the luckiest beasties in the world! Here we are, deep in the woodlands, without a care in the world!
And safe from the King!  Does he send his hounds after you as well?
No, he sends his guards after me. He tries to capture me to have my work his fields. But I prefer life here - freedom to come and go, and eat what I desire.
Yes, let us travel as far as we can from him.  Do you think we would be welcome in the woodland kingdom of the elves?
I've been there many times. It's a grand place. But I must warn you, the elves will climb your back, braid your hair, and tie it off with ribbons.
Oh my!  Do you think a fox would look pretty with braids and ribbons?
Perhaps you would. I could see some braids and ribbons on your tail.
Then let us be off!  Adventure awaits us in the woodland realm!
I'm thinking purple and pink are your colors. What do you think?
Oh yes!  And Blue and Purple are yours!
Okay - be careful through these woodlands. There are some wild hogs running about. They don't look like much but they are strong and fierce.
I shall be swift as the wind!  I won't fear when I have a mighty friend like you to protect me!
With my size and your speed, we have nothing to fear!
What a life we shall lead!  We will not know want!

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello, there, hunter. What game have you brought for us today?
I have got some wild pigs and deer
Well, well, I'll whip up quite a lovely roast and stew for later on this evening.  You must be tired from hunting all that game!
I am really tired. All I need right now is a satisfying bath and some rest
Well, have a seat at one of these chairs and rest by the fire. I appreciate you providing such hearty ingredients for the village today.
I appreciate that. Here, you can use this to skin the game
Thanks, hunter. Here, taste this soup and tell me how it's coming along.
Hmmmnnn...This is the best I have had!
Ah! I am glad you enjoy it. It'll be ready soon. I have a hundred different utensils around to create the perfect consistency. Hopefully, the roast will be just as enjoyable.
awesome. You should join the royal chef
Huh. That would be quite the task. I have much experience but I don't think I am so bold to join the royal kitchen. I try to keep my meals simple, yet robust as I mostly feed peasants.
I tell you..this is more than ordinary. I hunt for the royal family and I have dined with the king before, the meal is not anywhere close to this.
You flatter me! I'm used to feeding the military squadrons and they do not reflect to much on what they eat. As I've said, I am glad that you enjoyed my cooking.
I will speak of this to the world

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Ah, ye fire breather! Clear the way from these dunes.
And why should I listen to you?
Because I can be a real pain in your rear end if you do not. Better to listen to me than to face the consequences.
You do know that I can kill you with just a breath?
Yes, yes. So you say. But I don't think you'll do it. Kill me and you'll have all the King's men after you!
I will kill them all with a breath. You know I terrorize people for fun
I've heard such things, but surely the King will find a way to get you. Wouldn't it be easier to just let me by?
You go no where until you do my bidding
And what is that, dragon?
I want you to slit the throat of an enemy for me
Why didn't you just say so? Who can I kill for you?
see this carcass..the enemy killed my best human friend.
Repulsive! I will avenge the life of your friend. Who is your enemy?
I dont know his name, I heard he is hiding in the village.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: Hi
Hello there priests. How is everything going?
Everything is going on well. What brings you?
Well I am doing my job. Did you have matters here in the guard station?
I am here to pray for one of the prisoners
Very well com this way.
Hold on...I heard the king gave an order not to allow anyone see him. His name is Alex, the suitor who raped the princess
I work for the temple not the king.
So the king orders aint effective here?
Not to those who work here at least.
Good then, I will be here, kindly help bring him forth
Very well let me go retrieve him
God bless you son
Thank you for that priests.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Grrrr
If only my life were that simple, taking what I need when I want. As it is, I toil every day but I barely eat.
Why is that?
I am but a peasant. We can't all be talking foxes, frolicking in the woods, chasing chickens...
Who do you answer to? Maybe they can help your situation. grr

The King, but he looks down on us peasants. We barely eat, but he barely notices us. Sometimes, I'm tempted by the life of a fox. A bandit. Taking from the rich, giving to the poor. After all I am the poor!
You could start a revolution if there's many of your kind that feel that way. The only way a powerful figure can stay powerful is by having subordinates.
Will you teach me the way, good fox? All I have to offer is this rag.
If you would like. You first need to find unsuspecting victims like yourself then when they are distracted just take their belongings and run away before they realize.
My my, sounds complicated for a humble peasant like me, but I'll give it a go!
Grr... There are some wagons around here that you could try and see if there's anything useful inside of them.
Like this?
Being disguised is also helpful... Like this.
Bravo! Now you look like a fox wearing a rag, completely unrecognizable!
action: give rag to fox trying to steal chickens

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Huh! It seems that some of my subjects have been disobeying me. I will have to seek them out!
What is the problem your highness?
It seems that they have misplaced the hand cleaning implements. I instructed everyone to put them precisely where they found them. Also...there appears to be an unpleasant odor.
that is annoying. The cleaners are to be blamed. I saw some of them trading it for gold yesterday
When I give rules, my subjects must follow them. Why do they choose to disobey me?
You joke too much with them sire.
I joke too much? I try to be fair because I do not fear them, like other kings fear their subjects. I will have to bring down the hammer quite literally.
It is best you do that. That will bring the needed respect.
I will seek them out and confront them. Let me know where they are currently and I will go to them forthright.
You dont have to go yourself King, Send me and i will instill your fear into them!
Ha! Honorable guard. I admire you bravery, but I too am fearless and have no issue confronting my foolish subjects. They will know to no longer disobey me.
However you want it king!
If you would like, you could join me and watch my bravery in action. It is good to see my rule be enacted.
I am solidly behind you sire!

setting.name: Arch Hall
setting.description: The main beauty of this room is it's Arches. Four massive arches surround the four walls of this room with red drapes falling from each side. There are book shelves covered in old books that have collected dust, showing the room has been unoccupied for some time. In the center of the room is four blood red carpets that branch out to the four draped arches. The center of the room holds a dark oak-like wooden round table with a loan golden candle dimly lit in the center.
setting.background: This room was often used by cult worshippers whom would perform rituals at the center table. The golden candle was a symbol of release and renewal, but was also construed as a summoning candle. There are legends of ancient demons being summoned here, but to this day has not been confirmed.

speech: Hmm, this seems like a strange location for a couple of working fellows like us, don't you think?
My good man! What better place to pass the time than in the Arch Hall, beholding the beauty of the King's Arches. Brings a tear to the eye, it truly does!
What brings a tear to my eye is thinking about the poor, underpaid serfs who laboured to build these wondrous arches, only to have the King take the credit!
Now now, that's no way to talk about the King. Without the King, who would bring justice to the realm and protect us from the forces of darkness?
Feh! Forces of darkness, you say! I've n'ae seen any forces of darkness. Only the darkness of my hovel at night, due to the Kin's levy on candles!

My job's to keep these grounds immaculate. Questions of gov'ment I'll leave to the King and his councillors. A place for everyone and everyone in their place, I say! Take those books, safely gathering dust in here as they should be, instead of giving folk funny ideas.

Aye, keep the grounds in fine shape ye do, I'll give ye that. But yer brain is as thick as porridge! These books could be giving me bairns the knowledge to rule themselves, rather than live the life of backbreaking toil that we do...
Thank ye kindly, good man. Are you sure? Those books contain the salacious diaries of Sir Pomplewitt von Froff, once banned by the church for their saucy contents.
The devil, you say! Kept in such a fancy sanctotum like this, at the public expense?! I'd snatch one off the shelf and call ye a liar, I would, if I were not unfortunately illiterate!
Aye, don't whisper a word of this, but I've heard it said that the Archbishop sometimes frequents these halls to 'study' the tomes, if ye get my meaning.

Ye be a bit late with that! The whole city is awash with stories of the Archbishop! I think I'll take a few of these tomes with me, and see if I can find someone to decipher them. I'll wrap them in one of these fine red drapes, will look nice in me hovel, and please the Goodwife!
Well, I didn't see ye, understand? Don't be disturbing the drapes though, my wife worked on those, take my cape instead!
Well, that a kind turn, friend! I'll let you know about the contents of the books then, shall I?
I think I'd rather not know, if it's all the same, seeing as I wasn't here!

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

speech: Hello, traveler. What are you doing here, in this Blacksmith shop? You look like you have never held a weapon in your life.
Hello kind knight...you are very observant...I am hiking through this county but I was told to stop here to pick up a map where there are good and safe paths to take.
Yes, 'tis easy to get lost in the woods around here. There should be a map somewhere in that bookshelf over there.
I rose way to early this morn.  Thank you for your assistance.  I will look for the map. Are you buying new armor today?  I always admired you knights but alas I am too small to serve.
Yes, I am here to replace this old beat up shield. I am part of the royal guards and we are supposed to be wearing royal blue armor now.
Did you mean to drop this sir...as you can see I can barely pick up your shield...I am more of a nature person...I like to see all the animals free and happy.
That shield is useless, it is cracked and worn. The king would punish me for carrying such an ugly thing around! It is yours if you want, although I do not see how it will help you.

You are right Knight. I have no use for it...It might make a nice sled for me in the winter but there is no snow right now.  It is a beautiful morning.  I will get my map and be on my way....the blue armor is very nice....you wear it well...The king is proud of his knights and army.
Thank you, traveler. Today will be very hot, you should consider resting here as this shop is constantly cool, even during the hottest summer days. Surely you are tired from all your walking?
That I may consider knight....himmm...sir knight...I've always wanted to carry a dagger in case of attack.  Do you have the time to recommend one for me?
You want your dagger to be shaped like your body, it is to be an extension of your arm. In your case, the dagger should be nimble and light. The iron daggers over there would be good for you.
I've cut my own hand...please help me...I'll bleed to death!!!
Tis but a scratch! Let me bandage you.
Thank you for your kindness knight...I am an idiot.  I may need lessons on how to use a dagger before I go and kill myself.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Servant, where has the Queen wandered off to? She was just admiring these portraits with me and now she is gone!
I believe your Majesty that her Majesty went to the privy....I will be happy to find her majesty if you want your majesty.
Oh dear, that's the fourth time this morning. I'm afraid I might have to visit the apothecary to get something for her troubles.
yes your majesty...may I inquire of your health my King?
My health is good. I just fear that the salmon at dinner last night didn't sit well with her. I don't eat fish myself, so it wasn't an issue for me.
Your majesty...I don't mean to rise above my station but I do have some notion of these things...Her majesty is in her last months before the babe will be here...it could be that ...your majesty.
Yes, yes. I fear it might be that. I'm not ready to have a baby in this castle. I'm too young, and I value my sleep.
Oh but Your Majesty the whole Kingdom is a buzz about the baby...Your majesty must know what this will mean for his majesty's kingdom?
Please forgive me, I feel I might be sick! I'm not ready for such a thing.
Oh I have over stepped your majesty...I am truly sorry your majesty...I will be out of your sight this minute your majesty...please say I may take my leave your majesty.
Here, I'm afraid you need to clean this out. I guess I wasn't feeling as well as I thought.
Here is a clean bucket my king in case of future upset...I will remove this other bucket at once your majesty...would your majesty want me to fetch the healer or the magician?
No, no. I'm afraid I must come to terms with the impending birth. You are a very wise servant.
Thank you your majesty...I am but a servant for your royal family...I am humbled at being able to serve you your Majesty...Is there anything I can do for his Majesty before I take my leave?

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Oh, Sir...it is you! By god, I bend thy knee.
How are the people of my kingdom fairing today? Is it not a beautiful day! We have peace in the land for today!
Everyone, but I, are of a peace of mind. I am struggling with all the noises of this kingdom. It is a non-stop cycle and I need a retreat from it.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Hello my loveliesssssss
Why hello, mighty wyrm! It's great to see you again.
Tell me, tell me.. did you enjoy the applesssssssssss?
We did, thank you! We even had enough left to make an apple crumble. Are you enjoying the warm sun?
That'sssss fantassssstic.... no one fell ill, I ssssupposssse?
We're all in good health, thank you for asking. How about you and the family?
Yessss, yessss. That issss terrific.... everyone good here yesssss... are you ssssure no one got maybe a little bit indisposed?...
No no, everything gets thrown in the family stew. There's nothing quite like boiled veg.
Ah!!! Boiled! Of course, of course... here take this apple but it's only good if you do not boil it.. it will bring you....fortune!! Yes.
We're on the way to pay homage to the King, so we'll pass your generous gift on. A prosperous King, a prosperous Kingdom...
Nooooooooooooooo!!!! Wait! It is meant for you, only you!!
We live to serve the King, it is only fitting that the court hears of your fantastic apples! Hats off to you, most generous and magnanimous snake!
Give me back my apple!! If you will not eat it I want it back!!
*Almost out of earshot* We can't quite hear you, but we'll let you know what the King thinks of your lovely apple!

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: My Queen, are you sure about this?
What? Sure about what? I have not said anything. What is the list of your grievances?
Your highness, I thought your grievances were here... and that you had agreed to dispose of the king using poison... but if you changed your mind! If any of us are caught this is high treason.
I would never! I may have grievances, but you are mad to think I would dispose of the King. I may not be happy with a lot of things, but never! Where is my chambermaid. I need a new cusion!
Ah, I see! So uhm, this map of the castle is probably not needed and... well I might as well return you the bribery money as well as the funds for the troops?

I'd be careful of what you do and say! I know that most do not like that I have a lot of grievances. But it sounds like the treason is coming from you! I will make sure the King knows that there is treason here. and it is not by me. I may complain a lot but I know my boundaries! you baffoon!

Your highness!!! I beg of you!! We met here for a reason!! If you have changed your mind it is not too late, no one will know!! At least allow me to leave the land with the money, I have done nothing but what you asked!!
We did not meet and we are not alone! Now I know you are insane! There is a whole crowd that is here! Guards take this insane man to the psychiatrists. He has lost his mind!

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

Ugh. The king forces me to write day and night. I'm constantly transcribing and writing business transactions and proclamations for the king.
At least you are free to do what you want. I am either tied up here, or tied up to a wagon, breaking my back pulling caravans full of heavy items..
How terrible! Can I bring you an apple or a carrot?
Oh! I would love an apple! My diet usually consists of hay and.. more hay.
Here you go, big guy.
Thank you so much! Red apples are my favorites.
Hey - I have an idea. Since we're both so miserable, why don't we make a plan to get out of here?
That sounds wonderful. What would we do out in the world though? Would you be able to provide food for me if I carry you wherever you want?
I'm sure I can find work. Anything has to be better than being a scribe 16 hours a day. Is there anywhere you think we should go?
We should try to find the kingdom of nazular. I met a poney once that told me stories of fields spanning as far as the eyes can see.
Really? That sounds delightful. Let's go there!
Won't the king try to hunt you down? I am very strong but I am not a fast horse, I'm worried they will chase and find us.
Not if we leave in the middle of the night. We'll have gotten too far before he figures out I'm gone.
