setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Haha, smithy! Bet ye never seen anyone juggle with your knives!
Let's see you juggle this
You're a funny one, that hammer is too heavy and unbalanced! Are you trying to get me to boink my own head?
I'll make you a second hammer so you can juggle two of them
I thought you were a dagger maker! It says you sell knifes right there on your sign! Why would you make me a hammer?
I can make any item as long as it is made of metal
You should make yourself a metal mask to hide that ugly smug face! Ha Ha!
you're not funny. I'll go melt this now
Hey give that back! It is a prop I need to entertain the king tonight during his dinner. If I am not funny he will behead me!
Too bad for you. I thought you could juggle knives anyway
The king will know about this! I work in the royal court. This is your last warning.
Whoops in the fire that goes. Good luck with the king
Wait until I throw a show right on your chin, you silly smithy!

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Hello
Hello. What are you doing here?
I am the stable boy in charge of the horses..I just feel like seeing what is happening here
Well be careful. Some of the guards don't like it when other people are in here
I find that strange...why is it so?
Well would you like other people hanging out where you sleep?
Not that. The guards know me very well. I tend the horses...
Well unfortunately not much is happening here until tomorrow. Are the horses prepared for battle?
Yes, I saw to that very early this morning. Tell me, what does it feels like to be a guard?
It's the best feeling in the world to know you are protecting the king. Do you think you'll try to be one when you are older?
I think I will
Well good luck. It is truly an honor to become a guard. Have you ever held a sword before?
I tried it once but the weight almost injured me.
Yeah they can be very heavy. Would you like a tour of the training room?

setting.name: the mysterious shop's entrance
setting.description: The shop has a look of mysterious foreign artifacts and luxuries, with silks and other materials adorning the walls. There are various trinkets from all around the world as well as spices of different colors and odors.
setting.background: The shop is stocked by goods traded through traveling merchants who have traveled to far away lands. It carries novel items that can't be easily found in other stores in the town.

speech: Come in, come in! I have wonderful products at spectacular prices!
This place seems odd, the king asked me to investigate your shop. What do you sell exactly?
Only the finest and rarest of oddities in all the land!
What is this strong smell?
Ah, yes. The terrible rose we call it. Sort of a gag gift for the people you hate in your life.
It is aptly named! Tell me, I love swords of all kinds. Do you have any sharp weapons from exotic lands?
Oh, yes! If it's weapons you seek, look no further! I carry the Pike of Lucious! No man who wields it has ever lost a battle!
How did it end up in your possession then? Surely whoever possessed it previously died?
Erm...ancient family heirloom. I'm not much of a fighter though!
Sure... anyways, can you look in your wares for a sword similar to this one? Mine is getting dull.
Hrmm, let me see. Ah yes, let me check my supply. Ah, how about this one? Fabulous Hilt on this one!

I like it, it's perfectly balanced. I will put in a good word to the king for your shop. He was worried when he heard stories of weird artifacts being sold here, but it seems like he has nothing to worry about. How many copper pieces for this fine weapon?
You are very kind! However, copper simply won't do it for this piece. Usually it would cost 8 silver, but for you fine sir, I'll take 5.
Hmmm, fine. I guess quality items aren't cheap. It better not break in half during my first combat though!

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Hello, priest. The king will be visiting this church in three days and I have to make sure everything is clean for him.
Can I help you with something? I live to help others and I can spare the time
Well, we have to light this whole place with thousands of candles. The king's eyesight is getting worse by the day.
I have a few candles to spare, here you go,
Good, good. We will also have to fix the clock up there. Do you know why it is not showing the time anymore?
Hold my bible please, it seems like one of its pieces is stuck, we might have to call the clock master of Babenburg
He better be able to fix it, otherwise he will be whipped proper!
Dont worry, he always delivers, I will bless this clock and everything will be alright, we wouldnt want to upset the king,

Thanks. I don't like whipping people but the king personally beats me when something does not please him. I don't like being ruthless but it is needed to ensure everything is immaculate. I hope god can forgive me for that.
Its a good thing youare honest, I hate lies, they are pure sin, the king will like the cravings of angels in stone I hear he is a religious man
Yes, although we will have to clean them up a little bit as they appear to be as old as this church!
Ok my son, lets prey and we will start with the cleaning, give me my bible fact so I can read a verse from the sacred book
Here. I have memorized most verses, will you allow me to recite it with you?
Sure, that would be great my son, lets prey together

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: HI
Hi, guard. What brings you to the Gold Room?
I heard some noise in here, so i came to check what is going on
Well the only noise I've heard is from this old cat
you shouldnt be here to start with
Why not? This is where I've been assigned to clean
The heard guard didn't tell me that. I need to get the permission form the head guard first
Ok, please do. You'll find me here serving our king, honorable guard
Very well then. Go ahead and clean it up as quickly as possible.
Have you heard any more talk of the plot to overthrow the king?
you really need to lower your voice.
Ok, I'll whisper from now on
The king younger brother is behind it all
Oh my! Really? That's dreadful. Since when?

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: Greetings, lady. I come from the distant kingdom of Frurolia. I was sent by my king.
Hello. I am glad to see representatives from Frurolia here. May I tell you something that may be hurtful?
Please, go ahead lady.
I have  very sensitive nose.  You have a foul smell coming off you.
I am so sorry! I come from far away and I have not had the chance to take a bath yet.
I understand. Now, did you bring me a new cushion for my throne? King of Frurolia said they have the softest cushions there!
I have, but the king ordered me to give you the pillows only if we can come to an arrangement.
What are you wanting to arrange ?
The king of Frurolia would like to be given the right of passage through your land to attack the kingdom of Blumoria. Spies have told us they are planning a war and we would like to strike first.
Oh of course!  The Kingdom of Blumoria has been on our minds also.  Do you want to become allies in this war to come?
I would have to discuss this with our King but I believe he would accept to ally with you to defeat our common enemy.
Of course I understand. Now for the cushion?

It appears to be stuck to my clothes, surely the sun melted the fabrics together. You will have to excuse me Lady, alas I cannot give it to you. I can make sure a wagon full of cushions is brought to you as fast as possible, though.
What on earth!!!! This is a disaster. Where is my chambermaid.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: You may approach the throne and state your business.
Hello dear king! I come from the royal kingdom. I am here to discuss the recent treaty voilations on your part and what we can do to fix them.
The only royal kingdom I am aware of is the one you are standing in. What is this nonsense?
Here sir you may read this paper if you would like, it states that the northern kingdom of eldersville is unhappy with the way you are doing buisness.
Well, I simply do not agree with these claims. In no way have my troops violated our border agreement.

But sir, your recent merchants have been accompanied by city guards, they have been disrespecting and stealing from the other merchants and we dont want to have any problems. I am just here to peacefully request that you stop.
Well, this is the first I've heard of these accusations. You tell King Tibberuss that it I will look into this unlikely trespass.
Okay sir but thats not all. King Tibberuss has recently found a spy in his city gates, he confessed to be working for you after countless hours of torture, is this true?
Do you see this, Crown? Do you know who I am? If your "king" wanted to spit countless accusations at me, he should have done it to my face instead of sending some low level diplomat!
Sir, my king has been very busy and has directly sent me here to cooperate with you to avoid any future wars. I think we both know who would be destroyed if a war did happen.
ENOUGH! Guards, apprehend this man.
Please wait king. I have a gift for you sent from my kingdom. Maybe you will appreciate the gesture. It is a pen for your chickens!
Oh, Tibberuss, you old softy. I do love my chickens.
I knew we could agree on something! Thank you king I will report back to Tibberuss right away!

get a pen for the chickens

setting.name: bazaar outside the royal city
setting.description: The Bazaar is located between the village and the royal city. It is busy with many street shops for weary travelers. Many different types of fruits, meats, and weapons can be bought outside these wooden stands.
setting.background: The Bazaar is a place for travelers to rest up and refill their supplies. Many sellers and family go through here to get to the royal city. It is a long, rough path to the city and this place serves as a place to meet up and socialize with others.

speech: Good day dear guard, how are you?
Im great, what business do you have in town
I have travelled for 40 days, I am weary and wonder if there's any vacancy at your local inn, but firstly I have come to the bazar to get some water and nuts
Do you have coin? you can turn back if you dont, no inn will take you without money
I have this blade only, I found it in the belt of a dead warrior, it must be worth something, it is encrusted with jewels
Now were talking, there are many shops around time Im sure you can get decent coin for that article, its a royal city and that kind of sword is valued by nobles
fantastic my friend! Great to hear. Please, if you will, point me in the direction of the person who will offer me the best price
Ok so if you take a left on the street up ahead you will reach Mohinders Legendary Weapons shop, the owner is a bit odd but he will give you a fair price for the blade
Ok, thank you my friend!
No problem, let me know if you need anything else traveller, if not I need to return to my dutty and protect the king
Here, take this friend, its to be a cold night, and with my new found riches i'll be able to buy another. Thank you for your help.
Thanks, it can be cold out here, I appriciate your kindness, you are welcomed to return any time you like traveller
You're welcome friend, and thank you. Its always good to know that you're  welcome somewhere, especially if you are a traveller and become weary as myself!
Just tell others about the hospitality of the town and tell them to bring coin, the king doesnt like poor outsiders
action: give a sleeping bag to guard

setting.name: cactus field entrance
setting.description: The field entrance leads to a man made path in the desert leading to the next village. It is hot and barren. There is barely any form of plants or animals besides a few cactus. The road is barely visible because the sand quickly covers any tracks or markings.
setting.background: The desert is a very unkind place to all. It is dangerous and many have died wandering around looking for water and treasures. Many have heard stories of the cactus field and its mysterious placement in the middle of nowhere. Very few actually survive to reach these fields, and no one has come back to tell about it.

speech: Brrrr! So cold out today.
I love it! The colder the less people out to ruin my day and stop my eating!
Well, that makes sense. How are you, vulture?
I am good now that I got this trash heap.
Looks like it's about to warm up. I see the cactus field entrance!
Only thing cactus means for me is dry. Dry land! Dry plants! NO animals! No tasty trash.
Sorry! You'd better eat while you can. It's about to get barren quickly.
Which is why I brought this all the way here to enjoy. What are you doing out here alone?
I am on the run. What brings you out this way?
Run?! From what?
Well...I kissed the princess and the king found out. He sent the guards after me.
Oh such a silly thing! But it is the king, and he will have what he wants.
Exactly. He's prety easily annoyed these days what with the rumors that someone is plotting to overthrow him.
He should not take such a thing out on you, but if he wants to, then he will.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: hello
Why are you talking to me?  Is this a trap?
I know for sure that you can speak
I was taught as a young rat and that is why I am the Rat King.  But what is an old man like you doing in this horrible mass grave created by a cruel king?
I came here to mourn dear rat!
Who have you lost?
I lost all my friends... I am all alone
All your friends are in this pile?
Yes. Their bodies are among those
If you would like I could find them and bring you mementos if they have any.
I need to stay a little far back then. Yes, kindly help do that
I do require payment for this service.  Nothing in life is free.
Name your price.
Your cane!  I like the jewel in the top.

agents: graveyard keeper who lives across the yard

setting.name: The Grand Desert
setting.description: The Grand Desert seems to go for miles. The sand is golden and the sun glistens over the endless mounds. There are tents of all different colors scattered throughout the Grand Desert. Magenta and gold, blue and green, all different color combinations of triangular tents outline the sand mounds. Camels and palm trees are seen in the vast distance. The sky looks extraordinarily blue against the tents and sand. No clouds are in sight.
setting.background: The Grand Desert is the King's getaway from royal life. He goes there every year for a break from the kingdom. Here he will be greeted by dancing girls, delicious Arabian meals, and relax far from the stresses. At night he will sit by the fire and listen to the music while others dance in delight.

character: the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
speech: Oh camel. I'm not sure why I have to travel this desert just to dig a grave.
Is that why they brought you along? I've never seen you in our caravan before
Yes. I have to dig a royal grave.
How far must you travel?  The next town we'll arrive at is Tadasesh, and there are no kings there
I am staying in this Desert. I'm not sure why I have to bury him here. Don't you see his casket with us?
Sometimes merchants use such things to smuggle gems and spices past the guards; I gave it no thought
It's a dead body! Don't you smell it?
Kings and beggars smell the same once they're dead
Very true. How come you are able to talk camel?
I'll let you in on a secret. The merchant up there, in the orange robe, is actually a wizard! This jewel lets me understand and talk in human speech
Wow!  The fact that you are able to talk stunned me silent for a moment. My apologizes.
It can come in useful. Most folk do not concern themselves about being overheard by a camel, so I hear things others might not
That is very useful. I hear nothing digging graves.
So who is this king you are burying?
