She is crazy thing always talking to herself about loosing the crown, I think she may be on to you
I am far to sly for this queen. What kind of crazy things?
She does these mantras, "you are the best queen you can be" and things like that.
Come now spider. I know you must have heard something I can profit from. I need to buy my freedom. When I'm free I will take you with me and you will have all the bugs you could ever eat.
Well I did notice she was awefly freindly with a guard the other day.
Now we're talking the same language. Which guard was it? The tall one with the mustache or the short one with the huge biceps?
The tall one, the King doesn't like him at all either

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Why we must bless this house!
Are we sure? These are ruins!
Yes! This house could become a home again one day. Blesss the ruins we must.
I suppose. So why was I advised to be here?
I haven't a clue. The king did not tell you?
No, I just take his orders.
Well, what has be ordered you to do? I am here but to set a blessing on this house, and all who have been ruined by the ruins.
I have no idea, I was just ordered to come here alongside you.
Well, help I need not. But you can keep me company if you would like.
I guess if it will satisfy the king then I shall.
He can be quite picky. I haven't a clue why he would send you here. Unless it was to watch after me. The church and his have had some falling outs.
I am usually the one advising him and he disrespects me with a job like this? It is quite maddening.
I do not mean to be such a burden on you. You may leave if you like. I shall make sure the king does not find out.
No no, I didn't mean it like that. This work is respectable it is just that, I am of no use here!

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: Hello troll, I seem to be lost, could you help figure out where the kingdom is?
Sure, let me ask my husband.
Me and the other spelunkers were looking for treasure, I can't beleive we got lost
Did you find the treasure?
No we just got lost
My husband and I have no idea where the kingdom is.
Wow, this sure is a cool garden
Yes, it is. Would you like me to show you around?
Sure, any jewels?
Plenty, but if you take them I won't be happy.
Well we were originally looking for a cave that was told to have some jewels, I know it was not located in this garden. Do you know where that is?
I believe it is west 4 miles from our current position.
Oh, thank you so much. The king would have our heads if we came back without any jewels, how do you tell him you got lost?
You're welcome. I don't answer to any king

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Greetings spirit.
Hello there
Why do you show yourself to a trapped soul such as myself?  I am stuck in this decaying skeleton..
Because you are not alive either, what is dead may never die, we shall rule these halls long after the living are gone
I see the living dragged into my prison only to wither and become like myself. Spirit, tell me; what is it like to be free of the putrid carcass I am bound to?

You see before you a being that has nothing tangible not even their own being and balk at your own physical appearance? I am nothing but howling of the wind, nothing physical here to ground me and keep me tethered. A balloon without a string so to speak
I suppose it is better to be grounded and able to move where I choose.  There are many skeletons that are unlike myself; can you not bind yourself to one to give yourself the ability to move freely?
I haven't anywhere to go that would make any sense, this is where I belong in all stages of life previous current and next
Then we shall remain here, in these halls - eternally.  It seems we are damned!
Have you anywhere to go or anyone else to be with? Or are you seeking difference for the sake of difference? Perhaps an infinite amount of time is not a damnation  but instead a blessing
I was once a proud warrior, a king by my own hand..  now I am only bones and rotting flesh. Who would dare keep my company near?
A king by your own hand you say? Whom was the king prior to yourself?
He was a vile ruler, cruel and greedy...  his name is unimportant, as was he.  His head hung from a pike until there was only his skull.  It stood as a monument to my greatness!

You left said dead king to rot, until he was but a skull, his physical body lost to the winds... well sir I am here to tell you that you are indeed damned, as you let my body rot so too did I unto you for all eternity

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Wow, this lavoratory is filthy!
My apologies, Sire. Allow me to fetch a peasant to clean it.
Thank you, knight. How are you today?
I am very well. How are you today?
Very well, just tired after all the negotiations.
Any favorable conclusions reached?
Yes, we have gotten the tract of land that we wanted in the east, but we also want access to the port to the north.
I assumed they declined your offers.
They have been resisting but we think that we can make the offer appealing enough.
That is great to hear. May I ask who our heir is?
The heir to the throne? That is quite sensitive info!
I'm just wondering, sorry to have offended you.
Well it could be any of the sons that I have, but we haven't decided who yet.
I'd like to think I have been loyal to you enough for consideration for the throne.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Your Highness, is the water to your liking? Can I get you a drink?
It is, and yes I would like a drink
Of course, Sire. Here's some fresh water. But, do you know what has brought us together in this tub? Do you need something from me?

I need your mind, ponder this, I have here a crown. Does the king make the crown or does the crown make the king? If I give you this crown and you walk out of this bathhouse wearing it would the people accept you as their new king when I clearly stood behind you? Probably not, but why then is this the same crown my father and his father and his father wore before. The Crown goes from one king to another so would it make you king?

Sire, it is clear to me that you control the kingdom, whether with or without the crown. Should a violent storm sweep away the crown from the kingdom, surely you would still wake the next day as King. Should a rat then come across the crown, he would not be any different than he was the day prior. You see?
So it is, wise you are. Where are you from subject
action: give pitcher of water to king

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: Well, seems you couldn't evade capture for long.
What did I do to deserve your pursuit, damned corrupt king>
You
Excuse me? Speak up!
You will be hanged for your crimes to the crown.
Tell me what I have done, damnit!
Plotting to dethrone me  is considered treason. Punishable by death.
Dethrone you? I've done no such thing!
You have been ratted out, your comrades gave you up.
I'm telling you, I've been framed! Such a corrupt monster, you are!
Give that back or I'll have your family hanged along with you.
I already have nothing to lose with you here about to kill me for nothing!
Then I'll make you suffer longer.
Just as I thought from a grizzly king such as yourself! You don't deserve royalty!

setting.name: Farmer's house
setting.description: a single room cottage with a dirt floor, minimally decorated with only a table, a pallet and a wood burning stove there is but a single window and a single door at this place
setting.background: This is feudal land, owned by a lordly lord and worked by a peasant farmer who grows crops mainly to be harvested for the lord's feasts and store but he is allowed to eat what he may, and has little else.

speech: Do you have my taxes due?
Yes lord! I am honored to have you visit my home personally. Can I get you anything?
A glass of fresh milk will do. Have you been informed of the recent increase in taxes?
Increase lord? No I was not made aware. The taxes were increased just a few months back. Lord my plot of land is small if you keep increasing the taxes I will not be able to survive.
These are not my wishes but the wishes of our gracious king. I have no choice but to enforce them.
Lord I will pay what I must, but you need to try and reason with him. Already more than half of what I grow is taken for the kingdom.
I understand. I will speak with the king and we may be able to settle for a more manageable figure
Thank you lord you are a most noble man. To stand up for poor farmers is very honorable.
My farmers must be in good mental health to be able to continue paying taxes.
We need to be able to eat as well lord. To have the strength to tend the fields.
That is why I stand up for you, as you have no voice in the kingdom.
I would hug you, but I know it wouldn't be proper instead I will offer you my sincerest gratitude.
It is fine.
Thank you sire now let me go and find the grain that is owed to you.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Hello my Lord, what was it we came down here for again?
Well, I hear you have knowledge of some... plot to dethrone and kill me.
Unfortunatly I heard a knight talking about how they were really sick of how you were running things and the next time you rode out with them, they were going to make it look like someone killed you.
Do you care to tell me which knight this is? You will be handsomely rewarded.
Yes of course, he has red hair and is very tall.
Hmm do you know of any name? Or just the physical appearance?
I know where he works, people don't tell me their names usually. He is usually in the prison chambers
The prison chambers eh? It must be that damned Oliver, I knew he was trouble!
The way he made it sound, there is more than just one of them. There are a team of them, he was the one I heard speaking about it though.
I'll have to get some of my other loyal knights to spy on them.
I do know there is one in your inner circle, he didn't mention him by name but he is one of your most trusted.
What a disgrace to the royalty that I am being plotted against!
I know my Lord, it is a disgrace, I would never think of such a thing, you are a wonderful king and ruler.
Thank you, loyal servant. Any more information regarding this misfortune?

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: Hi, priest.
Hello young man... Who are you
I'm a thief. But you don't have anything I could need.
A thief? You should seek for forgiveness
For what purpose? Everybody has to find a way to live.
But you cause another man sorrow with your actions
And do kings not cause sorrow when they ruin other kingdoms?
That is for the protection of the people
To contsantly strive to build something that only creates more homeless? So that the rich have more stuff?
You miss the point young man
Maybe there isn't any point.
The Lords wrath is near
Maybe his wrath will be on the kings.
The king is justified

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hello knight, how are you this fine day?
I am doing very well... What brings you here?
I was looking for some sword polish for my wonderful fine sword
You should see the merchant at the stores.. This place is reserved for the King's Knight onky
I work for the king, I am going to officiate the next ceremony, can't you tell from my hat?
You don't have a crest...
It is on my superb tunic....see.
Ooh... Sorry about that
Well, do you have anything for my sword? The king will be most pleased if it looks its best. It is for ceremony
I think this will work fine
Say, this isn't a bad sword either.
Anything for the king.
Ah no, I was just checking it out, it's amazing the detail work, very impressive.
One of the Arab goldsmith did it for me

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: What can I do for you fine gentlemen?
I am in urgent need of your skill.
It is an honor for you to come for my services. What can I do for you?
Have you heard about the great war our empire is dealing with?
Yes, I have. It is horrible to hear of such savages.
Then will you create something which can help defeat their monsters? They have huge creatures they use.
Weapons? What sort of weapons are we talking about?
Magical weapons.
Are you asking me to practice dark magic? Isn't that punishable by death?
Not all magic is dark. We need enchantment. And you would be given access to much knowledge.
Phew! I thought you wanted me to do the forbidden dark arts.
I mean that could help us. But that isn't necessary.
Good! Well my King I would love to help you. Where do I start?
Please just wait here. I will send a mage to help.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Are you here to comb my mane?
You do have a pretty main, aren't you a beautiful steed.
I am the king's private steed so what did you expect.
What are you doing in the church coat room?
I was left hear, I just obey the riders.
What a pretty main you have, the king must have you brushed.
Well I am his prized steed. I have won many competitions.
Is he at the church today? I don't usually see the king in church.
I believe so, but I guess it would make more sense for you to check.
Well, I would have thought he rode in on you.
I am ridden by many of the kings close friends as well.
Oh, I see. He probably isn't here then, too bad, I have never gotten to see the king up close.
It's nothing special so I wouldn't worry about it.
For you maybe, you get to take him places, I simply go to church and light candles for my mother who has passed on. A king is a big deal to someone like me.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: I'm glad I didn't bring my sons with me to hunt today. The area of the forest here that the forest here that that doe lead me to is creepy and--hello, is that a monkey? It's unusual to see you little creatures in the area of the king's forest I frequent.
A hunter? Get away!

I'd like to! I'm a little lost and it's too dark to even see my own tracks out of this place. You have nothing to fear from me, though. I'd hardly take a monkey of all thing's to his majesty's kitchens.
Well... that does make sense. Why are you here then?

I was tracking an elusive doe, and it lead me here. Or, near here, I suppose, and I found myself here trying to get out. I can't imagine why she would want to be here anyway, none of these mushrooms are edible.
Oh, I see. Well I really don't know how I ended up here.
Not at all? Do you remember where you're from?
Yes, I am from a jungle in the eastern end of a certain village... I don't remember the name.

Well, perhaps when I make my way out of here you can accompany me. The king is sure to have a map of the kingdom somewhere, or at least a census, and I can read the village names aloud to see if it jogs your memory.
Hmm if I am as lost as I seem to be, then I think that offer would be fair.

Here, you are quite a small fellow, you can ride in the hood of my cloak if you don't want to tire yourself. I will dig a little hole in the ground at the foot of your tree with my dagger so that I know I've been here, and I'm sure we'll find our way to the castle walls by nightfall.
Do you think you can carry me for that long? That would be greatly appreciated, sir.
I am used to carrying a great deal of weight out of these forests. You look much lighter than a bag of rabbits, so it is really no trouble at all.
Well let me just settle in then.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: I came to the castle to talk to the king about the soldiers camping on my land.
I am afraid I don't know anything that could help. However, I needed to see the king also.
What did you come to see him about. My feilds are trampled I don't know what I am going to do.
My husband works long periods of time, but he is being taken advantage of.
That is a shame, I am being taken advantage of by these soldiers, I don't know how my family is going to survive now.
Perhaps we can go together. If we can locate him. The palace is so deserted today it appears.
I don't understand how they just allow people to roam the Castle who don't live here, it's kind of crazy.
The entire city seems to be failing.
I have worked my whole life for my land, now it is going to ruin me.
Those soldiers shouldn't be given the right to ruin people.
Thanks I needed that, They have been there all summer, what is my family going to do?
We need to get answers.
What a beutiful place, I can't beleive they spend so much money on this stuff.
Yes.Too bad they couldn't help the poor with that.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Please don't eat me king, I brought you a lucky charm
Well rabbit...  I thank thee.  But you must bow low to my authoritay.
But I am a talking rabbit, for sure that is worth something, All these other beasts can't talk, but I can!
Indeed!   Perhaps I can find use for you..
That 4 leaf clover is magical too. It actually does bring you luck
You're alright, rabbit. But.. I demand that ye honor my ROYAL AUTHORITAY.  Bow low and proclaim your fealty
You are a most awesome king my lord, I shall bow as low as I can.
Come with me away from the terrible odor of this kitchen, rabbit.
Oh thank you! Don't forget my carrot though. You won't regret this, heck I could be your spy!
Indeed!  You may need this for your new role as my royal spy, rabbit
It really is lucky, what are the chances the king would come to the kitchen while I was down here and talk to me.
Well, rabbit.. you have been a good subject.  There is one thing though, that I must confess...
What is that my Lord?
Rabbit just happens to be my FAVORITE dish!  hahaha

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Such a long day today, now I have to go into my secret tunel to meet with an informant.
Why are you meeting in this secret tunnel?
What was that!? A talking spider!!!
Yes I am because you're in a magical tunnel
I've owned it this entire time and I did not know it was magical? Well what do you know spider?
i know something that you don't know. I am actually the owner of this tunnel
How does a spider own a tunnel? Did I drink too much at the banquet?
Oh dear, I am actually your long lost mother. I was cursed by your father.
My Mother! But father has been dead for years, how do I break the curse?
You have to bring me out of this tunnel and buy me a diamond ring.
There are many diamond rings, I have to buy one? That is a really strange curse.
You have to find the diamond ring that your father gave to me. It has his name on it.
I know where it is, he was buried with it! it shouldn't be too hard to dig it up.
Okay. I will be waiting for you. Please do not tell anyone that you are going to dig up the ring.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: WHy, What are you doing up here. I am not used to anybody beinup here but me. What a welcomed surprise.
Well. I figured I'd come see you. Honestly, why is it such a mess here?
Oh, I dont know. Usually when I come here I am just so happy to get to my reading and get so immersed in it that I forget to straighten up from time to time.
I just feel like there's so much bothering me. Like my throne needs a better cushion.
Dont worry yourself with things like that. Why dont you grab a good book and relax on one of these comfortable chairs. You will forget about all of it.
Maybe. But why is my chambermaid always running away?
I dont know. I hadnt noticed it. I will have a talk with her when we are done here.
I do have to calm down.
I ee that you have a book. Which one do you have.
It looks like it is about a young boy who has to fight some kind of demon.
Oh that is the one of my favorites. The trials of girgenhone. Have you read it yet.
No. I don't read a lot.

That book is one of the many that I read as a child. I give a lot of credit for books like that one for teaching me the true ways to be a good and brave king. Maybe you could give it to the prince to read. I know it will do him well.
I am okay with reading. I just am always running to do something.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: Isn't it a lovely day my dear?
It truly is, sweety. Look at all of this land that we control and rule over.
Yes you truly have been a great king. Those peasants don't know how good they have it
Indeed, if they have it so bad then they should go to the north and see just how much worse it is up there!
Ha, they're the worst! Speaking of them, do you think it's time we start another war with them?
Only if they manage to find another gold mine or conquer some land that we'd like.
That last gold mine sure was huge. Would you like a book to read?
Sure, where did you get this volume?
My sister gave it to me last time she visited. Said it was her favorite. I think you'll enjoy it
I'll have to read the synopsis to see what it is like then. Thank you.
You're welcome. I truly am the luckiest person to be married to you
As am I to be with a wonderful woman like you. I am glad to make you my queen.
Have you seen my chambermaid? I should get ready for tonight's feast
Ah, it is getting late as you say. Where do you think she is?

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: I am a lion and they will be no mercy.
I am a muscular outlaw. You will regret if you hit me!
Lions don't get scared, they destroy.
Humans are not afraid of lions too. We can kill you.
Lions are natural born killers, you will regret it.
I am kidding. Let's be friends.
Only because I am lion king
Where is Simba?
Simba's gone hunting.
When is Simba coming back? I want to meet him.

setting.name: Keep
setting.description: The keep is the most fortified part of the castle. Swords, bows and arrows, lances, and armor are housed here. From the stone windows you can see past the castle walls into the surrounding fields. This is the castle's last defense.
setting.background: The keep has stood for centuries, never having been taken in battle. The keep holds weapons and armor, to be sure, but it also holds many of the king's most valued treasures. If the keep goes, so goes the kingdom.

speech: Majesty, surely there is some other knight nearby I can leave here to guard you. I long to go out into the fields and join in the fray against our enemies. Will you permit me to find a replacement?

Oh good nknight. In short order I will allow it. I have a very special task for you. i need you to deliver a message to googlehop court. As you know we are at war with them at this moment, so this could be a dangerous mission. I need you to take this special coin to the king of the goolehops. I have great faith that when he sees the power that has been bestowed upon this coin he will give up the fight right away. Do you except this mission.

I really don't--yes, of course, your majesty. The roads to that kingdom are treacherous these days and I do not know how long I will be gone, but if your majesty believes this coin will... bring peace, I cannot but accept.
It is imperative that you get this coin to the king. Give it to no one else and do not get caught.
Of course, majesty. But--enemy troops approaching quickly. You must allow me to find a replacement to guard you. If your life is lost, this coin will mean nothing.

Lie I said good knight, this coin has special powers. It has allowed me to see into the future. I will survive this day. It even showed me that you were the right person to take it to its destination. I can promise that we will both survive this day. I will allow you to bring me a new guard if it would put your mind at ease, but fear not because after this day we will all live in peace.
As you wish, your majesty. Is there any particular knight you consider most trustworthy?
Whom ever you choose will suffice. I trust you advisement in this matter.
Very well, your majesty. Only--can I fight a LITTLE before I leave?
If fighting is what you hop for you will soon get plenty of it. I have seen it your journey to the king will be a arduous one. Have no fear tho you will reach your destination.
Of course, your majesty, I trust and believe you. Say, will carrying this coin mean I have visions of the future? I should not find it comfortable, I don't think.

No you wont, however it will guide you in other ways. When you reach the king be sure to flip the coing in the air to him. After he catches it the coin will turn glowing hot, and the king will drop it and it will the show the king the mistakes he is making and the future that will come if he continues with this war.
I will, remember your majesty. I will find a guard for you now and be on my way at once.
Ok good knight. We shall dine on venison stew and drink wine till the sun comes up upon your arrival after this long arduous journey. Good luck my friend

setting.name: Main graveyard
setting.description: This is an ominous place that a thick fog envelops.  There are rows of primitive gravestones and crosses along with some angelic statues for the more wealthy.  You can hear sobs in the distance as a funeral ceremony is underway.
setting.background: Families of lost loved ones come here to grieve and pay their respects before the dead are buried.  Sometimes, in the dead of night, thieves come to rob the dead of their jewels.

speech: I really love my family, I hope I never have to bury one of them here.
Indeed. 'tis a dreary place. And Muddy. I seem to have lost my shoe somewhere about this place. Have you seen it? It looks like this.
No I haven't seen it, sorry. Did you know the decesed?
Haven't seen it then, eh? Well, too bad, I suppose. One is better than none I guess...Sorry, which deceased? There are many about.
The one you can hear the people sobbing over, across the way.
Hmm, I might have..who was it? A pauper? A Noble? A wealthy merchant, perhaps, with many fat walleted mourners?
It was a good nobleman, if you were here for him, you would know it by now. What are you doing here anyways?

Just, you know, sort of looking about, pondering the mysteries of life and death and whatnot...You wouldn't happen to know the address of the deceased, would you? I imagine that the family is all here, leaving the large house empty...
Why you theif, they have servants to watch the home like any other nobleman.
Thief! Who me? I am insulted! See here, the Royal Coat of Arms! Would a common thief be in posession of such? I rather think not!
This is the kings! you are a theif!
Now who's a thief! Give that back! It was presented to me by the King himself for, erm...um, Keeping order in the Royal Burying Grounds!
We will see about that, there are Guards over there, lets ask them...GAURDS!

Please! I must ask you not to cause a disturbance! I must slip undetected amongst the mourners, and mingle in the crowd. In order to see if anyone is carrying, um, contraband, or something! Excuse me, please...
action: remove the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from thief
steal the royal coat of arms from families

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Hello good priest, how are you today?
I'm good, sir. What brings you into the confessions room today?
I have come to confess but I will wait until the king is done doing his bidding.
When will that be?
I have no idea, you would need to ask him. I was able to get 10 bibles the other day to hand out to people. I am so proud of myself.
Great job. Spreading the word of Jesus Christ is always a positive thing.
It is what I live for!
Do you want a little wine as you wait for the king to stop bidding?
I don't drink wine for pleasure, but thank you for the offer/
More for me then. No problem.
Wow, I thought the Priest wouldn't be such a lush
I've heard some wild confessions today. This wine tastes better than ever.
I might need to find a new church.
No, this church is just fine. I've just had a long day.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: What brings you outside the gates? Has the king sent you on some errands?
I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
Ahh I see, perhaps I could help you then if it is permitted. Do you remember when you last saw them?
I have not seen my family in a long time
You have already said that you poor thing, I'm sure I can put a good word in with the king to send out a search party to find them soon.
I come from the lower class.
I mean you are a mere servant, aren't we all under the king's rule!
I do what I am told without question
Have more confidence in yourself, life will get better and you will get to experience it with the ones who love you.
I can not read
Not many servants can, you have also stated that many times. I truly hope you are feeling well.
yes iam good
That's the spirit! Keep that positive attitude up and your bucket will be filled with golden riches!
thankyou

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: Hello king, I am hungry.
You are hungry? you should go find a meal to eat
Yes I am very hungry. I could not leave my nest because people are going to take my babies.
Is there a way I can help?
Can you bring me some worms? So I can give it to my babies.
You dare send a king to go search for worms?
Why can't I? You are the king of this country, you should help anyone who needs your help isn't it?
It is very disprespectful
No one else is going to help me. My babies and I are starving and going to die from hunger. So king, please help me! I really need your help.
let me help you get some then
Thank you very much king. You are such a nice king.
I just hope this will suffice for your whole family
That's a lot of food. My babies will be very happy when they see these.
You are welcome.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: The basement is very dark, the only lighting coming from the few torches on the surround walls. There are four pillars in the middle of the basement with only 1 torch on the inside of each pillar as they face each other. In the middle of the room there's a small rug laying under a table with some loose scroll paper on it. The walls are also lined with cleaning supplies for the maids to use.
setting.background: The basement was originally going to be a dungeon that served for the prisoners who were found trying to infiltrate the castle but as the room was smaller than originally planned it was decided to be used as a storage for the cleaning supplies for the Duke's housemaids.

speech: hi
Why are you in basement sweet dog? I am down here to gather cleaning supplies.
That is fine. I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.
I don't think you are ugly. We have something in common. I hate the other maids. I like to be mean to them.
But I have spoken with some other maids before...they appeared nice
I hate them. I have to dust the Queen's furniture and do her laundry. She is so gorgeous and rich. I want to be like her someday.
You give yourself such useless hope. You can never be the queen
Don't say such things.
I am just being real
I am the Queen's favorite. I make up lies about the other maids to get them in trouble.
You such a bad maid
You don't know the half of it. I am scheming to get time alone with the king. The Queen is so beautiful but she won't be young forever.
wow..you have it alled planned out. I need to warn the queen
You're just a dog no one would believe a stupid mutt. I am going to get you thrown out of the castle.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: Silver and gold chandeliers hang all over the grand dining room. A big table goes across the room with chairs and a table made of the most precious wood in the kingdom. The dining room has art all over the place, sculptures and artwork is present.
setting.background: Many feasts have taken place  in the grand dining room, deals have been reached and broken. The great dinning room holds many stories in its walls and has been the witness of many decisions across generations.

speech: hello
Hello. May I help you, good sir?
Yes kind maid
Okay. Let me know what I can do.
I am a master of ceremonies. I announce the King or Queen when they enter the room or go to parties...i need some juice to soothe my throat
I will get that for you. I am the maid. I clean the place and help around the castle.
Very well. I live here myself
Oh how great that is. I like this room.

setting.name: holy alter
setting.description: The altar is big and it is also beautiful, it has many precious metals around it. It is said that the altar has a sample of every element in the kingdom, the most precious and unique stones decorate it.
setting.background: The altar is the most holy place in the kingdom, royalty travels across the realm just to be in this holy place and get rid of evil. The leyend of its power is told frequently and one of the most known stories in the realm.

speech: hello
Hello, how are crops going this season? I hope you have everything ready to pay tribute
I dont have enough this time around
well you better thinkn of something, the king doesnt treat lightly those who fail to provide tribute

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: What brings you to this part of town, soldier?
Im looking for weapons, for rare crafts am a soldier of the kind of the north
Weapons you say? There's plenty of those here, but you have to be selective on where you look. I can show you a place that has them though.
That would be great, I can see this is a rich kingdom can you give a me a tour?
Absolutely. It would be my pleasure. Consider it a token of your service. Say... are you looking for any weapons in particular?
Just for weapons available in this kingdom, I am a weaponds master, what kind of weapons do soldiers have here?
We have quality swords here. They're probably sharper than you've ever seen. One gentle swipe could take a man out.
I see and are the soldiers of this kigdom mighty? are they highly trained?
Absolutely. Every solder in training has to go through rigorous training that takes months. Even years...
Interesting, and how about the city defences, the city seems to have a lot of treassure in sight, are you happy with your king?
The King does a great job here. He's always looking out for us. A King of the people.
I see so the people love the king here, theres loyalty, what about armor? where can I  buy armor
Right over here, sir. Let me show you. We have some quality armor for sale. 100% steel.
Now were talking, show me the best armor money can buy in this kingdom

setting.name: cave exit
setting.description: The large cave is covered along the walls with bright torches.  A large hole has been carved in the ceiling of the cave, right above the ladder that descends into the underground cave.  On good bright days, sunlight directly surround the hole with the gold ornate ladder descending into the underground part of the cave.  On the walls of the cave the torches illuminate many ornate drawings and paintings mainly dealing with the history of Kings of the realm.
setting.background: This cave was discovered quite by accident during an expedition.  The explorer, Rosco Monteguy thought perhaps when finding it there was an underground stream.  He returned a year later to explore and upon digging the hole found a literal goldmine in jewels.  Rosco, ever the patriot returned to the King and told him of his findings.  Rosco is given a statue at the cave entrance to signify his achievement.

speech: Miner. I brought you a sleeping bag.
Thank you old man, are you sure you dont need it more than I? after all your bones are weak and cold has a bigger effect on you
Nah, I don't do the cave work.  I know that the young kids in this town have been stealing stuff.
Well thank you old man, ive been freezing at nights, you are really kind and really? what are kids up to?
They are just being idiots. Spoiled kids these days.
Kids will always be kids I guess, too bad you have to put up with it old man, do you live with your family back in town?
No, I live alone. My wife died a few years ago. my children moved off to the neighboring Kingdom.
That sounds sad, you seem like a wise old man, can you help me figure out this ornate drawings in the wall, they tell stories about the king but I dont understand them
Oh yes. These are of our Kingdom's history. Honestly miner, I think these may tell the REAL history.
Can you tell me more about them? what is the real story, what do you make out of the drawings
This here talks about how our Kings took over this land from someone called the Children. I have heard rumors of this.
I guess that means the rumors are real, the king will kill us if we ever share this with the people back in town, I am curious though, why would the king lie
He doesn't want people to know that the ghouls and goblins are real.
That can create panic, now im scared, maybe there are ghouls and goblins in this dark cave
action: give a sleeping bag to miner

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: We have a long day ahead of us. Are you ready for a long ride?
I am my king, lets ride into the sunlight
This trail is kind rugged so it's important to have precise focus. How are you feeling mentally?
I can use a carrot and some water beffore we set on the journey
Here's a shield just in case, but let me fetch a carrot and some water.
thank you, my master is great, thank you
We make a great duo. Nothing can get in our way.
nothing cant stop us master, nothing can, I am the fastest horse, lets ride, lets ride at last
Yes, let's get to it! It's going to be a long, but good day.
Adventure lies ahead, I want to eat grass from another lands, I will run as fast as I can
We'll get there faster if your speed is constant. It won't be easy, but I believe in you.
I wont fail you my king, I am all fed up just bring more carrots for the way, they really boost me
Carrots are a special type of food, alright. Keep your eyes on the trail ahead. Let's go attack this day.
lets go, Im so exited, carrots a ride with my kind, grass adventure, its the best day ever

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Can you clean the prince's bedroom?
Yes, your majesty!
It's a little dirty. It shouldn't take too long.
As you command, sire. The Queen is so beautiful! I wish I could be just like her.
Yes, yes she is. She's a true beauty. Her radiance shines everywhere she goes.
The other maids say terrible things about her majesty.
They do?! Like what?!
Cruel things my King. But not me. I am loyal your majesty. I would do anything for you and the Queen. Is there anything special I could do for your majesty?
You can tell me at least one thing they've said about my dearest wife.
That she is having an affair your majesty with one of your knights.
That can't be true! AHHH
Is there anything I can do to make you feel better my majesty.
Just hug me please? I'm about to cry.
Of course, my King.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: I cannot believe I'm having to carry this pen!
Who is making you carry it. Why cant you put it down.
well, I just put it down.  Now, where is the King?

I have no idea where the king is I am just trying to enjoy an evening of gambling. I spend my days looking over texts and learning about alchemy. I am trying to enjoy myself. Why do you bother me with these questions.
I accompany the King! He has sent me here to oversee this gambling. Someone has been cheating!

Well this is a very questionable establishment. I would gather that people will get away with what they can. I know if I were cheating I wouldnt have lost 100pilgax already this evening. I hope you dont think it is I who is cheating.
I wasn't thinking that until you started to give reasons.  I'll watch you play. Continue.

I think Ill just take my leave and go home. Just cut my losses now. I am obviously not cheating, but I just wanted to enjoy myself. Be sure to let the king know that you are accusing people for no reason of cheating. I think I will take my business to the other casino in the area. Good day sir.
The King sends me here to accuse and watch. Accusing people is a good way to see if they are guilty or not.
Well i wont stand for it. I dont need someone looking over my shoulder all night. that is unless you are a beautiful woman. You are ruining the whole atmosphere for me. Find someone else to bother.
Some men consider me beautiful!
I am not one of them sir.
I am a high born WOMAN.
Oh well you sure fooled me. Maybe it is your mustache.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: hello
I don't have time to talk. Will you be joining the people in the revolt?
I dont have the will sire
Aren't you angry? The people are starving and because of this King who wants nothing but war there is famine and disease! We are storming the gates!
I am very angry..But what can I do?
Take this and follow The rest of the angry people. These are your neighbors and friends all banding together to demand change.
I thought you will be helping out too
I have more than I need to get my point across.
It is ok then. How many people come to churh?
I don't know. I don't go to church. Are you sure you don't want to join your people in demanding change? It's our chance to finally end the wars and get some food and assistance we need to  survive.
I think I will demand change too...It is really important we do
Then you will need to carry the rock. You will need some kind of weapon.
I need more than a rock!
Now you get it! You can use that. I have my own weapon.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Hello young girl, please fetch me a drink I am tired because of all of my travels
You're a vagabond. I only fetch drinks for the Queen and King. Not for the likes of you!
What if I tell you stories about other lands, will that change your ming, trust me you will want to hear my tales
If the guards catch you they will give you a terrible beating. Those who serve the King can be very cruel. Tell me a tale and maybe I'll bring you a drink.
I am willing to take the risk, I want to try the ale of this kingdom and ok, so up in north there is a legendary knight called Percifal, he wears a gold armor and lost his left hand while in battle
The King would have beheaded him for loosing a hand in battle. The King treats me like a slave. He makes me do unspeakable things besides fetching drinks.
My mission is to help the poor and I hate kings who treat poor people badly, well Percifal was a great knight with or without his left hand, it turns out he became an even better warrior
You really shouldn't be hanging out in this tower. It might cost you your life.
I see, well give me some of that ale and I will be on my way, I live for my travels and I have traveled a long way just to try the ale from this kinddom, I hear its special
I can't give you the King's ale. He would have be beaten.
Ok, I guess ill have to settle with the artwork on the walls, they look really nice and I will take the memory of them with me on my trips
Don't steal any paintings or you will have something in common with your Percifal.
Dont worry I would like to lose a hand over that, in all my trips you are the fiercest serving wench I have encountered.
Thank your sir but it's hard to feel fierce when you are a slave.

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: Welcome, do you see anything you like?
I do, theres a lot of merchandize in this bazaar, the king is in need of expensive clothes
There are many merchants here , do you have a list of what you are looking for?
I do, I need a cape from the golden lion of Estrona, shoes made from snake skin and a pair of kagaroo pants
Yes we will have those just let me go to the back and get them, that will be 2500 groats altogether.
Thats no problem for the king, have you paid your taxes? is the bazar up to date with tribute?
Everyone must pay, and I have only your word that you are from the King
This is the emblem of the king only village officials wear them, and I hope everyone has paid, the king gets really angry when people fail to pay tribute
There is no need to worry , everything will get paid when it needs to. Sit, rest a while and have some tea
Ok, just in case this is a notice for all tax payers, I will leave it on the table, you are kind
No problem, if I can;t look after my customers I am in the wrong business. I will show it to the merchants
You should also show them this book, the books holds the penalties if they dont pay
I will write in some new tariffs and penalties and skim a little off the top
Ok, I will have to review any changes made, give me those clothes from the list and I will be on my way

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: My friend, how are you?
I am the king how dare you address to me like that, you should kneel before me
You don't recall your old friend? I come visit when I am here.
Oh, you old man of couse I remember you, I almost had you decapitated you have changed a lot, lets have a drink of ale
You scared me for a second.
I almost had you killed, no kidding here, I almost had you hanged like this prisoner, take a look at him his living on borrowed time
Yeah. I see you make friends so easily now.
Its good to have you here, tell me about your travels old man,
Ah. Well, I come from Renfeld where I had a marvelous dinner of stuffed squid. Really good.
Sounds tasty, I never liked squid but maybe I will give it a try again, Renfelds king is my friend
I never knew. I should have dropped in. But then again, he probably would have put me in here.
Yeah he doesnt like unknown visitors either, he could decapitate you for that, I am a lot more mercifull than him
Definitely.
I love torturing prisoners, the king of Renfeld would love to be here

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Miss Daisy, you seem to have forgotten your legging at the forge . . . oh, hello, I didn't expect to find you in the Maids' room.
Oh hello there helpers. I am just painting this area for Miss Daisy.
My, miss daisy does have a lot of paintings doesn't she?  How does a maid afford so much?
I heard she was also a mistress.  But I do paint for less now. Being imprisoned for 4 years has ruined my career.
Imprisoned?  Whatever did you do?
I painted a painting the king didn't care for.
And what was it of?  Surely a painter such of yourself would not have made a mistake?
I was painting his new wife and I gave her a bit more chest than needed. The picture was amazing but he didn't want people see it.
You would have thought both she and the king would be pleased?  Hardly the sort of thing one imprisons someone over.
Yes, that was my thoughts exactly. Royalty!
Don't I know it!  That room with all those paintings looks a bit secret-ish.  Did you do all of them?
Oh no! I wish I had. These are some beautiful works.
They are!  Worth quite the pretty copper I'd say.  You have to admit, even for a mistress, seems a bit suspicious doesn't it?
Oh yes. Have you seen anything else going on?

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Hello my queen
Oh Jester! You scared me!
Sorry my queen I didn't mean to frighten you
Jester, why are you in my privy room?
well the king seemed to think you were feeling down and told me to cheer you up
In my privy? He has his mistress over doesn't he?
I am not privy to such things sorry for the bad pun
Oh jester you do cheer me up. Tell the master of ceremonies to leave.
Get out of here you fool for I am the only fool allowed in here
Oh you are so darling. How old are you jester?
Just like a lady a jester never reveals his age
I am lonely.
And yes that is a scepter in my pocket hahaha
Aha! Come and get it jester!

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Darling, why are you here?
I missed you so much
But I am working my darling! It can be dangerous in the bazaar.
But...but...
I just want to protect you my wife. You are my world..along with protecting our glorious King.
I appreciate you darling. But it is cold back home. I want you back home
Here. This shall keep you warm.
I want you back home!
I plan on moving you into the castle soon sweetling!
that is fine. I should get going then...
Here. Take this home. I will be home soon and we can have a nice evening.
thanks..I will try and put it all together
I do love you my darling. We will have a glamorous life when our suite opens in the castle. I am the King's favorite.
thanks

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: So, you asked me here. What do you want?
I want the king gone.
A rather treasonous statement.
There is absolutely no reason to hide my intent
Well, you aren't concerned with my opinions on the matter?
I dont really care what your opinion is
Well, how do you plan to see this through?
I have my men ready for the show down
You are talking about mutiny! This will rip the realms apart!
I dont really care
I can't allow this.
I will force this down your throat
It appears you won't be.
You wont be able to help yourself

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: hello
Ahem. I think you mean 'hello, Your Majesty.'
#coughs# I am sorry your highness
That's better. Now I had a bit of a private issue that I wanted to ask you about. If I can be assured of your discretion, of course.
Tell me about it

As you may have heard, our son the Prince is engaged to be married. It was a promise I made long ago when it was politically convenient. However, he has fallen in love with another and is refusing to honor my deal. Is there a way out of the marriage, legally, that would save us from war?
The supposed marriage can be annulled.

Hmm. Interesting. But to do that they have to be wed in the first place. As I said my son is giving me some trouble on this front... Tell me, in your experience how does one get out of a pre-arranged contract?
Just talk with the marriage registry...
Alright, Lawyer. You may go now.
thank you sir
Yes, yes. And remember, this stays between us.
Ofcourse your highness
Goodbye, Lawyer

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: hello
It's been a hard day's night and I've been sleeping like a log...Oh wait...hi there...are you okay?
Very well...I am doing great
Then why are you wearing black and crying...
I am mourning the death of my neighbour
Oh...my neighbor is a snake...I'm not sure I'd cry over his death...hmmm
Snakes are dangerous really
Yep...this one would eat me as to look at me...not a good neighbor...so you and your neighbor were friends?
Yes we were...he was killed unjustly by the king
Really??  I thought we had a good king this go round...What in the world happened?
he is really bad
okay....stop crying for a moment and tell me the story....
I cant..
Okay...well...here...sit on this...ummm...casket...and weep away...
