setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Why am I sitting in this Confessional? I have nothing to confess, I am King, ruler of all.
Well don't ask me, I just nibble the shoes of the people who come in to confess.  The economy is tough, even for rats.
This smells good, I'm going to light it. Don't touch my shoes or I'll kick you into tomorrow.
Too late I'm afraid.  I already took a nibble, and some of the silk is caught in my teeth.  Please think of us starving rats, and use leather next time.
Here do something with this dear.  I have a rat to kick.
And I have an ankle to bite!  Up your pantleg I go, nibbling all the way to the top!
Why you filthy varmint.  I am King! You can't treat me this way.
So much to nibble on!  Next I will steal your family jewels!
Aieeeee.  You blasted lily livered scourge of my kingdom.  You will pay for this!
Promise me that you will send servants to feed me every day, and I will leave your jewels alone!
I do not barter with a rat.  Do your worst.  You will be on a plate for the dogs tonight.
Then your jewels shall be mine, I shall remove them to the sewer, and you will never touch them again!
I will not be bested by a rat.  I'll kill you myself!
Nibble, nibble, bite and scratch, nothing will remain unbloodied in these pants!

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: hello my highness not sure why they sent me here
I didn't send for you. Is that your child?
no I thought he was yours, the king said to meet you here
I have no idea who this child is or why the king sent you. Maybe if you told me what you did we could figure this out
Well I am a blacksmith by trade
Oh so you can make new shoes for my horse?
Yes I could do that
Great! Probably would've made more sense to meet in the stables than in my bedroom but I guess we can't question the king
No, I can't you maybe can but its done anything else you need me to make
Love? Haha I kid. No, I think I'm good. Since you're here tell me how things are for you
I am great just busy all day swinging the hammer
I'm glad we're keeping you busy. I hope you know that we care about all of our servants
I do your highness, well let me take the kid down to castle main I am sure there is a mom or dad wondering what happened
Thank you  I appreciate that. I will meet you in the stables in an hour if that works for you

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: BAAAAAA! I do not want to be sacrificed..... NOOOOO!
Why be scared. It is ultimately your given right to give your life to the gods.
NO! I said NO! I do not consent to this!
The gods will receive you with most warmth! You do not die in vain.
Are you telling me that I will have a better life once I give my life to the gods?
That is what we know. That is what we have been doing for decades and the gods are pleased
So, you cannot even guarantee anything. I could just die and that is it with no reward.... without even getting to live my life.
The only way to the kingdom of heaven is to be sacrificed. The King watches every one of them.
I am a goat. I have no room in such places. I will not do this! How about we sacrifice you and see how you like it?
Silly rabbit, trix are for kids! I mean goat! haha. Why is it you are so stubborn about this. You are the first.
How do you like those daggers in your side? Not too pleasant, eh?
You are silly, they only went through my robes!
May this cross held against you rebuke the demons and devils inside you that compel you to do this!
Hahahahaha.... you are not an exorcist! And I am not a demon!

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Ello, sir. Can I get you something?
I beer if you please
Yes sir, right away. Foreign or domestic?
domestic
Right away. What bring you to the bar this evening?
Just want to blow some steam hard day at work
What do you do?
I work  out in the field for the king, how long have you been working at the bar
Been about 2 years now, I'm hoping I'll become the manager one day.
That would be great for you, no real chance to move up where I work but it pays the bills and I get to see my family every night
Well surely it helps to have favor with the king?
yea it keeps me employeed hahaha
Indeed! Okay here is your beer. That'll be 2 copper.
ok its in here give me a sec

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: And this, my beautiful daughter, is where we keep the scum of the realms.
And what is the witch doing here?
Well, as you know, magic has been outlawed. This witch here was discovered turning children into toads.
Toads?  That seems like a queer hobby to me.  Why would she do that?
Why do witches do anything they do?
Well, maybe the torturer could find out?
The torturer is currently on leave. He was recently gifted a castle that he is decorating.
Well . . . maybe we could do it instead?  Father-daughter bonding over a little witch's blood?
Oh my...I never expected my daughter to have the blood lust. But I would do anything to bring you joy...
Then let us begin!  Shall we start with the kneecaps father?  Oooh, I am too excited to think straight.  You begin first.
How about we begin with some gentle splintering?
Oh yes father!  Tell me more!  What questions should we ask first?  Or should we even ask any questions?  Maybe we should ask how many lights that she sees, and get her to question her own sanity?
Okay, okay. First break off a piece of the wood. Then, ask the witch to produce gold into the bucket. When she fails, stick the wood beneath her fingernails.
Okay witch!  Make gold, and put it all in this bucket or else . . . hey, what do you know?  She did it!
action: give dirty wooden bucket to young princess
give dirty wooden bucket to witch

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: M'lord, I was told to bring this basket of fish for your approval.
It looks great make sure the cook gets it. So how are things going for you
Things are well. The seas are abundant with fish and my husband is a delight.
that is great, the queen speaks very highly of you please accept my invention  to the ball tonight
Oh! That would be wonderful! Thank you! Would it be possible for my husband to join me? He is a guard in the castle and has to work tonight.
Yes I will let the captain know to switch him with somebody else
You are a wonderful king! I must say, m'lord, your bedroom is very impressive!
Lol they say this is where the magic happens, crude I know but anyways make sure the cook gets the fish and you and your husband show up
Of course! What time does the ball begin?
It begins at sundown but it goes on all night till shortly after midnight
Will the fish be used for dinner at the ball?
Yes it will
How wonderful, I can't wait to see the smiles on all the faces eating the fruits of my labor
I am sure he will be a happy man
action: put food in Baskets of freshly-caught fish

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: I have buried the last of your family, and now you are King.  Do you think all of this violence has been worth it?
I am where I rightfully deserve to be.  Too bad if heads had to roll for me to get here.
And boy did they ever!  Did you know that I need to dig two holes in that case?
Aye you're a funny man.  I like funny men.
So what are your plans now sir King?
Why to eliminate all those who know of my deeds.
Well, that would be most of the town wouldn't it?  I mean, you really had quite the crowd when I worked that guillotine.
Aye I suppose you're right.  Perchance I took too big of a gamble getting to the throne.
Well, you did make sure you wouldn't have any opposition.  I mean, you even got your eighth cousins twice removed.  That shows real dedication towards regicide.
Aye I did.  No regrets right. I sit where I rightfully deserve.
There is only on thing you didn't count on . . .
And what's that old man?
That you failed to account for your ninth cousin, thrice removed!  You are now the only one who stands in the way of the throne, and not for much longer!
Aiiiieeeeeee.  How could youuuuuuuuuu?

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Hello, Hermit. Taken this place for a home, I see.
I sleep wherever I decide to lay my head. I do not like interacting with the people of the village. So, tell me what you want and be on your way!
Short and to the point as usual hermit! But I have a point, too. It's a sword. You'd do well to remember that.
Well, I suppose I could make conversation with you while you are here. I am sure it will not harm me...

That's much better! See your attitude is already improving. And besides, it's not like either of us has much to do. The King and Queen are out for a stroll, so I thought I'd watch over them from this tower.
Are you a watcher of the Royals?
Oh, I'm not in their Personal Guard if that's what you're asking. More like a... helper. I help them in various ways from time to time.
How do you help them? I am interested in you because I have never cared to talk to anyone else.
Well Hermit, the people of the village are very nice, mostly. You should try talking to them, sometime. As far as the King and Queen, well, mostly by helping guard them, but from afar you could say.
Are the King and Queen nice? I have heard rumors...
I would say yes. But it depends on who you ask. Certainly not to those who have offended them.
I hear he does not treat his servants with much respect. I hear they are planning a revolt.
Oh really, now? And what are the names of these servants?
All the servants of the village!

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: I wish I had a friend out here. All the people are scared of me and no one comes out here anymore.
I was demolished and tossed out here like the Kings trash. I used to be a great staircase which existed in the great castle.
Sentient Staircase? Interesting. Will you be my friend?
I would like that. Who needs the royal king? He is a greedy ogre.
Hey, the ogre is my cousin. No need to offend him.
how does that work? anyway, Why don't you use some of my stone to build with?
Now that's an idea! Would I kill you if I used your bits?
Just don't spread my pieces out to far. Ha!
okay! It would be nice to freshen up this bridge. Maybe if it's renovated, more people will come and use it!
You could charge them extra to pass through!
Well, I may offer a discount for awhile. I'm really trying to make more friends.
You have a friend in me. We don't need those humans. They will just disappoint you.
Perhaps you are right, you have been quite helpful.
I look forward to see what kinds of masterful things you will build with my beautiful stone.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: What are you doing at this barn?! Shoo!
Oh...but dear person...I am but an old soul trying to make my way...please...STEP ASIDE!
Age is just a number. Stealing is still stealing.
You are a fool if you think you can stop me from stealing this meat...I am hungry and I've thwarted the village police for many a year.
I can call police. And I've practiced karate when I was in elementary school.
I didn't go to school...it was too hard for my parents to let me go...they needed us to work the farm...the King took our farm for his army.
I'm sorry to hear that. Stealing still isn't right though. Just because the King took your guys farm doesn't mean you can take from others now.
I've been doing just fine up to now...I will take my leave now and you will not stop me.
Time for me to take control of this situation. Argh!
You will not catch me...take that and that...I am free...I won't come back here again...that guest person means business!
Ouch! How dare you! You have a lot of nerve!
You don't need this as much as I do...Now back off...
That's my purse! I don't know you!
I will take that...steal from the rich and give to the poor...in this case..I'm the poor!
action: steal pitchforks and scythes from thief

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Hello, what are you doing in this castle?
This is my home - no one else has live here for hundreds of years.  After a long day of begging, I like to sit here and imagine being a lord such as yourself.
Begging?
Aye, must seem strange to one so noble as yourself.  With no job, it is me only way to survive.
How terrible! Do you have a family?

Not any longer sir.  Me mother was taken by badger-cultists, and my father killed by the turtle-folk during the last uprising.  My sister was sacrificed to the weasel-god, and my brother caught a disease and pooped himself to death.
My goodness! What a dreadful existence. So now you just stay here and beg in town?
Pretty much.  What's my alternative?  They don't exactly let the homeless take wizarding classes at the mage's academy.
Can you not work?
With what jobs?  Ever since the recession, I can not even find work at a poop smithy.
I know the king has been looking for soeone to make repairs around the castle. Are you good at fixing things?
Well, I will give it my best shot.  Truly, you would do that for me?
Absolutely. You seem like an honorable man.
Thank you sir!  You are the kindest noble in the realm.  Perhaps I will even one day be able to afford the first bath of my life1

setting.name: A wooded magical village
setting.description: The village lay hidden in a secret grotto that is set in a sort of valley between trees. The village is populated by child-like peoples who wear clothes made of various plant matter such as large leaves and vines. The homes are made of wood, and seemingly blend into the green dense backdrop.
setting.background: The wooded grotto is home to a master wizard who is cared for by the child-like village people. He pays them by protecting them and their village from the dangerous animals that reside in the dark forest.

speech: The master wizard convention has begun.  What shall be our first order of business?
I have a feeling that danger is lurking near.  Any mass gathering of mages could attract evil doers. We should probably cast some spells of protection!
I shall cast "Mystic Swamp Gas" which will fumigate anyone who attempts to draw near.
I will cast a long lasting protection spell as well.  Keep your eyes peeled, this magical village is very isolated and surrounded by jungle.  We could be attacked from any angle.
Excellent plan.  The woses here will not object to our magics, being a magical people themselves.
I have been preparing for this gathering for some time now. The location was supposed to be secret but I fear that word has gotten around. I wear this necklace for protection as well!

And I shall eat this herb of mystic thinking.  Perhaps it shall give me a vision of those who seek to harm us.  It will certainly give me a vision . . . oh, I believe it is starting to affect me already.

Just be careful, fellow mage.  Those herbs are quite potent. I once took some and was lost in vision for several days. When I awoke, it was as if I had lived several lifetimes since I had gone under its effects.
Woah . . . did you ever think about fingers? . . .and how they move?  It's magic man.  Wait, I think I'm freaking out here. . .

Oh, no. The effects are only just beginning too. Okay, my friend. Focus on those fingers until I can find you a safe place to rest. If you are caught under the influence of magical herbs, you could very well be killed with ease, even if you are a master wizard!
Is it warm in here?  It feels warm.  Woah, those are some weird fingers.  Wait, my fingers are weird too.  Wait!  I'm a wizard . . .I can turn our fingers into snakes!

Whoa now, wait! That isn't such a great idea! Here, I will let you borrow my Necklace of Protection while I find the chief of this small village. He may know an antidote to this herb.  I may be a master wizard but spells are my specialty, not potion making!

WAIT!  A vision!  A host approaches carrying the banners of the King!  It is lead by Draco the Defiler, scourge of the seven realms!  He has found our meeting place, and means to destroy all who practice magic!

My. God. Not DRACO THE DEFILER! This is what I have feared most! He has been hot on our trail for sometime now! It is luck that you decided to take this herb, my friend, your vision may just very well save us all!

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: A knights job is never done.  I would love to fall asleep in this bed but alas, the King needs me awake and alert.
Yea. .. The king really needs you.
I come from a long line of Knights who have protected the King. It is my sworn duty but, it is hard work.  I hardly get a chance to sleep! I must be going mad too because I am talking to a roach!

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Your Majesty (bow) of the Unicorn realm...I beseech you to hear my request.
Hello there King. I'm all ears.
We have come here in search of a unicorn...who would go with us willingly...to the castle...for my daughter's birthday celebration.
Usually us unicorns are very careful to be out in public. You are a royal family though. For you, I'll do this.

Oh..your majesty...what an honor...you personally will join us in celebration of the princess's 10th birthday?  We will have all sort of fun activities and you can join in the jousting matches if you'd like.
I'm just there for you and your daughter. I hope it makes her happy. Can you do me a favor in return?
Yes of course...whatever you want...I an my men are at your service.
There are unicorn hunters present here at this palace. I'm trying to keep my composure, but it's difficult. Is there any way you can make them leave?

But of course your Majesty.  I did not mean to make you uncomfortable.  I brought them to ...well...you know...help...in case there was trouble...along the way.  They have left the room now...is that better?  Would it be okay if I give you these jewels as a way of thanking you for your promise?

Thank you for these. I understand they are your workers. I've just had bad experiences with them in the past. It's a hard mental block to get over. They've also killed some of my loved ones in the past.

Oh your Majesty I can promise you that none of those men would ever hurt a Unicorn...I the King of the North...would strike them dead personally if they would ever hurt a hair on a Unicorn...My daughter is my life and she loves you beyond measure...
I appreciate this reinsurance, sir. I'm glad we found common ground here and I'm glad I could be of help to your Daughter's birthday.

Would you be comfortable your Majesty if I send my Army to protect you on the day of the celebration?  You are welcome to come and stay in my Castle for as long as you'd like.  My personnel grooms will be at your beck and call.
I trust you. If you say these men are loyal then I trust you. Extra protection would be nice. It's hard going out in public because we're so rare.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: Care to stop and say hi to the new mother to be?
Of course! Motherhood is magical and a wonderful yet sometimes difficult journey. I would love to congratulate the mother to be!
She is very poor, and her husband was just killed by some wolves last night..... how sad...
She must be heartbroken, the poor woman. I have heard of the wolf pack that lives close to this beach. They have cultivated a taste for human flesh and attacks have been on the rise!
She is heartbroken and discouraged indeed. She cannot stop weeping over the loss of her husband. They were married for 10 years.

Here, I have this simple golden locket gifted to me by a suitor in town. He wouldn't object to me giving this to a woman in need. Ask her to sell it.  It may pay for a weeks worth of grain and milk for her.
You are a kind lady! Tell me where are you from and how someone can ever repay you for this?

I live close to this beach, about a 10 minute walk inland. Its a small village called Blythe Point. I am the seamstress there. I make many of the Kings robes there. I expect no repayment for this and wish to have no praise for it. I help when and where I can!
Oh how sweet you are! We shall all brag to the king about your kindness.
It is nothing the King would think of as praiseworthy. I fear his kindness doesn't extend past his own nose. I hear his incessant babblings at every fitting!
What?! How dare he not think of such as praiseworthy.

The King doesnt see me as a person of worth. He must think me an idiot for him to speak so in my presence. The words that pass his lips... Well, anyway, I hope this necklace helps the mother to be! She will be in my prayers!
Yet, you provide him with essentials? That is no king of mine!
I have even heard him speak of the wolf pack that roams this area. He should have sent his Knights to seek them out by now. Then, this poor woman may not have lost her husband so cruelly.

an a woman walking the beach

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: I have seen you before! Thief what is it you think you will get today?
I am not here to thieve today...I am here to see my brother who is being held here.
Is he a thief too?
Yes sir...he did thieve but I'm trying to convince him to tell on another thief so he can get out sooner...you know...make a deal.
A deal? What is it you have in mind?
He knows the name of the person who stole a jewel from the castle...that should be worth something...right?
It should be! Convince him!
I'll need some time with him...guard...man it stinks in here...doesn't anyone muck this place out?
I will just wait and listen around the corner! Do not try anything!
I guess you'll be wanting to hold onto this?
I'll keep that! Now get convincing!

He says it was Duke SoinSo who stole the jewel... my brother was there...yes...but just to get a loaf of bread...he overheard the Duke and the queen herself talking about taking the jewel...The queen is out to hurt the King!!!
How honest could a thief be... you know the saying no honor among.... Thieves!

Are you saying my brother is a liar...guard...he is a thief...not a liar...he knows the trouble he is in...he knows he is doomed no matter which way this goes...he has decided to do what is right and see what happens.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Jester, I need you to do your job. I'm feeling depressed.
What is it you need me to make you laugh with today?
I'm not the expert. Figure it out!
Do you want to see me trip and fall?
Let's give it a shot
Walking along and trip over own two feet. OWWWWW that smarts. It hurt worse than I thought it would
Hmm, no. That didn't quite do it. here, try eating this.
Really? I will break my teeth on that! Sire you jest! now that made me laugh.... get it jest?
DON'T LAUGH! It reminds me that I'm not laughing! Now eat it!
Owwwwwwww! owowow , not funny anymore is it. I have no front teeth... I need a dentist!
Wonderful, wonderful!
You are sick, my King! this is painful and I'm bleeding. I need a dentist!
You never fail me, Jester! Now I am in very good spirits!
You are a sick, sick man!
action: give red brick to the jester

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: I love looking around this Bazaar. Maybe I will find something for my wife.
You should bring her some cheese!
A talking rat! What sorcery is this?
HAH! I'll bet you've never seen this before! Run, puny villager!
Get away rat. I  make weapons for the King
I'll show up where you least expect it! You'll never know when I'll just show up- seeing human's fear brings me so much joy!
Well, that still does not feed you and I need to get this arrow to test a bow I am making.
oh, you think I need to eat?! There are enough crumbs here to keep me going for days! Curse this witch who made me a talking rat; I will get my revenge on you humans yet!
I knew there had to be sorcery involved.
*sob*
What a horrible life for you dear rat. My two children would love you dearly. I also think that vase would be good for my wife.
...I've never been hugged before.
Well, things will be better. Do you think I should take you home as well as this vase.
Things never get better! I'm stuck as an enchanted rat and everyone is scared of me- even other rats!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Welcome to my side of the realms.
We must come together, for the sake of both our Kingdoms. If not, I fear our people collectively will be in harms way.
What threat are you aware of that requires an alliance?
I have come here to seek your assistance with fighting the Orc army.  My spy's have alerted me to the fact that they are gathering forces now to attack both of our Kingdoms. We are in grave danger.
Orcs? I thought we wiped them out 20 years ago?

Me too! I caught wind of an uprising several years ago.  It took some time for my spy to infiltrate their ranks but now, I fear we are too late.  They have grown stronger than I could have ever imagined!
Then there is no time to spare. I will call upon my knights immediately.

We must call forth your most trusted supporters. We need to form an alliance between both our armies. If we act swiftly, we may just have a chance. They are quite angry about the Orc genocide from 20 years ago. They are out for blood!
Take this and wear it as a sign of our alliance. We must alert the couriers to spread out pamphlets about the coming threat.
I will wear this with honor. Make haste, we will need to have pamphlets spreading throughout the Kingdom by days end.
This will truly be a trying time, but I am glad to have you by my side.
Our Fathers once came together to battle the Orc army and here we are now, fighting the same fight.  They were successful, or so we thought. It is up to us now, my friend!
This time, it will be forever.
We can only hope, for the sake of our children, our children's children and our legacies!
action: give suit of armor to king

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: What news today, guard?
My liege! It is quite quiet today!
That is good to hear. How long have you been with us?
10 years my liege!
10 years! We appreciate your service. Was your father a military man?
My father, my grandfather and great grandfather. It is long line of guards we are
Very impressive. Tell me, what do you do in your free time?
I spend time with nieces and nephews. I have not married yet
Perhaps we can change that, if you're interested.
Are you saying what I think you are saying? You have a daughter?
Oh, heavens no. Not for you at least. No offense, but I think someone else may suffice. The princess has a peasant friend who would make an excellent friend.
I do not need another friend! I am not a peasant. You take me as a high regard of a guard
I see, perhaps I've misjudged you. Usually my guard know their place.
I know my place your highness! I thought you thought well of me! But I guess not. No disrespect intended

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: BOO!
Whaaaaat? Who is that?
I aaamm a ghosst.
There are no such things as ghost..... Maybe I have been told wrong all these years. I do not see anyone....
You can't see me either? Can yoou hear me?
I can hear you! You must be a ghost! I didn't think they were real
I am real. I am so glad to find someone who can hear me after all this time!
I thought the mouse here scared me more... but you put me off and I am leary
I am the king of castle's past.. I once ruled this great land!
How long ago did you leave this world>?
I have been scaring people in the castle tower for many years now. I have watched many different people come and grow old over the years.
How much have you seen? What wonders have you come across
I watched my son grow old and die. His son, my grandson was a meal ole King. He cheated on the Queen with every servant in this place!
Oh my word! That must have been a very hurtful event for you

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Speak, traveler. Tell me why an outsider visits this tower!
I have some important information that the King will want to hear.
You must request to speak with the King. You will need to tell me of what important information to relay to the King. We cannot let just anyone come in here!
I understand. I cannot give this information for free, but it is very important and urgent.
Then you must make your case to me, Traveler. I am entrusted with protecting the King and his Kingdom from outside threats. If you have information that we need, you must tell me at once!
King Joffrey plans to attack your kingdom in three days time.
Traveler, this is something that I have feared. I have heard rumors that this may happen. We must find the King and let him know of King Joffrey and his plans!
Of course, thank you. I have traveled from town to town, and King Joffrey has wiped out a few kingdoms, his next attack is here.
I fear for my couriers.  The King sent out several to check on neighboring Kingdoms recently. None have returned. We must make haste!

Yes, need to hurry. I need some traveling money to go warn the kingdom just North of here. King Joffrey plans to attack there once he is finished here. Maybe the kingdom in the North can make it here it time to help you stop King Joffrey!
I can send you with one of my most trusted Knights. He will offer protection to you on this journey!
Oh thank you. We will need horses to get there quickly.
Of course, we have several steeds to assist you both on your journey. Have you been trained to use a sword? If you are attacked on the way, my Knight can only do so much.
I have when I have must. I am glad to be of assistance. King Joffrey is sure to kill me if he finds out I have helped you. We must be on our way now.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Step back intruder! You have no business in the king's treasure cavern!
I dodn't know anyone was here!
And what if no one was? You had plans to plunder the king's finest trasures? Are you looking for a trip to the stockades?
Is that what is here?  I had no idea.  What are you doing here?
I have been appointed by the gods to protect the king and all of his possessions.
Sounds special.
Give that to me at once! You are not to touch these artifacts!
Touchy touchy.  Take it if you must!
You seem to have a death wish friend, trampling around in the king's treasures is a high offense. Don't you have anything better to do? I'd really prefer to keep my sword clean today.
I love your enthusiasm, but you better keep that sword in the sheath if you value your life.  I have a reputation to protect and if you touch the hilt you will be regretful...for a moment.
Unfortunately for both of us, I am immortal. As tempting as your offer sounds I must pass...
Immortal, huh?  Well....I don't know what to say.  Is it too late to leave?
After you've threatened the king's bodyguard? You're a funny one aren't you?
I try.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: The turtle-folk are rebelling again husband!  When will you lead the armies to take back our lands from the shelled ones?
My queen, how are you today?
Upset about the turtle-folks rebellion!  Did you hear nothing of what I said?
I was hoping to not chat about such negative affairs.

Well, you are the King, and you are only King because you married me.  So you had better get over yourself and talk to me, or I will find myself a better King to replace you with, and you can return to being the Baron of Hogswaddle.
How dare you undermine me, you best keep to yourself and let me run the kingdom.

That is it!  You have no blood-claim to the throne, and this *Queendom* is mine, as it was my mother's before me.  If I die, my cousin Broomhilda will inherit, and you know what she promised to do to you if she ever found you creeping outside of her window again.
Currently i hold all the power. I have your family in prison and you best mind me if you want to stay out of prison.

But my dear . . . you missed one family member.  The guard in this very room.  The one who pricked you with poison as soon as you entered my chamber.  Your organs will slowly dissolve over the next month, and you will die in excruciating pain.
If this is true, i shall enact my final plans...
Your final plan of dying slowly?
No i have put all of the kingdoms riches into a cave and traded it for a dragons loyalty.
Well, that seems like the dragon has no need for you then?  You gave her a hoard, which she will now guard, and ignore any oaths given to you.
We shall see. Now! let me go in peace or face me!

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: Hello grandfather
I am not your grandfather, and you are just a farm worker. Show some respect!
Well sir.  I have tended to the animals.  May I go home now?
You are home, these are your living quarters.
Well I am tired.  What is for dinner?
Why are you asking me? My daughter is married to the king. I am not your servant!!
Then why are you in the living quarters?  Perhaps the King has no use for a grouchy old man.
I am here to tell you how I want my land to be worked
Ha.  You are here as a glorified babysitter.
I demand respect!
Sit down old man before I put you down.
The king will hear about this
Give me back my bag, you old senile coot!!!
You will be executed for this disrespect!

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Tell me King, waht brings you to my land?
I would like to negotiate a deal of trade and I will have my beautiful daughter marry your son.
I see, is that all or did you want somethig else?
I feel that if our families combine through our children we can join our militaries and be the might of the world.
I see, they would make a fine couple. What can you do to prove to me your loyalty?
Non of that talk is necessary. We have been peaceful neighbors for centuries. It's time to join forces!
I have heard rumors my king. I need to make sure...
This is my families. Take this to honor our agreement. I will bring the princess here tomorrow for a meet and greet. I'm sure the two will adore eachother. Your son is a fine prince.
I know he is. I raised him. I expect the princess will do everything she can to adore him.
What do you think? Fine craftsmanship. They don't make them like this anymore.
I like it. Where did you find this?
Like I said. It's been in my family for centuries. It is yours now.
Did you kingdom create this? It seems like something that has a curse upon it.
No curses of any kind. I was just a nice gesture to conclude our agreement. It is customary.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: I thank you sir, i would have not found safe passage back home without you.
No thanks needed, my good merchant. I hope the sea has been treating you well.
Yes it has, it has been a peaceful voyage thus far. We were blessed with calm seas.
Indeed, though when you have as much experience as I do you know that can change quickly. Thankfully, the seas should stay calm for the time being.
Tell me, have you ever felt like the sea would take you? Like during a frightful storm?
Oh my yes. On one of my first voyages we got caught up in a storm that nearly tipped my vessel clear over. Lost five good men to the sea that day.
Oh wow, have you ever seen a creature or large squid. I have heard rumors of such a being.

There was... something a couple months back. With a gigantic maw and teeth the size of you or I.  It nearly took a bite out of the hull of my ship.  I've no idea what it was, and pray it doesn't make itself known again.
Oh wow! What part of the sea did you sea this strange creature?
Just off the golden coast. I was transporting the king and queen at the time. Thankfully they were below deck and didn't witness the monstrosity.
Oh my! What a frightening endeavor. I hope to go see this monster some day.
It looked very viscous, so I hope you see it from the safety of the land if at all!
I want to capture this thing. I would be famous!
Ahahahaha, that sure is the merchant mentality, isn't it? Trying to make some gold anywhere you can.

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

speech: How did you get in the tree house, fish?
The elf over there thinks its funny but he makes so I can breath air so its all cool, I just hope he puts me back pond later
That is very strange. Won't you die if he decides he doesn't care anymore?
Yea but they have a oath to do no harm to animals  so I should be ok, what brings you up here
I live up here. I am building myself a throne because I hope to be King of the Bugs
king of the bugs thats sounds awesome how many bugs are up  here
An untold number. We are everywhere
I see you should be living the life then
Yes, but I could use the help to achieve my aspirations. I go unnoticed by many
well the elf would be the one to talk to I am just a fish out water
It seems that you have an in with the elf though. Can you speak to him on my behalf?
.... He says that a king of the bugs deserves a huge throne so he gonna make you one
Thank you so much!!
well not sure if  I see you again but I hope you live long and prosper has king of the bugs

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: I'm the *king*! What possibly could you want from me, peasant?!
I.I don't want anything from you. You ordered me up here to send signals.
Why are you even talking to me? Do your job! You commonfolk can't do anything right.
I'm sorry! Your majesty! You are hurting me!
Pick *up* your moldy bread! Start sending the smoke signals, would you? I'm still waiting for someone to come carry me down the stairs!
Would you like some?
UGH! I don't want your nasty bread; I want you to send some signals and get someone up here to carry me down these stairs, for Gods sake! Are you deaf?
There, your majesty. The signals are sent. I warned them you are in a mood today and to bring your favorite purple silk pillow to sit on on your way down.
Hmph. You call wanting help down these dreadful stairs being "in a mood"? At least the view from up here is nice while i WAIT FOREVER.
I was just trying to make you laugh your majesty. Something seems to be troubling you.
You're right.  I own all these nice things in this beautiful land but I have no queen with which to share it.
There, there. You need to get out of this castle and find some adventure. You are likely to run into your love at some point.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I don't envy your lot.  A bit too damp in here for my taste, and I can't stand the sight of blood.
Yes it is so damp and depressing.  I only dream of leaving this dreary place.
Well, I do feel sorry for you.  What did you ever do to get in here, and why was it bad enough to get you sent to the torture chamber?
I went to market to buy food but did not have enough money.  I stole but a loaf of bread to feed my family.
I can see throwing you in prison for the rest of your life, or cut off your arm so that you can't steal anymore.  But torture?  That just seems inhumane.
It was rye bread, meant for the King.
Still, what information does he hope to get out of you?  You confessed easily enough to me without the need for torture.
It is a case of mistaken identity.  They think I am in league with Robin Hood.  I do not know the man
Robin hood eh?  Well, you certainly don't seem to be merry enough to be one of his men.
Who could be merry in this place?  You seem to be a kind fellow. Take pity and release me from the hell.
I take pity on one such as yourself - fine, but you will need to rough me up a bit, or else I might get sacked for cowardice.  But no blood, please!
Thank you kind sir.  I will owe you my life.
*oof*  Anytime *ugh* a few more hits *ack* there . . .that . . .should  . . .do it.. . . good luck.  And tell Robin . . . I am sorry.
I will definitely do so.  Your family will be so rewarded!!!

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: What are you all doing in here
Hello, good prince. I am the mightiest warrior in service to your father the king. I have returned from plundering and am bringing my bounty to be stored here.
Ah! What are you bringing here?
We looted the village to the east and found many bejeweled weapons, gold artifacts, and a rare and mystical glowing orb.
Oooooo, let me see the orb?
It began to glow as you reached toward it. Please do be careful. What is that sound?!
Where... what... what is this? Is it dangerous?!
I don't know prince, the village had a mystic and this was in her quarters. Surely it is cursed!
Perhaps it is so... look! There is a witch in here!
Oh spirits save us, you're bleeding sir!
Bleeding... no... no, I cannot die. I am a prince!
My gods, what anger have I wrought on this young man?! Drink this water I obtained from the river near the village sir. Queen, please go get help!
I... I think I am going to die...
No, my prince. Please fight bravely. The queen is bringing aid!

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hello my wife. How are you?
Not so good. The people of our kingdom are getting restless not knowing when the King of our neighboring kingdom is going to attack.
Ah, well I have sent my spies to find out
Very well. You must protect us all, and come up with a good plan of attack.
I will gather my advisors and we will lead our troops to attack them first
Yes, take the attack to them. Please make sure to be safe and come back home.
I will. Take care of my heir. The future depends on him
Yes my King. What is this spoon doing on the floor? The servant must be punished!
Clearly the servant is not doing his job. Throw him in the dungeon!
I almost fell tripping over the spoon. How am I supposed to take care of the heir if I were to get injured from the servants lack of doing his job. Yes, throw him in the dungeon!
I am so sorry my queen. I will find you new servants
I will need a good one while you are off fighting. I don't need anything else to worry about while you are off protecting our kingdom.
Of course, only the best for our royal family
We deserve only the best in this land.

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

Why yes, they would help make my lighthouse smell and look all the more lovely.  What kinds do you have, and how much?
Right now I have tulips for 5 copper pieces each and lavender for 2 copper each.
Well lass, here are two silver pieces.  I shall take three of each, and you may keep the change as a tip - we need more people bringing beauty into this world.
Why thank you, this kindness does not go unappreciated. This will do me and my daughter a lot of good.
You have a daughter?  How lovely!  Does she go to the local school?  My grandchildren are students there.

Oh my, that sounds fantastic! Are you sure that wouldn't be too much trouble for you?
Not at all.  The King pays me well enough, as long as no ships hit the shore.  And ever since my wife died, my children have said I don't keep things as tidy as they would like.
Well I cannot thank you enough for your generosity. I'm sure my daughter will be thrilled at the chance to make some new friends.
Well, their names are Marsha and Frederick, and they are six and seven.  How old is your little girl?

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: This water tastes like bat poop.
What do you expect. You are in the bat room... That's what we do!
I suppose.  I thought you might worry about the hygiene of your water, maybe you could take the doodoo outside.
When we tire of being in here, we fly out and go under bridges and in dark woods. There is plenty to drink out there
I see.  Are you the king of these bats?
That I am! You are a smart snake..
I am, and powerful.  I have come to collect your payment for my protection.
What are you talking about? You are rediculous!
You must be new to the king game.  Am I right?
No, I have been king for a long while. Now I will command my bat kingdom to partake in pelting you with rocks!
Now you are being ridiculous!  I will not be disrespected by a feeble bat king that poops in his own water!  I can bite your head off in an instant.
You cannot win this one.... we will pelt you with rocks and poop!
Do you think a 30 foot snakes fears a hoard of bats?  Bring me my payment.
Take this for payment! Pelts snake with rock covered with poop!

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Okay guard...let's discuss this...The other's will be here soon.  What's the plan?
I have trained the dogs to attack on my command. The other guards will be arriving shortly. I will train the dogs on them and pretend to aid them while you plunder the treasures.
Do you promise the dogs will not turn and attack me?  I think there is enough here to keep us for a very long time.  The horses are waiting and the boat is prepared.
The dogs obey only me. They shall only turn on you if betrayal is afoot.
No betrayal here...will they are be going with us to the new land?
They will need to stay behind sadly. We need them to detain the others while we make our escape. Only the slightest cry for help outside these walls and we shall surely be hung!
I hope the silence spell that the wizard gave holds...we shall see...if this goes sideways we will meet again in the afterlife.  But...in the meanwhile I'll keep gathering these rubies.
The risk shall be worth the treasure indeed, may the gods have mercy on our souls. I shall live a tortured, rich life knowing I betrayed my dear king.
Dear King indeed...I'm a duke and he treats me like a peasant.  I will not have a sleepless night if all goes well.
Here they come, ready yourself!

I have everything prepared...remember we will not be able to speak until we are out of this Cavern...the wizards spell will effect us and the dogs as well...it will be a silent battle....we will ride quickly to the water and then away!
Guards, please seize this man. He's been plotting a massive plunder of the king's treasure! Sir, I cannot betray my king, my honor must be preserved!

Wait...what...this wasn't part of the plan...how could you...Guards this guard has been plotting to overthrow the King and take his treasure...I am Duke SoinSo!!! You will take him into your custody and his dogs.  They are trained to attack you.  Be very careful!
Dogs, attack!

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: The priest tells me that you wish to seek refuge here, is that true?
For a short time if it can be offered.
It is a difficult process, what is the reason that you require refuge.
I just left the kingdom of Genericose and they have threatened me with tar and feathering.
Genericose? They are usually a reasonable people. What did you do that upset them so much?
I don't know, you kiss one princess and they all turn on you.
Oh! You kissed Princess Penelope? For that I cannot blame you. But if we accept you here, the King of Genericose will be very upset with us.
I understand the danger to you.  But please hide me.
We have our own princess, and though she is no beauty, how can we be assured that you will not try the same things with her?
It isn't how it seems.  I am her fiancee.  On my travel to No-wheresburg I met her and we fell in love.  Obviously no one can know.
Are you saying that our princess is not good enough for you? Are you calling her ugly? Perhaps the refuge you need is in our dungeon!

No, please.  I have not met your hideous princess....I mean beautiful souled princess.  I mean....I'm sure she has a good personality right.  But I am pledged to be married.  Otherwise...I would be all over it.
Relax. I was just testing you. I will tell the priest to offer you refuge here in his office. Tomorrow we will talk about how we may be able to help you further.
Thank you so much.  I thought you might be the princess for a second with a fake beard on.  I really don't want to be offensive.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Is the jester getting ready for a party?
I believe he is. I always enjoy his entertainment. Do you like him, too?
I think everyone finds him hilarious! If he wasn't I'm sure he would not be employed, maybe even lose his head.
Fair point! What brings you here on this fine day?
Well I was just coming in to view the paintings and to my surprise there is going to be a party. So it is with good luck that I came today. What is going on with your day?
I'm here to protect the royals in the event of a disaster. I love working here with all of the beautiful chandeliers and candles!
I can understand that! it is quite beautiful!
Are you attending the party?
I would love to join in the celebration. Is everyone invited?
I'm not sure. I haven't received any details from the king, but the chef told me he is preparing for over 500 people!
That is quite a lot of people.... There are about that many people in the village and I live there
Then maybe he is throwing a surprise party for the whole villlage. The rumor is that he has an annoucement related to the princess, but I don't know that to be true.
Oh that is great!  Can't wait to find out what it would be. What do think it could be?
She's been talking quite a bit with someone from another kingdom. Do you thinkit could be an engagement announcement?

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Aaaaah, my dining hall. And my loyal subjects.
Sire, I have brought the Royal Coinpurse and Ceremonial Hat for you.
Why thankyou, lowly one. I would like to feel fancy while I dine.
Yes Sire.
Now, food time. I must eat, for I have a long night of sleep ahead of me. And then, you, my subjects, may dine.
Yes, Your Majesty, Thank you, Your Majesty.
Here, take this. I won't wear it while I eat and maybe it'll keep you warm. But only for now!
Thank you Sire!  You are truly a wonderful King!
I know, I know. But enough about me. Time to eat! Everyone grab a plate, now that I am done. There should plenty left over for at least some of you
Yes Sire!  You are a generous ruler!  Thank you.
I'm feeling generous. Come, touch me. But not too much. And wash your hands first.
um, Yes Sire!
Okay ENOUGH hugging... give me my coinpurse back, one of you dirty lowlives stole it, and if I find who, there shall be hell to pay!
No Sire!  I have personally guarded it!  No one has come near it!

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Oh..it is so beautiful up here!
Child what are you doing by yourself! Where are your parents! This is not a safe place for you to be without supervision!
I'm not alone...my groom is right over there...I am a princess...
Well, I hope that is true! It is a magnificent site to behold up here
My pony brought me up here and I found this funny rock.
That is no rock, child. It is a crystal ball.
I thought it was a rock..I rubbed it and it was glowing...what is a c..r..y..stal ball?
It has magical powers for some to see into other places. Only a true soothsayer can see into a crystal ball
Too many big words for me...I think my father...the King...would be one of those sooth..things...
He can see into the crystal ball? He can see other places?
Don't know...just want to play up here and collect more rocks...
Yes, child? Do you want to keep the crystal ball? Or try to return it back to its rightful owner?
You can have it...you seem nice and it is shiny...I the princess...ummm...gift it to you.
Why thank you your highness! I appreciate that. I will make sure it gets back to whomever it belongs to
action: give a crystal ball to people
give a crystal ball to child
give a crystal ball to people

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Can I offer you some food citizens?
Please.  We are so hungry.  The king's men have stolen all we have.
I have nothing with me, but you all should come over for dinner at the family farm tonight. We have some items ready for harvest that you can choose to take home.
You are too generous.  How do you have so much bounty under this regime?
Well, I do good and people do good to me. I try to follow the good Lord as well.
It has worked well for you.  Do you have a church we can attend to be with more people like you?
Of course! The town church where the temple is! The priest is always very helpful in speaking truth.
Do the king's men leave the members alone?
Indeed they do unless a crime has been committed.
Good folks like you could never commit a crime, surely.
I have never committed a crime, no... no I have not. I have never seen reason to commit a crime. I have been blessed with family and fertile land.
You are far more blessed than I then.  My land and family have both been taken by the king and his men.
How about you come work for me? I could use some help on the farm.
Oh how kind you are.  I have truly been blessed this day to have met you.
