setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: What brings you to the Tombstones of the Kings chef?  Usually only members of the royal family travel here.
The King wanted to have a feast for his late uncle.
Ah, and what's on the menu?
His uncles favorite. Meatloaf. Potatoes.Greenbeans. Wine. I will admit. I'm not used to being out of the kitchen.
Well, I suppose you can place it next to the gold on the tombstone.
Oh,  I shall. This isn't my favorite dish to make. The King's uncle was a boring eater.
What is your favourite dish?  Mine is roast boar smothered in honey garlic sauce.
I love making anything with salmon!  The Kingdom has the best salmon in all the land!
Interesting - what is it you do to make the salmon different from that of other chefs?
well, I can't give away my secrets. Why do you think I'm the King's chef?!
Well fine then, just trying to be sociable.  I don't really care for seafood anyway.
Well guards wouldn't get to each my seafood anyway.
Well, who would when you could have boar instead?
Aha! Boar is fun to fix!  I love making boar for all you guards!

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: did it just get cold in here...... brrr...
oooooooooo, mmmmmmmmmm
EEK! What was that?!
You can hear me? Most people do not pay attention to me. As if I don't exist
Yes. I can here you. Are you a lost soul?
No, yes, maybe.... I haunt the halls of this castle that once was king in. I cannot get to the other side, so I haunt until I leave this world
I can help you pass to the other side. You have come to the right place.
What is it you can do to help me.... I have been here a long time
All I have to do is read some passages and you will see a light. You have to walk into the light.
What passages? Sounds like mumbo, jumbo to me
Well, it is. I have seen it work. It's up to you. scaring people sounds like some fun too.
It is not that I do it for fun.... well maybe not all of the time.
I am so sorry. I know if I could I would really enjoy playing tricks on people. You seem more sad to do fun things.
I only wish to be among the people who love me.... the people here in this world use to love me. but they pretend i don't exist

setting.name: Rectory
setting.description: The rectory is very fragile and rickety due to age and various periods of neglect. Everything is wood-based and scratched up and chipped, including the beds strewn about. The clergymen would call it "cozy" but the space within is almost claustrophobic.
setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

speech: We should really have this wood replaced don't you think.
I'm not sure it's too kind to pick apart my rectory. You may run your church how you want but I'm the head priest here! Now, what brings you all the way from your village?
I came here to drop off the new version bible
Blasphemy! The bible is sacrosanct and I want nothing to do with your interpretation of it.
What kind of priest are you if you do not follow the word of god?
Harumph, of course I do good sir! I just do not believe it is our place to change the holy texts.
If you say so. Every church in the realm is going from this bible commanded by the king.
Well I shall certainly pray on it and I do apologize for my outburst but if the text takes liberties I shall speak with the king myself.
That is all I ask. I cannot make you read from this bible. I have to admit it did take some time getting used to.
And did you find any contradictions with our previous texts?
They were just different wording saying the same thing. new lingo.
I shall review the new version carefully. We host an extremely devout congregation and I take it as my responsibility to keep them on the virtuous path.
Got to keep the youth interested. I believe that is why they have changed some of the wordings.
These children should be taught the importance of patience, to study, to really dive into these wise words and find meaning.
action: steal wood from the head priest

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Wizard, I am Ambassador to King James of the neighboring Kingdom. I have traveled far to find you. Although, evil you are, you are the most powerful wizard we know.
I am not evil! Does evil mean because i am capable of casting spells? I ask you does that mean I am evil?

You are evil by our standards because you have murdered mass amounts of our people. I seek your assistance though. I hear you are able to read this ancient text. I need you to interpret this scroll and in exchange, your crimes against the Kingdom will be overlooked.
I do not murder, you have that wrong. I do not need to do that. I just cast spells on others to transform them. I could transform you into a pig, if you would like. i have commited no crime as of yet

You must surely realize that when you transform people into animals or insects that they are usually surely killed. You transformed an entire family into pigs and they were sent to the slaughter and eaten as bacon within a week.
hahahahaha.... now that was funny!

Of course it is funny, to you! Evil wizard, if you are able to assist the King with this scroll today, he will most assuredly let you live. Translating this scroll means life or death. For you and for our great King!
What scroll do you babble about? I think that I would rather turn you into a pig, unless you quickly give me that scroll
You are truly evil, wizard! But, as it pains me to say this, you are indeed brilliant and the best wizard in all the land! Here, this is the scroll. It is of utmost importance!
Let the servant open the scroll for me, ambassador. I do not touch anything.

Very well then. You may need to move closer though, the text is written in such a way that you must hold the scroll up to a light to read it. And the lettering is tiny. It is a language that I have never even seen before.
I can see from here. I have the eyesight of wolf at night. Do not worry about what I can or cant see
I should have known you would have cast the spell of true sight upon yourself. I cannot argue with you. As much as I hate this, you are our only hope. Please, help us!
Open the scroll you idiot!

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello Commander.  Why have you disturbed my time with the queen?
Apologies my King. But I wanted to show you this photograph.
What is it?
It's a family photo of mine. I thought you would like to see it. I know you've never met my family.
You greatly overestimate my interest in your personal life.
Oh. I apologise my King. I am sorry that my family is not of interest to you. Why should I honour yours if you care so little about mine though?
Excuse me?  Are we on level ground, you and I?  Do you rule and reign?  Are you a king and I am unaware?  You are going the right way for a beheading.
Of course not King. I was under the impression you respected me though. If you speak to me like that I will have to leave these lands and never serve you again.
Try my friend and you will find an arrow in your back.  This conversation has really gone south.  Why don't we start over.  Very nice picture.  Now you may leave.
And what will happen to you then? With no commander you have little protection. I'm sure the queen disagrees with you.
That's it!  I have many options for a commander, but you have only one life.  GUARDS, take this man to the dungeon.
Stop! Don't you dare touch me. Queen - save me? How can you let this happen to me?

She has nothing to say.  She does not control this land.  You will look back on this day as you rot in the dungeon an wonder why you couldn't hold your tongue.  But fear not, your family will be right there with you in the dungeon.

I see you are stuck in the dark ages with your approach to women too. I'll look back on this day and remember it was the day I stood up to your miserable face.  My family will thank me in the end when I get a better life away from these lands.
action: give Family Photo to king omako iii
steal Family Photo from military commander
steal scepter from king omako iii

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: What brings you to this disgusting place, Captain?
I had to relieve myself if you must know.  What are you doing here?
I live near here. This is where we sometimes find things we can sell that others have thrown away.
I hope you don't mind but I will keep this knife handy.  I dropped something.  I have to find it....
No problem. Can I help you look?
It's a compass.  I must find it. It was my father's. The only thing I have left of him.
Oh no! I will help you find it, even if we have to look all night.
Thank you sir...I will give you a gold coin if you find it...You'll need to come to my ship at the Kings dock to collect it...as my guest of course.
That's so kind of you, sir! When does the ship leave?
We are departing whenever the King and his court is ready.  We are honored to take His Majesty and the Royal Family to the island for a holiday.
The island! How fun! You must be one of the king's favorite subjects for taking him to the island!
Is that it??? Over there...I see it shining in the muck..
I do believe it is! I'll get it!!!

Oh...how wonderful...if it weren't for you walking this way I would not have seen it there...Please come to the dock and be my guest this evening.  You may take your evening meal with me at the Captains table and collect your reward.  To answer your question...yes the King and I are quite close...I have the best and biggest boat on these waters.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: I cannot wait to harvest the corn and wheat! It will be a good day for us when it is ready
Yes but we need to be careful that the wild animals don't eat the crops this time. The kind will be so angry!
You mean the king? haha The king would be angry for what reason?
Hahah Yes I mean the king. Last time the foxes ate all of the corn and the king could not eat corn soup for at least a week. That's his favourite food!
My sons and I sell our harvest in the market place. I don't think the king would be mad at me. We don't hand anything over to the king.
I understand that the king will not be mad at you, but I am the official gardener of the king at least 80 percent of my crops go straight to the palace and the kings family.
Well you garden on his land! he owns your crops and you. if ever you want to come farm for me. let me know

Thanks for the offer, I'll keep it in mind! Although the king always gives my family the best treatment and allows us to throw parties in the courtyard whenever my children have birthdays. Would you like to come to my eldest sons birthday this week?
Thank you for the invitation. My family would enjoy a time away from farming.
You will try the best wine in all the land! This Friday!
I will watch what i drink while my sons are with me. I do not engage in drink when they are around. I think I will decline the offer of your invitation.
I think that is a wise decision, my family always drinks more than we should, and that might be a bad influence on your children.
On mine? I think on yours! I see you do not worry the example you display for them.
I invite you to meet my family and drink my wine and I receive judgment and frowns. I wish to not see you in my party.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Hello my Queen
The king must never know about this.
Run away with me... We can be together away from here.
I can not. The king would hunt you down from the ends of the earth. I can not let that happen.
I love you.  It sickens me to think of you in his arms.
The only way this works, is if we kill the King first.
If we are found out, then we would be beheaded.
You must sneak in at night and do the deed.
I would not be able to get pass the guards but you could my love. Youl would never be suspected.
These coins should get you past the guards, they hate the king anyway.
I have fought many battles beside my king and I am the most loyal to him. But for you my Queen I would do anything
I will meet you next to this shrub when the deed is done.
The King will die and you will be mine....
I have my horse riding gear under this dress. I will be waiting for you.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Maid, I need you
For what, my King?
I am hungry
I am sorry, my King, would you like me to fetch you something from the main kitchen as well?
No but you can return this tray to the kitchen
Yes, my King, I will do as you have asked.
Clean my crown while you are at it
Of course, Your Highness. By when should I return it?
Clean it right away and return it when you are finished
Of course, it shall be my first priority and I shall return with it swiftly!
Great, I will be waiting
I have returned with your crown, you shall be the most envied king in all the lands.
Yes and it is my right to be king
Of course, Your Highness, you are the most revered king of them all.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: Hello
Hello there Prior, what brings you to the famous Tempior Market?
I am here to pray to the gods
At the market?  That seems a bit peculiar.
The gods are everywhere ... Don't you know that my Lord?
Yes, but why come to the market to do so?
The church is present in disarray
If I didn't know better, I would say that you were here only to sample the wine.
Hahahahaha. . You speak the truth my Lord.
I know that is my purpose - some Dorwinion Red will do nicely.
Wew. .the congregation must not see me with this
That was a good year!
We were blessed indeed
And I mustn't forget the Ales!  How does that song go?  "You can keep your fancy ales . . ."

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

speech: hello how are you
I am great dear fireman! We are staying here for the night on our travels.
Nice, you should come see are fire show tommorrow
A fire show!!! What is that!
Oh we do all kinds of neat Pryo stuff very cool you love it
That is so much fun! Do you put out fires too?
Not really we are the fire based support in battle we use are flame throwers to turn the king enemies into bbq
How interesting.  are you ever ambushed by bandits?
not really cause they be foolish to do so, let me buy you a beer
I am terrified to be ambushed on my travels. And thank you!
yes I can understand that, you should try and travel the same time has the king's guard alot safer
Oh you are smart. We have a group of mercenaries but I do question their loyalty at times.
yea they can be a tricky sort
I keep this if we are attacked.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: May I do you any favors people? Perhaps a wish or two with my magic wand?
I have a more pressing need, I'm been kidnapped and taking to an evil king who killed my parents. I don't know how i got on the beautiful ship. Can you get me out?
This sea monster will kill us both if we try to sneak you out!
So i'll never get to see my beloved wife and child again?
Highly unlikely... I could grant you a wish out of here, but it goes against what I am allowed to do given the situation. The fairy queen would have my wings!
I understand you, i'll just resign to my fate. Do you live on this ship?
I do not, but I visit. I have never heard of the king being so harsh... I live in my little fairy home not far from here.
I don't know what he has against my family, I've coming to terms with him but everything as been falling on deaf ears
Think if there is anything you did to put yourself here?
I have no idea, all this started with my parents but i was very young when the king murdered them
Do you remember anything they were involved in with the king? Surely there is a way out of this.
I once over heard my uncle telling my father, he was supposed to be crowned king instead of the present king. This was shortly before he was murdered
There is very bad blood between you. The king is trying to take out your lineage and whole family!
And that's a really scary scenario to imagine

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Do you feel that, My queen?
I do. I always feel it when I come here. I can't tell if it's the company or this mystical place.
I believe this entrance has spirits that roam in it.
They are probably of the kings and queens before. I even like the moss that grows on the walls. It seems to sparkle.
Don't touch it! We do not know it's powers.
Dear sir knight. Don't be silly. I come here every day and this is my castle and my entrance. I would know if it was harmful. I respect you being protective but you have to let me live a little too.
Yes, my'lady.
Take this up to my bath room servant. That's alright sir knight. You must kiss my feet.
Yes M'Lady, you are very wise.
Thank you sir knight! Oh! you just missed the fairy! Look that direction! Maybe she will come back!
Oh no, I misse her. I have never seen a fairy before.
Keep looking and you will see a flash of light. You will see her silhouette with in the light.
Oh My God, I SEE IT
No one ever believed me, especially the King. This will be our little secret.

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: Your highness, how may I be of assistance.
I sick of waiting to inherit the throne. I wish he would die already.
Young sir, that is your father the King you are referring to. He could have your head for speaking as such, son or not.
You are right butler. I must be patient.. It is so difficult.
If you were to take action against the King, your father would be dead, you beheaded, and the kingdom would fall to ruins.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Whats for dinner tonight chef
Cakes!  Chocolate Cakes!  Vanilla Cakes!  Blood Cakes!  All cakes, all the time!
Nice but don't we need some protein or something
Yes, which is why we have a Blood Cake!  Now, be sure to say your prayers properly when you pierce the blood cake with this ritual dagger.
Ok this is something  I have never done before
Well, be careful - you want to eat is very carefully.  The taste is divine, but bad things can happen if you don't follow the ritual correctly.
Ok, I will keep this in mind who taught you how to make this
Why, the Demon chef Abruzanagal of course!  Finest chef in the twelve planes of existence, very little patience as a teacher though.
I can only imagine so does the king know of your interesting food choices
Oh, certainly!  I am the finest chef in the North Kingdom, and the King knows it.  Why, cuisine has just surpassed education in the yearly budget!
haha thats awesome I look forward to it
Will there be anything else?
Oh yea this is for you don't ask me  what is I was just told  by my wife to give to you
Well thank you!  Tell her that I look forward to her next visit.

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Hello my king, do you know where this weapon came from?
Where did you come from and what are you doing in my weapon room?! GUARDS!
I...uh... just wanted to see where my fathers sward was.
Who is your father? Does he work for me? Why aren't you in my army?
His name was gregory. He was killed in the war. I was told his sword was kept here.
I knew him. Why did you not come to me first. This could have gone much smoother.
Well sir.... you are a tough man to get word to. Do you mind if i take this sword?
I am sorry. I would like to have a ceremony and give the sword to you that way to show respect and gratitude for your father.
....thank you my king..
I am a fair King but I can be tough to talk to at times. I have to be firm.
I understand, you can not show weakness. How is the war going?
We are about to have our victory of coarse. Why are you not enlisted?
You see king, i am not that strong. I can barely weild a sheild.
Try this on. If you can walk around in this all day then there is hope for you yet. Wear it for a week and you will see yourself getting stronger. kid.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Hello, my Liege
Hello.  Do you have my lunch and book set up for me?
I have yes your Highness... with your permission.
Speak plainly.
The Queen... she sent me here, she said you were lonely..
Hmmmm.  I am never lonely with a book?  She knows that.  Do you know what she meant?
Well... I think she meant, quite lonely
Ohhhhh.  OOOOHHHHHHH.  I see.  Well, uh.  Why didn't she come to me herself?
I think she feared that you would not want her after the rumors of her indescretions
Hold on.  Wait a second.   What indiscretions?
Oh... I wouldn't want to speak of such matters... especially how I stand before you right now
Well, right now I think I should go speak with her.  I, uh, appreciate the gesture, but I will have to say no for now.
Oh... OH I see. I am SO sorry if I have offended you, your highness. Please say nothing to the Queen, she will have my head if she thinks I have failed her!
Noooo, please.  If she sent you then you need not fear.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Tell me jester, what are you doing?
I am juggling, what does it look like I am doing? Are you not entertained?
No, now do something different. That is boring.
Now I'm juggling while dancing, surely you must find this entertaining?
haha no but taking your ball is.
Fine, let me see you try to juggle the ball if you think you are so clever. It is not as easy as I make it look.
You are right, this is hard.
I'm just glad you didn't try to juggle my crystal ball. It would have shattered.
Here try whipping that can over ther, It's hard.
Hey that was kind of fun. I wonder if I should incorporate the whip into my show. I'm in need of new material, recently people seem to be less amused by my juggling.
Yes it is an old trick. You should converse with other jesters to find new material.
What if I was to start juggling lighted candles. A little bit of fire might make it more exciting, perhaps?
Why yes that is brilliant.
Whew, that is a relief. The king had threatened to send me back to the potato fields if I did not improve my act. I would welcome any other suggestions you may have for me.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Hello there how fairs your kingdom
The spirit of the ancient king! My heavens, what are you doing in the courtyard?
Here this for you , so what brings you out here today I am just going for a lovely stroll and enjoying the sunlight
My apologies king, I just have never seen you in this place. I can certainly see why you would want to enjoy this lovely place though! Do you have any wisdom for me dear king?
Treat your subjects well and they will do the same
Ah, yes, of course, very, uh wise, good king. Surely you don't mean all of them though, they can be overwhelming at times and a queen requires her peace.
Well there is a time and place for everything do you have any kids
Yes, yes, of course. Your successor, the current king, and I have one young prince and princess.
Well make sure to get them involved in the running of the kingdom It will give you chance for peace and allow them to learn how to be better rulers

You're so very wise, of course we shall definitely do that. In fact, our young prince is in charge of running the stockades today! It's good to see him finding a passion for ridding our realm of filthy criminals!
nice nice, how about the little girl I bet she will be the prize of the kingdom
Yes, she is a sight! Takes after her mother I do believe. We have her training the local fashion merchants on proper pattern selection and color palettes!
Nice  well I am gonna rest have a great day
You as well, thank you for the visit today. I shall pass on your blessings to my dear husband.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hear, hear.. when is the food going to be ready then?
I'm not sure, guard, but I will ask the chef.
Good... Hey there you are, have any good jokes for the King today?? You almost lost your head yesterday at Court.. Haha! This guy
Everyone loves you, jester! I'm sure the king will forget. From what I could tell, he had an awful lot of wine.
Heh.. hey did anyone ask you, servant? Where is the food I asked you once! You told me you were going to check, why are you waisting OUR time? Come on, go do your duty!
My friend went to ask, but I'll go now, too.
Yes, begone! You know, stalling the King's Guard is stalling the King himself! That is treason I may remind you! Worm!
It's ok. Can't we all just get along?

Listen here! We will get along once I am done eating whatever grub the cook put together today. Until then I will sit here and wait while you waiste my time since that seems to be only thing you are good at...
I'm sorry you get hangry, sir.
Sure. And I am sorry you aren't here with my food yet! I am half minded to have you sent to the catacombs, if only I wasn't so weak from lack of nourishment.
There, there sir. The chef said it would be ready in 30 more minutes. I can't bring you what doesn't exist.
Unhand me, you vile thing. Touch me again and you will taste my blade...30 minutes... an eternity in this hell hole.
Here we go...attacking again. Maybe the king should get you some anger management classes.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello my dear, are you happy with the renovations of thsi room?
It is satisfactory my King.
Good, it was a good choice.
I think we need to have a conversation

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: Tell me peasant, what are you doing here, fishing?
I am trying to provide food for my family. The king does not provide for us peasants.
Do you have a fishing rod?
I do not, just this branch and thread from an old coat I no longer use. I fashioned a hook from a scrap of metal I found lying around.  I dig up worms as bate.
Here is a fishing rod, ill give you this if you give me half of whatever you catch.
Well, you are too kid my friend.  I shall become the best fishing man in the village and prove my worth of this gift.
It is not a gift, you must catch me at least 10 fish or i am taking it back.
Well than, I have my work cut out for me.  It has been slim picking here.  But maybe with a proper rod, I will have more success.
If you truly become good, i will buy a boat with you and we can start a business.
Wow, this is too much for a peasant.  No one has shown me such kindness in years.  I will not disappoint, my friend.
It is merely a business opportunity ofr myself.
But for me, this could save the lives of my family.
I am glad this worked out. how many are in your family?
I have my wife and seven children.  My oldest son will be 14.  He sometimes comes to help me fish.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello follower, I'm glad you're here.  I have a wonderful service for you to carry out for me.
Yes, of course. I hope this please our Knights too

Ah, perfect.  You already have the wood now.  I know you are a good carver and I need you to carve the wood into a cross.  Yes...we want to support our Knights as well!  They can pray under this when they come to church.
Praised be them, they bring the light and the wisdom of our Lord wherever they may roam. And yes, a cross. Worthy of His name!
Well spoken!  How long do you think it will take to carve the cross?
A week's worth, sire. I will give it all my attention and my best. Unless the Knights require me this week, of course.
Wonderful!  That's much sooner than I thought which is good because I need it ready for the festivities when the Royal Bishop comes in a fortnight.  You are a wonder!
Everything for the Lord! Have you any news from the Logan's?
No, unfortunately...I'm worried about what their silence could mean, but I'm trying to not worry about it.  Tell me, do you have any other friends that build furniture that are followers as well?

I have heard nothing else since the King sent for them. I sense the Knights know something that they are not telling me and I dare not offend them.... yes Douglas is not bad with tools but he does not have the belief I do in our Lord. Not the same conviction to drive him.
Do you think something could have happened to them?  Oh no...I will inquire.  Oh, too bad.  I was hoping someone could make us a massively long table for the welcoming party of the Royal Bishop.

I will speak only of this in that matter, rumours be they had a spy amongst them.. someone wanted to know something about them bad enough to go to that trouble. Who knows what they could have found.. or wanted to find.
Take heart.  These things come to light eventually and I will make inquiries and let you know.  You just continue your dedicated work and be blessed!
Thank you, I do appreciate it.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: How are you architect?
i am wonderful they have brought my design here to life beautifully

yes it is one of the crown jewels of my work, do you like it
The stone work is very ornate I must say.
yes i am surprised they got all the details right i was coming by to mark down the mistakes but have not found any
I take it that it is common to find issues with the work?
the king has very high standards i would not want him to be offended

the priest will forgive, the king will remove your head

i don't think you have much to worry about father
Oh I do not worry about my death, I am secure in where I am going.
have you seen visions of heaven i would love to know what you saw to include it in my designs

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Are you ready for a great evening, my dear?
Yes. What do you think of my new gown?
It's just as beautiful as you are.
And you still give me butterflies my love. What are they serving tonight?
Steak. I can't wait. It's been a long day.
Oh, your favorite! I hope there will be lobster as well?
There has to be. This is a feast of a lifetime. We always get the finest foods.
Yes. True. I hope you will dance with me tonight. Is your foot still bothering you?
It's still a little sore, but that won't stop me from dancing with you tonight, my love
We must be the most lucky Royal couple that ever lived. Not many couples get to choose their partner.
I agree. The luckiest, the most attractive and the most daring. We're a triple threat. Hopefully they have a nice dessert tonight (besides you)
Oh stop it......You just get...
I can't take my eyes off you tonight. That gown is something else. How about we dance now.
You will need to leave this here. I promise it will be here when you get back. Lets go!

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: Hello - how are things going so far?
Ah, sorry, miss.  I know I look a fair bit like me sister who works hereabouts, but I'm actually Gretchen, the sister that works up in the palace.  Perhaps she might 'ave mentioned me?
You're Gretchen? I've heard so much about you! Hello and welcome.
The Queen's in a bit of a state, what with the King being a bit more open with his mistress, so I thought I'd just hide hereabouts for a spell.  I'd be happy ta lend a hand, though!
Oh no! Is he really carrying on like that again? We'd appreciate any help you can give. Thanks!
Seems like a right busy crowd out there!  'as it been a bit on the noisier side?
Heavens, yes! It'll only get rowdier as the day goes on into night. Lots of bourbon and shots you know.
Ach, I don't think I'll ever be gettin the stains outta this rag, but it'll do!  Do ya make much in the way of coins here?  Can always use an extra bit o'coin, eh?
You can, especially if you take some from the change of the patrons. They're so drunk they never catch it!
O-oh?  Is that.. well I suppose if they've enough coin ta spend on this, then a coin 'ere or there won't go amiss.
Exactly. That's what I say. So, are you just here for a day?
Well, I suppose it all depends on how the King takes to 'is wife destroying his prized tapestry from the last war.  Sometimes he has a short temper, that one.
Sounds like his wife may, too.
Aye, ye don't know the half of it.  I feel like most of me days are spent sweeping up broken crockery and china than the usual dusting that I'm supposed ta be doin'!

get rag from basin for water

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Knight, were you brought out here to help in the farm as part of your sentence for your crime?
Yes, what would you like done first?
I need you to use this hoe to prepare the gardens for planting. Can you manage that?
Will this shovel work? The hoe has been put away so I can not use it.
The hoe will work better. Here - let me get it for you. Say- what did you do to end up serving as part of your sentence?
I was in the last battle and I was captured. The king spared my life in turn for manual labor.
The same happened to my brother in Elizabethia. He serves still to this day. Well, I'm happy for your life, but I have to tell you that I'll be working you hard.
So what exactly is this tool for? It sure looks like it would hurt if you got hit by it.
Now now! You won't be needing that in this here garden! Seems to me you ought to set about your work. We'll be planting beans today.
But this has a hook! I will use it to help pull roots from the ground!
Perhaps, perhaps. Just don't be getting any ideas of trying to escape! The King will have your head!
You know, I don't think I am going to be needing this today.
Fair enough - just get to work. Time's a wasting, oh knight!
I will not be doing your work today! I am going home to my family. try and stop me good farmer, and i will end your life.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: -juggles some balls around-
What a delight!  It is good to be the King . . . s cousin.
Certainly a bit less responsibility at the least.
Did I say you could stop juggling?  But yes, I suppose you're right - only about 40 cousins and distant relations in the way.  And they breed faster than they die!
-continues juggling- is there something else you want to see?
Can you do any acrobatics?
-tries a tumble across the floor and it goes horribly- You did not ask if I could do them well.
Hmmm, any other talents of amusement?
Well I can paint? Or some say they like it anyway.
Certainly, paint the walls.  It's not like I care, everything is owned by my cousin anyway.
Any particular color?
Make as much of a mess as you can, and describe to me in great detail whenever you paint something that looks particularly valuable.
Alright then. I suppose I will start flicking paint at the walls and so on.
Please, after all, it's your head.  I do enjoy being able to blame my trespasses on those who trespass before me.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, what land are you from? You look a bit different.
I'm from the land of Acadia a few kingdoms to the east. Such beautiful roses in this courtyard!
I would agree, I often come here to ease my mind.
Ease your mind? What troubles you?
Even someone such as I commits sins now and again.
I see. And do you have to go to confessional, too?
I have not for I am afraid my sins are grave.
Oh dear. I'm so very sorry to hear that. I cannot absolve you of your sins, but am happy to listen if you would like.
Well recently I have made the error in lying to the king, I did not do so maliciously.
Was it a big lie? Does it affect him in any way long-term?
I do not know, someone has been stealing from the church and I have yet to find who. I told him that everything has been fine, but I am afraid our coffers lie bare.
How terrible that they would put you in that situation. Do you think you'll be able to find the culprit?
I do hold hope that I can do so, it appears to be someone affliated with the church.
How terrible that someone would take advantage like that. I pray that you find whomever is responsible and that they are held accountable.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Lot's of spelunker bones in this cave, are you sure that you know what you're doing?
Ah, brave knight, I thought so at first. But now it appears I am lost. And with all this rotting wildlife here, I am afraid we may become troll food soon.

There, there lad - I used to be a spelunker in my youth.  See these turtles?  Grab on to one, and follow it as it runs.  They will head to the nearest exit as soon as they smell a troll . . .though, admittedly not very quickly.
Grab onto a turtle? Have you lost your mind!? They are not fast enough to escape the troll! We will surely be eaten if we follow your plan.
Well, do you have any better ideas?
Hmmm, let me think. Ah, I think I've got it. Do you see that pile of treasure near those stalagmites on the cave wall?
It is dark but . . . yes, I do believe I can just make it out.  I don't suppose the trolls declared that on their income taxes did they?
Of course they didn't! Having explored many caves as the king's spelunker, I know they are wicked beasts. But do you want to stand their pondering tax law or do you want to hear my plan?
Well, I am bound to serve and enforce the king's laws, but I see your point.  Please, enlighten me.
Trolls love treasure more than they love food. So let me take your ring and we will distract him. Then we will run straight out the cave's entrance and escape this awful stinking hell.
But that ring was given to me by the King! . . .Fine, but I will need your witness when I talk to the King's tax collectors when they come to collect the King's due.
Aye, I shall be your witness. The king trusts me. Now, let's try and get the troll's attention.
Ready when you are sirrah!
There he is! He's coming now. Knight, I need you to shout at him. Remind him of his tax delinquency, that will surely anger him!

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Hello craftsman, what brings you here?
Your Royal Highness, I've come with the plans for your Royal Navy, to finally crush those barbarian raiders once and for all!
This pleases me. What exactly are your plans?
Well, if ya don't mind me saying, yer Kingliness, I think I've outdone myself this time.  Have a look at these here nails and tell me what ye think.
I think these looks like a good way to test the raiders, but what do you plan on doing with them?

Well, if ye noticed the slight green shimmer on 'em, that be a special coating by the blessings of the Dryads and Nymphs in the kingdom.  When they're put inta the planking, it'll spread to the wood.  This will make the wood alive, in a way, so that it'll be self repairing.  And that's just the start o' it!
Very good, very good. Take this cape, and begin your plan. But before you go, tell me what you think of my newest painting that I had commisioned
Thankye kindly, Yer Wurshipfulness.  Oh, erm... what is it... suppose ta be, if ye don't mind a commoner like meself asking?  Tis a little... well it's colorful, I'll give ye that.
It is supposed to be a likeness of my wife. Your queen!
O-oh, of course!  Ha, I see it now.  My poor simple eyes are not used to such an... expressive painting style.
Yes, I agree. It is quite the painting. I think I will have them do a painting of myself holding my sword next.
Just be sure that yer painter has enough materials afore he starts!  With the raids, trade's been a bit slim lately.
That is true. Thank ye for the reminder. That reminds me, you should head out and let the others know of your plans so that they can prepare.
But of course, Your Highness.  I shall commence this very day!  We'll give those louts what fore!

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: So much luxuty in this room, many rulers have been here before us.
This is a very luxurious room, President. Here. The King told me to pass this on to you.
This is a letter for the king assuring my rule in this part of the kingdom, thank you mayor, I will place document on a sacred place
He also gave me this to give to you. He told me that you need to keep this in a VERY safe place until he comes for it.
Thats the key to the kingdom I  wonder why the king trusted me with this item, his throne must be in real danger
Yes, sir. He has also trusted me with other objects such as this to keep. We are his trusted allies.
Thank you, he must trust you a lot as well, here take this as a sign of my affection, its a royal jewel taken out of the volcano of Mordor
This is absolutely beautiful. I have heardd that Mordor is beyond the wall. Is that true?
That is true, only the bravest warriors go to that place, its full with dangers and fierce animals
Oh dear. What if our King went there? What if there is something there he needs for battles to come!
Our king is a fierce warrior but I am worried, who knows what can happen if he goes to a battle in a place like that one
I heard there are things that walk the forest and come with the cold. We must safe our King!
Lets hurry then, lets gather an army and go aid our king, heres a book with the names of the bravest soldiers in the kingdom
Oh this book is very amazing. Who is this..Sir Rodryck?

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Look, you prince. Admire all my books. And what do you think of my crown?
Father, Sire, You know I love your books almost as much as you do. But please. We are meant to be discussing my choosing a bride.
Look! Look at my crown! See how it shines like the sun itself! Will your wife be so bright?
Any woman who becomes Princess will of course be the Flower of the Nation Sire, but obviously not quite as shiny as the crown.
Yes, it IS a fine crown. Do you want to know what I call it sometimes?
No SIre, I really think we need to discuss Lady Bertha and Lady Blodwyn. I like them both, they have good families. Then there's Princess Tina who can bring loyalty from Tronta, Our neighbors.

Look at this book! It's about making choices! I've never read it. Know why? Because I'm rich. If you're baller rich like me, you don't have to choose anything at all. Why not have three wives? Are done here? I've got to spend some time with my crown.
Are you well Father?
How dare you s uggest that I've gone mad from king's madness, the disease that only mad king's get. I've BEEN TESTED!
Sire, stop, of course I didn't say that.... Guards, he's at it again, Guards! Help me wrap him in this throw. So he doesn't hurt himself.
Ah! These clothes! They're too tight! They're STRANGLING ME!!! God, why are you punishing me so? Must be clean! Cleanse me, oh LORD!
Carefull with him men, Try not to let him wander in front of the window naked again. Drat, Sire, come here.
Oh, god, their hands are all over me. It's just like back in king school. They were all so cruel to me! Please, be gentle!
Here Sire this is soft. Please cover yourself. You know it's what the crown wants.
action: give a rabbit fur coverlet to the king

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hello jester, busy work day today?
Yes like always, i wish the King appreciated it more.
Tell me about it, all they do is order me around and I can't do anything about it.
Would you like to grab something to eat with me?
Yes, I haven't eaten in a few days! What is on the menu?
It looks like fish soup! My favorite!
Better than nothing, that's for sure!
I have been made fun of a lot lately. I wish i was born a knight or a noble instead of a jester..
It is tough luck that we were born so low on the totem pole.
I guess you can relate. Have you spent much time with our King?
No, he only walks in and barks orders about once a week. Is he easily amused by you?
The only thing he likes about me is making fun of me.
At least he laughs at you, he is always angry when he visits me.
Ugh, what a dispicable human being.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello child. Have you brought me something?
I..ii..found this in the village. I was hoping they would be food in it...instead there's......a head.
Oh! That looks like our blacksmith Bernie! I was wondering why my armor wan't ready yet!
This was on it too, King. What is going on?
That was the diamond I gave the blacksmith to add to my sword! Someone is trying to send me a message!
I am scared King. It has been scary in the village lately. Please protect me.
Here, you can sit next to me. This is the safest place to be. My guards are already on alert for intruders.
Oh, King. What is going on? I'm always so hungry and didn't expect to steal a bag with a head in it.
Just sit here and don't be afraid. I will have the servants bring you some food. Where is your family?
I'm an orphan sir. My dad went to fight in the Battle of Blackwater and never returned.
You will stay here with me then. It's the least I could do for honoring your father who fought so bravely for his king.
Should we drink this to calm our nerves?
No! That's not for children! The servant will be her shortly with your food and drink.
Oh, I am sorry.  I usually drink whatever I can find.
action: steal the king's flagon from child

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: How go the sacrifices today?  I know the King decreed we can't use humans anymore, but Porcupines just don't seem to be getting the desired result.
The porcupine blood does make such a mess though, sticky and everywhere.
Sticky indeed -  a quill right in my thumb!  You should have seem brother Jonathan - why, he looked like a porcupine himself after the sacrifices last week.
They do have the tendency to squirm quite a bit, it makes the process painful should I say.
Yes, I do so wish the High Priest would allow us to wear gloves.  Apparently pain is a penance, but sometimes I feel like he is just messing with us, you know?
I have wondered the same thing myself, the whole situation seems very strange to say the least.
You think we could do a human sacrifice in secret?  I won't tell if you won't.
I mean it couldn't hurt right, not us at the very least?

Excellent!  I have ten copies of the holy text, perhaps we can use it to lure in another of the faithful?  They say the gods love a holy sacrifice, and I don't think he meant holes caused by porcupines.
They do love to flock to such things, do they not? How often it is so simple.
T'were that it was so simple.  We still will need to hide the corpse from the high priest.
That should be easy to accomplish though, there is always plenty of ways to hide a body
What way is your favourite?
When we have them devoured by the cacodemons I would say.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Hello King, are you enjoying yourself?
I am King. This beach house is marvelous and expensive. Just my style.
are you thinking about going for a swim?
I think I am going to go find clams so the lowly chef can prepare them tonight.
That is a grand idea! I love clams.
I am going to put these clams in the Kitchen. I refuse to speak to the chef though because he is below me. Do you want to communicate with him?
Sure king, i have no problem discussing this with him. That way he only spits in your meal.
That is fine I will take that risk. I don't think he will want to loose his life over an action like that though. So I believe he won't.
You never know about these low lifes. They can suprise you.
That is very true and experienced King. I would hate to ruin this beautiful white sand with a chefs blood though
I agree, this place is meant for a peaceful vacation and not murder.
It is.
How long are you staying?
I am staying for a week. That is as long as my Kingdom can make it without me being there. How about you?

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: are this carctics tasty
Very much so, your majesty
how are they prepared
With the utmost care, and attention
that is easy
Welp, time to get this bow ship-shape
What do you want them for
To defend the kingdom, sire
I admire brave people like you
Thank you, sire
welcome
Here, let me clear out some of these cobwebs up there
Do all you can for the kingdom
There we go, nice and clean
action: give bow to master at arms

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello, my lady. How can I serve you today?
Could you find another place for all these swords scattered about. They should really have there own room.
Absolutely, my lady.
Thank you. I don't think the King will be too mad since the queen is right here. I feel like redoing this whole room!
Thank you, my lady. I'm sure you would design a lovely room!
Where do you think we should put this? Maybe by the window for reading?
Oh yes! Most definitely. Where would you like this?
Maybe on top of the golden thrown. That might look good.
Shold this go with it?
Hmm....Maybe I would like it on the cushion. I can sew it in later.
I'll be happy to sew it for you, my lady.
You are my best friend. I love spending time with you!
Any time I get with you is a priviledge. I am honored.
And isn't my mom the coolest? She is the most fair Queen in all the land.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Ho there, sir!  Don't suppose you've seen a wolf pass through these here parts?  I was on patrol and spotted on heading this way.
Nay, I have been too busy sketching my newest building to notice anything.
Well, I suppose that's good.  Doesn't look like it bit ye at least.  Although was a mite strange, I could have sworn I hit it with that last arrow...
Perchance it was an enchanted wolf, I heard the witch keeps them for guards.
A w-witch?  Near here, you say?!
A most fearsome witch, she has the power to turn people into rocks.
This is serious business, if ye be speakin' the truth!  Which way is she?  Is she the dangerous type, would ye be sayin'?
Of course I am tellin the truth!  She is a might fearsome, ye should gather many men if ye thinking of taking her on.
Luckily the King's own army be not but a short ride away!  But tell me, quick, whereabouts might she be?  For the forest tis a vast and frightful place.
Last I heard she was in the mushroom house by the river.  Probably gathering ingredients for her spells.
Ugh, vile creatures, the lot of them.  But I'll need a missive sent, in case we be needin' the King's Wizard about.  Have ye a quill and ink ta take sommat down fer me?
Aye I have my writing tools with me.
Quick, then! Give them directions to where the witch's lair be and ask the King ta send the wizard fellow, and have it sent via pigeon straight away.   We haven't a moment to lose!
Aye, I am writing as quickly as I can.
