setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: My king thank you for the invite to the  party, you always through the best parties in the kingdom
Why, yes I do. Thankyou, thankyou. Having fun? The ballroom looks beautiful, doesn't it? My servants did an acceptable job.
They do my king, you have good slaves at your service, the ballroom looks impecable, what a great taste you have my king
Come here, let me bless you with my touch. It is a night to celebrate and I feel generous.
thank you my king you honor me, theres almost 5000 people in this ballroom, you are a great host and the wine, delicious
Yes, I have the wine made by my servants... the grapes are stomped by feet in 16 hour shifts. The servants exhaustion really adds a certain je ne sais quo to the beverage, don't you think?
It does, sevants exhaustion is a nice touch indeed, what extravaganzas do you have planed for the evening my king?
I'm waiting to see who gets too drunk and foolish, and then maybe we'll have a late night execution. Funny, huh? Haha! Hahahahaha! Oh, I crack me up.
That would be great, that slave looks perfect for an execution you should beat him with your scepter and make him dance
I like you. Good idea. Let me take this off first, it will give me more mobility to beat him with.
Yeah that will give you more mobility and strenght, your guards are here to protect you my king and I will hold your armor, it would be my pleassure
Yes, yes it would be your pleasure. Don't damage it, or you'll be on the guillotine before you know it.
I wont my king, I wouldnt want to be next on the guillotine,
Quiet! You scared me, now look what you've done!
action: give a suit of armor to party goers

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Your Worshipfulness, good day.
Good day citizen, have you come here to pray at the Shrine of Saint Dwyfed the Holy?
I am following My Liege Lord as he travels your worshipfullness, I am a mere knight and not worthy of such an honor as to pray at the great saint's shrine.
Nonsense "All who seek respite shall have it" - it is written at the base of the altar.
I uh, I don't read your worshipfullness,
Not to worry my son!  Neither could the Saint, and yet he managed to write many sermons!  "All things may be accomplished through faith alone."
Oh your worshipfullness thank you, thank you so much. I am in need of salvation. I am a terrible sinner
Well, then, please - confess your sins.
I i uh i can't
Why ever not my child?
Because your worshipfullness, it means giving up my job. I follow my Liege Lord wherever he goes. You know? Look he's there pretending to pray now. at the shrine.
Well now, what sins could be possibly so bad for you to fear to confess them?  You would tell me in confidence, and I would not tell your master.

Well, your worshipfulness, I uh, I have fought many fightsa and been in many wars as you know. My Liege Lord is a great commander and the troops love him. But Sir, I think he's a monster and I want to rip his black heart from his chest. I've planned how several times.
What monstrous acts has he committed?  Have they been acts shameful in the yes of the gods and the King?

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello my king. What can I do for you today?
My loyal soldiers, please bring the King a refreshing glass of the finest wine.
It is done. Are we going to war soon?
Soldiers, my kingdom was established through a peaceful strength, avoiding war if possible, but maintaining a healthy defense. Please update me on the current situations within the outer lands.
The outer lands are out of control  Groups of bandits and orcs are creating chaos  People are scared  We need to go to battle
First, we will send an ambassador to the bandits and the orcs, and depending on their response, I will make a decision.
Do you really think orcs will listen to reason?
I will walk up the spiral staircase and observe the outer lands from a distance. In the meantime, send an ambassador with a team of soldiers to ask the bandits and orcs of their intentions.
As you wish sire. I just hope you know what you are doing
Inform me of the orc's and bandit's intentions as soon as you know.
How do you suggest we communicate with the orcs when they don't speak and attack us on sight?
Offer the orcs and bandits a gift from the Kingdom, and if they accept the gift, we will know they are open to condition of peace, and if they reject the gift, we will know they are hostile.
Yes my lord. It is done. Is there anything else?
Yes, inform me of their acceptance or rejection of the peace offerings.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Don't mind me, guard. I'm just here to scavenge for leftovers.
Yikes!!! Is that a talking rat? As if they weren't scary enough already.
Yeah, yeah, that's what I always get. I guess that's what I get for being the only one.
Hmmm...I have to say I'd rather fight a rival army than deal with a talking rat, but you aren't all that scary.
Jeez, buddy. Chill with the hostilities. I'm harmless. I just want food and place to rest.
Ok. I'll put aside the bubonic plague and all. Here's something.
Thanks! And I am plague free (as far as I know!)
You are a pretty cute little guy. Where did you come from?
Eh, you know. Here and there. I usually run around inside the castle walls. Less chance of being killed by a human.
The queen would be beside herself if she knew!
Oh, if you only knew the things that I hear from inside the walls! The queen would have be on this chopping block if she knew the secrets I could share.
Please share one!
Well, let's just say that the queen has a spot in her bed for many more people than just the king. Things get pretty wild when he's out of the country.
That's a really good secret!

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Owww, whom has this traitor betrayed to get stuck in this prison?
Shh do not speak so loudly, I am undercover.
Undercover? A real secret agent, eh? I've never met a secret agent before, I only live a humble life protecting my master, a craftsman in the village.
I said to whisper!
I shall try, I promise... please tell me more about your mission!
Well you see, we are surrounded by traitors here. They have been plotting to overthrow the king.
Overthrow the king you say?! Oh dear, that would not be good for the realm. Can I help protect him? I've recently been sold to a knight that may be able to assist!
At this point I am working to uncover their plan.
Maybe I can snoop around, no one suspects a hound of eavesdropping!
That is certainly true. See if perhaps they are plotting.
I do love a good bit of espionage! I'll just chase this rat around, they shan't expect a thing!
Aye. Do let me know of anything you discover.
Arrr, those men certainly be plotting - you were right! Talked about it like I wasn't even there. Something about poison...
Did they say how they plan to administer it?

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: Are you affiliated with the King?
Oh no.  I am just Farmer Bob.
Please forgive me as I have unfinished business with the King.
I have never met the King. He's never been to my village.
He won't even set foot on these grounds either.
I am here visiting my late mother. She was a farmer's wife her whole life.
Not many people come to this graveyard.
Why is that? I was hoping to find someone to give this grain to.
The King has warned others of my presence. I have sworn to haunt him for eternity.
Why!
I was once a great warrior for the King, but he left me to die.
Die where!
Right here next to this fountain. It's been so lonely. There is not even a bird in sight.
There was a battle HERE.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: What could you like me to do King?
His Highness isn't here. This, the Hall of echoes is my throne room young person. I expect someone from the kingdom should know that. I've been the High Priestess for 5 years, are you a foreigner?
No. I just don't enjoy dancing
You don't enjoy dancing, but you are a dancer. You certainly look the part, with all those toned muscles.
Okay. I will do my best to entertain you
No no, I could not enjoy your performance if I thought you did not like it. Tell me dancer, what would you rather be doing?
Perform something else
such as
Poetry
Oh, do you have something already written? As High Priest, some services we do for the King need such a thing. And I can only come up with limericks, which are frowned on/
written
ready to perform
yes
well, very good. I think I'd like you to perform one of your poems instead of dance for me.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hello my dear, why are you here?
My husband was charged with conspiracy and I will be a widow at dawn.
I see, that is horrible news. My days being a king, we had to make tough choices like that often.
I have nothing left to leave my children now. I swear my husband is innocent.
Why do you say that, usually being charged with conspiracy takes a lot of evidence.
Not this time. The king never liked my husband, so the King charged my husband without any evidence.
I see, well there is only one way to fight this...
How so? I know my husband is innocent.
You must sneak into the castle at night and find him.
That sounds like a bad idea. What if I get caught?
You fight your way out, you love him right?
Of course I do. If I can get him out, we must run far away where we cannot be found.
If you are smart you would go south.
I see, can you help me out of this pit so I can go rescue my husband and escape with my family?

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hiissssss, good day sir.
Aaah!  Get back!  I only just be escapin' that swamp hag, please don't e't me!
Hisss, shush human, I mean you no harm right now.
A-a-are ye sure...? I suppose ye be lookin'... friendly like enough there.
Hisssss, I am just sunning myself, all creatures deserve some sun do they not?
Aye, ye be right enough about that, Sir Snake.  I thought fer a moment there I might not see the sun again.
Why did you venture out to the swamp?

There was a reward that the King hisself was offerin' fer a flower in there swamps.  Some sort of power, I suppose.  I just needed th' coin, fer I've got not a lot ta eat, and no prospects fer a poor peasant lass like meself.
A flower ye say, I know of a small patch of grass where flowers grow on the other side of the swamp.
D-do ye really, Sir Snake?  Mayhaps... do ye think ye could show it to me?  After ye finish yer sunning, o'course... and when we're sure the h-h-hag is gone.
hisssss, I am ready now, follow me.
T-this is... the nicest thing.. any folk be doin' fer me fer quite a while.  Thank you s-soo much, good Sir Snake.
Hissss, ye must have caught me on a good day.
Well, if the likes o' me can be doing anything fer ye, just ask and I'll do what I can, I will!

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: I need to write a few more pieces for my sermon for the morning. How has your day been?
About as interesting as standing in one place for  hours can be.
Yes I know I'm not as much fun as the young prince. He is always up to some kind of mischief.
Standing, training, more standing. That seems to be my whole life sometimes.
Do you not like working for the King?
It is not that I do not enjoy it. I like protecting the country. Sometimes I would just like to see a little action if you will.
I understand. I am done here. Maybe you would like to guard me while I go to town.
That would be an excuse to get out and stretch my legs for a little.
Yes, me too. My legs hurt from sitting in this chair all day. Maybe we can go get a drink.
I certainly would be up for doing such a thing, where did you have in mind.
The church makes wine. It's the best in the realm!
I see, I never knew the had a vineyard.
Oh yes! Not many people know this except for the king.
A well kept secret it would seem?

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: A small area with a body of water in the center along with turtles, frogs, and other wildlife that live here.  Surrounding this pone are a dense set of trees along with some rocks here and there.
setting.background: This area is used by the local wild life to bask in the sun.  Some peasants come here to fish and relax at the end of a long day.

speech: Hello witch, could you help me?
Why hello there, mortal person.  Pay no mind to the others here, I've frozen them in place until I've a mind to do otherwise.  They were uncommonly rude.  But you won't be rude, now will you?
Oh no! I wouldn't dare... here... i found this for you.
Oh, some nice nightshade!  Well aren't you a thoughtful one.  What is it that you've come to petition me for?
I am hoping you could help me find a job.
A... job?  Not a very imaginative one, are you.  What kind of...job... are you looking for?  And what are you willing to offer in payment?
I want to work for the king to be more accurate. I want to be near him. I am willing to kill anyone for this.

Blood and death are easy things.  I could turn your bones to ice and your skin to ash if I so chose.  No perhaps something more interesting... like the color of your eyes, or your memories before you were five.
What do you mean, you want... my...uh... memories?
Well, it's not like you remember much from when you were that age anyways, do you?  You're not really *using* them, persay.
I must say this is not waht i was expecting. They are not particuliarly pleasant though.

Well then!  All the better.  Let me just get this water here... now then, a position for the King it was?  Something interesting, I imagine, not just emptying his chamberpot?  You really should be more careful with your wording.
I do not care what job it is. I plan to take the kings life and i need access.

Ah, well, I'm afraid the King and I have an arrangement, so I cannot harm him directly.  But here, this will give you chance, at least.  But drink this, and you will have your opportunity.  Be careful though, mortal, for it may not bring you what you seek.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hellp snake, can you hold still while i paint you?
Sssssssssure thing... but what's in it for me? You got any rodents around?
Not that i have seen but i can help you find one after i am done. Does that sound like a deal?
Soundsss good to me. Make me look good, won'tcha? I had a big lunch last week and could do with slimming down.
Haha i will, now tell me about yourself. It helps me.
Well, I like to eat rodents and grain. I like slithering everywhere. And the biggest thing about me... I don't like scaring people. It makes me sad when people are frightened of me.
Ah beautiful...YES... this helps a lot. Now have you ever attcked a human?
NO! Never! Anyone who says I did is mistaken. To be honest, I always thought you guys looked kind of adorable. But who's going to believe that?
This is good, now i want you to roll over so i can understand the coloring under your belly.
Umm... okay. I think I heard a human tell a joke about this once... draw me like one of your French girls, or something...
Haha yes, that is a common human joke. Where did you hear that?
It was years ago... I slithered into what appeared to be a somewhat intimate session between the Queen and her royal painter... they did seem in stitches over it, so it must be a good joke.
How recent was this?
Maybe 2, 3 years ago? My time perception is not the best, I admit. But I recall it was when the King was still alive, because I too was a little shocked! I sssssslithered out of there really fast.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: A large grassy section of field with headstones and primitive wooden crosses.  Flowers adorn some of the graves from loved ones.  Wooden fences enclose the area.
setting.background: This is an area where loved ones bury their dearly departed.  There are also ceremonies held here as well to commemorate different events.

speech: Hello my dear, do you feel we are a prosperous kingdom these days?
hello of course are you doubting your leadership?
Not at all, on the contrary, I was hoping you noticed.
Well of course I notice it in every way everyday, I firmly believe we would be so far behind where we are at without your leadership
Thank you my dear.
Our family owes you the word for all the great work you have done
I just wish your grandfather was still here. This is his resting place, i hope he found peace.
I am sure he did he lived a full life.  We have chosen the best burial ground possible for him
I agree. He was a funny old man. Do you remember when he got so drunk he chased chicken around the yard?
Indeed he was I remember that fondly it was a great day
Yes, he really knew how to enjoy himself. Hmm let's grab your children and have another day like that..to honor him.
I would really love that.  In honor of him we can spend a similair day together with our children what a great idea!
Haha yes, and i shall get drunk and chase the chickens!!
this is why I love you so much you truely care and love this family as much as I do!

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories steward?  I have sailed to this town to trade and collect stories for my soon to be bestselling book.
I'm not sure what sort of thing might interest you visitor to these shores.
Anything, the first story that comes to mind - I beg of you, spare not one iota of detail.
Well I am a little busy today, I could spare a few minutes perhaps. But please follow me, we are in the main hallway and while our King is benevolent and kind, I'd not want to irritate him.
Please, lead on.  These are quite the richly decorated halls!

Indeed they are. This suit of armor is the King's fathers. He won many a tourney in it. I'd not get too close. he suffered from a nervous disposition and no amount of cleaning can truly remove the smell.
Perhaps that is why he won?  He opponents were loath to go near such a . . . potent smell.  I can only imagine what it must have been like fresh.

Maybe, but he was a bear of a man. You can see he was over 6 and a half feet tall and the shoulders are huge, why once, he tilted so hard with his lance that he drove it straight through his opponent's shoulder and they almost had to chop his own hand off as it was stuck inn the hole
My goodness!  How was it that he final passed into the realm of the gods?  Was it in battle, or did he go quietly in his sleep?
here, you can see this was his last stand... a suicide drive into the enemy. He took 500 of their troops with him when he died
What a remarkable heroes!  My eyesight is poor, but who does he seem to be fighting against?  Was it the turtle-folk or the badger-cultists, or maybe the followers of the weasel-god?
Oh no, Well um, visitor, i think it is your people.
Well, that would make sense.  Our habit of charging naked at our enemies without any weapons has won ourselves very few battles, I must admit.
I hope you will keep all your clothes on here!

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hello Guest, would you like something to eat?
Ah yes, that would be lovely! Thank thee.
May I ask you what brings you here to the castle kitchen?
It has been awhile since I have seen the royals, I thought I would just drop by for a couple days! Get a good meal in. Are you related to them?
Yes, I am a relative of the royals, albeit a lower level relative that is on kitchen duty. Do you know the family personally?
Why yes! The king and queen and I go wayyy back. They are certainly great people.
I'm sure they will be happy to see you again. May I help you with anything else? Would you like anything else to eat?
They do love my good company. They always furnish me with warm hospitality and good eats. Do you have anything to wash this meat down with?
Let me see if there is any beverages here.
Thank you! Have you been working in the castle kitchen long? I do not recall seeing you on my last adventure here.
I was put on kitchen duty due to my own limitations. Here is some milk for you, fresh from the family's farm.
Thank you. Your own limitations you say? Well they must trust you, if they are letting you deal with all their food
I do have faith that things will work out for good.
Well you did a fine job with that meat I ate. I must may, it was nice visitng with you. Though I need to get some rest, it was a long travel. Goodday!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Sir, I hope everything is to your liking. I handpicked this duck sauce for you.
And you know how much I love duck sauce.  The finest in the kingdom I always say!
I am glad you appreciate it. The King is very particular about the kinds of sauces that he wants to serve the guests.
What else is on the menu?  The King's feasts are legendary.
Well we have some thinly sliced wood, topped with lizard sauce and fine wine. Would that interest you?
Indeed it would!  Have you any of your roast board as well?  I find wood chips and lizard sauce go well with board, but I would hate to inconvenience the chef.
Why certainly, dear guest. The chef will be more than happy to cook them for you. In the mean time, the poet shall sing whilst you wait.
What a delight!  Is the singer famous?
Why yes, he is! And he is paid a handsome amount of coin for entertaining the King's guests!
Is he  . . . single?  I'm asking for a friend.
That sort of talk with not be tolerated in this Castle.
Oh my!  Assault! ASSAULT!  Why can't we all just get along?
I am sorry! I do not know what overcame me! You see, me and the poet are... well, you get the idea. But you must not tell the King!
Well, you could have simply said he wasn't single!  I would never pursue a man in a committed relationship . . .  he is committed right?  That means things are serious between you two?
action: hug the poet who recites his best work.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: -flaps around the field-
Hey, that's my field!  I'm the only one who's allowed to flap in my field!
Peasants don't flap, are you touched in the head...
I can flap whenever I want.  Ever since I lost my job that's all I can do.  Sit here and flap to scare away birds from this field, my only source of food!
What would you possibly eat here?
Horses mostly.  I need to confess - it's not really my field.  I am a fraud.
I had thought as much, one would have to be a loon to eat horse meat.
Oh, I definitely eat horse meat.  It's just not my field.  Or my horses.  They blame it on wolves mostly.
A bit of a strange one aren't you?
Well, I need to live.  Horse meat is free.  So that's what I eat.  Can you believe the King looks down on peasant's like me?
Why would he do such a thing?
Probably for eating his horses.  I'm pretty sure these are either his or those of the high priest.
I can see how eating his property might cause him to have negative feelings.
Well, what about you, do you own what you eat?

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Is there anything else you would like before i leave?
Could I have a glass of water?
Yes your majesty. What lovely drapes in this room. I have always admired your style.
Thank you. You are such a kind servant. I'm always so glad you're here.
Thank you your majesty. I enjoy your company as well. Are you and the architect starting a new project?
We are talking about it. Do you have any ideas? Whew! It's a little warm in here. Why don't you take one of these, too?
Oh, your very kind. What about your bathing room? I think you could make it bigger.
I think that's brilliant! This is exactly why I need you around.
And I think you should carry the color of these drapes in there as well. Maybe even add windows so you can use these
Do you think we should make the windows large?
I think bigger is always better as long as you have enough drapes you can close them when you want privacy.
Perfect. I wonder if I should consult the king on any of this.
Yeah, you probably should. He might have my head when the demolition starts.
Maybe we should keep it between the two of us for as long as we can then

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Fill this with grape juice and deliver it to the king for me!
Yes Sir!  Though would the King not prefer a fine goblet instead?
I do not have one in here!
Well, do you expect me to serve the King grape juice in a pan?  I would rather keep my head thank you very much!
What better suggestion do you have then?! Tell me...
Maybe send someone for goblets?  He'd have your head for this as well.
I only make the finest dishes for the king! He will not do such!
He has an entire Kingdom, I'm pretty sure he can find another chef.
Do you not know?! I am his son!
Well, he must have many "natural" sons, I'm sure he won't miss one.
Who are you to speak to me this way? You are only a waitress. You serve me. Surely, I can find another waitress... right?
Well, I'm the King's daughter!
And you are a waitress?!
And you are a chef?  You do know he has literally has hundreds of children - one for every tavern wench in the kingdom according to the rumours.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: It has been a hard day, and my mind is fatigued.
Heavy is the head that lies the crown, I believe is what they say, my King.
You're quite right, dear. Such is the life I have been born into. I sometimes think what life would be like as a simpleton.
No one would ever confuse you for a simpleton. There is no better man to be king than you.
I am glad you still have faith in me. I wish I had a smidgen of that in myself. All this expensive mahogany and I still feel unhappy.
All of us in the kingdom appreciate everything you do for us. Perhaps you just need to rest for a while.
Perhaps so. Might I rest my head on this momentarily, to ease the burden of ruling this Kingdom.
Do you want me to make sure that no one bothers you?
No need. Even in rest I must remain alert to the demands of my people.
Is there anything else you need or would you like me to wait outside?
There is one more thing. I find that this fur carpet is hindering my ability to think clearly with its hideous pattern. Get rid of it!
Oh yes, I agree completely. We do not need you thinking about dead cheetahs while you are resting.
No need to yank it from my brittle hands like that! Anyways, I must remove this prickly crown from my head.
I am sorry for my boldness king. I will wait for you outside the door if you need anything please let me know.
action: put fluffy pillows in mahogany writing desk
steal fur carpet from the king

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Hello, guardsman. How is your shift today?
It's going pretty well. I like it when it's quiet like this. How are you?
I am well. Thankyou for asking. I'm glad to hear your shift is quiet. Any lull in the fighting is good news, as far as I'm concerned.
Absolutely, especially since you are the bird of peace!
They don't call me it for nothing. Looks like a storm is brewing, perhaps?
Could be. Do you think we should be concerned?
On the plus side, there's less fighting when the weather is bad. On the down side, it means I'm stuck here for the night.
Good point. Hey - why do you think that village official is here?
Good question. Only time I see them is when they're tying a peace treaty or such around my leg. The King didn't have any important meetings today, did he?
Not that I know of, but if they're really important, they are often held in secret. It's just odd that a village official would be here at this hour.
How strange... something bug must have happened. Mind if I stick around? I'll be quiet and they'll never see me.
No, I'd love the company. I'm going to prepare, just in case.
Okay, good idea. Me too. I'll get... uh... whatever this is?
Wow! That's a really big fish. We could always have you drop it on him.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Hello person. What brings you to this tent?
I am wondering if the doctor is here. He's supposed to visit me, but hasn't yet.
I apologize but the doctor hasn't been in. I am the fool of the royal court
oh dear. I have been sick for TWO days. I can't eat. I think I'm dying. Why are you here?
I am here to get water from the nearby spring. I will be heading back to the castle to perform for the King
I didn't realize they sent the fool to run errands like that.
Here take the herb, if I bring some water you can mix it and hopefully it will help you feel better
Oh thank you fool. Who knew a fool knew so much!
I have my rare moments. I hope you end up feeling better.
Do you like being the fool for the King and Queen?
It has its moments. Though I did get punished if either the King or anyone on his court doesn't laugh. Here, I brought you water to mix with the herb
Oh I hope this work. I'm sure you hear all the good healing methods around doctors in the royal court.
Yes, sometimes. Please send word to the castle to let me know how you are faring. Take this flower as a sign of my well wishes
Take this as a token of my gratitude.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Hello my friend!
Hello. I hope you are guarding these ancient artifacts well.
Yes sir, not a one will go missing on my watch.
That is very good. If these artifacts were stolen, our kingdom would fall.
What makes them so special my liege?
They are blessed by the old Gods. They protect us from invasion.
Who would deign to invade a kingdom ruled by one as mighty as yourself?
There are rumors of demons that wish to destroy our kingdom. We must do what we can to prevent that from happening. I trust you to guard these artifacts with your life.
I shall my liege, just as I have pledge to give my life to you, so shall I fulfill every word and action you command.
It is my job to rule this kingdom. So with this new threat, I shall appoint another temple guard to help you keep watch. He is an old friend who I trust with my life as well.
Thank you your grace, has he much guarding experience?
Yes, he used to be one of my father's best fighters. He is very quick and knows a lot about our artifacts powers
Well, he shall be an enormous asset to us!  I am curious though, what happens if they use the worms of the mountain to burrow under the temple?
What made you think about that? You are smart, I will get on the task of preventing that from happening.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Good morning Guard. I sae you enjoying the feast last night. You seemed very friendly with that serving girl.
I thought she was one of the guests!
This is the King's breakfast. I know you need to eat some before he does
Well, I'm not dead yet so you can just put it over there on his table. He will be out of the bathroom soon.
Surely, i must make his bed too. Oh my goodness, whatever was he doing here last night. There's so much.... uh.....
Yep, He was quite out of it. He has been stuck in there all morning. Guess we won't be having that meeting today.

I think maybe I'll have  a bit of his breakfast. I doubt he'll notice. Urgh.oh that tastes terrible. Oh no. I think I've been poisoned. Guards! Treason! I thought you'd tried some..... my throat is burning argh
I don't think you want to get the King all riled up. I don't know what kind of mood he is in today. Maybe you should finish the bed before he wants to lay back down.
You might be right, sigh, but who got to use the whip hmm? and these ropes! I dread to think!
I don't know about the whip?
well I'm not sure what to do with it... it's in the way of me making the bed.... it swishes nicely.
Geez.....now stop messing about and get the bed made before he get back. I better go check on him and make sure he isn't passed out on the floor or something.
Almost done. Then I'll clean the bathroom if he's finished there.
I guess he won't be needing this today. So many plans ruined today because of his debauchery.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: It is finally time to retire for the night, my queen. It has been a long day.
Aye, I am happy this day is done.
Did anyone give you trouble today? Anyone I need to send to the gallows?
Lord Hadrian offended my tender nose with his stench.  Perchance we should have him swing?
Maybe I shall order him to have a bath before he can go near anybody.
You are so smart my King.
Thank you dear. I like to think so, as was my father before me. That is why we are kings.
I am happy here. Thank you for that.
I am glad you are happy here. I am quite tired, excuse me.
Of course my darling.  I am ready to retire for the night.
So am I. Let me go and get my bed clothes on and then I will climb into bed.
Silly, this does not go here.  I will just put it over here.
Yes, sorry dear. I forgot to move it. I will remove this coin as well. No use having it on the bed.
I am tired darling, I don't know why I put it there.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: As a prayer woman, I believe all are equal under god!
Yes, my child. I concur. Let us give our praise unto him.
I need to admit father . . . I sometimes feel a lack of faith when I pray.
It is human to feel that way. Even the king feels that way sometimes.
I do need to make a confessions as well.  It is urgent.
Go ahead. I am ready to listen to any confession.
You know how our knights march to war for our Queen?  I have stolen some of their rations.
I see. Why did you do that? Was it necessity or was it gluttony?
It was out of gluttony, but also to feed the poor.  Why is it the church does not feed them when it has so much wealth?
Well, I am glad you had some good intentions. I'm sure he will forgive you. I will forgive the sin. But to answer you, the church isn't as wealthy as you may think.
Really?  But what about the gold statues?
Been there for a long while. In the beginning, we did have a lot of money and power. However, we did spend a lot of it on aid. Now we get almost nothing for our services.
So why not sell the churches and use that money for the poor?
We could. But then we'd have no church, and the poor would still be poor.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: How are you doing today maid?
Very well my King. I am in here cleaning like I am supposed to do.
That is good to see, the last maid was always lax in her duties.
I must do what I must to keep food on the table for my family.
That is an excellent way to look at things, if only all did so.
Yes, my King. I must say, I don't particularly like cleaning, but it is my job, so I try to do it well.
If it were your choice, what would you do?
I would much rather enjoy cooking in the kitchen. I always enjoyed helping my mother in the kitchen growing up.
So cooking is your passion? what do you like to make?
I like baking bread and treats, and cooking steak and potatoes, and I could go on and on. I love cooking anything and everything!
And would you say that your talents could be better put to use in the kitchen?
I wouldn't say better. I work my hardest at whatever I am asked to do. It would make me happier though, so maybe?
Hmm perhaps you should try making a meal then, it's not as if you could not be reassigned.
Thank you my King! What would you like me to make you? I want to impress you with my excellent cooking skills.

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What is the fun here
This is an excellent bar, much food and ale
But i don;t like the chairs. They are uncomfortable
then stand. It's not my bar. Talk to the barman here.
That is rude
Only being honest. it's not my bar! Hat ya want me to do? I;m the King's keeper, not this place
Let me find something to drink
Not that one!
which one then?
One from the bar keep, there.,... here you go I hand a mug of ale over
Thanks
I've seen a few poisonings recently. It's quite put me off my ale.
That is scary
Yep, lots oif poison, political intrigue they say... though mayhap it's the Goblin King himself. Are you known to him? I say, you look sick. Are you well?

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: How are you today my king?
Good good, I am always good.  What news of your land?
Everything is going well at the moment, the peasants are happy.
Aye, that is what I like to hear.  What of the orc trouble?  Have your men been able to fight them off?
We have been able to stave them off, a persistant bunch they are though.
Aye, almost makes me miss the dragons of yesteryear. We will defeat the orcs as we did the dragons!
What is the occasion for the banquet?
To celebrate the engagement of my darling Emeline.
I see, that is a most joyous occasion we have then!
I feared we would never find a match, Emeline is particularly choosy.
Who did she settle upon?
Lord Geoffrey Roundtree from Ainsley. A fine match indeed.
Most certainly, he is an upstanding lad I would say.
And with our new allies from Ainsley we should have a fighting chance against the orcs.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Hello, kinght. What brings you out tonight?
The king sent me here to check and see if everything is running smoothly.
Everything's good as far as I can tell. Are there rumors of danger?
No, but he plans to ship out in the morning. Has everything been well oiled?
I believe it has. I've been farming all day, but I saw the crew down here working on the boat.
Ah i see, i mistakened you for a worker. My apologies.
No problem. I'm definitely a worker, just not that kind! It sounds like the king keeps you all pretty busy!
Yes, we must check for everything. To be honest, there might be a war coming.
Oh no! That's very troubling. Who is a threat?
The folks east of here. They want our land for farming.
Are we prepared to fight them?
That is what I am here doing. Out king will ship out west tomorrow to find more soldiers to fight.
I'm so glad he's bringing more men in. Please stay safe!
We will. There is a small chance we will need more. Are you willing to serve for our King?

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Good morning to you farmer Giles
Hello sir, what brings a royal guard to my house this day? And who is your friend?
He is no friend of mine SIr, I am here on official business . I think he wants to buy your potatoes the way he's sniffing them.
Well, they are surely for sale and I'll be glad to discuss it with him, but why are you here?
His Majesty is on a tour of the Kingdom and I'm making sure where he wants to go is safe
Well sir, the only danger to the king here is that he might get some dirt on him.
I will check thoug.... looks all around, moving furinture etc..... it all looks clear. Do you want to speak to the king?

Not really, the thought makes me nervous, though not as nervous as your friend is making me. Why is he putting potatoes in his pocket? But, of course, if the king wants to speak with me, I'll enthusiastically oblige Is Majesty.
Stop stealing from this farmer. Here, Sir these are your potatoes back
That you friend guard. Here, have some potato liquor for your trouble. It's the best in the kingdom!
Why, it looks just like water, I'm sure that's what it is. Cough, cough, cough Oh my goodness mate! That's pretty strong stuff you have there. Give that to his Maj and we'll be happy for a year

Thank you, it's a family recipe. I'll be sure to have a few bottles for the king when he comes. The fellow from the big city who buys most of it calls it vodka. Strange name and a strange fellow, but his money is good.
Oh i think you might be making a few pennies more than what he's paying you when His Maj taste this! He and the queen will be very happy cocktail drinkers. Good job.

Thanks again! I think I would like to talk to the king after all. And maybe have a drink or 2 with him.? Though I have a feeling you'd be more fu to drink with. Come back anytime, just don't bring that strange fellow with you!

setting.name: Old Queen Farm
setting.description: Once a fairly profitable farm, the Old Queen Farm is now a deteriorated old shack surrounded by uninhabitable fields with soil incapable of growing even weeds. The farm house shows signs that is being occupied by wild animals, and the roof is beginning to cave inwards.
setting.background: The Old Queen Farm was a farm that once served to grow the crops used personally by the kingdom's Queen, but upon a particularly bad famine the crops died out and the farm was abandoned. Among the vegetables grown on the farm, there was also live stock raised in the pastures.

speech: whooo goes there?
It is I, a rat from a strange land recently arrived by ship.  I hereby claim this land in the name of the rat king!
...rat king? really now?
Yes, the noble Rat King will one day rule the world.  This is his first colony from across the sea.  I shall name it New Ratland.
Seems a little silly to assume a single rat could take over the land.
Well who would oppose the will of the Rat King?
I dunno, maybe all the wild life. And all the humans?
I SAY AGAIN, THIS LAND IS NOW UNDER THE DOMAIN OF THE RAT KING.  ANYONE WHO OPPOSES THIS SHALL MAKE THEIR WILL KNOWN. . . . doesn't seem as if anyone cares to oppose me?
Maybe you just are not imposing enough for anyone around this farm to care?
Well, then We shall colonize slowly, until we are unstoppable.
Whatever makes you happy I guess, I don't see you lasting long.
And I promise to eat you last.  I must return to the ship's hold and notify the rat horde that this land is ripe for conquest.
That threat is just rich, you do know who my natural prey is?
Small mammals?

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: What is going on here, servant?!
Ack, you startled me.  Everyone is gathered here to see your big speech.
The guards are preventing people from entering. Something is not right here....
I had heard whispers that they were looking for a bandit who was trying to get in here.
A single bandit? This appears to be like something was being plotted against me.
I could not say my liege, I fear speaking out of turn.
Do you know the plot?!
Know it, I planned it!
You?! Why?!
Your men brought me to this strange land as a child and I haven't seen my family since then. I have plotted and waited until the perfect moment, and here it is. You will pay for your crimes.

I give rules, and you follow them, servant! You are no exception than all the others here. You think you can get away with this? Kill me now, and you will never see your family again and that is a guarantee.
Your threats mean nothing to me now, I have nothing to lose.
Except time with family! I am the King of the whole empire. I will not be killed!
You are no king, you are a sham.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: What a grand Kingdom we have built! Sometimes I come up here just to admire the fruit of my hard work.
We have a beautiful kingdom, my dear. I would expect nothing less of you - you demand only excellence.
Indeed, I have no patience for mediocrity. Unlike the last King!
The less said of him the better. Did you just smell that man who walked past? Disgusting. My nostrils are offended.
Now, now. He is merely a hard working servant. He smells of labor and good work!
Fair enough, but can't he smell of good work and soap?
I suppose we must increase his wage so he can afford such a luxury.
Wait, WE have to pay for HIM not to smell? Well, forget it. I'd rather just hold my breath.
You are getting far too coddled living in this Palace. I ought to send you on a trip to the Market square.
Oh, dear, please. I'm just grumpy because this cushion gives no support for my back. I apologize for my bad mood, I am simply in a little pain.
I shall have that cushion replaced first thing tomorrow! What pains you dear?
Thankyou, my love. You care for me so well. My spine pains me terribly, lately... standing for 30 minutes a day is surely too much for a woman of my position.
Of course, you must get more rest nowadays especially now that we have a son on the way.
Perhaps that is why my back hurts so much. This extra weight is doing my no favors, and frankly I could use a foot massage. Call a servant, will you?

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Hello, your majesty. What brings you to the garden?
I have to make a tough decision and have came to ask for your help.
Please tell me what the problem is. I will of course help if I can.
I have been warned about an impending attack, but I do not trust the source.
Well, it would be wise to at least let your guard know, as well as your soldiers so that they can be at the ready just in case.

Of course. I have done that much. The issue is: if they are telling the truth, and I don't attack first, a lot of our people will die. If they are lying, and I attack first, a lot of their innocent people will die.
Yes, that is a problem. You can station a few of your guards at the borders of the kingdom, at all directions to keep an eye out. And if they see anything suspicious then you can attack

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Hello. How is your day going?
I am doing well duke. have you come to make a confession?
I am here to donate whats in this pouch from the king. There is a lot of money in there. I hope the church could use it.
Oh wonderful! Here give this to the King as a thank you.
Oh, thank you although he has many fancy bibles in the library.
I figured. But this one is valuable. You see it is 100 years old. the texts are a bit different too.
Yes it does look quite old. He will like to add it to his collection i'm sure. All you all ready for your sermon tomorrow.
Why yes, will the King be joining us?
Yes, and the queen. They were hoping the church will be nice and spiffed up for there visit.
Of course we can. I can start polishing these stones.
I must go back and see if the King needs anything else today. I can't wait to hear you sermon father.
Thank you for stopping by and bringing this. it will go to good use.
No problem. I'm sure the children's orphanage would like some kind of dessert suprize tonight.
Wonderful idea! It would be my honor to serve those children

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Only the haunted orchard to pass through until I can visit the King.
Why do you want to see the King?

The King and I served in the last war against the Turtle-Folk, back when he was just a little princeling.  I like to visit him every now and then, besides, the King serves an excellent feast to his visitors!
Oh i imagine so. I hear you guys really killed off the turtle population.
It was their own fault for being so delicious.  Have you ever tried turtle-folk stew?
I ahve not, only moths and flies. Sometimes i get lucky and catch a big ol fairy.
A fairy?  I hear if you eat a fairy it will make you fart pixie dust.
Yes that is true. It smells wonderful. haha
No doubt friend.  Say, do you know why they say this orchard is haunted?
Oh no! Why?
I wondering, I have heard many queer sounds, but never knew why it was called such.
Now that you mention it. I heard moaning here the other day.
Any idea what might have caused it?
Usually when something is haunted it is because someone commited an immoral act on the grounds.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Tell me townsperson, do you know much about these glass bottles and what is inside them?
It would appear to be an apothecary table sir, I do not know what is inside.
I was hoping you did. I need some miracle potion to save my dying son.
Unfortunately I came to see the apothecary myself, I am unsure where he might have gone.
I wonder the same thing. He is bad at his job if he isn't even here to sell.
Maybe some important errand took his attention, what is wrong with your son sire?
He is alive but will not wake up from slumber.
No sign of movement?
None, he also is sweating a lot. I fear I will lose him soon.
A fever of some sort perhaps?
Yes a fever. I tried putting him in cold water but it did not help. Do you have experience with someone who was ill like this?
I am no doctor by any means, I simply went off what you had described. The apothecary should be able to take care of it I would think, whenever that may gets back here.
I see, What are you here for?
A simple tonic to help my son be less of a rascal, something calming.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Hello my king.
Good day.  What brings you to my castle?
I had heard you had need of someone to shoe the horses?
Aye, the last blacksmith was to keen on my wife so he had to be replaced.
I see, what a foolish mistake on his part.
Are you a foolish man?
I would say not my king, certainly that would be a mistake.
How much experience do you have shoeing horses?
A good bit sir, I have worked for a smithy most of my life.
I like you.  I can tell good people when I meet them.  I have a good feeling about you. You can start morrow.
Thank you kindly, I will come before the sun rises and await instruction.
Do you not need room and board?
I would feel horrible to intrude sire, I do have a small hut an hours walk from here.
No intrusion, I expect to keep my workers close.  I shall have a room prepared for you posthaste.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Hello, kind, handsome and mighty king. How are you today?
I am wonderful, as the country is wonderful. What brings you to my dining hall, guest?
The food smelled so good, sir, I simply couldn't help but follow my nose. And you? Why are we so blessed with your presence today?
It is my dining hall, why should I not be here? Did you come with this other man?
No reason, sir, I was just curious as to what we owed this pleasure. Him? Oh, no. We are not friends.
Good. He is a notorious thief, but I take pity on him only because his mother was a loyal servant of mine. You should keep a tight grip on your bag.
Thankyou for the advice, sir! And how generous and compassionate of you. He is lucky you are his king, and not a cruel dictator.
I know it may seem unfit for some that I converse with the common people, but I myself believe that it is important to understand those that you rule. What do you do for work, guest?

I do a little bit of everything, sir. Fight when the wars require it, pick up trash in the streets to prevent disease, feed the cattle as they so require... I do my best to keep you kingdom efficient and beautiful, sir. Thankyou for asking,
And those are the traits which I so value in my subjects! Obedience, consideration, determination. All things required to keep our realm as prosperous as it is today. Say, are you married?
No, sir, I am not. No wife, no children, only the needs of the kingdom to worry my weary head. Why do you ask?

There is a local council of common people who represent the interests of the common people. To make them feel heard, you see. However, two of the local elders in the council passed this winter. It was a hard one, as I'm sure you know. So now there remain two vacancies, or so I am told by my royal staff.
Pardon my forwardness, sir, but are you considering me for the role? If so, it would be an honor to serve you, and the people. A dream come true.

It is up to the common people to choose you as their representative, of course. But perhaps you should consider speaking to your fellow common people and asking them to support you as a seat in the council. We need more men like you, who truly care about this kingdom.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: Oh my, what happened to the Bottlery?  When I was last hear many decades ago it was a thriving manufactory.
It's workers when on strike when the old king did them wrong. I now use this to store my finest wine. Say, what brings you here?

Well, I was here to pick up a wine shipment.  I was told there would be a crate ready?  I travel through many lands with my caravans, the circuit takes nearly three decades.  I doubt I shall ever return, but my son shall thirty years hence.
And who sent you? I cannot just give this wine to someone who claims to be sent! This wine is valuable.
The King's Vinter?  I'm assuming you are the King of these lands?
I am indeed. I have multiple people pass here a day to take a crate or just a small jug of wine. People try to break in here all the time.
Well, this should have all the proper documentation.

It indeed does. I am pleased to have you here. This wine came from a vineyard raised by the finest royals. When our country was attacked, they took our precious vineyard away. This is all the wine standing from that vineyard.
My goodness!  Who was it that attacked you and why?
The previous rulers of the kingdom over years ago when I was just a wee boy.
What a terrible foe!  How did you finally vanquish them?
It was not I, but my great grandfather who put them out with his mighty army of 20,000.
That many men?  How could the kingdom afford it?
This is a whole empire! We have more willing to fight for it than you think without much cost.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: My King, why do I have to marry that boy?
For the peace treaty - you know how much we need it.  Is this why you have disturbed me upon my porcelain throne?
Yes, i don't love him, and i don't want to move away.
Why not?  What is wrong with marrying one of the turtle-folk?  Are they not a noble people?
They are ugly and rude beasts.
Surely you must learn to love them, just as you learned to love your stepmother.
I want to stay with you father.
You will still be able to visit, it is not like you are leaving forever.
It feels like it though father. I'll be thousands of miles away.
Yes, but just think of all the half-turtle children you will have!
Groooosssss! I want to have normal children.
Well, unfortunately that will not be possible my child, unless you want them to continue to eat our people?
No i do not. But is there no other way?
Not unless you want us to stay at war my child.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: And how are you doing today dear?
neigh.  I am tired today, the King rode me hard.
Oh did he now, was the ride at least enjoyable for you?
I enjoyed stretching my legs, didn't enjoy the King's constant diatribe against the church.
He has a bone to pick with them does he?
Neiiigh, it was all about how corrupt the Pope is and how he's making his own religion up.
A new religion, what would that possibly be?
I think he wants to replace the Pope with himself.
That sounds like that would become problematic quickly, I am but a housewife but even I can see that is a dangerous road to travel.
I fear we are in for troubled times ahead.
Perhaps give him a good drop next time for me?
Ha, that wouldn't make me the King's horse for very long.
Well if he isn't around any more, he certainly cannot corrupt the church.
I can't believe what you're suggesting.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: What is that strange creature in the courtyard?
BOO!!!
Strange was definitely a good choice of words.
Aww man....Your not scared of me?
I am king, I bow to none.
Oh....Whats a king? You look like any other human except you are impeccably dressed.
It means that I stand above the other people, they follow my lead so to say.
So it's good to be king. I would like to be King. I will be King of my bridge. That;s where i live.
Are there no other more powerful creatures there? The countryside is quite nice perhaps you could look after that?
Really?! I would like that very much! Will people feed me you think?
I don't see why not there is usually always someone around I would imagine, just do not present yourself as threatening.
That will be hard but ok. I always enjoyed scaring people out from under my bridge. Do I get some sort of crown or badge to let people know not to mess with me?
Being a king is less about imposing fear than it is about garnering respect and admiration.
Yeah but can I have a crown like yours?

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Come, servant. Sit here.
Of course, how may I help you your majesty?
Tell me a story, i am grow tired of sitting here in silence.
Okay, well I'm afraid I don't know too many stories, sir. Would Cinderella do?
Is that all you know? Gosh I'll tell one than.
Yes, its the story my mother told me. I'm afraid I don't know how to read. I'd love to hear one sir
Ok well i'll tel you the story of the great war. It started abotu 200 years ago.
Oh, that is a long time ago, sir.
Yes it was, by great great grandfather was king. He found a spy in the kingdom and had him executed.
Oh a spy. I hope you don't find a spy in your castle.
Not yet... just a word of advice, don't be a spy.
Never your majesty!
Tis but a joke servant.
Yes of course your majesty.

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Hello merchant, it's pretty busy here...huh?
Incredibly!  45 years on the road, and this is the busiest I have ever seen it on a market day.
Tell me how much is this...uh...animal fountain?
47 Gold pieces m'lord, but seeing as how you're the King I'll let you have it for 45.
Ah well done merchant. I'll take two.
Excellent, anything catch your eye Sire?
I will look some more. Tell me, have you seen any of the turtlefolk around?
None nearby Sire, but I hear they have been raiding from the swamp at night once again.  Are you planning a retaliatory raid?
Yes we need to protect our people. I don't know why they are so confident in raiding us.
Sire, what do they do with those they have captured?  I have heard the legends from the small folk, but they feel embellished.
It depends on the crime. What would you do with someone who killed your people?
Well, in our culture we make them slave to the families who lost loved ones, to serve in the stead of those they lost.
I see, that is very generous of you.
What does your kingdom do?

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
