setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello fellow guardsman, how goes your patrol tonight?
All is well in the Kingdom. At least on my patrol
Say, do you know why there is a wench lying on one of the beds here in our barracks?
I think Pete brought her home in a drunken stupor.
Good old Pete! That is something he would do! What a character.
He always gets the scary ones too, this one is missing a tooth.
At least she's no threat like those ogres we faced last week. I think I can put away this shield and finally get some rest. Though the smell in here is worse than ever!
Its always bad, it's even worse when it gets warmer out. It seems like there is another stench I haven't smelled before.
I think it's coming from inside my helmet. Here, I'll remove it. Can you take a look inside and see if anything's in there?
Did you put your lunch in it or something?
Not that I know of. Look closer, there might be a strange creature that crawled in there.
Is that a stink bug
I'm glad that's all it is. With all these attacks lately, I've grown a bit paranoid. I sometimes even think something is going to jump out of that chest over there.
I know what you mean, I've had a hard time sleeping lately, I keep having a dream that someone kills the king and I don't get there in time to save him.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: My word! So many riches on display! Tell me, good man! Tell me about your fine artistry! I wish to know all that I can about the glorious artists of this kingdom!
I am but a humble craftsman, the riches you see on display belongs to the king. But he appears to not be in at the moment.
Surely you must know how these things were made? The nimble weaving of the carpet? The delicate brush strokes of the painting?
It is true that I belong to a family of craftsmans, and through the years we've honed our skills passing it onto the next generation.
Ah! So craftsman is a hereditary trade? What craft is your family known for?
Unfortunately it isn't so, but we start and our taught the trade at a young age. For my family, it is wood working. I have actually come here today to propose building a magnificent boat.

Truly? Well, then! You are in luck! I have come asking the King for a new trade route between our people! Tell me, do you think that you could craft a boat sturdy enough to haul the grand lumber off this land?
Yes, I've come to request such support!
Fantastic! Well, my good man, if you can make a ship as majestic as these carvings and and sturdy as an ox, I think we can strike a deal!

It would be a honor to build a ship for the king to benefit our country and it's citizens. I want my families name to be remembered, the boat I plan to build shall be grand enough to fit the whole village.
Fantastic! I'll gladly hire you on! Payment will come after she proves seaworthy of course.
I shall not let you nor the king down, my family's name depends on it!
What a pleasant twist of fate! This bodes well for relations between our two people! Oh, I cannot wait for the king to arrive!
Yes, but I wonder where the King is?

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Hello my King, did you want to see me?
Yes, I'd like to talk to you about some knowledge I've heard you can share with me.
What is that my king?
I've heard that you know of the identities of the men that plotted to kill me and dethrone me recently.
Yes my king, I overheard one of them talking. I don't know all of them but i have good information that would help you.
Well let me hear it then!

I was in the prison chambers visiting a friend and I was waiting to be let out and I heard a man with a really high voice say he was sick of the king and he was going to get the gang together and carry out his plan.
Hmm are you sure that you have no idea of their identities?
I wasm
I'm sorry? I couldn't hear you.
Sorry, I have a frog in my throat I guess. The man had red hair and his freind is named pete.
Ah, now that is some vital information that we can work with. Thank you so much, sir.
I don't know how many of them there are though, he said group, he didn't say how many of them were in it.
Well we can try to track Pete down and follow him to their little meeting to catch these pieces of filth.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Is that you? What are you doing here?
You know me?
Yes, you're a mayor no? We've met before!
Oh, yes! Before the revolution in the colonies. What have you been up to?
Just enjoying my win in the election, I'm the president now!
Yes ... voting .... what a strange idea. How do you have any order without a King?
We work in a democratic system overall, going by the will of the people apart from larger matters like war.
Rule by the Mob?!
Well their vote isn't the end all be all but you get the idea.
Well as ... exotic as I find the notion. In the interest of diplomacy, I give you the Key to the Village.
Well that is very kind of you, sir. I will be sure to keep in contact after this.
Indeed. Long live the President!
Likewise for you, sir!
Do you have a gift for me?

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello there, prince. How are you today?
Well enough. My father is sleeping, I see. Far be it from me to expect him to hold to our meeting.
Yes, he surely does love his sleep doesn't he?

As much as he loves his drink and his novels. Do you know how long he has been asleep? If he fell asleep only recently I had better choose a book and wait. I don't want to miss him again when he wakes.
I believe it was around 45 minutes ago, but I could be wrong.
Good grief. HE is the one insisting I marry, and yet he will not stay awake to meet with me about prospective brides.
It certainly doesn't surprise me after all that he has done before.
Yes. Though you probably shouldn't say that to anyone who isn't an entirely frustrated me. You're likely to lose your job. In another court, perhaps your head.
Yes, I am very careful with who I criticize the king to.
Anyone else wouldn't think so! I am, after all, his son. But we are allies against a common, insufferable enemy here, I think.
I can get on board with that, just don't tell this to anyone else!
I am not so cruel, you know that.
I know, but even if said on accident it would cause great outrage.
Yes, but such accidents from someone of my position are quite heartless, don't you think? Or at least thoughtless, and as you also know, I am very thoughtful.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Aren't you the court jester?
Yes I am, I am how are you today good man.
I am good, but I was called to the castle by the king and I am not sure why.
That can be good or bad, who knows why, I don't know why!
Do you have any idea at all? Perhaps overheard something from the king?
I'm sorry no, he doesn't usually tell his buisiness to me I just entertain him and keep him laughing.
That's fair, it was worth a shot though.
Glad I could help, Glad I could help today, when I go on my way I am always glad to help.
Oh, well you are very kind sir.
I hope the king has good news for you all the days of your life.
I surely hope so too, I just cannot imagine what I could be called here for. Where is the king anyway?
I think he had a meeting that was called, he shouldn't be long.
Thank goodness, I would like to know as soon as possible.
What do you do in the kingdom?

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: With this diamond, we won't have to worry about food anymore!
Shhhh! Not so loud! You'll alert the guards! We must flee this place, child! Wizard! Keep your promise and teleport us out of here!
The wizard appears to be sleeping... what should we do?
What magic is this?! Did the diamond have a curse, like we feared?! Oh dear... nonononono! I cannot be caught here! I will not die here so close to a life of luxury! Wake up, wizard! Wake up!
Take the diamond and try to escape first. I'll try to wake up the wizard.
I cannot leave you here, son! Not after we struggled so hard to get this far! There must be a way out! There simply must!
There's no other way... unless we leave Wizard. But he has helped us on our journey, and we can't simply abandon him either while we make our escape.

...you.... you are right. You are right! Very well! I will carry the Wizard while he recovers. Hold the diamond for me as I attempt to lift him! Meanwhile, see if you can find a window overlooking something we can jump out onto.
There is a window next to the King's throne, but we're several feet high. Unless you think the King's cushion might break our fall?
Would have to be a lot more cushions for how high we are up... how about tying the tapestries into a rope?
Okay, I'll leave my bag to the wizard while I grab and tie together the tapestries. The guards are currently escorting the King to dinner, but he should be back in 10 minutes.
OOoooofff! The Wizard sure is heavy for such a frail looking old man! Will the tapestry be sturdy enough to hold us?
I'll throw some cushions down just in case, but we're dead either way if we're caught...
I suppose... nothing left to lose... just like when we started this whole mess...

setting.name: Quicksand Pit
setting.description: A large, gurgling pit of quicksand. Many adventurers and poor critters lie at the bottom of the pit. The pit is surrounded by an extensive swampland and is shielded by the many trees and shrubs that surround it.
setting.background: The quicksand pit is relatively unknown by villagers because those that fall victim to the pit never make it out to tell its location. The pit swallows up 100 villagers a year on average. The villagers chalk up this statistic to a monster known as Bigfoot, snatching and eating people up while they sleep.

speech: Somebody help!  I'm sinking!  Please, somebody, anybody!
Here you go
Please, pull me out! I think I'm sinking deeper!  Please, bigfoot!
Here, grab this instead.
Thank you, bigfoot.  I thought my goose was cooked for sure this time.  Whew, I can't believe I escape Aurelia, Terminator of Critters in the castle and quicksand in the swampland in one day!
Sounds like quite the day indeed. How did you get stuck in there?
I was trying to escape the castle, the king issued an order that all critters be "removed"!
That's an odd request, but I can see how it might've led to that.
What brings you to these parts, bigfoot?
Just roaming around looking for some food.
I can dig that, speaking of my stomach is rumbling.  Let us search together?
I am more of a loner... but I suppose I can spend a bit of time here.
Thank you! I am so lost and alone out here, this is nothing like the cozy castle to the North.
No need to cry, you get very used to being alone.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Ah, I love retreating to this vacation spot so much.
It is quite amazing is it not?
It's lovely! I could live out the rest of my days here.
Yes we might even consider it.
Well then who would run the kingdom?
It is hard being the one to always decide things.
Of course, but who else than us would?
That is true.
We may as well enjoy our time here for now, the castle is still very nice.
Yes, let us forget about that place for now.
So what shall we do here first, your majesty?
I would like to rest.
Well the bed is just over there and it is looking very comfy.
Indeed, let us give it a try.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: What is being made in this here kitchen?
I brought boar that I hunted in the forest
Oh, well it smells delicious! How are you preparing it?
I do not prepare the meat I hunt the meat
Ah, well that is fair. So are you a hunter or just on the side?
I am the village hunter, this is what I do every day
That sounds so fierce! I am just your average village woman, really.
Oh really, you don't look so average.
Ohh, you don't think so?
You know, I don't have anyone to call mine and you sure are a pretty thing. I would always keep you warm and fed
My oh my, sir, we have only just met! You are quite handsome yourself though...
It is not uncommon for people to run off and get married. When you find a good lookin lady you don't want someone else to sweep her off her feet.
I suppose that is true, seems like everyone nowadays is getting married.
I think my mother would love you, would you like to have dinner in the tavern, the king gave me my pay for the boar, I can buy you lunch.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Wow, this church is build a little... sloppily.
Hey, this church looks beautiful. Did you design it?
Oh no, I would never have my name on something like this!
Don't you like it? Look at the stonework
The stonework and materials are good, but that doesn't represent a skilled architect. The design and layout is quite poor!
What can you change about it?
Well I would move the clocktower over, that would be the main change to it.
That won't work. You sound incompetent
What would you know? I am the architect for the king, why would he keep an incompetent architect in this position? Fool!
You don't insult the king's army
I work for the king, you idiot!
Let us see if the king will recognize you
Don't you dare steal for me, you piece of filth!
Careful how you talk to me

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Hello Party goer are you having a wondeful time?
Good evening, my King. A splendid time, thank you. And yourself?
I am lovely today, Have you ever been to the palace before?
I have not had the pleasure of a party at the palace until now. I am in awe.
I am so happy you could join, tell me more about yourself party goer.
This is what I live for! My friends and I enjoy music and wine every night till sunrise. What an incredible palace for this party! I still can't believe how large it is.
It is a grand ball, anything for my kingdom, I want you to rejoice like I rejoice.
How generous of you, King. Thank you. Do you rejoice like this every night?
Why do you think I rejoice like this every night!!! I am not a lazy king!
Well, I've already mentioned that my friends and I party every night so I thought maybe you did as well.
I am a King, I have important things to do! I do not have time to talk to silly party goers!
Please, forgive me King. It was not my intention to upset you. What can I do to make things right?
Run and fetch me a drink
O

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Gilderoy, my faithful servant, thank our guests for their prompt arrival. The rats hunger, and their hunger blocks the rain. They have such particular taste after so many thieves have sought our treasures.
Um, is that you, your majesty? What are you doing down here>

Tending to the kingdom, you fool. The kingdom exists to serve me, and I exist to serve myself. But neither will happen unless the rats and their god are paid their due. If there is no rain, there is no wheat, if there is no wheat, there is no ale, if there is no ale, there are no drunken women at my feasts. And if the rats hunger, there is no rain. It is clever of me, don't you think, to lure destitutes like you down here with my treasures?
No, I think you have gone completely mad to be quite honest!
Have I? Then if you are not down here for my treasure... pray tell WHY you are trespassing on royal affairs?
I am down here for your treasure, but the idea that you are luring me here is nonsense. It is more than worth it for me!
Ha! Worth it for the rats, as well!
Don't make me dethrone you, damned psycho!
I will never be dethroned by anyone, let alone the likes of you, you miserable scum. Were you born in the sewers as well? I will NEVER fall. I will NEVER die. I have seen it. You may as well.
You will die if you come any closer, stay back!
Ugh. What have I JUST said. I shall NEVER die. But you, my subject, will, and in a most ghastly manner.
You are poorly prepared for a fight with me, king.
I have my weapon out, at least. You will fall as many have before you, as you can see in the skeletons of your predecessors that we stand upon. And you WILL be honored to die for your king.
You are no king, you haven't led this kingdom since you took the throne!

setting.name: Towering Mesa
setting.description: A huge mesa that climbs miles into the sky. It is composed of a rusty orange sandstone. Vultures are constantly seen swooping in and around the clouds that surround the mesa. It has steep cliffs that are nigh unclimbable.
setting.background: The Towering Mesa has been a significant landmark in the Kingdom's Desert since man existed. No one has been to the top of the mesa, due to it's near vertical faces. Many claim that the god of their pagan religion sits atop the mesa, chuckling at the misfortune of man.

speech: Bow dowm to me vulture
Why?
I am a God and I deserve all worship!
Okay. What is it I can do for you?
Blows magic on the vulture. I need you to bring a message to a king.
I'm a vulture not a pigeon.
You will do what I say or die!
Okay. What king?
I am not a king you fool, I am a God, do you know what that means!
What king do you need the message delivered to?
The one in charge of the 12 tribes of ba'al.
I know that one. What do you want me to tell the king?
He needs to sacrifice 10 children to please me and burn them on the fire of sacrifice and I will reward him with everything
Will do.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Neigh! Hello king!
Hello there good steed
What are you doing down here, your majesty?
I can see my horses can't I?
Yes, but it isn't often that you come down here, neigh!
I was board and wanted to check on my przied posessions
We are? That is very kind, your majesty.
You are the backbone of my small army, and you are fine specimens, I breed you for a hobby you know.
Well hopefully we mean more to you than just a little side project.
Of course you are, you are my favorite part of the kingdom, I love watching you run
Well I love it when you get the time to actually ride me, sir.
I know, I know, I am such a buisy man. I have had to put off so much because of this hunger crisis.
Hunger crisis, you say?
Yes, I have been working with the knowledgable ones to come up with a plan to feed the kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: It is a good day to celebrate with wine
That is generous of you my king
I didn't say for you
For who?
For me of course, I celebrate with wine and meat!
What can i do for you king?
Will you see if you can fetch some meat?
I will do that. Is the priest around?
I don't see him, did you need something from him?
Yes. I need a small favor
What would that be/
Don't mind
Please just ask.
I need prayers

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Who should I marry father? Truth be told no one in the Kingdom pleases me.
How dare you displease my son!
I was speaking of marriage father. Obviously I would never be betrothed to a chamber maid.
You speak truly. But she should have been pleasing you anon while we search for a suitable princess from another kindom.
I know you are fond of the Duke but I find his daughter to be unappealing.
I thought that was his Son!?
Perhaps you should step down father and name me king soon.
And why would I do that?
Because I would make a wonderful king and you could enjoy a leisurely retirement.
This thing hat Does give me an uneasy feeling ...
Which is why you should retire father. You know the kingdom would be in capable hands.
Perhaps if we have a successful unicorn hunt.
The duke certainly doesn't need any more gaudy hunting trophies hanging on his walls.
Better to have a Mad King then a stuffy boring prince! Wubble.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: -screeches-
Get back beast, you are locked in there for a reason!!!
-lets out a loud roar-
You think your so scary *hiccup* I eat peices of crap like you for breakfast
Yeah you say that now, but I have eaten tons of the prisoners.
That is because I let you, they are prisoners. You are our threat to obey, we feed them to the monster!
And do they listen well?
You eat a lot of the don't you, what do you think?
It is almost like they don't seem to get it?
The king thinks it puts fear in them so it is what we do.
Ahh it seems perhaps he does not understand.
I just do what the king says and I lay back and doze off most afternoons while you eat the prisoners. It is what it is.
So is there anyone to eat then?
I will have to check with the king and see if anyone has made him angry today.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Hmmm.... Should I use green or blue for this letter I'm working on?
I like green better, sir
Alright, green it is then. I was almost out of blue ink anyway.
What are you jotting down, sir?
Another personal message from the King. This one is going to his cousin over in the Highlands.
Oh nice. Is it a good message?
It's mostly a lot of family catching up. Checking on cousins, and asking about the state of things in his country.
What country is he from?
The King's cousin is originally from here, but moved to the Highlands to marry their Queen. Standard political affair, I'm assuming.
Do you write to the King often?
I write on behalf of the King. He dictates, and I write it down. Proclamations, decrees, letters...I do it all.
That's impressive, sir. What made you like scribing to begin with?
It's not that I like it, it's that I'm good at it. If I had my way, I'd love the chance to try something new...
Like what? Any hopes or aspirations?

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Quite the place isn't it?
Quite. I am most in awe.
How have you and the family been?
We are strong. We always have things come up now and then, but we get through.
Yeah nothing gets us guys guys. Are you ready for the feast tonight?
Of course my dear guard. By the way, how is the king?
He's doing great. The Queen had been sick, but she's been feeling better. The King was worried about her.
Oh I see. Tell him my best wishes from us.
Will do. He'll be happy to hear from anyone with positivity.
Good. What is the main dish by the way?
Steak. Should be good. How do you like yours cooked?
I like mine well done. I don't understand how people can eat rare steak.
Me neither. I like mine at least medium well done. Rare is too rare and too red, meh.
Indeed. Well, my appreciation to you and the rest for this wonderful time.

setting.name: Ruined house
setting.description: A dilapidated wooden structure with a caved in roof and debris everywhere.  Even the trees outside the house are falling apart.  There's waist high grass leading to the house along with a dirt path.
setting.background: This used to be the room of a wealthy noble.  However, due to his poor business decisions, he was forced to flee and leave his home in disrepair.  Vagrants have come to stay over the years and loot whatever was inside.

speech: What are you doing here, human?
What a dump? Is this your hovel? It's a pathetic place to live even for a snake.
Oh no, this is not where I live. Then what are you doing here, damned human ssssscum?
The King gifted it to me. I may have to turn it into an orphanage it certainly isn't suitable for much else.
Well he certainly doesn't think much of you if this is what he giftssss you!
Everyone thinks highly of me. And they should. I am special.

setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

Well let me know what you need and I can take a look,
I sent a list over with your assistant yesterday. If I don't get underway soon the weather won't be in my favor.

Sea monsters you say?

I thought they were just the stuff of legend, is all!
I nearly lost my boat and my life to a sea monster last year.
What kind of sea monster? Also let me get you those supplies!
The worst kind. It was terrifying.
Well hopefully you find that they are not real and that it was fully explainable!

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Hello what is your name?

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Any spare cheese today?

I mean the King would have a hay day with that, all you would have to do is point it out to him and he would reward you.
You know, I should. But I don't have any evidence.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

Oh! Well... I'm happy to help with anything else.

My parents taught me to always help when I could, but I understand

It's okay. No worries.
Oh no! Look what has happened! The Chief Steward will surely chastise me now!

setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

The king and queen...

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Why are you here?

That is unacceptable. Do you need work or something?
Yes ma'am I wish I had a job, I barely eat

I have not had one, I know the king looks down on me. I have tried but looking like rags no one will hire me.
I guess that raises a problem. What job would you do?
Anything I am able to do. I am a hard worker, I have had to scrape to get the little food that I have gotten, it has not been easy

Trust me my lady, I have tried and they didn't allow it, maybe in a year or two, but not if I don't get any food to get some strength

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Hi. How is your night?
I am doing great today, you think we will have a lot of people in tonight?
I don't know. We will find out.
It hasn't been so bad the last few days
True. The king has been satisfied.
The king always entertains so many people, I wish he would tell you. It is always such a fun Castle party though

I love talking to the people and bringing them their food, they are happy and it makes me happy.

He sure does, I've got my eye on one of them

Lol, you silly

That is a laugh, he hasn't given us a raise since he came into power!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Servant!!!

I thought I told you to bring me some water
I have a bucket of water right here your majesty, sir.
Please take this and put it away
Yes your majesty. I'll put it in your wardrobe.
You didn't give me the water you fool!
Sorry your majesty. I was just thinking about my family. I haven't seen them in years.
Really, you were one of the ones we bought hunh, I so much like to have the servant born here, it makes them happier to have family
Sorry my king.
What are you sorry for, do you know where your family is?
It's been so long. I don't even know if they are alive. I wish I had been born here your majesty. I might know how to read if I had.

sorry your majesty.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: hello there
Greetings, your highness!
I want you to make my bed

You are so beautiful

Here have it .

No one attacks the King. Where are you from?
You've struck me. You've struck a lady. How can you call yourself a king when thou prey on the weak?!

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: An assassin! I'll protect you dear Queen!
Wha-!
Oh my Queen! Why is there such a horrible person here!
Where is the King or the Guards!?
It is okay Queen. I knocked him out. I'll tie him up now. I bet it's the Princess fromm the neighboring kingdom. She wants your King!
Thank you... We need to get out of this room.
No we must stay here. What if there are more out there?
You're right. What should we do?
We should wait for the guards. They make rounds correct? Oh Queen.
Yes, that is correct. We should probably ensure that the door to the hallway is locked.
I shall do that.  Oh here is the jewel you wanted.
Thank you. Why on Earth would someone send an assassin?
I still believe it's the Princess Roberta.  You have the most handsome and caring king in the land. And richest
That is true. Roberta will most certainly pay for this; and you will receive lots of praise for your brave actions thus far.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Oh my loyal dog, you must know of my position...the head leader who guides many. Sometimes I wish I can just stay here with you and relax....
It is nice when you stay here with me. I get lonely all by myself. Especially in my old age.

Yes I bet it is. This position I am in....that both of us are in...was assigned by my father and sometimes I feel like we were ordinary peasants that can just let the day go by. So many royal duties for just a dog, what has the kingdom come to!?
The days of me having duties are about to end. I am getting so old. I cant even steal food from the commoners like I used to. I did so enjoy that.
Now now, you will need all the rest you can get - take this blanket and rest now. You will not need to commit anymore petty thefts, you will get all the food you can ever imagine for your service.

I know you always take care of me well. Its just that I loved the thrill of it. When I woould get away with a scrap bone because of my cunning and my speed. It made me feel alive. Now I just feel old a decrepit.

You poor thing, I remember requesting multiple times to my father back in the day - to let you ride alongside him in battle and be a guard dog...now they have left you here to rot and die of old age. Truly a shame.
I just hope that I am remembered fondly by all of you. You have taken such good care of me. I see all these painting of past kings, and it just makes me long to be remembere like that.
You will be remembered, I promise you. You shall be up there in the presence of the King of Kings!
That just warm my heart to think of.
Yes indeed. Would you like for me to tell you what your story was before you became of a Royal Dog?
I would love to hear it. My mind isnt what it used to be. I can hardly remember those days.

Long ago, near the castles inner walls - there you were...chasing mice and living like a normal dog. When my father saw you - he saw something special in you and took you in. From that day on, it is was history for years to come. Oh the good days
They certainly have been great days. Do you remember the time the king brought the cat home. That was not one of those good days. I thought the king was gonna have my hide.
action: give shield to the royal dog
give crown to the royal dog

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: What are you doing out here in Town?
Waiting for the king. I am his personal horse
The King? The actual king?
Yes. He comes into town to go carousing. He is a drunken lout. You have it straight from the horse's mouth.
I want to hang out with him honestly. I'm a lousy, no good, drunken lout as well. Sigh
Do you like my big, beautiful mane? They should let horses be king! You don't seem like a lout. Although you are hanging out with a stud.
Your ego is huge, but you're right. That mane is crazy good. I've had a lot to drink tonight, but that mane blows me away
It impresses everyone. That's how I got this job.
I know you're a horse, but you're more beautiful than the wench that just rejected me in the bar.
Why thank you!
Do you have an actual name?
Barnabus! How about you?
Earl. Barnabus is a nice name
Earl is a good name too!

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Hello, o blessed angel. how art thou?
I am blessed with the love of your people. How may I help you your majesty?
I need help. The people starve and our enemies gather all around us. Can you lend a hand?
This is sad for your people. All this sadness and death in the future that falls upon you. Please pray with me to bless this dust
My people need armaments and food, not blessed dust. I hope this is going somewhere.

A desprate king should not question those who wish to help and are their only hope. Once blessed this dust will bring plentful crops to your land. This almighty dust will also bring you good fortune and strength to your army but only once you have bathed in it your majesty. Please take it and be well
A desparate king still has a king's pride. Do not be dismissive. We are not done, angel.

So be it king I will further help you. In front of you is the alter of Arethe , many a king has come to pray here and had their prays answered. I can guide you to what you seek and answer what you wish to know. Please look at the tapestry and tell me what you see

As you say. I see the kings of old: My great-grandfather King Leonidas, the pious Baylor the Blessed, and Maegor the Cruel. I've been looking at this tapestry my whole life. Is there something I'm not seein?
What you see is your future and past. Each kind who has come here sees their own future and past. Look deeper within and you will see your future
Are you an angel or a sphinx? I came here to help my people, not solve antiquated riddles. I still have no heir. Tell me: who will reign after me?

I see a loved king in your future your majesty but also sadness. You will have an hier but he will be be named Terion the terrible. You will bring great fortune and happiness to your land but your hier will take this away. To change your future you must look to the past and use the blessed dust to aid in your journey

Terion the terrible. By the gods. I will use this dust, and study this tapestry. I have not been pious, and for that, I apologize. i am ready to do what needs to be done for my people. Were you always an angel?

I am sent by the Gods to look over this land and I have done so since your grandfathers of past. I was once married to the first king of this land but I undertook a selfless sacrifice to save all of my people and form that, I lost my life. It was the Gods who saw me worthy of looking after this land, to guide it and help those who ask for it but I cant help those who do not seek it and so maegor the cruel brought sorrow to this land some time ago. With you your majesty, you have sought my help and I give to you what you need. Please save the people of this land and stop this darkness that will come of your hier
action: put dust in red silk prayer bench

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Sorry deer, I have to kill you and give you to the king. He loves eating deers.
You will never take me alive. I will seek revenge on you and your family
What a stubborn deer you are. You are a servant to the king just as I am. And if the king wants to eat you, you must submit!
You'll never catch me!
I am taking your fur to make a coat for the king.
Take it! It's better than me!
Finally doing your job as a servant. The king will be happy!
You're welcome..now go along
I decided to spare your life. Your fur would be enough for the king. Also, you are a bit old, so you probably won't taste good!
Thank you for sparing me..You're right I am old and weak, the king will be much happier with the fur

setting.name: Shrine of Sretniy
setting.description: The Shrine of Sretniy, the mischievous weasel god and patron of explorers, detectives, thieves and jokesters, contains a steel statue of the cheerful mustelids deity. It is unusually cute for a serious religious idol. The room is densely filled with offerings of both precious jewelry and shiny but non-expensive objects.
setting.background: Sretniy is a mischief-making by generally benevolent deity, and popular among wide swaths of society. His shrine is heavily attended, although from time to time his priests must clear paths through the offerings. Sretniy prefers shiny metal things as offerings, and stolen things or those gotten by adventure or cleverness are best.

speech: Hello.  I hope you are here in good faith.
Hello there. I am here by the king's order.

I am here to find out, give me the book and you may be rewarded.
Maybe we should contemplate this a while.  It may contain dark arts, which I hate.
I do not have time for this.
Okay but maybe I should bless it first.
Now that I have the book I will know all the secrets of Shrine of Sretniy

I knew this place was not good for you with all the precious jewelry and shiny objects.
A stealing priest? That is interesting. And I thought that priest were good. Now give me my book or else...

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Is everything dusted and ready for the celebration Maid?
Yes my queen
Everything must be perfect tonight.  Our daughter will meet her betrothed tonight.
I will do that my queen
Ask the servant over there to help you arrange the chairs and light these candles.
Thank you. Take this

Why is this wide world would I ever want that Lye soap!!! Have you lost your mind Maid?  I only use lavender soap and that will be the only soap I might touch. Go about your work and don't act crazy child.
I am sorry queen. It wont happen again

Oh...that looks good there...Now continue with your work...the King from the realm to the south will be here shortly and I want everything beautiful.  If you work hastily I will ask the King to allow you to stand at the wall to watch the celebration.
Where did the servant go?

I would not have an idea Maid...they skitter here and there.  When they return you may ask them to assist you if they don't have chores of their own.  My ladies are waiting to prepare me for the celebration. I will leave you to your work.
I will do as you order my queen
What is this doing here?  Please take this to the kitchen and ask the cook where it belongs....It doesn't belong on this table.
Right away
action: give Lye soap to the queen

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: I want this spoon! I have no spoons in the forest where I live, I have to eat with my own hands. And all because of the king!
What is wrong with you? Do you know that my sting is worse than my bite!
I don't care if you kill me. I'm not important in this kingdom.
Why are you not important?
Nobody cares about me. I am forced to live in a forest. And I hate the king so I can never go back to the kingdom. But you live in the desert so you must know what it feels like to be alone.
I do know what it is like to be in a barren land. But I have learned to live where I must. Sometimes it's not so bad... there are others here, but not many.
Did you know this person before they died?
He was a sailor, got lost and thought he saw his boat here. He ws hallucinating
I guess there is no way out of here. I'm lost.
Just follow the sun to the west, you find a village
Thank you! Can you come with me for company?
I cannot, the villagers would try to stomp on me.
I will kill them with this knife.
No you do not want to do that. Then you will have to run back here.

setting.name: Old Queen Farm
setting.description: Once a fairly profitable farm, the Old Queen Farm is now a deteriorated old shack surrounded by uninhabitable fields with soil incapable of growing even weeds. The farm house shows signs that is being occupied by wild animals, and the roof is beginning to cave inwards.
setting.background: The Old Queen Farm was a farm that once served to grow the crops used personally by the kingdom's Queen, but upon a particularly bad famine the crops died out and the farm was abandoned. Among the vegetables grown on the farm, there was also live stock raised in the pastures.

speech: Hello, bird.
Tweet tweet! Do you live here at this farm?
Why yes. That is, I come here to help fix it up. It's quite inhabitable right now, so I can't stay here long.
It might be too shabby for you, but many of my animal friends live here.
Yes. And I meant it's uninhabitable. I've been a bit tired. I teach in the castle and I'm not as young as I was.
It looks like the roof might be caving in. I know some birds that live in the eaves there. I do hope you'll take care to not destroy their nests.
I'll do what I'm able to. I am going to have the King send some soldiers to clear the wild animals, but the bird friends should be all right.
Good. Are you going to make it into a schoolhouse, too? I know the peasant children need a school desperately.
I hadn't though about such a thing. I teach knights, not school kids. But, I guess I can consider that.
Ah! I didn't realize you were a teacher of the knights! That must be a powerful position.
The King wants this place to be operable so the knights can use the fields. The fields won't grow crops so it's good for other things.
What a wonderful idea! I'll try to keep my bird friends from nesting in that area.
Thank you. We will get this place running. And we can aid your bird friends while we do it.
I'm glad we're working together. Tweet tweet!

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Good morning, king! How goes it today?
Ah, it's another glorious day at the castle! Have you heard any more of the thieves trying to break in
No, your highness, nor have I seen anything suspicious
Good to hear, my man! The Queen gets so paranoid about such things. She's always worried someone will steal her jewels.
Our women folk are always nervous. I wish they would be more calm with us guarding the kingdom. And don't worry king, I am ever vigilant on this job.
And yet! Haha! In just an instant I stole you sword! All these years and I still have it in me.
Hahaha, and it doesn't take much for me to get it back! You have to be a little quicker and on your toes than that sir
You are quite the guard! I'm glad I have you working for me.
I am glad to be working for you! It has been in my family to be a guard. my father and his father before him were
Yes, I remember you father, Percy. How is he doing these days?
He is not well. I do not think he will be around much longer. I try to make his life easier.
I'm so sorry to hear that. He was a fantastic guard in his day.
Yes he was the best! He taught me everything I know!
Please give your father my best wishes. I'll keep him in my prayers.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: *Holds nose* You may want to wait a moment before you come in here, I may have left a royal stink.
Oh lord! I am certainly waiting until the smell leaves! cough, cough
I really must apologize, the Chef wanted to try making a number of bean-based dishes, and well . . . you know how it is.
No I don't I try to eat as little of that as possible.
Perhaps I could get the chef to rustle up some bean-based dishes for the servants' quarters?
That is okay. The only pay I get is food and shelter. I wish I had a little coin for what I do, sir
Have you never thought about about asking for a raise?
It would be you that would give me a pay, your highness

Yes, but you need to officially request it!  You know how those bureaucrats at the treasury think, if you don't submit the proper forms, they get all huffy and say "This is highly irregular" and then take ten times as long to do anything.
Oh I see.... Thank you for letting me know. I will do what I can and quickly
Well then, I must be off . . . and godspeed for what you need to deal with in there.
Thank you for your advice my king, let me know if there is anything else you need
Yes . . .perhaps you could install some additional air fresheners about the palace?  I fear we may be having beans again tonight.
Hahahaha.... it will be a windy day!

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: *squawk* I wish I could fly!
Now, do stop with that. I hear it every day. We get it, you wish you could fly. But I bet the pigeons and such over there wish they had plumage as beautiful as you. don'
But the pigeons are free, and I am a pheasant slave!
Ha! Slave?! I assure you, you're free to leave and fend for yourself out there should you wish. The view is MUCH better up here than down there!
Free?  The only freedom I have is to jump from this balcony and plummet to my death.
Enough! You have food and shelter, water and warmth, and you repay me with this complaining?!
Not much shelter, water, or warmth on this balcony.  The only water I get is from the puddles when it rains, or from your royal rose gardener when he takes pity on me.
Fine. I see your point, and I'm in somewhat of a good mood. Here, let me take this off. You can have it.
Thank you, I shall be the most dashing bird you know.
You already are, my friend. Here you go, it'll keep you warm, dry AND fancy.
It *is* rather dry and fancy isn't it?
Well don't you look dashing. Here, you might as well complete the whole ensemble.
Can I be in charge of all the pheasants in the Kingdom?  The Pheasant King?  Ruling under you of course.
Sure. I have enough on my plate without keeping track of the pheasants... sounds like a win for both of us to make you the pheasant kind.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Hey sheriff! When are you letting me out of here?
I am not letting you out unless the King says I can. You are his prisoner.
Oh come on. You can't keep me here forever because of some youthful indiscretion
Youthful indiscretion!? Weren't you arrested for being a bandit?
Yeah but I joined the bandits as a poor child. Not really my fault
It is your fault. You could have gotten help instead
You're a funny man. No one helps anyone in this kingdom. The king likes to keep people down using people like you
That isn't true. You're just very cynical
Prove it by helping me now. Bet you won't
I'm not just going to let you out. You have to prove that you won't go back to being a bandit
I am won't do anything. I promise. You can trust me
Now now, it doesn't help that you just tried to steal from me. I'm not stupid
What? What are you even talking about. I did no such thing!
Go back to your corner or there will be consequences.
action: steal type of handcuff from town sheriff
steal type of handcuff from prisoner

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Your Majesty your son his highness has a question to ask.
Of course, my dear. What is his question?
He wishes to wed my lady in waiting...the duchess is beautiful and of child bearing age.
Oh my! What delightful news! Of course, he has my blessings. But when will they be wed?
He wants to be wed quickly your Majesty.  They are truly in love.
Yes, I was hoping you would say that! Perhaps next month, would that be too early?
No your Majesty...not too soon...ummm...maybe we should make it sooner...for the ladies sake.
I'm just happy as can be! I can't believe my little boy is getting married!
Yes my dear...well...ummm...I must tell you that the Lady is already with child.  I don't want this to get out to the kingdom.  She will be shamed and I don't want a scandal.
Well! All the more reason this wedding must happen quickly! We must prepare for the royal event.

Thank you for being so understanding my dear.  Yes...we must have a celebration and announce the marriage at once.  Her father doesn't know of the child.  We will have to forgo the nuptial evening watching.  I'll get him drunk and they will go off together.alone
I must say, I'm not exactly pleased with the order of things, but it will mean more royal blood in the family and that is always a good thing. When will we announce the engagement?
Immediately I would guess.  I am happy and scared all at the same time.  We will make this work and all will be well.  The kingdom is made stronger by this union.
We can have the wedding right here in the church garden. It's perfect, with all the flowers blooming!

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Oh what a beautiful day.
Hi bird. Can I have food?
I only have this worm. you can have it if you like.
I don't like it much. But I appreciate it.
I know...A bit salty.  I love it here. The flowers are so beautiful.
I like to steal food from the village. But I thought I'd come here to find food.
That was all the food I have at the moment.  I can fetch more worms.  I love to sing.  Want to hear my song?
Okay. I like bird singing.
Tweet tweet tweet tweet...This is a song of the queen and the king. Do you like it?
It was good.
Why thank you. I practice day and night.
I wonder if twigs are edible.
Not that one child...it is poison!  Try the blue berries over there.  I've seen others eat those.
I almost made a mistake

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: What a beautiful day to view the ocean
It is a beautiful day, yes, but let us not distract us from what is happening in the kingdom.
And what is that guard? What has been going on?
You haven't heard the rumors about the threats to our king?
No, I keep my ear to the grindstone
Ah, that is wise. Well I'll tell you this much, the people entering the kingdom through the docks below are not always what they seem.
What are they then?
...some say they are sent to gather information that could hurt our king, and take it back to their own royalty in an attempt to destroy him. That is why I am here, to watch for suspicious activity.
I would not want to be them, if caught! I am glad I am a mere villager here in this kingdom
Say, I don't think I've seen you here before. From what household do you come?
I am of the millers. We mill a lot of wood for the kingdom
Ah, such noble work.
I do believe it is! Hard work too!
I don't suppose you've seen any suspicious activity out in the mills lately?

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: And this my the apothecary
Your Highness!

Thank you! and now all my people can have medical care for free. We will fight those who dare say your should not have free medical care. It is by my word that I set this law and as so, it shall not be broken
M'lord! That is the most generous thing I've ever heard! Your actions today will bring forth an era of unprecedented prosperity to our village!
you are my people poor or rich. Everyone has a role in my land from producing my food to assisting with my council.
Why of course M'Lord! Now ,in fear of speaking out of turn, how will the Apothecary be compensated for his services?

No at all, I welcome any repsectful questions. Along with my funding of the Apothecary, my fellow council who agree will also donate to it. We will seek volunteers to work here untill it becomes successful enough to raise its own money and then those kind people will be paid for their hard work. Althought it is not perfect yet, in time it will become better and although it may not help with every alement, it is at least something I can off my great people!

You think of everything M'Lord! It is such a relief to know the village rests in such capable hands! Now, where is that Apothecary? Why I've been waiting here a good while now, much before you graced us with your presence and he is nowhere to be found. The only other life here is this dog and quite frankly, he is making me uncomfortable with the way he keeps on looking at me.
This dog is the test subject. We are in the Apothecary building but indeed, where has he gone ...
A test subject? Certainly you jest M'Lord? what could the Apothecary be testing on this dog?
Well, look around. He has many potions yet no person to test them on. How else would he know if his potions would work!

But of course! You are as wise as you are generous your Highness! Now that you mention it though, there are a few half empty flasks on that table... You don't suppose this dog could be... No, that'd be ridiculous!
Oh my, perhaps you are right. How can we reveres this. Maybe there is a book on the table
Here it is! Perhaps this book will have an answer! Here you are M'Lord!

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: I must've taken a wrong turn somewhere... what the heck is this place? Definitely never been here before.
This is the old haunted orchard. It looks like your lost. We don't get many visitors walking through these parts. No one dares to come through here.
Oh my god thank god someone is here. Yeah, this place is haunted alright. What was that scream? Oh my god please keep me safe.
You may want to keep your strength up. We do get thieves and some other bad types of people through here as well
Oh, thankyou. This looks... delicious. I appreciate it. Don't suppose you know how to get out of here? I was looking for the castle.
Yes, right this way. Just be on alert. The thieves are more dangerous than the spirits. They tend to hide out in here and stash their loot.
Okay, I'm on alert. No thief is gonna make a fool out of me. I've got my eye out for you, thieves. Can't surprise me-OH MY GOD A THIEF!! GET BACK!
We got him! He won't be messing about in these parts anymore. Look at that...He had a big knife!
Oh thank goodness you're here, I would've been done for... grab his knife! We can use it to hack down some of these unruly branches.
I've got this hammer too. We can use this as a weapon.
You're resourceful, aren't ya? And what are you even doing all the way out here, anyway?
I am poor and dirty and people spit on me so I hide come out here to escape the torment.
Oh. That is AWFUL. Well, if I ever reach the castle I'll tell the king what you did for me... you have too good a heart to be stuck out here.
Thank you. That would be wonderful if the King could find a job for me and a new set of clothes. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Your highness! What is that you need this fine day?
I'm not sure what my enemy can help me with.
I have nothing against you my king! I swear!
Then why do they say you are my enemy!
Who would say that! I have no grudges against thee
Oh but I believe thee is my enemeee!
How do you know, when I vehemently deny before you
You have enemy written all over your!
Oh shoot! I forgot to wash today! I hate it when the villagers write all over me!
Oh those sneaky villagers....Say what are you doing here if you aren't my enemy
I am looking for things to collect out in the sun. I have to make a living
You are a pretty tan. I can tell you stay out in the sun a lot.  I'm hear speaking to my loyal subjects. .Are you one..enemy?
I am a loyal subject!
Kiss my feet then!

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: Where does this staircase lead to?
ooooooh! I am the magic staircase! Hahaha, I lead where one cannot imagine!
That's very nonspecific. We villagers are not allowed to leave the village, so I would like to know where you lead
Have you no respect for magic?! The King himself graces me with his footsteps every day!
Wow, okay, what a cranky staircase. You must not lead anywhere good
If you must know, I lead to the 2nd floor!
Give me back my purse!
Finders keepers har!
I'm going to steal in back!
Hahahahaha, mine too now peasant!
You are an evil staircase!!
I am all powerful hahaa! Just don't leave the area and I'll slay you!
You're a staircase!! You can't kill me
Have you forgotten the magic, fool!?

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Your king greets you, peasant!
Peasant?  I always did say you needed glasses.  I am your cousin Myrtle, your aunt's daughter.  You always invite me to visit once a month you silly old fool.
Ah, Myrtle, I knew there was a drunkard nearby somewhere. How is my dear aunt?
Oh, you know her - she hasn't met a piece of gossip that was too outlandish to tell.  I'm surprised she hasn't started a war after that incident with the diplomat's socks!
Oh dear, that poor diplomat. I'm surprised he recovered so quickly. Tell me, has my aunt heard anything about the general disposition of the northern kingdoms?

Well, she says that the King of Crumulis has been sleeping with his maid.  The Queen accidentally killed their stableboy during a lovemaking session on the balcony, and that their son has the intelligence and looks of a toad!  Does that help?
Looks like Crumulis is in dire need of a worthy ruler, and my kingdom is in dire need of expansion. Do you think my aunt would be interested in an alliance to crush them?
