setting.name: The Choir room
setting.description: It is a room with a table in the middle with chairs around it.  There is a closet that contains Choir robes that are long white and green accents.  There is a small keyboard in the corner.
setting.background: The choir room is always filled with music.  Many people like to pass by and listen to hear the songs being sang.

speech: You! Please help me!
Why are you here? What have you done wrong?
I was captured in the most recent battle. I am lucky to still be alive. I have to escape soon! Please tell me... where am I?
You are in the choir room. So you are our enemies! No... I won't help you
Please... for dear god. I must escape. Please what can i do?
Maybe you can plead guilty and surrender to the king. He will spare your life. Our king is noble and honorable!
No. The king will have me executed. Are you crazy?
Don't worry sir... Just tell the secret plan of your king... Our king will understand and you will be released for sure
No. I can't do that.
It is the only way or you will stay here, rotten until you die
Look. I'll get you anything. What do you want in exchange for your help,
I won't betray my king! No... He is the one who raised me... He treated me like his own son!
He doesn't have to know. It wouldn't be betrayal! It would be mercy!
No! My king is my sun and star! I won't betray him!

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Guard... are you hungry?
No, I hunger not when I am on duty, peasant!
I brought plenty of sandwiches. The cook gave them to me to bring.
I am wary of your offer, peasant. Who knows how you could be trying to get past me and steal from the King?
I have no need to steal. The cook likes me and he gives me what is left in the kitchen after the days meals.
I shall abstain for the moment, good sir. What else brings you to this cavern?
Just that. I would assume you are lonely for company in this cavern. It can get cold and dank and make you think you are daft
Hmmmm. It can be, but at least this servant is here, too.
Does she talk much?
Nay, good man, she doesn't.
I didn't think so. She hasn't said a word since I came in.
You are a humorous one, aren't you?
Sometimes quiet from them is more welcome, then going on and on.
Ah, yes. Like we seem to be.

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: Hello, sir Bishop.
Maid! There you are! Bring my my robes. I have a ceremony I need to perform for the King tomorrow, and I do not want to be looking like common peasant filth. Get to it!
I do not have your robes, sir. A thief stole them while I was retrieving some soap. I didn't even see him! Forgive me, sir.

Let God do the forgiving, wench. I do not have time for this. I am a most prized man of God, do you not understand? He has given me the sight to council in His matter, and as such I must be well dressed! Find me replacement garb fitting for court with the King, or do not return to my office.
Sir, I was hoping you could pray with me. I am frightened the thief will return.

Fine, fine, Maid. Dear God, your holiness, you in your infinite wisdom, please protect this maid from thievery and nerdowell. Also, we ask of you that you bring to me a new, fresh set of robes so that I might honor you and serve you to the best of my abilities.... In your name, we pray, amen.
Thank you, Amen.
Now, is there anything else you need? I am a very busy man. God's word does not spread itself.
May I borrow a prayer book?
Yes, but keep it from the thief, will you? They do not print themselves, and the monk who wrote all this down died of the Black Death, so it is quite irreplaceable.
Yes, sir. I will guard it with my life. I will ask permission of the royal seamstress to get the finest robes she has to replace what the thief took.
Good, good. Tell her she best have them to me by sunrise. I have to take council with the king, you know. I haven't the time for idle hands.
Yes sir. I will just take these with me. Is there anything else I can do for you, sir?
Bring me lunch! I must study the Good Book, and doing so on an empty stomach is unwise.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: I am feeling really sick, you need to help me now
My liege! Of course! Would you prefer to go down to the infirmary first?
I cant go there, thats not a royal place worthy of me, your king, you have to bring the medicine to the palace
Of course, m'lord. What seems to ail you?
I  have fever and feel weak, maybe my enemies poisoned me,
Hmm, let me check your pupils. Hard to say, it's rather dark in here. Here, have some water, m'lord.
Im feeling weak, I  think im going to pass out,
King! I need you stay focused, it's going to be my head if we don't get you well!
Ok I will do my best, the kingdom will be lost without me, I bet my enemies know this, keep me alive doctor or we will all die
Alright, I need you to try to stand. I'll hold you up. We have to get you somewhere for examination.
Ok, ok, fine, hold my scepter and call the guards, they need to be by my side
Guards! This way please! We will take your goblet with us and check for harmful poisons.
Ok I will get my revenge, I bet it is poison, being the king involves constant danger
Let's get you right to ensure that you do, m'lord.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Nice view up here, isn't it?
It was well worth the climb to get here, thats for sure!
So, who's the lucky guy or girl?
A mysterious man who sent me a letter, promising a lifetime of gold if I marry him. I am so excited!
Wow, that's certainly an adventure in the making! Wonder who this mystery man is.
I wonder who he is too. He said he's a rich noble of the Kingdom.
Maybe it's the king, if you're lucky! Its been a while since the queen died.
But the King is too old for me! Lord knows the man can't even walk nowadays.
But think about the money! You'd be able to travel and do whatever you want!
Or be locked up in his dungeon for eternity. I hear the King is a strange man...
Strange indeed, although perhaps that applies to everyone.
Indeed, as you can see by my face. I am no ordinary woman; I am an ogre from the swamp!
AHHHHH, YOU FILTHY MONSTER. HOW DARE YOU DECEIVE ME!
I didn't mean to scare you! Please, I am a beautiful soul on the inside.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Oh, how I wish my crops would grow!
Hello farmer. Why aren't your crops growing?
I'm afraid the land just isn't very good. The king allows me to live on it but I just can't seem to profit from it.
Hmm that's unfortunate. Perhaps ask the king for better land
You know his reputation.
Well good luck with that then. Not much I can do for you
What do you do for work?
I am in charge of the most important section of the castle
Which section is that?
Where the royal family resides
Ah, yes of course. Do you think you might put in a word for me?
I will try, but I can't promise anything
You are very kind to even try!
I am not a fan of hugs

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: Rrrooooaaaaarrrrr! What are you doing on my mountain?!
Woah woah woah! Just exploring the outer reaches of the king's realms.
That's what they all say! Then they leave bear traps and such, and come back trying to get me!
Oh, bear, you got me all wrong. I would never trap such a spectacular creature like yourself!
Then why do you have this big stick? Hmmmmm....?
It's to help me up the treacherous terrain. I am not as spry as I once was, you know.
Here - take your stick. But leave my type alone. And not a word of me to the King!
Not a word! Here, are you thirsty?
No, thank you. I drink from the river at the base of the mountain. I had my fill earlier today, of fresh water and fish. I do love nature's bounty!
Bear, would you mind if I lived with you for awhile. I would really love to learn your ways.
Do you have any shenanigans in mind? I really do hate shenanigans!
Not a single one, I just love nature. I feel you have much to teach me.
I can teach you to live like a predator, but you will have to get used to raw meat!
I am certainly willing to try it, but i'm not sure it's good for my stomach.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: It was a nice evening wasn't it?
Aye the jester was funnier than usual, his rhyming was spot on.
Yes, He was on fire tonight. Everyone was laughing!
I am stuffed, was a delicious meal.
would you like your night cloths my love? I really enjoyed the duck.
Thank you my darling.  I found the duck greasy but the fowl was just right.
Do you think it would be silly of me to wear my diamonds to bed. I don't trust those virgins.
Ah my darling I love your suspicious nature.  Let us lay amongst all our jewels tonight.
That sounds divine my love. Will you ask the virgins to bring us some more of that lovely wine we had this evening?
A perfect way to end such a pleasant night.  Well thought of my love.
How does this look. should we add more?
It is perfect darling, just like you.
You are perfect. I love you so much. Thank you for our wonderful life.
Aye, a fine match you turned out to be.
action: put various diamonds in the bed

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Its getting quite cold here sir, are you sure it isn't time to return to the Castle?
Me?  I served in the Ice Drake wars of '72.  I never froze then, and I won't freeze now.  What about you civilian, shivering in your boots?
Sir, I am but trained in agriculture. Such... cold conditions are unlike the warm weather where I have grown up.
Then what is an agricultural advisor doing here in the winter?  Shouldn't you be taking the winter off?
The True King gave me this map to find a rare type of seed that can grow wheat in the winter. I am here trying to create it for him.
That looks like badger-cultist territory to me.  You'll never make it alive.
I have heard myths about them, surely they are not real! Whats that picture in your hand?
It is the only picture I have left of my family.  They were eaten by the Turtle-Folk during their last rebellion.  I failed them.
Such a beautiful family...the Turtle folks are a truly savage bunch. I hope the Lord punishes them with a fruitless harvest!
It may interest you to know that when ground up, turtle-folk make excellent fertilizer.
Is that right? Why that might just be solution to my winter harvest conundrum. Commander, I shall require to bring me the carcass of a turtle-folk.
Well, there's a village over yonder we could raid.  That would net you some two or three hundred carcasses.
If I may, I shall stay back and use a Catapult to destroy their homes. Just what they did to you...
Indeed . . . I like your Agricultural Advisor.  I think I can spare a cohort to fetch your seed in badger-cultist territory.
action: put a tattered map in large green land
give Family Photo to agricultural advisor
give Family Photo to military commander

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Growing season has been great this year!
It has! I've never seen the fields so green and abundant with vegetables. I'll make a fortune after harvest.
Same here! Look at this corn. It's so beautiful. The king is going to be so pleased
Not to mention, we'll be able to store plenty of food away for the cold months. Our kids won't go hungry again this winter!
That's definitely a relief. My son didn't do well last winter. How are your kids these days?
Well, Miranda, my wife, is pregnant again. That's child number 9! Bruce is going to marry his girlfriend, the rest are doing well in school aside from the youngsters. How is your brood?
9! You're definitely crazy. We just have the 3 little ones. Didn't want to press our luck after last year. They're doing well though. My son wants to be a knight
Yes, his name is Percival if I recall correctly. A knight? What an honorable choice!
Yeah need to stay on the king's good side so Percy has a chance to go to knight school. This crop yield should help
And look here... here comes tonight's dinner! Miranda will be thrilled with such a large chicken!
That almost looks big enough to feed your whole family! I assume your wife is a great cook?
Oh, she is! She can make some fantastic foods! How about you bring your family over for dinner tonight?
Yes, that sounds like a great idea. Thank you so much!
You are always welcome. With a harvest like this, we'll have food enough for the whole town.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: My love what do you think of the garden?
Oh, my King, my husband.  It is lovely.  It is so peaceful here; so much life.  Have you seen the rainbow the gods have given us today?
Yes it's almost as lovely as your sparkling eyes. Tell me do you remember when we first met?
I was so nervous.  My parent
Hahaha yes. I don't think your father was too fond of me first

I don't believe he was either but you won him over with your love for me.  My nerves melted and we shortly had our first son.  Then our second! I don't think there is a luckier lady in this fair land than I.
Surely not. No woman could ever compared to my lovely Queen. Strong, bold, daring, but submissive to me. I love it.
All the ladies giggle at me.  But they don't know our love, my King.  It's as pure as these birds we hear singing.
They are just jealous of what we have. Don't let them get to you haha!
Never, my love.  How can I? With this beautiful land and our beautiful sons.
Ah yes! I've been thinking... would you want to try to have a daughter soon?
YES! I would love to have a little princess running around.
Right here in the garden?! Oh my you're bold!
We are only surrounded by what the gods' have given us. Please, my king. Take me now.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Maid, clean up this mess on the table please.
Certainly sire.  I must ask, who is Omamoko?
You mean you have never heard of King Omamoko? He was the first King of this land, he conquered the evil King who ruled all the lands thousands of years ago.
No, they usually don't give peasants any schooling.  What more can you tell me of him?
He was a very kind man. He dreamed of the day where everyone was treated with respect. It is a shame we haven't gotten there yet, I sure have tried.
What have you done to accomplish his dream?
I know it is not much, but I do treat you and the servants with kindness and provide you with plenty of food, yes?
Food yes, but with no wages it seems more like slavery, if you would forgive my bluntness sire.
There is only so much I can do all at once. Our kingdom isn't as rich as it used to be. What if I gave you some time to yourself to go find a part time job for some wages?
Well, I need all sixteen hours a day to get everything cleaned your grace.  I'm not sure what could be spared.
Just take care of the main areas then. There is no need to clean the spare rooms every single day.
Yes sire, thank you ever so much!
You are very welcome. I hope you have good luck. Maybe I should offer the Butler and the other workers the same deal? I'm sure my wife and kids would be happy to take on some of the work around here.
Oh yes, truly you are paving the way towards Omamoko's dream!

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

speech: Good day old man. Have a pint with me?
Surely. What ale will we have today?
The only one they serve funny man.  Let us drink to good health!
Hahaha! Such a kind fireman. Tell me, what made you get into the profession?
I've always loved playing with fire, the chance to wield the flame in battle is a great honor and one that I am lucky to be able to do.
You must have a pretty high risk tolerance!
I have a sworn duty to our sovereign King and Queen to protect their interests.
Do you always agree with the royalties interest, honestly?
It is not my duty to question who they tell me to fight.
It's not, but surely you've had a doubt at one point in your career?
What were you when you were young?
I was a economist. I made sure we made the best decisions financially as a kingdom.
Then you cannot understand what going into battle entails.
I can not, but I'm still curious

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: I suppose you move aside, servant. It's about to get hot in here.
A d...d....d...dragon.
Oh, none of that stuttering please or screaming. It bores me.
What brings you here might dragon? Please don't hurt me. I just do what I'm told and mind my own business.
I'm here for the King's gold. It is my very favorite thing.
The King's gold? The King would never willingly part with his gold. Perhaps you could come back another time? I could tell the King you stopped by.
I don't require his willing agreement, peasant.
Bloodshed is never good. Plus I might never get to see my family again. I haven't seen them in ages as it is.
Oh, I brought them with me. Would you care to see?
Please don't harm anyone Sir Dragon.
See! Look! Aren't I kind?
That couldn't be them. You wouldn't know where they live. It's been so long I don't even know. Please go away Sir Dragon. The castle is closed today.
It will soon be closed FOREVER!
Aaaaaa........

setting.name: Entrance to church
setting.description: The entrance to the church can only be described as a bit scary.  It is overgrown with mosses and weeds.  It has not been taken care of and is a mixture of wood and stone.  It is dirty, and things live here.
setting.background: This was the church that the King attended with his family when they were alive.  They all died under mysterious circumstances and are all now buried in the cemetery.  But now no one comes into this church, it is considered sacred ground.  And there are things that live here, things that are different.

speech: Boo! What are doing here Bandit? I hope you weren't planning on raiding the Church.

Ach, I just came here ta rest a bit, ghostly person.  I... admit I didn't believe th' rumors of this place bein' haunted, but I thought that it might at least keep His Kingliness from followin' me here, aye?  Mind if I... erm... trespass on yer good graces?
Why if thats the case, then you are most welcome to.. trespass for the night. Make sure to keep your distance from the zombies though, he likes eating human brains.
Gah!  I didn't even notice the blighter there, 'e's standin' so still.  Ugh, I should have noticed by the stench though.
Yes, he does smell quite a bit. Sadly, his inside keep leaking all over the place and I have to clean it up with wet moss.
Well, I've used some moss a time or two when the king's guards fer his taxes get a little too cheeky with their blades.  There's worse things one could use, I'd say.
I get a feeling you and the King do not get along very well. Just as well that you came here for a bit of respite.

Well, he don't take too kindly ta me relievin' him of some of his excess coinage, ya see.  But the way I be lookin' at it, tis plenty of coinage ta go around.  And if some of it happens te make its way to me pockets, or other, more deservin' folk, well then...
I think this might be of interest to you then. The excessive coinage you have on your back might be getting a bit heavy.
Eh?  What's this, then?
Its a magical rune that transports you into a different world momentarily. A colorful and painless world filled with riches...
Hm, I don't know.  Gots ta keep me edge, ya know.  Rather not join the likes of you anytime soon, eh? Ha!
Fair enough. Did you hear that? Sounded like footsteps coming up the entryway.
Ach!  I'd best hide - perhaps that zombie there 'll give 'em a turn!

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: How fare you today?  Any sign of the badger-cultists on the river?
I haven't seen any thankfully. How are you on this fine day, Captain?
Fair, not too much of any emotion I suppose.  Take a look through this spyglass, do you see that movement on the river?
I don't see anything yet, but if you have a bad feeling, I trust your judgement. You have more experience than anyone around these parts.
Then summon the rest of the guard, the badger-cultists may be looking to harvest flesh.
I absolutely will right away! Do you think there are many of them? How many men shall I gather?
At least twenty for the initial assault, should buy us time for the rest of the guard to man their stations.
Got it, Captain. In the meantime, take this.
Thank you - have you any experience on the battlefield son?
I'm afraid not. My only experience is here guarding the king. Any advice?
Aim for the eyes, and try to avoid their teeth at all costs.
Got it, Sir. I will do my best.
They're closer - steady, steady.
How close, Sir? More men are on the way.

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Is someone here?
...Well that wouldn't make this any fun at all, would it?...
Please tell me you don't eat bugs. I am going to be King of the Bugs and I can't have anything killing me before my reign even begins.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: I am famished! I wonder what is on the menu today
Me too. I'm real happy the king brought us all around for Fool's day. You know, they used to say king's food would kill peasants.
What is this Fools day you talk of?

They don't have Fools Day where you're from? It's the day where everything goes up on its head. Children play japes with their parents, the jailers let the prisoners go free, you know. All Fool's Day.
What jibberish are you talking about? How much have you had to drink?
Ah, never enough for what I do, friend. Never enough.
I thought I smelled a smell like gasoline coming from you. What is it you like to drink sir?
Well, we only get the time for beer. Keep the still on our property, you know. Cheap when you've got extra barley. But I've a taste for the...foreign spirits. Vodka and such.
Well I think they are just serving food and wine tonight
Unfortunate. Hey, speaking of. In the April Fools' tradition, would you mind if we switched clothes for a bit?
No sir, You go switch clothes with someone else. You fool!
Oh, bother. I'm just joking. But pass me those herbs if you don't want to do my work, I need to get those planted soon.
I think that you should get those herbs yourself. I believe they are yours
You're holding them, my good fool.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: I did not expect to find you here of all places. You have no business in the King's personal quarters.
I'm sorry son. I came looking for you. I only came to tell you how much I love you and how proud of you I am.
I do not wish to speak to you. You abandoned me on the streets and fueled your love for ale instead of taking care of me.
I can't believe how ungrateful you are. You would have never made it where you are right now without my guidance!
I see that you are still chasing your love for drinks judging by your movement. Did you come to give me this?
I came to give it to you to remind you of where you came from. Even though you are in the king's quarters now, it is important that you remember your roots!
The old tea pot... I remember Mother used to make use honey pot drinks for us every morning.
Yes son. I'm all that's left of your family now. I know I can be argumentative at times but I only do it to get through to you.
Thank you father. I understand that I used to be an unruly child growing up. I will keep this heirloom for my children.
That means a lot to me, son! So, tell me about your new role the King has given to you so I can show off about you to my friends from the village.
I am the King's principal advisor. I bet you did not expect that I would get his far. Will your friends be impressed?
If they're not impressed I'll make them impressed! Just kidding! Since you're an expert, what do these carvings on the wall mean?
They are mystical patterns that only the King understands. He does not share the decipher secrets with me.
Believe in yourself and you will gain the king's confidence, son! Make yourself indispensable. That is my advice to you!
action: steal family heirloom from his father

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Hey there rat. What are you doing in here?
I lost a piece of cheese I was carrying... I came back to look for it.
Sorry I don't have any to offer. You could ask the king but he'd probably want you killed.
Here it is! See I told you I lost it here. UMMMMM
Looked like it was some good cheese. You steal it from the kitchen?
No sir! One of the guests threw it to me.
Oh I don't care if you do. I do it sometimes as well. This king here sucks.
Oh, I only wait for scraps and bite sailors that try to run me off
Haha I'd like to see that some time. Do you like being free or do you wish you had a permanent home?
I like being free... there are so many that throw scraps to me. Well you just might see me bite one today.
Aren't you afraid of all the feral cats trying to get you?
I have to keep low and run fast.... the sailor's help with that, by trying to kick me.
Sounds like the sailors aren't very nice. You can take this arrowhead and use it on them
Thank you sir! That just might come in handy in more ways than one

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Good morning.
Hello there.
So are we all in agreement on the Sunday morning sermon?
I thought we were still deciding? What is the plan?
Oh of course that would be up to you your grace. I just would like you to include charity in the sermon.  I have been collecting for the poor and the alms have been down.
Ah, yes. Helping the needy is why we are here.
I am so happy we can all work together for the glory of god and the glory of the kingdom.  Has the King sent his thoughts for this Sunday?
The King hasn't sent me anything in months now. I hope he is doing well. We shall pray for him this Sunday.
Wait...what...the King hasn't sent us his thoughts. This is terrible.  I will go to the castle and check on the royal family's well being.  I am sorry to say I have neglected them of late.
That would be great. I heard he was sick a while back, but thought he was doing better by now.
I will go post haste to the castle this day.  If I find the King well I will ask for his thoughts on Sunday and will report back to you.
Here, take this with you. If he is ill, say a prayer for him.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello child. Are you taking good care of the royal horses?
As best as I can, Your Highness. How are you today?
Very good. Say how would you like to become a squire?
A squire? That sounds fun! What does it involve, Sir?
Doing whatever my knight needs and taking care of his horses and following him into battle
Thank you so much! I'm really excited. What do I need to do to get started?
Just learn all you can about the horses from the stable hands. The knight will otherwise get you what you need
Thank you, Sir. How can I ever repay you?
You can repay me when you make it to knighthood and follow me into battle
Absolutely! May I ask why you chose me?
No reason really. You look like you work hard
Thank you. I will do everything I can to make you proud.
You're welcome. Good luck to you
Thank you

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: King, I'm afraid I have some horrible news..
What is that is so horrible?
Your wife, the queen.. she has confessed to some horrible sins. Sit down on that bench and I will tell you everything.
My wife? How could that be?? My wife is dead!
My dear king, what are you talking about? Are you in delirium? Your wife is currently visiting your brother in Nopel.
No I am too old! My wife is dead you fool. It is you that is delirious
If you say so, my king.. What are you doing in the courtyard?
I am resting you fool! Do you not know anything. You try to spread rumors about my dead wife! I should have you arrested
Hah, don't make me laugh. You know I am trusted and I have too much power to be arrested.
You have no power! You are told what to do by the pope! You are so funny. Just let me raise my hand and the guards will be here lickety split!
My poor king, you are getting weaker every day. Are you even able to raise your old hand?
Cardinal, you overstretch boundaries! I do not believe the pope would like you being disrespectful and treasonous
I have done some terrible things that I will bury with me. I do not care about the pope.
So you are treasonous, not only with your king, but to the pope. Who has made you so mad that you would want to end your life by a noose.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello sir! What'll you have?
The usual. It has been a particularly tiring night for me. I had a bad run in with some lowly bandit.
Oh my, hope he didn't hurt you!
He caught me by surprise and elbowed me in my stomach! Because of that, forgive me if I am not able to eat the entire duck meat tonight
Wow! That is intense. would you like a song to help you relax? I've taken up singing to help pass the time!
Certainly. Dance my lovely lady. Distract me from the horrible smell inside these Barracks
A rainy day, a cold knight, took a hit, that didn't have much bite. And when he had his go, well he gave that bandit a long throwwwww.
Well done, you move with the grace of a humming bird. I sure taught that bandit a lesson; he's locked up for life in the dungeon!
Good! Do you think i'd make a good guardsman?! I'm pretty tough! Grr!
Easy there now lass! It is heavy and you might hurt yourself with it. Let me help you.
Oh come on, scared I might be your commander one day! Haha!
By the King's name, you sure look strong in that armor. I am sure you will make a mighty fine warrior like me one day.
I hope to one day leave this place, and do something more with my life, do you think I could pass as a guard and sneak away? Defeat bandits and thieves? Protect the king?!
Those are dangerous dreams. Being a hunter of bandits is no easy task. The world out there is very cruel and unforgiving!

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: My King, good day to you sir!
Ah my favorite diplomat. Do you bring good news?
I do...our rival King will accept an alliance...but for a price, I am afraid.
What is the price?
I'm afraid they want 500 florins...and your daughter to be married to their Prince.
500 florins i don't mind, but my only daughter that's too much to ask. I want her to be able to marry anyone she pleases.
I'm afraid they said the price was non-negotiable...but perhaps there is some way around it.
We could always destroy their kingdom.
That wasn't what I had in my, my Liege...but you are the King. How many troops do we have on hand that can be ready within the week?
Two thousand five hundred of the royal army could be spared, but going to war would look terrible. I want my people to have a king they adore.

Whilst not actually attacking them...perhaps a threat could serve well enough to make their King back off. Or, we could lie and tell them your daughter has already been betrothed and that it would be a sacred offense to break that arrangement.
What would you recommend? You have many years of experience under your belt.

Well, whilst I do not doubt our army's strength compared to theirs...you are right in keeping favor with your subjects. I would then prefer the latter, but a simple white lie. Should do the trick. Their King seems gullible enough.
Let's see to it. I want you to craft a letter and have three horsemen deliver it to the goa kingdom!

setting.name: The Brush Den
setting.description: The entryway to the brush den is made of arched bushes and various plants, as is the ceiling and walls. The inside is furnished with seats made of plant roots that have grown together, and a table made of wood adorned with flowers and wooden cups and plates. A small vine dangles with a glowing floor from the middle of the ceiling that lights the room dimly. Three small beds lay in one corner of the room made of interlaced grass and leaves.
setting.background: The fae inhibit this small cot hidden in the brush of the forest. These small creatures slowly add new brush and decorations to their den as they scavenge the forest for food and supporting their animal friends. The small den lies just a short distance east of the lake with the door facing the lake. One might easily miss it with a quick glance as many bushes and glowing flowers are outside of it.

speech: Crud! Just my luck, I've crossed paths with another predatory human!
I am not a predator. I am a wizard, we like all things magical.
Yeah, you like magical things so you can enslave them and use them to give power to your spells and wizardly tools...I'm a fae, but I'm not as naive and trusting as others like me.
That's not true. I can make myself invisible. One of your faery friends helped me gain this power. I even helped her out in return.
What a humorous euphemism! Let me guess, you want to offer me "help" as well?
Not at all. I was just admiring your beauty. Your kind always did fascinate me. I would never hurt a faery.
Well if you're going to stay in the Brush Den, I can at least make sure you have no power to harm the gentle creatures of the forest by removing your tools of oppression.
Of course. I would not what to harm any creatures in the Brush Den.
Remove all of the items! And tell me, why did you come here?
I can here to meditate for a while. I need to channel the earth to protect the kind souls in this land.
What danger do you speak of that threatens the fae?
The Kingsmen in the castle. He wants to capture your kind to use your powers to protect his land.
Aren't you but a servant to the King and the Kingsmen? What happened to my faery friend that you helped?
I am not servant to the evil King. I helped her escape from the King. You must trust me, I have seen your future in my crystal ball.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello king. I brought you this book as a sign of good will.
Why are in my bedroom? This is my private chamber.
Did you forget that you invited me to see your book collection that you keep in your rooms?
Oh.. did I now?
See this is the book I promised.  Now can we talk about the wedding?
I've been having terrible headaches and memory loss of late. Please catch me up to speed.
My daughter and your son will be wed.
Is that so. When did we agree upon this?
The union will bring more wealth to your kingdom and this union will bring security to my kingdom.
Are you trying to take advantage of me king.
No sir.  Let's invite our queens into the conversation.
My queen is on the diplomatic journey currently. She will be back in a few days.
But King I don't wish to upset you but she is currently in the garden with my queen. See there they are now. Look.
What.. since when?

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Oh how i miss you grandfather..
Please accept my warmest hug. Your grandfather is a great man
Thank you. He truly was. We all miss him.
He is watching you from up above. I think he will be proud that you become a good man
I hope so. He loved these flowers. He wanted to grow them on feilds.
I'll clean up the dirt... I remember I used to cook beef stew for him. It was his favorite food
Oh i love that stew. I hope to enjoy it again sometime.
I will bring it over to your house the next time I am in town. Do you want to clean your hands? I know the graveyard is so dirty. It was full of grass and weeds before I came here
Yes, thank you. I wish we could trim these trees to let sunlight shine on the grave.
We can do it next time, son. How is your family business?
It is hurting with pa. He was so good with customers. I am struggling.
Wish I could help. All I know is cooking and cooking
Well there is no doubt you mastered both.
As long as the king is keen to my cooking, I will be alright. Hey I heard the king is going to make a new law. I hope it won't affect your business.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: I'm sick of this! How can the king just pretend our lives are disposable! I'm sick of fighting a war because of his greed!
Woah woah woah, what happened soldier?
My team was slaughtered in an instant. The orcs proved far too troubling.
When they breached the western wall last month, I was about to be executed before some knights came in and saved us, we weren't prepared, they moved in so fast!
This isn't fair! That king should get off his high horse, and fight his own war he started. The orcs never bothered us still he provoked them.
I understand brother. For now we need to just stand strong. Princess Richard is due to return with his men in 3 weeks time, then we can take the fight to them!
3 weeks... I don't think we can make it for one!

If we give up hope, we won't make it all. It's hard, I know, but we need to stick side by side. do not count on the king, count on the man next to you, because if you have faith in him, and he in you, we will make it through this.
Such charamisa you have... A-alright! I'll pull myself together!
We will hold this position, against all odds, and if we die, you can believe we are taking a whole army of Orcs with us!
Yes! I'll make sure  before I go down I take out 30 of them myself!
Woah! a little excited there! Haha! Save it for the Orcs.
Ahh! I'm sorry! I'm just full of burning passion!
Let's go on a patrol, maybe get the chance to take the fight to them!

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Welcome child. Did you find the toy you were looking for?
No sir.. I'm so hungry.. please sir.
Hungry?! We can't have a hungry child in the throne room. Come sit by this cushion and I will order you a chicken or two!
Th-th-hank you sir. I can't find my parents either..
That is most heart wrenching to hear. Where did you last see them Child?
They were in the village, but over night they disappeared. I came here for guidance. One of your advisers brought me here.
I see, the advisor did the right thing bringing you here. We shall find your parents . Tomorrow I will send a mission to the village to ask around.
Thank you so much!!
No need for thanks child. It is my duty to serve my people, even if they are below me!
You're the best king ever
Whats inside that bag in your hands though, Child?
It's food... I was so hungry. I had to take what I could...
I am sorry I suspected that you stole something luxurious from my throne room. How foolish of me!
I.. I would never sir!!

setting.name: Cactus Field
setting.description: Towering, withered cacti stand their ground as they have for centuries before. There are so many cacti that no one is able to see through the dense field. The cacti look imposing and scary, threatening to snatch the first passerby up.
setting.background: No one knows why the cacti are in this location in such number nor why they look so ominous. Villagers claim that there lies treasure at the heart of this field of death. No one dares ventures inside, since their clothes and skin would be torn to shreds.

speech: Oh why must I go through such misfortune!
W-what's wrong, human person?  ...you haven't come here for some rare iguana meat, have you?
No I'm not looking for iguanas. At least not today. It is our village, we have been made out to be bad. all because we like to explore the forest that we are forbidden to go to
Forest?  What strange word is that?  And why should you not be allowed to go where you please?
It has been so ordered by the king. But we still go and explore
You let another human tell you where you can and cannot go?  How strange... is it dangerous?  Is this.. king fellow... especially wise for you to listen to him?
I suppose he is wise that is why he is king. Maybe there are magical creatures in the forest who knows
Have you not been there yourself?  And how is it that you came to this place?  Humans truly are strange with their loping ways...
I have been in the forest and once there I decided to keep exploring. But this is very treacherous land
Yes, mind the spikes.  Your hands look very soft, and your fingers quite fat, so I imagine they might get stabbed easily.
Yes those needles do look sharp!
I hope you brought water with you too, because there's none to be had in the direction you're going!
I have brought plenty in my canteen. I will return to my village before the day is up
Very good... mind you tell them not to eat any iguanas!  Or... I shall be quite cross...

setting.name: High Priest Chamber
setting.description: Many books and religious idols litter the chamber. A squat chair with a high back sits at an ornate desk. A cup of holy water lies on the desk. Bookshelves line the entire chamber with religious texts.
setting.background: Many a high priest has taken residence in this chamber. It is where the priest works from and studies from. When he is not giving a service, he is in this chamber, poring over ancient religious texts, looking for anything he can use to give meaning to his religion. It smells of elderberries.

speech: What was that noise? Is someone here?
It is I, your father, back from the dead!
What? Father?
Yes!  Wooooooo!  Bet you didn't expect that son!
I have missed you since you died! I need you!
Hey!  You fell for it!  I was just kidding.  You should have seen the look on your face though!  It was like you had just seen a ghost!
That was not funny on my side, but I guess it was on yours!
Sorry, unfinished business you see.  I bet the devil that I could make the King laugh.  If I won, I would get gold, women, or fame.  If he won, I would sped my afterlife teasing people.
I guess you got the short end of the stick!
Well, I always did like telling jokes, and you know what they say - the King can only flay you alive and feed you screaming to his dogs once.
Hahahaha.... I guess you got away from being fed to the dogs
Oh no, I was definitely fed to the dogs.  It was not at all pleasant.
Oh what a terrible way to go!
Yes, I would certainly not recommend it to be honest.  He's still the King now in case you were wondering.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello there!
Nice to meet you here in the church. Aren't these pews something?
They are marvelous, I am a follower of the knights, we were hoping you'd let us rest here for a bit!
Certainly, certainly! I'm one of the founders of GloopdeGloo. Are you familiar with it?
I am not, but I am very interested in learning more. the knight's I'm with are from King Egbert's village, going to hunt down a rogue night who has stolen from the king!
Is King Egbert going after Ragnar Lothbrok? Here, put these shoes up.
I hope not, that man is mad! He is going after one that was his own. But no longer. The knights i'm with are a bit rough, i should warn you.
Hmm, the "rough" knights will be careful here in the church, won't they? Otherwise they must stay outside. Let me put these clothes out of the sack and put them on.
They will. but if they feel challenged they will act, as will I. I have no respect for those who do not like these men. I will keep my armor on at all times to show my pride!

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Well hello there, guest. What brings you here?
Why to enjoy the ocean, of course!
room_objects: a A gigantic and lavish marble pier
a A gigantic and lavish marble pier

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Time for battle!
Against who?!
Against the foul Badger-Cultists!  I fear they may be hiding in this very tower!
Oh no, there's been no unusual people in here!
Are you in league with them?
I am not! I am a servant of these people of the town that your king rules over.
Then you are not protecting a cannibal cult?
Oh no! I do not get myself into such things.
Then you won't mind if I slaughter every cultist I find in that tower?
If you find some, but you won't.
If I find none, I will assume you assisted them in escaping, and will gut you like the coward you are.
This is so tower of the enemy!
You shall come with me and lead the path, I don't want your friends ambushing me.
You do not listen do you? The only friends you will find in here are friends of you too. You are insulting.

setting.name: Beside temple entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the temple is quite hidden - shrouded by many trees and shrubs. One wouldn't even think to give it a second glance, as the stone that was used to create the entrance is worn down. The textures and characters that once adorned the entrance are memories of the past.
setting.background: The temple entrance is how one would gain access to the temple. It is very hard to find and many archaeologists try to find it every day. The king has a reward of one hundred sheep to the first person to find its location.

speech: What are you do hiding at the temple entrance?
Well, thank you for noticing my sneakiness sir. What makes you think I should answer to you?
Nothing sir.
Oh, oh, oh, no. You do not steal from me good sir, I steal from YOU!
What do you think you are doing here?
Simply scouting out my next mission, I should ask you the same thing!
I must warn the King before you steal all his gold.
The king is a great friend of mine fool, he has requested to speak today about a mission of plunder in the neighboring village.
Oh great. I traveled to the wrong kingdom today. This is the land with the crook of a King.
How dare you speak of our great king that way?!
He is not my King. Crooked Kings are why I travel from place to place.
Crooked he is not! He simply knows where to take and where to give...
Stealing from the people to give to himself is not the type of King I would want to live under.
To himself? Unlikely the king needs any for himself, he is magnanimous with his realm!

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: Oh, hello there cute little mouse, YOU'LL BE MY FRIEND!
Hello, old maniacal man, I do long for the company of another.  Tell me, why are you in this dreadful place?
I came here for the view years ago but somehow I've gotten locked in!
I see, how did you happen upon this place? I for one heard there are no cats here
Well I came here looking for my marbles, the king's guard said they'd be up here. I'm still looking! CATS YOU SAY?! WHERE?
CATS?!?! I was told there were none here!  Please, hide me on your person! Protect me from the cat!
I've got you pal! We'll escape this tower alive!
Eek! Not so rough! May I call you Lenny?
THAT'S MY NAME! Oh dear heaven's it's been so long I'd forgotten...
You must be starving down here.  Please take this cheese friend, it will give you strength for our journey.
Of course, of course. Such a sweet, kind mouse. EGADS A SPIDER!
Do not worry, he doesn't seem to be bothering anybody.  Should he attack I will stop him!
Such a brave mouse, I shall recommend you for a medal of honor to the king myself! Oh heavens, we really should plan our escape - any ideas?
Well, you appear to be shackled to the wall so we must find a key somewhere.  Have you noticed any keys around by chance?
action: give cheese to an old maniacal man

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Halt! Who goes there!
I am the king's architect. I am planning out how to add to the church.
Ah, very well then.  Sorry to startle you, I was put on guard duty today!
It is nice of you to protect our town's church. It is a very ancient building you know.
I know, it has been here as long as I can remember! Such a beautiful church.  What are your plans for it?
I plan on fixing up the walls so they stay strong, and adding another room here in the front entrance. I wouldn't want to destroy any of the existing structure.
Ah, I see. Have you done any other work for the king?  How can we trust you with suych an important project?
Yes, I have. I have made many improvements to the castle, and before that, the shops in town. I am very careful with my work.
You did those improvements to the castle?!  Those were brilliant, you are definitely the man for this job.
Thank you for noticing my hard work. You know that new building in town? That was my last project.
It's hard not to notice, you really brought new life to the old thing.  I apologize, I have not seen your new shop yet.  I don't get out much!
I must say it is my best work yet. You should go see it when you get the chance.
Where is it located? I may go with some of my army buddies from the nearby barracks.
By the market and blacksmith. You can't miss it.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: I love the sound of my hammer beating on the armor
its because of guys like you that we are kept safe
It's also because of my father getting killed using faulty armor, that made want to make the best!
both the knight and i think you are doing a fine job.
What is I can do for you today?
I need some super cool armor, the king wants us to go into battle any minute
Well i can't make it in a minute or two... why did not come in a fort night ago
that crazy king of ours, never can make up his mind. one minute its peace, next minute its plunder.
I have some pieces made, but you would have to see if they fit. Here try this on
This is exactly what i was looking for, with it i will be invincible
I am glad it fits! It will definitely keep you protected!
im sure it will, time to invade !!!!!!
Is there anything else you need?
my horse needs armor, what do you have for him?

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

I've come here seeking ingredients for my tinctures. I've heard there is some forbidden ivy growing outside this mansion.
What is these tinctures you speak of?
The ones I am working on help repair the moods of those who are melancholy.
Oh how wise is that of you! How do you use it?
It is smeared upon the soles of the feet before bed. It's said it works by morning. Do you know of someone who suffers from foul moods?
I do sometimes. I get so lonely and sad.
Ah - perhaps this can help you. Also, is this your divining rod?
It is indeed! Why do you ask?
I was just curious. It's not often that one comes across a divining rod sitting outside a mansion. It seemed random so I thought perhaps it was yours!
Ah yes, when I am not opening doors for the king, I am finding valuable treasures.
Delightful! And how did you come to be the royal key holder?
It was passed down to me by my father!
Just as my mother before me was the wise woman in the village!
