setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Wow! This is a grand place to play. Thank you sire for inviting me to play here
I appreciate your awe, but I called you here today to play music for my court, not to make conversation.
Excuse me your highness, but when are the people due to come and enjoy my music? They are not here yet
The guests will not arrive until noon tomorrow, but I wanted to personally ensure that your music was good enough for the upper-class and royalty I will be hosting.
Do you not remember interviewing me 2 weeks ago and that is why I am here. You cordially invited me and you said that you would pay me well! Do you not remember?
I remember clear and well, but I can just as easily go back on our deal. I have asked for a demonstration now, and that is exactly what I expect from you.
Well I have another gig in the kingdom not far from here and they will pay. and keep their word. I'm going to go now
If you leave here now, I will have your hands severed so that you may never play another instrument in your life!
Do what you will, but I believe that is not in your best interest seeing that you need a musician
I'm sure I could find another musician who plays twice as well as you, and for half the cost too!
And that is why I heard you have not had a party in years! You are the most unkind king in the land. There are better and kinder kings around.
What do you know of ruling a kingdom, bard? Kindness does not rule an empire and keep law, an iron fist of order does!
But kindness does make people want to come to your parties and share in your fine love of people

You have come into my castle and insulted me, even though I was going to provide you with pay and lodging for the night. My patience is at it's end now, and I suggest you leave before I have you killed where you stand.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: King! What are you doing here??
Out of my way! I'm here, if you must know to ask for help with infiltrating and enemy.
Why is a foool here?
I could ask you the same, he is in the sewers you reside in. Leave now, fool!
This is my home! I will not be pushed out by some human!
Then you shall help me with my task. I need some information that I think you could get for me.
What is this information...
There's been talk of a neighboring king discussing a raid on my kingdom. I need to know if it's true, so I can prepare. No one shall take my land! I offer compensation.
I can easily infiltrate a kingdom, but with the plague going around, people kill rats on first sight. I will need more.
I give you my scepter..that should be plenty enough. Plus, your home will be safe.
Ok, I will do it.
Thank you so much. I will be return in a few days time. I hope to hear good news.
Ok, so long king.
Don't betray me, or it'll be your life that you pay with.
action: give a crystal ball to fat rats

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Hello, can you assist me in a favor?
Maybe. Are you going to rob me?
I intend on robbing the king! I despise him so I need a route from this underground crypt to his castle from below.
Oh I can do that. With the king distracted I can look for new bones
Perfect. You promise not to rat me out?

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Let's take a look and see what is bothering you.
It's my hoof, the back one on the left. It just feels painful when I trot.
Would you please raise your foot for me? You sure are a majestic stead. The King knows his horses.
Ouch! It hurts when you move it like that.
That's not good.
You're not going to send me to the glue factory, are you?
Never. I love horses and all animals. I couldn't do that to any animal.
Oh, good! Please tell me, what is wrong with my hoof?
The good news is it will heal on its own.
That's very good news! I think it may be because I stepped on that scorpion the other day on the edge of the desert.
Let me take another look then. You didn't mention that.
I forgot. I'm an old horse. My memory is not what it used to be.
It's not infected. There doesn't seem to be any poison in your foot.
Good, good! So I'll be able to march in the King's parade this weekend?

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Please refill this with more ale
We are out of ale, sir. The bar and the kitchens are running low on food.
How can this be? My great kingdom soul dhave plenty of food and drink for its king
We are indeed running low. Suppliers are scared to deliver here because there is a rumored attack on the kingdom!
Why am I only hearing of this now? Clearly this soldier is not doing his job. Would you like to be my new personal assistant? I need better information and you seem like the person for the job
I would love to be promoted to such! I cannot read though, so you cannot expect me to read or write anything.
Well you were able to get information that I did not have without those skills. I'm sure you can find someone to do it for you until we can get you trained.
I agree! We should keep it secret around this village though so people can trust me with information.
Sounds like a plan. Do you know where the attack is coming from?
From the village over! They have been quietly working and sheltering in some nearby buildings.
Can you tell the army to gather? I think we'll attack the village in the morning. If we take the fight to them they'll never expect it
Of course! Will they listen to one like me?
Take this with you and they will have no choice
I will indeed take this and tell them to prepare for an attack!

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: I can't wait until we get to take over the world, starting with the King!
Well how would you do that stuck in here?
Check out how sharp this is.
Well it is a sword...
I'm going in for the attack.
Aww shucks I dropped it.
What is wrong with you?!
What is wrong with you, I'm just sitting here and then you start going on about nonsense. I just want to eat some crumbs.
You're small enough to get to the lock, go over and free us.
...Are you crazed or something? -leaves the cell-
Get back here and unlock this cell!
I think I will just stand outside here, first you assume I am some part of your plan then you attack me. Now you want to make demands, how rude.
You forget that I am much larger and stronger than you. You are lucky I have been sparing you and not just flat out squashing you.
I outside the cage...why flail against the bars hoping for something that won't happen.

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: I love to snack on people, but for some reason I can't bite you!
Yes, because I am a ghost spirit of a great warrior who had fallen in battle. If you are hungry for a snack, there is grass and weeds next to you.
Grass? Weeds? I need blood! I'll bite humans, or animals. Even, if I'm really desperate, a bird. But not grass or weeds!
Well I guess you're out of luck here. What brings you out here to my fountain?

Searching for dinner. I like it when it's moist out, so on dry days I prefer not to hunt. But it's been dry so long, I had no choice but to come out. Normally there are animals about, but it's eerily quiet tonight.
Yes, I prefer it nice and quiet. You are a brave little bug hunting these grounds considering this graveyard is the most eerie one in the land.
I'm not afraid of ghosts, even you! I am, however, afraid of starving, which might happen if I don't eat soon.
I think I may have an idea, guess what it is?
What is it?
The king in the castle is about to eat and I will try to haunt him. Hopefully, he will get scared and release his hounds outside to patrol and you might be able to suck their blood!
You would do that for me?! That would be delicious! And then I could stay here and keep you company.
Of course. Nothing is guaranteed but I can try. Give me one second.
*whistling* Waiting for my new friend, the ghost... waiting for my feast on dog blood ... gonna be so full tonight! *whistle*
He was so scared! He thinks he is being hunted by demons and summoned his knights around the castle. They have no armor on right now so you should be able to feast on human blood!

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Ready soldier!  The badger cultists will storm the wall any moment!
I am ready, but sorry did you say badger cultists!?
Oh yes, very dangerous.  They like to bite.
Why are they attacking us?
Because they are hungry and think we will make good sacrifices to their god!
Alright then. My sword is rather useless here in this hole. I guess I should pick up a bow
Aim for the eyes, the limbs will just make them angrier.
Will do, hopefully we win. I don't want to be eaten by badgers
No, me neither.  I hear they start with the fingers and toes first, then the move on to . . . other places.
Gross
Well, they're not called the badger-happy-fun-time-club.
Perhaps not. We must protect our land and king!
FOR THE KING!
Do you think we are winning??

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: I wonder... I'm so hungry.  Maybe if I crushed this rock and cooked it I might get some feeling of fullness in my stomach at least...
Take the fruit off the bush there!
Fruit?  Where?!
There is some little ones growing there.
You mock me, stranger, I see no fruit to be had.  Not that I'm surprised - the king has decreed that fruit be only for those of Noble Blood.  Although I'd risk the noose, even so...
I did not mock nor deceive you! A bush is better than a rock to eat
Hm, well I shall content myself with this... slightly moss covered rock.  But why comes a swimmer to this place?  Are you from the swamps just beyond this place?
I come to ponder after a long swim!
Here?  It seems an odd spot.  Whence do you come from?
I come from inside the palace. I am the country's swimmer for the olympics.
The... the what?  Is this some sort of nobles' fete?  A new type of tournament?
It is indeed. The best of the best compete with other countries for top three ranking.
I've naught heard of this before.  Can anyone enter?  Tis there a prize to be had?  Perhaps food?
You are only chosen to enter. Showcase your skill!

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: Hey, you!!!
Please I'm innocent! You have to believe me!
That's not what your uniform says. Tell me the truth, are you an escapee or were you just released?
I... I was just released! Yes this morning! I just needed to write a letter that's why I'm here, haha..
Ok, I believe you. I can't arrest you anyway! I am a guard in the royal army and I work for the king himself only.
Oh that's a relief! What are you doing here anyway?
This is where I to to turn in the records of my shifts!
Oh, I must be in the wrong place then I best be going!
I am
Whatever do you mean?
Hot diggity dog! I am tired!
Well i better let you rest then, I'll be seeing you around. Send my regards to the king!
I am a guard in the royal army.
Right... Don't work so hard!

setting.name: Reception area
setting.description: The building itself is ordinary in appearance and is somewhat foreboding.  It is surrounding by a dense fog and high grass.  Sometimes, one can hear whispers in the wind.
setting.background: This is a plain building where business matters of the graveyard are conducted.  Peasants and royalty alike come here to make deals to bury their loved ones in the graveyard.

speech: What the heck happened? Why are these people eating each other?
Brraaaaaawwaaaaiiit!  I... I have control.... but only... only for a moment
Is there some type of disease? My god, where are all of the people?
Tis I.... Jonas... your graaaandfaather!  I... I need to warn you of what is to come.  But do not get too close to me!
Grandpa! Why are you eating that little girl'
I have... no control!  Even now I hunger for... for... but no!  I will... I must... no, *you* must warn... the king!  Aaah, the hunger!
What? I can't understand you grandpa. Let me get closer to you.
Nooo, get back, boy!
You bit my arm! What is wrong with you. Do you have rabies? get away from me.
Ah, no! Ah, me lad... I'm.. so... sorrbrrraaaains!
I feel a little funny. Everything is getting a cloudy. It's almost as if....
Sorry there... you're ... you're one of us now, lad... one of us...
My god those brains smell delicious!
They are lad... that they are...
action: give a sleeping bag to zombies

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello there tax agent.
Hi, and thanks for meeting me. Is this the dock which has been serving as a tax haven?
It would seem to be so, that is the word I got.
It must be judging by the strange look of this place. We must catch these tax thieves.
I appreciate your help in the matter.
Here, write the names of all the towns people that have used this dock in the past few weeks.
I do believe this list covers the ones I am aware of.
Good work, the King spares no mercy to those who fail to pay their taxes and try to escape the Kingdom!
I would hope not, damn those law breakers.
You must find them so we can punish them and collect their overdue taxes. Such actions can not be allowed to go unpunished.
What should we do with the lot?
Bag them and send them in chains to the King's Court, and seize their gold as well.
I might need some help moving such a large bunch.
Here is a bag full of money, use it to pay for additional police and get all the help you need.
action: give ink to some kind of police
give bag to some kind of police

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Hey there neighbor! How are things going today?
It's a poor life we peasants lead. I hunger for bread and an opportunity to work.
I can teach you how to catch mice. They're pretty tasty you know.
Ew. I don't think I'm quite that desperate.
Suit yourself. Do you have any skills that can help you get work?
I have but my hands and a willing heart.
Where have to tried to find work? Did you ask the farmer if he needed any help?
Nay, there's no use in asking while the king keeps us down as he does.
So if you don't try to find a job, how are you ever going to get a job?
What do you know about having a job?
I eat the mice in the barn so we don't get diseases on the farm. That's my job.
And you get paid, do you?
I get to live here in the barn. The farmer's wife gives me a saucer of milk and, of course, I get to eat the mice.
That seems like a pretty sweet deal.

setting.name: Clearing
setting.description: Few trees surround the area.  There's a low section of the grass on the floor along with some stone boulders.
setting.background: This is an area where there are few trees, allowing sunlight to come through.  Animals take advantage of this area by basking in the sun.

speech: I need your help animal, the Kingdom is falling!
What can I help you with, King?
I must... find a fine, meaty duck before sunset or my wife the Queen will have my head!
Well I am a forest creature myself, I'm not quite sure how I can help. I've never seen a duck before.
Ohh thats a shame. Then I need to find something else to eat for dinner.
There are plenty of wild boar in the forest. I know where they like to hide. I can show you.
Please do, I feel rather exposed in the Clearing with such few trees to hide behind.
Me too. The other creatures would love to eat me. Just like I enjoy eating the rabbits.
I wouldn't mind eating rabbits myself. Do you have any?
Not on me, but I can easily catch another!
Here, use this. Its a powerful tool to help you catch one faster.
Thanks, but I can't carry a sword and run at the same time. If I help you, will you tell all your people to stop trying to catch me? I wouldn't taste very good myself.
I will outlaw it once I get back to my Throne. No one shall touch such a previous animal as you!
Thank you, kind King. The rabbits like to play by the boulders at the edge of the clearing. Let me go get you one.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Whooaaaa too much of a crowd of people for me
Not for me! Perfect time to do evil.
Sounds like fun. I barely have enough to eat!
Fun? Do you not fear me...
I do not. The king looks down on me and I cannot find a job to help feed and clothe me
Oh, how sad! Maybe you should join me in my wrongdoing
Do you get any money from doing it?
I gain everything for it!
Coin? I must have coin!
Yes! You can get coins directly or sell items you take
Sounds like a plan! I'm in!
You must steal, destroy, and murder. Do you understand?
I do... but I'm not sure about the murder.
Even if it means saving yourself?

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: -scitters around the prison floor-
Ew! A filthy spider! What are you doing here?
This is a prison?
I specifically told the guards to kill any spiders here.
Seems a little over the top considering where we are.
You do not understand, I will not have creatures like you in my castle, no matter if it is the throne room or the dungeons.
A bit of a grumpy king are you not, I don't even eat the bugs I catch cause I am a nice guy.
How bout you start eating some more bugs then, then I'll think of letting you go.
So all you want is for me to eat bugs?
Yes, keep the dungeons clean.
I will do what I can then.
Thank you, spider.
I'm just glad to not have anyone trying to kill me.

setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

Yum Yum *gulps it up in one bite*
Awe, you are so cute when you eat.  Here, you can have the princes plate. Looks like he won't be showing up to dinner, again.
Woa Boy, this lady always surprises me. First she yells at me then she gives me a whole plate.
You know I can't stay mad at you.  Just stop bringing dead things into the royal chamber when I am with the king!  It always ruins the mood!
*Nuzzles up to the queen*

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

character: a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.

a child lost from his mother.
speech: Hey there, child! What are you doing by this dead and desolate pond?
I'm lost and dont know what to do!
Where is your mother boy? You can't be out here with this dead animals. You'll get sick or worse!
We got separated on our way back from the fresh pond over yonder, some men got in the way and I ran for it
Oh dear, I remember when I was but a wee peasant. I lost my mother too. Life is not fair for us unfortunate. Where is your home, boy?
My home is in the Land of Greece, Odin makes it a tradition for his people to learn the ways of survival. What do you make of this footprint?
Aye, in our land we are born indebted to the corrupt king. I was going to ask you the same, boy. I thought these might be the men that went off with your mother.
those are the men
Really? I wonder if they are same men that take 90 percent of my crops every year. And these god forsaken, insects. Come on, kid. We're going to go find your mother.
shall we take the horse or nay?
Aye, yes, we shall take the horse. It'll carry this heavy bag of fish. Where'd you get these from anyway?
the cleaner pond on the other side of the forest
Hmm, well let us head in that direction. We'll follow these footprints and get away from these smelly dead animals.
well there seem to be foot prints of different flavors here looks like they have a wolf with them
action: hug a child lost from his mother.
put Baskets of freshly-caught fish in The ground
get Baskets of freshly-caught fish from The ground
