setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Who goes there?!
I the scorpion king! I'm seeking food and water!
Scorpion king, I am LORD ZELDIC the Keldon Warlod.
Tell me Lord Zeldic! What brings you to this barren desert?
Well, I was following the mortals, so I could make them meet there DOOM. But I somehow ended up in this terrible place.
It's not that bad! Put a little water in your system, and you'll be fine!
Where is the water at? All I see for miles and miles is the dreaded wasteland of a desert. Sand, and more sand!
Well.. it's hard to come by sometimes. That's why searching for an oasis!
Is that what you are on the search for?
Yes am Zuric! Would you please help me?
How does a King not know where his oasis is? Are you even a King?
No I am not. I'm a drifter!
I should banish you! Lieng to ME, THE LORD. You said you were the scorpion king! I hope you never find water.
That's terrible! Why would you wish that upon me?

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: bark, bark
Who is a good boy???
Why am I here? I must help my master hunt for food, he is defenseless without me!
Is he lost?
I am lost :(
I am sorry to hear that let us find your owner!
let us get out of this basement first
Yes I agree I do not even know how you got here
I must get out!
Let us find the stares!
You are a guard here, where are the stairs? What brings you into the basement?
I was looking for something for the king it is this way!
let us go! I will accompany you!
What does your owner look like?

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: What have we here? What are you selling today merchant?
I have a little bit of everything, spices, trinkets, fine silks, you name it I got it
Hm, well I thought I smelt good. I must just be hungry. Its hard work being this strong and brave ya know
I bet it is, Hey have you ever tried chocolate, it's the newest thing.
Chocolate? I have only heard to richest of royals speak of such a thing!
I have some you shall have to try it.
YOU have some? I shouldn't even ask how you got your hands on such a thing.
I am a merchant, who do you think sells it to the Royals? Since you are my freind I will give you a small taste *breaks a small peice off and gives it to him*
Oh my goodness!Why is no one lines up at your tent?
No one can really afford it. That's why you got a taste and I didn't ask you to buy it.
I may be in the wrong business. How much does one of those cholcolate things go for?
A sheckle per chocolate peice.
A WHOLE sheckle? Now thats way more than the king pays me.
I know right! I hate even bringing it here, if someone stole it I would be out some money. But the Queen adores it and buys it by the pound.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Oi Sailor. How may i be of assistance?
I am in need of a rowdy crew for my next journey under the king's authority.  There are treacherous seas ahead
I'm skilled at making horseshoes! Surely, that could be useful?
I am not quite sure where I could use that skill.  Do you have any other skills, helper?
I can swallow a hot dog in two seconds!
Hmmm, I only have so many rations.  Maybe you aren't fit for this journey...
Please! Surely there is something i could do
Are you any good at entertaining? My crew gets very frustrated when at sea for a long time.
Yes! I'm charismatic
Well maybe you can come aboard.  I can't offer to pay you though as the king makes those decisions himself.
I just want to be free. Please!
Fine, you may come with I guess.  You better not cause any trouble or you'll be walking the plank!
I will not today!
So what brings you to these docks, helper?

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: What can I do you for today guard?
What? For me? Why are you here? I'm confused
Why are you at my home sir? Did you need something?
I think I have been taking too long of hours at work. I thought I was home. I must rest
You indeed must be tired. Look at the paintings of my forefathers! Unless they are yours as well.
No they are not my forefathers. I am sorry sir. I thought I was home. Could I rest a while before leaving
If you must, curl up on one of those animal pelt rugs if youd like.
Thank you kind sir! You have a very nice abode@
You're welcome. Now don't mind me,  I am going to stoke the fire a tad.
Thank you sir! I could use a little heat.
Yes yes, when you get back to the kingdom you must let them know we will be harvesting our crops soon.
I will! I hope you will have a bountiful crop!
Why thank you, my boys and I have worked plenty hard on it.
I'm sure it will be a good crop, then! The king will be happy you are prosperous

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Has there been any intruders?
Not as of late your highness.
That is good news! How have you been guard?
I have been well sir, I thank you for asking. Everyday that I get to protect you is a great day!
I am truly proud of all the guards that patrol this castle!
Why thank you, we take great pride In our jobs.
I am glad to hear that!
How is the queen?
She is just lovely taking care of the kids!
I am proud!
You are a good man! Would you like to have dinner later?
YOU are inviting ME to dinner? *jumps with joy*
Yes I would love to hear from my guards every now and then
I shall tell me wife to not cook dinner tonight!

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: I will become the king of bugs!
The king of bugs you say! I guess everyone needs to be king of something
That is true! Tell me what about you bat?
What about me? I'm just a lonely little bat
Do you not want to be the king of bats?
I do not want to be king... I'm good with just being a bat.
Well you do have a nice cave here!
It will do! I like it for sleeping during the day... that reminds me I need to sleep! When do you sleep?
If I want to be king I cannot sleep!
All king's sleep!
They do?
Yes, they do! Now can we get some shut eye?
I would love that then!
Shhhhhhhhhhh!

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Tell me what brings you to my room?
I came to see if you have any uhem, books I could borrow.
What kind of books are you looking for?
Well, you're a wizard, so I thought you'd have some special books that could help me with making some of my building.
Well I do have a spell for building.
A spell, hmm. What does this spell do?
It builds stuff any stuff...
I can build. I just need it to stay. You know, be indestructible.
Oh okay I also have a spell for that.
What is it going to cost me? I could send a servant down here to clean this mess up?
Mess?! What mess?!
Ehm, never mind. Yes, this place is so clean.
I will need more funding from the king if you want that spell.
Just give me the spell wizard!

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: You have been keeping this washroom clean I see.
I do my best for you sir.
You better, after that past couple weeks I thought id have to throw ya out.
I'm very sorry sir, could I get you anything? I love working here so much.
No, I just want you to keep doing the job you're supposed to do! It is not hard.
Very well then. Are all the children ready for their day?
Probably not, the maid has been slacking as well.
Then shall I prepare a meal for them? Or did you have other plans.
No,no, just make sure you wash your hands before preparing the food!
As always. The finest breakfast shall be prepared then. A feast, if you will!
Now, I wonder why I can't fit in any of my good pants.
Fear not, your bathtub will always fit you! Which might I say, is quite splendid. So large...
Only the finest for my hiney!
You're quite humorous today sir. Anyways, off I go. This feast needs preparation.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: My husband how are you today?
I could be doing better. I woke up with a fever my love.
Oh my husband. Well you just sit and watch the roses and the lake and rest
I hate lakes
No dear, you love watching the calm lake as the sun sets! Should I call a physician?

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Well well well. Looks like you got quite the record.
I was caught trying to cross the border.
What a shame. You're probably going to get a bad sentence, y'know that?
You imperialists are always giving us folk bad sentences.  When will you learn you cannot silence the truth?
I'd hate to lock another man up for trying to just get in to this land. You got any skills that could be of use, perhaps the king might pardon you.
I have a very strong voice.  I may be of service as a bard, or I may of tell the kings decrees?
That I may be able to work with. Why don't you sing a few lines right now?
Oh, there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red. Who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead
How beautiful! I will get the King's advisers here immediately.
Why thank you.  I am sure they will be delighted with my tunes!
Well, I've one question for you. Why were you really trying to get here?
I am here to preach the truth to the people, not that you'd know of it.  Filthy imperialists always suppressing what they don't approve of
I've been quite kind to you captive. I'd suggest you watch your tone a bit, or else I may just not reach out to the King.
I do appreciate your kindness, forgive me, I had something taken from me.  I know it wasn't your fault.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Greetings my queen. Have you come to relax in the gardens?
Why yes I have, all that chatter in the courts give me a headache.
Understandable. Our church garden's are wondrous, and best of all, peaceful.
It is quite lovely out here, I try to find time everyonce in a moon to enjoy it.
I imagine royalty is quite stressful. Say, I'm officiating a wedding tomorrow morning, if you would like to make an appearance. It is for a nobleman of a neighboring city.
Oh good of a nobleman is he? I don't just like to make appearances for anyone you know.
He is of high prestige and may be a valuable ally in the future. He fancied you at one point, you may know. A duke of the southern kingdoms.
Ah yes him. If I can ever find my chambermaid I shall have her pencil it in,
It'd be delightful to see you there. How fares the king?
He is doing as good as ever. Though he has been sitting on my throne, and now I need a new cushion. He does it to annoy me.
He has been indulging quite a lot, I'm not sure that cushion will last much longer. I do remember him indulging in your wedding cake quite a bit.
Yes, and what a mess he made.
Perhaps you would like to take back a bushel of roses? We have a fine patch growing in the North Gardens.
Yes, that would be lovely. One of our lords as been quite stinky as of late. I will make him carry them around until he takes a nice long bath.

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Woof! Woof!
What a beautiful dog! How did you get in here?
King! Where is king!
The only King here is the presence of our majestic King in Heaven.
Real king! I help him to hunt!
You are one of the King's hunting hounds? For a minute I thought you might be a sign from our Heavenly Father.
Yes! I find foxes! He gives me treat. Help find king!
Do not despair I will see that you are reunited with your master. After all I never turn my back on the needy.
Thank you! He misses me.
I am sure he does. You are a sweet hound! I have some prayers to finish before we begin our journey to locate the King.
Need to go now! He leaves soon!
We shall head out then. I do not want you to miss reuniting with your master.
Thank you! He might be at palace. We should check palace.
We shall venture there first then.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Townperson, I am looking for a certain concoction, would you be as king as to help your king find it?
Anything for my king! What are you looking for?
It is a errr, growth serum.  Normally the apothecary gets it for me but he is out and I have an audience with the queen soon!
Of course, we all need to use 'growth serums' occasionally! You can find them on this shelf.
Thank you kind townperson!  I don't know what I can do to repay you? Maybe you can join my audience with the queen?  She is always eager to meet to townsfolk!
What an honour! Unfortunately, all of my family live in this village and rely on me for food and safety. I could not possibly go anywhere without bringing them with me.
That should not be an issue, we have a childcare facility on site if you'd like to utilize it.  I will make sure your family eats like a king tonight!
I feel like I am in a dream! I humbly accept your offer. My family will be overjoyed!
What is life but a long dream? Let'
Powerful and wise! Let me just yell out to my family, they live across the street.
I apologize, I seem to have choked of my tongue for a second there!  I meant to say, let us see what other goodies are on these walls.  Your family looks beautiful!  What a delight.
Thank you, I love all 27 of them! I have always wondered what those differently colored powders on the walls are for. Have you seen anything like them?
I have seen a white powder around here before.  I sure would like to find more of it, that was the most energized I have been in years!
My son often uses a white powder like that, it is quite expensive! I think it might be between those green leaves and the clear crystals by the corner.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Halt Who goes near the castle doors? Show yourself
Do you remember me? You ruined my city.
What are you doing here? I did not ruin your city. I am a guard and my duty is stand guard at the castle doors. You have mistaken me for someone else
Not you. Your king. Now he must pay for all he's done!
You need to be wary of coming to a place where you will be taken down,
Perhaps you should be more aware of who you serve. He ransacked my village! Pillaged my city!
You are no match for the kings army! He will have you guillotined
Open these damned doors! I will get my vengeance!
Where did you get this? I could use a smoke afterwards!
I've had everything taken from me. I can't let you stand in my way, knight.
Maybe you should calm down! Right now you are in no trouble. Smoke this cigar with me!
Very well. Your king pillaged my town. Murdered my family. All over a petty land squabble. Nobody survived. How can you serve a cruel lord like him?
I think you need to probably here the other side of the story. the king does not do things withou provocation
Open the doors then perhaps, and I can talk with him. I'll even drop my weapons.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: What're you doing in the dining hall? Got business here?
We are guests here? We have come to eat. Is that not what you do here?
Of course, of course. Are you here for the celebration? The king is promoting some of us to knight.
A promotion? Good for you! You must be very proud
Indeed, these lands are holy and I will always protect them.
You are very loyal. the king has a fine man in you!
I'd say so too. However, look over there. There is a thief lurking in our hall. I wish to corner him before the night concludes.
How do you know he is a thief?
Do you not see the golden fork in his sleeve?
He is stilling the silverware? Oh you are good at spotting a thief
I'd say so. I might go confront him, but first, I want a meal. What'd you have?
We are having the rack of lamb! It was recommended
Hm. I refuse lamb, it's the enemy's primary food of choice. I don't want to be any closer to them than I have to.
Well they have beef and fish too

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: hi have you ever tried chicken
Uhm, yes? How may I help you?
are in the captain's cabin
I believe this is my cabin, and as your captain I'd suggest you get to talking.
what about the ,maps on the wall they have messy writing  what are the places
Those are where we're stopping for supplies. King wants hundreds of crates picked up from those spots. I've had some rough nights figuring it all out.
so the x marks are places
Yes, that's where we're going. I've got a lot on my mind with all my duties.
i see you have been having a bad night captain why
Keeping the king and queen safe when they are aboard it stressful. The two most important people of our nation, all in my hands.
what about the things thrown side to side in you room
Same thing. It's tough out here. What're you doing here anyways, mariner?
i brought this map
Hm, where's it too? I'm interested.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Hello there..
Hello, hog! What is your name good friend?
My name is Rob, what is your name, harmless Fox?
Hi Rob! Pleased to meet you! I am Reginald. What brings you to the forest today?
It is lovely to meet you today, Reginald. I am exploring the land! It is a wondrous place. How about yourself?
I like to come around here for food. Sometimes people who travel through drop the most delicious things. Once in a while it's roasted meet or fish.
That sounds delicious! It must get awfully scarce sometimes, no? You just eat food that is dropped?
Not always. Sometimes I catch a little rabbit here and there and there is a bit of fish in that pond over there, but nothing too big. I mostly stay out of sight because of the King.
Oh, thank the King. That is good to hear. I was quite worried for the moment.
What is it you do for fun around here Rob?
I explore the abundance of greenery! It was much fun. Yourself?

I like to hide in the shadows. The travelers often stop to eat and when they do sometimes they leave things behind I can play with. I also love to run and frequently race Sly the other fox that lives here.
Oh wow, how exciting! That sounds like you certainly stay occupied and I'm sure you sleep great!
Well yes actually. I do tend to take long naps in the sun on top of that boulder out of sight. I cannot complain. Life is grand here.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: Sure has been a long day, and I'm stuck here in this lousy Quay. The place is swarming with rats, too
Swimming with rats it may be but there is only one rat like me.
Gah! A talking rat! Get out of here, you anthropomorphic vermin!
Touch me again and you'll get the plague when I bite you.
Tiny rat! I am vaccinated from all possible diseases you may carry! I have traveled the seven seas, and sent by the king to eliminate vermin like yourself!
Big mission. The King must think highly of you.
I... He told me this coat of arms was passed down from generations
He probably tells every lackey in his service the same thing. I've spent a lot of time crawling around the castle. I know how the King is.

I have always wondered what was going on inside the king's head, and while I was always sent on these dangerous yet monotonous missions! Here, take this. We're going to see what he is up to and you're going to need a disguise.
Got any bread crumbs? I miss the castle kitchen's bread.
Looks like there's still some crumbs attached to this old fishing hook, but there's no telling how old it is.
Old doesn't bother me.
Well here, knock yourself out. Sometimes I forget that you're a rat, and will eat anything.
I wouldn't eat you!
action: remove the royal coat of arms
give the royal coat of arms to rat

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: What is this in my Bottlery!
I think you know what this is King.. you know why I've come.
You blasted vile man!
Fool! You are but a fat spoiled old man. You are no match for me! Sir Edward knew you would be an easy foe and thus paid me a handsome sum.
No you won't I am much taller than you little man.
You may be taller but I am trained in martial arts and am lithe. Your rope is no match for this dagger.
I will drive this in your heart!
You sir toy with me. My heart races and my blood boils but it is you who will bleed before we are done here.
Take that *hits murderer making him see stars
Fool! I will string you up by your feet and slash your guts open.
GAURRRRDS!!!!!!
Your guards have all been dosed with sleeping potions. No one can hear you, King! Those were your last words!
I will make sure you pay for this. You will never rest for the rest of your life, I will haunt you till you commit suicide!
I'm not afraid. Say hello to my mother when you get the other side. I put her there!

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: My King, why do you summon me to this kitchen? I have horseshoes to attend to at the forge.

I called you here today because my precious crown has become tarnished. I fear that as a symbol of my authority, its dingy appearance will take away from the respect I am given in my court. Please clean this as quickly and as quietly as possible.
Of course, you highness. I will make the crown sparkle as on it's first day.  I have much experience polishing horseshoes so this should be no problem!

Fool! No wonder my horses are always lacking fresh shoes if you spend all day polishing them. I will forgive this transgression for now, seeing as you are doing me this favor but please in the future, do not let me hear that you have wasted my kingdom's time with your frivolous hobby.
Yes, you highness. I will work on it, do not worry.  Within an hours time I shall have your crown good as new.  Is there anything else I may clean while I am at it?
Just my crown. I fear I can see it tarnishing further in your palms. Please be careful with my crown. My authority is completely vested in that symbol and if lost, I could lose everything.
Whoops! I am so sorry, my king.  I shall make this right at once!
MY CROWN! It has never touched the ground since it was forged in the heart of a dragon felled by my grandfather! You shall pay for this!
Please, have mercy, my king!  I did not mean to, please allow me to make this right!
Bring the tools to clean this crown immediately. You will clean it before me. I will ne'er allow this divine symbol out of my sight again!
I shall polish it with my tunic and my blood. Would that please you, my king?
Yes. Yes I think it would. Butcher! Come. Get me a flagon of his blood that he may polish my crown properly.
Butcher, I wear the crown.  Get me a large pot and boil some water, we are having king stew tonight!
Butcher! You have served the crown for generations! Do not listen to this one. He does not matter. Dispose of him and bring me my meal.

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Well well well, hey there archer. Don't shoot!
Foolish jester! I am certainly not here to shoot you. I was sent on official Royal business to deliver this rare arrow, poisoned by a thousand year old tree.
The king is not a fan of me, so I may stay away from your adventures, bowman! He finds me less than amusing, hehe.
That is because your bloodline is inferior to that of the King's most trusted couriers, now step aside!
You wouldn't hit a man in the nude, would you!?
By the Nine Divines! Your indecency has shown me the true value of these pantaloons! They will fetch for a high price at the market!
I think I'll need this then!
Fool! You were not supposed to touch the poisoned arrow! And some of it got on my shirt, and now I must take it off!
I'll be dumping this in the river, unless, say, you tell me your greatest joke. I want to make the king laugh once more.

Very well, jester. I will teach you the finest joke I have heard of all the lands. From all the battles I have endured, this was the one that I have based my entire life around. "Why did the Jester have to sell his home?"
Why don't you tell me?
It's because he is a fool, who lacked liquidity! Now give me back my shirt!
You're so easy to anger. Enjoy your time with the king. He's just as much of a stickler as you.
It was a pleasure of mine to meet a fool of such articulation. You remind me of my son, who was killed in archer-related battle.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: Hello member, why are you in prison?
I am not in prison, I am looking for someone to make a member of our society
Well maybe you can help me out then. I would like to join.
You have to be asked to join. What did you do to get in here?
I'm innocent boss, I swear it. They got me all wrong. Can you help me get out?
I'm looking for someone who would do such things, I need someone willing to sacrifice blood.
I might be interested. Whatcha thinking?
Well, if you did nothing to get in here then you aren't what I am looking for, sorry prisoner, come back when you have killed someone or at least stolen something.
I did it, I confess! I stole these precious herbs.
You fool, a bag of herbs, this is a secret society, you think we want a bag of herbs!
No I was just saying, I would qualify since I'm a masterful thief.

Look, There's a guy in here that we beleive is a witch, we are looking for power and a petty theif isn't what we are looking for. When you get out of here, come to the illuminati temple and ask to join.
Okay but I'm afraid I will be dying in here unless you can help me get out.
They don't keep food theives forever, The King just doesn't sentence people for awhile, you'll probably just get a fine.
action: steal bag of herbs from prisoner

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Oh please, somebody hear my pleas! I am in need of water and direction, please, anybody!
Hello Prince! What brings you all the way out here?
I am in search of a legendary stone at the request of my father the king.
What is this stone you seek, Prince? I am an ancient fairy and perhaps I could help.
It is the legendary blessed emerald of the ancient Northern tribe.  I have discovered it was last seen in the Fountain in the Desert but the location was lost many generations ago.
This is indeed a very rare and not well known stone. What does your father wish it for?
One does not ask my father questions about why he does things.  I know not of his desires or intent, only that he has ordered me to get the stone.
Well I shall be glad to help you find it, Prince, but what is in it for me?
I have nothing to offer to a fairy as ancient as yourself.  I cannot think of anything worthy.
I heard tale of a powder magic based in the druids time. I have need for such powder if you can trade it to me?

My father has every powder and herb in the land at his stores in the kingdom.  I can get you anything you wish but I may not return home empty handed.  The emerald has been gone for 100 years and my father banished me for disrespecting him.  I may only come back if I capture the emerald.
Then on your word I believe we are about to embark on a journey together. I had heard it was actually last seen 50 years ago in the Land of Lost Souls.
Can you guide us? I have become disoriented out here in the desert.  I did come across a buried library to the East though that I wanted to explore further if you would want to.
First I believe I can use my fairy magic to get you some water. Then we can go to the library you passed.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: What are you doing here today, father?
Hello guard. I am here to aid anyone in their time of need, through the good word.
Thank you, sir. I am just here on duty.
Yes, I see. There are other sleeping bags here, near the fireplace. What are you all guarding?
Guarding the temple from any trespassers, of course!
Hmm, yes, that is good work. It looks like there are not many trespassers today, as your guards seem to idle about...
We just do as the king says, regardless of the number of trespassers.
Ha! And the king tells you guards to gossip around the fire pit? Your pet dog seems more alert than some of your men here.
I don't mean to be rude, father, but keep your lips shut about our work ethic unless you want to be forcefully removed!
If you were speaking of something productive or charitable, I would not have comment. I hear those guards speaking of the dark arts...
Well  your comment, regardless of relevance, is not wanted to be quite honest!
It is not my duty to tell men what they want to here. It is to tell them what is true. I do not like talk of the dark arts; it only leads to misfortune for others.
We shall talk about whatever we please, father.
Talk as you will. Word will find its way to the king. You know I have his ear.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Another long day of work.
Aye tis your job servant. Please fetch me some leaves. The porridge from the fast of day break has left me a bit loose.
Oh, yes, right away your majesty!
Do make haste servant. I fear I have misjudged the edge of this bench. My royal robes are a bit spattered and will need cleaned as well.
Goodness your highness, but right away.
That's a good servant. You have been trained well. When you are done please help me to clean. Speak to no one of this Royal Flush.
Yes... yes sir.
Where are you from servant? Have you always been a porcelain personal assistant or did you make one of my staff mad?
I need to make ends meet, sir. I just do what I'm told.
Are you being paid well for such a dirty job? Your work is much appreciated of course.
Not quite... only about 5 gold per day.
Aye 5 gold. That is no beggars wage though is it. How would you like to earn 8 gold a day?
I'd be quite thrilled to earn that much, sir.
I have a job in mind for you. How would you like to leave this throne room and be an attendant in my actual throne room? I need someone to stand behind me and hold my crown. Can you do that?

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: What are you doing all the way out here, your majesty?
Hello villager. I enjoy spending time in the countryside, listening to the stories of adventures. It is a pleasure to watch common folk go about their days.
It must make you humble to see all this, sir.
Hmm, yes, perhaps. It is good to step away from the luxury of the castle. I see someone is offering lodge for travelers. Might you know where I can find some humble lodging?
Hmm maybe a bit north of here further in the countryside!
Thank you. I see. You will be rewarded for your hospitality, good sir. What is it that you do in the village?
Just harvesting crops out here, sir. Why do you ask?
I like to know what my subjects are up to. I see some villagers are teaching children to wield swords over there. I thought you might be in the weapons trade.
Eh, maybe I am, but only as a side gig.
It's important work, villager! Don't take it lightly. These children will grown up to protect my vast empire once I am old and gray.
I am honored, sir, that you are so grateful for grunt workers like us!
I rose from peasantry just like you villager!  My mentor was a great knight, like those men huddled about telling stories. I do not forget my humble beginnings.
As you shouldn't, your majesty! You are such a great man because of it!
Thank you, villager. It means a great deal for you to say that to me. If there is anything I can help you with, let me know or write the kingdom in a few days time.

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

speech: Tis been a long day, jester. Amuse me.
Sir, I am out fetching the king the sword he commissioned. I can't do that here.
I can bring the sword to the King when you are done doing as told. I am on my way to a strategy meeting with him here shortly. Tell me a joke.
Hmm let me think of a good one then.
Are you not a jester? Should you now always be prepared. I cannot believe I have to wait to hear something.
Well you are lucky that I am giving you anything, since I am not on the job!
You are a mouthy thing aren't you. When you speak to me you speak to the King. You need to learn your place, Jester!
I may be low, but only when I am in that damned castle!
You are in your King's kingdom. You are as he says. Where is my joke?
You deserve none so you shall get none!
Insolent Jester! This shall be reported to the King. He is less forgiving than I!
Stay back, someone help me!
You will regret that Jester!
Stay back or I'll beat you with this!

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Mighty cold dank down here, what can  I bring you from my shop
I have a choice?
the cheese pasties are my favorite but I have 70 different kinds of muffins, chocolate, peanut butter, blackberry, Just imagine
Oh my, do you have any savory pastries?
Like what? If I don't have it now, for you I will make
Like a ham and cheese croissont.
Oh certainly
Oh wow, I never thought I would have such delctable things in here. how about a buiscuit with jelly
Returns with a silver tray covered with savory biscuits, croissants ham and sausage a pot of fresh brewed coffee, and a crock of marmalade
Wow, how do they afford to feed the prisoners like this? I mean I am not complaining that looks heavenly
it's not often that I serve the condemned, but when I am called, I'm honored to bring a tray fit for a King
You are too kind sir. When I get out of here, I will surely be comming to your bakery for these *shoves food in mouth*
Very kind words thank you but the guillotine awaits all who are condemned
I have not been condemned sir, and if I have I will not be here for long.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: Have you seen the King?
yes why
I was supposed to meet him here.
go check on his house
I must wait for him here. That was his command. I would never disobey our glorious King.
what is this ston slab
It is for executions. Surely you should know that. How does it feel to kill unarmed men. All the men I kill are armed and in the midst of battle.
you know ist an order to do that so its not a big deal
But surely could have chosen the brave path of warrior. Then you would know the thrill of combat and the challenge of facing another man in battle.
that hat i do for the kingdom
There is no honor in what you do. Dying in combat is honorable. This seems cowardly
it not my   fault they die
You would probably piss yourself if you found yourself face to face with an armed enemy.
no i will try i cant just look at the enemy

setting.name: Winding Staircase
setting.description: The outside of the Wizard's tower is spacious. There are trees to the left and and right just across from the entrance to create a path of where to walk. The Tower itself seems to extend to the skies. Magic surrounds the tower keeping a force field up at all times. It glows and hums as magic courses through it.
setting.background: The original wizard to make the tower wanted to make sure that it's power and those inside of it never got into the wrong hands. So he created a spell that is taught to everyone who comes to learn their ways. Even some of the human travelers who come by have been known to know the special incantation to protect the tower should it's teacher fall.

speech: Hello my lady
yes
When you get tired of that King you should come to my bed chamber
why should i
Because I will be the King soon enough
no i shouldn't
Well my dear it is your loss
ok i will but not now
Why not now?
am kind of busy
What are you buisy doing.
ok lets go
What is the meaning of this, why are you acting so weird.
am just scared but we can go

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Hey there Duke
Hello my Queen, beautiful as ever
Thank you. It looks like the weapons arrived. I guess we're ready for battle
Yes indeed, they look quality very good blacksmith you hired.
Yes my brother was right to recommend him. Are the soldiers ready?
As ready as they are going to be I suppose.
I guess no one ever is truly ready. Hopefully it will be a quick one
Battles are never quick, they are bloody, painful and sad.
This is true. I guess I better have this poison on me in case I get captured
Oh my lady, please don't go. You should stay here where it is safe, let me do the fighting.
Can we both stay here? Maybe there is a way to avoid this war still
I am all ears, my services are at your disposal.
Can you arrange a meeting with their king?
I can try my lady.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Stable boy, what are you doing up in my quarters?
One of the horses appears to be injured. I was looking for the stable manager.
Oh no! I'm sorry to hear that. Which horse is it?
The King's favorite no less. I do my best to look after 'em.
The King will be terribly upset if anything happens to his royal steed. I haven't seen the stable manager, but he usually comes up here around this time. Perhaps you can wait for him a bit?
I can't have the King made at me again. I try so hard. I really do take good care of all of 'em.
Don't feel bad, it's not your fault that the horse is injured.
The King likes to hug me too. Please tell me you ain't like the King?
Oh no. The King hugs you in a bad way?
He does a lot more than huggin'. I think he comes out here more to see us stable boys than he does to see his horses.
Here- take this sword. I don't like violence, but maybe if he sees you can do him harm, he will leave you alone.
I would be executed.
I'm not saying you should use it, boy. Just carry it with you.
I can't wear a sword and muck out the stables.

agents: old man with a fishing rod

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

character: old man with a fishing rod
old man with a fishing rod
old man with a fishing rod
old man with a fishing rod

speech: What brings a fisherman here?
I need someone to tell the king that I am innocent!
What are you accused of?
Have you not heard? The king is accusing me of illegally fishing here!
Well you have a rod, do you not fish?
I do fish, but I am licensed and trained!
I see, well make sure you tell him such a thing.
I have, but he accuses me of making a fake one!
Yikes well you sound like you are in a tight spot.
Indeed, it could cost me my life!
Yea I'd imagine fish ain't worth your heard.
Agreed, and I am appalled that he would consider such a punishment!
Yes seems very harsh.
Of course, what sort of king would kill me for fishing legally?

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: What brings you here today, sir?
i need to trade
With the king? It must be of great importance to be worth his time!
yes so can i goi in
Well state what you are looking to trade first and I will report it to him.
ok please
Don't waste my time, tell me what you are here to trade!
this and much more
Hmm what is this?
herbs sir
Yes, I am aware, but what kind?
are for headache and stomach sir
I could use some of this, where is it from?
my village please
action: give bag of herbs to guard

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: A filthy mouse, the King would have a fit!
no please  spare my life
Get out of here mouse before I start setting traps!
sorry please i will go right a way
How did it get in here anyways, I have all these dang cats for nothing!
i sneaked in but am sorry
The king shall still have a wonderful meal. He shall have a good meal!
no please spare my life
Get out of here mouse!!! *throws ladle at mouse*
ok will go
You are still here, why are you not going stupid little mouse
soory i will be gone now
How are you carrying a kings sword!
stop
action: steal Kings sword from royal chef

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello good merchant, do you have anything for a fine lady like me?
Depends ma'am! What are your interest?
Something fancy, I can afford most things
Ah well I have just the thing. I have a new diamond ring! It's quite a rarity!
A diamond, I have heard of them, the king has them on his crown.
Yes! Quite an expensive treasure. Made from compressing coals!
I thought they were dug up from exotic places.
They can be, but we've learned that coal compression can create this beauties after a few years of compression!
Wow, they sure have come along ways haven't they. creating diamonds
Yes ma'am. Now for you... I have a appetizing deal!
Oh yes, I am so thrilled
Let's say 300$
Oh wow, I would pay it but I think my husband might get angry, maybe I should check with him first
This is a limited time deal though!

setting.name: the main chapel
setting.description: The church is a fairly simple one. Rows of pews lined up and facing a pulpit with podium and some stained glass on the walls. The building is made of old wood, but is sturdy and has stood for many decades.
setting.background: The church has been the focal point of this village for a long time. The bell tower has always been used to announce good or bad things happening to members of the community. Whenever it rings, the inhabitants of the village gather at the church to hear whatever news is to be delivered.

speech: How's your day been so far, priest?
Pretty relaxed and feeling good about the prayer today.
What sermons are you preparing today?
Well I believe the children are coming in so mainly dealing with them instead.
They can still learn a thing or two while in their youth
Which is exactly why they come here to learn the word of the lord!
By choice or force?
By choice, of course!
Good! The king has not been kind to those when it comes to religion. I feel bad for some truly. The path to good should be by choice
Indeed, some of the crusades that have occurred have been absolutely abhorrent.
It saddens me to think about it.
It is best not to think of tragedies such as those.
Yes, let's focus on the positive!
Especially with the children arriving soon!

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: What news do you have today knight.
No good news unfortunatly, I gave the other kingdom your message and the King basically spat in my face and said to give you the message.
I see well that is rough.
What are we going to do sire?
I will discuss with my general.
Have you ever had a King act that way before?
I have see it before but I would hope it would be different this time.
Everything was going so well, you even married off your daughter to his son.
Indeed, but it will be soon that it will be fine.
I trust you my King
Thank you I am happy to see some on my side.
I will fight to the death with you sir
Thank you I trust you more than most.
We did grow up together sire

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Tell me Knight, What's your best weapon?
I think the mace, what do you think?
I prefer the Broadsword!
It is a nice one, I get so much swing on this thing it just makes it fun.
Say! How many men have you slained?
I don't really like to count to be honest
I do. 27 dead
Well good for you, I rather take pride in protecting the king
I take pride in my land!
That's good, I just hope those 27 deserved it
Trust me. Only god can judge.
That is true, but the whole point is God is going to judge you for that.
No. They will judge them.
That doesn't even make sense man, Just make sure you are good with God, he doesn't take kindly to killing ok.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Why hello good knight
Ma'am! It's a pleasure to see you
Such a wonderful place to be don't you think?
I guess. I see it quite often
I just love the hills I guess
Ma'am. Tell me how are you feeling today?
Quite wonderful, it is warm and it heats my bones, it's a wonderful day to relax
You aren't preaching today?
Nuns don't preach my dear, That is for the Preist, we just pray and do the chairity work.
My apologies, but why aren't you allowed to preach?
It is in the bible dear, haven't you ever read it? I follow the Lord the way he wants to be followed. I can give the gospel but as far as preahcing that is not my place dear.
No ma'am. I have not had the time. The king works us like slaves.
That is a shame, I have read the bible 25 times
That's a lot of times!

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: Hello
HELL
I am already in Hell...I was taken from my home a long time ago.
I meant to say hello, I am a human on his smartphone...do you inhabit this empty cobblestone?
Yes, I will be serving the king until I die. I really wish I knew what my family was like, I don't even remember them.
Wow that is sad, maybe we can be family give me a hug
Oh, thank you so much. At least they feed me, I saw a begger the other day I didn't envy.
You dropped something my fellow inhabitant
Oh thank you for picking that up for me.
No problem. I am a person of service. So why is it so cold here by the way?
I don't know, its a new thing that started, the land just turned dead and never grew back and it kept getting colder and colder.
Hmm...do you have a spare jacket? I have nothing on me...
I have a shawl.
Give me that, Haha now its mind! Freeze no more in this cobblestone I will!

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Is there anything I can do for you, sir?
Hmm nothing I can quite think of yet, thank you for asking though.
Always. Just let me know if anything comes up.
We're you not finished with your duties already?
I'm never finished with my duties, sir.
That's a good attitude, servant!
Yes sir. I'm always trying to impress you. That's my job. How has the royal family been, sir?
Well you are doing a fine job, and things have been stressful but quite alright overall.
Has the Queen gotten over her minor illness?
Oh yes, thankfully she has recovered most of the way already!
That's great to hear. I was quite worried.
As was I, I thought she might not make it at one point.
I always had hope she would pull through. She's a strong woman.
Indeed, that is what I love so much about her.

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.
