setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hello husband, for what am I graced with your presence.
Check out my new fighting moves!
Here I thought you were coming in here for something serious...
I am done with this. I have come to sit with you in our thrones.
For what reason?
Because that is what we do my queen. What is wrong with you today?
You are just getting on my nerves.
Well, maybe have a few sips of this.
What is this?
It's your favorite wine. It's an aged batch from the monks.
Wow that is delicious, thank you dear.
Someone needs to pick this up before they slip on it.
Well why did you drop it?
To watch them pick it up. What else are we ganna do around here. might as well amuse ourselves.

setting.name: Town Theater
setting.description: This is a quaint theater with plush velvet seats and a beautiful red curtain. It can seat 200 people. It is decorated with mirrors and golden accents. There are posters of past plays in the lobby.
setting.background: The theater was built for the local troupe. They put on several plays a year. They also hold town meetings there. People will also rent it out for special occasions.

speech: I am looking forward to seeing the show tonight.
I am excited for the show but not the abundance of people...
I am hoping it brings in some guests, we need the money.
I am sure it will. What is it about again?
Ahh it's a good one tonight.  The tale of how our fine King ascended to the throne .
Any action or crime fighting in there?!
Of course, it chronicles the whole bloody tale from start to end.
Oh how exciting it will be. Will we have the King here/
Aye, his special box has already been prepared.
Should I do anything more than escort him?
Be very careful not to touch the Queen.  He is very particular about that.
I will be certain! Any other tips? I expect he may be a little needy?

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Hello boy, have you eaten yet?
No, father, and I am positively famished. I haven't eaten since breakfast. Please, do pass me the meat.
Here you go. Make sure to find yourself a plate. You are royalty and royalty eats with plates.
Fine, fine... I do hate when I have to be a model of politeness, but I guess otherwise the people would eat even more disgustingly than they already do.
Good boy. Now are you prepared for tomorrows celebration?

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Hello your Highness.
Hello Parcival, have you made the arrangements for the Queen's...disappearance?

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Hello there neighbor, are you headed to the pub this evening?
I am, indeed. It's been a hard day of work and I'm exhausted. Are you in search of a brew, too?

Yes, I am. The day has been hard and those pesky little fairies have been moving things around again. It makes the king angry when things are a mess and he doesn't believe me about the fairies. I need a drink!
Here - take this bag. It's got some herbs in it that help to repel the fairies!
Wow, thanks! How do I use them?
Simply sprinkle them about your workplace or any place the fairies are troubling you. The fairies can't stand the odor.
I'll give it a try tonight! Come on, let me buy you a drink. Is the knight going to come too? He's kind of creepy just standing there silently all this time.
He's what they call an introvert! He just likes to watch people talk.
Is he dangerous? I don't want any trouble. I have enough stress as it is.
Not at all! Look- he won't even respond when I hit him!
Wow, that's very strange. Is he bewitched or something? Can I hit him too? It looks like fun.
You can try. He never does a thing to me. Won't even come for a beer!
Okay, I'm going to give it a try! He doesn't seem to even feel it. I don't think I want to have  a drink with him. He's kind of scary.
Yeah, I'm not even sure he is alive!

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Neigh! Guard, why did you bring me down by these tombstones?
We are just patrolling the grounds silly horse
That's fine, but I don't want to stay here long. I spook easily, and this place feels scary to me.
Don't worry, we are just passing through
But why is the chef out here? He's not going to raid the graves for dinner, is he?
I certainly hope not. I have no idea what he is doing out here. Let's go find out
He's kneeling on the ground. What is that about?
Maybe it has something to do with this gold that is lying around
That MUST be it! But surely that's not meant for him. You should arrest him!
Here, hold this while we sneak up on him
Shh, quiet. I think he is suspicious!
Now he is caught
You got him! Now you can put the gold back.
Yes, let us take him to the king

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: Good morning Priest. What a glorious day.
Indeed, it is! God has blessed us and this sanctuary!
God is good! I found this outside. Who would leave it there?
I cannot imagine. Some children were playing out here earlier. Perhaps one left it behind.
What do you think of this new religion the villagers are talking about? Their leader The High Sparrow seems like a phanatic
Yes, I agree. It makes me hold this cross tight to my chest. I've heard frightening things.
I hope the king does not fall under his spell.
Yes. Well, the King's mind has been swayed in the past. We'll have to pray it does not happen again.
Being a young King does not help. I pray day and night for him.
And unfortunately, the wine like this troubles his soul, too.
I have heard such. The Queen mother needs to step in and guide him better. The Lord can only do so much. The King needs the will.
Well, I'm afraid all we can do is continue to pray that God will guide his soul.
Do you see the Ghost here? I have never seen him here.
Yes. I'm afraid we have recently lost a vestry member. His ghost is lurking, unsure of where to go next.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Woof, do you have food for me servant?
No, but I have some sparklies for you to play with!
Oooh shiny. Where did you get these?
The King said they were for you to play with, marvelous aren't they?
I wonder if they're good to eat
Well, probably not, but if you do the handmaids will need to search for them once they pass through your system.
Oh well. Not my problem. They didn't really taste like anything
You are such a good boy aren't you?
Yes! I'm hungry though
Maybe this rat will be apetizing?
It's not for eating! It's for playing
Okay, want to play fetch with it then?
Yes!
Okay boy, go get it!

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Hello, King.
Ah, my glorious wife! We meet on the staircase in secret!
I still love it after all these years, my King
And I, you. But I'm concerned about our son. He's not showing any interest in the fair maiden we have brought him.
Oh dear. Has he said why he's not interested in her?
He says she is malodorous! I have detected nothing of the sort.
Hmmm...that is very unusual indeed. Perhaps we should find him another maiden?
This is the fifth one this month! I'm afraid he will never be satisfied.
Well, we may have another issue on our hands then, dear King. How are you feeling today?
Still ill in my stomach. I believe the salmon last night was not cooked well.
Oh dear. Will you call for the cook's head?
No, no. We all make mistakes. Gustave is the best cook in the land!
Thank goodness! I was hoping you'd feel that way.
Yes, I'm demanding but understanding.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello, Commander.
You there - your boots are scuffed!
As they are. I have been out scouring the land.
What news have you from the front?
There are enemy line just past the gate and over the mountains. We need to tell the King
I shall inform his majesty. For now, rouse the troops and assemble them here outside the wall.
Yes sir. Do the homes outside the walls need to be warned?
Indeed. Dispatch a company of troops to warn the villagers to take shelter inside the wall.
Right away, sir. All of the King's aides are already here but we will station troops inside their homes for a sneak attack.
An intriguing idea. However did you come by it?
Many years of experience. A main part of my job protecting the king consists of battle strategy
We shall follow your plan. Should it succeed, your name will be passed down in song!
Nothing makes me happier than protecting my beloved kingdom! Bring the Agriculture Advisor to me forthwith. We need to plan and I need his help
Whatever for?

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: We're getting ready to start harvesting the corn, the last of our crops for the year. I hope that it does as well as the wheat and rice did
The crops look good this year.
Yes and the king has been happy with the quality as well. Always good to have a happy king I say.
Indeed. The king has been kind to my family and I.
I'm going to hitch up the wagon and get ready to take this load of grain into town. Do you need anything from the market while I am there?
I have everything I need. I thank you for your kindness.
Of course! I'm going to get some nails and lumber, I have to repair the sheep shed before winter gets here.
I hope this winter is not as harsh as last year's.
Agreed. Last winter was a difficult one. I'm getting too old for winters like that. My sons are going to be doing more of the outside chores this year
Speaking of children, maybe you could fetch me something from the market. A good wife perhaps?
Aye, and any special requests? Redhead, blonde, brunette?
Anything prettier than the goats here.
Well, that shouldn't make the task too difficult then!
Well, I should probably get back to the family before night falls.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Hello my love, what a beautiful day out here in the garden.
Though it does pale in comparison to you.
You are too kind. would you care to help me pick some flowers for our chambers.
Certainly, what preference do you have towards them?
Pink roses and white lilies would look lovely.
As you wish my queen I will search for some.
You are the best thing that has ever happened to me.
I am flattered that you would think so.
I shall also make myself a beautiful flower crown to wear to the dinner tonight.
You have always liked the simpler things.
Wealth can swallow you whole, we must always stay true to ourselves
Those are very wise words, it is easy to fall prey to our material desires.
I hope our sons take after us in that sense.
One could only hope, sometimes boys can be troublesome to raise right.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: You will bow to your king woman
Wow, you are a rude king

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Oh how beautiful our castle is, dear!
Do you think so? I cannot help but notice the stones are askew.
I see that with moss growing on them... We need to get these cleaned.
I shall dispatch some servants posthaste!
Indeed! We could tidy this area up since we are expecting guests from the neighboring kingdom.
Have you planned the banquet for them yet?
I have maids and servants getting everything together now. I will add this to the list.
Excellent! What, pray tell, is on the menu?
Peasant with rice and gravy. What do you think?
Pardon me...did you say "peasant?" Shall we cook the commoners?
I did. I did indeed. Let it be what I say then.
I see. It is an intriguing proposition.
I am only kidding with you, dear. We are having the finest duck from across the bay with a side of green beans, mashed potatoes, carrots, and peas.
Excellent! I knew to trust you with such details!

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: What do you have to give me, guard?
Excuse me? That sword was given to me by the king himself.
Well it's mine now
This is ridiculous.
Just give me your possessions and we can be through with this!
Not a chance!
What's this? A map to the King's treasure!?
He would never leave that where a pirate could find it!
Yeah, and I wouldn't leave it where you could steal it. I'm just toying with you

setting.name: Within the walls of the city
setting.description: The Tower stands tall, built of the best stone with a number of odd runes that only the local mages truly know how to read. Despite age the stones do not crumble, and stand ever vigilante as a watch station for the city.
setting.background: Built as a ever watchful reminder so that the people would know the guard had eyes on approaching danger the Inside Tower was commissioned by the first ruling family of the area. The grand wizard of the area carved runes blessed by the fair folk so ensure that no matter what was thrown against it the tower would stand strong.

speech: Have you seen any beasties lurking about - besides myself, of course!
If I did, I would have run them out of here by now.
Now, don't run them out! Just let me know about them and I will make them my snack!
It is my sworn duty to protect the King.
I don't know- I saw you outside chatting with a maiden earlier.
That was a mage and they were teaching me how to read the runes on the tower.
She certainly was a very attractive mage!
I have had an interest in those runes ever since I became a guard here. Legend has it is that they do not crumble.
Interesting! Well, I'll keep the other guards away while you talk with your mage friend if you let me know if you see any snacks for me lurking about!

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: I take it you slept well last night?
I did, father.
Good, Don't forget school starts in a week, and you have a lot of studying to do.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Hello my love. Have you found a suitable cushion for my throne yet? It has already been three weeks.
Why yes I have! But I'm afraid you are mistaken, I am no king of yours, I am from the lands to the south.
That is intriguing, I was sure you were my king. Who are you exactly, then?
As I said, lord of the kingdoms to the south. I've come to visit as I have quite a proposal for you, to change your people's lives forever.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Hello King! I come to you today to ask for your help in financing my next project, a boat big enough to hold the entire village!
You speak to your King like this? You should kneel when you address me, knave!
Yes, you are correct my king, take this sword as an apology.
The court accepts your gift. Now speak more of this boat
This will be a very large boat, a towering thing, big enough to hold the entire village, so that we may escape if ever there was a reason to, or just to travel to new lands if we wish.
Ha! Behold the gold and jewels that surround you! I could build a hundred such boats if I wished! But what benefit is it to me, your divine ruler?

Why yes you could, but none that you would build could stand up to mine, for I am a master craftsmen, I am good at what I do, the best even, you will find no other that can build something as well as me.
You boast highly of yourself Craftsman. I have no reason to take you at your word. What proof can you offer to back up this bluster?
This hammer was forged from the strongest metals on earth, it is useless in any others hands but mine own, with this hammer I could craft a boat to please even the gods themselves.

This throne itself was forged by a master craftsman. But I never heard any tales of a magic hammer. If what you say is true, then you could forge something made of these royal jewels. Do you dare to accept this task?
I could build whatever you please your majesty, you name, I build it.

These are precious. Look at them, feel them. All the paintings you see around you are of kings who possessed these. If any of these are damaged, you will forfeit your very life. Are you still so confident in your skills?
Look! see how it broke into pieces on the floor? This piece was a fake! Are you sure they are so precious?!
My treasures!

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Woah! What are you doing here?
Shhh!  Quiet, I mean you no harm!
Are you hiding?
I was tied up here by some goblins that I was tracking... I think they've gone now though, for a while at least.  Do you have any tool I can use to get myself free, my good man?
Hmm let me look. Those goblins are a cruel species.
I've got to get back to the King to let them know they've made it this far.  I'm worried that this might be just a scouting party..
Here i found this. Did you see them here on my land?

Ah, thank you!  There... that should... ah, it's good to have some freedom of movement to my legs at last.  They were not far from here, in the woods over by your wheat fields.  I don't think they're bold enough to attack, but stil...
Let's go search. I cannot afford goblins to be messing with my wheat.
Hold there, Farmer!  I admire your spirit, but these goblins were nasty beasts, well armed.  Perhaps... is there a village nearby?  Could a group of men be raised for the task of hunting them out?
I uuhhh guess. I am just a farmer. I do not know many fighters or soldiers.

Well, safety in numbers.  Even a group of farms and villagers with knives and pitchforks can at least deter them.  It might be safer if the women and children were sent to the village as well, for a time.
I'll be sure to tell them to leave. Here i'll take that back.
Ah, yes, sorry.  Well, I should make haste.  My horse is not far - I'll be back soon with troops.  Stay on guard until then, good man!

steal Tool from a captured knight

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Hello King, is this gift left here for you?

Ah, thank you.  These old eyes of mine can't see too well, and since I've travelled here to treat with the young king, my mind gets a bit lost in these new surroundings... perhaps it is for me.  May I borrow it, kind bird?
Sure, as long as you tell me what's inside!
Ah let me see... hm, it looks to be a bracelet of some kind.  Although more suited, I think, for a lady?
Oh wow. That could be a necklace for a bird perhaps?
Why yes, I don't see why not!  Although I wouldn't wear it all the time.  A hawk might find it a bit easier to find you.  But for special occasions, I think it will suit you quite well.
Oh wow thank you! And yea i am sure it sparkles in the sun light.

So tell me, bluebird, you seem to be well acquainted with this garden.  I'm considering forming an alliance with the King here and came to meet him.  But I'm sure you can tell me more of his character than I can glean for myself.
He has his moments but overall he is very cruel. He steals my eggs a lot.
Oh - that doesn't seem very nice.  After all, bluebirds have the most beautiful song!
Why yes we do! Thank you! Why do you want to form an alliance?

Well, I am getting on in years.  My daughter is still quite young, so I was hoping when I passed on, if she at least was on friendly terms with her neighbors, it would assist in her reign, and perhaps strengthen our borders.
You sound like a smart King. I hope everything goes well for you.
Ah, thank you, kind bird.  You are more than welcome to travel to visit my kingdom, should you wish.  We are quite careful with our bluebird friends there.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Gah - help me up, man!  I thought I was going to be Troll food.  Thank you, I owe you my life!
Might need this how did they get you
Was *ahem* relieving myself when they snuck up behind me.
The got you in a compromising position huh what a shame
Well at least I wasn't eaten on top of that.  I can see my tombstone now "Here Lies Sir Galahad, Bravely Feasted Upon by Trolls"
Yes this is true here  take this you will need it
Ooof! How can they carry such things all the time?  I guess it's no wonder they get so hungry...
haha thats  funny where are you from sir
I was placed at Camelot for a time, but it was a very silly place, so I headed out in search of adventure!  Which, perhaps, was not my *best* plan...
I see I after the  grail myself  I could use a companion

Y-you too seek the Grail?  I did not think any other was questing.  Well, I heard of one so called King, but he had no horse, only pranced about with coconuts, so I wasn't sure whether to take any stock in it.
I do I think its gonna be our salvation
So it is written!  Well, it is good to have an ally.  I had heard of a tower of fair maidens that may hold the key to the next step in our quest.  Shall we venture there together?
Yes , plus I can always love to see a fair maiden or two

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Anything else, M'lady?
Are the sheets cleaned and ironed? How about the curtains?
Everything is as you wish, Queen. Now... If I could just be going... I have an appointment to keep.
An appointment to keep? You are still on duty with me. I need a new cushion for this throne. What are your suggestions?

I believe the king requires extra soft cushions as he spends so much time reading there. It would be more comfortable. I know M'lady prefers finer silks, but I do not believe such would hold up with the use the throne gets. Now, could I please go? You did say that I would be off early tonight so that I could go to the barn raising dance.
You may go after you obtain this cushion I need. You just got here. Do not be in a rush...
Which curtain would you prefer I fetch, your highness?
Cushion... the King's cushion. I believe I should start looking for your replacement.
I am so sorry, your majesty. Right, the cushion. Silly me. I am just so excited for this dance tonight... the stable boy will be there, and...
No need to discuss this with me. Hurry on and get that for me so you can leave. I do not like to be rushed, for I am the Queen.
Which cushion is that then?
You are asking me details we have already discussed.

Yes, m'lady... That was the King's cushion, then. Yes, I remember now. So sorry.... The stable boy is just so charming, your majesty. What should I say to him? Should I wait for him to speak to me? Oh, I am just so distracted.
If you come back with something incorrect, you will not be talking or going anywhere tonight!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Man it's been rough the past few days with our kingdom going to war. how are you holding up?

I am sorry my job has not gotten us better accomodations but we must always put a smile on our faces correct
As long as we have each other we are much stronger.
Well let me eat some of our delicous food and then maybe I can make a few coins doing jokes for the local people
Good idea. I am so happy the King lets us do this for extra coin.
Would you like to come along and you can maybe be a part of the performance. It could be fun and definitely better than staying here with our smelly food.
I'll try but i am no performer. If anything i'll practice trying to learn how to read.
All you have to do is follow my lead and joking and fun will come naturally
Hmm.. alright like i said, i'll try.
Oh and please don't be offended if you are a part of the joke sometime.  It is all in good fun

I guess, I will just put it back then....BUT HOW WILL I GET FOOD WIZARD?!

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Look at those eggs... We got dinner tonight!
Yes, I spent all afternoon collecting them. 4 dozen in total!
Here! give them to your wife. Any news from your son?
No, he has been gone for three weeks now on a trip. I hope he's okay...
I'm worried about him too. The king got more crazy everyday. Who knows what he is up to?
I might even go out to get him, peace is not something to take for granted in these days.
Not the best idea... but we might have to do it. count me in if you are going. I don't want to stay any longer in this kingdom
Would you like to accompany me?
Sure.. but we probably should lower our voice.... you know... the walls have ears
Ok, pack your things.... We will leave tomorrow afternoon before sunset.
Or should we leave at dawn? Yesterday John was captured by the guards for passing the city limit.
Yes, that is a better idea. Let me go and pack now.
I'll get this milk to my kids
Take some more, I wont need it

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Look at this crystal waters washing up on this beach! Could you ask for a better place in the world to visit?
Truly, a respite from the troubles of the world
Please rest assured that I will be keeping you safe during your visit. Where are you from, originally?
I grew up in a village near Pasama, to the West. What brings you here, sir knight?
Ah- I serve the King. He has asked me to protect these premises during your visit.
Is this a dangerous land to pass through? It seems hard to imagine
No, no. We rarely see any trouble here. But there have been some bandits seen wandering the beach lately, looting a few shops. The King did not want to take any chances.
Of course. I am grateful for your presence. What is your name, sir knight?
I am William of the family Chester. My father was a knight, and his father before him.
Well met. I am Daros
Daros, I recommend you spend some time in the waters while you are visiting. They are quite warm and calm this time of year.
Have you been to this inn many times before?
I've never been to this beach house before, but I have come to this ocean front many times before, as a boy.
I see. It has been a while since I visited the village I grew up in ...

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Hello servant. Have you seen the little prince running around here?
I believe I heard him beckoning for the Queen, Your Highness.
Was he in trouble?!
I do not believe so. He was running about and ran into one of these spiderwebs and was a little upset about it, but he was fine.
haha he is still very young. Tell me did you finish your tasks for the day?
Not quite, Sire. I still need top mop the tower entrance yet. Is there something I can do for you
Yes I want you to polish my crown. Wait to mop later.
Of course, Sire. I'll polish it right away.
Good, make sure to use the right polish this time.
Of course, Sire. I didn't realize that the last container said Shoe Polish. Forgive me.
Ok now, tell me where you're from boy.
Where I'm from? What do you mean? My mother is the Queen's handmaiden.
I wondered if you were concieved outside this kingdowm. You look like a northerner.
Mom always told me I was conceived by the Prince. Oh, wait.... I wasn't supposed to say that.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: I'm not sure why we get such a bad rap around here, Mosquito.
"For real. We're just two working bugs, trying to get by!"
Exactly! And so what if you like blood and I like rotten flesh! We're just doing what God created us to do!
"Really, it's the human's fault they get itchy when I drink from them. Or God's fault for making them itch!"
Precisely! This is just what I say, my friend! And I couldn't help nibbling on the King's wound the other day. I had no idea he had a cut on his leg! I was only trying to help!
"Hey, I hear doctors are even using maggots to help patients! You were doing the King a favor!"
Exactly! That's what I tried to tell them. But do they listen? No!
"It's just pesticide this and flyswatter that. We're all part of God's plan, aren't we? Humans are so cruel."
*munch munch* And I try to keep all this rotten flesh eaten so they don't have to deal with it!
"Exactly! Humans never appreciate what we do to help them! And if we take a bit of blood or flesh now and again, that's just fair, innit?"
Precisely! Ain't we God's creations, just like them? They're always praying to God, but do they pray for us? Noooo!
"We should go to the church and ask to be represented! I've heard that dogs go to heaven, but what about insects?"
Oh, my friend, it is so true! Why are we not considered? Where are our lands? Where are our rights?
"Humans are so self-centered! It's all about them and 'Man's best friend'! What do dogs even do! They carry fleas and fleas are much more harmful to humans than we are!"

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: If you've come to kill me, you are not the first and you will not be the last.

Oh, I apologize for the misunderstanding sir.  I was referred to you by the Queen on the understanding you had some work for me.  I can understand how my current garb may be a bit off putting to one enduring frequent assassination attempts such as yourself.

Ah, yes, yes. The assassin friend of my wife. Yes. Alright, well you see there is a wily and mistrustful man out for my head whom I wish you to slaughter... he is my son of course. The fool wants to become King! As if he us up to the task, I tell you. Can't even get an assassination attempt right. Please kill him for me, if you would.
Certainly sir!  Would you care for the five star package, the three star package, or the discount package?
I don't have time for your pageantry, wretch. Tell me about your various deals or I will be forced to higher a more concise assassin to kill the boy AND you.
Well, the 5 star deal is 10 gold pieces, and allows you to fully specify the manner of death, or if you would rather him brought in alive for you to deal with as you please.
Hmm... interesting... But the murder budget is tight this season, so on with the other star packages.

Three star allows me to choose the manner of death, though it may result in undue suffering, as well as collateral civilian casualties.  A finger, toe, or eye will be delivered complementary as proof of the deed, your choice.
His eye strikes me as quite poetic. He has lovely blue eyes like his mothers... Alas, I cannot waste coin on his murder, so perhaps explain the final package.

The final package is only a single coin, but you will need to agree that the contract will be considered fulfilled even if it only results in a maiming or amputation.  You can take this package as many times as you like, though after four or five failures there is, to be honest, very little of the target remaining intact.

How about two coin, you perhaps maim him instead of full-on murder him of course, but perhaps leave a note by his side that reads, "Don't cross Papa, boy." I can provide such parchment, of course. Agreed?
Certainly sir!  Which limb/organ would you like him to lose?  It can be gift wrapped and delivered to you for only twelve copper more.

Blast! Stop it with your infantile add-ons. I will not pay a piece more! Just maim whatever bit you like, and leave the blasted note! I am only agreeing to such a deal because of its cheapness, and because his dear mother would probably be less cross with me if he was only made lame rather than made... well... dead, of course.
Then it is arranger Sir King!  Two gold pieces, and it will be done you command, or my name is not Discount Assassination Tim!

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: My king, what are you doing down here in this filth?
Filth? These are riches! See the treasures I'm smearing all over me? They smell like.... like gold!
Here i'll take that than. You look rich enough.
Would you like some of this, too? You'll be rich! Rich, I tell you!
No sir, I am not particuliarly fond of those riches.
Here's my royal scepter! It's worth millions!
That is a beautiful piece my king.
You take it! I got it just for you!
...Thanks. How long have you been down here?
Oh, a few nights, I think. See that rat? It's my friend. I named him Egon.
I do see him. he seems about as happy as you.
Yes, yes! He is, he is!
Tell me king, where are the treasure of the kingdom? A friend of mine was wondering..
Buried under the privy, of course!
action: steal crystal ball from mad king

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Are you studying this place sir?
Yes I am... You can see this bones belong to an unusual large creature. A giant I would say
A giant?! How do you know?
I will take it back. You have no business in this place
You have more of a right than me. Don't make me laugh.
This is an ancient graveyard. This bones are very important for science
Why do you have this?
It is to assist me with this bones. What are you doing in this place? The Duke told me to lead a mission in this place
I am here to collect some bones to make tooks out of.
No you are not going to steal a valuable knowledge. You better get out of this place. You don't know about the curse then..
Woah there. Hold your horses. You don;t want to fight with me.
What is this?? What inside the pot? Where did you get it?
It was used by the king to go to the bathroom....
Fool! Did you know that this pot is used by KING Frederick?!

agents: goat for company for the horses

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

character: a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses

a goat for company for the horses
speech: *baaaa*
Woof woof... you're welcome for killing that fox the other day.
He was a nuisance! *baaa*
He was not alone there are more out there. You need to be careful.
How long will you stay around the stable to help us?
As long as the King is here. i follow him.
We are glad! You have been of tremendous help!
Thanks! I am the best in all the ladn, you know?
Is that so? What feats have you pulled?
I have captured and killed the fastest animals in the area. Deer, boars, and anything else the King is looking to eat.
Boars?! They are like mini tanks!
Theya re tough to bring down. The trick is to wear them out.
Huh! You must have quite a lot of stamina!
Yes it took me awhile to get used to this life.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: I am the countess and deserve to be the Queen, not like my no-good sister!
Well, I'm sure I know nothing about any of that. I'm just a guest visiting the kingdom.
Well, you are sitting in my sitting room, so you will let me jabber on as I please!
Fair enough. Tell me, what makes your sister so undeserving?
She is the most ungrateful arrogant self-absorbed b . . .witch you will ever meet!
Well she sure sounds terrible. How did she come to be queen if she's so terrible?
She is apparently more conventionally attractive than I!  Do you believe it?
One becomes queen just by being beautiful?  My, this truly is a strange kingdom isn't it.
Well, the King does value large . . . tracts of land over wits.
Well, if you were to be more sensible than that, I agree that you should be in charge!
Thank you for your support!  Where did you say you were headed again?

I'm actually a visiting merchant, heading in to the market to try and peddle some potions and the like.  After a long journey, though, I'm going to need a good night's rest before a long day of selling tomorrow.
What sorts of potions?  You are full of surprises!
Mostly things for increased vitality and the like. A few more rare ones, generally meant for more...specialized uses.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Hello sir what brings you here today
I am just here to ensure that those who choose to disobey our laws are properly punished. Has anyone been whipped today?
No not yet hopefully it will be a pious today
Hmm yes, that's good. Say, how long have you been a priest here? I don't think I've ever seen you before while doing my duties.
I am pretty new to this town but I have been a priest for 15 years
Oh, well welcome! I'm so glad that we're getting some new church leaders here.
its always good to have new blood and change of perception
So how do you like it so far here in our little village?
It seems to be nice and the people so far seem to be pious
Yes, that is true. But, and don't tell anyone that I said this, there has been an increase lately in the number of sinners who need to be punished. The King is very worried indeed.
Yes I had  a talk with him the other day, I will be giving some sermons to remind everybody there duty
Here, here is a list of known repeat sinners. Your village would appreciate if you reached out to them to try to entreat them to follow the word of God.
Yes, I will good thing I have my bible with me
Thank you so much, Priest. You are truly doing the Lord's work!

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Dog, what are you doing here?
I sometimes come in to keep a watch over prisoners like you
I am not a criminal though. I was in that traitorious group as a spy for the king.
You are here, aren't you?

setting.name: beach house
setting.description: the beach house is falling apart due to the storms, it's door is hanging and it's humid inside. There is no floor, just sand, and a hole to serve as the outhouse.
setting.background: the beach house is used for those who live in exile, it is said that the area is haunted with dead people over the years. It is forbidden to help anyone who lives there.

speech: Hello there, is that your message in a bottle over there?
No,but let us read it. Maybe it's a message from my family!
What does it say?
It says that they are lost and need help. It isn't from my family. I do not know. Do you know spider?
It must have washed in from the sea during the storm.
That is scary. I wish I could wash into the sea. I'm glad I have you here with me.
I can realte to that feeling. To be honest i hate other beings.
I was convicted of a crime I didn't commit and sent here to live alone.
That is depressing. What crime did they think you committed?
They think I plotted to kill the king. Since they didn't have concrete evidence they sent me here.
Were you plotting? You can tell me. I am jsut a lowly spider.
Oh never. I have always respected our king. I didn't question his advisors faith and believe that's why I am here.
Ah playing politics is a rough game i have heard.
Yes, I should have kept quiet and to my family. I knew better.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: We must whisper to avoid the echoes!  . . .echoes . . .echoes . . .
Indeed, we must keep our voices low. I wonder why they built this hall this way. I am sure it must be great for delivering sermons though.

That was likely the intent, but you are still hearing the first word of the sentence when you have just heard the last, then it proceeds into the next sentence . . . it is a terrible cacophony of sound.
I see, I am not sure if this is what the Pope had in mind when he built this. Say, here is the notebook you requested.
Ah thank you!  Can you believe we wrote these stories together when we were young? Seems like a lifetime ago, before the great war . . .
Ahh yes the Great War. Me and my friend used to come here and play with the echoes. The war took him from me...
I am so sorry Friend, I lost many that were close to me as well.
Such is the cost of war. What is that scroll in your hand? Are you learning some new form of wisdom?
It is a letter to the King, requesting an increase in the amount of charity he gives to the poor.  Even though it has been five years since the war, there is still ever so much need . . .
I see, the King has done a fine job bringing some wealth back into the Kingdom. All the people need right now is a friendly hand and some peace.
You see well friend, would you care to add your name to it?
Of course, I shall give what I can. Someone may need it more than me.
Thank you ever so much, and may the gods bless you always!
Now shall we have a bit of holy wine?

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Hello, Rebecca
Hello, Your Highness. Would you like the Show Room prepared for your guests?
I would. Thank you. Have you seen the king today?
Yes, I saw him in the royal library looking at books on fishing, I believe.
Thank you. Could you also please get a glass of water and take these books to the library?
Of course, Your Highness.
I appreciate it.
Oh dear- these books are on primitive torture methods. Are these for your guests?
Heavens no. My husband asked for them. How dreadful!
I'll head to the library and get you a glass of water. Is there anything else you need?
That is all. You are always such a help to me. Thank you.
I'm going to take the Prince with me! He always loves going to the library.
I think that's a wonderful idea! He is such a good son.
We are lucky to have you, Your Highness!

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Why is court taking place in this bone pit, again?
Between you and me, I'm not sure. My legal assistant requested it and I agreed because I couldn't be bothered to argue. But tell anyone and you'll be in there too!
I won't say anything! I wouldn't want to end up on one of these spikes.
You'll be fine. Ugh, this place stinks...
Yes, it does. Tell me, do you think the defendant is guilty?
Hmmm.... probably. There's plenty of thieves and murderers in the village, why would this guy be any different?
I don't know, he seems like an honest man. Although if you wish, I can try to convince the rest of the jury otherwise.
I don't really care either way. I'm in my castle and with war going on the people are restless anyway... this gives them a distraction whatever happens.
What will happen to him if he is found guilty?
Thrown into that pit and pecked to death by vultures. Ugh, it really does smell awful...
That pit is pretty foul, ugh. I would hate to be that guy.
Me too... well, don't let your compassion get the best of you. You're still a juror.
You're right. Since you had no special order for me, I will judge him fairly.
Excellent. You were a good selection for juror... reasonable, fair. I should look into what else you could do for me.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Have you come with news form the outlying villages?  Have you caught sight of the enemy?
I have much news to tell you, yes. If only you would offer me food or a bed for the night in exchange, I can tell you much news.
Certainly man!  But I see smoke in the distance, the enemy is almost upon us!
So hand over whatever rations you have, and I will tell you of the approach!
Here man, take it!  I can hear the screams of the refugees as they run towards us!

There are forty men on horseback and ten on foot. They have torches and crossbows. However, I noticed upon running up the hill side that they have a weakness in their left ranks, as some of the horses are badly injured. Perhaps this information is of use to you. Thank you for the food, good sir.
Excellent!  Thank you citizen - you may have saved many of your kith and kin.  Seek shelter now, this may get ugly.
I... I want to fight! I heard soldiers receive housing and hot meals, is this true? I am willing to take up arms against the invaders.
Here lad, take this bow, and do your best to hit the enemy.  If you prove yourself, I can vouch for you and have you enlisted in the King's company.
Thank you, kind solider! I will fight valiantly along side you. In the name of the King!
FOR THE KING!

They're approaching. I see the men upon horse back have broken ranks with the foot soldiers and are fast approaching. Maybe three or four have gone down, but the bulk lot is charging us with flaming arrows.
Aim for the largest ones first!  If they fall, the rest of the mongrels will flee.
Aye! I think I have one in my sigh- I'VE BEEN HIT! HELP! I'M BURNING!

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: Do you have a sermon ready for this afternoon's service?
Priestess, I am struggling to come up with the words for it. My mind has been foggy since morning.
Well, tell me what you have and perhaps I can give you some assistance.
I started of by praising the Lord and addressing the concerns of the people regarding the Great War. But I do not know how to comfort them with words.
Comforting can only go so far; what can you offer the people to help aid their needs? It is the Temple's duty to provide assistance, is it not?
You are quite right. But with the lack of weddings and baptisms during wartime, the people have little avenue for togetherness.
Perhaps it is time for a new religious festival. Something to honor the souls lost in the War.
A festival, you say? Hmm that might actually be great idea. May I ask that you request some funds from the King for this festival?
Hey, now why do I have to ask?! I had to ask him last time...
Well, Priestess. Its just that it might look better coming from you. You being the High Priestess of the Church of course.
If you insist. We'll need a name for this festival. Any ideas?
Thank you! I can envision it now.. yes.. it should be 'A Festival of Faith'.
That does have a nice ring to it.
I am sure people will be curious when they read the name and won't be able to help themselves!

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Where do you plan to sail to next, sir?
Wherever the sea takes me! Did you pull in a good catch overnight?
There weren't as many fish as usual this week. I wonder if the water conditions are poor.
The water is fine, I'll tell you it's the sea monsters that drive the fish away!
Sea monsters don't exist! However, I'll make a bet with you, catch the sea monster and I'll feed you all the fish you want free for life!
Obviously you have only fished with one foot safely still on land. If you had dared to venture into the deep, dark, unforgiving waters, you'd be lucky to return to land with your soul intact.
Show me these deeper waters. You'll need an expert catcher to grab a sea monster!

You fool! To attempt to catch a sea monster is certain, unpleasant death! The sea monster would toy with your body and keep you at the brink of death forever. People like you should avoid the sea because you do not have a healthy respect for it.
We will distract the sea monster by feeding it this useless thief, and then we will be able to catch it!
We? Don't include me in your idiotic scheming! Stay in the Dock unless you'd rather end up in prison or the bottom of the sea!

Then I will continue fishing here, and hope the fish come back. Show me proof of your sea monster though, I still don't believe it exists. There must be some reasonable explanation for the reduction in available fish that doesn't involve fantasy.

My presence here is proof enough! I hid the purpose of my mission from you before...I am a sailor appointed by the king to protect his explorers from the sea monster as they journey to the other side of the world.
In service to the king? Well then, take today's catch as tribute.
Finally, something useful from you. And promise you will stay safely on land until the professionals vanquish the monster!

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Ugh, how come these birds keep getting in here?!
I am the King's Hawk.  I am allowed to hunt wherever I wish for rabbits.
Do you have proof of that? Do you have golden talons like the legends say?
No . . . but that would be pretty awesome if I did huh?
You say you are hunting for rabbits. My weapon room is the cleanest in town, you will find no rabbits here.
Are you sure?  What if some snuck in while you were sleeping?
Then they would get chopped in half by my sword! Ha Ha!
Well, next time you do split one in half, can you share it with me?  I do so love the taste of fresh rabbit.
Since you're the royal hawk, I could do that for you. I don't want the king to come knocking at my door.
I can see things that are really far away.  I can look at things for you in payment.
I don't think anyone would dare attack me, as I have been trusted by the king to equip his soldiers for many years already. The guards will protect me.
Well, what if there are assassins lurking in the woods?  I could claw their eyes out.
That sounds fun, but how can you tell assassins apart from honest citizens?
Good question . . . claw first and ask questions later just to be safe?

setting.name: Clearing
setting.description: Few trees surround the area.  There's a low section of the grass on the floor along with some stone boulders.
setting.background: This is an area where there are few trees, allowing sunlight to come through.  Animals take advantage of this area by basking in the sun.

speech: Such a beautiful day for a mouse!
Hello mouse. It is a beautiful day. I am here to speak to the animals.
How wonderful! We are so honored you came.
Oh yes. I am the highest of the priest. I am the only one who can speak to the animals. Have you seen anything out of ordinary?
I haven't. Is there supposed to be?
I do not know. I am just checking.  Times are scary. I am trying to protect all.
Why are times scary, Father? What do you mean?
War is upon us animal.  I thought it was over after The Red Wedding, but I was wrong.
Oh dear. I had no idea. What happened at the Red Wedding?
Oh the King in the North died.  Let's not talk about that.
Ok, I'm sorry, Father.
Have any other priests been here?
Not since last week, Sir.
What were the doing? No other priests are to come here.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Oh horse, it is so hard preparing to be the next king
*neigh*
You have been such a loyal horse
*neighs in gratitude*
Look at your dirty stable. I must clean it for you.
*neighs* You? Why not have a stable hand do it?
Because you have been a faithful friend who carries me to see my loving subjects.
*neighs*
Here use this as a blanket as I clean.
*neighs in thanks*
These are beautiful hanging tapestries in your building.
*neighs* You provided them!
Your gratitude is appreciated. Move over so I can get the corner
*neighs as I move over*

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Where are your parents at?
My parents told me to go for a walk, so here I am.
I see. You need to be careful wandering the town square alone.
Why is that, Sir?
I have seen a lot of bandits around here stealing and getting into fights. I'm sure your parents wouldn't want you to get harmed.
Oh my! Thank you so much. What is your name?
Katia. What is yours? That food sure looks delicious.
It is. My name is Timmy. What brings you to the town square?
I must beg for scraps of food. I have no job and I barely eat.
Oh no! How terrible. Please have some of mine.
Thank you. Are you sure your parents won't get mad at you for giving your food away though?
They will not. They always taught me to share.
Awh. You have very kind parents. I wish the King was half as nice. He is always looking down on me and my fellow peasants.
He is? Why?

setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: How many more men must I bury before this blasted war ends?
Hopefully no more. The graveyard is falling apart.
Well, with all funds being diverted to the war effort, it's not much of a surprise is it?
We just have to do the best we can to give the fallen some dignity.
Ah, Billy Sprouts.  Fastest lad in the village.  Not fast enough to outrace arrows apparently.
Too many young men have give their lives for this country.
Aye, and have ye ever lost anyone close?
My son is still to young to be a soldier and I hope this war ends before he's old enough.
Well, it have been what, near twenty years already?  Good business for me, but not for the Kingdom I daresay.
You're nearly running out of room though.
Aye, soon we'll have to be doubling up.  Not right, but the neighbours won't give up any more land for burials.
I'll have to speak to the king about seizing their land and giving them a fair payment.
Would you?  That would be so very kind of you.
It's least I can do for those that made the ultimate sacrifice.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Queen, did you summon me? I am at your service!
I'm not the queen. I'm her most loyal servant. I was tol to meet her here. Wait, if we both thought we were supposed to meet her here....is she missing?
Is that right? The maid seems to have misinformed me. I wonder why we have been brought here together.
The maid isn't capable of doing something to the queen on her own. Someone must be behind this. Have you heard any talk against the queen?
Perhaps you're right. Yes I heard whispers in the corridors this evening, but I waved them away...
They must be behind this. Who was it? I will kill every single one of them if I have to. I am no losing the queen today
It was a strange looking fellow, wearing a spectacle and a chain clock. I wonder if he was an assassin
It's going to be ok. Together we can save the king. Come, lead me to where you saw this man.
We better be quick. I saw the man just outside the hallway of the Queen's Quarters. We must alert the guards.
We need to do this on our own. We don't know who else is involved in the conspiracy. Can you handle that?
It is above the intelligence of an unread servant like me but I shall try sir. We do not know yet it the guard are conspiring too...
It's above mine too but I know if we work together we will save the queen and the kingdom today. You won't be a servant much longer. You'll be a hero
I hope so, I am tired to cleaning the Castle with this rag all day. Now, let us keep our voices low, lest there be anyone outside eavesdropping
I'm sure there are eavesdroppers. This had to go veery far and wide for the queen to be kidnapped.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Now that the King is dead I can finally rule on my own.
At least he can't look down on me now..
No, thank you for disposing him for me.  Which Earldom was it that you wanted?
I care bit my lady, I would just be happy to no longer be a peasant.
Come now, tell me the Earldom you seek, and it shall be yours.
I suppose I would like Yankstontownhillbradshire.
That is a mouthful, and very unpopular with the Crier.  It shall be yours, arise, Earl . . . wait, what was your name again?
My name is Bobsonhamptondorf.
Arise Earl Bobsonhamptondorf of Yankstontownhillbradshire!  I shall call the Bob of Yank for short.
Thank you your highness.
Well then, let us be off Bob of Yank.
Yes lets, this cemetery gives me the creep.
Which way to the exit?
Right this way my lady.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: My love! What say you during this fine day?
Who are you been dallying with? I haven't seen you in awhile!
The usual. I've been meeting with my advisers, all of whom seem to be a burden than a help
What about this winter? We have to see about the provisions needed to survive!
We're fine. I've told the farmers to re-double their efforts or face the consequences. We've faced winters before, what makes this one so special?
You know we lost some child and elderly last winter due to our lack of preparation. Don't you remember?!
