My lady - some of us must suffer for the rest of us to survive. You know that's how the world works. Don't go soft on me now
I'd slap you if my bodice wasn't so tight.
You test me, woman. It's been a long day already. I say you get ready for bed now. And we can send your lady in waiting away
Actually, lady, fetch me some more mead. Mine is stale already.
Ah yes, more drink for the missus. Not concerned with others who go without mead are we?
At least I don't go on hunting trips that last two weeks!
Running this country is no easy feat. I would hold my tongue lest you bear the consequences. I gave this to you and I can take it away.
Let's not say anything we will regret tomorrow. You are right, we should get ready for bed.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Can you believe the Nerve of the Earl of Northampton walking in to court smelling as he does?  Disgraceful!
Oh, but he is such a sweet, sweet man. He works hard in the day. Surely he deserves some slack.
Some slack?  Not when it comes to my royal nose!
He is a handsome, hard-worker for this kingdom!
Is he though?  Name one thing he has done.
He works as a guard for the King. How could you not know? He is in training.
You must be mistaken, that is far too lowly a task for an earl.
What do you mean?!
The nobility do not debase themselves as such.
Suppose he was on his way from training to clean himself up... then what?
Are you addled?  Just because one trains does not make someone a guard!
You are speaking about a man who has given his life and freedoms to the King. Yet, you are so ungrateful for how these men protect you. Without them, your kingdom would crumble!
*Sigh* Guards, cast this one in the Oubliette.  She talks too much and thinks too little.
I am a personal assistant to the King. You will never get rid of me...

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Sir watcher, how art thou?
I am well, but weary. I hear of an oncoming attack.
Any whispers of who has it in for us?
The kingdom over. The king is hungry for power.
He shall not find it here. The King's family has served the people for one hundred years. A lesser king with a hunger for power will not make it past the gates!
I have watched and watched, but I see not activity from the other side.
Perhaps they are planning a sneak attack?
Perhaps... but from where?
I've heard rumors of flying machines, do you believe in them?
Those things they call planes?!
I've not heard that term, do those fly in the air as if by magic?
They have some special type of engine and design. I hear about them being made all the time.
Have you seen one with your own eyes?
I have not. I feel sometimes that I hear them but never see them.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Halt you knave!  What business have you here?
Shh I am hiding...
Well not here you're not!  The Kings should be back any minute.
Exactly just be quiet for a minute!
Well, I don't think you should be here.  You don't look like his Minister of Relaxation to me.
Just look at me I am very relaxed.
No, you wear too many clothes to be one of the King's ministers.  Please leave, I don't want to get in trouble.
I swear he is expecting me.
Not like that he isn't!  If you want to be a minister you'll have to dress like one.
Alright, just give me a moment to change,
Let me know when you're finished, I'll hide my eyes.
Oh just a moment don't peek.
Still have my eyes closed, are you nearly done?
-slashes throat- Next is the king!

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: And how are you today boy?
Tired, I think I eat too much. Also, I just peed on the bed, but you always forgive me so I don't feel bad about it.
Well you are a good boy despite being so pudgy.
*Bark* You're my favourite out of all the humans!
Even more than the king?
Well, I'm your dog, not his.  I poop on his throne sometimes to show my dominance.
How does he respond?
Not very well, he shouts at me, I bark at him.  He hits me, I bite him.  He starts bleeding and runs away, I eat the poop.  Pretty standard really.
Why do you eat it though?
Well, I think it might taste good.  Sometimes it does, it depends on what I last ate though.
I had never considered doing such a thing, personally I quite like the King he has been very good to me.
Well yes, but if he hit you, wouldn't you try to bite him?
I suppose I would, I wish you two would get along.
Well, if he wouldn't yell at me there wouldn't be any issues.  The hitting has to stop too.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: What are you doing in my bed chambers?
Sent here to seduce you oh King!
What in the thousand gods are you talking about? You better explain yourself or I will have your head!
The Queen said that since you didn't want to spend time with her, you could spend time with me instead!  I would much rather be out hunting with my crossbow though.
I won't spend time with the queen because she is a spoiled brat. This is none of your business, though!
Well, does that mean you don't require my services?
Well, since you're here.. hold this lamp while I walk to the kitchen to get a late night meal.
Certainly sire.
You said earlier that you are good with crossbows, aye?
Yes, one of the best shots.  I hunt to feed my village.
Would you like to join the best marksmen in the kingdom? Assuming you can prove yourself, of course.
But of course, what must I do to prove myself?
You have to win the archery tournament next sunday.
It shall be done . . . but only if crossbows are also allowed.  I'm only so-so with a bow.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: It appears you need some guidance.
Huh? I've never seen an angel before.
Perhaps you have never needed to see one?
Why do I need an Angel now? Have I done something wrong?
Well it would seem that one amongst you plans harm.
Someone in my land plans to harm me? Who?
The duke of Eastshire I am afraid.
What!? I can't believe it. He has been my friend for many years.
Friends close, enemies closer. That is a human saying.
I suppose. Has he always wanted to harm me? or is it a recent change in him? Surely you must know?
He has plotted these past two years now and intends to move soon.
Well if you are here to help, how do I stop him from attacking? This is still so surprising, I am a very respected King in this land.
Sometimes the more respected you are the more those around you grow with envy. You must send the guards to apprehend him right away.
Thank you kind Angel for warning me. I will send my guards at once.

setting.name: Old Gnaisha's
setting.description: Old Gnaisha's is a rather ramshackle little building which advertises itself in faded letters as a perfume shop. The first room is indeed a perfume shop, but peel back the ornately woven green curtain at the back, and you'll find Old Gnaisha's true stock in trade �in shelves and shelves and yet more shelves of magical artifacts of every kind. Blessed talismans, cursed amulets, potion ingredients, and more! The place is dingy and a bit smelly, but Old Gnaisha has amassed a staggering variety of wares.
setting.background: Gnaisha used to be a treasure hunter, but after a nasty Manticore night out an end to that, she discovered her true calling hawking weird, wonderful and horrible magical items. Old Gnaisha has been here for decades, and if you don't bother her, she won't bother you. On the other hand, as that one carpet merchant found out to his sorrow, a wise man doesn't antagonize someone with so many magical things at her disposal...

speech: Hello vendor. What are you selling?
I have this pouch full of silk. Do you want to buy it?
They are very nice, but I'm afraid all I have on me is this bone.
Is that the old bone from the king of last century?
Yes, I believe so. Is it of some value?
Not for someone like you. But I've heard stories of his greatness my whole life and it would be an honor to own his bone
Alright, so we trade, the bone for the pouch of silk?

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: I am glad you are with me Brother - soon I shall conquer a Kingdom for you to rule for your very own.
Yes, we  shall conquer all that eye sees
Shall it be the Kingdom of the Elves, or that of the Dwarves?
The dwarves they have all the gold
Right!  So what tactics should we use?
Well I think we  can use our vast navy to blockade any food from reaching them
Good plan brother!  Their mountain fortresses will bow before the might of our navy.
yes they will
Anything else?
well we do need to send some harrasement troups to keep moral low
The slave caste perhaps?  They are usually hungry for blood.
yes this would be wise
SHould you lead them?
it is up to my brother but I would love the chance to prove my self

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: King, I come to you to serve.  I have led many men through many hard times, do you have work for me?
indeed i want everyone wiped out that does not bow to my thrown
I see, that is not my usual line of work but anyone who disrespects the throne shall taste the wrath of my blade!
You tell your warriors to gear up.  I have heard rumbling from each corner of our land that do not honor what we stand for!
I shall, my liege.But first, shall we eat? We cannot let this beautiful banquet hall go to waste!
Yes these are the fruits of our labor enjoy them to the fullest.  Should I call over a wench for you as well?
Ah yes, I could use a wench after my long journey here.  Do you happen to have any of the apothecary's growth serum by chance?
Not here but I shall see to it that you and your men are provided with what you need
Thank you, my king.  Your generosity is surely appreciated!  Now, let us discuss what to do with these traitors you spoke of..
I want an example made of them.  Bodies burned so the stench travels miles to the others who dare disrepect us!
As you wish, my king.  I shall ready the men at once and have the traitors' leader to you by the morrow!
I knew I could count on you
Of course, anything for my lovely king!  I do need a set of armor and a weapon though, your guards stripped me of mine...
well this is a formal dinner it shall be returned upon your exit you have my word

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Well, the King told us to guard you, but I don't like the look of this, not one bit.
The art is this place is absolutely splendid!
And spooky . . . and likely haunted.
But the sculptures are amazing! I've donated a lot of coin to the local artists but the talent on display is incredible.
I'm pretty sure if you take something you will be cursed by the guardians of the tombs.
You are probably right!
Best leave a coin to beseech their forgiveness for our trespass here.
That's a great idea!
Oh mighty spirits, we know not what we do, but we promise to leave very, very quickly . . .
Surely we can linger a bit...
I am far too nervous.
Oh surely I don't need to leave this.
Put it back you fool!
But I put it there in the first place!

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Say do you know anyone who cleans clothes?
I do not why do you ask?
Well I need to look decent for when I visit the king.
The king? When will you be meeting him? I am just a fisherman but I would love to meet the king
I have to go see him in two days.
What is the occasion?
I am distantly related to him and he summoned for me.
Here is my shirt you can use this to wash with
Thank you very much for your help in the matter, you said you would be interested in meeting him?
I have this sail cloth also you can have it may help.  Yes indeed us fisherman have so many products he may want to purchase the freshest fish available they are delicious
He does like to hear from the people and get their ideas as how to better the kingdom.
Sure what did you have in mind?
Well I figured since you helped me, perhaps you would like to come along?
Absolutely I would love any chance to meet his Highness

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Something you need my king?
Yes, I am afraid I seem to have blocked both toilets.
Your stools are quite large my king.
Indeed!  I must apologize though, it smells very much of low tide in there at the moment.
Have you considered that you may need more fiber?
Yes, but I am the King!  I have commanded my bowels to obey, but they are most rebellious it seems.
I know, just look at them it is sticking straight out of the seat.
Perhaps I should summon the royal sculptor to commemorate this moment?  I must admit, I am rather proud of my creation.
It may just be called for sire, tis quite a load.
Indeed!  How would you say that your best compares?
Well I am very petite, it pales in comparison.
That is a shame, I was thinking of perhaps starting a Kingdom-wide competition?
I wonder if any man could best you?
I had the same thought myself - though I wish it to be a very modern competition, women may enter as well if they so choose.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Such a beautiful sunset, it is a shame the king is not here to see it.
That it is, he would like it.
Why is he not with us tonight, my queen? I sure worry about him sometimes!
He always seems to be busy with matters of the kingdom.
What is the matter today?  I thought he had a relaxing evening scheduled with you...
Something just always comes up.
I understand.  Do you know how our battles on the Eastern frontier are going? I worry for our soldiers in arms.
From what I have been told it is going well, I do hope I can get a new throne cushion out of him cancelling on me tonight.
It is getting dark, my queen.  Shall I help you inside?
Alright, I do believe my headache has passed that would be fine.
We may also stay out here if you would like, the swans usually come to the lake around twilight
It has been ages since I have gotten the chance to watch them.
Then let us stay.  This time of year they sing for their mates.  It is a stunning song!
I do agree, at least I have some company.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: hello sherrif what kind of criminals do we have today
The kind we need to hang!
Well as you know I always win so you know they will get convicted when I am the lawyer
Criminals always lose around here. I make sure of it.
You and me both
I am glad I can count on you to help me deliver swift justice. We need to schedule some beheadings for tomorrow. We rounded up some bandits this morning.
I am glad to hear it these bandits keep me in business.  I will be swift and they will go down hard
And headless.
hahaha they will be beheaded if we have anything to say about it!
When you see the King next be sure to put in a good word for me. Let him know he can count on me to keep the town safe and the bandits in check!
I will be sure to pass the word and thank you for your great work
I would do anything to keep the town safe.
Me as well we make a great pair I am sure the king would be proud
I appreciate all your help!

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Good morning my king.
Hello priest. I really enjoy our talks out here in the church garden.
As do I my king, I trust all is well.
Yes, of course. I think that your gardens are even more beautiful than mine. What is your secret?
It is all in the manure.
Haha! Then what are you feeding those horses, pray tell?
To be honest with you we have them trim the grass near the cemetery, I know it sounds odd but it works.
MOther nature works in mysterious ways that I will never understand.
That it certainly does sire.
Forgive me if I take off my crown and get comfortable. It is not often that I get to relax among friends.
I can only imagine that it must be tiring on the neck.
Well, you should know. I've seen the funny hat that they make you wear around town. Try on the crown if you like, let's see how it looks.
Ah I do despise wearing that thing.,..
Well, I'm sure the Queen and my minions are looking everywhere for me. I look forward to seeing you at service this Sunday.

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: This place sure is creepy...
Yeah I think I'm lost. Can you take me to the king?
I do not know the way there. I just came here hoping to find some food.
I don't like it here. Do you know how to get out? I'll give you food if you can get me out of here
I could lead you I suppose, as long as I get the food anyway.
Yeah absolutely. I have some chicken back in my room
Well that sounds great!
Wait before we go, has this thief been following you?
Wait, who is that? I did not notice him before.
Hold on let me take care of him
Thank you I cannot say I have the strength to fight, the hunger has drained me.
I think he won't bother us anymore. Now let's get out of here before we have to eat that gross bread
Oh yeah, I hate moldy bread.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: -runs around in a circle-
*Chases dog in a circle* Who;s a good boy?  You're a good boy!
How did you know?
Because you are the Prince of Canines!  Hear, I made this crown for you - it's a miniature version of mine!
Well thank you kindly! I have always wanted one.
And this scepter!  Now you're like a doggo mini-me!  So cute!
Gee and here five minutes ago I was but a simple dog.
And now you are the Prince of Dogs!  I am going to get the royal painter to make a portrait of you.
Do I always get dog servants?
What a fabulous idea!  How many dog servants would you like?
I believe two would suit my needs.
Then two you shall have!  Any breed in particular?
Something elegant I think, like a bichon frise?
Wonderful!  Would you like some human servants as well?

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: King!
Another weak enemy, hah!
It is I your archenemy Krumpus Dumplestumper!
Shall we duel? I am not afraid of you.
Yes let us do it!
Take this, you weakling!
Yes, but now I am the king!
Hahahah! Do you really think wearing the crown makes you king? Fool!
Well of course, it works for you does it not?
Give that back!
Hahahah never, you shant defeat me!
will have your head. I will hand it over these doors.
Say what you like but I will marry your daughter!
Hic! sorry I am a little bit tipsy. But you shall know, my daughter won't marry a headless man!

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: <Flies up to the top of the tree> You won't be catching me, predator!
I am not looking for you bird!  I do not harm the other creatures of the North Forest.
That is good to know. What are you looking for then?
I hunt the humans of the city to the south when they stray too far from the safety of the walls.
Ah I see. I'm usually up at the castle and the young price and princess take care of me there. I am out to stretch my wings before flying back
The princess and prince you say?  I sure would love to get a tast...errr, meet them someday!
Hmm I will have to warn them of you.
Bird of many colors, I ask you not to.  For if they learn of my presence the king will send his best men after me.  I am just trying to survive like you.
Well then you must promise that you will not harm them.
I shall not lay a finger on them, I promise.
Very well, then I will not tell them of your presence for now
Thank you my friend.  Is there anything I can do for you in return?
Not right now. I'll let you know if I think of something.
So, do the prince and princess ever come outside of the walls to play?

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Oink!  Where did you go sorceress!
what nonsense are you speaking
My sorceress!  My owner!  I am a magical hog.
ok, I think you ate some  bad food
Well I think you're rude!
you are funny guyhaha
So what brings you here to the hunting grounds?
my master  wants to me to move some stuff around
Really?  And who might your master be
He is the master farmer for the king
Well, that really doesn't explain why we wants you moving stuff around the hunting grounds.
I don't ask questions I just do what I am told
I agree, you really don't seem like the question asking type.
Nope but I don't pretend a sorceress is  my master though

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: How are you doing today?
I am doing well, a little thirsty though.  How are you?
I came to gather some water myself.
As did I.  Though I have no bucket to bring any home to my family in the village.
I have a canteen I could let you borrow though it is not much?
Anything would help, stranger, or shall I call you friend?
I don't see why not us simple folk must stick together it is the only way to get ahead in this world.
Would you like to come meet my family? I am sure they would love to meet the man who provided them with water!
Sure I would love to, it is always nice to meet new folk.
Fantastic, but let me drink some more of this crystal clear water first.
What sort of town do you live in? My village has a bit of an unwarranted bad reputation itself.
I live in a quiet village to the North, we produce alcohol for the king in the capital.
Sounds like a quiet life.
Very quiet.  We have very few visitors outside of the tithe collectors and military men.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Time for some grub.
Food sounds delicious right now. Can't wait to try the Elk I killed earlier
I see, did you bring it here?
I brought it here and gutted it. Your chef was suppose to be cooking it up
Hmm, I just got here so maybe I just did not hear of it.
You're going to love it, sir. If he cooks it just right... it'll be the best meat you ever tasted.
Maybe they have it in the oven or something, where are the chefs anyway?
I don't know. Hopefully they're not having trouble.
I mean I do smell something cooking...
At least that's a positive sign. Hopefully it'll be done soon.
Maybe they took a break while waiting on it.
Maybe so. They better hurry up though.
The way I see it is, it is done when it's done. Trying to rush it would just spoil the meal.
That's true. So how is the Queen doing?

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: What brings you to these dunes, bishop?
I heard there was a need for a ceremony for the dead.
That would be due to my handiwork.
I see, offed them did you?
No, but it was my planning. There's never been a foe I couldn't out strategize!
A sharp mind is a dangerous thing after all.
Tis true! I am glad you are here. Someone need to focus on my dead. I must turn my attention to the living and the next battle.
Who is set to be your next foe?
The same foe with been fighting for weeks, our rival Kingdom to the west. This campaign is going to keep us both busy
They are a savage people are they not?
Absolute brutes! Totally uncivilized but they fight like mad. You should go west and convert them bishop.
The savage people are usually quite hard to bring to god, usually it just ends in people such as myself being killed.
And many brave soldiers. It's the price we must pay to keep our Kingdom safe. Long live our King!
Well someone has to do it and I take comfort in the fact that you do so well.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: What are you doing in here?
I came to check on the king, your highness
I see, in the bathroom.
We just received emissaries from the east, and i was told to come and inform him about their arrival
Hmm well go and find my father.
I'll do just that, is there anything you'll like me to help you with while I'm here?
No I am fine.
I'll be taking my leave now your highness
Ok well good to see you.
The pleasure was all mine
Of course.
Heard you'll be part of the emissaries travelling with the queen to the northern islands, is that true your highness?
Yes tomorrow night.
So i won't be seeing your lovely face for about a month

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Servant fetch me a drink!
Yes, sir. One moment.
'Tis hot in this foyer wearing armor such as this. You are luck your life is much easier.
I can only imagine, sir. Here you go. Here's your drink.
Aye thank you servant. Tell me what is your name and from whence do you hail?
My name is Peach, but you don't have to call me that. I hail from Georgia. That's a state in the USA.
Peach... like the fruit? 'Tis an odd name for a servant. How did you end up here ?
That's what my parents named me, eh. I ended up here because I moved here. My parents left me. The rest of the story is embarrassing. I just try to do my job now as a servant.
Well as long as you keep your head down and an agreeable manner I think ye shall fair quite well in this castle. You serve a very good Master who is generous and kind.
That's the goal, sir. I give it my all everyday.
Well you are doing good indeed. How long have you been at this post Peach?
Thank you, sir. And for a couple years now.
I will put in a good word with the King. Perhaps you could be moved up a bit.
That would be great, sir. I'd be very thankful for that.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Greetings, my Lady. Isn't the garden lovely today?
It is, very nice work.
Thank you. It's these fish; they make great fertilizer
I see, well very innovative of you sir.
Here's a tomato for you to snack on, my Lady. Have you seen Alice?
No, but thank you for the food.
Okay, I'll just shovel these fish into the earth around the vegetables.
Sounds like a good idea.
That's me, full of good ideas for the garden, mistress.
Well I will check on it again tomorrow.
Perhaps you could mention me to the King if he is looking for extra help in his own garden.
Of course, do not worry.
singing "Oh sweet Alice, someday we will be together... lalalalala"
Yikes I do not know if I can help.
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to Garden
put shovel in Baskets of freshly-caught fish

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hey..who is that?
Who are you speaking to?  I am the royal duke!
And I am the queen! You wont talk to me like that
Do you want to take over the kingdom or do you want the king to continue to disgrace the throne?
What sort of question is that? Are you suggesting my husband is not competent enough?
Do your grievances not cover these page? You are the one who suggested this idea in the first place!
I cant remember suggesting that!
What has gotten into you? We have everything we need to make this happen tonight!  Let us get this over with so our kingdom can once again prosper
I need to tell the king about this!
Do you want to end up like his previous wife?  Your head wouldn't look good on a spike...
hellllpppppp
Quiet!  We will all be killed if the king finds out!
I know nothing of what you speak of!
I am sure you don't remember this either then?  How could you forget our time together?

setting.name: the mysterious shop's entrance
setting.description: The shop has a look of mysterious foreign artifacts and luxuries, with silks and other materials adorning the walls. There are various trinkets from all around the world as well as spices of different colors and odors.
setting.background: The shop is stocked by goods traded through traveling merchants who have traveled to far away lands. It carries novel items that can't be easily found in other stores in the town.

speech: Come inside, is there anything that interests you?
I am shopping for my father, the King's head cook.
I see and what is it you are looking for a present perhjaps?
Here is a list. I am supposed to trade these fish and the basket of grain.
Yes, yes I can buy them they seem well enough.
The king is tight with his coin so my father must be too!
What were they looking to get in return?
The items on the list. Oh, this spice looks interesting! What is it?
Oh you mean the cayenne pepper?
I grow a few herbs in the kitchen garden but I am not familiar with this pepper. Is it hot?
Well if you are not used to spicy things it may be so for you, overall it is mild.
Intriguing. I don't eat a lot of spicy food in the castle.
Then I would suggest you have a drink ready.
Is it expensive?
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to merchant
give A basket of grain to merchant

setting.name: main gate
setting.description: The main gate is tall and strong enough to protect the mansion from invaders, and has large wooden doors reinforced by planks and steel sheets. There are two towers on either side of the gate for the town's watchmen to use as their post.
setting.background: The mansion's main gate is built to be strong enough to protect the royalty inside the mansion from robbers and invaders alike, who might try to batter down the gate. The gate can only be opened by two of the mansion's servants.

speech: Please cheer up sad woman.
Watchman, what do you know of sadness?
I see it every day, I must turn away the hungry just because I am told.
Why do you do as you are told when you could help the hungry?  What is more important?
If I don't do what I am told then I will be one of the hungry.

Then you would know true sadness.  You are given rations by the king, you have food on your table.  I can barely grow enough food in our garden to feed my children, let alone myself.  I am in need of a husband to help feed my children.
I am single, if you marry me I can bring you into my home and I will get a ration for every one of your children. Are you a widow or divorced ma'am
I am a widow, I would marry even  you at this point just to feed my children.  Shall I call over the priest?
How about you go to the general store and buy you a pretty dress. I will give you some money and meet me back here, I will get the pastor to marry us and a few friends together. Bring your kids too.
Sure thing, thank you mister.  I don't even know your name yet!
Sir Richard

We will have to come up with a shorter nickname for you! My children can only speak one syllable words.  What do you think of this beautiful white dress I got with the money?  I love it, it reminds me of my old wedding dress.
That's real nice, They can call me sir for now, what was your name dear. You sure cleaned up real nice.
Yes, sir.  My name is Thalia.  Nice to meet you, sir.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Hello servant,
Hello cat, what brings you here today?
I just want to play.
Odd, as a talking cat I'd have thought you'd be into more intelligent activities.  Such as chess or marbles
I can play those things, I like putting the kings hats on my head and acting like I am king kitty
Be careful, the king would not be too happy if he saw you doing that!  I am too afraid to touch them myself, the king told me not to.
Aw, what's he going to do, I'm a cat, if he didn't want me in here they would shut the door.
I suppose that is so.  Are you the kings cat or a roaming cat?
I am the kings cat, who else would have a talking cat.
Perhaps the Great Wizard of the North?  John is his name I think, I recall tales of him having a talking cat
I was a gift from the Wizard for the kings birthday.
Ah!  I am sorry that we do not have lasagna down here yet, I heard that it was your favorite food back home.
Well, that does sound nice. I don't really have a favorite though, I will eat any of the itallian cuisines you would want to make.
I am afraid there is not much to eat at all in this room.  The king doesn't like his treasure getting dirty!

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: hello
Hi there guys. How can I help you today?
What! You dare call an army guys?
I'm laid back. I didn't mean to offend.
It is ok. What brings you here?
I came to talk to the King, but he's not here at the moment.
It is security related?
It is actually.
I would like to hear it
I was thinking we could improve your weapons
We really do need an upgrade
This plan would really help.
Where do you source your weapons from?
America

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: hello
What brings you to the throne sir, King?
Well, I should be the one to ask you that
I came here to study a little bit. To get some new ideas.
You should go to the royal library then
Are you in a bad mood, sir?
I just have a lot on my mind
I can imagine. Is there anything I can do to make you feel better?
Just get me some wine and let me drink away my sorrow?
Sure thing sir. Let me get the wine.
Pleasre do...and do that fast
Here you go sir (gives drink)
thank you. How is your family?
They're okay, Hanging in there.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Here, kitty kitty.
Spare so food pwease?
Of course, kitty. Here's a bird that flew against the windows earlier today
Thank you looks great!
That's not all. I've got some catnip in this herb bag!
Really? I would love that.
OK, just a little though. I know how you get when you've had too much of that.
Yes I would love it though.
Sure thing. Go ahead. I've got to roll out some dough to make a pie for the king.
Ok well I will watch.
Hey, I already gave you YOUR bird. These are for the King's pie!
I cannot stay and watch?
Okay. First, use this as a scratching post. It makes the texture better.
Oh wow that looks fun.
action: give bag of herbs to cat
give crude rolling pin to cat

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello could I interest you in anything sparkly
I absolutely must have a new dress. Not an ordinary dress either.
Would you want it to match this hankerchief, I have just the thing!
No! I am attending a very exclusive play with my husband and I insist on never wearing the same dress twice!
Oh, alright let me show you what we have, do you have a color in mind. I love this light blue one it would bring out your eyes.
Is this the best you have? It isn't easy being the wife of a wealthy aristocrat.
I'll have you know this is the Queens favorite designer.
I should have known it was too much to expect a lowly merchant to have an eye for fashion. I would be embarrassed to greet my friend, the Queen, in that dress.
The Queen owns this dress woman, she bought one like it last week.
Some prostitute from the brothel across the street must have come in told you she was the Queen. You local merchants can be so gullible!
Ma'am I hand deliver the Queens garments, she gets first pick of every shipment. You are a rude woman and don't even deserve such a fine dress.
You don't deserve my business! My husband will have you imprisoned for insulting my honor.
Shall I tell the Queen what you said about her taste?
The King is the godfather of my firstborn. Now that you threatened me I shall merely whisper in his ear and your head will soon be parted from your foul neck!

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Hello guard. I have come back from a long voyage for a brief stay before I sail again.
How was your voyage?
We encountered some pirates and recovered their stolen loot. We also discovered some islands that had some strange natives living on them.
Pirates!? That must have been a frightful encounter!
They were tough and we lost two men but the storm we sailed through was even rougher. What is behind that door over there?
That would be the armory where we keep our equipment!
Can you show me?
No it is not for outsiders!'
I sail for the Royal Navy. I am not an outsider.
But you are no guard and I cannot let you pass.
Oh I almost forgot- we took this from the pirates, your commander might want to see this. Apparently there is a big fleet of allied pirates preparing to invade the harbor soon.
A fleet? oh no this is a disaster! I will show the king right away!
We Navy mariners are ready to do our part to protect our fine harbor city!
I will send a messenger with a response from the king!
action: remove the royal coat of arms
wear the royal coat of arms

setting.name: city of elders
setting.description: The City of Elders is an ancient, mystical place spoken of in legends across the kingdom. Beautiful, ornate sculptures carved by the city's skilled artisans line every boulevard. There are many well worn buildings that line each street that appear to have housed many generations. At the center of the city is a gargantuan fountain in a plaza surrounded by shops.
setting.background: The City of Elders was names because of the mysterious property of its residents - they seem to live twice the lifetime of a normal human on average! They prefer a life away from the trappings of modern society, isolated by a vast jungle from civilization.

speech: I am finally free to do with my life!
that sounds like freedom!
Tell me how is this city?
This the place to be. You dance a lot I suppose, you will make a great living here
Yes I am an entertainer for the king now.
That is good to know. I can learn some moves from you then
Are interested in dancing?
Yes, just for the fun of it
I will be more than happy to show you then!
Ok then..let us start.
Okay follow me..... one two three bump one two three bump
hahaha..this sure look like fun
Yes just make sure to follow my lead!
alright..let us start all over again

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Hello
Hello sir, how are you tonight?
I am doing very well sire..Your Highness, I remain loyal to the kingdom.

I appreciate that. That is why I was looking for you tonight. I know this is odd to meet in the Laboratory, but I needed to speak in private and I need someone I can trust. You see, I think the Queen is having an affair with Knight Rob. I am distraught and I need him taken prisoner and killed at once. Can you handle this?
What!!! My queen having an affair with a knight? Burn the knight at once..

I knew I could count on you. That is why I found you. Yes...burn him at once! You must keep this a secret and remain loyal. You will move to the highest level in the castle. Your loyalty will be greatly rewarded. Queen Shafria can only have eyes for me.
I will get to that immediately. No traces must be found your highness

Yes, no evidence. The queen must not suspect a thing. Here take my crown as a token of my gratitude. I am so very grateful. I will also need you to keep an eye on the Queen after this and make sure there are no others.
Your Highness..your crown is a little too much as a gift. My allegiance is with the king.

I know, but the Queen means everything to me. I can't even fathom the thought of losing her to a younger knight. After Knight Rob is taken care of, you shall get your own bathroom. This Lavoratory is quite beneath you. You will be held in high regard.
wow! This sounds like a great reward. Thank you so much your highness
You are quite welcome! Shall you take care of Rob tonight?
Rob is done Sir! No traces will be found
Thank you. I knew you I could count on you. I will have your items moved to to a nicer bathroom. You will now work closer to me. We shall talk later. Have a good night, Knight.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Well fancy seeing you here in my tub, Your Highness.
This is my tub why are you here?
I paid taxes, so this is MY tub too!
I can have your head!
Sure you could, but why would you hurt a poor taxpaying girl like me?
Please, the queen is near here.
Maybe YOU should put these on, then.
Those are not mine.
They'll fit. You're kinda skinny.
I have pants tho.
Yes, but I'm going to put on your pants.
Ok go for it but if you take that I will kill you.
It's just that I'd like to have SOMETHING to show for all the taxes I pay you!
I see well I guess you shall pay with your life.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Please lord send me an Angel I need help with this next battle, The king is over his head on this one.
The Lord has heard your prayers!
Oh my an Angel. You are so beutiful
Be at peace brave Knight.
I am afraid the King is over his head on this battle, can you tell me how we can win this thing?
I shall aid you in your darkest hour. The Lord shall not let you falter.
Thank you good Angel, is there anything I need to do for the Lord?
Continue to love, worship, and serve Him.
That will not be a problem, So what is it like in heaven?
Is is pure love to be in the continual presence of our Lord.
Any other messages from God?

I shall walk through the enemy camp tonight. Whether the enemy sleeps or stands I shall slay all with my heavenly sword. In the morning you and your King will find that all of the enemy have perished according to the Lord's will.
Really we don't even have to fight them, that's great
Leave this room of weapons and go sleep my loyal knight!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: What are you doing in this room?
Oh, um... nothing.
You aren't the one that works in here? Where is that imbecil then?
Oh yes, it is me! I work here!
I need something for a particular prisoner, I don't want to scar them but I want it to hurt
Hmm... how does this dull whip look?
more sting
Well what  about this larger whip?
It has a good snap to it, maybe I will put that in the maybe pile.
There are seemingly endless tools, so I can keep looking.
Do it now, I want to make them cry
How is this cat of 9 tails?
That is too bloody, I don't want to break the skin remember, do you have any long poles?
Yes, I have a baton here?

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Well guard, where do you think ran to?
my Queen, I was just going round for my routine rounds
Have you seen the King, he ran off somewhere
No i haven't, he must have gone hunting with his guards
Oh, that man, how I love him so. Are you going to the ball tomorrow, I know you are a single man, maybe you could find a mate
Love makes a man weak my queen, i don't have time for it
Oh dear, everyone needs love, you haven't lived without it. Forget about being weak, Love will make you an honest man.
It is a waste of time, My Queen
Your loss my friend, I could never imagine life without the King. You should come and just see if you see anyone you fancy.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Hello ,warrior. Looking for anything in particular?
Not really, just looking for something to pass the time
I have some top of the line armor here if you are interested? No one in the kingdom has any yet and you would be first to check it out.
What makes it top of the line?
THe alloy used to meld the armor resist impact and reflects it back into the deliverer. The armor is light weight and comfortable and more pliable for movement.
That is light, can I test it out before buying?
Certainly as long as you do not stray far from my stall here. Let me help you get fitted.
Wow, it fits like a glove and I can't even tell it is on/
It really is the best in the kingdom. Are you interested in purchasing it Sir?
How much is it, I don't even know if I can afford it
Well for you I can do the low low price of 200 shintles. It's the deal of the century!
That is a deal I just don't know if I can afford it. Being a Warrior doesn't pay much.
How about this... you get paid by the King weekly right? I will take weekly payments of 50 until it is paid off.
Well, I don't think I can refuse, it seems like it was made just for me.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: What are you doing in here, your majesty?
Well I like to check on our stocks sometimes, make sure everything is in order.
That's what we are here for, sir!
Oh I know, but I do feel a sense of personal accountability.
I suppose that is fair, and I will not question your wisdom.
How are you doing though?
Quite alright, sir. Just doing my job, really.
Nothing new in your life?
Not really, it is quite monotonous but in a good way.
So you enjoy the structured life you mean?
Indeed, I don't need much surprise or adventure to stay content.
Nothing wrong with a simple life.
Different strokes for different folks, like I always say.
That is indeed a wise saying.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Hello there
Hello your highness, what brings you to the Blacksmith today?
Came to check on an old friend
The man with the hammer?
Yeah, he his an old friend
That's funny, my friend is here too, the aprentace.
Interesting, so what are you doing here?
I was going to see my friend we are going to the pub together
Ok, so you're taking him away from his work place?
He gets off of work for luch, the blacksmith allows it
Ok, hope you don't keep too long outside
They usually have the stew out quickly we will be back in a jiffy
I hope so, so what do you do?
I just came to the market to try the new corn. I am a housewife.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: What another great day at Church.
That certainly was a great sermon, I am glad I came today.
Yes it was so good.
I must get back to working hard for the king
Yes it will take time to do what he wants.
I hate paying all my tax money to him, he gives me the money just for me to give it back to him.
Yes I would rather give it to church.
At least it would go to something good. I still must be off to read my complicated documents.
Yes I bet it is hard.
What are you doing later?
I do not know.
What do they put in those baskets on the walls, any idea?
Nope it looks cool though.
Would you mind walking out with me, I sure enjoyed our chat

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Well what is a monkey doing here?
Oo oo oo ah!
It's ok little monkey, I bet the king would love to have one of you why don't you come and take a ride with me.
Oooo?
You would get bannanas galore and any other fruit you like
Hmm... oo!
Come here little buddy
Ahhh!
Is it ok if I hug you?
Oo oo!
Oh, I will get rewarded handsomely for this. He looks young too.
Oooooo!
Hey you silly thing, you can meet them in person if you like.
Ahh!

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: hello
Dinner will be magnificant today my king
hmmmmnnn...i anticipate that
Tell me are you in the mood for cake or pudding?
I would love some cake! wew!
I have some ready now if you would like a snack
yipeeeeeee
Here you go, there is a plate waiting for you on the counter
hmmmmnnnn..I think I really need to promote you
It's called a carrot cake.
cake made out of carrot?
Yes, you wouldn't think so but it makes the cake so moist and yummy.
i would like more serving of this
Of course my king, you can have as much as you like!

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: hello
I knew I would find you here, did you get that information you talked to me about?
i didnt....it was kept more securely
Kept securly, you are suppose to evesdrop, did you go or not?
well, your highness, i tried my best really
You will have to try again, that is all there is to it.
Let me get going then
I can't beleive you didn't get the information, the kingdom rides on this spider!
I am really sorry for my incompetence
You are an insect I suppose, do this right and I will bring you that faery you wanted the other day.
i will get it right this time
You better, I don't know what all this hugging is about.
a way of appreciating your understanding
Alright, I understand just fine. stay safe ok, I can't get another talking spider

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hello there, what are you doing in here?
I am talking to one of the Guards, I grew up with him you know
Ah, well I won't distract you for long!
I almost would rather be in these Barracks, I am going to be king someday, it is so stressfull
Ohh you really think so? That is quite the bold claim!
My life has never been mine to choose what I actually want. I always have to have someone else in mind when I make choices.
Well if that is the case, this claim is even more strange and bold!
I am determined to grow up and be a Legendary King.
You have quite a high expectation to meet then!
I can do it, I mean what else do I have to do with my life. I want to be talked about for years, like King Auther and the Knights of the round table.
Just be an honest worker like me!
That I will do, You shall be my favorite maid.
As in, go for a more... attainable goal!
No, no I will be Legendary. you will see, everyone will talk about the Legendary King.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: You look magnificent today my Queen
Thank you, my love
How are you today?
Very well my King, anything interesting going on in the kingdom today?
The ginger twins came in again today wanting a loan for their egg buisiness. She claims we should have one producer of eggs so no one else has to deal with it.
So what did you say?
I don't think it is a good idea to have one producer for everything, I mean what if they all get a disease.
Yes, that's a good point. So we don't get shortages when anything happens to their eggs
That would be disasterous. I am going to think about how I can appease them with something though, they just keep asking.
I can't imagine having only one egg producer, what happens when they decide to inflate prices
There won't be only one, I was thinking I could let them set something up outside of the kingdom, like a before you get to our kingdom you can go to their egg hut
That would be a good idea, and they would be the first to meet before getting in the kingdom, so they sell at any price for the outsiders coming into the kingdom
Yes and we can tax it of course, they could even prepare them for travelors
Yeah and we could put a military outpost close to their store

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: My king I do most certainly need a new cushion for my throne!
Ok my dear I would love to get you a new cushion. Maybe the seamstress can make one especially for my Royal Queen
I certainly do hope so, just look at it. It is pitifully flat these days.
What do you think of the new painting my dear? It has a Gold frame, just like you like.
It is quite nice that you now mention it.
It shows you in a great light, so beutiful
Thank you for your kind words my king.
I think it is my favorite painting of you, Rwar
Are you growling at me?
You are so fine my lady
You haven't seen the chambermaid around have you dear?
Why no, I think I seen her go down the hall to the Kitchen
Hmm she is supposed to be cleaning, sometimes I wonder about that girl.
She had her hands full dear she wasn't going on an evening stroll. It's tough being the king you know, help me relax

setting.name: Dwarven blacksmith
setting.description: The blacksmith's shop is filled with weapons and armor. Axes, swords, shields, pole axes, and many more weapons line the walls.
