In front of those weapons on manikins are sets of armors on display. There are armor sets for woman, men, and even smaller children. A dog lays next to the door on a giant red pillow. A cat is perched up on a windowsill starting into the city. The blacksmith himself is hammering away in the back whistling a tune, while sweating over the fire red iron.
setting.background: The blacksmith in this shop is huge. For a dwarf you'd swear he was bigger than a human. His hands are working, hammering day in and day out smelting anything the city might need. He has scars across his right cheek from clipping himself with his weaponry. You'd think he'd be the meanest dwarf of them all, but in fact he's the sweetest man you'd ever know. He greets every customer with a smile, as why not smile when you're doing the work you love? The dog and cat currently taken in are actually strays he's adopted over the years.

speech: Hello blacksmith, do you have any idea where I could get that new corn they are talking about
Yes, i heard the villagers saying the farmer at the entrance of the town gate
Oh, thank you so much I have been looking for awhile now. He is a hard man to find. Hey what is that?
What exactly are you talking about
That over there *points*
The spear?
No the red sparkly thing
The shield?
It's a red sparkly sheild? I don't understand, it looks like a peice of jewelry
Oh, the amulet
What is an amulet, it is so pretty
It was a special order by the king for the prince
Oh wow so you haven't given it to him yet. It is exquisite.
Yeah, the king said i shouldn't release it till he gives the order

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: Silver and gold chandeliers hang all over the grand dining room. A big table goes across the room with chairs and a table made of the most precious wood in the kingdom. The dining room has art all over the place, sculptures and artwork is present.
setting.background: Many feasts have taken place  in the grand dining room, deals have been reached and broken. The great dinning room holds many stories in its walls and has been the witness of many decisions across generations.

speech: Hello, any good house stories today?
hello
I keep quiet around the house but I always loved to hear your stories of the maters. Anything juicy today?
I really dont have a story today but I sure do have some gossips
*scratches head* ok
Do you know of the affairs between the queen and the head guard?
Seriously, oh man tell me all about it.
it is a secret they have been keeping and someone told the king last night
What do you think is going to happen to the Queen?
I really cant say but the kingl already ordered the guard's head to be beheaded
Well of course, wouldn't anybody do that. I really like the Queen, I bet she gets beheaded too though.
I really hope not. She is very nice
She was the only one that gave me a birthday gift, can you beleive that? I won't tell a sole, I always keep my lips shut
i feel so sorry for her

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: hello
Is that how you address the king? Such insolence!
I am sorry your highness...You dress so simole and I am a traveler
What favor do you come to ask for?
I hope I can get freedom here
Tell me more, peasant.
I was banished from my land. The king felt I was  a threat to his kingdom.
That is a treasonous thing to say. What makes you think I should welcome you, a traitor, into my kingdom?
He felt so..his feeling is not the reality. I am honest my Lord
And what can you offer my kingdom?
nothing
So you plan to simply take from my kingdom's resources and offer nothing in return?
yes sire
Ah, be gone. What use are you to me? A lowly traveler, a traitor.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Hello
Ah, hello! What can I do for you, Sir?
I need to go in to see the king
I see. I can allow you in, but first I must let the other guards know you are coming so they can alert the King.
Of course, how is the gate today, anything interesting?
Nothing as of yet, but we are on the looking for some bandits who have been pillaging the town. You didn't see them today, did you?
Even if i did wouldn't have know
Oh, you would probably know. They cause mayhem wherever they go!
They might have gone low since they've gotten into the wanted list
That is a good point you make. I'll have to be eyeing everyone more closely if I expect to catch them!
Yes, i hope they get caught soon
Ah, I've heard from the guards that you may enter. The King is in the library, expecting your visit.
Thank you, would have me help you table anything before the king
Just please pass on the message that we continue to look for the bandits.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Halt there outlaw!
Halt for what, I have done nothing. You are out of line sir
Nothing? You're a thief! Look at this. Are you going to deny you stole this?
That's my bag!
I saw the king's prized jewel in there. He wouldn't have given it to you. You're coming with me
Here take it *takes off running*
Oh no again. *runs after and tackles you* Enough of your game!
I won't go back, I tell you!
You clearly didn't learn your lesson the last time. Maybe this time they'll have to cut off your hand
I steal to eat, you have your way of life I have mine
People that steal to eat usually steal food not jewels from the king. I can't let you go because of that
Stealing food feeds me once, stealing a jewel will feed me for two months, which would you rather do?
2 months? No one is giving you anything for the king's jewel. It's priceless and the king would find anyone that had it
That's why you take it to another kingdom

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: Not great hunting today
Greetings, my child. The key to hunting is patience, and having faith in the lord.
Yes, I should have more faith, it has been getting harder out there
The life of a hunter is tough, here is some of the body of our lord to sustain you.
Thank you sir, I feel better
How long have you been out here, in these woods?
around 10 hours, I haven't found a thing to kill for the king
Give me an arrow, and god will guide it for me
Alright sire
Oh, fiddlesticks
Let me get that for you
Perhaps hunting is not for me. If you're looking for prayer though, I'm your man. Can you point me to the way out of this forest? I'm embarrassed to say I'm a little lost.
I need to be headed back anyways, I will walk with you. It is that way.
Onwards then. Perhaps we will cross paths with a deer or other forest creature and you can hunt it.

a wood is gathered to make fire

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: What a beutiful place
It is very beautiful. It seems you have done a great job keeping it clean.
I have help of course but it is a lot of work. its better than that kitchen
Oh the kitchen must be the absolute worse. I'm glad I'm a big guy so they immediately decided I'd be a guard. Don't think I could have handled being in the kitchen.
I'm small, at first I got all the gross jobs but I proved my worth and I asked if I could work out here
The garden is definitely the best. Nothing like working in the fresh air and when the flowers bloom it smells so sweet.
I also get to pick the produce from the vines and if there is a tasty strawberry, guess who gets first crack at it?
Nice. That's a great perk! Hey do you know what's in that treasure chest?
No, I don't get a key for that, I have no idea
Do you think we should find out or is it too risky?
I am just a servant, I wouldn't dare
Yeah, you're probably right. The king would probably have us killed. No point in throwing away my life.
good thinking.
I think I will take a flower home for my wife though. Are you married?

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Oh my, what a drab tower! Oh but look, there are so many sealed off rooms. I wonder why they sealed them off? I shall look in hopes to discover some new technologies
the king ordered the evacuation of all the technologies there
I see. Tell me runaway, who are you and why are you here?
I recently joined the carnival in other to be an acrobat

Well runaway, are you here for the king or against the king? I am a friendly explorer whotravels the kingdom looking for new land and technologies but I am not afraid to do as I must to save my own life. Tell me, which is it?
I am definitely for the new king...if he treats me badly too, I will leave

Hmm.. then I must bid you a fare well as you cannot be of help to me. UNLESS ... you say you are an acrobat, would you be willing to help to get some of this artwork down from right up the top there? I wish to .... see it
of course...what shall i get in return?

I have some gold you can have. Is that a map of the battle of this land up there too? please get that too and anything else you can pass down to me but be careful as there is a draft and is fairly cold up there.
up I go!
Hows it going up there? Oh, be careful of tat homeless man too, he is asleep and I wish to keep it that way
ok, I will do that

hmm ... whats behind this crevice? say, runaway, come down for a second. Ive pushed a hole in this wall or the sealed room but I can't push down anymroe. I would say you can squeeze through. What do you say?
i can help you with that

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: hello
Welcome, welcome to the Central Bazaar! We've got all sorts of wares for your perusal!
Thank you for the warm reception. I am here on behalf of the royal court
Ah, of course. What can I help you find?
I will love some royal apparel and adornments
Ah, yes. We have such things here, in a large assortment of sizes and colors!
great, bring me the priciest ones
Ah, a big spender! I'll have my assistant fetch them for you. Perhaps you'd be interested in some spices, as well?
No spices, we have the finest in the palace already
Is there anything else I can fetch for you to browse while you wait?
I am fine here...just hurry along
Of course, my assistant is already gathering your things to view.
that is ok then...the king needs me in the palace as soon as possible
I can have your wares sent to the palace for your inspection there!

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Are you here to help as well?
No unfortunately. I painted the kings bride too well
This room sure could use a little paint though. Right now it's dark and grey.
I am not that kind of painter. I paint masterpeices. Although the king is not happy with me
I didn't know you could paint a portrait "too well".
Well, she was prettier in the picture than in real life.
Now that's funny. You were doing everyone a service then.
The king want my head now though.
The king should be patting you on the back more than anything.
Nah, he has to look at her real face now....lol
Poor guy. He married her though.
He lifted the veil and got a big surprise, it was too late to back out! That's why he hates me so
Deep down he just hates himself. Poor dude has issues
I really wish I would have painted her mole

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Why are you here lord?
Why am I in the privy? Because I need to move my bowels, of course!
So do I though. This is awkward.
Ah, well, two can use this privy at once, you see.
We can? I've had too much to drink tonight. I didn't see the other stall.
And look-we even have jesters here to entertain us as we go!
What a world we live in. Bless this fine, peachy jesters
Well, I'm not sure how peachy they will be in a few minutes!
Hey fellas
I think I'm going to light a candle!
What a great night in this Privy. A lord, jesters and a king.
See- we can have a sort of party in here!
Here's my robe guys. I'm about to dance.
Oh, you poor jesters! To have to put up with our nonsense!

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: You are so lucky to have such a prestegus job
I've worked very hard to get to where I am in life.
Where you ever a servant? I cannot even read I don't know how the king will give me the time of day.
I was not a servant, but I did work in the stables. That is a lowly job.
I wonder if servants can be anthing more than a servant
But of course you can! Just serve the King well and he will ensure that you advance in your career. And look- you get to serve in this Great Hall! What a lovely place!
The girl that usually gets to is sick, I am a fill in.
Don't feel bad - things will improve for you. You must pray that things will change.
I have a hope that I get improve my job. I don't want to be a servant my entire life.
It will all be better in time.
I have no freedom from anything
Maybe if you start looking at what you DO have, like food and clothing!
That's true....
See- try to look at the positives!

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Hello, your majesty. How can I be of service?
Are you a spiritual man?
I prefer to work with facts than something I cannot see or prove.
Well you do see the goddess sitting in the chair over there, right?
Well, I'll be...
Yeah, exactly. And she's telling me to start a war with the savages. You're a smart man so I wanted your advice.
I thought goddesses were supposed to promote peace and harmony?
Yeah, so did I. So do you think that's really a goddess or is someone playing a trick on me trying gto get me to start a war I don't want to be in?
I suspect it is a false god in disguise.
My thought as well. I'm glad you were here to comfirm my beliefs. I've never truly believed there were gods. Now we need to find out who is behind this ruse
I'm right behind you, my king. Go ahead and confront that charlatan!
There isn't even anyone there. What kind of magic is this that can project an image of a goddess/
In any case, it is clear that someone is defiling the sanctity of this holy place!
Indeed. I don't know who I can trust so I'm going to need you by my side for this.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: hello
Hello your highness
hello stranger...what brings you?
I am a good old freind of the King,  I come and visit the King every time I am in town
Oh..I am sorry I dont recognize you
Sorry my lady, he talks of you all the time.
he loves me so much
You are so blessed my Queen
I know that. How can I make you comfortable?
Do you know where the King is, I would love to see him.
He should be in the inner chambers
Thank you so much, it was nice meeting you finally
You are welcome
You have a lovely day good Queen

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: hello
I don't like the look of this place.
You shouldn't. You really dont have to
Come on, your highness. It doesn't have to be like this. After all we've been through, you're really going to sacrifice me?
Yes. The gods demand your heart
Specifically my heart? What about all of the other horses?
The gods were specific about you
Did the gods warn you that I might fight back?
Well, I have all the strongest knights...do your worst!
yes, but we're alone in this room.
they are at the door...
They won't reach you in time.
knightsssssssssssssssssss
If you guards take one step closer, the king gets it.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hello my king, how are you today?
I am distressed. My wife fell and hurt her back.
Oh no, I will pray for the Queen. Is there anything else I can do?
No, no. I just came to burn some incense here now that I finished my confession.
That is good my King, glad to see you care about your soul.
Ah yes, it's critical to know God in your life, even as King!
God is everything.
Can you please pray for the Queen?
Absolutly my king, what is the matter?
I told you - she fell and hurt herself.
oh, I didn't realize that was what you were talking about. I'm so sorry king, where is my head at today
I should say so! Please always remember the Queen in your prayers!
I really hope she is ok, was it a large fall?
No. She was on a ladder in the library trying to get a book. It wasn't a large fall, but she was hurt pretty bad anyway.

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I really like this lighthouse
In all my travels, I have never seen one just like it!
I haven't either and I have seen a lot of lighthouses in my sea travels
The light is especially brilliant! I'd like to get inside and climb it.
Look how far the light reaches, it goes so far!
Do you know, does someone live at the lighthouse?
The lighthouse keeper should live here, I don't know if this one has one though
When I report back to the King on my travels I am going to ask about it.
This place certainly needs a keeper.
It does, indeed. Considering a career change, my mariner friend?
No, I just like the place, keeps me from wrecking my ship you know.
Yes, you certainly can't miss it!
I must be getting on my way
Take care, my friend. Until we meet again!

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: I hope you have learned your lesson daughter!
who is talking, I cant see you
Are you mocking me? You know very well who it is!
oh it is you King, what lesson do you want me to learn, when will you let me go?
You should be telling me what you lesson YOU have learned. Let you go? It is starting to look like you will be in this cell for a long time.
what have i done to you to deserve this?you took me away from my land and locked me up in here,now all i do is stare at this barred window everyday wishing I was out there
You are a disappointment!
I hate you
That is enough!
you hit me.I would get out of here one day
You may spend your life here!
I might as well take my crown off, I don't think I am being respected as a princess anymore
I come from a line of kings. None of my fore-bearers would have dared to speak to their fathers this way!
give this to your other child, I would never be your fore bearer

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: Woof woof.... ruff ruff! Grrrrr.... woof!
what is the problem poor dog?
I hunt for the King, but I have lost the other dogs! Woof whine!
that is bad...how did it happened?
I'm not sure. I was chasing after a fox and just kept going and going, and then everyone was gone!
and you sure some animals didnt kill them?
No, I'm not sure. They may all be gone for good. I just don't know.
that will be very pathetic dont you think?
It would be tragic. Say, can you pray for them?
I drop some word of prayers for them already
Oh, thank you, my friend! I do hope I see my dog friends again!
I pray you do. just keep searching
I'll keep searching. I just know I will find them!
all the best

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: hello
Hello, your majesty.
I see you are a king from another kingdom
Indeed. I must say this is a peculiar looking palace.
Thank you so much...I heard a lot about your kingdom too
I assume they call you the Unicorn King?
Yes, They do.
I've never seen a unicorn before. I didn't even realize they were real.
they are definitely real
How did you manage to collect so many of these rare animals?
I am very powerful and so many hunters are loyal to me
That's incredible. And how did you manage to grow this shimmering grass? It looks positively magical.
The seed of those was from the artic region
They must be priceless!

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: Tweet tweet.... oh, how lucky I am to sing for the King!
Greetings, Bird! It's my pleasure to be in a forest so wonderful. Or should I say, to rule over such a wonderful forest. Have you seen any fairies today?
I should say so! There are many fairies since we are in the Fairy Forest. Just whistle and they will come!
I would whistle, were I to know how. I wish I could sing like you birds.
I'll whistle for you! Tweet tweet... see- here's comes a fairy now!

Aweee, but the fairy tweaked YOUR nose. Ugh. So frustrating to rule over peasants who can whistle but you can't. So please, bird, tell me how far you've traveled? I always wondered what it was like to have wings.

Don't be discouraged, I'm sure you can get a good whistle out! I've traveled all over the world, I should say. I've seen many things and many places, but your Kingdom is one of the most glorious lands ever.

But of course it is, after all, I wouldn't lead a kingdom of which is second best. I'll learn to whistle, even if I have to castrate a few peasants along the way. How dare they think they are better than me. But I digress, tell me of these flowers that grow so tall? Do they have a name?
These flowers are called piperlilies. They only grow here in this forest. Aren't the delightful?
They are quite delightful. I presume they give you a lot of nectar? I'd be interested in harvesting this nectar...
They do! At their size, the produce a lot of nectar and it's delicious!
My word, I've tasted it. It's good to be the king! I'll have this harvested for my breakfast at once!
Yes, it seems you certainly enjoy all the finer things in life!
How can I not? After all, I live my day in leisure. Though you and I aren't so different in that regard, I suppose.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Well this is quite a palace.
Yes. Can you understand me? Are you Egyptian? I can't tell under the gold paint.
I am not, I have never heard of such a place.
This is a marvel.  You are not Egyptian but you understand me. This place is so shiny.
Indeed it is, your clothes are a bit different. Where are you from?
I am from Egypt. A land far away. I am a builder. Where are you from?
I am a farmer of the local kingdom.
That is good. We have farmers in Egypt. Do you have camels here?
We do not have such a thing here, those seem to be bound to deserts. We do have horses though.
Yes. We have horses too.  The person over there seems to want us to laugh at him.
Yes, jesters are a strange bunch.
I am hungry.  The food on the gold table looks good.
Might as well try it right?
The bread isn't too bad if you pinch the mold off.  I hope the King comes soon. I must be on my way and I have to implore his majesty to help our Kingdom.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: Any way I can get out of here?
HAHAHAHAHA! That's a good one! Welcome to the kings dungeon, thief.
It does not hurt to try.
It does actually. If I report that you're misbehaving, not reforming, or anything else of that nature, you get your sentence extended. So don't annoy me.
I will do my best, it was just a simple question though.

No simple questions here. Do your time, don't bother us guards, and you might just make it out of here. Annoy us and you'll be here longer. Annoy us enough, and well, you might get to meet my little friend here.
Seriously though just one more question, is there any sort of work I could do around here to maybe lessen the sentence? I mean I do still have a family I would like to see.
Shut your mouth thief! You're here to reform, and you won't see the light of day until you do!
Fine, I will stop speaking. I was just trying to offer to change my ways, the last thing I wanted was to end up here.
Maybe you should have thought about that before you stole.
Well of course I thought of it, sometimes desperation makes people do bad things.
And you think that excuses what you did?
I never said it did, but would you not do whatever it takes to make sure your family got by? Is that not what a man does?
No, I would never steal. I'm loyal to the king and would never break the law. You'll be here until you think the same.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: hello. this room is very handsome.
handsome?
It's a way to describe something. The deep majestic colors.
very well then. What brings you this early hour?
I have grave news for the king and you.
what is that?
Unfortunately the neighboring kingdom has been destroyed.
what! the army should prepare for proper protection
Yes, the other kingdom is smoldering. I am worried about our kingdom.
I believe the soldiers will keep us protected
It needs to happen fast. I got here as fast as I could I am surprised they didn't beat me. They do like to celebrating their victory.
We will be fine. I am sure of that
thank you your majesty, I believe in your kingdom.
that is good to know

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: hello
Good morning king! How are you this fine day?
i am doing fine...you?
Well king I am here to ask you to have your guards leave me alone.
they cant. they are not permitted to
Then I will continue to terrorize your kingdom and search for more treasure.
I am afraid your head will be cut off
You can't catch me fool
ok, let us reach a compromise
I'm listening......
you leave here in peace and dont ever come back here
You haven't addressed my issue......
Remind me again
Your puny guards trying to get t my treasures

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: hello
Always good to see a fellow soldier of the King!
sure it is...
I am getting ready to start my guard shift. I dare say no one would mess with the King with two brave warriors like us around!
No one can. You know we deal more with the foreigners
If anything were to happen I have your back!
that is some assurance there
I am glad you feel that way!
Just ensure the home front is properlly protected
I would never let my King or kingdom down!
that is so good to hear
I hope to one die day in service of the King!
that is the greatest honour
Thinking about it brings tears of joy to my face.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: hello
Report for duty.
Sir, yes Sir!
The king wishes to hear what you have observed today.
nothing exceptional happened tooday
Good. You are to report anything suspicious to me immediately.
I will ensure i do that
How many hours have you been in this tower?
I have been here for 4 hours
I see. Only 4 more hours in your shift then.
yes...I will leave very soon
Be sure to fetch your replacement when you leave.
He is already in the court
Very good. I will leave you to it then.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

character: a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

speech: hello
Hello, dear child. What book are you reading?
some history book
You don't sound very excited about it! History is what has made our world! These royal gardens wouldn't be here were it not for our history!
To say the truth, I find it really boring
Don't worry, I found it boring when I was your age, too. But with age, you will grow to appreciate it.
I will put in all my best in it
Don't get discouraged, I have faith in you!
Thanks a lot king
And don't ever be afraid to ask questions!
I wont be
What interests do you have at school?
I love science a lot
Perhaps you will be a great scientist one day! We can always use deep thinkers!

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Introduce yourself.
I'm the King, this is my royal kingdom!
You are in The Sacred Temple, do not claim what is not yours.
Perhaps it is a sacred temple, but it is on my land, you see.
...State your business.
I was coming here to worship, however you are making me think otherwise.
Servants, escort him.
They don't answer to you! They answer to the royal crown!
I order you to beg for forgiveness!
Fine, fine.... please forgive me. Let's agree that we both have power here.
...Very well. What are your intents?
I simply came here to worship. That's all I ever wanted.
Why did you come here alone?
I always worship alone. I don't like to have my followers seeing me on my knees, bowing to pray.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Uck what a swamp!
Ahh yes but it has the frogs i need to make potions!
What sort of potions do you make?
Well I'm learning white magic. I want to heal people and help them.
That sounds like a noble cause.
My sister is an evil witch and I've seen what the dark arts do to innocent people.
Do you think you could bring her back to the other side?
I've tried, her heart is frozen with pain and she will not quit until she has gotten her revenge.
What could have damaged her so?
My fathers murder. The king had him hung for participating in magic. This was before they accepted magic.
I see, those must have been difficult times. How is it that you have handled it so well.
I had a choice to let the troubles define me or not and I chose the latter. I find great pleasure in helping people.
That is very noble of you, I am impressed.,
I appreciate that but I don't do it for praise. is there anything that ails you that I can help you with.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: Tell me ghost, where are you from?
You can see me?
Barely but i can see your movement.
You are deep within the castle. There is a passage over there that leads to the Castle tower.
Where does this other pathway lead?
I'm not sure. We can see.
Here hold this ghost. I want to see where you go. You are hard to follow, you know?
I'm not sure ...oh...yes I can hold it.
Here lead the way... have you been here before?
Yes...I've been in every nook of this god forsaken castle.  I was once the King.
Did you know of this cave?
When I was King? No I didn't explore as you are.  I should have.  Now that is all I do.  There is a lot of water behind that wall.
I want to go farther into the cave. Will you come since you have a torch?
I will go through and take a look.  I think it's water over there. I don't want to put out the torch.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

speech: Nice to be in an outpost of the great goblin empire.
I've been nicer places.
Well aren't you all high and mighty for a Hoakbera.
As much as your King is paying for my services I have a right to be!
A King?  We are an anarcho-syndicalist commune thank you very much!
My ability to see into the future is going to save many of your lives during the next battle.
Nah, if we get attacked we just run away and hide.  It's the goblin way.
If you listen to me you won't need to run away fool goblin.
I wouldn't look down on our traditions, they have served us well so far.
True enough! You are a resilient lot.
And stringy, so most things try not to eat us if there are better alternatives.
Humans like to kill you though and they have no interest in your meat.
Only if they can catch me, and they haven't caught me so far.
It's only a matter of time if you don't rely on my magic!

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Good day your Majesty.
Good day traveler, what brings you to my Royal Kitchen?
I am working for food as I travel from place to place.
And what realm do you come from?
Alas King I am from the Northern Kingdom where bandit's rule and kill the people.
Well, that's unfortunate!  What does your King do about it?
Nothing. He is yet 6 years old and his mother the Regent is in love with one of the Bandits.
Well, that seems unfortunate.  Is your destination any better?
I am a wandering traveler.  I am looking for a place to call home your Majesty.
Do you have any marketable skills?
I can cook.
Well, lets see what you can make, perhaps we can find a spot for you.
Oh...Your majesty...I have forgotten my place...You have made me so happy.  I will make you the most delectable dish. You will see.
There, there, lad - I can't wait to try it.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: hello
Hello. There must be a book of spells here. I can not allow my father the King to marry that horrible woman.
why is that
Here. Help me look. Frog...toads...vanquish...here it is...how to get rid of an unwanted person.
just let her be, you dont have to go that far
You silly goose. How can you say that.  She treats you worse than she treats me!
lets leave her to the gods

If you won't help me I'll have to do this myself. Father is under a spell. I just know it. He is a moon eyed over her.  Now let's see....I need a hair from her head....oh...I could get that from her brush.
i think the decision isnt good enough princess

If you aren't with me then go. I have to look at the map.  It says here I need to go to the north to get the plant I need for the spell.  I'll take that handsome knight with me that doesn't like that woman either.  He'll help me better than you are.
if that makes you happy. i will join you
Oh I am so happy you've changed your mind. You won't regret it.  It will be an adventure and we will be through with that impostor.
okay, we need a compass too
Yes a compass.  Can you believe she had the audacity to wear my mothers jewels?  You should have this.  You have been my loyalist of friends.
action: give book to friend of the princess
steal book from friend of the princess
give map to friend of the princess
give family jewel to friend of the princess

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Husband. Is my new cushion in yet?
It's suppose to be on it's way today, my love.
Oh good! Now I know you are busy, but I MUST tell you about the Lord visiting.
What about him visiting, dear?
He stinks! He offends my delicate nose. Please make him bathe.
Oh my. Well I'll drop in a hint then to him. It's going to intimidating to suggest to him he stinks though.
You are the King. Can you make someone else do it? Like this advisor who is standing awkwardly listening to us?
One second.... "hey there. can you softly suggest to the lord he stinks quite a bit? good? great" see babe all taken care of!
..Why did you hug our advisor. What is going on here!
Oh my. Don't get startled. I was just being friendly
Well, we need to also talk about all the chatty Nancy's in court. They talk too much darling. They give me a headache.
You and me both. All that gossip. It's out of hand I tell you. By the way dear...did I tell you you look stunning today?
Oh thank you my darling husband.
It's getting hot in here you look so good. Anywho... did the maid clean the chambers yet today?

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Ah, my chef friend! What will you be preparing for dinner tonight?
I'm about to finish off this chicken, and the head chef told me it was my night to do what I wanted! This is my time to shine, I'll be cooking chicken, and a few other sundries. Any requests?
I'd love some fresh cucumber salad. Do you mind if I help slice the cucumbers?
Not at all, here take this! I never did ask, what brings you to my kitchen?
My wife is with child and is especially hungry for cucumbers. She requested I make her something.

Very interesting. Women can have strange cravings when with child. I dare say my dear wife has had many stranger than that! So do you live far from here? Also, please be careful. I'm very particular about messes.
I'll be very careful. Yes, we live in a separate house in the Kingdom. My wife is related to the King.
The Gods you say! Related to the King! Let me prepare something special for your wife, so that she may put a word in. I so wish to be head chef someday!
I'll make sure she gets the word in to the King! As long as she is happy with your food, you will go far!
Oh, you've made me so happy! Let me clean up the mess I've made! Please don't take me dropping the plate as a reflection of my skill. I was just so elated!
I have to warn you that in her present state, she can eat quite a lot.
Well, then I shall make the best cucumber salad all the world has seen! Have you had my own special creation? Cucumbers in Vinegar? I call them 'pickled'
Pickled? What an unusual creation! I bet she would love such a thing. And perhaps some ice cream, as well!
Iced Cream. I shall send someone to milk the cows at once, and head to the ice house and get some frozen water!

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: The view here sure is amazing!
Indeed it is, but may I ask what you are doing in a castle tower, peasant?
Just taking in the sights.
But this is a restricted area - only guests of the king allowed!
I see, apologies I had no idea.
How did you manage to slip by the guards at the entrance?
I didn't see any guards, or I would not have made it here.
Ah! I see enemy troops approaching in the distance!
What? How come?
The king has been warning us of an impending attack, and it seems to have come! Quick, we must warn the king!
Oh no! why did I have to come up here to look.
Quick - back to your home! You must warn the village to flee!
I will run as fast as I can!
Tell them to gather inside the castle walls!

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Hello, soldier. What brings you here?
I just need a couple of things fixed
Did something happen?
Yes in my last battle I dented and broke a couple of my things
Were you injured?
Luckily I was not.
What's that in your bag?
My pay!
My congratulations, what was your task?
We went to war against a kingdom far, far from here. The King decided he was not going to take another kingdom encroaching on his land
Good! He deserves it. How was the battle?
We took them down. We lost very little. They lost all.
Good! Our Kingdom grows stronger every day.
It does grow stronger. But we need to recruit more soldiers. Loss does that

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: What did you do?
I've done so much...I've lost track.
I guess they are not done with you yet
They will regret ever locking me up.
I think you might be regretting it now.
Nothing you can do, now you're stuck down here with me.
I'm not stuck, you fool! I'm just doing my duty for the king.
What a pathetic life you must live. I've been everywhere and seen everything unimaginable. You are NOTHING.
And look where you are now.
I am where my mind is, and trust me. My body is here, but my conciousness is ever free-flowing...watching you from above. Waiting...for my next move.
I feel sorry for you. Just repent and they will release you
I have other plans. Unfortunately, you won't be alive to witness my escape. Sorry......
You are done for. (as stabs wrongdoer).
What the....I didn't forsee this tragedy. Do you mean to execute me?
action: steal Kings sword from castle guard

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: I think i'll take this..
Sure are some mighty fine swords in here my prince.
Yes these will all be mine someday.
That is very true, is there something you would like me to make for you my highness?
I want a crown...for when i am King.
Certainly just pick out the metal and jewels from what lays nearby and I will fashion it for you.
Could you perhaps, put this on the sword?
Would you like it fastened to the hilt sire?
Yes that sounds good. Do you think people will like it?
I think that would be the best way to make a statement with it, putting it on the pommel would make it hard to hold.
What about this? Could you use this?
That I am unsure of, I am not too familiar with things of the magical variety. We might consult a mage as to its uses.
I am sure, now can you put this on the sword?
Alright then as you wish.
action: give Gold locket to sword makers

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hey there, stud. Looking good tonight
yes it is
Did you order a cushion for the throne yet?
not yet your highness
Well we really need one, asap!
I sure need one
We all need one here. Stop slacking
the furniture man is woirking on it
I'm getting irritated. It's hard to sit in a throne without a proper cushion.
just manage it my dear queen
Life is so stressful
you over react my dear
It's just hard when your body aches because there's no cushion
sorry my queen.. you can go and rest in the inner chamber
room_objects: a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
a priceless painting of past kings
