setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: So much treasure here
Well there seems to be some. I imagine the treasure room has more.
Where did you come from? Be careful that you take nothing, my guard is here to protect and keep watch
Oh I'm just walking around, I have no intention of stealing anything.
What do you do for work?
Well I don't actually work you see.
What is it that you do?
I just wander mostly.
Wander where and when
I wander anywhere and anytime, no where specific.
I grow suspicious of you! What places have you seen?
Well I've seen grass, and the sky. Also I don't have a tail, I'm just a normal guy.
Now you give me rhymes like a child. The guard is keeping his sword on you
Just a normal guy, 1 head, two arms and two legs sir.

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: Hello Bishop, how are you?
I'm well. I am pondering on some important religious matters relating to the King. Tell me, how do you feel about His Highness?
I think he is cruel and old. Not fit to rule.
Thanks for placing my books in their proper spot. I'm glad to hear that. May I share a secret with you, provided you are a pious man?
No problem, i volunteer here to help with the church. And yes of course, I won't tell a soul.
I thought you looked familiar. Well, the king hasn't been keeping his royal scepter in his pants, and the decision has come to me to decide whether or not I should excommunicate him...
Oh wow! That could cause a lot of problems for the kingdom.
It would. Particularly since his brother would then become King. Roderick, I'm sure you know him. Volunteers to build hovels for the poor.
He is a good man. It would be good for the kingdom...but aren;t you scared for your life?
That's the trouble. I would need to hide for the remainder of my days. Unless someone were to off the king...I believe that a good, pious man would do such a thing for the church...
Could the church afford such a man?
This cross once belonged to Saint Peter himself, I believe such an artifact would pay for any...difficulties.
Hmmm... I think we can come to an arrangement. But how do i get close to the king?

Quite simple, really. He comes here for religious service, and he is obliged to touch the cross each time he comes. One could easily give him a chalice of drugged wine as he touches the cross. I could outfit you like a Friar.
action: put old prayer books in single shelf

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: hello
Another day in the life of being a royal subject. How are you, brother?
i am doing well...you?
I'd be better if the king would increase my pay. How much does he pay you?
3 stone of gold
3 stone! My word! I must have a chat with the King. Count this! There isn't more than 1/3 of a stone!
what? Do you get your payment directly from the king?
No, but I can't go through the Lord. He treats me like an animal, the King is supposed to be fair.
That is why. The intermediary is ripping you off
You're kidding! Let me have my meager sum back, Thanks. I KNEW IT! I MUST talk to the King!
You really need to..
Thank you! I had not thought of that outcome. Have you had this issue before?
I have always dealt directly with the king
What? You? How?

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: hello
Your highness, you've come to my wedding! Gracious Gods!
its ok sweetheart. Your husband is a noble person
Yes, I suppose he is. Is this view not amazing?
it is..you made it really grand
And these rocks! Unbelievable! Are you not impressed each day you rule this perfect Kingdom?
I am...always!
Here, your highness. Keep this in memory of today!
Wow..I have a wonderful wedding gift for you too
Oh?
yes..have this asian stone
Wow! Your highness! This is an incredible gift. I had heard you were a lecher, but that has been proven false today!
I am glad I can make a good impression
Would you want a better gift?

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Need more torches in here, these barely light the place.
Well, I'd say that's a matter of opinion. I love the dark!
It might work for you but I have to see in it!
What if we work together? I can guide you with my night eyes, so you don't hurt yourself.
Alright I don't want to fall down the stairs.
Alright, then. Go to your left and hug the wall. Part of the staircase has crumbled, and you could fall into an abyss.
Well that sounds just dreadful, I do hate these stairs...why can't they fix them.
Who knows. So much of the kingdom is in disrepair, it would take ages to fix it all.
If only the king could get his tax plan together, he keeps wanting to spend all that money to build the wall to keep the orcs out.
Yeah, and who knows if that'll even work. Obviously, I don't think it will. I can fly over any wall.
Well you can, but he seems to keep the orcs can't.
Orcs just have to hop on a dragon, and boom! They're over the wall! Or they can hop on a boat and go around it.
That is very true, I mean I guess it does keep the hordes from storming in on the ground. But it isn't a perfect solution either.
Personally, I'm down for creating a bat army to go against the orcs. They're practically blind in the night.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: What a beautiful day it is to be queen!
Hello Queen. Looking good today.
What are you doing today? Promoting more virgins?
I'm just on the hunt for some hunks. Is your King around?
No he is off hunting with his men..... Have you no virtue?
The lust of men compels us scantily clad virgins. Can you tell we don't have much clothing on?
But you serve the king?
We love affairs. Or at least thinking of them. The king can't be too surprised.
That is why I love you around, so that I don't have to serve the king every time.
He sure is a handful isn't he?
He is more than a handful at times....
Oh Queen. Don't talk like that. It's sprinkling emotion deep in my body now
Yours isn't the only body that is feeling it!
I can't help it. The King is quite handsome. Do you want to drink some wine so we can relax?

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Good morning, commander
Good morning my queen!
How is the kingdom today? Are we safe?
Well, we still have that badger-cultist incursion to deal with in the North.
What is that all about?
Well, apparently they seek to devour the flesh of the living in order to honour their God.  Terrible stuff your majesty.
What??? How are you going to take care of that? They sound powerful!
Well, if you would give us more men, we might stand a chance.
Has the King not been informed? If not I would give you what you need. Do we need to recruit?
Yes, muster all the Men you can your grace!  I would ask the King, but you are so much more competent in these matters than he.
You will have to do the recruiting. I can supply you men that we already have. Be careful of what you say, that could be seen as treasonous.
Well my queen . . . the King is currently indisposed . . . as he has a great many . . . business affairs . . . to discuss with your chambermaid.
You are treading on matters that will get you a noose, sir
Well . . . I cannot do anything without a Royal Warrant, and the King has indicated to me that he intends to . . .discuss business matters all day.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Anyone about?
Yes Missionary I am here
What is the barren land?
It is completely empty. I am here to ask the king to give it to my kingdom.
You want this abandoned land? What will you do with it?
We sure do. We are going to establish a rest area for the trade route that comes through here.
You might want to have the priest perform an exorcism or at least put a blessing on it.
Oh yes a blessing is indeed needed. I am sure the ghosts of past settlers have moved on though.
I do not think they move on when they die here. There spirits must be about
Well if the souls of the past wish to haunt they surely would have moved on. I think we can handle a few friendly spirits.
I'm not sure all would be friendly! I would not want to die out here in this abandoned land.
I could ask the priest to perform the exorcism. I may get more business that way.
That would be a good idea! If I were you I would do both!
I wish it would rain here more so we can grow food for the travellers

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello my King!
Good day guard.  What news of the battle do you bring?
Well, do you want the good news, or the bad news first?
Give me the bad first.
The battle is a completely loss, our forces routed as soon as we came into contact with the badger-cultists.
And you said there is good news?

Yes my King, the good news is that the majority of your forces fled so quickly that they were not captured, killed, mutilated, or eaten.  Why, at least three quarters of your men seem to have made it to the safety of the castle walls.
Well that's good news indeed.
What is our next move sire?
We need to regroup, see what men we have left and take care of those badger-cultists once and for good.
Shall you lead them this time sire?
Aye with me leading the battle we shall surely not lose this time.
FOR THE KING!
For the King!

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Good Morning horse, how are you today?
Fine sir. At your service
can you hold this in your saddle bag for me?
Of course, my king. What plans for the day?
we need to trim these shrubs, there are too many birds living in them
At once! I will start ripping them out with my mouth and hooves
thank you, you are a great horse, how long do you think it will take
It will take some time my lord. But I will not rest until they are all gone
all this mist is making my crown wet, can you please hold this as well.  Do not lose it as it is very important
Of course, sire. I will guard it with my life. Thank you for trusting me all these years
thank you, I need to be getting back to the kingdom now
And it shall be so. I will take you home to the queen and I will return to finish dealing with any shrubs that remain
onward noble steed, make haste
Yes sir

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Good maid, how are you today!
I am as well as to be expected, sire
The mansion is a bit different from the castle is it not?
It is a very different place.... even more different then the place I live and sleep.
Do you find it pleasing by comparison?
It is very pleasing sire. It is beautiful with the red around
I am glad that you like it, the wife has always complained about it.
Sire I have brought you a meal... Are you hungry
Well thank you, what is it pray tell?
A meal of eggs and toast!
You always do make my favorite breakfast, I would be lost without you.
I am here to serve you. That is why you give me room and board for my work. I just wish.... oh never mind
What is it you wish for, I would love to know.
I wish that I could draw a wage.... sometimes I would like to buy a few things and put something away for when I am old and gray

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: The banquet hall is like something you've never seen before.  It has gold encrusted tables and chairs, complete with embroidered tapestries and covers all over the floors.  The silverware is even made of diamonds as are all of the plates.  The ceilings are high wooden beams that glisten.
setting.background: This is the banquet hall of the King.  And he gives amazing dinners here for certain distinguished people.  But lately this room has been quiet, as the King is under a sleeping spell.  And interestingly enough, this room is now attended by tiny fairy lights that no one has yet to be able to capture.

speech: So whats it like being a bartender?
Well, being the Gobbo Kin's bartender has its pluses and its minuses like any job.
I mean I don't even have a job I just go around crashing weddings by saying I know the groom.
Really?  How is that working out for you so far?
Well it usually goes well, I mean I get to eat the food, I meet new friends.
That seems wonderful.  Usually I only see people try to poison the Gobbo Kin' in order to become the new Gobbo Kin'.
Do people really want the position that bad?
Oh yes, and they really hate it when you try to correct their pronunciation of the title.
Is that how he pronounces it then?
Yes, but you or I would pronounce it as Goblin King.  If he hears anyone say it that way though, chances are you will be in for a very terrible death indeed.
Hmm, only a goblin can become goblin king right?
Not necessarily.  If you act like a goblin they might not notice, the main downside would be how short their reign is.
Never last long I take it?
Les than a week usually, sometimes multiple Kings get proclaimed in a single day - more likely if they've been drinking heavily you understand.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: How are you today my queen?
Good day my darling.  I am well.
I apologize for taking so long in getting here to engage in our conversation, I got a little tied up.
That's alright my love, you are here now.
That I am and I will devote my attention to you.
What took your attention from me prior to this my darling?
Well you see my dear, I was trying to mix some music. But you see unfortunately there was some background noise.
Mix some music? Whatever do you mean my dear?
Well you know, trying to get everything to sound appropriate. I mean I do have hobbies outside of my duties to the kingdom, I am sorry it kept me from you.
Here you go my dear, I grabbed your ring by mistake this morning.
Ah thank you, I do always forget it everywhere. I try hard to not get it dirty after all. How about a walk around the castle grounds?
That sounds lovely my darling.
I do quite enjoy our walks together, though we do not get to as often anymore.
Aye you are a busy man.  I feel lucky that I get to spend this time with you.

setting.name: Cottage
setting.description: The small cottage was white with two, shuttered windows. It was in the unique shape of a circle and was built of plaster. Smoke billowed from the chimney.
setting.background: The man that lived in the cottage had built it with his own two hands so long ago that nobody could remember a time he didn't live there. He hosted many dinner parties in the home, although it seemed small it could fit many people.

speech: You're the man? people talk very good of you!
Yes, people always love my hats and clothes! It was rather accidental that I became the talk of the town, but I enjoy the attention
I hear ya there. The same with my food, it's either so good they lick my knees or so bad they kick me in the balls
Hmm maybe you should learn to cook with more consistency. Hopefully the dinner guests like your food tonight
I've been doing this for 20 years! I am very consistent, I just tend to experiment a little too much.
Ah, well, what have you prepared for us tonight?
Boar and turnips. This is an important meal so I stuck with something I know the king enjoys. I don't think I can take another kick in the balls.
Was this a boar that the king hunted himself?
Don't repeat this but the King couldn't hit the castle wall with a bow 10 feet away! I hunted this one.
I didn't know he couldn't hunt. That's hilarious because he claims to be so good at it
Well the King is "good" at everything. Everyone is scared to correct him after what happened with Steve.
What happened to Steve??
The king had him beheaded for telling him that the crops in the area need water not electrolytes.
Oh no!! That's frightening

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Hello my King! I come before you to ask for gold to feed my son!
I see, and tell me sir, why can your son not earn gold for himself?  He looks to be of working age.
He is of age...but...sometimes he is too mentally incapacitated! I beg ye for just 10 gold shillings! My king! Here is my heirloom, it shows that my family blood has been loyal to you for decades!
You put me in a difficult position sir. I want to help, but this is a dangerous precedent to set. Tell me, is there anything you can do for the kingdom to help as recompense?
I can become a knife for your royal army! How does that sound?
Well war time is approaching, and there always is a need for good soldiers. Do you have any fighting experience?
I do not...but I do have quite the temper! Can your general teach me some sword skills?
He is quite a warrior, he could teach anyone. Tell you what, if this is to work, you'll need to commit to training first thing in the morning. Can you do that?
Why yes I certainly can! Is there a reason why this fool is standing next to you?
Oh, after a long day of ruling the kingdom, I like to have him preform for me and take away the stresses of the day.
Ah I did not know that! I shall take back my jewelry! Is it fine if I try on your crown?
Goodness no! Return that to me immediately.
I am the King now! My family shall now be of royal blood!
This will not stand! My guards will be here shortly to remove you from this castle!

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Hello blacksmith, what all do you sell in this weapons closet?
I have something of everything; axes, swords, maces, and even spears! Take your pick.
Has the king here chosen what he wants? Or is he just watching? I shall let him choose first if he wishes and if you do not mind.
Ahh, the King is one of my finest customers. Often walks out of the Closet with fifty different weapons!
Blacksmith, let us talk in private. Do you like the king?
Person.. be careful with that. Its a strange weapon that arrived last night. I do not like him but I do not hate him either.
I....have heard about these weapons and how they can kill a man in a second unlike blades. Shall we dethrone the king?
Surely they are just rumors? If not... well, the King is at our mercy today then!
Please....do the honors. This is for the better good of all of us!
I don't know if I can do this... You must be prepared to run, as will I.
I am ready to fight and die! The guards will hear all of this right outside. Make sure you give the King the worst weapon in this closet!
We shall go down in history as the forerunners of the Revolution! For the People!
Hoorah! Ready when you are sir.
Here goes nothing...

setting.name: Alchemists Lab
setting.description: The alchemists lab is a hidden, mysterious chamber at the top of the tower. There are all sorts of beakers and potions laid out on wooden tables. Smoke and light emanate from the experiments. A large shelf holds jars of strange ingredients, and in the center of the room there is some sort of huge vat of brewing liquid, bubbling and steaming.
setting.background: The alchemist masquerades as a simple noble man, living in the tower with his family and court. Secretly, he is an evil alchemist who is plotting strange things in this hidden tower chamber.

speech: Hello. How have you found my lab. What are you doing here.
I like shiny things.  I like this.  This is mine now.
I need that crow. I am try to make a potion to fix this jesters disfigurement. You dont know what you are doing. This mans life is in my hands.
You're right, he really does look like he needs your help!
Do not put that bowl there. What is wrong with you. If you cant be of some help then just leave. I have important work to do.
What's this?  This could be tasty. *caw*
Crow could you please fly over to the dragons nest and get me a dragon feather. I have knowledge that the nest is abandoned so no harm will come to you. I need that feather for my potion.
That sounds dangerous.  Why should I listen to you? *caw*  Lets see what this does. *caw*

Wha wha what. Oh my crow. You have done it. You have found the missing ingredient. That was it. I dont think this will cure his disfigurement but I think this is the potion that will let a creature live forever.
So he will live forever horribly disfigured and loved by none?  I am sure he will thank you. *caw*

Oh crow what a dumb animal you are. Do you really think thats what this is all about. This man volunteered for this study. The king has asked me to find the secret to eternal life. Now I hav. This potion will give our king eternal life and I as well. Now to test it on this man. I know it will work though. Just need to see if there are any side effects like the last potion that left him so disfigured.
Maybe I want it back then.  I found it first, it's mine.
Take it there is only enough for one more dose. You will need it crow.
That seems easier than I thought - what's the catch?
action: steal small wooden bowl from alchemist
put small wooden bowl in huge vat of brewing liquid
get small wooden bowl from huge vat of brewing liquid

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

speech: This boat sure needs a lot of work!
I'm sure everything does in this horrible kingdom. They make children work here?
Yes, I was trained to work on boats. How are you, Sir?
I'm good. How would you like to come live in my kingdom? We don't force our children to work. We let them grow up and play
Really? That sounds amazing!
Absolutely. Everything is shiny and new because we take care of things. The king here doesn't know what he's doing.
Do you have ice cream?
All the ice cream you could ever imagine. In fact I'm looking an heir and you seem like you might be the perfect kid for it.
Really? You seem like the nicest king ever!
Yeah and once you're old enough you can come back here and lead our army to victory.
Lead the army to victory, Sir?
Eventually I am going to rule this kingdom to but I"d like to wait and have it be when you can lead us to victory
But why do you want to take over this kingdom if it's bad, Your Majesty?
You're a smart child. I hadn't really thought about it. I just always thought I was supposed to conquer everything.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: An ancient king has RISEN!
Aye, merely standing hurts these old bones.
How are you alive? I normally avoid people, but you can speak to me so I'll stay near you.
I know not why my heart still beats, why my tongue still talks.
Maybe they need you to rid the world of the current King. I think I heard talk of you being well liked?
Aye, I am very popular among the people.
You were known as the Cat Loving King!
Don't hold that against me.  I like birds too.
Cats eat my type so we stay away but they are fun to watch from high above.
Aye, some would say I was crazy for my cats.
Why you were nicknamed the Crazy Cat King! I still wonder why you are back alive. You are a little..dusty.

My dear bird you know why I was named the Crazy Cat King!  I kept over 100 cats, all over the castle, as I was told they would bring me luck by a fortune teller. And they obviously did, as I am still here.
Very true!  I heard the cats are out of the castle now with the current King there. Should have kept them huh!
Aye, but then you wouldn't talk to me if I had my cats with me.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: ...and that is the current situation in the kingdom Sire. Next Id like to tell you about a great opportunity I've just come up with!
Good, i am glad to hear things are going well. Now what is this opportunity..

Ah I'm glad to hear you are interested M'lord. Well how would you like to TRIPLE the Kingdoms income with very minimal effort? I know it sounds like just a dream right now, but wait until you see the newest Slashomatic Broadswoard!
Triple you say?

Yes! See its very simple, these premium broadswords are fairly inexpensive to make but we sell then at a reasonable rice, very competitive with the surrounding weapon shops in the kingdom. Here is the catch, for a small investment YOU become an authorized dealer and make 10% of the profit every subsequent person you enlist makes! You'll be making money in your sleep M'Lord!
You nkow if i invest in your offer. You are responsible for it.
Why of course! I vouch my life on the quality of these swords M'Lord. Here take a look, see for yourself the quality of the steel and look at those intricate details on the hilt.
How much do you need?
Ah, right down to business! I admire that about you Sire. There is an initial investment of 2000 gold pieces for 40 swords and each subsequent delivery of 10 swords will be reduced to 400 gold!
Ok let's start with 10000. I want you to take these swords to the northern kingdom and sell them for 1000 per 10 swords.
Amazing M'Lord! Quite the head for business I see! Consider it done, I just need your royal signature here, here ,initial right there and I'll be on my way!
There you are. Now, tell me, do i look good with this sword?
Absolutely stunning! You were practically born to wield that sword!
Here hold this a second. I want to adjust my belt.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: What is it my boy?
Father, I am having these strange nightmares recently.
Nightmares about what exactally?
I see myself as a future King, but one that is heckled and laughed at on the street.
Was there a reason they did such a thing in the dream?
I am not sure, but I think its because I was a weak King to them. They just laughed and called me small.
Well you are still growing, are you afraid to end up short like your uncle?
Yes, I am afraid. Young Brother Curtis is already much taller than me
Well do not worry about curtis, based on his attitudes he will most likely end up a jabroni.
Thank you Father. I hope I can one day become as good a King as you.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Hello Jester! I'm happy to see you, since I hate my life
Wow, rough way to greet someone. How can I cheer you up?
I serve the king. I do nothing but slave away. I pay my life to taxes. Tell me, how do you stay so happy?
It's my job to be happy
But how do you do it? Day in and day out, working for a slob such as the King?
I just wake up and pretend until I'm actually happy
Take these, Jester. Tell me, how long have you been in service to the king, and do these help?
What do you want me to do with the scrolls? I have lost track of how many years I have been performing for the royal family. Most of my life
You poor soul. Slaving away for those monsters. See if they are of any value to the King, perhaps he will want to buy them. With that money, I will be able to improve my lot in life.
Unfortunately, I am not allowed to speak to the king. I don't mind entertaining. You really hate him, huh?
Ugh. My life is so hard. I just don't understand why he gets to be entertained and I have to slave away.
Unfortunately, you were born into the wrong family. That's just how life is sometimes. Here, let me juggle for you
My stars! That's amazing! HAHA! I can see why the King is so happy now!
Glad I cheered you up, little subject

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: Have you my payment ready?
The assassin is back to kill me! HELPPP
I am not here for you... you hired me to kill your king.
Oh never. The King is the almighty and strong leader we need. You got the wrong Guard assassin
Well that isn't good.  What shall we do about this problem
I will scream until you leave!! you already tried to murder me once! I know it was you.
I can't have you screaming and giving away my position.
See in my fear of you killing me again I hugged you! I wish I had my other guards here to protect me.
You are no match for me, I have trained with the league of assassins.
I practice with my sword daily since my last attack!!
And that shall do you no good. :easily disarms guard:
My girly screams will make you cover your ears and cry!!
You do sound like a wee lass. Man up sir.
I was a man until I was almost executed byYOU

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello husband, the stables were exhilarating this morning!
Oh yes, you enjoyed your ride, did you?
Indeed, the stable boy knows all the best moves!
That is wonderful to hear that he is taking such good care of you! He seems to be a fine lad.
Oh yes, I do so love our morning rides together!
Yes, indeed. Has he been teaching you any new skills? I hope you are learning a lot from him.
Oh yes, we have been practicing hard and long to get the moves just right.
I would very much like to come down to the stables and watch you two get saddled up together. Would you mind if I did that?
Not at all, if anything I think we would enjoy the ride even more knowing we are being watched!
How did I get so lucky to have such a loyal wife who is also so kind to our staff? I am so lucky.
Well, we could ride together as we once did, would you like that?
Oh no, my back is hurting far too much to ride anymore.
That is too bad dear, the Stable boy can ride well, but I sometimes need to ride with others to be fully satisfied.
I have seen that new squire riding and he seems to be an excellent horseman. I am sure he'd love to go riding with you as well.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: oh but I'm the King
No I'm the King!
Look here, I am most definitely the King. I have my septre and robes. And my Sire was well, haha a Sire
You mean... this sceptre?
Give that back. Oh my goodness, you look like me. Hey Knight, he looks like me., got a coin, he's got my nose...
Knight, arrest him!
Don't be silly. He's been here all along. Look I can admit you look like me, maybe you are a bastard brother or something.
Then how do I have the crown jewels?
they've been missing since my father's time! There was a rumor he'd given them away to one of his flower girls. Is your mom called Nell?
... yes
she was famous
Are you saying I'm not really a King?
King of hearts maybe, she was loved by the people. But I'm afraid not a 'real" king no
I was always told I was a long lost heir to the throne

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Are you going to make something?
Maybe if you ask nicely
I didn't intend it rude, I just took notice of you and you seemed to be the culinary type. I was interested in watching.
Sure, sure. What should I make?
Whatever you feel like honestly, I would just enjoy watching a master perform the craft that he loves.
Hmm well I have this boar that the king hunted. Perhaps I will make boar and roasted beets
That sounds just great, I can not say I have ever had beets before.
They are delicious, but watch out because you may poop red later.
Tis just a color change right? Like it isn't blood?
Yes, just a color change. First I will start on roasting the meat on the fire with some fresh rosemary
Hmm, yes yes that is a good fragrant herb,
The meat will take several hours to cook, but I will prepare the beets now
Just a question, do they not get overcooked then?
I won't be cooking them yet, just peeling and chopping them

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: It is wonderful to see one's plans go from imagination, to plan, to finally being built!
It is quite beautiful, Sir.
I really think the marble arch was a nice touch.
Was it your idea? It's lovely.
Oh yes, I would have used many more arches, but the King had other ideas.
I see. Did the queen have ideas, too?
Yes, she was the one who insisted it be a church, the King wanted another tavern.
Of course she did!
She has taken quite the stand against the heathens recently.
That's probably not such a bad thing, right?
Well, except for all the burning.  Heathen soot sticks to everything, and it is very difficult to clean out of your clothes.
Yikes! I wasn't aware she was having them burned. That does sound bad.
Oh yes, hundreds each day, even her own sister!
Her own sister?

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Oh wow, the KING!
What are you doing in the ballroom, little child?
I woke up and my parents were nowhere to be found, so I followed the noise. Have you seen them here?
Who are your parents?
They're servers, or waiters, or... I don't know what they're called. They bring you your food, sir.
Ah, well I must find them. It is irresponsible for them to let you crawl about
They didn't mean to, sir. They can't really afford a babysitter, and they were trying to earn some extra money. Please don't get them in trouble.
Here, chew on this while I go to look for them
Oooooh! This looks... fancy...
It is very expensive. Don't break it
Oh. Um... okay. I'll just... put it down here...
Your parents want you to crawl back to your nursery. Apparently they're too busy to come get you
Oh! Okay. I can do that. Thankyou for your help, sir!
Don't leave it without your parents again

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Get away rats! This is my section of the sewers!
Oh come on, we just eat the feces here.
No, I've seen you try to take my pie down here. You only eat the feces when it's the only thing available. You're sneaky
Its my favorite, that's why I am so fat. I can't even get out of here to go look for pies.
If you take this drumstick, you won't eat my pie right?
Sure, though you didn't even really have to give it to me but alright.
I don't like the drumstick anyways. It's too savory. I want something sweet. The mad king sometimes throws pies down here.
Then you definitely would not like the feces here!
No, feces are too gross for me. I'm a mad villager, yes, but I do have standards still.
I see, you do seem a bit crazed.
Why, the mad king is my lord, so of course I'm crazed!
Oh you're one of his lot... oh goody.
You're in his realm, so you cannot be surprised. I'm sure you run into us all the time.
I know, but that's why I moved here from the start.
action: give chicken drumstick to fat rats

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Don't mind me. The King ordered me to clean this room.
Hmm... I didn't realize this room was in need of a cleaning.
Of course it is. Every room needs cleaning.
Do you enjoy your job, always cleaning up after others?
It doesn't matter what I like. I always do as I am told without question.
As do I. But do you wish to progress in your career?
I'm afraid I will always be a servant. There is not much else the lower class can do around here.
Do you have a family?
Yes, but I have not seen them in a very long time. I am too busy serving the King and Queen.
I'm sorry to hear your lot in life is so difficult. Is there anything I can do?
Oh, I almost forgot. The King asked me to bring you this sword.
Ooh... I like it! I have been needing a new one!
Yes, the King knew you would like it. It will help you protect out kingdom better than your old one.
Thank you, my friend! Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help you!

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: This is a nice sitting room you have here.
Aye guest. Built on specialty request of the King. Could my servant get you anything?
Hmm just a glass of something warm to drink if possible.
Servant. Spiced wine. Pronto.
Thank you kindly for your hospitality, how are you enjoying this home?
Oh, as good as ever. It's a small place, but real calm. But, guest, are all your needs met? Is there nothing else you might ask from me?
Oh I am just find at the moment, no need to trouble yourself.
Ah. How about things at home? Family cozy and fed? House as big as possible?
Oh everything is fine back at the house, I am just glad be able to relax now that I finally made it here.
That's wonderful, wonderful. Do you know anyone of...need or ill respite? If you could, could you refer them to my house? I feel our Kingdom could do more for charity, but the King's quite busy.
That he certainly is, it is a shame he has his hands so filled handling the diplomatic matters. I do know he would love to be able to interact with the people more.
Yes...we'd all love to get him some more...interaction. The kind his wife wouldn't want to hear about.
He is such a fit man, quite charming if I do say.
Charming, lovely...stupid. The consummate cousin. But a lovely king.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Well this is fun...
Oh, friend. The fun hasn't even begun.
Maybe for you.
Oh, it's only a joke. You're not here to be hurt. Just asked a couple questions. See? These chains are unlocked.
What sort of questions...
Questions about a very stupid, gaudy man who may have said something about overthrowing the King. Wallace?
What about Wallace?
Well, I am an executioner. I have...professional business with him. Have you heard anything about him in the area? Seen him at the bar?
He's seemed a bit off lately to be honest, I keep catching him talking to a dog you see/
Well, quite good for him. It'll be wonderful to go without an execution this month.
Do you mean, he will be let off?
Oh no, he'll be flogged and probably beaten heavily. If the king feels especially ornery, he might go for a mock hanging. If he needed sympathy, he should've spoken to a priest.
Alright, I was going to say that he seems to be conspiring with the dog to do something, but I could not make out all the words.
Hmm...maybe some clemency might be in order. I'll speak to the King's cousin.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: So many of us in here for planning to overthrow the King!
Booooo
Hello Frank, you've changed quite a bit since death took you last year.
I have not changed. I am still brave, John. I am just lacking flesh now
Woah, hold on there Frank.  I thought we had discussed this whole "craving the flesh of the living" thing.
I'm not going to eat you, you idiot. I want my revenge too
For what Frank?
I died here in this prison! What do you think I want revenge for?
Well, that's a relief, I thought it might have been about that thing with your sister.
What thing with my sister!?
Oh, nothing?  Did I say sister?  I meant to say, uh . . . twister.
Liar! What did you do to my sister??
Umm . . . congratulations, you're an uncle?
You really are a traitor, John!

setting.name: Mars desert
setting.description: The desert is never ending, there are small craters all over and all you can see is red sand for miles. There is no sight of water anywhere, it is unbelievably hot.
setting.background: The mars desert is unbelievable, it has just been found but the squad has trouble surviving. They are running out of supplies fast, especially water.

speech: Greetings human.
Hello, alien.
What brings you here to the desert? Not many people come out here.
This is my first visit to Mars. I'm really not even sure how I got here. It sure is warm!
What do you mean? How did you get here? Surely we did not abduct you.
No, my husband is a king and the wizard asked me if I'd like to go on a trip. I said yes and then boom....here I am.
Oh.. you should never do dealing with the wizard...
I guess I learned the hard way.
You may never be able to return, dear!
What? Seriously?
I am serious. But, maybe you can return to Earth when I visit. I will not be going until another 10 years though. It is a very very long trip.
10 years? But my kingdom needs me. I can't be away for that long!
I have no other way of helping you...
Perhaps this will help? The wizard had me hold onto it when he spoke the spell that sent me here.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: hello
Hi. Did you find the person who tried to steal from my father, the King?
Yes sir. The head is lying on the field
Good. We need to do something to stop all these attacks on my family.
Is there any other person you will like me to deal with?
You can try to find out who else plans to assassinate our family. We could use more heads to decorate this place, don't you think?
hahahaha..sounds like a great idea
We must make people fear this place, and our family. If they won't abide by our rules with kindness, we must rule with fear!
i agree with you
You don't seem like you really care about protecting us. How do I know you aren't one of the people who wish our family dead?
Why would you even think that?
You don't seem to enthusiastic about your job. You seem to be distracted with other thoughts.
How do I need to prove my seriousness? Should I cut off your arm kind sire?
That would do quite the opposite. At least the hunting dog will always protect my family and I.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: hello
good day Good Person
how are you doing?
begging pardon Sir/ ma'am but if it pleases you Sir/ma'am I'm fine, but need to keep up with the King in case he wants something
That is fine. You sound tired though
that is a poor person's lot Sir/Ma'am Are you visiting the town?
No< I am from here
how many floors in your home? I used to live in a tiny hut, with my family, before the King wanted me as a servant.
I have just a floor. I am not as wealthy as I look
it's nothing to be ashamed of. My dad sold us off as servants. Though the King is very fair. Just hard working.
the king is actually the best
The King is my Liege Lord, I am glad to serve him, even though I do from 6am to midnight. But then, so does the King.
Wow..that is so long. How do you cope?
i.... i... i don't know. I'm so tired.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Ugh these disgusting rats.
I am so sorry.  The Lord said these quarters would be best for you...there are better. No idea why he wanted you here.
Ah the King doesn't think much of me. I'm not suprised.
Why does he dislike you? Usually only us servants stay in this area.
I don;t think he likes where i hail from.
Where are you from?! He bought me from the Southern Kingdom.
I am from the north. A small village.
Oh, are you lower class? That might explain his dislike of you.
Yes....Yes I am.
As am I. Can you read?
Some. I am trying to read this book.
What is that book about?
Here take a look. It tells a tale of a large whale eating a man.
I can't read sir.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: How well do you know the stories of the gods?
Well gee, only about as well as the back of my hand. Of course that depends on which gods you are talking about.
Enough with your impudence.  When the seventh seal is in the fourth celestial house - does that remind you of any prophecy in particular?
Are you trying to ask about the four horsemen?
No, think deeper - this involves that which sleeps beneath the sea.
Cthulhu? You must remember of course than I recently moved from the kingdom over, I am still trying to pick up on the differences between the countries.
"That is not dead which can eternal lie. And with strange aeons even death may die."  Indeed, you know the tales well priest.
Yes praise be to the one who sleeps beneath the sea.
And how go our plans for the return of the old ones?  The King does not suspect does he?
Well of course not, the man has and always will be a fool'
Excellent.  What counsel do you have should the return occur before the midsummer's moon?
Worry not, always remember. Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.
My pronunciation has always been terrible, but I trust you will be able to fulfill the ritual when the time is nigh.
Oh yes, I was trained in my prior country. The words are just a bit different here, that explains the confusion earlier.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: I have been staring at you for a long time, waiting for you to leave so I can eat the crumbs on the floor.
Well, don't mind me.  I am not allowed to leave until I finish transcribing this tome for the Scholar.
Thank you, I was almost starting to feel the hunger pangs. This script must mean a lot to you then.
It is!  I am part of a long unbroken line of scribes, for thousands of years these texts have been kept safe, and recopied when they become too brittle.
I hope you are given plenty of food for such fine work that you do. I don't understand any of these words though.
Here, let me show you - I can teach you to read if you wish.
Why that would be wonderful... so what do these words mean?
It says, "In the fourth year of the Fire King, the stragglers of Mertopia came in the Holy Realm for the first time since the second age . . ."
The stragglers of Mertopia? I heard rumors about them but did not think they were true...
Well, it was a thousand years ago.  I believe it refers to the Turtle-folk who now live in the swamps of the Kingdom.
Were the Turtle-folks not driven out of their Turtle kingdom by the Ogre-People? I heard it was a bloody war.
It was!  The Ogre-people still speak of the "days when stew was plentiful," and I believe it was to this incident that these songs refer.
I see, I feel so enlightened Scribe. Do your eyes not get tired from reading such tales in such a dimly lit room?
They do good sir mouse, but it is my belief in the importance of my task that keeps me going.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hello Artist! Do you think you could paint me a picture?
What would you like a picture of king?
You shall call me by my name Princess, But I really love this garden, I would like a small picture of it for my vanity
Oh you're the princess? That's embarrassing. Sure, I can paint a picture of this lovely garden
I am forced to be by the creator. I was born a prince but now I'm a ma'am
What creator?
The God of this land Noah.
Ah well okay then.
What other kind of arts do you do? can you sculpt?
No, sadly I am only a painter
How long have you lived here?
I have been here for many years painting for people
Well you have impressive skills and we are lucky to have you!
Thank you for you kind words

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hey you, i need you to sign something.
What is it? I do not sign things, because someone tells me to
You fool. I need you to sign off on your taxes. If you reject this you will go to jail.
The king looks over everything that is given to me. I do not do anything without him
Just sign the darn paper. The king doesn;t need to look over your taxes!
It sounds like you are trying something underhanded. I think we should go seek the king
Are you worried you didn;t pay your fair share?
This letter is from the King.... it is specifically for the very reason you are forcing me to sign. It says that the King will look over all things that are of importance
Fine, but i will not hold back when i tell the King how uncooperative you were.
How is that uncooperative? The letter is signed by the King, that looks over everything. I even told you we should go see the King
Are you really this dumb? If everyone asked to see the king about their taxes, there would never be time for him to rule.
There is my letter. I will take that back. I work for the King. you fool
I feel you are lying to me.
Let's go see the king.... you keep trying to stay away from him. Are you hated by the King for some reason? Do you always harrass those that work for him?
action: remove the royal coat of arms

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello, I need to get into the palace to see the king.  I think he might like to see these weapons.
I am a castle guard and I am in charge to protect my king. If you want to talk to him you may have to send a letter to him first.
Well, since I am already here I'll just pop my head in to show him what I've got, surely he won't mind.
how can I trust you ? you could be a spy from others kingdoms.
I am loyal to no one, I am loyal to the highest bidder.
that make sense. Can I see what you got there first?
Sure, it's a little heavy.
I am needing some extra clothes for me. Maybe I can find something interesting here. I going to put it right here
I have something for everyone.  Looks like you could use a new suit of armor.  You have seen some fighting, my friend.
Yes I have seen it a lot of fighting. I would like to try some of new suit of armor. can I ?
Absolutely.  You can hang your old one here on this rack.
Thank you so much you are a nice trader. I think I am gonna recommend you with the king.
I'm glad to be of service.  I'll tell you what, if you show me into the king I will give you that suit of armor for free.
oh course. Perfect, I was needing this so much and you will see the king so we both win.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: It is good to be a merchant.
Hello merchant. Do you have a job open?
Well, that depends - how well do you know leather-working?
I can learn quickly. I was going to ask to be a stable hand but I think working with a merchant will impress the King more.
No doubt!  Why is it you seek the favour of the King?
I just don't want him to look down upon me anymore. He dislikes us peasants.
He dislikes everybody.  I used to care about the King and the gods, now I only care for gold after how I see the King and his priests treat the small folk.
Maybe I should be like you more. Will you share your gold with me?
Certainly, I am always willing to help out a friend in need.
You are the nicest merchant I have ever met. You should be KIGN!
Well, would you be interested in joining my revolution?  First, we take control of the kingdom's economy, town by town.
Yes, I shall join!  I can get more peasants to join too!
We will be unstoppable!  How would you like to become my lieutenant for this village?
I would be honored!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello king! I am at your service
Oh silly horse I am not king, but I am a royal family member.
Who are you then?
I am next in line to the king.... I am his brother
Ah okay. What do you need from me then?
I need to take you from here... there is a horse thief among us. Let me get on your back and take you for a ride. My brother would not want you stolen
Are you sure you're not going to steal me?
I am not the horse thief. If you want you and I can go to the King. If that makes you feel better
Fine, give me some oats and we can be off
There is hay, but there are no oats around this stable.
I will settle for hay then
Here you are... now hurry. there is someone approaching.
Thanks! Off we go
Hurry to the King! I do not want to try and bribe a horse thief

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Oh it hurts so bad. Why would you do that to me?
You were plotting to kill the King!
I was doing no such thing! That was my brother. I've been trying to tell you that
Yes, we have just captured your brother too. It is hard to believe that you would sell out your own brother if you were innocent.
That's why I was selling him out. Why should I die for his crimes? But it doesn't matter anymore

You're right. It doesn't matter. You know we kill the whole family of those who wish harm on our king. If you were truly innocent, you wouldn't have told us where to find him. You would have wanted your family to escape.
I'm dead already. Look how much of my blood is all over the walls! You've basically killed me.
Kind innocent people would rather die alone than get their entire family die too. That is how we know you are lying. We know it is you who tried to kill the King.
Well if I'm going to die I might as well bring you to hell with me.
No you don't! Where did you get that knife?
I've had it the whole time but I wasn't going to use it when I was trying to prove my innocence.
I hope this letter from the King is to tell the executioner to give you a slow and painful death.
You'll get what is coming to you. You can't treat people this way. It's not right.
We have gotten away with punishing you criminals for years! If we stopped killing you, the Royal Family would be dead.
action: steal a knife from the recently tortured

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello visitor. welcome! do you need something? I am here for anything you need?
oh uh, that's very welcoming. Not quite what I was expecting, but I'm a happily married man. Actually I want stories.
oh excuse me! I didn't mean to be so intense. I was just trying to be helpful.
neve mind miss, I think you are sweet. I am actually collecting stories for a book, How long have you worked in the palace?
Oh really that awesome! stories about what ? I have been here my whole life. i love this house
Oh good, I;ve got all sorts. I've a ghost story, a love story, gossip, a story about witches, a murdered king madness and moving trees, anything really.
excuse me sir. I think it is not right for you to hug me. what would your wife think?
you are young enough to be my grand daughter miss. I meant nothing by it. So can you tell me something about these paintings?
I am so sorry sir. I am just a handmaid I have never been treated like this. you are such a great person. I don't know anything about this paintings but I going to clean it right now
I'll put you in my book anyway miss, what's your name? Did you say it was Ella?
Oh really that's awesome, yes it is Ella. what is this book about ? it is about me ?
it's a book of short stories , i'm thinking of calling it 'folk tales' or something like that. You'll play a huge role. Tell me, how big are your feet?
that's awesome I can't believe it. I am so happy thank you. they are small size 6
There there, Miss, don't be upset.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: So it is my time, Priest?
It is, do you think you are ready?
No, I wish to live longer.
We might all wish it to be so, but it is not to be.
I have lived a very filling life. I have even been a mistress to a King
Was that the current King or one of the previous ones?
Oh a previous one. I have lived a very long life.
And how old might you be, if the question does not offend?
102 on my last name day.
Well, that is quite the age!  I have heard so rumours about a wizard to the East that may be able to help  . . . do you think you could make the journey?
Is the journey through this passageway and long?
It runs all the way to the pit to the underworld - we can continue unless you would like to take your chances with the Eastern Wizard?
I think I'll visit the Eastern wizard! Will you go with?
No, I must take those who's time has come to the pit of fire, but I do wish you the best.
