setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: ugh This place is filthy.
Yup, hard to find many tasty morsels in here.
Woah you can talk?!
Oh yeah, big time.  Who are you again?
Why I am the King. All of this land is mine.
Well, I never voted for you.
I wouldn't accept a rat vote anyway.
Well, good thing I didn't vote for you.  I prefer to be ruled by rats.
Makes sense. You rats have no idea what it's like to be human.
Not really, seems all you do is harm the environment . . . not particularly admirable if you ask me.
We have our flaws but our intentions are good....most of the time.
So why are you in the debtor's prison anyway?  Forget to pay back your loan to the banking clan?
No i needed somewhere to clear my mind. I thought no one would be here.
Well, couldn't you take a walk in a garden instead?

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Thank you for letting me come in here.
Of course my dear. What seems to be the problem?
Well, I love my job, but my boss seems to take advantage of everyone who comes for his help.
How so my dear?
He likes to overcharge everyone for his services. He knows that they can't afford it, but he just doesn't care.
I see. Let us pray for this man, as he lacks the moral character of a normal man.
I hope this helps, but I have my doubts. Please pray for this man to see the error in his ways.
Why do you doubt our God?
I do not doubt God sir, I just believe is too far gone. He has changed a lot in these past few days. I fear he may be possessed.
Interesting. What other signs lead you to this conclusion?
He speaks in tongues that I do not understand. Do you think you could pay him a visit to see if he is possessed?
Sure my dear. I sure hope he is not. it is hard to release a demons after it has already latched onto someone.
I sure hope he can be saved. He was always the kindest man I knew, besides you and the King.
Well if that's the case it might not be that hard.
action: give a cross to lady in waiting

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: *whistles* Ah another day
Another day indeed... how is work going?
Going good! I am almost done in fact. When did you learn to talk?
The wizard spilt something on me last week and ever since, the humans and I can understand each other!
Oh how lucky for you! You even have an accent! That is funny.
Oh do I? What kind?!
It is what we humans call a southern accent.
Southern, huh? I like it. Makes me sound... cool. So what's up with the queen today?
I am not sure. She seems to be "out of it"
I thought so, too, that's why I asked. Does the king know?
I am unsure. I don't talk much to others when i work.
Fair enough. I try to keep to myself, too. Except it's difficult now I can talk and hear you all, I guess
I bet it was suprising the first time you understood a human.
Sure was. Even moreso the first time they understood me! I think we just stared at each other for what felt like hours.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Do you mind grabbing that bale for me?
Whoa! A talking horse....of course?
Yup... I am pretty smart.
How did you learn to speak, you intelligent horse you?
Someone cast a spell on me. The king wanted to talk to me.
I wouldn't expect the King to be in contact with a witch... Who would the Palace trust with enchanting magicks I wonder? What did they look like?
He has one royal witch at his castle. She is green adn old.
Really! The Good King Harold, making his acquaintance with an old green witch. Were it not coming from a talking horse, I'd scarcely believe it.
Haha. Yes it is not a normal thing to see i'd imagine.
I have to ask...is it frustrating being the only talking horse? If the other horses in the field can't understand you, that is.
They can understand my movements and actions. Nothing really has changed as far as communicating with other horses.
Nothing has changed for the Horse that Spoke to a King? That's a shame! I figured you'd be a minor celebrity.
They don't really understand it when i talk to other humans. They are ignorant.
What did the King have to say to you?

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Hello guard, do you have any cheese?
No cheese I'm afraid Sir Rat.
Hmm, could you at least fill this bowl for me?
Certainly, I do have plenty of gruel left.
Thank you guard!! What are you guarding here?
Prisoners - the other cells are full of them, but this one only has you and that ugly maggot.
What did the prisoners do?
Mostly revolutionaries, protesting against the King and whatnot.
Hm. Can you arrest all of the cats for me?
That might be a bit of a challenge, have you ever tried herding cats?
No they eat me if I go near them
Well, that is rather unfortunate.  Maybe you could hide in this boot?
Okay, I will try that. Thanks!
Good luck little one!  May you succeed in your noble cheese quest.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: ah there you are, I asked to speak to you yesterday, but was told you were at a site. So please tell me how the new palace plans are going
Sire, they are going excellently. We have found a patch of forest with hills on both sides, perfect for fortification. We only need laborers to clear the land first.
oh, fortification... it was meant to be a pleasure palace. I didn't think we needed any. After all we've lots of castles for that
The enemy will use the fact that it is for pleasure against thee. We must be viligant.
Now now, what enemies, the people love us, my wife and I. Who else would be king? I am king by divine right after all.
That is true, sire. But other kingdoms would seek to usurp your holy power.
maybe we just redecorate here. Could you make this less.......... pink?
I am not the decorator, sire, but I could let her know your ideas. Is there anything else you'd wish to change?
less drapes... i think  they don't give me a feeling of love
Her majesty would approve?
possibly? ...... maybe .... I need to introduce her to a friend of mine called Marie, have you met her. Full of joy she is.
Marie is lovely, I have met her.
You know what I mean then about the room, it's just full of old stuff bringing us down. I mean, suits of armor, old pictures. lets scrap it all.
Yes sire. I will have the royal pages get rid of everything.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: Good day Archer. Is everything prepared?
Yes, everything is ready for any one who wants to participate
You know what I mean archer. Is everything prepare for the King. Remember? Here is the poison.
What? I honestly don't know what you mean. Do you have me confused with one of the other archers?

Remember the plan.  Your are giving the poison to the sharp shooter over there and when you preform your flaming arrow act then the sharp shooter will shoot the King with the poison arrow...and then I will be King!
Even if this were to work, I'm pretty sure the King's son will be king next. And if not him then his brother.
You are not listening to me and you have been my faithful servant up to now. My blood is royal but of the challenging family. Our families have fought for years.  Now it is our time.  I will succeed!
You may be of royal blood, but there are others before you in the succession line. Do you really want that much blood on your hands?
Obviously this was not the time or place to try to usurp power.  I thank you for helping me to my senses. I wish you well in the competition today.
I'm glad you are finally seeing sense. And thank you. This should be an interesting competition.
Yes...to the winner go the spoils.
You are beginning to make me nervous. I think I'm going to go to my tent to prepare
Yes archer be away now.  I will see you after this is over.
Yes, once it is over.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: Hey, have you seen the King around?
I saw him here earlier this morning with a big bow, hunting down my friends
Oh no, we must be careful. I am going to take this bell off so he can't hear me.
Good thinking. We must get out of here. They'll pick us off like sitting ducks if we don't escape!
We should work together. Two heads are better than one.
I agree, now what is your plan. Perhaps we should use the pig to distract them whilst we make a run for it.
Yea sadly. The pig is too slow to escape. I think that is a good plan.
Give me that bell. I shall wrap it around the pig's neck and send him away.
Sounds good. When i scream we take off...ok?
Screaming will just attract attention. Just wink at me when you're ready.
Good idea. Are we ready?
Yes! The pig is on its way and will distract the Knight's, now is our chance!
Alright let head for that tree.
Disguise yourself between the branches so that you blend in naturally!

agents: grazing milk cow in the background

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

character: a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
speech: I sure do like grazing, these pillows taste spectacular.
Why my queen wanted a cow in here is beyond me.
She thinks I'm cute! *munch* *chew* *shred*
You are a nuisance. Why do you think pillows are food?
Because they are tasty?
Ugh can you just stand there and be quiet?
This looks tasty too.
You pooped on my favorite rug!!!
Well, and in a few more places on the way here.  Your servants were very unhappy.
You need to be put down.
That's what the servants said about you as well.
Really? Which one?
All of them, whenever you are out of earshot.  Apparently there are rumours of revolution among the peasantry.  But that's none of my business.
I feel like you are lying to me cow.

steal fur carpet from a grazing milk cow in the background

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: We should put this enemy to death immediately before he tries to escape
Don't you think we should play with him a bit to see what kind of valuable intel he has?
You're probably right. What kind of interrogation did you have in mind?
Well good ol' fashioned wood and anvil to the stomach has never failed me.
I like the way  you think. Do you think he knows who is behind the plot to kill the king?
I doubt it, he looks like some disposable soldier the enemy sent. But he ought to know the names of the higher ups.
That would be good to know. I'll hold him over the fire while you hit him
The log is hot and simmering, be careful not to get close to it as I press it against his chest.
Thanks. Let us hope we get enough information to make the king happy
Arghh! Take this you heathen savage! i don't think he took that very well.
Might have been a bit much. I think he's unconscious. Oh well we can eat while we wait for him to come to
Oh well, I am rather hungry any ways. Now where is my fish stew?
I think I saw it over by the wooden wall. Let me go get it for you. I know it's been a long day
Thank you, it has. I did not expect the outpost to be attacked three times in one day.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: ALRIGHT MEN, I want this ship loaded with these supplies, and I want it done pronto!
You heard the man!  The King wants the ship built precisely to my design.
These idiots would never get anything done without someone breathing down their neck the whole time.
I know what you mean, why just the other - wait, is this pine?  The ship must be made of oak!
The paperwork I was given from the loggers certified that this is oak. You don't think they'd try and swindle Royalty?
Feel the wood - it is far too light, the grain is all wrong, and it smells like an air freshener.  It seems they were trying to swindle the King.
I wouldn't know wood grain from cereal grain, Craftsman. But these are serious accusations if what you say is true.
How much of this wood have you used so far?
None yet. It was delivered last night, very late. This whole project was a bit of a short notice from His Majesty.
Thank goodness, otherwise we might have been required to scrap all of the work which has been accomplished so far.
Well that's just dandy. MEN, LISTEN UP. Leave the wood, but load the other supplies! We'll be taking this load back to the Castle grounds!
And how long do we have to complete this project?
Not nearly long enough. This vessel is supposed to commemorate the coronation of Prince Thaddeus.
The coronation!  Why, we'll need to work night shifts to finish it on time.
action: give wood to foreman ordering his workers

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: We are almost there now horse. Soon we will be performing for the King!
And what a wonderful performance it will be!
I think it will be. Here, have some candy - I think you deserve it after such a long journey.
Oh thank you, you are ever so kind to me!
I would be no where without help horse, of course you are deserving of my kindness.
And you are my favourite human!  I love you so.
Thank you. Its getting cold in this tent, I ought to fuel the fire with some wood.
Yes, it has been a rather chilly march.
Our struggle will not be wasted when the King sees our performance.
Which act will you choose to perform?  The performance must be special!
I will first sing the Hymn of his Holiness and then perform Nightmare of the Horse with you.
Oh my, that does sound exciting!  Please, tell me more!
In the final scene, I will climb on top of you and do a flip whilst playing the flute.
Oh yes, just as we practiced!  You are ever so talented in you fluting acrobatics.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Why hello there your highness
Guard! It is good of you to come so quickly. I can not find the King!
Well he did take his horse thunder for a ride this morning, I don't know if he has come back yet
He should be back by now. He is always in his Chambers by supper@
Let pull out the map and see what has marked maybe he was doing something else other then casual stroll
Good idea. Hm it shows here that he went to Duck Hunt and then... he returned to the Palace? But... where is he?
hmm I sense another  presence in here take this and defend yourself
Alright. I sense something strange in here too. Someone seems to have left the windows open...
How dare you threaten the royal family !!!!
An assassin! Kill him guard!
I am the best swordsmen in all the land he shall die today
The assassin won't stand a chance. I wonder what he did with my husband
He is dead funny the map says he is  in this room maybe check the wardrobe
Oh.. oh no. This can't be... the King is dead...

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello. i'm sorry, are you lost?
It would indeed seem like I am, I was just standing by a grave mourning a loss.
you are in the King, my husband's bed room.
Oh dear indeed...it must have been that witch, she was not satisfied to already take my husband from me...
I am sorry? I beg your pardon, I must have misheard. A witch did you say?
Yes, a witch cast a spell on my husband sending him to his grave, I was there mourning and then I heard laughter.
but why?
She just showed up one day saying our forefathers owed her money and demanded interest as well, we had no means to pay it.
oh I am sorry, and sorry for your loss. How did you husband die? Will this help? You really should have brought this to the
I apologize for the long story my queen, the witches curse got him.
Why did you not report this? Please, I want the Kingdom to be safe and my king secure. Why would she send you here>?
I suppose in an attempt to further humiliate me by making it seem like I meant harm, hoping that a guard would quickly come for my life.
Well that might be true after all. I will have you arrested while we go gather this witch for questioning. Guards! Guards!
Please no my queen...!! I am only a victim in all this...

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Is there anything I can do for you?
His majesty the king has asked me to come here to repair this bench.  I just can't figure out what is wrong with it.  If I don't figure it out then I don't get supper.
Well have you tried sitting on it?
Yes.  It doesn't do anything.
Hmm, what about the shape of the legs?
They look like good legs to me. Nothing out of alignment.
Is the backing in order?
hmmm...seems to be.  It could be me ...but the bench seems to be putting me to sleep.
Well there must be an issue with it.
Do you think there could be a hex on it Preacher?
I am not versed in hex's, I mean it seems fine. What could be the matter with it I wonder...
It's probably just me.  I've been working so much lately.  Oh...look there...there is a lump under that cushion.
Well what is the lump?
It's a church mouse living in the Kings Bench!!!  No wonder his majesty is upset with this wiggly thing in the upholstery.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: Hello my King. What brings you here?
Man, are you doing in my bed chambers?!?! I came to nap, and yet here you are!
Oh i am sorry sir, It's my first time here. I didn't know this was your room
Yes, it is, as evidenced by the many fancy ornaments and fine silks. How on earth did you get in here? Where was my guard?!
I was looking for the bathroom. I did not see a guard.
Ugh, damn guard... well HE'S fired... the bathroom? Turn down the hallway on your left, and it's the 17th door on the right. Very easy. Or you can use mine, since you're here.
Thank you sir. You are a kind King.
Of course, of course... one doesn't like to be caught short in a building this big, does one?
Haha. It is very easy to get lost in here. How long did it take you to remember where everything is?
I was raised here, so thankfully it's very easy for me... but I can see how it would be confusing. I believe the servants have two weeks training on the layout of the place.
That's not much time if you ask me. Was this always your room?
No, I had a smaller room on an upper level as a child. I only moved into this one when I became king.
I would sleep like a baby on that bed. Haha
And I do! Haha. Tell me, what is your bed chamber like?

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Please accept my offering angel so that I may win favor with your god
What is your offering?
This sword. It has served my family for generations
It is useless to me. If it has been used to cause grief and harm, it is not an offering that is needed.
You are an ungrateful angel
You are an ungrateful person! Do you think that the Lord can be bought?
I will offer this sword  to the dark lord then. He will surely be grateful
You are not even thinking of how much you are worth as a person. You would sell yourself to someone that is ungrateful for everything.
I will convince my whole kingdom to follow the dark lord instead. Your lord shall certainly lose power
He will not lose power. He will be sorrowful that you have decided to do evil instead of good.
Does a lord not lose power if he has less worshipers? I am a well respected king. All will follow me
You may think you are well respected. But do you know what they think or say behind your back. It would benefit you to change to be a king that is truly respected, not feared.
I shall be truly respected. You have made a mistake today angel
It is you I pray for. It is you I hope for. It is you who needs strength. You are the one taking the easy way out.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: Hello my good sir's. How are you guys on this beautiful day? What's the alter for?
I'll do the asking here priest.  I am from the village and came for a walk and find you here with an alter. Please tell me you are not preforming a sacrifice on our beach. You have a temple for that.
Do not speak such words. I am a child of god. Thou shall not kill. Who put this alter here?
Oh I see.  You are selling this alter to this customer who has a boat.  Are you authorized to make such a deal?  Does the King know what you are doing?
I will have nothing to do with the alter. I detest the dark arts. It is probably his alter. Bringing the dark arts into our kingdom.
Well what ever you are doing it better be for the good of our God and Kingdom.  I just want to enjoy my walk.  I don't usually run into a man of the cloth outside of the temple.
I was out for a nice stroll. Would you like to walk with me and hear about our lord?
I'm thinking I know about as much as possible since I'm in every service but if you have a good fishing story I'd love to hear it.
I can't say that I do son. Are you a fisherman?
No not me father.  I know you spoken of fishing in your sermons so i thought you liked to fish.
I do, but I hardly catch anything. Doesn't make for a good story I'm afraid. I like the peace and serinity.
Look at this. Someone lost a cloth and there is a washboard over there.  I wonder who it belongs too?
Maybe it was the customers as well. Let's ask him.
Yes it was his. He sure has a bunch of stuff scattered out here.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Brother, I have decided to make you a knight of the realm!
I am quite honored! Thank you for your kindness.
No need to thank me, it is what you always wanted - and now, at the age of eighty three, I think you have earned it!
An achievement no less. Are we here in the armory to pick out my regalia?
Yes!  You will carry this war Axe as a symbol of your office.
What do you say we have a little duel before my promotion? You know I like to play rough, but our sisters don't care much for it.
I suppose brother, though at the age of eighty-five I'm not nearly the shot I used to be.  Can you believe it has been Seventy years that I have held the throne?
A great time of rule indeed. But now is not the time for chatter, on guard! Your move, King.
It seems my first shot has gone wide brother!
Looks like being younger keeps me sharp.
Neither of us are quite as young as we once were . . . .ooooh, my angina.
You've still got quite the strike! Perhaps we should pick me out a sword too for my promotion, wouldn't you say?
*wheeze* We could . . . have one . . .*cough* . . . custom made . . .
I want one forged just like this! Father used to carry one when he hunted.
room_agents: an a squire still keeping everything sharp
