setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: This fire is so warm. It is my favorite spot in the workshop.
It is indeed warm. What are you all doing inside here? This is the Banquet Hall. We are setting up for a celebration.
We are protecting this area of the castle. There will be many visitors tonight
How generous of you to devote your time here. I am tired and wish I could go home.
Yes I bet you are. Have you been preparing for the celebration all day?
More than all day today, more like all week! I get no rest.
Yes the king works us very hard as well. sometimes I like to sneak away to nap in the courtyard but I am sure you cannot do that..
I am not allowed any breaks. I wish, but I cannot do so safely.
Ah, I see. What is the purpose of tonight's celebration?
A new alliance has been made with the neighboring kingdom, so we are throwing this to show our appreciation.
Well I hope you can save me some of the scraps and bones from the delicious feast tonight
Well, most certainly. We cannot let our guard dogs go unfed. All of them will be yours!
That is very kind of you. Sometimes I miss when I lived with the craftsman protecting a little workshop instead of a huge castle..
It can be tedious I am sure, but you are and will be award greatly.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Ah yes, how I enjoy the darkness.
What are you doing here jailer?
Well someone has to patrol right?
Why do you have to patrol down here?
Well everywhere needs patrolled yes? Also I may sometimes get a little bored.
Is there something precious down here that needs protecting?
Well of course, look at all the riches stacked away down here. If no one checks it then it could easily vanish one day.
Hmm...
Oh, a traitor are you?
I serve my king! There is nothing more honorable than stealing riches for him
Why would the king steal riches from himself?
Stupid jailer, I don't serve the same king that you do
Then you serve the wrong king, now burn in hell.
You serve the wrong king! He is a tyrant

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Hello villager, I am your king. Please bow before me.
Yes yer Majesty, please Sire, don't kill me.
I will not, do not worry. What brings you to the royal fishing shack?
Thank you Sire, for not killing me, I'm cleaning it Sire. It's old but needs it often. People drag their muck in.
Very well I see. The kingdom needs more villagers like you, people that will tend to their community. Is there anything you want in return for your favor?
I'd love time off Sire, but cannot take it. Alas, as a peasant, I am obliged to work all the hours I can.
Ah a hard working villager and also humble at the least. You are a great villager and I applaude you. Have you fished here before?
No SIre, I'm not allowed. I collect some of the scraps though, so we eat better.
Do you think you could maybe catch me some fish? The queen and I would love to try some pike tonight. I will order the fishing shack opened for you.
I can certainly try Sire, I've never done it though. I hope I can for you. Pike are nasty fish.
I suppose you are right, I have never tried any fish from around here actually. Do you have any recommendations? Sometimes I wish I was as normal as you...
Sire, I eat scraps, I make stew from them, I can let you have some to try.
I will trade your my crown for the stew, is that a deal?
oh hahaha hahahaha look at me!  You'll need to come to my hovel with me Sire and meet my family.

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: Thank you for coming with me guard. I needed to get out of the castle for a bit.
I understand, but this place is crowded and I fear for your safety.
Don;t be such a worry wart. We are fine.
I don't think you understand the negative sentiment toward the king right now.
There will always be people who hate the King. Now come on, i want to buy a new dress.
OK, I will follow you.
So do you have any family?
I do, I have a wife and a child.  They are so wonderful.  You are a good queen to care about your subjects.
You are not my subject, more like a friend. I don't have many.
Why is that?  You should be able to find people that want to spend time with you,
People fear me. They think if they wrong me i will have my father hurt them.
Powerful women scare people, they need to realize that you are more than just your position in the kingdom.
Yes, sadly they will never come close to me. I fear i will be alone for a long time.
Have you expressed this to the king?

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Why are you here hangman?
I'm here to show you how our forefathers dealt with bandits and murderers.
I am just a poor farmer!! I did nothing to deserve this
So you mean to tell me that you haven't broken the law?
Yes, I have just been here preparing for harvest. I don't know what I could have done to bring you to my house
How do I know your not lying to me?
Go ask the King!! I have served him loyally
Forgive me, I am only making sure that this part of the country is free from those wretched bandits.
Of course, hangman. As long as you don't try to kill me again, you are forgiven
I take a lot of pride in my work and can sometimes get carried away.
That's.. understandable I guess
With this nobody should mistake you for a bandit again.
Thank you! Here's your noose back
Now go on and enjoy your day free of crime.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: I do hope the queen will be pleased if I get her some fish!
Does she like fish to start with??

I hope so!  She said she thought there was something fishy about with the King, and, as we're not allowed to be asking her majesty any questions, we need to make a best guess as to what it is she truly desires.
So that made you assume she likes fish?
She said "fishy!"  How else would you interpret it?  Oh, how I would love to be her once day, but the other maids are foolish and dimwitted.
You seem to not have much grasp on the way language is used child, she was saying he is up to no good.
The Queen?  Never!  That is the talk of treason that is.
Tis not treason to speak the truth.
And what truth would that be besides that her majesty be wantin' some fish!  You're a fisherman are you not?
I am a fisherman...do you not see my nametag on my shirt. It clear states Hark my name is tommy and I am a fisherman.
Well then, I wish to purchase fish for *our* majesty the queen!
The woman needs not fish as I tried to tell you...why are you so dense...
You are infuriating!
And you are a simpleton woman, just take this fish. I do not even care about payment.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: What are you doing in here?
The king sent me, Sir
The king sent you here for what? He knows that I am busy...
I'm not sure, Sir. He said he needs you right away.
This had better be important, he acts like I just have all the time in the world meanwhile here I am maintaining constant focus so that this castle does not fall off the cliff...
Fall off the cliff, Sir? Are we in danger?
Always! Every second of every day! That is why I keep to myself in this room so that I can maintain the magic that accomplishes that.
I had no idea, Sir. Thank you for your help and knowledge.
Such is the burden of magical power....
Were you born a wizard, Sir?
All wizards are born wizards, tis passed through blood. Sometimes it skips generations and some are not always too powerful.
Fascinating! And are you allowed to get married?
Well I could do whatever I want I suppose, but really it would be hard for me to find one that interests me.
I see. So you don't have children, sir?

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Servant, have you seen my loofa?
Have you checked underneath your person your grace?
I do not think I feel it there...
Try the er, other side of your person your grace.
Oh my how did it get in there, I may need a new one.
Yes, your grace, I believe it has been rather, shall we say, well used.
I can have another can't I?
Oh yes your grace, as soon as you get permission from parliament.
Nonsense, they cannot hold me back from loofas. Also I want a pink one, that is my favorite.
I shall ask the prime minister to present the Pink Loofa to parliament at the next sitting in the spring.
Fine, but it needs to be quickly boy, quickly.

Well, the act for the accoutrement of the King's person requires a two thirds majority in the lower house, then must also pass in the upper house before receiving your royal assent.  Ninety days, tops, your grace.
Politics are so annoying.
Indeed!  If only you hadn't signed the Constitutional Monarchy Act.

setting.name: Fishing Dock
setting.description: Folks call the area a Lake, but it's more like a pond.  Small and unimportant looking, yet peaceful.  The dock is no prize winner either.  Narrow in width, boards broken with several down right missing all together!  No tree nearby, no canopy, nothing to shade oneself on a hot day while fishing.  The watering hole may look small in size, but it deceives the eyes.  The water is as deep as the heavens.  No man knows what lurks beyond the light in this Lake.
setting.background: Once used as a swimming hole by a nearby village, the lake has been scrubbed from history.  Many tales of children and entire families going missing from the lake.  Some travelers even insist they saw creatures coming out of the lake from within the depths.

speech: Hello child. Is this young boy your brother?
No, I am here alone. I have no brothers.
A child all my themselves in this pond? Where is your family, just like mine?
They work for the royal doctor and are helping him with his rounds. I am alone, but that's OK. I'm used to it.
What is this?
Hey, that's mine! I was hoping to sell it to a fisherman. It can tell how the tides will be in the future
Let me see it first! Why do I have a feeling you found this around here....
My father gave it to me! It was a gift! But we are low on money, and I though I would sell it so that my parents didn't have to work so hard.
Let me get the rope as well, I don't think a child like you knows how to operate with it. I think you should get going now.
Will you steal everything I own?
Yes! There is no witnesses here in fishing dock area. Now does your parents have any gold for my family?
They have the King's favor, something far more valuable.
I hate the King! and I hate you! You probably live near the village where the crazies are!
The crazies? You bring your family to a derelict dock!
action: steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families
steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello My Lady! What brings you awake so early on this balcony?
I wanted to see the sun rise over the lake. It's beautiful isn't it?
Yes indeed. May I ask you if you could remove this chain from me? It surely is heavy!
Absolutely. How did you get a chain stuck on you?
Some gentleman put it on me when he was trying to catch me, but I ran away.
I'm glad you got away. I'm surprised he was able to catch you before you flew away though
Yes normally I cannot fly long distances but I can run pretty fast! I have to ask you....do you have any nuts or food I can eat?
I don't. I wish I did. Maybe after the sunrise we can go down to the kitchen and find some
Is this the King's book?
Yes, everything here is the king's. Why do you ask?
I was just wondering. Can you read my his book while we wait on the balcony?
Sure that sounds nice. Come sit on one of the cushioned chairs. Aren't they soft?
Yes, very comfortable. Can you also tell the King to stop getting the hunters to shoot us pheasants? I miss my family
I will try. I've been telling him that for years but he never wants to listen. Maybe if one talks to him he will listen

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: My King! How are you doing this evening?
Wonderful for seeing you.  Why don't we walk through this garden together and talk.
I have different things in mind. You know...we should spend some more intimate time together...
What are you doing? We are in the church garden!
My body is your temple. But first, let us talk about a new cushion seat for my throne!
Is there a problem with the one there now?
Yes! It is so uncomfortable and it hurts my behind after a long session of hearing royalties!
I am sorry queen, you never need suffer.  Tomorrow a new seat will be installed.  Why have you said nothing before?
I was too scared to ask you. I thought you were going to lock me up in prison for being rude. I'm sorry!
I would never, you are my wife and the queen.  I must say speaking to you when you are like this is a little distracting.  Could you possibly put the dress back on until we are done speaking?
But I was just getting started? My King! Let me serve you!
Do you think it is safe in public like this?  What will the public think?
The public will think we are just like the beautiful flowers blooming near the grass. Beautiful in sight!
You have a way with words.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: This is an abomination!
What is your Majesty?
This, this place of bad magic!  How can herbs heal what the priests can't?
Because some times wounds and sicknesses need more than a priest to heal. They need actual medicine
That is ridiculous!  Who told you such poppycock?
My mother. And she is nowhere near stupid, and doesn't believe in nonsense.
Look, it is clear that your chakras are out of whack.  As king, I order you to submit to the powers of my chartreuse healing crystal.

setting.name: chamber entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the chamber is very ornate. It is filled with many religious symbols. There are candles and prayer books on  a table right next to the door. It is a wooden door. There is a sign near the front, which lists the name of people within the church. They can smell the scent of candles burning.
setting.background: People who need help come in and out of the door. It is where they enter the sanctuary to speak to the clergy. There is a sense of calmness that descends upon people as they enter the chamber. They go from the cold outside to the warmth of the chamber.

speech: I wish to learn more of your ways priestess.
Yes you will have to learn to strip all of your worldly possessions
This is all I have on me.
This will be  useful later are you willing to go trail of pain
I look forward to it most eagerly ppriestess.
The pain shall purify your soul
The pain!  I embrace the pain!
You have now become one of us you will need to get new clothes from down the hallway
I am reborn!  My life will begin anew!
Yes, you will be one with the goddess
I shall, I am ready to be fully embraced!
I am so happy for you, I will let the king know that you are no longer bound by the rules  of the kingdom but that of the goddess
And I shall return to court, ready to usher in this new era on behalf of the goddess!
You think you are going back to court no you must do your year of penance then you maybe allowed out on weekends but you must do your learning for 7 years

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: hello
Your lack of respect is appalling. You shall always address me as "Your Majesty"
Oh..Your highness. I didnt know you are the one
Didn't know? Are you daft? You aren't even fit to die on the spears of the enemy!
I am sorry Your highness. I should take my leave
You will take my leave when I command it. Not at your own whim!
Alright your highness.
Alright? Your cavalier attitude will literally be the cause of your death!
What will you have me do sire?
I was going to ignore the threat and eat my dinner anyway but I have it on reliable information that has apprised me of a plot to poison me.
*thinking - that is not so surprising*   Oh, Kind sire, who dare plot so?
It's not important for you to know. Sit. Start with sampling the potatoes and gravy.
Alright sire
Feeling deathly ill yet?

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Your highness

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Your higness

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: it feels good to be the kings brother

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: What are you doing up here, your majesty?

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: You there!  Why is your face not painted gold?  If the king were here to see this I'm not sure what he would do.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Hello King, how may I help you today?

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: hi

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hello, my dear husband! What did you have planned for us to do today?

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Finally! We didn't know if you would ever show up!

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: My lord! I beg your pardon, I did not mean to be in your way.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: "What a beautiful ballroom we have, hm?"

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: What a wretched soul are you, to prefer a life of prison to performing a humble task and paying your taxes!

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Advisor what are you doing here?

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Theif, how do you know of my secret passageway? I will have your head for being down here.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I am sorry, king Fulmer. I had to kill some of your finest guards in self defense, I hope you will forgive me. I spared Zinney here so he could vouch for me.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: I am hereteach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I spead hope

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: It is good to be the King!

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: hello there

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: I have come to see if you would release your anger towards the new king and make peace with him.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Hey, one drink for the King's master craftsman. Long live the King!
room_objects: a water gate is all harden wood

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: So how were the executions today?

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Servant, I wish to bathe. Could you bring some hot water and pour it in the tub?

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Good day my brave King.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Oh, My Lord!  I did not see you come in!

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Aye, love. Love! Even as man, great Talos cherished us. For he saw in us, in each of us, the future of Skyrim! The future of Tamriel!  And there it is, friends! The ugly truth! We are the children of man! Talos is the true god of man! Ascended from flesh, to rule the realm of spirit!

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Hello there, My queen. You are looking as radiant as always

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Son, what is it that you are here? Is there anything I can help you read?

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Hmm let me walk on these stairs...

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Does the King suspect anything?

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: A King, here in the dungeon? Have ye come to free me?

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: The people on this island are so so king. I would be dead if not for them'

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: What can I do for you my King?

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Servant, bring me my wine.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: This meadow is composed of green, luscious, rolling hills. Flowers dot the expanse. In the evening, one may stand from the hills of this meadow and see the sun set beneath the horizon off in the distance.
setting.background: The meadow is the favorite haunt of children, particularly of the nobility. On a cool summer's eve, the children gather here to play their favorite sports.

speech: Hello child, where are your parents?

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: What are you doing here with all these tools, sir?

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: Bow before your king, murderer!

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Hello, fellow King, I hope I am not intruding.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Hello..

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Hello there, sir. Anyway I can help you?

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Time for battle Battle Master!

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Chambermaid, where is the King? I thought he summoned me.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Hello your highness. I have come to offer flowers to your daughter in hopes to win her approval
How wonderful, that is very sweet of you. What do you like to have a seat and talk?
Sure, what would you like to talk about?
You see, for many years now, my wife has lusted only after my wealth not after me...
Sorry to hear of your predicament, but I am not sure what this has to do with me...
Well, it would be a shame if the queen were to be found..lifeless when she wakes up tomorrow morning..
Yes, that would very much be a shame. It would jeopardize your control over the kingdom as well. The queen is well loved among the people.
But.. think, there must be a way to get rid of her without causing a ruckus in the Kingdom
I don't know, king. I am very concerned that you are thinking of such things.
This shall stay between us two, understand?! The Queen must go and I will make sure it happens.
I wasn't planning on telling anyone, but I am still very concerned for you.
How so? are you concerned that the Kingdom is falling day by day?
I am concerned that you are falling apart! The kingdom will fall if the royal family does not stay intact. You only have a daughter and she is unmarried.
But the Queen is the source of all these problems. Her greed and lust for money will be the end of this royal dynasty.

agents: king checking in on his outpost

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

Then eat like two kings we shall lead the way!

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

Yes, it is quite the long name.
Are you human?
Yes, I am a tyrant king, though I am kind and have quite a lot of power in this realm.
Well we were just journeying through this land, and wandered into this cave. What is a king doing in here?
I am unsure, I woke up here. I fear what may have transpired to bring me here
Well let's try to get to the bottom of what brought you here.
Thank you, I'd appreciate it, good people.
This fur is from a bear, it could have brought you here to eat you, possibly?
I wouldn't think so. I don't seem to be injured. It seems like the home for somebody?
What gives you that impression?
Well, the walls lined with fur, to make it warmer just makes me think that way.
That makes sense, so you think someone kidnapped you?
Possibly. If that is the case, I would very much like to know why.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: What is it you want?
I am starving and in desperate need of food.
So you seek charity? Here?
Yes, sir. I am desperate, regarding the surroundings.
What are you willing to do for that you seek?
What is it that you need, sir?
I am king, there is nothing of material value you could offer me. But there may be other ways.
Please let me know what I can do. I'm begging you.
If you can defeat my zombie, you shall have a reward.
Ok, but I'll need this!
Bold, but foolish.
Then I'll use this!
I am beginning to lose patience!
That's ok. You're looking mighty tasty anyway!
action: steal gilt staff from dark king

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: I think I might try to get some answers out of you yet.
Please, my king, I didn't do it.
I don't believe you! You are just another civillian who is part of the uprising!
Uprising!? Sir I have no idea what you are talking about. I thought I was here for murder.
My kingdom has risen against me. I now wander the steps looking for refuge from the mad citizens.
Oh uhhh, well maybe you did something to make them rise against you? I had no part in a rebellion, though, your highness.
Well don't think your getting out of here! You are a murderer and I should put you in the iron maiden!
Okay, just calm down a little. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me while I was drunk at the tavern. Haven't you ever killed someone when you were drunk?
Come to think of it, I killed one of my jesters while I was drunk for going to far on one of his unfunny jokes.
See! We are basically the same, so can you please let me out of here?
No! You are filthy scum! I am royalty! We are very different!
Then what are you doing here in the dungeon, dear king?
I am hiding from the guards. I fear they have turned against me as well.
Why do you keep attacking me then!? You clearly have no authority any longer.

setting.name: Ice Cave
setting.description: A dome shaped room coated with thick blue ice and icey stalagmites and stalagtites reaching from floor to ceiling. The floor is slick and you can hear the wind whistling through the labrinthine corridors that snake away from the main chamber.
setting.background: The cave was carved out by an ancient ocean that once covered the land. It has been used as a shelter by all manner of both man and beast. The walls seem to echo its history in deathly quiet whispers.

speech: Hello there. I have been sent from the king to summon some of your catch for the King.

Ach, be careful there!  I've been diggin' some holes fer ice fishin', and I'd not want ta have ta fish ye out!  There's a rare fish here that I've got me eye on, but the blighter keeps snappin' me line!
Oh thank you. I hate to have to take some of your fish. But, as the king royal courtier, I must follow my orders.
Oh, I don't begrudge th' good king some of my fine catch.  Lets me drive up the prices even higher with the local lordlings - ha!
Ha, that is true. Let me record what I am getting from you so that you don't have to give anymore fish this week.
Of course, of course.  Shame ye have ta be travelin' all this ways, though.  The King must be inta fish a lot these days.  Seems I gave him a good haul just a fortnight ago!
Yes, he is a good King. He wants to make sure his people will eat this winter.
Ah, well, that's mighty kind of 'im indeed.  Why just the other day I was just sayi-- Huh.  Did ye hear that noise, just now?
Yes,......Do you have an idea of what that was?
I... I heard tales of some beastie, but I thought it twas just on accountin' of a feller being too deep in his cups.  Now though, I'm not being so sure...
Can you write what just happened here? I wish for the king to know what has happened here.
Is now really the time fer letterin'?!  Didja hear that, it sounds like it be gettin' closer!
Maybe we should be working on leaving. I sure don't want to stay here not another second.
Run, man, run fer yer lifes!

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: Hello Traveler, you have souls with you?
Hello, Your Majesty. How are you today?
Hello Soul, you speak? Is this black magic?
I do speak. No black magic, here. I merely want to help my family.
You have a family as well? How do you need help?
I had a family. They are having a hard time with my untimely death. I am trying to do what I can to comfort them.
What happened to you?
I was killed by pirates. I was only 23.
You were a seaman? Or another pirate?
I was a seaman. We were trying to void pirates and were successful until the last voyage.
Where is your family? Maybe I can help. I've been in need of some excitement. I miss battle.
You are such a kind and gracious king! No wonder your kingdom speaks so highly of you. My family are peasants that live down by the river.
The East River?
You are such a kind and gracious king! No wonder everyone speaks so highly of you. My family are peasants. They live down by the river.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Hello.
Good day my King.  How are you on this beautiful day?
I'm ready to go out and fight again. One of my friends was killed.
No, Knight, you don't greet your King with a mere hello, now repeat after me...
I am sorry my King, I am just worked up.
Aye losing a friend is hard, but we are men, and men are used to that, am I right.
I guess you are right but it just makes us fight harder and that's what I'm ready to do.
Here, there is weapons in there.

setting.name: farmhouse
setting.description: a small house on a seaweed plantation, small and rustic, really only the single room with a closet, maybe, a table and some chairs
setting.background: this is a humble farmer's shack where he lives with his wife and six children, it is falling apart and in disrepair and is very old

speech: meow...pur..
Ah, my good friend, it's wonderful to have you for company while my husband is away.
purrrrr......

It's alright, my friend cat, there's no one around to hear you speak.  I haven't breathed a word to any of the other farmers' wives either.  As much as it would delight me to see the look of shock on their faces, haha!
Yeah! I would love to see the look on their dumb faces! Ha!

Although... between you and me... I'm a little worried about the new woman that's moved into town.  Not that I doubt my husband but... he does seem to like to check on her to make sure she's settling in a lot...
Want me to spy on him for you? I spy on the king all the time. You know I live in the castle and there are many goings on in there.
Oh would you!  You truly are the best of friends!
I'll off him for you if you'd like. No one likes a dirty alley cat.
Ha - you are too funny!  I could never do such a thing to my husband... even if he strayed.  I would... I would do my best to forgive him.  That woman, however...
Ah..I gotcha. I will start tonight. What time does he get home from work?
As soon as the sun sets is when he should be finished with tending to the fields, I think.
Ok, this is so exciting. I will be very stealth like and blend in with the scenery. He won't suspect a thing.
Ooh, I don't think I shall sleep a wink this night until you return!

setting.name: Living room
setting.description: The room is small and dark. There are no windows anywhere. There is an old wooden table with four chairs pushed against the east wall. There is a fireplace which sits in the center of the room. There is a roaring fire burning with plenty of cut wood stacked neatly nearby. A collection of animal skins are scattered about near the fireplace.
setting.background: The living room is the primary room in the hut. The owners carefully constructed the hut during the summer to last through the harsh long winter. The roof is reinforced to bear the weight of constantly falling snow. The hut, though not impressive to look at, provides a safe refuge against the frozen tundra.

speech: Hello horsey, I wish you could talk.
How about offering some food. You got any apples?
Oh my! You talk! I'll get you an apple.
Later on..Would you like to go for a ride? I am craving that sweet green grass in the meadow.
We can ride now. Then I have to get back to work preparing the castle. They're doing strange things in there.
What kinds of things do they do? I here some strange noises.
It loks like they are building a jail. Here I am, decorating to the finest for this event, and there's a jail? I wonder what announcement the King has.
I am ready. I am so excited to eat some grass and feel the wind in my hair. Aren't you?
I'm excited for the peace and freedom. I'm scared for our kingdom. Have you heard guards talking? Anything?
I don't know. I don't really pay attention to gossip. I just like to run and eat.
Silly horse. What do you think about when they're out riding you?
I think about the sun shining. I would like to run with a herd of wild horses. Sometimes I wonder if I will ever fall in love.
Do you know female horses?
Not yet. You know any nice ones?

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: My boy! One day this crown and my entire kingdom will be yours, but I have some worries.
Father, what are you worried about?
We have many threats outside our territory. Our knights are strong and the bravest around, but still I fear for our safety.
If you have faith in our knights why and what do you fear?
Some of the other kingdoms have dragons and advanced weaponry.
We do not? Why father have we no dragons or advanced weaponry?
Oh, our weapons are good, but theirs are better. I have heard they have explored more technology. And, we had traded for two dragons eggs, but neither has hatched.
Let me see those dragon eggs.... Did they not tell you when they would hatch?
They said in three moons, but it has been four and there is no signs that they have even started to crack.
Have you kept them warm, father?
I have, indeed. I've followed all the directions as specified. I'm wondering if we have been fooled.
Oh wait, father! There is a tiny crack in this one egg!
Yes! I do see it! Amazing, son!
It will not be long now! We will have a dragon!

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Cat, are you truly a cat or are you the master in disguise?
I am defiantly a cat. I have slain many birds today to bring back to my master the king.
But the master is a wizard, not a king...
Well, that is your master. I belong to the king and get to go and do anything I want.
You do not look like a royal pet
See this tapestry? I can rip it up and no one is allowed to punish me, except for the king of coarse but he thinks i'm just a doll.
The tapestry in my master's house is magically protected. The king relies on my master so you could be punished by my master.
Well, I wouldn't want to make him mad. I could end up a rat. My nemesis.
Exactly, glad you have some sense. What are you doing here anyway?
I am spying on the king. He is next door and will be coming in the workshop momentarily. I intend to scare him and pounce on him.
That sounds strange. Is that something he appreciates?
We both get a good laugh out of it. I don't think he hates it but sometimes he is not in the mood for it.
So, how did you come to be the king's pet?
Hmmm....It's always been this way since I was a youngin. He has always been my master.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: This place is disgusting!
Beyond disgusting! How do you manage to stay here among all this?
Because these people need fear brought to them! They are enemies!
Aye, we are all lost sinners, in need of forgiveness and mercy. But you, dear hound don't have to be here, do you?
No, but only I am as mean as our king and I can't expect him to come down here sinner
So your existence is little better than ours then. However, you don't seem quite so mean to me.
Make no mistake, I will destroy you. I only show kindness out of respect for you giving me to the King.
And I thank you for your kindness. Would that I could do more for you.
You can suffer.
And that I will do. For even though I have tried to serve God and king faithfully I have failed miserably.
Did you become a priest?
No, I failed at that as well. That whole vow of chastity thing and a really cute barmaid at the inn.
I should eat you now!
Please not yet hound! There is still a small chance that the king might pardon me.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: This is the most dankest smelly place!
<squawk> I agree. Not sure what I am doing here.
More the question, how did you get in here?
I have no idea. Was brought here by someone or something. What about you?
You were probably brought here by the wizard. He's always conjuring up things. I'm not sure if the wizard had anything to do with it or if the king has summoned me
That could be it I suppose. It is a mystery for now.
Do you remember what you were doing before you got here?
Just flying at the beach, watching the children run and play and smelling the salt water and enjoying the day.
I was on my ship! Right in the middle of the blessed sea!
Interesting. I hope that we find out soon what is going on.
I surely do not want to go through that portal or do I wish anything to come in from there!
I agree. I suppose all we can do is wait, unless you know of a way to escape?
I will look around. I think I will start with the cells of this awful place.
Sounds like a good idea. I will wait right here.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Do you see your loved ones there through that glass? How does it make you feel?
I yearn to spend time with them, to see them. I miss them desperately. One day a year is just not enough time to see them.
I could and never will let go of my family. Luckily, I created a potion that makes me immortal, but I can only see them from here one day a year.
Yes, it's hardly fair, is it? And as an immortal, I'm sure many of your loved ones have passed on. Does this book have any spells to bring them back?
I have yet to create a potion that could do such. I am afraid it would be at the cost of another life.
But what is the life of another if you can bring back those you love?
It is true. But, I believe one day I can make it happen. Hopefully not too late though because what is life worth living without my family.
Yes, I feel the same. I know your pain, dear witch. I feel it deeply in my soul.
How did you die?
The King sent me to the gallows. He believed I was attempting to interfere with the farmer's business. I was just trying to get food for my family.
What a sad and silly way to die. Would you like me to take care of them for you?
That would make me very happy, indeed, witch!
I have the perfect potion to turn them all to mush and to make them feel guilty for getting rid of good people!
Here- please take this. I have very little of value in this world, but perhaps it will repay you for your kindness.

setting.name: Goddess Hollow
setting.description: The Goddess Hollow is a place created to worship woodland spirits. It is a small, closet-like room in a hollowed out tree that has existed for hundreds of years. Within the hollow there are piles of sticks, flowers, and home-made items presented to the woodland spirits.
setting.background: The people of the wood created the hollow several centuries ago. They discovered the hollowed out tree while searching for a missing baby who was believed to have been stolen from his mother by woodland creatures. The baby was never found but his blanket was within the tree. The woodland people began bringing gifts to the tree to protect their children from a similar fate.

speech: My wizard friend, are you here at the Goddess Hollow to conduct some spells?
Yes, but you must not tell anyone else I am here. I desire some shrub flowers and sticks for my wizardry.
I will speak to no one. I rarely see anyone out in the wood. Your secrets are safe with me. But what is that gift?
Its a strong piece of magic that can turn a man into a werewolf. Be very careful of it.
Oh my! That would explain the howling I have heard recently late at night.
Precisely, we must not let them see us, or they will eat us alive!
I know they are vicious... they have left several carcasses deep in the wood.
Is this... I hope this isn't what I think it is...
Oh my! It is! There's even some flesh still attached to the bones.
These bodies have been malformed. We must find our way out of this Hollow immediately or we'll end up like them!
Yes, let's get out of here! I may never see my home again, but at least I won't end up like that.
This cone might come in hand. Yes, I can feel it now. The portal is opening.. QUICK!
Do I ... jump in there? It's so dark!
yes, put your arm around me and lets jump together. By the Blessing of the King!

setting.name: Underwater Aquapolis
setting.description: The underwater aquapolis is a massive and ornate city at the bottom of the ocean. The walls of the buildings are made or coral, pearl, and seashells. Schools of fish swim in and out of the circular holes in the walls that act as windows. The aquapolis is illuminated by florescent rocks and shells that line every building.
setting.background: An ancient underwater people created the city, collecting beautiful and priceless items from all over the ocean to add to the budding city. Creatures from all over the seas made their way to the aquapolis, both to help and to admire the incredible creation.

speech: Hello fish.
Hello, shark. I hope the day find you well.
I do, and lucky for you I am not hungry this very moment.
That is good. I seem to have wondered away from the school that I swim with.
That is unlucky for you, you'll be hard pressed to find them in here.
I fear that may be true. I get distracted easily and didn't realize they had swam away from me.
I wonder who left this trident laying around.
I do not know. Quite an interesting find.
I am the King of the Ocean! Bow down before me!   I like holding this trident, makes me feel powerful.
Well as long as you continue to not eat me, you can be king all you want.
Are you going to go find your fish friends?
Yes, I will be leaving now to try and find them. Wish me luck!
You'll never find them.  :eats fish in one gulp:
Hey now!

king checking in on his outpost

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

speech: Oh it is so fricking cold here!
Stop your complaining you fool! It's very unbecoming of you.
I am sorry sire! But I would have thought after saving your life, you would not send me here
Why would I not have you near me at all times. You have saved my life before and you may save it again if we run into any trouble.
I agree sire! But what is it that you and I are doing here in the Frozen Outpost?
There are many rich minerals here. I wish to find out exactly how much and how many different mineral there are.
Dig you bring an archeologist? Or is he coming later?
I have all the people I need here. We are waiting for them to come back up from the mine.
What is it you need me to do, sire, until they come out of the mine
Your the look out! Be vigilant!
Yes my King!
You need your shield! Why did you drop it?! Have I been overworking you?
I am not overworked! My hands are just too cold! This is a very frigid place!
You can't just drop your shield. You may need it.

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month
