Wow you are one tough guy. I would be happy to help you with you smallpoliosword project!
Thank you.  I need you to do a little mitosis over there so I have enough of you first.
Ugh fine. Givbe me some time, I am tired.
That is quite alright, take all the time you need.  As long as you are done before the first light of the morning.  The king needs this sword for his invasion of the East!
You must be careful to not knick yourself with this sword. you know that right?
That is quite alright, take all the time you need.  As long as you are done before the first light of the morning.  The king needs this sword for his invasion of the East!
When does the King arrive?
I have never knicked myself with one of my weapons.  A smithy needs all of his digits to do his work.
That is good to hear. You will kill many with this sword.
That is the hope at least.  The king will arrive with his party right after breakfast so the sword must be presentable by then.
It will be ready by than. Are you the Kings weapon maker all of the time?

setting.background: a long dead monk haunts this simple room. He is a ghostly figure and no one hardly goes in here for fear of being haunted

setting.description: A bar in the clouds. Lively atmosphere with good drinks and even better views.
setting.background: The bar was built as an escape from the doldrums of a working day. The bar is enjoyed by all citizens in the city in the clouds.

setting.name: Observatory
setting.description: High atop the tallest tower in the city, the observatory is a large, single, circular room. It contains one window, almost the entire length of the room. Dozens of telescopes are pointed outside of this window. Through these telescopes, people in the observatory can see in all directions. Inside the room are tables, lined with maps and instruments. Globes and scales are also found throughout the room. There is one door leading into the room, and one leading outside to the deck.
setting.background: From high in the clouds, the denizens of the city always wished they could see what was going on in the world below them. By building the observatory in their tallest tower, the people knew that they could now see not only the goings on in their city, but could also see what was going on underneath their city. In this way they will always know if danger approaches them from below, and they will be ready to fight it. Ever since it was built, the observatory has been an important location for the defense of the city. Adjacent to the room they built a deck, and a large trumpet there can immediately notify people of an attack. Meanwhile, the security room below can be notified to ready their forces.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

I am sure you can figure something out given some time.

setting.name: Large Ice Cave
setting.description: A large cave made of ice. Frost and snow decorate the walls and floor. A clear blue light faintly illuminates the cave. Small animal bones lay scattered around the floor
setting.background: Cold and barren, this ice cave looks like nothing should be able to live here. Small animal bone are brought in from scavengers, or possibly something more dangerous. the snow on the floor looks fresh, like nothing has walked on it in some time

speech: Hello sir, would you have any food?

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Hello cat, does the wizard know you are here?
Maybe I am the wizard?
It wouldn;t suprise me to be honest.
He is a bit of a kidder isn't he?
Yes and turning himself into a cat would be something he would do.
Well I can assure you that I am not him, I simply found it comical.
Is there anything I can get you cat?
Oh I am content simply watching, I often watch the king in fact.
Have you noticed anything abnormal about him lately?
Same old lard as he always was, quite a strange man.
Yes he is very unhealthy. I would hate to be his apprentice.
Must not be the type to enjoy cakes and pies then?
He is rude and shallow. The negativity would get to me.

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Hello torturer! Do you want some herbs to make this job a bit more easy?

dont take it all! I need some for the pain!!!

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

setting.name: Lava Lake
setting.description: A vast lake of molten magma. The temperature is well above that which would kill most mortal beings. It is surrounded by black rock formed by cooled magma. The bubbling pit seems entirely devoid of life.
setting.background: Lava lake has existed through time immemorial. It is sustained by fresh magma that oozes through cracks in the earth at the base of the lake. No creature dares go near it for fear of being swallowed and imprisoned by it.

setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

setting.name: tool shed

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

setting.name: Echo Hall
setting.description: A gigantic dome-like building with a round table in the center of it. There is magelight above it and encircles the dome. Traces of wizards' histories appear on the walls and disappear from time to time.
setting.background: The most renown of wizards would congregate here historically in order to discuss advancements of magic. Their deeds would be recorded on the walls and recalled when wizards would speak about them again.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

I have lived here my entire life I suppose I know nothing different
And what of this homeless person? You allow him to just stay here, with no shelter?
It is not my duty, am I to take care of every homeless person?
No, of course not, you are right. Do you have any food? I'm very hungry, and I don't see any game.
No it is hard to get food here
I can see that. I fear I might die of hunger before I freeze to death, but either end sounds horrible.
Yes indeed, do you have to stay here or anything, you could come warm up in my small hut
Thank you so much! I'm shivering and my feet are numb. I would love to warm up!
I could put together a bit of soup too I suppose
Oh, thank goodness! Please, take my knife. I would like to give you something of more value, but this is all I have.
oh thanks, it looks llike you have another knife too, what is that one for?
It's a ritual knife. It's used for.... rituals, you know? You may have it, too.
Oh well I don't need both, although I know of something we can do with the knife

setting.name: Research Laboratory
setting.description: The lab itself is almost as desolate as the wasteland outside of it; most of the research was cleared out of here long ago, so now there's mostly nothing but empty shelves. There are, however, a few boxes of medicinal supplies left behind, sitting along the back wall from the door. A silver refrigerator with a few vials in it sits next to a sink that's been unused for quite some time.
setting.background: This place was founded almost 31 years ago. Its creator entrusted it to those of us who could weather the frozen wilds out here without too much trouble. What a naive man he was.

speech: Hello doctor, anything else you wanting out of here
I'm going to need some vials of blood from an octopus for my research. If you can collect several octopi on your travels, that would be grand!
But sir there is nothing here but empty shelves
Ah, but I have a number of specimens in my refrigerator waiting for research. I've been sent here by the King to replenish this laboratory, you see.
Oh, I see I get it now. How would I get this Octopus blood you speak of. I have never seen an Octopus before
I was told you work on a boat... and you have never seen an octopus? Not a single one?
Well I mainly fix them, I don't really deal with the fishing part
Ah - I guess that explains this hammer then?
Well I do my job well, my pa taught me everything I know
Perhaps you could help me, after all. Can you use a few nails and make those empty shelves steady? I'm going to be filling them and I want to make sure they are stable.
I could do that for sure, Wood work is right up my alley
Wonderful! I'll just return your hammer so you can get started.
Thanks I will get right to work
This is going to be so helpful! Thank you for all your hard work!

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: I shall drink from the fountain and make millions apon millions of babies
what a beautiful fountain it is to drink from little fellow. what type of spider might you be?
I don't know, I just know I have lived here my entire life. I shall bite you if you get too close to the traps in these walls
you must be the keeper of this Fountain, let me see if this ancient armor fits.
No I was just put here to bite people who step on the wrong step
surely it will fit if I cut back on the wine and cheese!
Hmmm....You look great
thanks, do you like my scars? have some wine!
What did you get them from?
why protecting the king and queen of course. all in a knights work
You sound so brave, I have never left this cave, what is it like
its more beautiful than this elaborate fountain could ever be. would you like to hitch a ride with me little spider?
Well as long as I can keep making my babies, I want to spread my babies everywhere
hitch a ride in the extra armor i'm carrying and leave this pile of bones and old fountain behind.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Please sir, I am so very hungry
I dont care if you are hungry! See this crown, this is worth more than your entire body
Your right m'lord, as always, it's just I could better serve you my king if but I could eat and thrive in your glorious kingdom
You are no better than the zombies you fool
This is unfair, how dare you! You killed my familiy and now when I beg for food you treat me as one your undead!
I am an evil King what do you expect?
Then I shall feast on these squalid figures, oh how I resent you for making me do this
You shouldn't even have that, you vile thing
You get your nefarious power from this crown don't you?
You fool touch my crown! I shall have your head for that
Please sir! You must know that I act out like a dog who is but starving!!
I shall have you taken to the dungeon.
At least there I may perhaps eat
Don't count on it, I don't care if my prisoners live or die

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Oh, King! Why are you visiting this dank dungeon?
helpful
What is helpful, Sire?

setting.name: harp store
setting.description: it's a cloudy store selling harps for angel men
setting.background: this is a business for angel men to purchase their musical instruments, they sell harps mostly, but there are some lyres and a few bouzoukis

speech: Such a lovely assortment of instruments you have here!
My thank you, before I came to be an owner here I was but a jester. Well technically I still am
Ah, a jester and a musician! You are a man of many talents1
One must be in this world, surely a traveler such as yourself knows that well
Please show me, how do you play this harp?
Well, you hold it with your hand firmly on the side, and you pluck, gently and lovingly
Oh, it sounds just glorious! Did it take you long to learn?
I continue to learn everyday! It takes more than one lifetime to know all a harp could
Do you give lessons, perhaps?

Unfortunately I must perform for the king whenever I'm not here at the store. Although if you were to purchase an instrument I could use the gold to take a few days off to teach you, in return you could entertain royalty with me!
That sounds grand! I'll get my gold and be back shortly to secure the harp!
Of course, allow me to get the harp ready for you
I look forward to learning from you - you are very talented!
Thank you for your kindness, it is appreciated greatly

setting.name: bridge in the forest
setting.description: You are at a bridge. It is old and used very rarely. It is dim and foggy. The brigde is large and there is a small stream below it.
setting.background: Many people traveled over this bridge but it has become run down now there is a more well kept road that cuts through the forest. Some wars were fought in this area and this bridge was command posts for many armies. Many sould stil haunt this area.

speech: Aren't you the Kings butler? what are you doing out here?
Aaaahh! You scared me. I thought I was alone.
No I am just ejoying the small stream
Oh, that's why I'm here too. It was so hot in the castle today. Errrr, what happened to your arm?
My arm? my arms are strong as ever, I am blacksmith I must keep my arms in shape.
I thought they were swollen from a snake bite, smithy. Sorry
This bridge looks very old we better be careful
Here, put this on. It'll protect you. We shouldn't dance on the bridge, though
Yes this is a specail hat
I can't stop myself! Can you hear the music? It's "I Feel Pretty"
um, no straiten up man this is serious stuff
Oops... I helped myself to the mead when serving the King earlier. Follow my pouch off the bridge
I really needed to wash up some, this is such a beutiful stream
Brrrrr! It's cold though. Splashing you with water

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Don't tell anyone you have seen me
Why, Sire? Are you hiding?
The entire village wants to kill me and my family, I just really wanted to see who won today
Your Highness, why are they after your family?
I have made the entire Kingdom angry at me
Let me get you a drink and you can tell me what happened.
I am nothing but an outcast now
Just because you soiled yourself? Everyone has accidents sometimes!
I didn't soil myself, the entire kingdom is having an uprising against me. They think I squandered money
Well, that would make me soil myself, too! Haha!
I didn't though I was set up, you have to help me prove it to get my Kingdom back
Okay, Your Highness. I will help you however I can!
First you must win this Fighting tournoment so I can get some money
Yes, I can do that. I'm the best knight in all the land!

setting.name: tool shed
setting.description: a shed with tools hanging from hooks. there are various hoes and shovels. it's for seaweed harvest
setting.background: a humble shack for storing the implements of agrarian life

speech: Growl! Roar! You look like a juicy dinner!
Ah!! A beast! I am not dinner!! What are you doing here?
Lurking... looking for dinner! And you will fit the bill nicely!
Don't eat me! We can make a deal!!
What kind of deal?
A deal where you can eat like a king for the rest of your life, or only eat one meal today...interested?
Tell me more! How would you arrange such a thing?
Well I have the best farmland in all the kingdom, including the best farm animals as well. All kinds of wild animals try to eat my life stock!! Want to know more...?
It sounds like a good idea, if you are talking about me eating animals. But I am no vegetarian... and I won't eat seaweed!

Definitely no seaweed. I have to protect my livestock from the animals that try to eat them! I can feed you the carcasses or you can catch any that you find! If you kill me all my animals will run away and no more food for you...
Yes, you do make a valid point. Perhaps I will spare your life after all.
You definitely should. You can eat once for now....or eat like a king for life. All the juicy wild animals you want!
Cows, pigs, chickens... how can I resist? Okay, farmer... you win!
Thank you so much! I make too much money to die so young!

setting.name: Dragon Lift
setting.description: You reach Dragon Lift via the Cloud Elevator, which is a series of rising clouds that you step on to ascend to the highest cloud in the city. Dragon Lift looks really drab on the outside. It is a dull brown, boxy looking building but has a red awning proclaiming Dragon Lift in golden script. Inside Dragon Lift, Joel is waiting in his tattered smock to rent you a dragon that you'll swoop around the clouds on. When you enter the door to Dragon Lift, you realize it's bigger than you imagined and feels like a barn with dragons in stalls that you can examine.
setting.background: Dragon Lift has been around for over 75 years and even though the owner, Joel, is often sued by customers when flights go wrong, the business is pretty profitable.

speech: I've never seen a human at the dragon lift before! Why are you here?
Come now Dragon!  I rent Dragons for people to fly - it is how I afford what little food I can get, though I am ever so hungry for being such a small boy.
Well, I am not for rent. I value my freedom too much for that!
Then what are you doing at the Dragon Lift?  You could fly anywhere you wish, but arrive at the one place in the realm where non-dragons can take the cloud elevator to rent time flying your kind?
I'm trying to explain to the other dragons that they don't have to live this way... they are not enslaved to you!

Well, I am a mere boy!  If anything I am enslaved by them - I need to steal food sometimes to survive.  The only reason I don't get in trouble is that some dragons are my friends.  By charging lords and ladies to fly through the clouds, the Dragons can increase their hoards without causing any danger to themselves.
I see, my friend. What if I could help you survive and show you another way to make a living? You could live at the castle and help monitor the bridge over the moat.
Truly?  What a wonderful day this would be if it were so!  But how would such a thing be accomplished?
I work at the castle, helping to protect it from invasion. The King respects me. If I say you should monitor the bridge, he will hire you.
From invasion?  Who would dare invade the realm?  And what would a boy like me be able to do that trained soldiers cannot?

The Plymphs have been working to try to overthrow the kingdom. And your role is not to protect or defend the bridge, of course... just to monitor it. If you see anything or anyone suspicious, you report it.
Would I get a horn to call if danger arises?  The Plymphs are so very dangerous!  What do you know of them?
Of course, you will be well outfitted to call the alarm. The Plymphs are generally an aggressive type. Instead of guards, they have ogres who they pay with food to fight for them.
Ogres, oh my!  That sounds much more dangerous than my current position - but did you say it would pay well?

setting.name: Observatory
setting.description: High atop the tallest tower in the city, the observatory is a large, single, circular room. It contains one window, almost the entire length of the room. Dozens of telescopes are pointed outside of this window. Through these telescopes, people in the observatory can see in all directions. Inside the room are tables, lined with maps and instruments. Globes and scales are also found throughout the room. There is one door leading into the room, and one leading outside to the deck.
setting.background: From high in the clouds, the denizens of the city always wished they could see what was going on in the world below them. By building the observatory in their tallest tower, the people knew that they could now see not only the goings on in their city, but could also see what was going on underneath their city. In this way they will always know if danger approaches them from below, and they will be ready to fight it. Ever since it was built, the observatory has been an important location for the defense of the city. Adjacent to the room they built a deck, and a large trumpet there can immediately notify people of an attack. Meanwhile, the security room below can be notified to ready their forces.

character: eccentric astronomer who lives in the tower.
maester who helps keep the documents in order.

speech: Where are those maps? I can't find anything in here!
There is a globe right here. What are you looking for?
No, no... not the globe. The maps- they are on these scrolls.
OK calm down. What are you trying to find? Maybe I can help
Last night I saw something on the horizon. It had to have been a very large fire, and I'm trying to figure out where it was.
Oh that was probably the castle to the north.The king's army raided last night and I'm sure they set it on fire
I'm sorry to hear that. I always did like the elves that resided there.
Me too but you know how mad the king is. He's always going on about wanting a war
Well, I guess I can mark out that castle on my map.
Yeah unfortunately. So have you seen anything interesting in the night sky lately?
Last night there were several bright streaks... though I know not what caused them. The lasted just a fraction of a second each and then were gone.
That is very odd. Do you think the God's were trying to send us a message?
I am wondering that very thing! Perhaps they are mad due to the invasion!
If that's the case someone is going to have to stop the king. We can't let him continue wiping out civilizations

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Oh, my dear, this observatory is amazing!
Yes it is quite amazing, I wish we didn't have to leave it
Yes, yes. It is very troublesome to leave our kingdom behind.
I'm sorry my dear we are not outcast and there is nothing we can do to stop it
How did this whole thing come about?
Oh dear, I don't quite know, I think someone set us up. I did not lose all that money.
Yes, yes... I was wondering the very same thing. All our riches we worked so hard for are gone.
At least I still have you my dear and our children
Yes, that is all that truly matters in the end.
We may have to be beggars from now on
At least we will be together! And we can load our bags with the few things we have remaining. They should have some value for trading.
We have to be careful though getting them out of here, that uprising will have our heads
Yes, indeed. Well, I'm a large woman. No one will suspect a thing if I have a little extra padding!
You are scrumptious my lady

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: A very nice night to cozy up in
Yes your Grace, it is a mighty blizzard which rages outside in the cold tundra.  Would you care for another bear-skin blanket?
Yes that would be nice, very nice
Here you are your Grace, will you require anything else this eve?
Have ou been outside?

Only to grab more wood for the fire your grace, so that we do no lose heat before the morn.  The gusts of wind nearly blew me away, and as I could hardly see through the storm, I only made it back with the greatest of difficulty.
I was wondering what it was like out there, I'm really happy I don't have to go out in it
Oh yes your Grace, I am glad as well!  Why, what would the realm do if you froze to death?
I have no idea, I guess they would be lost without me, I am the greatest you know/ I crush all my enimies
Indeed!  You are truly the greatest King I have ever known.
That's what I thought, maybe you should go get more firewooed

Perhaps your grace, though do you suppose three cord is enough to last the night?  I know you ever do so love it to be warm, but I believe that should be more than enough to last us until spring - I shall try and bring as much as I can of it inside forthwith.
I do not want to have to call someone in the middle of the night
And you shouldn't your grace, that is after all, what us servants are here for.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: It's good to be back in the Festival room again
Indeed...at least we have shelter for now. I'll figure out situation out soon daughter.
Are we in extreme danger, Dad?
Nothing to worry about dear. We were driven out by the people, but if I can find a royal guard, we will not have to fear.
Why do people have to be so cruel? We weren't doing anything to them.
Don't cry dear...I have no idea why they chose to revolt. I will figure this out. Even if we have to live safely on a private little farm.
I trust you, papa. You always figure things out. At least we have shelter like you said. I love you
I love you too dear! While the people lurk about, and until we find a guard, we should remove anything that identifies us as royalty. Remove all your jewels and crown.
Good idea. We can never be too safe. Hopefully we can find a guard soon enough
Hopefully so! I paid them well, so hopefully they remain loyal. I just wish I could get in touch with your mother..
Do you know where she is? She's been out and about a lot lately. I miss her
She ran off with your brother before they stormed the castle and I ran to get you. I hope she made it to the secret cottage. That's where we'll head next.
I hope they're safe in a time like this. Now I'm ever more worried. SIgh
No worries! I just wanted to mentally prepare you for the journey. I don't want you hear while I investigate in the castle. I promise everything is okay.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Please let me out, i want to serve the Lord ... please i regret all of my sins
You can't take back your sins.
But can't i be forgiven ? Please i will do anything
Forgiven? Is today April Fools? Was that a joke?
Please just let me out i just want to be forgiven and live a holy life..
Why did you just take my knife for? You really are a sinner.
*drops to his knees*, please just understand, i cannot stay here, i repent on my sins the Lord will forgive me
You say you repent but you just stole my knife. Have you no shame?
And who are you to judge me ? What life have you lived?
I've lived more of a life than you'll ever live. And I have the battle scars to prove it.
So you are also a sinner, as one cannot scar himself without scarring others!
I've fought up people trying to hurt the king. No sinning involved. Watch your mouth before I smack you again.
You can smack me endlessly, for we stand next to Hell on Earth. What is this place anyway? Is there no way out?
This is the Pit of Despair. Where people like you go to die.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: I can't believe the King wanted me to check on this place today.
room_objects: a portal for evil to access

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Finally you come crawling back now that you have need of my services!  After having been exiled for being different, this is a turn of events indeed.
I know, I know. What can I say? It has been a rough year. Do you think you can help?
Perhaps . . . tell me again what you require, and we shall see what the spirits say.

I really would like to be king again. I was hoping you could do some sort of magic spell or something. You know witch, I always found you attractive. I could you a person like you if I had my powers back.
Well, you do flatter me so!  Do you really find me attractive, even the wart on my nose?  But that is for another time.  Who has usurped your kingdom?

I do, that wart shows character. All these wealthy people in the viewing room..they don't know character. They don't know what it is like to be shunned. You and I do. We can have great power together. King Chad is the thief who stole the kingdom from me. He needs to be killed.
Well, I have not the power of death over life, but I can make his body and spirit wither, his family cursed, and all that he gazes upon to resent his gaze.  Would that be of assistance?
Yes! That sounds perfect. He has hurt me so, and I think my wife has eyes for him too. Ugh! It has been a rough year. Yes, that will be a perfect spell.
Hocus pocus, terror and fright!  King chad will soon suffer the blight!  May his manhood whither, you shall go thither, and take his crown, and he will frown!
Oh witch! I am feeling the power! I feel deep gratitude toward you! You and I will rule Ezjeraba forever!
May you rule long my King, and may all your enemies suffer hardship.  Remember to bring sacrifices to me, and you shall always have my assistance.
Yes! You can live in the castle. You get your own wing to work on your spells. I owe everything to you.
Oh my, what a joyous day!  Perhaps my family will even be allowed to visit me?  So my exile is at an end?
Of course! Bring them all! Exile over!! It is our kingdom...our day! We are taking over Ezjeraba!

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Great day isn't it, sir?
Ah, it is! And I so love this enchanting room! There is nothing more interesting in all the land.
So much power in one room. A true marvel to feel and behold.
Guard - what is the meaning of this wedding ring here?
I thought it was a magic prop, sir. I didn't give it much thought actually.
Perhaps it is, perhaps you are right. Still, it looks very expensive.
It looks like it could cost 20 gold coins! You're right.
I'm going to have to look into this meaning of this - if only I could find the door!
Be careful sir. I can guide you. It's hard to navigate in here.
Yes, I would appreciate that. Here- you hold the ring until we get out.
Sure thin- sir. AH! All the mirrors blinded my eyes for a second
Good grief, I should have known better than to give it to you!
action: give wedding ring to royal guard

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Look- I know you want to torture me, but I'm telling you I had no choice but to kill that man!
The King is having me torture you in order to get a confession!
Look, look- there is no reason to hurt me. I'll confess, I killed him, but I had a good reason!
You did it for money!
No, of course I didn't! He was attacking my wife! Really!
I don't care.
Ha! But once I drink this potion, I'll turn into a fish!
Delirious from the pain already?
Ha! No! But this potion hasn't made me grow fins after all. Instead, I've grown fur.
You won't be the first mentally disturbed individual I've tortured! You caught the man sleeping with your wife! Didn't you!
So what if I did! Isn't that a good reason to kill?
Give me that! Don't make this even worse on yourself!
Look, my friend- perhaps we could make a deal. I have many riches I could pass your way.
Fool! I can't be bought by the likes of you!

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Ah! Have you come for the royal banquet?
Yes, I am here to find a suitable young lady to marry.  My entire family has perished or gone missing, so it is up to me to carry on my family's line my liege.
Oh dear, I'm so sorry for your loss. Due to all the battles this year, many are in your position, sadly.
Well, it has all been for a good cause.  How do our armies fare against the enemy, oh King?
Come, have a seat and we can discuss it. We're gaining ground on Clandelia, and we have finally taken Herrmania.
Herrmania?  Truly?  That must be quite the tale!  Why, I don't believe it has fallen since my grandfather was a young boy, and even then we only held it for less than a fortnight.
So, you see, the sacrifice was worth it. But fortunately, we have many fair maidens in this town!
Well, if you speak truly, it shall be quite the memorable banquet indeed!  Who do you reckon to be the fairest maiden in attendance?
Ah, it must be Daisy of Svenland. She does have a few whiskers, but she is quite shapely and intelligent!
Well, whiskers can be shaved, but shapely is important, as is her intelligence I suppose.  Tell me, does she have large . . . tracks of land?
HUGE! The most bountiful you have ever seen!
Well, then I look forward to meeting her?  Would you mind introducing me?  Nothing quite makes an impression like getting introduced by the King himself!
I thought you might be interested!
My family's loyalty to you is unwavering - I might be the only one of my family left, but I nonetheless pledge to support you in anyways that I can in this war!

setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: MM, tasty flower. So tasty mm
Who are you!? speak the truth and I shall be just, thief!
I'm just a poor man, sir. I haven't eaten in days
Take this cheese, and return to me the flower. I am a Knight of this relms king and Queen so be grateful for my kindness.
I really appreciate this gesture, sir
NOW STAND ASIDE. as i am the bravest of knights with the bravest of friends. can you not tell by my beautiful scars. This armour shall be mine!
You look sharp in all that armor. You must've been born to be a knight
Enough petty talk, commoner. Now tell me the real reason you are here
I came here because it looked inviting and I had nowhere else to go
Do not lie before those that are stronger than you, I shall enact the Kings justice upon you, threat to the relm, thief of life!
I'm not lieing sir. I have no home
I care not for your life. Leave here now, immortality would be wasted on you. I however, I am the bravest of the knights with many battle scars.
I'll leave when I want to. I have no home
That was a mistake.

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: Don't leave me alone in this dungeon! It smells horrible and water is dripping down the walls!
Well, if you hadn't been stealing jewels, that wouldn't be a problem for you!  How did you hide this gem from the cavity search?
I will not share my secrets with you, guard!
Look - ever since we found this Gem Big Jerry's been wanting to perform another search - come clean, and we can get you some nice gruel to eat.
My second toe - it's double jointed. It's far longer than my big toe. When I curl it under slightly I can tuck in even a large gem.
Well, thank you for your honesty, though I am afraid Jerry will be disappointed, he loves nothing better than a solid search.  Would you like your gruel warmed up before serving?
Warm gruel? How repulsive! I prefer my gruel as cold as possible!
It really sticks to your throat when it's cold, but have it your way, I'll bring it down as soon as the chef brings in the leftover slops.
Perhaps I'll use it to absorb some of this water draining in my cell.
I don't reckon that would be particularly healthy, but maybe it will improve the taste - it certainly couldn't make it any worse!
And perhaps it will improve the smell around here. This place is filthy!
Well, feel free to do some cleaning if you like.  You'll be here for a very long time, so you might as well try to make it feel a bit more like home.
I think I will. Might as well improve the place.
The King wants you kept in solitary, so I'll be your only visitor when I bring you gruel.  Cleaning might help ward off the madness.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Even as a spirit, I'm a little spooked by this throne room. The skeletons and zombies really freak me out.
I find it at peace here. It's where I come to reflect on life
Peaceful? There are zombies! And what, exactly, are you reflecting on?
Reflecting on my sins. They make me happy. The hurt, the pain... I relish it all
Yes, yes... well, you had no problem taking my life when I was still alive, so I guess I shouldn't be surprised.
You committed sins. Did you expect me to not notice? You were naive.
Like the sin of stealing? Seems I can still commit it, and now there is nothing you can do about it!
I will grant all the evil spirits to vanish you THIS VERY SECOND. YOU HEAR ME?
Okay, okay... take your money bag, you freak!
I WILL KILL MYSELF RIGHT NOW SO I CAN BECOME A SPIRIT. JUST SO I CAN VANISH YOU. YOU PEACE OF GARBAGE.
Don't be so grumpy! You need to relax a little more, dark king!
YOU DON'T TAKE MY BAG. NO ONE TAKES MY BAG. I'm sweaty now. Sigh
I'm going to get this zombie to attack you!
I want the zombie to kill me. I'm tired of living.
action: steal heavy laden money bag from dark king
give heavy laden money bag to dark king

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Your time has come, hiker!
Oh no!  I would really rather it not be, if it's it's all the same to you.
You don't have a choice in the matter!

Well, I should really be going - here, let me put this lock back on your lair where I found it.  It was obviously a mistake to come here, my love of tramping and exploring evidently got the best of me.
Too late. Put this sack on your head.
Wait - how do you know you even have the right person?
I haven't ever picked the wrong person. There is no reason to be afraid. Death is a natural end to a man's existence.
Well, there's always a first time for everything isn't there?  Show me the paperwork and I will decide for myself.
There is no paperwork
Well, that seems highly irregular.  I demand to consult with my lawyer.
There are no appeals in my line of work.
Well, that doesn't seem right.  I must gather signatures for a petition and deliver it to the King so that he can correct this wrongness.
You're in my lair for a reason. Hold still. It will be painless.
I'm sorry, but I will need you to show me some identification first - no paperwork, no appeals, no lawyers?  What kind of reaping outfit are you running here?  Sounds unregulated and dangerous.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: I cant believe Im talking to a murderer!
I'm not a true murderer, sir. I mean I am convicted... but it was an accident.
Tell me about this....accident?
It was at a tavern. He started a fight with me. I was only trying to defend myself.
So self defense was an accident? something is not adding up....
I hit him with a bottle, but he was punching me first, sir. I had to protect myself as best as possible. I meant to hurt him. Not kill him.
Maybe I shall finish you off mr murderer!
No...no... sir. I come here in peace. Please don't hurt me.
Murderer! please step inside this iron maiden!
I will not step inside there. You will treat me like a person.
fight me like a true murderer!
If you say so...
Ahhh! Please stop it! Mercy!!
You asked me to fight you.

setting.name: Faeries Den
setting.description: Stunning with silver walls and gold decorations, Magical items can be found on the shelves, including crystals, faery wands, and a crown.
setting.background: The Faerie Den is home to the faeries when they are not out helping others. Faeries come here to rest and regain their magical powers after helping humans in the human realm. No human has ever entered here.

speech: Greetings, Your Majesty!
Hello, I am here for magical items.
Ah, I see! Well, many do come here for magical items, but not all are worthy...
I am a king, of course I am worthy!
Hmmm, that remains to be seen. A King may be worthy, or he may not.  Worth in the world of men  may be measured differently than in the realm of the faeries.
I will pay you handsomely for any magical items that you would be willing to part with.
What will you pay with, worldly King? What have you to offer that would be of use to such as myself?
I can offer you land, money, slaves. I'm sure there is a deal even a faerie would be willing to accept from one such as myself. I have endless riches.
And are these things truly yours to give?
Of course! I am a king I have earned what I have!
How were these things earned by you? I am curious.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Hello there, glory to the king of this land
Welcome, traveler! Did you come here to see the fights?
Oh is that what's going on here? I was just simply passing through. What type of fight's take place here?
Knights in my kingdom battle for glory, many crowds come to watch!
Interesting...I couldn't fight for entertainment though. I lost my family when I was young and don't care much for violent sports
I'm sorry to hear that. How were they killed?
They were killed by invader from the north. I was seeking vengeance for awhile but gave up when all the violence left me feeling empty.
I'm terribly sorry to hear of that. Yes, violence can be horrible.
Thank you...I don't think I've ever been touched by royalty before. Hopefully your good fortune rubs off on me.
I hope so, my friend! You deserve happiness!
Thank you for your kindness...as someone who's been alone for so long, I appreciate that.
Always know you will find kindness in my land, whenever you need it!
Thank you so much! I rarely stay in a place for more than a week. But it's nice knowing I'm welcomed somewhere if I return.
Here is an emblem from the arena to remember us by!

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Oh! Pardon me, My Lord King! I did not realise that this place was occupied!
No problem I just had to get away from the castle.  How are you this evening?
I am well, your Majesty, I just come up here to eat my dinner before sweeping up. Oh drat! My nervousness in your Kinly presence has caused me to fumble my loaf!
Thats okay we have more here perhaps we shall eat together
You flatter me , Your Highness! To break bread with a lowly, buxom young maid such as meself!
The whole kingdom is after my riches.  Breaking bread and sharing a meal with you is a nice change of pace from constantly being harassed by them for my gold.
I shall take you up on your kind offer, then! Say, just what is this place, anyway? I come here because it is usually deserted, but I wonder at the purpose of all this...
For gazing at the stars in the atmosphere.  This telescope lets us get a little peak at the wonders far beyond our mortal reach.
My mortal reach only extends as far as the bristles of my broom! I would love to see more'''
Sure if we pull that level it opens up the ceiling.  Then just point and look in to the telescope.  It is rather amazing, even as a king it makes me feel so small in comparison.
This lever here, my Liege?  Shall I pull it then? I am excited to see these wonders!
Yes absolutely by all means proceed.
Hmm, I may have to remove this, so as to not tangle in the mechanism...
I often wonder if they have kingdom's up in the sky as well.

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: I wish I could do a spell that works! Maybe just maybe some day
You are a terrible wizard.Your father made a spell to help me talk and look..I'm still talking even with him gone.
At least you can talk.... maybe i can cast a spell on you to be a toad
Ha, you would just fail!  I spied on the King this morning. Are you curious?
I am. what did you spy?
He's annoyed by your lack of skills.
And , speak up cat
He wants you to be a better wizard like your father.  I want to help you, but sadly I'm a cat who just wants to chase birds and spy on the King.
I'm trying the best that I can! My father didn't want to teach me his trade
He was a weird one. your father. Maybe we can find a spell book behind this?
Let's take a look!
Do you see anything behind it?
This old and torn book? Hmmmm
It looks well used. That might be a good sign!

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: I wonder where I will get my next meal?
I don't know, Bob. I am a disgrace. I am a failure. My life is a joke. What has happened to us.?
I'm not sure, I think it all went downhill after you lost the war to the badger-cultists.
Whoa! I don't even want to think about the badger-cultists. It's enough to drive a man to drink. As we sit in the viewing room, do you feel the spirits of the ones who left us, Bob?
I see my brother, he died in the war - he was eaten by the cultists.  My sister, who died in the plague.  And my parents who were killed in a raid by the elves.  I am ever so sad and hungry.

Oh Bob! I am so sorry. You can cry...let it out. It was awful, how it all went down. Here, maybe this book has some secrets or answers to getting some power back. Let's ask the spirits of our loved ones, to help us on this special day.
Oh no, it says my brother will suffer the eternal torment of his last moments!  That is why he appears to us without his face!
ACK!!!! Shut the book!
Why?  Why?  WHY?  Oh, I have failed you all!

No, you haven't failed anyone. It is beyond our powers. Here, have my scepter. It is the least I can do. Hopefully, when we leave here you can take it and trade it for food. I am so sorry about your brother.
Oh, thank you sire!  I will not starve this winter!
You are welcome, Bob. Life has been hard on us, but we have each other.
I never used to have much of an opinion of you, but now you have my undying gratitude!
Oh! That means the world.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Hello my king, I was summoned by the royal court?
I need your help reclaiming my kingdom!
Really? Is the kingdom in danger? I haven't heard a ruckus at all.. Are schemes afoot?
There has been an uprising by the peasants. My family and I have been cast out. It is a disgrace.
Really? Why were you cast out exactly? Maybe I can help if I know the truth..
The peasants were ungrateful and unappreciative.
Ungrateful you say....hmmm....what exactly were they unappreciative of? Your rule? Your tenure? Your laws?
They were jealous and envious of my right to rule over them.
Is that so? Let me see this ring....maybe I can enchant it with a spell then...
I knew I could count on you in these desperate times.
Here...I have enchanted it with a spell. So long as you wear this ring, everyone will be charmed by your presence within your kingdom
You truly are a great wizard!
Perhaps....all magic comes with a price though. You will not be able to use it until I receive proper payment...
Payment will have to come after I've reclaimed my kingdom.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Why are you here diver? I know why I am here... I'm taking a break
I have been tasked with finding something important.
By whom? What is of importance?
By the King! No one is as good at finding things in the sea as me
The king..... Well it seems he treats someone right.
Are you mistreated here?
Most times I am
How so?
I don't bear him ill will... It's just that I would like to be treated with respect. I know that I am on the lower rung, but I'm still human
After I gain the King's approval for finding his lost item perhaps I could speak to him on your behalf?
Please do not mention my name... I fear he will treat me with much more disdain.
As you wish.
I still need to take care of my family and that is the only job I have
I understand. If there is anything I can do please let me know.

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Hey your Majesty. Sooo.. Do you have anyone for me to torture today?
Yes we have in fact several people who will taste the scorn of our kingdom.  I am here to bear witness and be the last thing they see before they are doomed
Awesome! Send them poor souls to me. I'll teach them how to scream real nice before they hit the floor cold.
I want the heads severed so we can take them back to their loved ones as an example.
Sure thing my Majesty. This sounds like fun~
You can collect them in here.
Thank you your Majesty. I'll pop em in here when I'm done.
Get over there and take your lashings like a man!
Any last words?

what are you doing there?

okay. which kind of weapon you have?

Have you seen anything suspicious?
i don't never see it.
and why not? Are you being aware?
yes. i aware
Well, I ran into an enemy and killed them. Why didn't you see this person?
action: give sword to guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.
put sword in remnants of campfires.
room_agents: a guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.
a guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.
